Annotation.description_cn: ADB 密钥的备注信息，用于对该密钥进行额外说明或标记。
Annotation.description_en: Remarks for the ADB key, used for additional notes or tags
Annotation.example_cn: 测试专用 ADB 密钥

AuthType.description_cn:
ADB 密钥的权限类型。取值：

* `1`：root，以最高系统权限连接设备，可执行系统级操作（如修改系统文件、访问受保护目录等）。
* `2`：user，以普通用户权限连接设备，执行常规调试操作。
AuthType.description_en:
Permission type of the ADB key. Values:

* `1`: root, connects to the device with the highest system privileges and can perform system-level operations (such as modifying system files, accessing protected directories, etc.)
* `2`: user, connects to the device with regular user privileges for standard debugging operations

EffectType.description_cn:
ADB 密钥的生效范围，为空表示添加所有生效范围的密钥。取值：

* `1`：业务维度。
* `2`：实例维度。
EffectType.description_en:
Scope of the ADB key. Leave blank to add a key for all scopes. Values:

* `1`: Business level
* `2`: Instance level

KeyName.description_cn: 需要添加的 ADB 密钥名称。
KeyName.description_en: Name of the ADB key to be added

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，管理云手机资源、开展云手机业务的标识。您可以登录 [云手机控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/ACEP)，在已创建的业务卡片中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID, used to manage cloud phone resources and conduct cloud phone operations. You can log in to the [Cloud Phone Console](https://console.volcengine.com/ACEP) and obtain it from an existing business entry

PublicKey.description_cn: 用于 ADB 密钥认证的公钥内容，可通过该公钥进行云手机实例的 ADB 连接身份验证。
PublicKey.description_en: Public key content used for ADB key authentication. This public key can be used to authenticate ADB connections to cloud phone instances

CustomRouteName.description_cn: 自定义路由名称，用于标识该路由的用途，建议使用有意义的名称，方便后续管理。
CustomRouteName.description_en: Set a custom route name to identify the purpose of this route. We recommend using meaningful names for easier management.

DstIP.description_cn: 代理服务器 IP 地址，部署了代理服务的服务器 IP 地址。云手机的所有流量将通过此服务器转发。建议使用与云手机同区域（Zone）的 ECS 实例作为代理服务器以降低延迟。
DstIP.description_en: Proxy server IP address. The IP address of the server where the proxy service is deployed. All cloud phone traffic will be forwarded through this server. For lower latency, we recommend using an ECS instance in the same zone as the cloud phone as the proxy server.

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，指定该路由规则将应用于哪个业务下的云手机实例。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID specifies which business's cloud phone instances this routing rule will apply to

ProxyCipher.description_cn:
代理加密算法。当 `ProxyProtocol` 为 ss 时，此项为必填；对于 SOCKS5 协议，此项无需填写。您选择的加密算法必须与 Shadowsocks 服务端配置完全一致。支持的算法列表如下：
- aes-128-gcm
- aes-192-gcm
- aes-256-gcm
- chacha20-ietf-poly1305
- xchacha20-ietf-poly1305
- aes-128-cfb
- aes-192-cfb
- aes-256-cfb
- aes-128-ctr
- aes-192-ctr
- aes-256-ctr
- rc4-md5
- chacha20
- chacha20-ietf
- xchacha20
ProxyCipher.description_en:
Proxy encryption algorithm
This field is required when `ProxyProtocol` is set to ss; not needed for SOCKS5 protocol
The encryption algorithm you select must match the Shadowsocks server configuration exactly
Supported algorithms:
- aes-128-gcm
- aes-192-gcm
- aes-256-gcm
- chacha20-ietf-poly1305
- xchacha20-ietf-poly1305
- aes-128-cfb
- aes-192-cfb
- aes-256-cfb
- aes-128-ctr
- aes-192-ctr
- aes-256-ctr
- rc4-md5
- chacha20
- chacha20-ietf
- xchacha20

ProxyPassword.description_cn:
代理认证密码。
- `ProxyProtocol` 设为 ss 时必填，请提供与您 Shadowsocks 服务端配置一致的连接密码；
- `ProxyProtocol` 设为 socks5 时选填，如果您的 SOCKS5 服务器启用了用户名/密码认证，请在此处填写密码。为保障服务安全，我们**强烈建议**您为 SOCKS5 服务启用并配置认证。
ProxyPassword.description_en:
Proxy authentication password
- Required when `ProxyProtocol` is set to ss. Please provide the connection password that matches your Shadowsocks server configuration
- Optional when `ProxyProtocol` is set to socks5. If your SOCKS5 server uses username/password authentication, enter the password here. To keep your service secure, we strongly recommend that you enable and configure authentication for your SOCKS5 service

ProxyPort.description_cn: 代理服务端口。DstIP 上代理服务监听的端口号。
ProxyPort.description_en:
Proxy Service Port
The port number on DstIP where the proxy service listens

ProxyProtocol.description_cn:
代理协议类型。指定 DstIP 上部署的代理服务所使用的协议。当前支持以下协议：
- ss：Shadowsocks 协议。
- socks5：SOCKS5 协议。

平台将根据此参数选择合适的连接方式。
ProxyProtocol.description_en:
Proxy protocol type. Specifies the protocol used by the proxy service deployed on the DstIP. The platform currently supports the following protocols:
- ss: Shadowsocks protocol
- socks5: SOCKS5 protocol

The platform selects the appropriate connection method based on this parameter.

ProxyUserName.description_cn:
代理认证用户名。
- `ProxyProtocol` 设为 ss 时必填，请提供与您 Shadowsocks 服务端配置一致的认证用户名；
- `ProxyProtocol` 设为 socks5 时选填，如果您的 SOCKS5 服务器启用了用户名/密码认证，请在此处填写用户名。为保障服务安全，我们**强烈建议**您为 SOCKS5 服务启用并配置认证。
ProxyUserName.description_en:
Proxy authentication username
- Required when `ProxyProtocol` is set to ss. Enter the authentication username that matches your Shadowsocks server configuration
- Optional when `ProxyProtocol` is set to socks5. If your SOCKS5 server uses username/password authentication, enter the username here. To keep your service secure, we strongly recommend enabling and configuring authentication for SOCKS5

Zone.description_cn: 区域 ID。指定云手机实例所在的区域。代理服务器（DstIP）通常应与云手机位于同一区域，以获得最佳网络性能。
Zone.description_en: Region ID. Specifies the region where the cloud phone instance is located. The proxy server (DstIP) should usually be in the same region as the cloud phone for optimal network performance.

OverlayPersistProperty.description_cn: 实例初始化系统属性，持久化，重启实例后生效；详细信息，参考 [SystemProperty](#systemproperty) 定义：适用于只读系统属性，或 AOSP 原生非持久化的系统属性的修改，如 ro.product.model。
OverlayPersistProperty.description_en: Initialize instance system properties and persist them; changes take effect after restarting the instance. For details, see the [SystemProperty](#systemproperty) definition. Applicable to read-only system properties or modifications to native AOSP non-persistent system properties, such as ro.product.model.

OverlayProperty.description_cn: 实例 Settings 系统属性，非持久化，立即生效，重启实例后失效；详细信息，参考 [SystemProperty](#systemproperty) 定义。
OverlayProperty.description_en: The system property for Instance Settings is non-persistent, takes effect immediately, and becomes invalid after the instance restarts; for details, see the [SystemProperty](#systemproperty) definition.

OverlaySettings.description_cn: 实例 Settings 属性列表；详细信息，参考 [Settings](#settings) 定义。
OverlaySettings.description_en: Instance Settings property list; for details, see the [Settings](#settings) definition.

PhoneTemplateName.description_cn: 机型库名称，账户下规则名称唯一，长度不能超过 200 个字符。
PhoneTemplateName.description_en: Model library name and rule name under the account must each not exceed 200 characters. Rule name under the account must be unique

Status.description_cn:
机型库状态。

* 1：已发布
* 2：测试中
* 3：已废弃
Status.description_en:
Model Library Status

* 1: Published
* 2: Testing
* 3: Deprecated

PodIdList.description_cn: 实例 ID 列表，可通过 `ListPod` 接口获取，最大长度为 1000。
PodIdList.description_en: Instance ID list, obtainable via the `ListPod` API, maximum length is 1000.

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID, available in 'Cloud Phone Console > Business Management > Business Details'.

TagId.description_cn: 标签 ID，可通过调用 `ListTag` 接口获取，空值为删除实例已绑定标签。
TagId.description_en: Tag ID, obtainable via the `ListTag` API. Leave empty to remove tags bound to the instance.

AbsolutePath.description_cn:
- `InstallType` 为 0 时：选填。应用在实例中的绝对路径。当指定了该参数时，优先使用实例中的安装包路径安装应用，否则使用下载链接进行安装。
- `InstallType` 为 1 时：必填。应用镜像存储的根目录，如 `/ceph`，`/apkserver`，`/data/app-image`

DownloadURL.description_cn:
下载应用安装文件的地址。
使用机身存储独立安装，即 InstallType 设为 0 时必填。

ImageId.description_cn: 镜像包 ID。`InstallType` 为 1 时必填。示例：`com.abc.tmp.app_ddfklidkfa`，其中 “`ddfklidkfa`” 为镜像包 MD5 值。

InstallType.description_cn:
应用安装方式：
- 0：（默认值）机身存储独立安装；
- 1：应用镜像安装。

IsPreinstall.description_cn:
用于标记该应用是否为预安装应用：

- true：是；

- false：否。

当标记某应用为预安装应用后，重置实例时可选择是否保留该应用及相关数据。具体参看 [ResetPod](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221459) 接口的 `PreInstallAppPersistedType` 字段说明。
该参数需配合 2024 年 9 月 5 日及之后发布的公共镜像版本使用。

MD5.description_cn:
- `InstallType` 为 0 时，传入应用安装文件的 MD5 值，必须与下载的应用安装文件匹配。
- `InstallType` 为 1 时，传入镜像包的 MD5 值。

PackageName.description_cn: 应用包名。`InstallType` 为 1 时必填。

PodIdList.description_cn: 指定实例 ID 列表进行应用安装。

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取。

VersionCode.description_cn: 应用版本号。`InstallType` 为 1 时必填。

BackupAll.description_cn:
是否备份所有文件（即整机全量备份），默认为 false。

* 取值为 true 时，无需设置 IncludePathList、ExcludePathList 参数。
* 取值为 false 时，需要设置 IncludePathList、ExcludePathList 参数。

如果取值为 false 且 IncludePathList、ExcludePathList 参数均未设置，则调用接口时按整机全量备份处理。
BackupAll.description_en:
Whether to back up all files (full device backup). The default value is false.

* If set to true, you do not need to set the IncludePathList or ExcludePathList parameters.
* If set to false, you must set the IncludePathList and ExcludePathList parameters.


If set to false and both IncludePathList and ExcludePathList are not configured, the API will perform a full device backup by default.

BackupMode.description_cn:
备份模式。如果是开机状态的实例，可选择备份模式：

* `0`：（默认值）先关机实例，再进行备份，备份完成后会自动开机。
* `1`：开机状态下直接备份实例，选择该模式表明了解并确认开机操作存在一定风险。

如果是关机状态的实例，则无需传入该参数，实例会在关机状态下直接进行备份，备份完成后实例仍处于关机状态。
BackupMode.description_en:
Backup mode
If the instance is powered on, you can choose a backup mode:

* `0` (default): Shut down the instance first, then back it up. The instance will automatically start after the backup is complete
* `1`: Back up the instance directly while it is powered on. Selecting this mode means you understand and accept the risks associated with backing up a running instance

If the instance is powered off, you do not need to specify this parameter. The instance will be backed up directly while powered off, and will remain powered off after the backup is complete

Description.description_cn: 备份数据描述。最大长度为128个字符。
Description.description_en: Backup data description. Maximum length: 128 characters.

ExcludePathList.description_cn:
排除路径列表，被排除的路径不会进行数据备份，必须以 `/data/` 开头。

* 如果 BackupAll 为 true，则该参数无效。
* 列表最大长度为 10，多个路径之间使用半角逗号（`,`）分隔。
* 单个路径最大长度为 256 个字符。
ExcludePathList.description_en:
List of excluded paths. Paths in this list will not be backed up, and each path must start with `/data/`.

* If BackupAll is true, this parameter is ignored.
* The list can contain up to 10 paths, separated by half-width commas (`,`).
* Each path can be up to 256 characters long.

IncludePathList.description_cn:
包含路径列表，对该列表内的路径进行数据备份，必须以 `/data/` 开头。

* 如果 BackupAll 取值为 true，则该参数无效。
* 列表最大长度为 10，多个路径之间使用半角逗号（`,`）分隔。
* 单个路径最大长度为 256 个字符。
IncludePathList.description_en:
List of included paths. Data backup will be performed for the paths in this list, and each path must start with `/data/`.

* If BackupAll is set to true, this parameter is ignored.
* The list can contain up to 10 paths, separated by half-width commas (`,`).
* Each path can be up to 256 characters long.

PodIdList.description_cn: 实例 ID 列表，用于指定想要备份数据的源实例 ID 列表。最大长度为100。
PodIdList.description_en: Instance ID list used to specify the source instance IDs you want to back up; maximum length is 100

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，用于指定想要备份数据的实例所在业务。可登录云手机控制台，在已创建的业务卡片中获取。
ProductId.description_en: The Business ID is used to specify the business where the instance whose data you want to back up is located. Log in to the cloud phone console and obtain the Business ID from a created business card UI element.

PodIdList.description_cn: 待备份的实例 ID 列表，多个实例 ID 请以英文逗号 "," 分隔。最多支持传入 100 个实例 ID。
PodIdList.description_en: List of instance IDs to back up; separate multiple instance IDs with a comma (,). Up to 100 instance IDs are supported

ProductId.description_cn: 待备份实例所归属的业务 ID。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID associated with the instance to be backed up

ForbiddenInterval.description_cn:
封禁时长，单位：秒，取值范围为 [60, 259290]：

- 若传入值为空或 0 表示允许该用户重新连接云手机；
	
- 若传入值大于 0，且小于 60，自动调整为 60；
	
- 若传入值大于 259290，自动调整为 259290。
ForbiddenInterval.description_en:
Ban duration, unit: seconds, valid range [60, 259290]:

- If the value is empty or 0, the user is allowed to reconnect to the cloud phone.
- If the value is greater than 0 but less than 60, it will be automatically adjusted to 60.
- If the value is greater than 259290, it will be automatically adjusted to 259290.

PodId.description_cn: 实例 ID。

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID, available in 'Cloud Phone Console > Business Management > Business Details'.

Height.description_cn: 截图图片高度，参考客户端屏幕比例，可选范围：[200-2560]
Height.description_en: Screenshot image height, refer to client screen ratio, optional range: [200-2560]

IsBroadcasted.description_cn: 截图事件是否广播。true：（默认值）广播 false：不广播。
IsBroadcasted.description_en: Whether to broadcast the screenshot event. true: (default) broadcast false: do not broadcast

IsSavedOnPod.description_cn: 是否保存截图文件在云手机实例。
IsSavedOnPod.description_en: Whether to save the screenshot file in the cloud phone instance

PodIdList.description_cn: 实例 ID 列表，用于指定想要截图的实例 ID 列表。最大长度为100。
PodIdList.description_en: Instance ID list, used to specify the list of instance IDs to be captured. Maximum length is 100

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，用于指定想要截图的实例所在业务。可登录云手机控制台，在已创建的业务卡片中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID, used to specify the business where the instance to be captured is located. You can log in to the cloud phone console and obtain it from the created business card

Quality.description_cn: 截图图片质量，取值范围为 [1, 100]，默认值为 100。
Quality.description_en: Screenshot image quality, value range [1, 100], default is 100

ResizeMode.description_cn: 截图图片缩放模式 0:等比缩放，缩略图限制在指定w与h的矩形内的最大图片(默认方式);1:等比缩放，缩略图为延伸出指定w与h的矩形框外的最小图片;2:等比缩放，缩略图为延伸出指定w与h的矩形框外的最小图片，之后按照固定宽高进行裁剪;3:等比缩放，缩略图限制在指定w与h的矩形内的最大图片再按照固定宽高进行颜色填充;4:按照固定宽高强制缩放，若宽高与原图宽高比例不同，则会导致图片变形;
ResizeMode.description_en: Screenshot image scaling mode 0: Proportional scaling, thumbnail is the largest image within the specified w and h rectangle (default); 1: Proportional scaling, thumbnail is the smallest image extending outside the specified w and h rectangle; 2: Proportional scaling, thumbnail is the smallest image extending outside the specified w and h rectangle, then cropped to fixed width and height; 3: Proportional scaling, thumbnail is the largest image within the specified w and h rectangle, then filled with color to fixed width and height; 4: Forced scaling to fixed width and height, if the aspect ratio differs from the original, the image will be distorted

Rotation.description_cn: 截图画面横竖屏旋转：0：默认值，截图方向不做处理； 1：截图画面旋转为竖屏：手机竖屏的截图，不做处理；手机横屏的截图，截图顺时针旋转 90 度。
Rotation.description_en: Screenshot is rotated to portrait orientation: 0: Default value, no processing for screenshot orientation; 1: Screenshot is rotated to portrait orientation: Portrait screenshots are not processed; landscape screenshots are rotated 90 degrees clockwise.

RoundId.description_cn: 每次截图的标识ID，用于唯一标识一次截图任务，该参数传入时
RoundId.description_en: Screenshot task identifier ID, used to uniquely identify a screenshot task. When this parameter is provided

TosInfo.description_cn: 上传截图文件的Tos信息，当 UploadType 为 2 时，本参数必填，使用前需开通火山引擎对象存储访问权限，参考附件
TosInfo.description_en: TOS information for uploading screenshot files. This parameter is required when UploadType is 2. You must enable Volcengine Object Storage access before use. See the attachment for details

UploadType.description_cn: 上传截图文件的方式：1：上传到控制台配置的对象存储中；2：上传至接口指定的对象存储中。默认为 1
UploadType.description_en: Screenshot upload method: 1: Upload to the object storage configured in the console; 2: Upload to the object storage specified by the API. Default is 1

PodIdList.description_cn: 实例 ID 列表。支持同时指定多个实例 ID，多个实例 ID 之间请使用英文逗号 `,`分隔，最多可指定 100 个。
PodIdList.description_en: Instance ID list. You can specify multiple instance IDs at the same time. Separate multiple instance IDs with a comma `,`. Up to 100 instance IDs can be specified.

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，管理云手机资源、开展云手机业务的标识。可登录 [云手机控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/ACEP)，在已创建的业务卡片中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID, used to manage cloud phone resources and conduct cloud phone business. Log in to the [Cloud Phone Console](https://console.volcengine.com/ACEP) and obtain it from the created business entry.

PodIdList.description_cn: 实例 ID 列表。可通过调用 [ListPod](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221468) 接口获取。
PodIdList.description_en: Instance ID list. You can obtain the instance IDs by calling the [ListPod](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221468) API.

PortMappingRuleIdList.description_cn: 端口映射规则 ID 列表，需确保规则 ID 全局唯一；可通过调用 [CreatePortMappingRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1185240) 接口获取。
PortMappingRuleIdList.description_en: Port mapping rule ID list. Ensure that rule IDs are globally unique. You can obtain them by calling the [CreatePortMappingRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1185240) API.

ProductId.description_cn: 云手机业务 ID，可在**云手机控制台 > 业务管理 > 业务详情**中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Cloud phone business ID. You can find it in **Cloud Phone Console > Business Management > Business Details**.

ImageFileFormat.description_cn:
镜像文件格式，默认为 volc_toc。

* volc_tos：从火山引擎的 TOS 对象存储中拉取文件。选择该选项后，必须设置 ImageTosInfo 参数值。
* url：从第三方对象存储服务拉取文件，当前已支持阿里云 OSS。选择该选项后，必须设置 ImageUrlInfo 参数值。

ImageTosInfo.description_cn:
存储在火山引擎对象存储系统中的原始镜像信息，具体参数说明参见 [AOSPImgTosInfo](#aospimgtosinfo)。
ImageFileFormat 取值 volc_tos 时，该参数必填。

ImageUrlInfo.description_cn:
存储在第三方对象储存服务中的镜像文件信息，具体参数说明参见 [AOSPImgUrlInfo](#aospimgurlinfo)。
ImageFileFormat 取值 url 时，该参数必填。

PodIdList.description_cn:
取消备份的实例 ID 列表。
1. 仅支持取消“备份排队中”状态（即 `ArchiveStatus` 为 5）的实例备份，已完成备份或正在备份中的实例不支持取消操作。可调用 [`ListPod`](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221468) 接口，获取指定实例当前的 `ArchiveStatus` 值。
2. 单次接口调用支持取消备份的实例数量上限为 100。
PodIdList.description_en:
List of instance IDs for which backup will be canceled
1. Only supports canceling backups for instances in the 'Backup Queued' status (that is, `ArchiveStatus` equals 5). Backups that are completed or in progress cannot be canceled. You can call the [`ListPod`](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221468) API to get the current `ArchiveStatus` value for a specified instance.
2. A single API call can cancel backups for up to 100 instances.

ProductId.description_cn: 取消备份的实例所归属的业务 ID。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID associated with the instance whose backup is canceled

PodIdList.description_cn:
取消还原的实例 ID 列表。多个实例 ID 请以英文逗号 "," 分隔。
仅支持取消“还原排队中”状态（即 `ArchiveStatus` 为 `6`）的实例还原，已完成还原或正在还原中的实例不支持取消操作。可调用 [`ListPod`](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221468) 接口，获取指定实例当前的 `ArchiveStatus` 值。
PodIdList.description_en:
List of instance IDs to cancel restoration. Separate multiple instance IDs with an English comma (,).
You can only cancel restoration for instances in the 'Restoration Queued' status (ArchiveStatus = 6). Instances that have already been restored or are currently being restored cannot be canceled. Call the [`ListPod`](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221468) API to check the current ArchiveStatus value for a specific instance.

ProductId.description_cn: 取消还原的实例所归属的业务 ID。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID of the instance whose restore was canceled

PackageName.description_en: Package name of the app to be closed.

PodIdList.description_cn: 指定实例 ID 列表执行应用关闭任务。
PodIdList.description_en: Specify the list of instance IDs to execute the app closing task.

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID, which can be obtained in 'Cloud Phone Console > Business Management > Business Details'.

DNSName.description_cn: DNS 规则名称，支持中英文、数字、下划线、中划线，长度限制为 0~64个字符。
DNSName.description_en: DNS rule name. Supports Chinese, English, numbers, underscores, and hyphens; length limit: 0–64 characters.

Dc.description_cn: 机房 ID, 可通过 ListDc 接口获取。
Dc.description_en: Data center ID, available via the ListDc API.

IPList.description_cn: DNS 地址列表，参看 IPInfo 数据结构说明。
IPList.description_en: DNS address list. See IPInfo data structure description.

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID, available in 'Cloud Phone Console > Business Management > Business Details'.

Type.description_cn:
指定同一机房内创建的实例是否默认使用该 DNS 解析规则。
- 0：默认值，不使用该 DNS 规则；
- 1：使用该 DNS 规则。
> 同一个业务的单个 Dc 维度只支持一个默认的 DNS 策略。
Type.description_en:
Specify whether instances created in the same data center use this DNS resolution rule by default.
- 0: Default, do not use this DNS rule
- 1: Use this DNS rule
> Only one default DNS policy is supported per business per Dc.

Density.description_cn:
屏幕像素密度，单位：dpi。包含以下值：
- 160
- 240
- 320（默认值）
Density.description_en:
Screen pixel density, in dpi. Supported values:
- 160
- 240
- 320 (default)

DisplayLayoutId.description_cn: 屏幕布局 ID，支持的最大长度为 64 字节，只支持大小写字母、数字、下划线（_）、中划线（-），在同一业务下唯一，一个业务下最多可创建 100 个屏幕布局配置信息。
DisplayLayoutId.description_en: Display layout ID. Maximum length: 64 bytes. Only uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-) are supported. Must be unique within the same business. Up to 100 display layout configurations can be created per business.

Extra.description_cn: 备注信息，长度不超过 32 字节。

Fps.description_cn:
屏幕刷新率，单位：fps。包含以下值：
- 30
- 60（默认值）
Fps.description_en:
Screen refresh rate, in fps. Supported values:
- 30
- 60 (default)

Height.description_cn: 屏幕高度，取值范围在 [200, 2400] 区间的偶数，默认值为 1920，单位：px。
Height.description_en: Screen height. Must be an even number in the range [200, 2400]. Default: 1920. Unit: px.

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务信息」中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID. You can find it in 'Cloud Phone Console - Business Information'.

Width.description_cn: 屏幕宽度，取值范围在 [200, 2400] 区间的偶数，默认值为 1080，单位：px。
Width.description_en: Screen width. Must be an even number in the range [200, 2400]. Default: 1080. Unit: px.

ConsoleFileTOSKey.description_cn: 文件在tos中的key, 控制台构建时使用
ConsoleFileTOSKey.description_en: File key in TOS, used during console build

FileUrl.description_cn: 需要内置的应用或文件的下载地址；内置的文件需按照固定格式提供整体压缩包文件，文件名需为 `file.zip`。详请参考[预置应用或文件上传说明](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1181814#%E9%A2%84%E7%BD%AE%E5%BA%94%E7%94%A8%E6%88%96%E6%96%87%E4%BB%B6%E4%B8%8A%E4%BC%A0%E8%AF%B4%E6%98%8E)。
FileUrl.description_en: Download address for the required built-in apps or files; built-in files must be provided as a complete compressed package in a fixed format, with the file name as `file.zip`. For details, see [Instructions for uploading preset apps or files](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1181814#%E9%A2%84%E7%BD%AE%E5%BA%94%E7%94%A8%E6%88%96%E6%96%87%E4%BB%B6%E4%B8%8A%E4%BC%A0%E8%AF%B4%E6%98%8E).

ImageAnnotation.description_cn: 镜像描述信息，由用户按需添加镜像备注说明，便于业务识别。

ImageId.description_cn: 镜像 ID，作为构建自定义镜像的基线或基准镜像。
ImageId.description_en: Image ID, used as the baseline or base image for building a custom image.

ImageName.description_cn:
镜像名称，由用户自定义，用于业务标识。
支持英文、中文字符、数字和下划线，需以英文或中文开头，长度不超过 128 个字符。
如不指定，则使用默认名称，格式为 “公共镜像 ID+AOSP 镜像版本+账号 ID+自定义镜像”。
ImageName.description_en:
Image name, user-defined for business identification.
Supports English, Chinese characters, numbers, and underscores. Must start with an English or Chinese character, and be no longer than 128 characters.
If not specified, the default name format is 'Public Image ID+AOSP Image Version+Account ID+Custom Image'.

ProductId.description_cn: 云手机业务ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Cloud phone business ID, available in 'Cloud Phone Console - Business Management - Business Details'.

ConfigurationCode.description_cn:
运行实例的套餐规格 ID，即购买资源时选择或创建的实例规格。
当前业务下已购入的实例可选规格可以通过 [ListPodResource](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1262345) 接口查询。
更多规格信息参看[本地存储实例规格列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1473600#本地实例)或[云盘存储实例规格列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1473600#云盘实例)。
本参数创建**单实例**时必填，创建**多实例**请使用 `PodSpecList` 参数。
ConfigurationCode.description_en:
Instance specification ID for running instances, selected or created when purchasing resources.
You can query available specifications for purchased instances in your current business using the [ListPodResource](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1262345) API.
For more specification details, see the [Local Storage Instance Specification List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1473600#本地实例) or the [Cloud Disk Storage Instance Specification List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1473600#云盘实例).
This parameter is required when creating a **single instance**. To create **multiple instances**, use the `PodSpecList` parameter.

CustomRouteId.description_cn:
自定义路由规则 ID，已调用 [AddCustomRoute](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1651303) 接口创建自定义路由规则后，可使用本参数为实例匹配规则。
可选的自定义路由规则 ID 可通过 [ListCustomRoute](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1651305) 接口查询。
1. 本参数为创建**单实例**时使用，创建**多实例**请使用 `PodSpecList` 参数。
2. 需保证为实例匹配的自定义路由规则归属 Zone 与实例所在 Zone 一致。
CustomRouteId.description_en:
Custom route rule ID. After creating a custom route rule using the [AddCustomRoute](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1651303) API, you can use this parameter to match the rule to an instance.
Available custom route rule IDs can be queried via the [ListCustomRoute](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1651305) API.
1. This parameter is used when creating a **single instance**. To create **multiple instances**, use the `PodSpecList` parameter.
2. Make sure the zone of the custom route rule matches the zone of the instance.

DNSId.description_cn:
自定义 DNS 规则 ID，已调用 [CreateDNSRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1351364) 接口创建自定义 DNS 解析规则后，可使用本参数为实例匹配 DNS 规则。
可选的 DNS 规则 ID 可通过 [ListDNSRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1351360) 接口查询。
* 本参数为创建**单实例**时使用，创建**多实例**请使用 `PodSpecList` 参数。
* 需保证为实例匹配的 DNS 规则归属 Dc 与实例所在 Dc 一致。
DNSId.description_en:
Custom DNS rule ID. After you call the [CreateDNSRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1351364) API to create a custom DNS resolution rule, you can use this parameter to match DNS rules for the instance.
Available DNS rule IDs can be queried via the [ListDNSRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1351360) API.
* Use this parameter when creating a **single instance**. To create **multiple instances**, use the `PodSpecList` parameter.
* Make sure the DNS rule matched to the instance belongs to the same Dc as the instance.

DataSize.description_cn:
单个实例预期占用的存储容量，取值范围为 1Gi～128 Gi，且必须为整数。请结合实际业务情况，按需填写存储大小。
本参数仅适用于**云盘存储**方案。本地存储方案中，DataSize 为默认固定值，不支持自定义。
DataSize.description_en:
Expected storage capacity per instance. Valid range: 1Gi to 128Gi, must be an integer. Please specify the storage size based on your actual business needs.
This parameter applies only to the **cloud disk storage** solution. For local storage, DataSize is a fixed default value and cannot be customized.

Dc.description_cn:
机房 ID。
本参数为创建**单实例**时必填，创建**多实例**请使用 `PodSpecList` 参数。
Dc.description_en:
Data Center ID
This parameter is required when creating a single instance. To create multiple instances, use the `PodSpecList` parameter.

DisplayLayoutId.description_cn:
屏幕布局 ID，用于指定云手机实例的屏幕显示配置。
您可以选择系统提供的屏幕布局，也可以使用通过 [CreateDisplayLayoutMini](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1262191) 接口创建的自定义屏幕布局。

* 若使用**系统屏幕布局**，可选项包括：
   * `single-display-landscape`：1080p 横屏，分辨率 1920*1080 像素，像素密度 320 dpi，帧率 60fps；
   * `single-display-portrait`：1080p 竖屏，分辨率 1080*1920 像素，像素密度 320 dpi，帧率 60fps；
   * `single-display-portrait-720p`：高清竖屏，分辨率 720*1080 像素，像素密度 320 dpi，帧率 30fps。
* 若使用**自定义屏幕布局**，可选项可通过 [ListDisplayLayoutMini](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221495)` `接口获取。

* 本参数为创建**单实例**时使用，创建**多实例**请使用 `PodSpecList` 参数。
* 若本参数传空，则各规格实例将使用默认的系统屏幕布局。
   * 以下规格实例使用 `single-display-portrait` 1080p 竖屏布局：
      * `common`/`commonPlus`/`commonPro`
      * `enhanced`/`enhancedPlus`/`enhancedPro`
      * `ultimate`/`ultimatePlus`/`ultimatePro`
   * 以下规格实例使用 `single-display-portrait-720p` 高清竖屏布局：
      * `basic`/`basicPlus`/`basicPro`
      * `elementary`/`elementaryPlus`/`elementaryPro`
      * `sample`/`samplePlus`/`samplePro`
DisplayLayoutId.description_en:
Screen layout ID, used to specify the display configuration for a cloud phone instance.
You can choose a system-provided screen layout or use a custom layout created via the [CreateDisplayLayoutMini](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1262191) API.

* If you use a **system screen layout**, available options include:
   * `single-display-landscape`: 1080p landscape, resolution 1920*1080 pixels, pixel density 320 dpi, frame rate 60fps
   * `single-display-portrait`: 1080p portrait, resolution 1080*1920 pixels, pixel density 320 dpi, frame rate 60fps
   * `single-display-portrait-720p`: HD portrait, resolution 720*1080 pixels, pixel density 320 dpi, frame rate 30fps
* If you use a **custom screen layout**, available options can be retrieved via the [ListDisplayLayoutMini](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221495) API.

* This parameter is used when creating a **single instance**. To create **multiple instances**, use the `PodSpecList` parameter.
* If this parameter is left empty, each instance type will use the default system screen layout.
   * The following instance types use the `single-display-portrait` 1080p portrait layout:
      * `common`/`commonPlus`/`commonPro`
      * `enhanced`/`enhancedPlus`/`enhancedPro`
      * `ultimate`/`ultimatePlus`/`ultimatePro`
   * The following instance types use the `single-display-portrait-720p` HD portrait layout:
      * `basic`/`basicPlus`/`basicPro`
      * `elementary`/`elementaryPlus`/`elementaryPro`
      * `sample`/`samplePlus`/`samplePro`

DownBandwidthLimit.description_cn:
实例下行带宽上限，用于控制云手机接收数据的流量，单位：Mbps。
如需设置下行带宽限速，为确保顺畅的浏览和使用体验，建议限速值不低于 5Mbps。
默认为 0，即不限速。
本参数为创建**单实例**时使用，创建**多实例**请使用 `PodSpecList` 参数。
DownBandwidthLimit.description_en:
Instance downstream bandwidth limit, controls the data flow received by the cloud phone. Unit: Mbps
Set the downstream bandwidth limit to at least 5 Mbps to ensure smooth browsing and usage
Default is 0, meaning no speed limit
This parameter is used when creating a **single instance**. To create **multiple instances**, use the `PodSpecList` parameter

HostId.description_cn:
云机 ID，用于指定实例所归属的云机。
当前业务下的可用云机可通过 [ListHost](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221480) 接口查询。若本参数传空，系统将自动分配空余云机。
* 本参数仅适用于**本地存储**方案，即仅当 `ResourceType` 为 `200` 时生效。
* 本参数为创建**单实例**时使用，创建**多实例**请使用 `PodSpecList` 参数。
HostId.description_en:
Cloud host ID, used to specify the cloud host to which the instance belongs.
Available cloud hosts for the current business can be queried via the [ListHost](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221480) API. If this parameter is left empty, the system will automatically assign an available cloud host.
* This parameter is only applicable to the **local storage** solution, and takes effect only when `ResourceType` is set to `200`.
* Use this parameter when creating a **single instance**. To create **multiple instances**, use the `PodSpecList` parameter.

IPWhiteList.description_cn:
私有参数。支持配置白名单 IP，对白名单 IP 不限速。同时对 pod 访问的其他 IP 进行整体限速。以 ',' 分割。
本参数为创建**单实例**时使用，创建**多实例**请使用 `PodSpecList` 参数。
IPWhiteList.description_en:
Private parameter. Supports configuring allowlist IPs; allowlist IPs are not rate limited. All other IPs accessed by the pod are subject to overall rate limiting. Separate IPs with ','.
This parameter is used for creating a single instance. To create multiple instances, use the `PodSpecList` parameter.

ImageId.description_cn:
自定义镜像 ID，如不指定，则默认使用平台提供的官方标准镜像。
本参数为创建**单实例**时使用，创建**多实例**请使用 `PodSpecList` 参数。
ImageId.description_en:
Custom image ID. If not specified, the platform's official standard image is used by default.
This parameter is used for creating a **single instance**. To create **multiple instances**, use the `PodSpecList` parameter.

IsSelinuxOn.description_en: Is SELinux enabled for the instance

OverlayPersistProperty.description_cn:
持久化系统属性设置，长期有效，重启实例后仍旧保留。
* 本参数为创建**单实例**时使用，创建**多实例**请使用 `PodSpecList` 参数。
* 适用于只读系统属性，或 AOSP 原生非持久化的系统属性的修改，如 ro.product.model。
OverlayPersistProperty.description_en:
Persistent system property settings remain effective long-term and are retained after instance restart.
* Use this parameter when creating a **single instance**. For **multiple instances**, use the `PodSpecList` parameter.
* Suitable for read-only system properties or modifications to native AOSP non-persistent system properties, such as ro.product.model.

OverlayProperty.description_cn:
非持久化系统属性设置，仅在当次实例运行期间有效，重启实例后不予保留。
本参数为创建**单实例**时使用，创建**多实例**请使用 `PodSpecList` 参数
OverlayProperty.description_en:
Non-persistent system property setting; only valid during the current instance's runtime and will not be retained after restarting the instance.
This parameter is used for creating a **single instance**. To create **multiple instances**, use the `PodSpecList` parameter

OverlaySettings.description_cn:
实例初始化系统偏好设置。
本参数为创建**单实例**时使用，创建**多实例**请使用 `PodSpecList` 参数。
OverlaySettings.description_en:
Instance initialization system preference settings
Use this parameter to create a **single instance**. To create **multiple instances**, use the `PodSpecList` parameter.

PhoneTemplateId.description_cn:
机型库 ID。当 `UsePhoneTemplate` 设置为 1 时，即可使用本参数指定已发布的机型库；若本参数置空，则从已发布的机型库中随机选择一个使用。
您可以调用 **ListPhoneTemplate** 接口查询已发布（`Status` 参数传值 `1` 表示已发布）的机型库列表。
对于同一属性，通过 `OverlaySettings`、`OverlayProperty`、`OverlayPersistProperty` 设置的值优先级高于本参数中预设的值。
PhoneTemplateId.description_en:
Model library ID. When `UsePhoneTemplate` is set to 1, you can use this parameter to specify a published model library. If this parameter is left empty, a published model library will be selected at random.
You can call the **ListPhoneTemplate** API to query the list of published model libraries (`Status` parameter set to `1` means published).
For the same property, values set by `OverlaySettings`, `OverlayProperty`, or `OverlayPersistProperty` take precedence over the default value in this parameter.

PodName.description_cn:
实例名称，可自定义。如不指定，则默认与返回的实例 ID 一致。
本参数为创建**单实例**时使用，创建**多实例**请使用 `PodSpecList` 参数。
PodName.description_en:
Instance name, customizable. If not specified, defaults to the returned instance ID.
This parameter is used when creating a **single instance**. To create **multiple instances**, use the `PodSpecList` parameter.

PodSpecList.description_cn:
多实例配置项，用于在创建多实例时，指定实例的自定义配置。
创建**多实例**时必填。
PodSpecList.description_en:
Multi-instance configuration item, used to specify custom configurations for instances when creating multiple instances
Required when creating **multiple instances**

PortMappingRuleIdList.description_cn:
端口映射规则 ID 列表，已调用 [CreatePortMappingRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1185240) 接口创建端口映射规则后，可使用本参数为实例匹配端口映射规则。
可选的端口映射规则 ID 可通过 [ListPortMappingRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1285450) 接口查询。
本参数为创建**单实例**时使用，创建**多实例**请使用 `PodSpecList` 参数。
PortMappingRuleIdList.description_en:
Port mapping rule ID list. After you create port mapping rules using the [CreatePortMappingRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1185240) API, you can use this parameter to match port mapping rules for the instance.
Available port mapping rule IDs can be queried using the [ListPortMappingRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1285450) API.
This parameter is used when creating a **single instance**. To create **multiple instances**, use the `PodSpecList` parameter.

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，管理云手机资源、开展云手机业务的标识。可登录[云手机控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/ACEP)，在已创建的业务卡片中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID is an identifier for managing cloud phone resources and conducting cloud phone operations. Log in to the [Cloud Phone Console](https://console.volcengine.com/ACEP) and obtain it from an existing business entry.

ResourceType.description_cn:
实例所属业务对应的存储方案类型。
本参数默认为云盘存储方案，取值为 `100`。若当前业务（`ProductId`）对应本地存储方案，则本参数必填，取值为 `200`。
无论创建单实例还是多实例，只要使用**本地存储**方案，本参数必填 `200`。
ResourceType.description_en:
Storage solution type for the business associated with the instance
This parameter defaults to the cloud disk storage solution with a value of `100`. If the current business (`ProductId`) uses a local storage solution, this parameter is required and must be set to `200`.
Whether creating a single instance or multiple instances, if you use the **local storage** solution, this parameter is required and must be set to `200`.

Start.description_cn:
创建完成后是否立即开机。取值如下：

* `true`：是；
* `false`：（默认）否。

本参数为创建**单实例**时使用，创建**多实例**请使用 `PodSpecList` 参数。
Start.description_en:
Start instance immediately after creation? Possible values:

* `true`: Yes
* `false`: (Default) No

This parameter is used when creating a **single instance**. To create **multiple instances**, use the `PodSpecList` parameter.

TagId.description_cn:
标签 ID，已调用 [CreateTag](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1262203) 接口创建标签后，可使用本参数为实例添加分组标签。
可选的标签 ID 可通过 [ListTag](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221497) 接口查询。
本参数为创建**单实例**时使用，创建**多实例**请使用 `PodSpecList` 参数。
TagId.description_en:
Tag ID. After creating a tag using the [CreateTag](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1262203) API, you can use this parameter to add a group tag to the instance.
Available tag IDs can be queried through the [ListTag](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221497) API.
This parameter is used when creating a **single instance**. To create **multiple instances**, use the `PodSpecList` parameter.

UpBandwidthLimit.description_cn:
实例上行带宽上限，用于控制云手机发送数据的流量，单位：Mbps。
如需设置上行带宽限速，为确保顺畅的浏览和使用体验，建议限速值不低于 5Mbps。
默认为 0，即不限速。
本参数为创建**单实例**时使用，创建**多实例**请使用 `PodSpecList` 参数。
UpBandwidthLimit.description_en:
Instance uplink bandwidth limit, used to control the data traffic sent by the cloud phone. Unit: Mbps
To set an uplink bandwidth limit, we recommend a value of at least 5 Mbps for smooth browsing and user experience
The default is 0, which means no limit
This parameter is used when creating a single instance. To create multiple instances, use the `PodSpecList` parameter

UsePhoneTemplate.description_cn:
是否使用预设的机型库，已调用 **AddPhoneTemplate** 接口创建机型库后，可使用本参数选择是否使用预设机型参数。包含以下取值：

* 1：使用，此时可以通过 `PhoneTemplateId` 参数指定想要使用的机型库。
* 2：（默认）不使用。
UsePhoneTemplate.description_en:
Use preset phone model library. After calling the **AddPhoneTemplate** API to create a phone model library, you can use this parameter to choose whether to use preset phone model parameters. The following values are available:

* 1: Use. You can specify the desired phone model library with the `PhoneTemplateId` parameter
* 2: (Default) Do not use

AppList.description_cn: 应用程序列表，用于指定实例成功创建后需要安装的应用程序。
AppList.description_en: Application list for specifying which applications to install after the instance is successfully created

ConfigurationCode.description_cn:
运行实例的套餐规格 ID，即购买资源时选择或创建的实例规格。
当前业务下已购入的实例可选规格可以通过 [ListPodResource](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1262345) 接口查询。
更多规格信息参看[本地存储实例规格列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1473600#本地实例)或[云盘存储实例规格列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1473600#云盘实例)。
ConfigurationCode.description_en: The instance specification ID for the running instance refers to the specification selected or created when purchasing resources. You can query available specifications for purchased instances in your current business using the [ListPodResource](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1262345) API. For more specification details, see the [local storage instance specification list](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1473600#本地实例) or the [cloud disk storage instance specification list](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1473600#云盘实例).

CustomRouteId.description_cn:
自定义路由规则 ID，已调用 [AddCustomRoute](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1651303) 接口创建自定义路由规则后，可使用本参数为实例匹配规则。
可选的自定义路由规则 ID 可通过 [ListCustomRoute](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1651305) 接口查询。
需保证为实例匹配的自定义路由规则归属 Zone 与实例所在 Zone 一致。
CustomRouteId.description_en:
Custom route rule ID. After creating a custom route rule using the [AddCustomRoute](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1651303) API, you can use this parameter to match rules for the instance.
Available custom route rule IDs can be queried through the [ListCustomRoute](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1651305) API.
Make sure the Zone of the custom route rule matched for the instance is the same as the Zone where the instance is located.

DNSId.description_cn:
自定义 DNS 规则 ID，已调用 [CreateDNSRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1351364) 接口创建自定义 DNS 解析规则后，可使用本参数为实例匹配 DNS 规则。
可选的 DNS 规则 ID 可通过 [ListDNSRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1351360) 接口查询。
请确保为实例匹配的 DNS 规则归属 Dc 与实例所在 Dc 一致。
DNSId.description_en:
Custom DNS rule ID. After you create a custom DNS resolution rule using the [CreateDNSRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1351364) API, you can use this parameter to match DNS rules to the instance.
Available DNS rule IDs can be queried through the [ListDNSRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1351360) API.
Make sure the Dc of the matched DNS rule is the same as the Dc of the instance.

DataSize.description_cn:
创建的实例预期占用的存储容量，取值范围为 1Gi～128 Gi，且必须为整数。请结合实际业务情况，按需填写存储大小。
* 本参数为创建**单实例**时使用，创建**多实例**请使用 `PodSpecList` 参数。
* 本参数仅适用于**云盘存储**方案。本地存储方案中，DataSize 为默认固定值，不支持自定义。
DataSize.description_en:
The expected storage capacity for the created instance must be an integer between 1Gi and 128Gi. Please specify the storage size as needed based on your actual business requirements.
* This parameter is used when creating a **single instance**. To create **multiple instances**, use the `PodSpecList` parameter.
* This parameter applies only to the **cloud disk storage** solution. For local storage, DataSize is a fixed default value and cannot be customized.

DisplayLayoutId.description_cn:
屏幕布局 ID，用于指定云手机实例的屏幕显示配置。
您可以选择系统提供的屏幕布局，也可以使用通过 [CreateDisplayLayoutMini](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1262191) 接口创建的自定义屏幕布局。

* 若使用**系统屏幕布局**，可选项包括：
   * `single-display-landscape`：1080p 横屏，分辨率 1920*1080 像素，像素密度 320 dpi，帧率 60fps；
   * `single-display-portrait`：1080p 竖屏，分辨率 1080*1920 像素，像素密度 320 dpi，帧率 60fps；
   * `single-display-portrait-720p`：高清竖屏，分辨率 720*1080 像素，像素密度 320 dpi，帧率 30fps。
* 若使用**自定义屏幕布局**，可选项可通过 [ListDisplayLayoutMini](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221495)` `接口获取。

若本参数传空，则各规格实例将使用默认的系统屏幕布局。

* 以下规格实例使用 `single-display-portrait` 1080p 竖屏布局：
   * `common`/`commonPlus`/`commonPro`
   * `enhanced`/`enhancedPlus`/`enhancedPro`
   * `ultimate`/`ultimatePlus`/`ultimatePro`
* 以下规格实例使用 `single-display-portrait-720p` 高清竖屏布局：
   * `basic`/`basicPlus`/`basicPro`
   * `elementary`/`elementaryPlus`/`elementaryPro`
   * `sample`/`samplePlus`/`samplePro`
DisplayLayoutId.description_en:
Screen layout ID, used to specify the display configuration for cloud phone instances.
You can choose a system-provided screen layout or use a custom layout created via the [CreateDisplayLayoutMini](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1262191) API.

* If you use a **system screen layout**, available options include:
   * `single-display-landscape`: 1080p landscape, resolution 1920*1080 pixels, pixel density 320 dpi, frame rate 60 fps
   * `single-display-portrait`: 1080p portrait, resolution 1080*1920 pixels, pixel density 320 dpi, frame rate 60 fps
   * `single-display-portrait-720p`: HD portrait, resolution 720*1080 pixels, pixel density 320 dpi, frame rate 30 fps
* If you use a **custom screen layout**, available options can be retrieved via the [ListDisplayLayoutMini](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221495) API.

If this parameter is left empty, each instance type will use the default system screen layout.

* The following instance types use the `single-display-portrait` 1080p portrait layout:
   * `common`/`commonPlus`/`commonPro`
   * `enhanced`/`enhancedPlus`/`enhancedPro`
   * `ultimate`/`ultimatePlus`/`ultimatePro`
* The following instance types use the `single-display-portrait-720p` HD portrait layout:
   * `basic`/`basicPlus`/`basicPro`
   * `elementary`/`elementaryPlus`/`elementaryPro`
   * `sample`/`samplePlus`/`samplePro`

DownBandwidthLimit.description_cn:
实例下行带宽上限，用于控制云手机接收数据的流量，单位：Mbps。
如需设置下行带宽限速，为确保顺畅的浏览和使用体验，建议限速值不低于 5Mbps。
默认为 0，即不限速。
DownBandwidthLimit.description_en:
Instance downstream bandwidth limit, used to control the data traffic received by the cloud phone. Unit: Mbps
To set a downstream bandwidth limit, it is recommended to use a value of at least 5 Mbps to ensure smooth browsing and user experience
Default is 0, meaning no speed limit

HostId.description_cn:
云机 ID，用于指定实例所归属的云机。
当前业务下的可用云机可通过 [ListHost](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221480) 接口查询。若本参数传空，系统将自动分配空余云机。
本参数仅适用于**本地存储**方案，即仅当 `ResourceType` 为 `200` 时生效。
HostId.description_en:
Cloud Host ID, used to specify the cloud host to which the instance belongs.
Available cloud hosts for the current business can be queried via the [ListHost](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221480) API. If this parameter is left blank, the system will automatically assign an available cloud host.
This parameter is only applicable for the **local storage** solution, meaning it takes effect only when `ResourceType` is set to `200`.

IPWhiteList.description_cn: 私有参数。配置白名单 IP，对白名单 IP 不限速，同时对 pod 访问的其他 IP 进行整体限速。以 ',' 分割。
IPWhiteList.description_en: Private parameter. Configure allowlist IPs; allowlist IPs are not rate-limited, while all other IPs accessed by the pod are subject to overall rate limiting. Separate with ','

ImageId.description_cn: 自定义镜像 ID，如不指定，则默认使用平台提供的官方标准镜像。
ImageId.description_en: Custom image ID. If not specified, the platform's official standard image is used by default

IsPreinstall.description_cn:
用于标记 `AppList` 中传入的应用是否作为预安装应用。
当标记某应用为预安装应用后，重置实例时可选择是否保留该应用及相关数据。具体参看 [ResetPod](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221459) 接口的 `PreInstallAppPersistedType` 字段说明。

* true：是；
* false：（默认）否。

* 该参数需配合 2024 年 9 月 5 日及之后发布的公共镜像版本使用。
* 后缀为 .xapk 的应用，不支持标记为预安装应用。如果安装 .xapk 应用时 IsPreinstall 参数取值为 true，请求将会失败。
IsPreinstall.description_en:
Used to indicate whether the apps passed in via `AppList` are pre-installed apps.
When an app is marked as a pre-installed app, you can choose whether to retain the app and its related data when resetting the instance. For details, see the `PreInstallAppPersistedType` field description in the [ResetPod](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221459) API.

* true: Yes
* false: (default) No

* This parameter must be used with public image versions released on or after September 5, 2024.
* Apps with the .xapk suffix cannot be marked as pre-installed apps. If the IsPreinstall parameter is set to true when installing a .xapk app, the request will fail.

IsSelinuxOn.description_en: Is SELinux enabled for the instance

OverlayPersistProperty.description_cn:
持久化系统属性设置，长期有效，重启实例后仍旧保留。
适用于只读系统属性，或 AOSP 原生非持久化的系统属性的修改，如 ro.product.model。
OverlayPersistProperty.description_en:
Persistent system property settings remain effective long-term and are retained after instance restart
Applies to read-only system properties or modifications to AOSP native non-persistent system properties, such as ro.product.model

OverlayProperty.description_cn: 非持久化系统属性设置，仅在当次实例运行期间有效，重启实例后不予保留。
OverlayProperty.description_en: Non-persistent system property setting; only valid while the current instance is running. Not retained after restarting the instance.

OverlaySettings.description_cn: 实例初始化系统偏好设置。

PhoneTemplateId.description_cn:
机型库 ID。当 `UsePhoneTemplate` 设置为 1 时，即可使用本参数指定已发布的机型库；若本参数置空，则从已发布的机型库中随机选择一个使用。
您可以调用 **ListPhoneTemplate** 接口查询已发布（`Status` 参数传值 `1` 表示已发布）的机型库列表。
对于同一属性，通过 `OverlaySettings`、`OverlayProperty`、`OverlayPersistProperty` 设置的值优先级高于本参数中预设的值。
PhoneTemplateId.description_en:
Device template library ID. When `UsePhoneTemplate` is set to 1, you can use this parameter to specify a published device template library. If this parameter is left empty, a published device template library will be selected at random.
You can call the **ListPhoneTemplate** API to query the list of published device template libraries (`Status` parameter set to `1` indicates published).
For the same property, values set by `OverlaySettings`, `OverlayProperty`, or `OverlayPersistProperty` take precedence over the default value in this parameter.

PodName.description_cn: 实例名称，可自定义。如不指定，则默认与返回的实例 ID 一致。
PodName.description_en: Instance name can be customized. If not specified, it defaults to the returned instance ID.

PortMappingRuleIdList.description_cn:
端口映射规则 ID 列表，已调用 [CreatePortMappingRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1185240) 接口创建端口映射规则后，可使用本参数为实例匹配端口映射规则。
可选的端口映射规则 ID 可通过 [ListPortMappingRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1285450) 接口查询。
PortMappingRuleIdList.description_en:
Port mapping rule ID list. After creating port mapping rules using the [CreatePortMappingRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1185240) API, you can use this parameter to match port mapping rules to instances.
Available port mapping rule IDs can be queried using the [ListPortMappingRule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1285450) API.

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，管理云手机资源、开展云手机业务的标识。可登录[云手机控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/ACEP)，在已创建的业务卡片中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID, used to manage cloud phone resources and conduct cloud phone business. Log in to the [Cloud Phone Console](https://console.volcengine.com/ACEP) to obtain it from the business cards you have already created.

ResourceType.description_cn:
实例所属业务对应的存储方案类型。
本参数默认为云盘存储方案，取值为 `100`。若当前业务（`ProductId`）对应本地存储方案，则本参数必填，取值为 `200`。
ResourceType.description_en:
Storage solution type for the business associated with the instance
This parameter defaults to the cloud disk storage solution with a value of `100`
If the current business (`ProductId`) uses a local storage solution, this parameter is required and the value should be `200`

TagId.description_cn:
标签 ID，已调用 [CreateTag](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1262203) 接口创建标签后，可使用本参数为实例添加分组标签。
可选的标签 ID 可通过 [ListTag](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221497) 接口查询。
TagId.description_en:
Tag ID. After creating a tag using the [CreateTag](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1262203) API, you can use this parameter to add a group tag to an instance.
Available Tag IDs can be queried using the [ListTag](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221497) API.

UpBandwidthLimit.description_cn:
实例上行带宽上限，用于控制云手机发送数据的流量，单位：Mbps。
如需设置上行带宽限速，为确保顺畅的浏览和使用体验，建议限速值不低于 5Mbps。
默认为 0，即不限速。
UpBandwidthLimit.description_en: Instance uplink bandwidth limit, used to control the data sent by the cloud phone. Unit: Mbps. To ensure smooth browsing and user experience, it is recommended to set the limit to no less than 5 Mbps. The default value is 0, which means no limit.

UsePhoneTemplate.description_cn:
是否使用预设的机型库，已调用 **AddPhoneTemplate** 接口创建机型库后，可使用本参数选择是否使用预设机型参数。包含以下取值：

* 1：使用，此时可以通过 `PhoneTemplateId` 参数指定想要使用的机型库。
* 2：（默认）不使用。
UsePhoneTemplate.description_en:
Choose whether to use the preset phone model library. After you call the **AddPhoneTemplate** API to create a model library, you can use this parameter to select whether to use preset model parameters. Available values:

* 1: Use. You can specify the desired model library with the `PhoneTemplateId` parameter
* 2: (Default) Do not use

Direction.description_cn:
方向类型。取值如下：
- Inbound：入向（默认）
- Bidirectional：双向
当前在中国大陆内，该参数仅在华北/石家庄、华东/扬州、华南/广州等部分机房节点支持设置，若有涉及，请联系技术支持团队确认。
Direction.description_en:
Direction type. Possible values:
- Inbound: Incoming (default)
- Bidirectional: Bidirectional
Currently in the Chinese mainland, this parameter is only supported at certain data center nodes in North China/Shijiazhuang, East China/Yangzhou, and South China/Guangzhou. If involved, please contact the technical support team for confirmation.

Isp.description_cn:
运营商信息。取值如下：
- 1：移动（默认）。
- 2：联通。
- 4：电信。
- 7：三条运营商线路各开一个。
- 8：BGP，香港地区。当 `VolcRegion` 设为 `cn-hongkong-pop` 时生效。
当前在中国大陆内，该参数仅在华北/石家庄、华东/扬州、华南/广州等部分机房节点支持设置，若有涉及，请联系技术支持团队确认。
Isp.description_en:
Carrier information. Possible values:
- 1: Mobile (default)
- 2: Unicom
- 4: Telecom
- 7: One line for each of the three carriers
- 8: BGP, Hong Kong region. Takes effect when `VolcRegion` is set to `cn-hongkong-pop`.
Currently in the Chinese mainland, this parameter is only supported at certain data center nodes in North China/Shijiazhuang, East China/Yangzhou, and South China/Guangzhou. If involved, please contact the technical support team for confirmation.

PortMappingRuleId.description_cn: 端口映射规则 ID，需确保规则 ID 全局唯一；如不指定，由系统随机生成。
PortMappingRuleId.description_en: Port mapping rule ID. The rule ID must be globally unique. If not specified, the system will generate one randomly.

ProductId.description_cn: 云手机业务 ID，可在**云手机控制台 > 业务管理 > 业务详情**中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Cloud phone service ID, available in **Cloud Phone Console > Service Management > Service Details**.

Protocol.description_cn:
端口映射的协议类型，取值如下：

- `tcp`：（默认） TCP 协议类型。
- `udp`：UDP 协议类型。
Protocol.description_en:
Protocol type for port mapping. Options are:

- `tcp`: (Default) TCP protocol type
- `udp`: UDP protocol type

SourcePort.description_cn: 源端口号，您可根据自身业务需求，自定义配置端口号。
SourcePort.description_en: Source port number. You can customize the port number based on your business needs.

VolcRegion.description_cn:
资源所在的物理区域，包含以下选项：

- `inner`：中国大陆（默认值）
- `cn-hongkong-pop`：中国香港
VolcRegion.description_en:
Physical region where the resource is located. Options include:

- `inner`: Chinese mainland (default)
- `cn-hongkong-pop`: Hong Kong, China

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID, available in "Cloud Phone Console - Business Management - Business Details".

ImageIdList.description_cn: 镜像 ID 列表，单次请求可同时传入最多 10 个 ID。
ImageIdList.description_en: Image ID list. You can specify up to 10 IDs in a single request.

KeyIdList.description_cn: 待删除的 ADB 密钥的 ID 列表，可通过 [ListAdbKey](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/2571039) 接口查询。
KeyIdList.description_en: List of IDs for ADB keys to be deleted. You can query these IDs using the [ListAdbKey](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/2571039) API.

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，管理云手机资源、开展云手机业务的标识。可登录 [云手机控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/ACEP)，在已创建的业务卡片中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID, used to manage cloud phone resources and identify cloud phone business. Log in to the [Cloud Phone Console](https://console.volcengine.com/ACEP) and obtain it from the business card section in the console.

AppId.description_cn: 应用 ID，可通过调用 `ListApp` 接口获取。
AppId.description_en: App ID, can be obtained by calling the `ListApp` API.

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取。
ProductId.description_en: You can find the Business ID in "Cloud Phone Console > Business Management > Business Details".

BackupDataIdList.description_cn: 备份数据 ID 列表。最大长度为100。
BackupDataIdList.description_en: Backup data ID list. Maximum length is 100.

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，用于指定想要删除备份数据所在业务。可登录云手机控制台，在已创建的业务卡片中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID used to specify the business where the backup data you want to delete is located. Log in to the cloud phone console and obtain it from an existing business entry.

CustomRouteId.description_cn: 待删除的自定义路由 ID，可通过 `ListCustomRoute` 接口获取。
CustomRouteId.description_en: Custom route IDs to be deleted, obtainable via the `ListCustomRoute` API

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，待删除规则所生效的业务。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID: business where the rule to be deleted is effective

DNSId.description_cn: DNS 规则 ID，可通过调用 ListDNSRule 接口获取。
DNSId.description_en: DNS rule ID, can be obtained by calling the ListDNSRule API.

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID, can be found in 'Cloud Phone Console > Business Management > Business Details'.

DisplayLayoutId.description_cn: 屏幕布局 ID，可通过调用 `ListDisplayLayout` 接口获取。
DisplayLayoutId.description_en: Screen layout ID, which can be obtained by calling the `ListDisplayLayout` API

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID, which can be obtained in 'Cloud Phone Console - Business Management - Business Details'

ForceDestroyFlag.description_cn:
是否强制销毁实例：
- true：支持开机状态下销毁实例。
- false：默认，不强制销毁实例，如不填写，在开机状态调用本接口销毁实例时会失败。
ForceDestroyFlag.description_en:
Force destroy instance:
- true: Allows instance deletion while powered on.
- false: Default. Does not force destroy the instance. If not specified, deletion will fail when the instance is powered on.

PodId.description_cn:
实例 ID，可通过调用 `ListPod` 接口获取。指定该参数时，仅销毁单个实例。
> 与 `PodIdList` 二选一。

PodIdList.description_cn:

APIBodyHash.description_en:
SHA256 hash value of the API request body. Optional parameter. When the request type for APIType is POST, PUT, or PATCH:

* If the request body participates in signature calculation, set this parameter to the SHA256 hash value of the request body content.
* If the request body does not participate in signature calculation, set this parameter to `UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD`.

APIPayload.description_en: API request parameters. Used to pass the parameters required for the API call. The key is the parameter name, and the value is the parameter value. The specific parameters to be passed depend on the requirements of the interface corresponding to APIType, and will ultimately participate in the generation and signing of the pre-signed link as query parameters.

APIType.description_cn:
API 请求方法类型。用于指定生成预签名直连链接所对应的 API 调用类型。当前已支持的类型如下：

* TakeScreenshot：获取云手机实例当前屏幕截图，用于画面预览、状态检查或问题定位。
* RunSyncCommand：在云手机实例中同步执行命令，并返回命令执行结果。
* UploadFile：将本地文件上传到云手机实例中的指定位置。
* DownloadFile：从云手机实例中下载指定文件到本地。
* Frp：建立基于 FRP 的内网穿透连接，用于访问云手机的服务端口。
* SandboxWebshell：打开沙箱 WebShell 会话，用于通过网页终端操作沙箱环境。
* SandboxExecute：在沙箱环境中执行指定命令或任务，并获取执行结果。
* SandboxHealthz：检查沙箱环境的健康状态，用于判断沙箱服务是否可用。
* SandboxGwTermAttach：通过沙箱网关附加到已有终端会话，用于继续交互式操作。
* SandboxGwTermExecute：通过沙箱网关在终端中执行命令，用于远程操作沙箱环境。
* SandboxGwAgentChat：通过沙箱网关与 Agent 服务进行对话，用于触发或控制智能体任务。
* SandboxGwAgentHealth：通过沙箱网关检查 Agent 服务健康状态，用于确认智能体服务是否可用。
* SandboxGwOpenclawChat：通过沙箱网关与 OpenClaw 服务进行对话，用于执行 OpenClaw 相关交互任务。
* SandboxGwOpenclawHealth：通过沙箱网关检查 OpenClaw 服务健康状态，用于确认 OpenClaw 服务是否可用。
APIType.description_en:
API request method type. Specifies the API call type for generating a pre-signed direct access link. The currently supported types are:

* TakeScreenshot: Capture the current screen of the cloud phone instance for preview, status check, or troubleshooting
* RunSyncCommand: Execute a command synchronously in the cloud phone instance and return the result
* UploadFile: Upload a local file to a specified location in the cloud phone instance
* DownloadFile: Download a specified file from the cloud phone instance to your local device
* Frp: Establish an FRP-based intranet penetration connection to access the service port of the cloud phone
* SandboxWebshell: Open a sandbox WebShell session to operate the sandbox environment via a web terminal
* SandboxExecute: Execute a specified command or task in the sandbox environment and obtain the result
* SandboxHealthz: Check the health status of the sandbox environment to determine if the sandbox service is available
* SandboxGwTermAttach: Attach to an existing terminal session via the sandbox gateway to continue interactive operations
* SandboxGwTermExecute: Execute commands in the terminal via the sandbox gateway for remote sandbox operations
* SandboxGwAgentChat: Communicate with the Agent service via the sandbox gateway to trigger or control agent tasks
* SandboxGwAgentHealth: Check the health status of the Agent service via the sandbox gateway to confirm agent service availability
* SandboxGwOpenclawChat: Communicate with the OpenClaw service via the sandbox gateway to perform OpenClaw-related interactive tasks
* SandboxGwOpenclawHealth: Check the health status of the OpenClaw service via the sandbox gateway to confirm OpenClaw service availability

NextToken.description_cn:
分页查询凭证，用于标记查询数据的起始位置。

* 初次查询时无需设置，服务器将根据筛选条件返回一部分数据，并返回一个 NextToken 凭证值记录这批数据的结尾位置，作为下次查询的起始位置。
* 后续查询中，将上一次查询时返回的 NextToken 作为参数传入，服务器会从该位置继续返回后续数据。

1. 重复调用本接口进行接续查询时，不可修改原始筛选条件，否则会影响查询数据的连贯性和准确性。如需修改筛选条件，请将本参数置空，从第一条数据开始重新查询。
2. 接口返回的 NextToken 有效期为 2 小时，若传入过期或无效的值，服务器将从第一条数据开始重新查询并返回。
NextToken.description_en:
Pagination token, used to mark the starting position for querying data.

* No need to set this for the initial query. The server will return a portion of data based on the filter criteria and provide a NextToken value to record the end position of this batch, which serves as the starting point for the next query.
* For subsequent queries, pass the NextToken returned from the previous query as a parameter. The server will continue returning data from that position.

1. When repeatedly calling this API for continuous queries, do not modify the original filter criteria, as this may affect the continuity and accuracy of the queried data. If you need to change the filter criteria, clear this parameter and start a new query from the first record.
2. The NextToken returned by the API is valid for 2 hours. If you provide an expired or invalid value, the server will start a new query from the first record and return the results.

更多规格信息参看 [本地存储实例规格列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1473600#%E6%9C%AC%E5%9C%B0%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B)。
ConfigurationCode.description_en:
Instance specification ID. Specify an instance specification to query details of all cloud machines under your business that use this specification.
For more specification information, see [Local Storage Instance Specification List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1473600#%E6%9C%AC%E5%9C%B0%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B).

Dc.description_cn: 机房 ID。可通过指定机房 ID，查询该机房内的云机详情。
Dc.description_en: Data center ID. Specify a data center ID to query details of cloud machines in that data center.

ExpireTimeBefore.description_cn: 过期时间小于此时间的云机，用于筛选即将过期的预付费云机。时间需大于当前时间，且与当前时间的最长跨度为 10 天，支持预付费云机。
ExpireTimeBefore.description_en: Cloud machines with expiration time earlier than this time, used to filter prepaid cloud machines that are about to expire. The time must be later than the current time, and the maximum span from the current time is 10 days. Supports prepaid cloud machines

HostIdList.description_cn: 云机 ID 列表。指定多个云机查询时使用，多个 ID 请使用英文逗号 `,` 分隔，最多支持指定 100 个 ID。
HostIdList.description_en: Cloud host ID list. Use this to query multiple cloud hosts. Separate multiple IDs with an English comma (,). Up to 100 IDs can be specified.

MaxResults.description_cn: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，默认值为 `10`，最大值为 `100`。
MaxResults.description_en: Number of rows per page for paginated queries. Default is `10`, maximum is `100`.

NextToken.description_cn: 分页查询凭证，用于标记分页的位置。初次调用该接口时无需设置。下次查询时，取值为上一次 API 调用返回的 `NextToken` 参数值。如果提供的 `NextToken`无效，则会从第一条记录开始返回，不会产生错误。
NextToken.description_en: Pagination token used to mark the position for paginated queries. No need to set this when calling the API for the first time. For subsequent queries, use the value returned in the `NextToken` parameter from the previous API call. If the provided `NextToken` is invalid, results will be returned starting from the first record without causing an error

PodId.description_cn: 实例 ID，可通过调用 ListPod 接口获取
PodId.description_en: Instance ID, can be obtained by calling the ListPod API

PodIdList.description_cn: 实例 ID 列表。可通过指定过个实例 ID，查询各实例所在云机的详情。多个实例 ID 请使用英文逗号 `,`分隔，最多支持指定 100 个实例 ID。
PodIdList.description_en: Instance ID list. You can specify multiple instance IDs to query the details of the cloud hosts where each instance resides. Separate multiple instance IDs with an English comma (,). Up to 100 instance IDs can be specified.

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，管理云手机资源、开展云手机业务的标识。可登录 [云手机控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/ACEP)，在已创建的业务卡片中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID, used to manage cloud phone resources and identify cloud phone business. Log in to the [Cloud Phone Console](https://console.volcengine.com/ACEP) to obtain it from the created business entry

Region.description_cn:
云机所在的大区 ID。可通过指定大区 ID，查询该大区内的云机详情。

* 当资源所在区域选择中国大陆，即 `VolcRegion` 设置为 `inner` 时，该参数可选值包含：
   * `cn-north`：华北
   * `cn-south`：华南
   * `cn-east`：华东
   * `cn-middle`：华中
   * `cn-southwest`：西南
* 当资源所在区域选择中国香港，即 `VolcRegion` 设置为 `cn-hongkong-pop` 时，该参数可选值为 `cn-hongkong-pop`。
Region.description_en:
Region ID where the cloud machine is located. Specify a region ID to query details of cloud machines in that region.

* When the resource region is set to Chinese mainland, that is, `VolcRegion` is set to `inner`, the available values are:
   * `cn-north`: North China
   * `cn-south`: South China
   * `cn-east`: East China
   * `cn-middle`: Central China
   * `cn-southwest`: Southwest China
* When the resource region is set to Hong Kong, that is, `VolcRegion` is set to `cn-hongkong-pop`, the available value is `cn-hongkong-pop`.

StatusList.description_cn:
云机状态列表。可通过指定一个或多个状态，筛选云机进行查询。多个云机状态请使用英文逗号 `,` 分隔。取值如下：

* `0`：初始化
* `1`：正常
* `2`：退订中
* `3`：异常
* `4`：重置中
* `5`：重启中
StatusList.description_en:
Cloud machine status list. You can filter cloud machines by specifying one or more statuses. Separate multiple statuses with a comma `,`. The available values are:

* `0`: Initializing
* `1`: Normal
* `2`: Unsubscribing
* `3`: Abnormal
* `4`: Resetting
* `5`: Rebooting

SyncRenewType.description_cn: 是否返回预付费云机的续费类型信息。仅当该参数设置为 `true` 时，接口才会返回续费类型信息。
SyncRenewType.description_en: Whether to return renewal type information for prepaid cloud machines. The API returns renewal type information only when this parameter is set to `true`.

UseStatus.description_cn:
云机的使用状态，用于标识云机实例的占用情况。支持的取值如下：

* `1`：未占用，实例数为 0
* `2`：已占用，实例未占满
* `3`：已占满，实例已占满
UseStatus.description_en:
Cloud machine usage status, used to indicate the occupancy of cloud machine instances. Supported values are:

* `1`: Not occupied, number of instances is 0
* `2`: Occupied, instances not fully occupied
* `3`: Fully occupied, instances fully occupied

VolcRegion.description_cn:
云机所在的物理区域，包含以下选项：

* `inner`：中国大陆（默认值）
* `cn-hongkong-pop`：中国香港
VolcRegion.description_en:
Physical region where the cloud machine is located. Options include:

* `inner`: Chinese mainland (default value)
* `cn-hongkong-pop`: Hong Kong, China

Count.description_cn:
单次查询返回的最大记录数，用于控制每次查询返回的数据量。例如，若 `Count` 为 100，则表示在查询数据时，系统将每次返回 100 条记录。
可与 `Offset` 配合使用。假设当前数据集的记录总数为 200 条，如需查询第 101～150 条数据，需设置 `Offset` 为 100，`Count` 为 50。
Count.description_en:
The maximum number of records returned per query, used to control the amount of data returned each time. For example, if `Count` is 100, the system will return 100 records per query.
Can be used with `Offset`. If the current dataset contains 200 records and you want to query records 101–150, set `Offset` to 100 and `Count` to 50.

ImageIdList.description_cn:
指定需要查询的镜像 ID 列表。多个镜像 ID 使用英文 "," 分隔。
该参数置空时，系统将默认返回业务下所有镜像 ID 的分布情况。
ImageIdList.description_en:
Specify the list of image IDs to query. Separate multiple image IDs with an English comma ",".
If this parameter is left empty, the system will return the distribution of all image IDs under the business by default.

Offset.description_cn:
查询结果的起始位置，用于指定从哪一条记录开始返回数据。例如，若 `Offset` 为 10，则表示从第 11 条记录开始。默认值为 0。
可与 `Count` 配合使用。假设当前数据集的记录总数为 200 条，如需查询第 101～150 条数据，需设置 `Offset` 为 100，`Count` 为 50。
Offset.description_en:
Starting position of the query results, used to specify from which record to begin returning data. For example, if `Offset` is 10, data will be returned starting from the 11th record. The default value is 0.
Can be used with `Count`. If the current dataset contains 200 records and you want to query records 101–150, set `Offset` to 100 and `Count` to 50.

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，可在「云手机控制台-业务管理-业务详情」中获取
ProductId.description_en: Business ID, which can be obtained in "Cloud Phone Console - Business Management - Business Details"

IsPublic.description_en: Is this a public device model library?

MaxResults.description_cn:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。

* 最大值：100
* 默认值：10
MaxResults.description_en:
Number of rows per page for paginated queries

* Maximum: 100
* Default: 10

NextToken.description_cn: 分页查询凭证，用于标记分页的位置。初次调用该接口时无需设置。下次查询时，取值为上一次 API 调用返回的 NextToken 参数值。NextToken 无效会从第一条记录开始返回，不会产生错误。
NextToken.description_en: Pagination token used to mark the position in paginated queries. You do not need to set this when calling the API for the first time. For subsequent queries, set its value to the NextToken returned by the previous API call. If NextToken is invalid, results will start from the first record and no error will occur.

PhoneTemplateName.description_cn: 机型库名称，账户下机型库名称唯一。
PhoneTemplateName.description_en: The model library name must be unique within the account

Status.description_cn:
机型库状态。

* 1：已发布
* 2：测试中
* 3：已废弃
Status.description_en:
Model Library Status

* 1: Published
* 2: Testing
* 3: Deprecated

ArchiveStatus.description_cn:
实例备份/还原状态。本地存储业务若已调用 [BackupPod](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1398954) 或 [RestorePod](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1398957) 接口对实例执行备份还原操作，使用本参数可以筛选出对应状态的云手机实例进行查询。取值如下：

* `-2`：还原失败
* `-1`：备份失败
* `0`：正常状态
* `1`：备份中
* `2`：备份完成
* `3`：还原中
* `5`：备份排队中
* `6`：还原排队中
* `7`：备份取消中
* `8`：还原取消中
ArchiveStatus.description_en:
Instance backup/restore status. If the Local Storage service has called the [BackupPod](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1398954) or [RestorePod](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1398957) API to perform backup or restore operations on an instance, you can use this parameter to filter and query cloud phone instances with the corresponding status. The values are as follows:

* `-2`: Restore failed
* `-1`: Backup failed
* `0`: Normal
* `1`: Backing up
* `2`: Backup completed
* `3`: Restoring
* `5`: Backup queued
* `6`: Restore queued
* `7`: Backup being canceled
* `8`: Restore being canceled

AuthorityStatus.description_cn:
实例运维授权状态。使用本参数可以筛选出指定运维状态的云手机实例进行查询。包含以下取值：

* `1`：未授权
* `2`：已授权
AuthorityStatus.description_en:
Instance O&M authorization status. Use this parameter to filter and query cloud phone instances with the specified O&M status. The possible values are:

* `1`: Not authorized
* `2`: Authorized

ConfigurationCodeList.description_cn:
云手机实例套餐规格 ID。使用本参数可以筛选出指定规格的云手机实例进行查询。
当前业务下已购入的实例可选规格可以通过 [ListPodResource](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1262345) 接口查询。
ConfigurationCodeList.description_en:
Cloud phone instance package specification ID. Use this parameter to filter and query cloud phone instances with the specified specification.
You can query the available specifications for purchased instances under the current service through the [ListPodResource](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1262345) API.

DNSId.description_cn: DNS 规则 ID。关联了自定义 DNS 规则的实例，可使用本参数筛选出指定规则查询关联实例详情。
DNSId.description_en: DNS rule ID. Use this parameter to filter instances associated with a specific custom DNS rule and query the details of those associated instances

DcList.description_cn: 实例归属机房 ID。使用本参数可以筛选出指定机房的云手机实例进行查询。
DcList.description_en: ID of the data center to which the instance belongs. Use this parameter to filter cloud phone instances by specified data center for querying

FilterAI.description_cn: 过滤查询AI版本pod实例列表。
FilterAI.description_en: Filter and query the AI version pod instance list.

HostId.description_cn: 云机 ID。**本地存储**业务可以使用本参数筛选出指定云机上的云手机实例进行查询。可通过 [ListHost](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221480) 接口获取。
HostId.description_en: Cloud host ID. The **Local Storage** service can use this parameter to filter and query cloud phone instances on a specified cloud host. You can obtain it through the [ListHost](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221480) API.

MaxResults.description_cn: 分页查询时用于设置每页返回的条目数。最大值为 100，默认值为 10。
MaxResults.description_en: Sets the number of items returned per page for paginated queries. Maximum value is 100; default value is 10.

NextToken.description_cn:
分页查询凭证，用于标记查询数据的起始位置。

* 初次查询时无需设置，服务器将根据筛选条件返回一部分数据，并返回一个 NextToken 凭证值记录这批数据的结尾位置，作为下次查询的起始位置。
* 后续查询中，将上一次查询时返回的 NextToken 作为参数传入，服务器会从该位置继续返回后续数据。

1. 重复调用本接口进行接续查询时，不可修改原始筛选条件，否则会影响查询数据的连贯性和准确性。如需修改筛选条件，请将本参数置空，从第一条数据开始重新查询。
2. 接口返回的 NextToken 有效期为 2 小时，若传入过期或无效的值，服务器将从第一条数据开始重新查询并返回。
NextToken.description_en:
Pagination query token, used to mark the starting position for querying data.

* For the initial query, you do not need to set this parameter. The server will return a portion of data based on the filter criteria and provide a NextToken value to record the end position of this batch, which serves as the starting position for the next query.
* For subsequent queries, pass the NextToken returned from the previous query as a parameter. The server will continue to return the following data from that position.

1. When repeatedly calling this API for continuous queries, do not modify the original filter criteria, or it will affect the continuity and accuracy of the query results. If you need to change the filter criteria, clear this parameter and start the query again from the first record.
2. The NextToken returned by the API is valid for 2 hours. If you pass an expired or invalid value, the server will restart the query from the first record and return the results.

OnlineList.description_cn:
实例运行状态。使用本参数可以筛选出指定运行状态的云手机实例进行查询。包含以下取值：

* `0`：开机中
* `1`：运行中
* `2`：已关机
* `3`：关机中
* `4`：重启中
OnlineList.description_en:
Instance running status. Use this parameter to filter and query cloud phone instances with the specified running status. The possible values are:

* `0`: Starting
* `1`: Running
* `2`: Stopped
* `3`: Stopping
* `4`: Restarting

PodIdList.description_cn: 实例 ID 列表。如需查询指定实例的详细信息，请通过本参数设置目标实例 ID 列表。最多支持传入 100 个 ID。
PodIdList.description_en:
Instance ID list
To query details for specific instances, set the target instance ID list using this parameter
Supports up to 100 IDs

PodName.description_cn: 实例名称，可以根据实例名称精确查找。
PodName.description_en: Instance name; you can search for instances by name

ProductId.description_cn: 业务 ID，用于指定想要查询的目标业务。可登录[云手机控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/ACEP)，在已创建的业务卡片中获取。
ProductId.description_en: Business ID, used to specify the target business you want to query. Log in to the [Cloud Phone Console](https://console.volcengine.com/ACEP) and obtain it from an existing business entry.

RegionList.description_cn:
实例归属机房所在的大区 ID。使用本参数可以筛选出指定大区的云手机实例进行查询。包含以下取值：

* `cn-north`：华北
* `cn-south`：华南
* `cn-east`：华东
* `cn-middle`：华中
* `cn-southwest`：西南
* `cn-northwest`：西北
RegionList.description_en:
ID of the region where the instance's data center is located. Use this parameter to filter and query cloud phone instances in the specified region. The possible values are:

* `cn-north`: North China
* `cn-south`: South China
* `cn-east`: East China
* `cn-middle`: Central China
* `cn-southwest`: Southwest China
* `cn-northwest`: Northwest China

ServerTypeCode.description_cn: 云机规格。**本地存储**业务可以使用本参数筛选指定规格云机上的云手机实例进行查询。云机规格详情参看[本地存储云机规格列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1473600#%E4%BA%91%E6%9C%BA%E8%A7%84%E6%A0%BC%E5%88%97%E8%A1%A8)。
ServerTypeCode.description_en: Cloud machine specifications. The **local storage** service can use this parameter to filter and query cloud phone instances on specified cloud machine specifications. For details on cloud machine specifications, see [Local Storage Cloud Machine Specifications List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1473600#%E4%BA%91%E6%9C%BA%E8%A7%84%E6%A0%BC%E5%88%97%E8%A1%A8).

StreamStatusList.description_cn:

* `0`：空闲
* `1`：推流中
* `2`：就绪

更多相关说明参看 [实例推流状态说明](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1181811#fd37cfff)。
StreamStatusList.description_en:
Instance streaming status. Use this parameter to filter and query cloud phone instances with the specified streaming status. The available values are:

* `0`: Idle
* `1`: Streaming
* `2`: Ready

For more details, see [Instance Streaming Status Description](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1181811#fd37cfff).

TagIdList.description_cn:

当前业务下已创建的标签可通过调用 [ListTag](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221497) 接口获取。
TagIdList.description_en:
Tag ID. Use this parameter to filter and query cloud phone instances with the specified tag.
You can obtain tags created under the current service by calling the [ListTag](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221497) API.

ZoneId.description_cn:
实例归属机房所在片区 ID。使用本参数可以筛选出指定片区的云手机实例进行查询。
可通过 [ListDc](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/2189056) 接口返回的 `Zone`字段获取。
ZoneId.description_en:
Instance data center zone ID. Use this parameter to filter and query cloud phone instances in the specified zone.
You can obtain the `Zone` field returned by the [ListDc](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/2189056) API.

- `ultimate`: Ultimate
- `enhanced`: Enhanced
- `common`: General
- `sample`: Entry
- `basic`: Basic
- `elementary`: Low-end
- `ultimatePlus`: Ultimate Plus
- `enhancedPlus`: Enhanced Plus
- `commonPlus`: General Plus
- `samplePlus`: Entry Plus
- `basicPlus`: Basic Plus
- `elementaryPlus`: Low-end Plus

In addition to the above 12 specifications, the local storage solution also includes the following 6 values:

- `ultimatePro`: Ultimate Pro

- `basicPro`: Basic Pro
- `elementaryPro`: Low-end Pro

Count.description_cn:
单次查询返回的最大记录数，用于控制每次查询返回的数据量。例如，若 `Count` 为 100，则表示在查询数据时，系统将每次返回 100 条记录。
可与 `Offset` 配合使用。假设当前数据集的记录总数为 200 条，如需查询第 101～150 条数据，需设置 `Offset` 为 100，`Count` 为 50。
Count.description_en:
The maximum number of records returned per query, used to control the amount of data returned each time. For example, if `Count` is 100, the system returns 100 records per query.
Can be used with `Offset`. If the current dataset contains 200 records and you want to query records 101–150, set `Offset` to 100 and `Count` to 50.

Dc.description_cn: 机房 ID，精确搜索。可通过 [ListDc](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221465) 接口获取。
Dc.description_en: Data center ID for precise search. You can obtain it via the [ListDc](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6394/1221465) API.

Offset.description_cn:
查询结果的起始位置，用于指定从哪一条记录开始返回数据。例如，若 `Offset` 为 10，则表示从第 11 条记录开始。默认值为 0。
可与 `Count` 配合使用。假设当前数据集的记录总数为 200 条，如需查询第 101～150 条数据，需设置 `Offset` 为 100，`Count` 为 50。
Offset.description_en:
The starting position of the query results, used to specify from which record to begin returning data. For example, if `Offset` is 10, data returns starting from the 11th record. Default is 0.
Can be used with `Count`. If the current dataset contains 200 records and you want to query records 101–150, set `Offset` to 100 and `Count` to 50.

ProductId.description_en: Business ID, which can be obtained in **Cloud Phone Console > Business Management > Business Details**.

ResourceSetId.description_en: Resource group ID for precise search.

Offset.description_cn:

可与 `Count` 配合使用。假设当前数据集的记录总数为 200 条，如需查询第 101～150 条数据，需设置 `Offset` 为 100，`Count` 为 50。

NextToken.description_en: Pagination token, used to mark the position for paginated queries. No need to set this parameter when calling the API for the first time. For subsequent queries, use the NextToken value returned from the previous API call. If NextToken is invalid, results will be returned starting from the first record, and no error will occur.

PodIdList.description_en: List of instance IDs to be migrated. Separate multiple instance IDs with a comma (,). You can enter up to 100 instance IDs.
