Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to ensure that this value is unique across requests and to prevent duplicate operations when the client retries multiple times due to API timeouts or server errors. Value requirements:
- Only ASCII characters are supported, and the value must not exceed 64 characters

LifecycleActivityId.description_cn: 生命周期活动ID。您可以调用[DescribeLifecycleActivities](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/130749)接口查询生命周期活动ID。
LifecycleActivityId.description_en:
Lifecycle Activity ID
You can call the [DescribeLifecycleActivities](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/130749) API to query the lifecycle activity ID

LifecycleActivityPolicy.description_cn:
实例挂起状态结束后执行的策略，如不填则表示遵循所属生命周期挂钩的策略。取值：
- CONTINUE：继续执行。
- REJECT：中止后续操作。
- ROLLBACK：针对弹性收缩活动，会拒绝释放ECS实例，进行回滚；针对弹性扩张活动，效果同REJECT一样。
 tip
执行后实例变更流程的详细介绍请参见[执行流程和策略](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/108545#%E6%89%A7%E8%A1%8C%E6%B5%81%E7%A8%8B%E5%92%8C%E7%AD%96%E7%95%A5)。
LifecycleActivityPolicy.description_en:
Strategy executed after the instance exits the suspended state. If left blank, the strategy defined by the associated lifecycle hook will be used. Options:
- CONTINUE: Continue execution
- REJECT: Abort subsequent operations
- ROLLBACK: For scale-in activities, the ECS instance will not be released and the operation will roll back; for scale-out activities, this has the same effect as REJECT
 tip
For a detailed introduction to the instance change process after execution, see [Execution Process and Strategy](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/108545#%E6%89%A7%E8%A1%8C%E6%B5%81%E7%A8%8B%E5%92%8C%E7%AD%96%E7%95%A5).

LifecycleHookId.description_cn: 生命周期挂钩ID。您可以调用[DescribeLifecycleHooks](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/130747)接口查询生命周期挂钩ID。
LifecycleHookId.description_en:
Lifecycle hook ID
You can call the [DescribeLifecycleHooks](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/130747) API to query the lifecycle hook ID

保证请求幂等性。由客户端自动生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一，避免当调用API超时或服务器内部错误时，客户端多次重试导致重复性操作。取值：
仅支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
ClientToken.description_en:
Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a parameter value to guarantee uniqueness across requests, preventing duplicate operations if the API times out or encounters a server error and the client retries. Value requirements:
Only ASCII characters are supported, and the value must not exceed 64 characters.

LifecycleCommand.CommandId.description_cn:
云助手命令ID，表示触发生命周期挂钩后在实例中执行云助手命令。
- 如果命令执行成功，则按照CONTINUE执行挂起结束后的策略。
- 如果命令执行失败/超时或生命周期挂钩超时，则按照`LifecycleHookPolicy`参数的配置执行挂起结束后的策略。
 tip
关联云助手前，您需要首先创建所需的运维命令，并确认相关实例已安装云助手客户端。详细操作请参见[挂钩关联云助手功能介绍](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/108545#%E7%9B%B8%E5%85%B3%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD)。
LifecycleCommand.CommandId.description_en:
Cloud Assistant command ID, used to execute a Cloud Assistant command on the instance after a lifecycle hook is triggered
- If the command executes successfully, the post-suspension policy follows the CONTINUE action
- If the command fails, times out, or the lifecycle hook times out, the post-suspension policy follows the configuration of the `LifecycleHookPolicy` parameter
 tip
Before associating Cloud Assistant, create the required maintenance command and make sure the relevant instance has the Cloud Assistant client installed. For details, see [Introduction to associating Cloud Assistant with lifecycle hooks](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/108545#%E7%9B%B8%E5%85%B3%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD)

LifecycleCommand.Parameters.description_cn:
云助手命令中的参数和参数值。
参数的个数范围为0~60，且需要注意：
- 参数不允许为空字符串，最多支持64个字符。
- 值允许为空字符串。
- 参数与原始命令内容在Base64编码后，综合长度不能超过16KB。
- 设置的参数名集合必须为创建命令时定义的参数集的子集。对于未传入的参数，使用默认值代替。
LifecycleCommand.Parameters.description_en:
Parameters and values in Cloud Assistant commands
The number of parameters ranges from 0 to 60. Note the following:
- Parameter names cannot be empty strings and can contain up to 64 characters
- Values can be empty strings
- The combined length of parameters and the original command, after Base64 encoding, must not exceed 16 KB
- The set of parameter names must be a subset of those defined when creating the command. For parameters not provided, default values will be used

LifecycleHookName.description_cn:
生命周期挂钩名称，创建后不可修改。取值：
- 不能以数字、中划线、下划线开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线和中划线。
- 长度限制在1 ~ 128个字符之间。
LifecycleHookName.description_en:
Lifecycle hook name. Cannot be changed after creation
Allowed values:
- Cannot start with a number, hyphen, or underscore
- Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens are allowed
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

LifecycleHookPolicy.description_cn:
实例挂起状态结束后执行的策略。取值：
- CONTINUE：继续执行。
- REJECT：中止后续操作。
- ROLLBACK：针对弹性收缩活动，会拒绝释放ECS实例，进行回滚；针对弹性扩张活动，效果同REJECT一样。
 tip
执行后实例变更流程的详细介绍请参见[执行流程和策略](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/108545#%E6%89%A7%E8%A1%8C%E6%B5%81%E7%A8%8B%E5%92%8C%E7%AD%96%E7%95%A5)。
LifecycleHookPolicy.description_en:
Strategy executed after an instance exits the suspended state. Options:
- CONTINUE: Continue execution
- REJECT: Abort subsequent operations
- ROLLBACK: For scaling in activities, ECS instances will not be released and the operation will roll back; for scaling out activities, this has the same effect as REJECT
 tip
For details on the instance change process after execution, see [Execution Process and Strategy](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/108545#%E6%89%A7%E8%A1%8C%E6%B5%81%E7%A8%8B%E5%92%8C%E7%AD%96%E7%95%A5).

LifecycleHookTimeout.description_cn: ECS实例保持挂起状态的时间，超时后，自动结束挂起状态，根据执行策略继续执行扩缩容行为。 请您评估自定义操作的处理时间后，设置合适的超时时间。取值：30 ～ 21600（6小时），单位 s，且必须为整数。
LifecycleHookTimeout.description_en: Set how long the ECS instance stays in the suspended state. When the timeout is reached, the suspended state ends automatically and scaling actions continue based on the execution policy. Please estimate the time needed for your custom operations and set an appropriate timeout. Valid values: 30–21600 seconds (up to 6 hours). The value must be an integer.

LifecycleHookType.description_cn:
伸缩活动的类型，发生指定类型的伸缩活动时，生命周期挂钩会被触发并挂起ECS实例。取值：
- SCALE_IN：弹性收缩活动。
- SCALE_OUT：弹性扩张活动。
LifecycleHookType.description_en:
Type of scaling activity. When the specified scaling activity occurs, the lifecycle hook triggers and suspends the ECS instance. Options:
- SCALE_IN: Scale in activity
- SCALE_OUT: Scale out activity

ScalingGroupId.description_cn: 伸缩组ID。您可以调用[DescribeScalingGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109814)查询伸缩组ID。
ScalingGroupId.description_en: Scaling Group ID You can call [DescribeScalingGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109814) to query the scaling group ID

EventTypes.N.description_cn:
事件通知类型。
- 参数 - N：表示事件通知类型的序号，取值1 ~ 10。
- 多个事件通知类型之间用&分隔。	
- 取值：
	- ScaleOutSuccess：成功的弹性扩张活动。		
	- ScaleInSuccess：成功的弹性收缩活动。		
	- ScaleOutError：失败的弹性扩张活动。		
	- ScaleInError：失败的弹性收缩活动。		
	- ScaleOutWarn：部分成功的弹性扩张活动。		
	- ScaleInWarn：部分成功的弹性收缩活动。		
	- ScaleReject：拒绝弹性伸缩活动。		
	- ScaleOutStart：弹性伸缩组扩容伸缩活动开始。		
	- ScaleInStart ：弹性伸缩组缩容伸缩活动开始。		
	- ScheduleTaskExpiring： 周期规则到期提醒。
EventTypes.N.description_en:
Event notification types
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the event notification type, with values ranging from 1 to 10
- Use & to separate multiple event notification types
- Values:
    - ScaleOutSuccess: Successful elastic scaling out activity
    - ScaleInSuccess: Successful elastic scaling in activity
    - ScaleOutError: Failed elastic scaling out activity
    - ScaleInError: Failed elastic scaling in activity
    - ScaleOutWarn: Partially successful elastic scaling out activity
    - ScaleInWarn: Partially successful elastic scaling in activity
    - ScaleReject: Elastic scaling activity rejected
    - ScaleOutStart: Elastic scaling group scale-out activity started
    - ScaleInStart: Elastic scaling group scale-in activity started
    - ScheduleTaskExpiring: Periodic rule expiration reminder

NotificationType.description_cn:
事件通知方式，当前仅支持云监控通知。
- 取值：cloudmonitor。
NotificationType.description_en:
Event notification method. Currently, only CloudMonitor notifications are supported.
- Value: cloudmonitor

ScalingGroupId.description_cn: 您可以调用[DescribeScalingGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109814)查询伸缩组ID。
ScalingGroupId.description_en: You can call [DescribeScalingGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109814) to query the scaling group ID

ClientToken.description_cn:
保证请求幂等性。由客户端自动生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一，避免当调用API超时或服务器内部错误时，客户端多次重试导致重复性操作。取值：
- 仅支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
ClientToken.description_en:
Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a parameter value that is unique across different requests to prevent duplicate operations when the client retries multiple times due to API timeouts or server errors. Value requirements:
- Only ASCII characters are supported, with a maximum length of 64 characters

Eip.Bandwidth.description_cn:
公网IP的带宽峰值，默认为1，单位：Mbps。取值：
- 当Eip.BillingType取值为PostPaidByBandwidth时，取值为1 ～ 500。
- 当Eip.BillingType取值为PostPaidByTraffic时，取值为1 ～ 200。
 tip
如果您需要使实例在加入伸缩组时自动分配公网IP，则必须至少配置Eip.Bandwidth、Eip.ISP、Eip.BillingType中的任意一项，均不配置则表示不分配公网IP。
Eip.Bandwidth.description_en:
Peak bandwidth for the public IP. Default is 1 (unit: Mbps). Value range:
- If Eip.BillingType is set to PostPaidByBandwidth, the range is 1 to 500 Mbps
- If Eip.BillingType is set to PostPaidByTraffic, the range is 1 to 200 Mbps
 tip
To automatically assign a public IP when adding an instance to a scaling group, you must configure at least one of Eip.Bandwidth, Eip.ISP, or Eip.BillingType. If none are configured, no public IP will be assigned.

Eip.BandwidthPackageId.description_cn:
共享带宽包的ID，表示将公网IP加入到共享带宽包。 您可以调用 [DescribeBandwidthPackages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6623/100685) 接口，查询共享带宽包的ID。 公网IP加入到共享带宽包必须同时满足如下条件：
- 二者的安全防护类型相同。
- 二者的线路类型相同。
- 共享带宽包为IPv4类型。
Eip.BandwidthPackageId.description_en:
The shared bandwidth package ID, which is required when adding a public IP to a shared bandwidth package. You can call the [DescribeBandwidthPackages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6623/100685) API to query the shared bandwidth package ID. To add a public IP to a shared bandwidth package, the following conditions must be met:
- Both must have the same security protection type
- Both must have the same line type
- The shared bandwidth package must be of IPv4 type

Eip.BillingType.description_cn:
公网IP的计费类型，取值：
- PostPaidByBandwidth（默认）：按量计费-按带宽上限计费。
- PostPaidByTraffic：按量计费-按实际流量计费。
 tip
如果您需要使实例在加入伸缩组时自动分配公网IP，则必须至少配置Eip.Bandwidth、Eip.ISP、Eip.BillingType中的任意一项，均不配置则表示不分配公网IP。
Eip.BillingType.description_en:
Billing type for public IP. Options:
- PostPaidByBandwidth (default): Pay-as-you-go—charged by bandwidth cap
- PostPaidByTraffic: Pay-as-you-go—charged by actual traffic
 tip
To automatically assign a public IP when adding an instance to a scaling group, you must configure at least one of Eip.Bandwidth, Eip.ISP, or Eip.BillingType. If none are configured, no public IP will be assigned.

Eip.ISP.description_cn:
线路类型，取值：
- BGP（默认）：BGP线路。
- 若您的账号已申请使用静态单线，ISP还可以传入ChinaMobile（表示中国移动）、ChinaTelecom（表示中国电信）、ChinaUnicom（表示中国联通）。
 tip
如果您需要使实例在加入伸缩组时自动分配公网IP，则必须至少配置Eip.Bandwidth、Eip.ISP、Eip.BillingType中的任意一项，均不配置则表示不分配公网IP。
Eip.ISP.description_en:
Line type. Options:
- BGP (default): BGP line
- If your account is enabled for static single line, you can also set ISP to ChinaMobile (China Mobile), ChinaTelecom (China Telecom), or ChinaUnicom (China Unicom)
 tip
To automatically assign a public IP when adding an instance to a scaling group, you must configure at least one of the following: Eip.Bandwidth, Eip.ISP, or Eip.BillingType. If none are configured, no public IP will be assigned

Eip.ReleaseWithInstance.description_cn:
公网IP是否随实例删除。
仅按量计费公网IP且在ECS控制台删除实例时生效，在伸缩组中删除实例后公网IP的保留情况请参见[实例管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/87021)中的详细说明。取值：

- true：公网IP随实例删除。
- false（默认）：公网IP不随实例删除。
Eip.ReleaseWithInstance.description_en:
Delete public IP when instance is deleted

This setting applies only to pay-as-you-go public IPs when you delete an instance in the ECS console. For details about public IP retention after deleting an instance in a scaling group, see [Instance Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/87021).

Values:

- true: Public IP is deleted when the instance is deleted
- false (default): Public IP is retained after the instance is deleted

Eip.SecurityProtectionInstanceId.description_cn:
安全防护包的ID。
 tip
当`Eip.SecurityProtectionTypes.N`不为空时，本参数必填。
Eip.SecurityProtectionInstanceId.description_en:
Security protection package ID
 tip
This parameter is required when `Eip.SecurityProtectionTypes.N` is not empty

Eip.SecurityProtectionTypes.N.description_cn:
公网IP的安全防护类型。
- 参数 - N：表示安全防护类型的序号，当前仅支持取1。
- 取值：
	- AntiDDoS_Enhanced：申请增强防护类型的公网IP（可加入到DDoS原生防护实例）。
	- 不填则表示基础防护类型的公网IP。
Eip.SecurityProtectionTypes.N.description_en:
Public IP security protection type
- Parameter - N: Indicates the index of the security protection type; currently, only 1 is supported
- Values:
    - AntiDDoS_Enhanced: Requests a public IP with enhanced protection (can be added to native DDoS protection instances)
    - Leave blank to request a public IP with basic protection

HostName.description_cn:
实例的主机名。取值：
- Linux实例
	- 允许使用点号分隔字符成多段，每段中允许使用字母、数字或中划线“-”。
	- 不能以点号“.”或中划线“-”开头或结尾，且不能连续使用点号“.”或中划线“-”。
	- Linux系统的主机名长度限制为2～63个字符。
- Windows实例
	- 允许使用字母、数字或中划线“-”，不能完全是数字。
	- 不能以中划线“-”开头或结尾，且不能连续使用中划线“-”。
	- Windows系统的主机名长度限制在2～15个字符。

如不填，则遵循以下规则自动生成：
- 结构：iv- + 初始主机名，例如`iv-3tigy72q3u3vj0******`。
	已创建实例保持原主机名生成逻辑，不随实例重启发生变化。
- 初始主机名生成逻辑：
	- Linux：提取实例ID`i-`之后的全部字符。
	- Windows：提取实例ID`i-`之后的后12位字符。
 tip
您可以为扩容的各实例设置有序且唯一的实例名称或主机名称，配置规则请参见[配置有序且唯一的实例名称或主机名称](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/699428).
HostName.description_en:
Instance hostname. Options:
- Linux instances
    - You can use periods to separate the hostname into segments. Each segment may contain letters, numbers, or hyphens (“-”).
    - The hostname cannot start or end with a period (“.”) or hyphen (“-”), and periods or hyphens cannot appear consecutively.
    - Hostname length for Linux systems must be between 2 and 63 characters.
- Windows instances
    - You can use letters, numbers, or hyphens (“-”). The hostname cannot consist entirely of numbers.
    - The hostname cannot start or end with a hyphen (“-”), and hyphens cannot appear consecutively.
    - Hostname length for Windows systems must be between 2 and 15 characters.

If left blank, the hostname is generated automatically as follows:
- Format: iv- + initial hostname, for example, `iv-3tigy72q3u3vj0******`.
    The original hostname generation logic is retained for existing instances and does not change when the instance restarts.
- Initial hostname generation logic:
    - Linux: Extracts all characters after `i-` in the instance ID.
    - Windows: Extracts the last 12 characters from the substring after `i-` in the instance ID.
 tip
You can set sequential and unique instance names or hostnames for scaled instances. For configuration rules, see [Configure sequential and unique instance names or hostnames](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/699428).

HpcClusterId.description_cn:
实例所属的高性能计算集群的ID。
仅当InstanceTypes.N指定为“高性能计算GPU型”时有效。
HpcClusterId.description_en:
ID of the high-performance computing cluster the instance belongs to
Valid only when InstanceTypes.N is set to High-Performance Computing GPU Type

ImageId.description_cn: 镜像ID，伸缩组自动创建实例时使用的镜像资源。您可以调用[DescribeImages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70808)查询镜像ID。
ImageId.description_en: Image ID refers to the image resource used by the auto scaling group when automatically creating instances. You can call [DescribeImages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70808) to query the Image ID.

InstanceDescription.description_cn:
实例的描述，取值：
- 不能以数字、中划线开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线和中划线。
- 长度限制在0 ~ 255之间。
- 不填默认为空字符串。
InstanceDescription.description_en:
Instance description requirements:
- Cannot start with a number or hyphen
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens
- Length must be between 0 and 255 characters
- Defaults to an empty string if left blank

InstanceName.description_cn:
实例的名称，取值：
- 以字母或中文开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线“_”、中划线“-”和点号“.”。
- 长度限制为1～128个字符。
 tip
您可以为扩容的各实例设置有序且唯一的实例名称或主机名称，配置规则请参见[配置有序且唯一的实例名称或主机名称](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/699428)。
InstanceName.description_en:
Instance name requirements:
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.)
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
 tip
You can set ordered and unique instance names or hostnames for each expanded instance. For configuration rules, see [Configure ordered and unique instance names or hostnames](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/699428).

InstanceTypeOverrides.N.InstanceType.description_cn:
指定抢占式实例的规格。
- 参数 - N：表示实例规格的序号，取值为1 ～ 10。
- 取值 - InstanceType：表示抢占式实例的规格。	
- 多个规格之间用&分隔。
 tip
本参数仅当`SpotStrategy`取值为SpotWithPriceLimit时生效。
InstanceTypeOverrides.N.InstanceType.description_en:
Specify the instance type for spot instances
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the instance type, with values from 1 to 10
- Value - InstanceType: Indicates the type of spot instance
- Separate multiple types with &
 tip
This parameter is only effective when `SpotStrategy` is set to SpotWithPriceLimit

InstanceTypeOverrides.N.PriceLimit.description_cn:
指定抢占式实例规格每小时的最高价格。
- 参数 - N：表示实例规格的序号，取值为1 ～ 10。
- 取值 - PriceLimit：表示抢占式实例规格每小时的最高价格。取值：大于0，且最大不超过3位小数。	
- 多个价格之间用&分隔。
 tip
本参数仅当`SpotStrategy`取值为SpotWithPriceLimit时生效。
InstanceTypeOverrides.N.PriceLimit.description_en:
Specify the maximum hourly price for each spot instance type.
- Parameter - N: The index of the instance type, ranging from 1 to 10
- Value - PriceLimit: The maximum hourly price for the spot instance type. Must be greater than 0 and have no more than three decimal places
- Separate multiple prices with &
 tip
This parameter is only effective when `SpotStrategy` is set to SpotWithPriceLimit

InstanceTypes.N.description_cn: 实例的计算规格列表。您可以调用[DescribeAvailableResource](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/76279)查询计算规格的库存信息。
InstanceTypes.N.description_en: List of compute specifications for instances. You can call [DescribeAvailableResource](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/76279) to query inventory information for compute specifications.

Ipv6AddressCount.description_cn:
是否为实例网卡分配IPv6地址。取值：
- 0：不分配IPv6地址。
- 1：分配IPv6地址，系统自动为您分配IPv6网段。
Ipv6AddressCount.description_en:
Assign IPv6 address to instance network card?
Values:
- 0: Do not assign IPv6 address
- 1: Assign IPv6 address; the system automatically assigns an IPv6 subnet for you

KeyPairName.description_cn:
使用“SSH密钥对”登录实例时，请输入密钥对的名称。
如果同时设置了`KeyPairName`和`Password`，则仅生效`KeyPairName`。
KeyPairName.description_en: When logging in to an instance with an SSH key pair, enter the name of the key pair. If both `KeyPairName` and `Password` are set, only `KeyPairName` will be used.

Password.description_cn:
使用“密码”方式登录实例时，请设置root登录密码：
- 长度限制在8 ～ 30之间
- 密码只能由大写字母、小写字母、数字和特殊字符组成，且必须包含至少三项
- 特殊字符可以使用：`~!@#$%^&*()_-+= |
- 不能以“/”和“$6$”开头
Password.description_en:
When logging in to an instance using the password method, set the root password as follows:
- Password length must be between 8 and 30 characters
- Password can only consist of uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters, and must include at least three of these types
- Allowed special characters: `~!@#$%^&*()_-+= |
- Password cannot start with '/' or '$6$'

ProjectName.description_cn:
伸缩配置创建的实例所属项目，默认为空。一个资源只能归属于一个项目。
- 只能包含字母、数字、下划线“_”、点“.”和中划线“-”。
- 长度限制在64个字符以内。
ProjectName.description_en:
Project to which the instance created by the scaling configuration belongs. By default, this is empty. Each resource can belong to only one project
- Only letters, numbers, underscores (_), dots (.), and hyphens (-) are allowed
- Maximum length is 64 characters

ScalingConfigurationName.description_cn:
伸缩配置的名称，在同一地域下同一伸缩组内伸缩配置名称唯一。取值:
- 只能以中文、字母开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线和中划线。
- 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符。
- 暂不支持特殊字符。
ScalingConfigurationName.description_en:
Scaling configuration name must be unique within the same scaling group and region
Value requirements:
- Must start with a Chinese character or letter
- Can only include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
- Special characters are not supported for now

ScalingGroupId.description_cn: 伸缩配置所属的伸缩组ID。您可以调用[DescribeScalingGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109814)查询伸缩组ID。
ScalingGroupId.description_en: The scaling group ID associated with the scaling configuration. You can call [DescribeScalingGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109814) to query the scaling group ID.

SecurityEnhancementStrategy.description_cn:
是否开启安全加固，取值：
- Active：开启安全加固，仅对公共镜像生效。
- InActive：关闭安全加固，对所有镜像生效。
SecurityEnhancementStrategy.description_en:
Whether to enable security hardening. Values:
- Active: Enable security hardening; applies only to public images
- InActive: Disable security hardening; applies to all images

SecurityGroupIds.N.description_cn:
实例主网卡关联的安全组ID。您可以调用[DescribeSecurityGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70753)接口查询安全组ID。取值：
- 参数 - N：表示主网卡关联的安全组的序号，最多支持同时绑定5个安全组，取值：1 ～ 5。
- 参数 - SecurityGroupId：表示主网卡关联的第N个安全组的ID。
- 多个安全组ID之间用&分隔。
SecurityGroupIds.N.description_en:
Security group IDs associated with the primary network interface of the instance. You can use the [DescribeSecurityGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70753) API to query security group IDs. Values:
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the security group associated with the primary network interface. You can bind up to 5 security groups at the same time. Valid values: 1 to 5.
- Parameter - SecurityGroupId: Indicates the ID of the Nth security group associated with the primary network interface.
- Separate multiple security group IDs with &.

SpotStrategy.description_cn:
实例的抢占策略。取值：
- NoSpot（默认）：表示创建正常按量付费实例。
- SpotAsPriceGo：表示系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格的抢占式实例。
- SpotWithPriceLimit：表示需要设置出价上限的抢占式实例。
SpotStrategy.description_en:
Instance preemption policy. Options:
- NoSpot (Default): Creates a standard pay-as-you-go instance
- SpotAsPriceGo: System sets the bid automatically; creates a spot instance that follows the current market price
- SpotWithPriceLimit: Requires setting a maximum bid for the spot instance

Tags.description_cn:
伸缩配置创建实例的标签。标签以键值对方式传入，最多传入20组标签。Key命名规则如下：
- Key命名规则如下：
	
	- 不能以`volc:`或`sys:`的任意大小写组合开头。
         tip
        `volc:`或`sys:`开头为系统预留标签键，禁止创建。
        
	- 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“\_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
	- 长度限制在1～128个字符之间。
	> 同一伸缩配置的标签键不允许重复。
- Value命名规则如下：
	- 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“\_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
	- 允许为空，长度限制在0～256个字符之间。
Tags.description_en:
Tags for instances created by the auto scaling configuration. Tags are passed as key-value pairs, with up to 20 pairs allowed. Key naming rules:
- Key naming rules:
  - Must not start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`.
     tip
    Keys starting with `volc:` or `sys:` are reserved for system use and cannot be created.
    
  - Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following English symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@".
  - Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.
  > Tag keys within the same auto scaling configuration must be unique.
- Value naming rules:
  - Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following English symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@".
  - Value can be empty; length must be between 0 and 256 characters.

UserData.description_cn:
实例自定义数据。设置的自定义数据必须经过Base64编码，且Base64编码前的自定义数据大小不能超过16KB。
不填则默认为空。
UserData.description_en: Instance custom data. The custom data you set must be Base64 encoded, and the size before encoding cannot exceed 16KB. If left blank, it defaults to empty.

Volumes.N.DeleteWithInstance.description_cn:
云盘是否随实例释放：
- 参数 - N：表示云盘的序号，序号为“1”表示系统盘；序号为“2”或大于“2”表示数据盘。取值：1 - 15。
- 参数 - DeleteWithInstance：云盘是否随实例释放。
    - true（默认值）：云盘随实例释放。
    - false：云盘不随实例释放。
- 取值为false时对系统盘无效，系统盘默认随实例释放，不允许保留。
Volumes.N.DeleteWithInstance.description_en:
Release Cloud Disk with Instance:
- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk number. 1 refers to the system disk; 2 or greater refers to data disks. Valid values: 1–15
- Parameter - DeleteWithInstance: Whether the cloud disk is released with the instance
    - true (default): The cloud disk is released with the instance
    - false: The cloud disk is not released with the instance
- Setting this parameter to false does not apply to the system disk. The system disk is always released with the instance and cannot be retained

Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceIOPS.description_cn:
云盘额外IOPS性能大小，仅ESSD FlexPL数据盘支持，单位为次/秒。 `ExtraPerformanceTypeId`为`Balance`或`IOPS`时需设置该参数。各个类型的额外性能取值范围如下： 
- IOPS型：1～50000。 
- Balance型：1～50000。 
 
- 参数 - N：表示云盘的序号，取值范围：1～16。N = 1表示系统盘，故N传入1时，该参数将被忽略。N ≥ 2表示数据盘，可正常传入该参数。 
- 多个云盘之间用&分隔。
Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceIOPS.description_en:
Extra cloud disk IOPS performance, only supported for ESSD FlexPL data disks, measured in operations per second. This parameter must be set when `ExtraPerformanceTypeId` is `Balance` or `IOPS`. The value ranges for each extra performance type are as follows:
- IOPS type: 1–50000
- Balance type: 1–50000
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the cloud disk, value range: 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk, so this parameter will be ignored when N is set to 1. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks, and this parameter can be set normally.
- Use & to separate multiple cloud disks.

Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB.description_cn:
云盘额外吞吐性能大小，单位MB/s，仅ESSD FlexPL数据盘支持。 `ExtraPerformanceTypeId`为`Throughput`时需设置该参数。 取值范围：1～650。 
 
- 参数 - N：表示云盘的序号，取值范围：1～16。N = 1表示系统盘，故N传入1时，该参数将被忽略。N ≥ 2表示数据盘，可正常传入该参数。 
- 多个云盘之间用&分隔。
Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB.description_en:
Extra cloud disk throughput performance, measured in MB/s. Only supported for ESSD FlexPL data disks. This parameter must be set when `ExtraPerformanceTypeId` is `Throughput`. Value range: 1–650.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the cloud disk, value range: 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk, so this parameter will be ignored when N is set to 1. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks, and this parameter can be set normally.
- Use & to separate multiple cloud disks.

Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceTypeId.description_cn:
云盘额外性能的类型，仅ESSD FlexPL数据盘支持。关于额外性能的更多介绍，请参见[云盘额外性能](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1174767)。
取值： 
- Balance：均衡型额外性能。 
- IOPS：IOPS型额外性能。 
- Throughput：吞吐量型额外性能。 
 
- 参数 - N：表示云盘的序号，取值范围：1～16。N = 1表示系统盘，故N传入1时，该参数将被忽略。N ≥ 2表示数据盘，可正常传入该参数。 
- 多个云盘之间用&分隔。
Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceTypeId.description_en:
Type of extra cloud disk performance. Only supported for ESSD FlexPL data disks. For more information about extra performance, see [Extra Cloud Disk Performance](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1174767).
Values:
- Balance: Balanced extra performance
- IOPS: IOPS extra performance
- Throughput: Throughput extra performance
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the cloud disk, value range: 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk, so this parameter will be ignored when N is set to 1. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks, and this parameter can be set normally.
- Use & to separate multiple cloud disks.

Volumes.N.Size.description_cn:
云盘的容量，单位为GiB。
- 参数 - N：表示云盘的序号，序号为“1”表示系统盘；序号为“2”或大于“2”表示数据盘。取值：1 ～ 15。
- 取值 - Size：表述第N个云盘的容量，单位为GiB。
	- 系统盘取值范围：10 - 500。
	- 数据盘取值范围：10 - 8192。
- 多个云盘之间用&分隔。
Volumes.N.Size.description_en:
Cloud disk capacity, measured in GiB
- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk index. '1' refers to the system disk; '2' or greater refers to a data disk. Valid values: 1 to 15
- Value - Size: Specifies the capacity of the Nth cloud disk in GiB
  - System disk range: 10–500
  - Data disk range: 10–8192
- Separate multiple cloud disks with &

Volumes.N.VolumeType.description_cn:
云盘的类型：
- 参数 - N：表示云盘的序号，序号为“1”表示系统盘，序号为“2”或大于“2”表示数据盘。取值：1 ～ 15。
- 参数 - VolumeType：表示第N个云盘的类型，取值：
    - ESSD_FlexPL：极速型SSDFlexPL。
    - ESSD_PL0：极速型SSD PL0。
- 多个云盘之间用&分隔。
Volumes.N.VolumeType.description_en:
Cloud disk types:
- Parameter - N: Indicates the cloud disk sequence number. '1' is the system disk; '2' or higher is a data disk. Value range: 1 to 15
- Parameter - VolumeType: Indicates the type of the Nth cloud disk. Values:
    - ESSD_FlexPL: Ultra-fast SSD FlexPL
    - ESSD_PL0: Ultra-fast SSD PL0
- Separate multiple cloud disks with &

ZoneId.description_cn: 伸缩配置可用区ID。
ZoneId.description_en: Scaling Configuration Availability Zone ID

ClientToken.description_cn:
保证请求幂等性。由客户端自动生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一，避免当调用API超时或服务器内部错误时，客户端多次重试导致重复性操作。取值：
仅支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
ClientToken.description_en:
Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations when retrying due to API timeout or server error. Value requirements:
Only ASCII characters are supported, and the value must not exceed 64 characters.

DBInstanceIds.N.description_cn:
RDS数据库实例的ID。
- 参数 - N：表示数据库实例的序号，取值 1 ～ 40。
- 多个数据库实例的ID之间用&分隔。
- 如不填，则表示暂不绑定数据库实例。
 tip 
伸缩组关联RDS数据库实例为邀测功能，如需使用，请联系客户经理申请。
DBInstanceIds.N.description_en:
RDS database instance ID
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the database instance, from 1 to 40
- Separate multiple database instance IDs with &
- Leave blank to indicate that no database instance is bound
 tip
Associating RDS database instances with scaling groups is an invite-only feature. To use this feature, please contact your account manager to apply

DefaultCooldown.description_cn:
执行一次伸缩活动（添加或移出ECS实例）结束后的冷却时间。冷却时间内，该伸缩组不执行其它的伸缩活动，仅针对云监控报警任务触发的伸缩活动和伸缩规则有效。
取值范围：5 ~ 86400，单位：秒。默认值：300。
DefaultCooldown.description_en: Cooldown period after a scaling activity (adding or removing ECS instances) completes. During the cooldown period, the scaling group does not perform other scaling activities. Only scaling activities triggered by cloud monitoring alarms and scaling rules are effective. Value range: 5–86400 seconds. Default: 300 seconds.

DesireInstanceNumber.description_cn:
伸缩组中期望运行的实例个数，更多介绍请参见 [期望实例数](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/97218)。取值：
- 不小于最小实例数MinInstanceNumber且不大于最大实例数MaxInstanceNumber。
- 默认值：-1，表示不开启期望实例数能力。此时，伸缩组创建完成后会立即开始伸缩活动自动添加相应个数的实例。
DesireInstanceNumber.description_en:
Number of expected running instances in the scaling group. For more information, see [Expected Instance Number](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/97218). Value range:
- Must be no less than the minimum instance number (MinInstanceNumber) and no greater than the maximum instance number (MaxInstanceNumber)
- Default value: -1, which means the expected instance number feature is disabled. In this case, after the scaling group is created, scaling activities will immediately start and automatically add the corresponding number of instances

HealthCheckType.description_cn:
伸缩组的健康检查方式。取值：
- NONE：不做实例健康状态检查。
- ECS（默认）：对伸缩组内的ECS实例做健康检查。
HealthCheckType.description_en:
Health check method for the scaling group. Options:
- NONE: Do not check instance health status
- ECS (default): Check the health of ECS instances in the scaling group

InstanceTerminatePolicy.description_cn:
实例移除策略，取值：
- OldestInstance：移出最早加入 （**包括自动创建和手动添加**）伸缩组的实例。
- NewestInstance：移出最晚加入（**包括自动创建和手动添加**）伸缩组的实例。
- OldestScalingConfigurationWithOldestInstance（默认）：移出最早与伸缩组绑定的伸缩配置中，最早由伸缩组 **自动创建** 的实例。
- OldestScalingConfigurationWithNewestInstance：移出最早与伸缩组绑定的伸缩配置中，最晚由伸缩组 **自动创建** 的实例。
InstanceTerminatePolicy.description_en:
Instance Removal Policy options:
- OldestInstance: Remove the instance that joined the scaling group earliest (including both automatically created and manually added instances)
- NewestInstance: Remove the instance that joined the scaling group most recently (including both automatically created and manually added instances)
- OldestScalingConfigurationWithOldestInstance (default): Remove the earliest automatically created instance from the scaling configuration that was first attached to the scaling group
- OldestScalingConfigurationWithNewestInstance: Remove the latest automatically created instance from the scaling configuration that was first attached to the scaling group
InstanceTerminatePolicy.example_en: Oldest Scaling Configuration With Oldest Instance

InstancesDistribution.CompensateWithOnDe.description_cn:
当因价格、库存等原因无法创建足够的抢占式实例时，是否允许使用按量实例补充抢占式容量。取值：
- true: 允许。
- false（默认）: 不允许。
InstancesDistribution.CompensateWithOnDe.description_en:
Allow on-demand instances to supplement preemptible capacity when not enough preemptible instances can be created due to price, stock, or other reasons
Options:
- true: Allowed
- false (default): Not allowed

InstancesDistribution.OnDemandBaseCapaci.description_cn:
伸缩组中按量计费实例个数的最小值，取值范围：0~2000。当组中按量计费实例个数少于该值时，将优先创建按量计费的实例。
 tip
该参数仅当伸缩组绑定的[伸缩配置来源](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/88737)的计费类型为抢占式类型时生效，且该参数不影响最终创建的实例数量，实例数量仍有最大/最小/期望实例数限制。
InstancesDistribution.OnDemandBaseCapaci.description_en:
Minimum number of pay-as-you-go instances in the scaling group. Range: 0–2000. If the number of pay-as-you-go instances in the group falls below this value, pay-as-you-go instances will be created first.
 tip
This parameter is only effective when the billing type of the [scaling configuration source](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/88737) bound to the scaling group is preemptible. It does not affect the final number of instances, which is still limited by the maximum, minimum, and desired instance counts.

InstancesDistribution.OnDemandPercentage.description_cn:
伸缩组满足最小按量实例数要求后，超出的实例中按量实例应占的比例，取值范围：0～100。
 tip
该参数仅当伸缩组绑定的[伸缩配置来源](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/88737)的计费类型为抢占式类型时生效。
InstancesDistribution.OnDemandPercentage.description_en:
After the scaling group meets the minimum required number of pay-as-you-go instances, set the proportion of pay-as-you-go instances among the excess instances. Valid range: 0–100
 tip
This parameter only takes effect when the billing type of the [scaling configuration source](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/88737) bound to the scaling group is preemptible.

InstancesDistribution.SpotInstanceRemedy.description_cn:
是否允许抢占式实例到期替换。开启则表示在抢占式实例被回收前5分钟左右，伸缩组将主动新建新的抢占式实例替换掉当前抢占式实例。取值：
- true: 允许。
- false（默认）: 不允许。
InstancesDistribution.SpotInstanceRemedy.description_en:
Allow preemptible instance replacement at expiration. When enabled, the scaling group creates a new preemptible instance to replace the current one about five minutes before it is reclaimed. Options:
- true: Allow
- false (default): Do not allow

LaunchTemplateId.description_cn: 实例启动模板ID，配置后表示选择启动模版作为伸缩配置来源。
LaunchTemplateId.description_en: Instance launch template ID. When configured, selects the launch template as the source for scaling configuration

LaunchTemplateOverrides.N.InstanceType.description_cn:
指定实例规格。
- 参数 - N：表示实例规格的序号，取值为1 ～ 10。
- 取值 - InstanceType：表示实例规格。
- 多个实例规格之间用&分隔。
- 填写后，会覆盖启动模板中原本的实例规格；如不填，表示复用所选启动模版中的规格。
 tip 
本参数仅当LaunchTemplateId参数存在取值时生有效。
LaunchTemplateOverrides.N.InstanceType.description_en:
Specify instance type
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the instance type, valid values are 1 to 10
- Value - InstanceType: Indicates the instance type
- Use & to separate multiple instance types
- If filled, this will override the instance type in the launch template; if left blank, the instance type from the selected launch template will be used
 tip
This parameter is only valid when the LaunchTemplateId parameter is specified

LaunchTemplateOverrides.N.PriceLimit.description_cn:
指定抢占式实例规格每小时的最高价格。
- 参数 - N：表示实例规格的序号，取值为1 ～ 10。
- 取值 - PriceLimit：表示抢占式实例规格每小时的最高价格。取值：大于0，且最大不超过3位小数。
- 多个价格之间用&分隔。
 tip
本参数仅当`LaunchTemplateId`参数存在取值，且启动模版的计费模式为设置出价上限的抢占式实例（即SpotWithPriceLimit）时有效。
LaunchTemplateOverrides.N.PriceLimit.description_en:
Specify the maximum hourly price for spot instance types
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the instance type, with values from 1 to 10
- Value - PriceLimit: Specifies the maximum hourly price for the spot instance type. Value must be greater than 0 and can have up to three decimal places
- Separate multiple prices with &
 tip
This parameter is only valid when the `LaunchTemplateId` parameter has a value and the launch template billing mode is spot instance with price limit (SpotWithPriceLimit)

LaunchTemplateVersion.description_cn:
实例启动模板的版本。取值：
- 模板的某个版本号。
- Default（默认）：始终使用模板默认版本。
- Latest：始终使用模板最新版本。
 tip 
本参数仅当LaunchTemplateId参数存在取值时生有效。
LaunchTemplateVersion.description_en:
Version of the instance launch template. Options:
- A specific template version number
- Default: Always use the template's default version
- Latest: Always use the template's latest version
 tip
This parameter is valid only when the LaunchTemplateId parameter is specified.

MaxInstanceNumber.description_cn: 伸缩组中实例个数的最大值，默认取值0 ～ 100。
MaxInstanceNumber.description_en: Maximum number of instances in the scaling group; default value: 0 to 100

MinInstanceNumber.description_cn: 伸缩组中实例个数的最小值，默认取值0 ～ 100。
MinInstanceNumber.description_en: Minimum number of instances in the scaling group, default range is 0 to 100

MultiAZPolicy.description_cn:
扩缩容策略，如果您选择了多个子网，需配置本参数。取值：
- PRIORITY（默认）：优先级策略。
- BALANCE：均衡分布策略。
 tip
选择策略后的实例扩缩容情况请参见[创建伸缩组](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/88723)中的“扩缩容策略”参数说明。
MultiAZPolicy.description_en:
Scaling policy. If you select multiple subnets, you must configure this parameter. Options:
- PRIORITY (default): Priority strategy
- BALANCE: Balanced distribution strategy
 tip
For details on how instances are scaled with each strategy, see the 'Scaling Policy' parameter description in [Create Scaling Group](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/88723).

ProjectName.description_cn:
伸缩组所属项目，默认为default。一个资源只能归属于一个项目。
- 只能包含字母、数字、下划线“_”、点“.”和中划线“-”。
- 长度限制在64个字符以内。
ProjectName.description_en:
Project to which the scaling group belongs. Default is 'default'. Each resource can belong to only one project.
- Only letters, numbers, underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-) are allowed
- Maximum length is 64 characters

ScalingGroupName.description_cn:
伸缩组名称，同一地域下伸缩组名称唯一，取值:
- 只能以中文、字母开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线和中划线 。
- 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符。
- 暂不支持特殊字符。
ScalingGroupName.description_en:
Scaling group name must be unique within the same region
Value:
- Must start with a Chinese character or letter
- Can only include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
- Special characters are not supported for now

ScalingMode.description_cn:
伸缩组的实例回收模式，取值：
- release（默认）：释放模式。
- recycle：停机回收模式。
ScalingMode.description_en:
The instance recycling mode for scaling groups includes the following options:
- release (default): the instance is released
- recycle: the instance is shut down and recycled

ServerGroupAttributes.N.Port.description_cn:
负载均衡后端服务器组中服务器的端口号。
- 参数 - N：表示服务器组的序号，取值 1 ～ 20。
- 参数 - Port：端口号，取值1 ～ 65535。
- 多个服务器组的端口号之间用&分隔。
- 如不填，则表示暂不绑定负载均衡。
ServerGroupAttributes.N.Port.description_en:
Port number for servers in the load balancing backend server group
- Parameter - N: Server group index, values 1 to 20
- Parameter - Port: Port number, values 1 to 65535
- Separate port numbers for multiple server groups with &
- Leave blank to temporarily not bind to load balancing

ServerGroupAttributes.N.ServerGroupId.description_cn:
负载均衡后端服务器组的ID。您可以调用[DescribeServerGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6406/71782)接口查询后端服务器组ID。
- 参数 - N：表示服务器组的序号，取值 1 ～ 100。
- 参数 - ServerGroupId：服务器组ID。
- 多个服务器组的ID之间用&分隔。
- 如不填，则表示暂不绑定负载均衡。
ServerGroupAttributes.N.ServerGroupId.description_en:
ID of the load balancer backend server group. You can call the [DescribeServerGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6406/71782) API to query backend server group IDs
- Parameter - N: Indicates the server group sequence number, with values from 1 to 100
- Parameter - ServerGroupId: Backend server group ID
- Separate multiple server group IDs with &
- If left blank, the load balancer will not be bound for now

ServerGroupAttributes.N.Type.description_cn:
负载均衡服务器组类型: 
- 参数 - N：表示负载均衡服务器组的序号，取值 1 ～ 100。单个CLB/ALB最多支持添加20个后端服务器组，所有CLB/ALB最多支持添加100个后端服务器。
- 参数 - Type：表示负载均衡服务器组的类型。
	- ALB：应用型负载均衡。
	- CLB：传统型型负载均衡。
- 多个服务器组的ID之间用&分隔。
- 如不传入本参数，则表示暂不绑定负载均衡。
- 如传入本参数但不传入取值，则默认选择CLB。
ServerGroupAttributes.N.Type.description_en:
Load Balancer Server Group Type:
- Parameter - N: Indicates the server group sequence number. Valid values are 1 to 100. Each CLB/ALB supports up to 20 backend server groups, and a maximum of 100 backend servers can be added across all CLB/ALB.
- Parameter - Type: Specifies the server group type.
  - ALB: Application Load Balancer
  - CLB: Classic Load Balancer
- Separate multiple server group IDs with &
- If you do not provide this parameter, no load balancer will be bound
- If you provide this parameter but do not specify a value, CLB is selected by default

ServerGroupAttributes.N.Weight.description_cn:
负载均衡后端服务器组中服务器的权重。
- 参数 - N：表示服务器组的序号，取值 1 ～ 5。
- 参数 - Weight：权重，取值0 ～ 100。
- 多个服务器组的权重之间用&分隔。
- 如不填，则表示暂不绑定负载均衡
ServerGroupAttributes.N.Weight.description_en:
Weight of servers in the load balancer backend server group
- Parameter - N: Indicates the server group index, valid values are 1 to 5
- Parameter - Weight: Weight, valid values are 0 to 100
- Use & to separate weights for multiple server groups
- Leave blank to temporarily not bind to a load balancer

SubnetIds.N.description_cn:
伸缩组中实例主网卡的子网ID列表。您可以调用[DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497)接口查询子网ID。
参数 - N：表示子网的序号，支持多选。多个子网需属于同一个VPC，同一可用区允许选择多个子网。
SubnetIds.N.description_en: List of subnet IDs for the primary network interface of instances in the scaling group. You can use the [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) API to query subnet IDs. Parameter - N: Indicates the subnet sequence number; multiple selections supported. All selected subnets must belong to the same VPC. You can select multiple subnets within the same availability zone.

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
用户标签的标签键。
- 参数 - N：表示标签键的序号。取值范围：1～50。
- 多个标签键之间用&分隔。

命名规则如下：
- 不能以`volc:`或`sys:`的任意大小写组合开头。
     tip
    `volc:`或`sys:`开头为系统预留标签键，禁止创建。
    
- 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“\_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
- 长度限制在1～128个字符之间。
> 同一资源的标签键不允许重复。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for user tags
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key. Value range: 1–50
- Separate multiple tag keys with &

Naming rules:
- Cannot start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`
     tip
    Tag keys starting with `volc:` or `sys:` are reserved for system use and cannot be created
    
- Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following English symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
> Duplicate tag keys are not allowed for the same resource

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
用户标签的标签值。
- 参数 - N：表示标签值的序号。取值范围：1～50。
- 多个标签值之间用&分隔。

命名规则如下：
- 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“\_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
- 允许为空，长度限制在0～256个字符之间。
> 如果传入该参数，则必须先传入`Tags.N.Key`。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value for user tags
- Parameter - N: Indicates the index of the tag value. Valid range: 1–50
- Separate multiple tag values with &

Naming rules:
- Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
- Can be empty; length must be between 0 and 256 characters
> If this parameter is provided, you must first provide `Tags.N.Key`

AdjustmentType.description_cn:
伸缩规则的伸缩行为， 适用于简单规则和步进规则，取值：
- QuantityChangeInCapacity：增加或减少指定数量的实例。
- PercentChangeInCapacity：增加或减少指定比例的实例。
- TotalCapacity： 将当前伸缩组的实例数量调整到指定数量。
AdjustmentType.description_en:
Scaling actions for scaling rules apply to both simple and step rules. Options:
- QuantityChangeInCapacity: Increase or decrease a specified number of instances
- PercentChangeInCapacity: Increase or decrease a specified percentage of instances
- TotalCapacity: Adjust the number of instances in the current scaling group to a specified value

AdjustmentValue.description_cn:
伸缩行为的调整数值， 适用于简单规则和步进规则，取值：
- 当AdjustmentType参数取值为QuantityChangeInCapacity时：-100 ~ 100，不允许为0，单位：个。
- 当AdjustmentType参数取值为PercentChangeInCapacity时：-100 ~ 10000，不允许为0，单位：%。
- 当AdjustmentType参数取值为TotalCapacity时：默认为0 ~ 100，单位：个。
 tip
单次调用本接口最多可以调整的实例个数不允许超过300个。
AdjustmentValue.description_en:
Adjustment value for scaling actions, applicable to simple and step rules. Value ranges:
- If AdjustmentType is QuantityChangeInCapacity: -100 to 100 (cannot be 0), unit: instances
- If AdjustmentType is PercentChangeInCapacity: -100 to 10000 (cannot be 0), unit: %
- If AdjustmentType is TotalCapacity: default is 0 to 100, unit: instances
 tip
You can adjust up to 300 instances per API call

AlarmPolicy.Condition.ComparisonOperator.description_cn:
单指标告警时的规则表达式对象。
- \>：大于
- <：小于
- =：等于
 tip
仅当`ScalingPolicyType`取值为Alarm时有效，且必须配置`AlarmPolicy.Condition.x`或`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`相关参数，当二者同时配置时，仅`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`生效。
AlarmPolicy.Condition.ComparisonOperator.description_en:
Rule expression object for single-metric alarms
- >: greater than
- <: less than
- =: equal to
 tip
Only valid when `ScalingPolicyType` is set to Alarm. You must configure either the `AlarmPolicy.Condition.x` or `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x` parameter. If both are configured, only `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x` takes effect.

AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName.description_cn:
单指标告警时的监控指标名称，取值：
- CpuTotal_Max：带内CPU使用率最大值，表示伸缩组中所有实例CPU使用率的最大值。
- CpuTotal_Min：带内CPU使用率最小值。
- CpuTotal_Avg：带内CPU使用率平均值。
- MemoryUsedUtilization_Max：带内内存使用率最大值。
- MemoryUsedUtilization_Min：带内内存使用率最小值。
- MemoryUsedUtilization_Avg：带内内存使用率平均值。
- Instance_CpuBusy_Max：带外CPU使用率最大值。
- Instance_CpuBusy_Min：带外CPU使用率最小值。
- Instance_CpuBusy_Avg：带外CPU使用率平均值。
- Instance_NetTxBits_Avg: 带外网络流出速率平均值。
- Instance_NetRxBits_Avg: 带外网络流入速率平均值。
- Instance_NetTxPackets_Avg: 带外网络发送包速率平均值。
- Instance_NetRxPackets_Avg: 带外网络接收包速率平均值。
- SystemDiskReadBytes_Avg: 带内系统盘读带宽平均值。
- SystemDiskWriteBytes_Avg: 带内系统盘写带宽平均值。
- SystemDiskReadIOPS_Avg: 带内系统盘读IOPS平均值。
- SystemDiskWriteIOPS_Avg: 带内系统盘写IOPS平均值。
- NetTcpConnection_Avg: 带内TCP连接数平均值。
 tip
仅当`ScalingPolicyType`取值为Alarm时有效，且必须配置`AlarmPolicy.Condition.x`或`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`相关参数，当二者同时配置时，仅`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`生效。
AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName.description_en:
Monitoring metric names for single-metric alarms. Available values:
- CpuTotal_Max: Maximum in-band CPU utilization, representing the highest CPU usage among all instances in the scaling group
- CpuTotal_Min: Minimum in-band CPU utilization
- CpuTotal_Avg: Average in-band CPU utilization
- MemoryUsedUtilization_Max: Maximum in-band memory utilization
- MemoryUsedUtilization_Min: Minimum in-band memory utilization
- MemoryUsedUtilization_Avg: Average in-band memory utilization
- Instance_CpuBusy_Max: Maximum out-of-band CPU utilization
- Instance_CpuBusy_Min: Minimum out-of-band CPU utilization
- Instance_CpuBusy_Avg: Average out-of-band CPU utilization
- Instance_NetTxBits_Avg: Average out-of-band network outbound rate
- Instance_NetRxBits_Avg: Average out-of-band network inbound rate
- Instance_NetTxPackets_Avg: Average out-of-band network outbound packet rate
- Instance_NetRxPackets_Avg: Average out-of-band network inbound packet rate
- SystemDiskReadBytes_Avg: Average in-band system disk read bandwidth
- SystemDiskWriteBytes_Avg: Average in-band system disk write bandwidth
- SystemDiskReadIOPS_Avg: Average in-band system disk read IOPS
- SystemDiskWriteIOPS_Avg: Average in-band system disk write IOPS
- NetTcpConnection_Avg: Average in-band TCP connection count
 tip
Valid only when `ScalingPolicyType` is set to Alarm. You must configure the relevant parameters for `AlarmPolicy.Condition.x` or `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`. If both are configured, only `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x` takes effect.

AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit.description_cn:
单指标告警时的监控指标阈值的单位。取值：
- 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName参数取值为CPU/内存使用率时: Percent。	
- 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName参数取值为系统盘读/写带宽时: Bytes/Second(IEC)。
- 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName参数取值为系统盘读/写IOPS时: Count/Second。
- 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName参数取值为TCP连接数时: Count。
- 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName参数取值为网络流入/流出速率时: Bits/Second(IEC)。
- 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName参数取值为网络收发包速率时: Packet/Second。
 tip
仅当`ScalingPolicyType`取值为Alarm时有效，且必须配置`AlarmPolicy.Condition.x`或`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`相关参数，当二者同时配置时，仅`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`生效。
AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit.description_en:
Unit for monitoring metric thresholds in single-metric alarms. Possible values:
- If the AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName parameter is set to CPU or memory usage: Percent
- If the AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName parameter is set to system disk read/write bandwidth: Bytes/Second (IEC)
- If the AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName parameter is set to system disk read/write IOPS: Count/Second
- If the AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName parameter is set to TCP connections: Count
- If the AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName parameter is set to network inbound/outbound rate: Bits/Second (IEC)
- If the AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName parameter is set to network packet rate: Packet/Second
 tip
Valid only when `ScalingPolicyType` is set to Alarm. You must configure the relevant `AlarmPolicy.Condition.x` or `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x` parameters. If both are configured, only `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x` takes effect.

AlarmPolicy.Condition.Threshold.description_cn:
单指标告警时的监控指标的阈值，取值：
- 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit取值为Percent时：1 ～ 100。
- 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit取值为Bytes/Second(IEC)时：大于0的整数。
- 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit取值为Count/Second时：大于0的整数。
- 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit取值为Count时：大于0的整数。
- 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit取值为Bits/Second(IEC)时：大于0的整数。
- 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit取值为Packet/Second时：大于0的整数。
 tip
仅当`ScalingPolicyType`取值为Alarm时有效，且必须配置`AlarmPolicy.Condition.x`或`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`相关参数，当二者同时配置时，仅`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`生效。
AlarmPolicy.Condition.Threshold.description_en:
Threshold value for monitoring metrics in single-metric alarms:
- If AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit is Percent: 1 to 100
- If AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit is Bytes/Second(IEC): positive integers only
- If AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit is Count/Second: positive integers only
- If AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit is Count: positive integers only
- If AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit is Bits/Second(IEC): positive integers only
- If AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit is Packet/Second: positive integers only
 tip
Valid only when `ScalingPolicyType` is set to Alarm. You must configure the relevant `AlarmPolicy.Condition.x` or `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x` parameters. If both are configured, only `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x` takes effect.

AlarmPolicy.ConditionOperator.description_cn:
多指标告警时的判定条件。
- &&：多个指标同时成立才判定为触发告警。
	
- ||（默认）：任意指标满足条件就判定为触发告警。
	
 tip
仅当`ScalingPolicyType`取值为Alarm时有效，且配置`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`相关参数时生效。
AlarmPolicy.ConditionOperator.description_en:
Criteria for triggering alerts with multiple metrics
- &&: Alert is triggered only when all metrics meet the conditions
- || (default): Alert is triggered when any metric meets the condition

 tip
Effective only when `ScalingPolicyType` is set to Alarm and the relevant `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x` parameters are configured

AlarmPolicy.Conditions.N.ComparisonOpera.description_cn:
多指标告警时的规则表达式对象。

- \>：大于
	
- <：小于
	
- \=：等于
	
 tip
仅当`ScalingPolicyType`取值为Alarm时有效，且必须配置`AlarmPolicy.Condition.x`或`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`相关参数，当二者同时配置时，仅`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`生效。
AlarmPolicy.Conditions.N.ComparisonOpera.description_en:
Rule expression object for multi-metric alarms

- >: greater than
- <: less than
- =: equal to

 tip

AlarmPolicy.Conditions.N.MetricName.description_cn:
多指标告警时的监控指标名称。
- 取值：
	- CpuTotal_Max：带内CPU使用率最大值。
	- CpuTotal\_Min：带内CPU使用率最小值。
		
	- CpuTotal\_Avg：带内CPU使用率平均值。
		
	- MemoryUsedUtilization\_Max：带内内存使用率最大值。
		
	- MemoryUsedUtilization\_Min：带内内存使用率最小值。
		
	- MemoryUsedUtilization\_Avg：带内内存使用率平均值。
		
	- Instance\_CpuBusy\_Max：带外CPU利用率最大值。
		
	- Instance\_CpuBusy\_Min：带外CPU利用率最小值。
		
	- Instance\_CpuBusy\_Avg：带外CPU利用率平均值。
    - Instance_NetTxBits_Avg: 带外网络流出速率平均值。
    - Instance_NetRxBits_Avg: 带外网络流入速率平均值。
    - Instance_NetTxPackets_Avg: 带外网络发送包速率平均值。
    - Instance_NetRxPackets_Avg: 带外网络接收包速率平均值。
		
	- SystemDiskReadBytes\_Avg: 带内系统盘读带宽平均值。
		
	- SystemDiskWriteBytes\_Avg: 带内系统盘写带宽平均值。
		
	- SystemDiskReadIOPS\_Avg: 带内系统盘读IOPS平均值。
		
	- SystemDiskWriteIOPS\_Avg: 带内系统盘写IOPS平均值。
		
	- NetTcpConnection\_Avg: 带内TCP连接数平均值。
		
- 参数 - N：表示指标的序号，取值：1 - 5。
	
- 多个实例规格之间用&分隔。
 tip
仅当`ScalingPolicyType`取值为Alarm时有效，且必须配置`AlarmPolicy.Condition.x`或`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`相关参数，当二者同时配置时，仅`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`生效。
AlarmPolicy.Conditions.N.MetricName.description_en:
Monitoring metric names for multi-metric alarms
- Values:
    - CpuTotal_Max: Maximum in-band CPU usage
    - CpuTotal_Min: Minimum in-band CPU usage
    - CpuTotal_Avg: Average in-band CPU usage
    - MemoryUsedUtilization_Max: Maximum in-band memory usage
    - MemoryUsedUtilization_Min: Minimum in-band memory usage
    - MemoryUsedUtilization_Avg: Average in-band memory usage
    - Instance_CpuBusy_Max: Maximum out-of-band CPU utilization
    - Instance_CpuBusy_Min: Minimum out-of-band CPU utilization
    - Instance_CpuBusy_Avg: Average out-of-band CPU utilization
    - Instance_NetTxBits_Avg: Average out-of-band network outbound rate (bits)
    - Instance_NetRxBits_Avg: Average out-of-band network inbound rate (bits)
    - Instance_NetTxPackets_Avg: Average out-of-band network outbound packet rate
    - Instance_NetRxPackets_Avg: Average out-of-band network inbound packet rate
    - SystemDiskReadBytes_Avg: Average in-band system disk read bandwidth
    - SystemDiskWriteBytes_Avg: Average in-band system disk write bandwidth
    - SystemDiskReadIOPS_Avg: Average in-band system disk read IOPS
    - SystemDiskWriteIOPS_Avg: Average in-band system disk write IOPS
    - NetTcpConnection_Avg: Average in-band TCP connection count

- Parameter - N: Indicates the metric sequence number, values range from 1 to 5

- Use & to separate multiple instance specifications
 tip
Valid only when `ScalingPolicyType` is set to Alarm. You must configure the relevant `AlarmPolicy.Condition.x` or `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x` parameters. If both are configured, only `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x` takes effect.

AlarmPolicy.Conditions.N.MetricUnit.description_cn:

   - 当AlarmPolicy.Conditions.MetricName参数取值为CPU/内存使用率时: Percent。

AlarmPolicy.Conditions.N.MetricUnit.description_en:
Unit for monitoring metric thresholds in multi-metric alarms
- Values:
   - When the AlarmPolicy.Conditions.MetricName parameter is set to CPU or memory usage: Percent
   - When the AlarmPolicy.Conditions.MetricName parameter is set to system disk read/write bandwidth: Bytes/Second (IEC)

AlarmPolicy.Conditions.N.Threshold.description_cn:
多指标告警时的监控指标的阈值。
- 取值：

   - 当AlarmPolicy.Conditions.MetricUnit取值为Percent时：1 ～ 100。
	
   - 当AlarmPolicy.Conditions.MetricUnit取值为Bytes/Second(IEC)时：大于0的整数。

AlarmPolicy.Conditions.N.Threshold.description_en:
Threshold for monitoring metrics in multi-metric alarms
- Value range:
   - When AlarmPolicy.Conditions.MetricUnit is Percent: 1 to 100
   - When AlarmPolicy.Conditions.MetricUnit is Bytes/Second (IEC): positive integers only
   - When AlarmPolicy.Conditions.MetricUnit is Count/Second: positive integers only

Valid only when ScalingPolicyType is set to Alarm. You must configure either AlarmPolicy.Condition.x or AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x. If both are configured, only AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x takes effect

AlarmPolicy.Effective.description_cn:
指定报警任务的生效时间段。
* 不填表示在所有时间都生效。
* 如需在特定时间生效，请使用[Cron表达式](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/101113)配置，适用于在业务高峰期关闭缩容等场景。
AlarmPolicy.Effective.description_en:
Set the active time period for the alert task
* Leave blank to apply at all times
* To activate during specific times, use a [Cron expression](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/101113). This is useful for scenarios like disabling scaling during peak business hours and similar scenarios

AlarmPolicy.EvaluationCount.description_cn:
当监控指标数据连续几次达到阈值时，即触发伸缩行为。取值：1 ～ 180。
 tip
仅当ScalingPolicyType取值为Alarm时有效且为必填项。
AlarmPolicy.EvaluationCount.description_en:
Triggers a scaling action when the monitoring metric data reaches the threshold for several consecutive occurrences. Value range: 1–180
 tip
Required and valid only when ScalingPolicyType is set to Alarm

AlarmPolicy.RuleType.description_cn:
报警任务的类型，取值：
- Static：表示由agent采集的静态监控。
 tip
仅当ScalingPolicyType取值为Alarm时有效且为必填项。
AlarmPolicy.RuleType.description_en:
Alarm task type. Possible values:
- Static: Indicates static monitoring collected by the agent
 tip
Valid and required only when ScalingPolicyType is set to Alarm

ClientToken.description_cn:
保证请求幂等性。由客户端自动生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一，避免当调用API超时或服务器内部错误时，客户端多次重试导致重复性操作。取值：
仅支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
ClientToken.description_en:
Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if the API times out or a server error occurs and the client retries. Value requirements:
Only ASCII characters are supported, and the value must not exceed 64 characters.

Cooldown.description_cn:
伸缩规则的冷却时间。 取值：0~86400，单位：秒，不填则默认使用伸缩组的冷却时间。
 tip
当伸缩规则的冷却时间和伸缩组的冷却时间冲突时，伸缩规则的冷却时间更为优先。
Cooldown.description_en:
Cooldown time for the scaling rule. Range: 0–86400 seconds. If left blank, the scaling group's cooldown time is used.
 tip
If the cooldown time for the scaling rule conflicts with the scaling group's cooldown time, the scaling rule's cooldown time takes priority.

ScalingGroupId.description_cn: 伸缩规则所属的伸缩组的ID。您可以调用[DescribeScalingGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109814)查询伸缩组ID。
ScalingGroupId.description_en: ID of the scaling group to which the scaling rule belongs. You can call [DescribeScalingGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109814) to query the scaling group ID.

ScalingPolicyName.description_cn:
伸缩规则的名称，在同一地域下同一伸缩组中伸缩规则名称唯一。取值:
- 只能以中文、字母开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线和中划线。
- 长度限制为1~ 128个字符。
- 暂不支持特殊字符。
ScalingPolicyName.description_en:
Scaling rule names must be unique within the same scaling group and region
Naming requirements:
- Must start with a Chinese character or letter
- Can include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens
- Length must be 1 to 128 characters
- Currently, special characters are not supported

ScalingPolicyType.description_cn:
伸缩规则的类型，取值：
- Scheduled：定时任务。
- Recurrence：周期任务。
- Alarm：报警任务。
ScalingPolicyType.description_en:
Scaling rule type options:
- Scheduled: Scheduled task
- Recurrence: Recurring task
- Alarm: Alarm task

ScheduledPolicy.LaunchTime.description_cn:
表示任务的触发时间。
- 当ScalingPolicyType取值为Scheduled时，表示定时任务的触发时间，需大于当前时刻。
- 当ScalingPolicyType取值为Recurrence时：
    - 如果未指定ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType时，则表示仅按照此处指定的日期和时间执行一次。
    - 如果指定了ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType，则表示周期任务开始时间。
    - 仅支持选择自创建/修改当日起90日内的时间。
- 当ScalingPolicyType取值为Alarm时，本参数无效。
ScheduledPolicy.LaunchTime.description_en:
Specifies the trigger time for the task
- If ScalingPolicyType is set to Scheduled, this is the trigger time for a scheduled task and must be later than the current time
- If ScalingPolicyType is set to Recurrence:
    - If ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType is not specified, the task runs once at the date and time specified here
    - If ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType is specified, this is the start time for the recurring task
    - Only times within 90 days from the creation or modification date are supported
- If ScalingPolicyType is set to Alarm, this parameter is not applicable

ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceEndTime.description_cn:
表示周期任务的结束时间。仅支持选择自创建当日起365日内的时间。
* 若不配置，则根据重复周期（ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType）默认为此刻后的一天/周/月。
* 设置为空，表示本任务永不停止。
 tip
当ScalingPolicyType取值为Recurrence时有效且为必填项。
ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceEndTime.description_en:
Specifies the end time for the recurring task. Only times within 365 days from the creation date are supported.
* If not set, the default is one day/week/month after the current time, based on the recurrence type (ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType).
* Leave blank to keep the task running indefinitely.
 tip
Required and only valid when ScalingPolicyType is set to Recurrence.

ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType.description_cn:
表示周期任务的重复周期，取值：
- Daily：每XX天执行一次。
- Weekly：选择每周中的几天，每天执行一次。
- Monthly：选择每月中XX号到XX号，每天执行一次。
- Cron：按照指定的Cron表达式执行。
 tip
当ScalingPolicyType取值为Recurrence时有效且为必填项。
ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType.description_en:
Specifies the recurrence period for scheduled tasks. Options:
- Daily: Runs once every XX days
- Weekly: Select specific days of the week to run once per day
- Monthly: Select a date range within the month to run once per day
- Cron: Runs according to the specified Cron expression
 tip
Required and only valid when ScalingPolicyType is set to Recurrence

ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceValue.description_cn:
表示重复执行周期任务的数值。
- 当ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType参数取值为Daily时，只能填写一个值，取值：1 ~ 31。
- 当ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType参数取值为Weekly时，可以填入多个值，使用英文逗号（,）分隔。星期一到星期日的取值依次为：1,2,3,4,5,6,7。
- 当ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType参数取值为Monthly时，格式为A-B。A、B的取值范围均为1~31，且B必须大于等于A。
- 当ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType参数取值为Cron 时，表示UTC+8时间，支持分、时、日、月、星期的5域表达式，支持通配符英文逗号（,）、英文问号（?）、连词符（-）、星号（*）、井号（#）、斜线（/）、L和W。
 tip
当ScalingPolicyType取值为Recurrence时有效且为必填项。
ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceValue.description_en:
Indicates the value for recurring scheduled tasks
- If ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType is set to Daily, enter a single value from 1 to 31
- If ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType is set to Weekly, you can enter multiple values separated by commas. Values for Monday to Sunday are: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7
- If ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType is set to Monthly, use the format A-B. Both A and B must be between 1 and 31, and B must be greater than or equal to A
- If ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType is set to Cron, it uses UTC+8 time and supports a five-field expression for minute, hour, day, month, and week. Supported wildcards: comma (,), question mark (?), hyphen (-), asterisk (*), hash (#), slash (/), L, and W
 tip
Effective and required when ScalingPolicyType is set to Recurrence
