- 参数 - Type：表示负载均衡服务器组的类型。
	- ALB：应用型负载均衡。
	- CLB：传统型型负载均衡。
- 多个服务器组的ID之间用&分隔。
ServerGroupAttributes.N.Type.description_en:
Load Balancing Server Group Types:
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the load balancing server group. Valid values are 1 to 40. For single-type server groups, you can select up to 20.
- Parameter - Type: Indicates the type of load balancing server group.
  - ALB: Application Load Balancer
  - CLB: Classic Load Balancer
- Separate multiple server group IDs with &

ScalingGroupId.description_cn: 伸缩组的ID。您可以调用[DescribeScalingGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109814)查询伸缩组ID。
ScalingGroupId.description_en: Scaling group ID. You can call [DescribeScalingGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109814) to query the scaling group ID.

ScalingPolicyId.description_cn: 伸缩规则的ID。您可以调用[DescribeScalingPolicies](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109829) 查询伸缩规则的ID和当前状态。
ScalingPolicyId.description_en: Scaling policy ID. Call [DescribeScalingPolicies](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109829) to query the scaling policy ID and current status

ScalingConfigurationId.description_cn: 伸缩配置ID。您可以调用[DescribeScalingGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109814)查询伸缩组ID。
ScalingConfigurationId.description_en:
Scaling Configuration ID
You can call [DescribeScalingGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109814) to query the scaling group ID

ScalingGroupId.description_cn: 伸缩组ID。您可以调用[DescribeScalingConfigurations](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109824)接口查询伸缩配置ID。
ScalingGroupId.description_en:
Scaling Group ID
To query the scaling configuration ID, call the [DescribeScalingConfigurations](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109824) API.

ScalingGroupId.description_cn: 伸缩组的ID。您可以调用[DescribeScalingGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109814)查询伸缩组ID。
ScalingGroupId.description_en: Scaling group ID. You can call [DescribeScalingGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109814) to query the scaling group ID.

ScalingPolicyId.description_cn: 伸缩规则的ID。您可以调用[DescribeScalingPolicies](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109829) 查询伸缩规则的ID和当前状态。
ScalingPolicyId.description_en: Scaling rule ID. You can call [DescribeScalingPolicies](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109829) to query the scaling rule ID and current status.

ClientToken.description_cn:
保证请求幂等性。由客户端自动生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一，避免当调用API超时或服务器内部错误时，客户端多次重试导致重复性操作。取值：
- 仅支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
ClientToken.description_en:
Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to ensure uniqueness across requests and prevent duplicate operations when the client retries multiple times due to API timeouts or server errors. Value requirements:
- Only ASCII characters supported, maximum 64 characters

InstanceIds.N.description_cn:
实例ID。您可以调用[DescribeScalingInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109831)接口查询实例ID。
- 参数 - N：表示实例的序号，取值1 ～ 20。
- 多个实例ID之间用&分隔。
InstanceIds.N.description_en:
Instance ID. You can call the [DescribeScalingInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109831) API to query instance IDs.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the instance sequence number; valid values are 1 to 20.
- Separate multiple instance IDs with &.

ScalingGroupId.description_cn: 伸缩组ID。
ScalingGroupId.description_en: Scaling Group ID

ClientToken.description_cn:
保证请求幂等性。由客户端自动生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一，避免当调用API超时或服务器内部错误时，客户端多次重试导致重复性操作。取值：
- 仅支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
ClientToken.description_en:
Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if the API times out or a server error occurs and the client retries. Value requirements:
- Only ASCII characters are supported and the value must not exceed 64 characters

InstanceIds.N.description_cn:
实例ID。您可以调用[DescribeScalingInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109831)接口查询实例ID。
- 参数 - N：表示实例的序号，取值1 ～ 20。
- 多个实例ID之间用&分隔。
InstanceIds.N.description_en:
Instance ID. You can call the [DescribeScalingInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109831) API to query the instance ID. 
- Parameter - N: Indicates the instance sequence number, with values from 1 to 20. 
- Separate multiple instance IDs with &.

ScalingGroupId.description_cn: 伸缩组ID。
ScalingGroupId.description_en: Scaling Group ID

MaxResults.description_cn: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，取值范围为1~100，默认为10。
MaxResults.description_en: Set the number of rows per page for paginated queries. Valid range: 1–100, default: 10

NextToken.description_cn: 分页查询凭证，用于标记分页的位置，初次调用该接口时无需设置。下次查询时，取值为上一次API调用返回的`NextToken`参数值。
NextToken.description_en: A pagination token is used to mark the position in paginated queries. You do not need to set this when calling this interface for the first time. For subsequent queries, set its value to the `NextToken` parameter returned from your previous call to this interface.

ResourceIds.N.description_cn:
资源ID。 您可以调用[DescribeScalingGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109814) 接口查询伸缩组ID。
- 参数 - N：表示资源的序号，支持多选。取值范围：1~20。
ResourceIds.N.description_en:
Resource ID. You can call the [DescribeScalingGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109814) API to query the scaling group ID.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the resource index; supports multiple selections. Value range: 1–20.

ResourceType.description_cn:
资源类型。取值：
- scalinggroup：伸缩组。
ResourceType.description_en:
Resource type
Possible values:
- scalinggroup: scaling group

TagFilters.N.Key.description_cn:
精确查找弹性伸缩资源时使用的标签键。
- 标签键长度的取值范围：1~128。
- 参数 - N：表示标签键的序号。取值：1～50。
- 多个标签键之间用&分隔。
	`TagFilters`用于精确查找绑定了指定标签的弹性伸缩资源，由一个键值对组成。
- 仅指定本参数时，返回关联该标签键的所有资源。
- 同时指定多个标签键时，返回同时满足所有标签键的资源。
TagFilters.N.Key.description_en:
Tag keys are used to precisely search for auto scaling resources
- Tag key length: 1–128 characters
- Parameter - N: indicates the tag key sequence number. Range: 1–50
- Separate multiple tag keys with &
`TagFilters` is used to precisely search for auto scaling resources bound to specified tags and consists of a key-value pair
- If only this parameter is specified, all resources associated with the tag key are returned
- If multiple tag keys are specified, only resources matching all tag keys are returned

TagFilters.N.Value.description_cn:
精确查找弹性伸缩资源时使用的标签值。
- 标签值可以为空字符串，长度取值范围：1~128。
- 参数 - N：表示标签值的序号。取值范围：1～50。
- 多个标签值之间用&分隔。
> 指定本参数时，则必须指定TagFilters.N.Key。
TagFilters.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value used for precise search of elastic scaling resources
- Tag value can be an empty string, or if not empty, its length must be between 1 and 128 characters
- Parameter N indicates the sequence number of the tag value; valid range: 1–50
- Separate multiple tag values with &
> When specifying this parameter, you must also specify TagFilters.N.Key

LifecycleCommand.CommandId.description_cn:
云助手命令ID，表示触发生命周期挂钩后执行云助手命令，在实例中安装。
- 如果命令执行成功，则按照CONTINUE执行挂起结束后的策略。
- 如果命令执行失败/超时或生命周期挂钩超时，则按照`LifecycleHookPolicy`参数的配置执行挂起结束后的策略。
 tip
关联云助手前，您需要首先创建所需的运维命令，并确认相关实例已安装云助手客户端。详细操作请参见[挂钩关联云助手功能介绍](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/108545#%E7%9B%B8%E5%85%B3%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD)。
LifecycleCommand.CommandId.description_en:
Cloud Assistant command ID. Indicates that the Cloud Assistant command will be executed on the instance after the lifecycle hook is triggered.
- If the command executes successfully, the policy applied after suspension ends will follow CONTINUE.
- If the command fails, times out, or the lifecycle hook times out, the policy applied after suspension ends will follow the configuration of the `LifecycleHookPolicy` parameter.
 tip
Before associating Cloud Assistant, create the required maintenance command and make sure the relevant instances have the Cloud Assistant client installed. For details, see [Cloud Assistant Hook Association Feature Overview](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/108545#%E7%9B%B8%E5%85%B3%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD).

LifecycleCommand.Parameters.description_cn:
云助手命令中的参数和参数值。
参数的个数范围为0~60，且需要注意：
- 参数不允许为空字符串，最多支持64个字符。
- 值允许为空字符串。
- 参数与原始命令内容在Base64编码后，综合长度不能超过16KB。
- 设置的参数名集合必须为创建命令时定义的参数集的子集。对于未传入的参数，使用默认值代替。
LifecycleCommand.Parameters.description_en:
Parameters and parameter values in cloud assistant commands
You can set 0 to 60 parameters. Note the following:
- Parameter names cannot be empty strings and can have up to 64 characters
- Parameter values can be empty strings
- The combined length of parameters and the original command, after Base64 encoding, must not exceed 16KB
- The set of parameter names must be a subset of those defined when creating the command. For parameters not provided, the default value will be used

LifecycleHookId.description_cn: 生命周期挂钩ID。您可以调用[DescribeLifecycleHooks](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/130747)接口查询生命周期挂钩ID。
LifecycleHookId.description_en: Lifecycle hook ID. You can call the [DescribeLifecycleHooks](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/130747) API to query the lifecycle hook ID.

LifecycleHookPolicy.description_cn:
实例挂起状态结束后执行的策略。取值：
- CONTINUE：继续执行。
- REJECT：中止后续操作。
- ROLLBACK：针对弹性收缩活动，会拒绝释放ECS实例，进行回滚；针对弹性扩张活动，效果同REJECT一样。
 tip 
执行后实例变更流程的详细介绍请参见[执行流程和策略](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/108545#%E6%89%A7%E8%A1%8C%E6%B5%81%E7%A8%8B%E5%92%8C%E7%AD%96%E7%95%A5)。
LifecycleHookPolicy.description_en:
Strategy to be executed after an instance exits the suspended state. Possible values:
- CONTINUE: Continue execution
- REJECT: Abort subsequent operations
- ROLLBACK: For scale-in activities, ECS instance release is denied and the operation is rolled back; for scale-out activities, this has the same effect as REJECT
 tip
For a detailed description of the instance change process after execution, please refer to [Execution Process and Strategy](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/108545#%E6%89%A7%E8%A1%8C%E6%B5%81%E7%A8%8B%E5%92%8C%E7%AD%96%E7%95%A5).

LifecycleHookTimeout.description_cn: ECS实例保持挂起状态的时间，超时后，自动结束挂起状态，根据执行策略继续执行扩缩容行为。 请您评估自定义操作的处理时间后，设置合适的超时时间。取值：30 ～ 21600（6小时），单位 s，且必须为整数。
LifecycleHookTimeout.description_en: Duration for which the ECS instance remains suspended. When the timeout is reached, the instance automatically exits the suspended state and scaling out or scaling in actions continue according to the execution policy. Please evaluate the processing time of your custom operations and set an appropriate timeout. Range: 30–21600 seconds (up to 6 hours), must be an integer.

LifecycleHookType.description_cn:
伸缩活动的类型，发生指定类型的伸缩活动时，生命周期挂钩会被触发并挂起ECS实例。取值：
- SCALE_IN：弹性收缩活动。
- SCALE_OUT：弹性扩张活动。
LifecycleHookType.description_en:
Type of scaling activity. When a specified type of scaling activity occurs, the lifecycle hook is triggered and the ECS instance is suspended. Options:
- SCALE_IN: Elastic scale-in activity
- SCALE_OUT: Elastic scale-out activity

EventTypes.N.description_cn:
事件通知类型。
- 参数 - N：表示事件通知类型的序号，取值1 ~ 10。
- 多个事件通知类型之间用&分隔。
- 取值：
	- ScaleOutSuccess：扩容伸缩活动成功。
	- ScaleInSuccess：缩容伸缩活动成功。
	- ScaleOutError：扩容伸缩活动失败。
	- ScaleInError：缩容伸缩活动失败。
	- ScaleOutWarn：扩容伸缩活动部分成功。
	- ScaleInWarn：缩容伸缩活动部分成功。
	- ScaleReject：伸缩活动执行被拒绝。
	- ScaleOutStart：扩容伸缩活动开始。
	- ScaleInStart ：缩容伸缩活动开始。
	- ScheduleTaskExpiring： 周期规则到期提醒。
EventTypes.N.description_en:
Event notification types
- Parameter - N: Indicates the serial number of the event notification type, values range from 1 to 10
- Use & to separate multiple event notification types
- Values:
	- ScaleOutSuccess: Scale-out scaling activity succeeded
	- ScaleInSuccess: Scale-in scaling activity succeeded
	- ScaleOutError: Scale-out scaling activity failed
	- ScaleInError: Scale-in scaling activity failed
	- ScaleOutWarn: Scale-out scaling activity partially succeeded
	- ScaleInWarn: Scale-in scaling activity partially succeeded
	- ScaleReject: Scaling activity execution was rejected
	- ScaleOutStart: Scale-out scaling activity started
	- ScaleInStart: Scale-in scaling activity started
	- ScheduleTaskExpiring: Periodic rule expiration reminder

ScalingGroupId.description_cn: 伸缩组ID。您可以调用[DescribeScalingGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109814)查询伸缩组ID。
ScalingGroupId.description_en: Scaling Group ID. You can call [DescribeScalingGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109814) to query the scaling group ID

Eip.Bandwidth.description_cn:
公网IP的带宽峰值，单位：Mbps。取值：
- 当Eip.BillingType取值为PostPaidByBandwidth时，取值为1 ～ 500。
- 当Eip.BillingType取值为PostPaidByTraffic时，取值为1 ～ 200。
 tip
如果您指定的伸缩配置中已配置公网IP，此时指定本参数为0值，则表示删除公网IP配置；如果未配置公网IP，那么配置Eip.Bandwidth、Eip.ISP、Eip.BillingType中的任意一项后，均可以为伸缩配置添加公网IP配置，未配置参数取默认值。
Eip.Bandwidth.description_en:
Peak bandwidth for public IP, in Mbps. Value range:
- If Eip.BillingType is set to PostPaidByBandwidth, the range is 1 to 500
- If Eip.BillingType is set to PostPaidByTraffic, the range is 1 to 200
 tip
If a public IP is already configured in your scaling configuration and you set this parameter to 0, the public IP configuration will be removed. If no public IP is configured, specifying any of Eip.Bandwidth, Eip.ISP, or Eip.BillingType will add a public IP configuration to the scaling configuration. Any unspecified parameters will use their default values.

Eip.BandwidthPackageId.description_cn:
共享带宽包的ID，表示将公网IP加入到共享带宽包。 您可以调用 [DescribeBandwidthPackages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6623/100685) 接口，查询共享带宽包的ID。 公网IP加入到共享带宽包必须同时满足如下条件：
- 二者的安全防护类型相同。
- 二者的线路类型相同。
- 共享带宽包为IPv4类型。
Eip.BandwidthPackageId.description_en:
The shared bandwidth package ID is used to add a public IP to a shared bandwidth package. You can call the [DescribeBandwidthPackages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6623/100685) API to query the shared bandwidth package ID. To add a public IP to a shared bandwidth package, the following conditions must be met:
- Both must have the same security protection type
- Both must have the same line type
- The shared bandwidth package must be IPv4 type

Eip.BillingType.description_cn:
公网IP的计费类型，取值：
- PostPaidByBandwidth：按量计费-按带宽上限计费。
- PostPaidByTraffic：按量计费-按实际流量计费。
 tip
如果您需要使实例在加入伸缩组时自动分配公网IP，则必须至少配置Eip.Bandwidth、Eip.ISP、Eip.BillingType中的任意一项，均不配置则表示不分配公网IP。
Eip.BillingType.description_en:
Public IP billing type options:
- PostPaidByBandwidth: Pay-as-you-go—charged by bandwidth cap
- PostPaidByTraffic: Pay-as-you-go—charged by actual traffic
 tip
To automatically assign a public IP when adding an instance to a scaling group, you must configure at least one of the following: Eip.Bandwidth, Eip.ISP, or Eip.BillingType. If none are configured, no public IP will be assigned.

Eip.ISP.description_cn:
线路类型，取值：
- BGP：BGP线路。
- 若您的账号已申请使用静态单线，ISP还可以传入ChinaMobile（表示中国移动）、ChinaTelecom（表示中国电信）、ChinaUnicom（表示中国联通）。
 tip
如果您需要使实例在加入伸缩组时自动分配公网IP，则必须至少配置Eip.Bandwidth、Eip.ISP、Eip.BillingType中的任意一项，均不配置则表示不分配公网IP。
Eip.ISP.description_en:
Line type options:
- BGP: BGP route
- If your account has applied for static single line, the ISP can also be specified as ChinaMobile (China Mobile), ChinaTelecom (China Telecom), or ChinaUnicom (China Unicom)
 tip
To automatically assign a public IP when an instance joins a scaling group, you must configure at least one of Eip.Bandwidth, Eip.ISP, or Eip.BillingType. If none are set, no public IP will be assigned.

Eip.ReleaseWithInstance.description_cn:
公网IP是否随实例删除。
仅按量计费公网IP且在ECS控制台删除实例时生效，在伸缩组中删除实例后公网IP的保留情况请参见[实例管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/87021)中的详细说明。取值：
- true：公网IP随实例删除。
- false：公网IP不随实例删除。
Eip.ReleaseWithInstance.description_en:
Delete public IP with instance
This setting applies only to pay-as-you-go public IPs when deleting instances in the ECS console. For details on public IP retention when deleting instances in scaling groups, see [Instance Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/87021).
Options:
- true: Delete public IP with instance
- false: Retain public IP after instance deletion

Eip.SecurityProtectionInstanceId.description_cn:
安全防护包的ID。
 tip
当`Eip.SecurityProtectionTypes.N`不为空时，本参数必填。
Eip.SecurityProtectionInstanceId.description_en:
Security protection package ID
 tip
This parameter is required when `Eip.SecurityProtectionTypes.N` is not empty

Eip.SecurityProtectionTypes.N.description_cn:
公网IP的安全防护类型。
- 参数 - N：表示安全防护类型的序号，当前仅支持取1。
- 取值：
	- AntiDDoS_Enhanced：申请增强防护类型的公网IP（可加入到DDoS原生防护实例）。
	- 不填则表示基础防护类型的公网IP。
Eip.SecurityProtectionTypes.N.description_en:
Public IP security protection type
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the security protection type; currently, only 1 is supported
- Values:
    - AntiDDoS_Enhanced: Public IP with enhanced protection (can be added to a native DDoS protection instance)
    - Leave blank: Public IP with basic protection

HostName.description_cn:
实例的主机名。取值：
- Linux实例
	- 允许使用点号分隔字符成多段，每段中允许使用字母、数字或中划线“-”。
	- 不能以点号“.”或中划线“-”开头或结尾，且不能连续使用点号“.”或中划线“-”。
	- Linux系统的主机名长度限制为2～63个字符。
- Windows实例
	- 允许使用字母、数字或中划线“-”，不能完全是数字。
	- 不能以中划线“-”开头或结尾，且不能连续使用中划线“-”。
	- Windows系统的主机名长度限制在2～15个字符。
 tip
您可以为扩容的各实例设置有序且唯一的实例名称或主机名称，配置规则请参见[配置有序且唯一的实例名称或主机名称](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/699428).
HostName.description_en:
Instance hostname. Valid values:
- Linux instances
  - You can use periods (.) to separate the hostname into segments. Each segment can contain letters, numbers, or hyphens (-)
  - The hostname cannot start or end with a period (.) or hyphen (-), and periods or hyphens cannot appear consecutively
  - Hostnames must be 2 to 63 characters long for Linux systems
- Windows instances
  - You can use letters, numbers, or hyphens (-). The hostname cannot consist entirely of numbers
  - The hostname cannot start or end with a hyphen (-), and hyphens cannot appear consecutively
  - Hostnames must be 2 to 15 characters long for Windows systems
 tip
You can set sequential and unique instance names or hostnames for scaled-out instances. For configuration rules, see [Configure sequential and unique instance names or hostnames](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/699428)

HpcClusterId.description_cn:
实例所属的高性能计算集群的ID。
仅当`InstanceTypes.N`指定为“高性能计算GPU型”时有效。
HpcClusterId.description_en: ID of the high-performance computing cluster the instance belongs to. Valid only when `InstanceTypes.N` is specified as "high-performance computing GPU type".

ImageId.description_cn: 镜像ID，伸缩组自动创建实例时使用的镜像资源。您可以调用[DescribeImages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70808)查询镜像ID。
ImageId.description_en: Image ID, the image resource used when the auto scaling group creates instances automatically. You can call [DescribeImages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70808) to query the Image ID.

InstanceDescription.description_cn:
实例的描述，取值：
- 不能以数字、中划线开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线和中划线。
- 长度限制在0 ~ 255之间。
InstanceDescription.description_en:
Instance description value requirements:
- Cannot start with a digit or hyphen
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens
- Length must be between 0 and 255

InstanceName.description_cn:
实例的名称，取值：
- 以字母或中文开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线“_”、中划线“-”和点号“.”。
- 长度限制为1～128个字符。
 tip
您可以为扩容的各实例设置有序且唯一的实例名称或主机名称，配置规则请参见[配置有序且唯一的实例名称或主机名称](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/699428)。
InstanceName.description_en:
Instance name requirements:
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.)
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
 tip
You can set ordered and unique instance names or hostnames for each expanded instance. For configuration rules, see [Configure ordered and unique instance names or hostnames](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/699428).

InstanceTypeOverrides.N.InstanceType.description_cn:
指定抢占式实例的规格。
- 参数 - N：表示实例规格的序号，取值为1 ～ 10。
- 取值 - InstanceType：表示抢占式实例的规格。	
- 多个规格之间用&分隔。
 tip
本参数仅当`SpotStrategy`取值为SpotWithPriceLimit时生效。
InstanceTypeOverrides.N.InstanceType.description_en:
Specify the instance type for spot instances
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the instance type, ranging from 1 to 10
- Value - InstanceType: Indicates the instance type for spot instances
- Separate multiple instance types with &
 tip
This parameter is only effective when `SpotStrategy` is set to SpotWithPriceLimit

InstanceTypeOverrides.N.PriceLimit.description_cn:
指定抢占式实例规格每小时的最高价格。
- 参数 - N：表示实例规格的序号，取值为1 ～ 10。
- 取值 - PriceLimit：表示抢占式实例规格每小时的最高价格。取值：大于0，且最大不超过3位小数。	
- 多个价格之间用&分隔。
 tip
本参数仅当`SpotStrategy`取值为SpotWithPriceLimit时生效。
InstanceTypeOverrides.N.PriceLimit.description_en:
Specify the maximum hourly price for spot instance types
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the instance type, ranging from 1 to 10
- Value - PriceLimit: Represents the maximum hourly price for the spot instance type. Value must be greater than 0 and can have up to three decimal places
- Separate multiple prices with &
 tip
This parameter is only effective when `SpotStrategy` is set to SpotWithPriceLimit

InstanceTypes.N.description_cn: 实例的计算规格列表。您可以调用[DescribeAvailableResource](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/76279)查询计算规格的库存信息。
InstanceTypes.N.description_en: List of instance compute specifications. You can call [DescribeAvailableResource](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/76279) to view the available inventory of compute specifications.

Ipv6AddressCount.description_cn:
是否为实例网卡分配IPv6地址。取值：
- 0：不分配IPv6地址。
- 1：分配IPv6地址，系统自动为您分配IPv6网段。
Ipv6AddressCount.description_en:
Assign IPv6 address to instance network card
Options:
- 0: Do not assign IPv6 address
- 1: Assign IPv6 address; the system automatically allocates an IPv6 subnet for you

KeyPairName.description_cn:
使用“SSH密钥对”登录实例时，请输入密钥对的名称。
如果同时设置了`KeyPairName`和`Password`，则仅生效`KeyPairName`。
KeyPairName.description_en:
When logging in to an instance using an SSH key pair, enter the key pair name
If you set both `KeyPairName` and `Password`, only `KeyPairName` will take effect

Password.description_cn:
使用“密码”方式登录实例时，请设置root登录密码：
- 长度限制在8 ～ 30之间
- 密码只能由大写字母、小写字母、数字和特殊字符组成，且必须包含至少三项
- 特殊字符可以使用：`~!@#$%^&*()_-+= |
- 不能以“/”和“$6$”开头
Password.description_en:
When logging in to an instance using the password method, set a root login password:
- Password length must be between 8 and 30 characters
- Password can only contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters, and must include at least three of these types
- Allowed special characters: `~!@#$%^&*()_-+= |
- Password cannot start with '/' or '$6$'

ProjectName.description_cn:
伸缩配置创建的实例所属项目。一个资源只能归属于一个项目。
- 只能包含字母、数字、下划线“_”、点“.”和中划线“-”。
- 长度限制在64个字符以内。
ProjectName.description_en:
The project to which instances created by the scaling configuration belong. Each resource can belong to only one project
- Only letters, numbers, underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-) are allowed
- Maximum length is 64 characters

ScalingConfigurationId.description_cn: 伸缩配置的ID。您可以调用[DescribeScalingConfigurations](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109824)接口查询伸缩配置ID。
ScalingConfigurationId.description_en: Scaling configuration ID: You can call the [DescribeScalingConfigurations](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109824) API to query the scaling configuration ID

ScalingConfigurationName.description_cn:
伸缩配置的名称，在同一地域下同一伸缩组内伸缩配置名称唯一。取值:
- 只能以中文、字母开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线和中划线。
- 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符。
- 暂不支持特殊字符。
ScalingConfigurationName.description_en:
Scaling configuration name must be unique within the same scaling group and region
Allowed values:
- Must start with a Chinese character or letter
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
- Special characters are not supported for now

SecurityEnhancementStrategy.description_cn:
是否开启安全加固，取值：
- Active：开启安全加固，仅对公共镜像生效。
- InActive：关闭安全加固，对所有镜像生效。
SecurityEnhancementStrategy.description_en:
Whether to enable security hardening. Options:
- Active: Enable security hardening; applies only to public images
- InActive: Disable security hardening; applies to all images

SecurityGroupIds.N.description_cn:
实例主网卡关联的安全组ID。您可以调用[DescribeSecurityGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70753)接口查询安全组ID。取值：
- 参数 - N：表示主网卡关联的安全组的序号，最多支持同时绑定5个安全组，取值：1 ～ 5。
- 参数 - SecurityGroupId：表示主网卡关联的第N个安全组的ID。
- 多个安全组ID之间用&分隔。
SecurityGroupIds.N.description_en:
Security group IDs associated with the instance's primary network interface. You can call the [DescribeSecurityGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70753) API to query security group IDs. Values:
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the security group associated with the primary network interface. You can bind up to 5 security groups at the same time. Valid values: 1 to 5.
- Parameter - SecurityGroupId: Indicates the ID of the Nth security group associated with the primary network interface.
- Separate multiple security group IDs with &.

SpotStrategy.description_cn:
实例的抢占策略。取值：
- NoSpot：表示创建正常按量付费实例。
- SpotAsPriceGo：表示系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格的抢占式实例。
- SpotWithPriceLimit：表示需要设置出价上限的抢占式实例。
SpotStrategy.description_en:
Instance Preemption Policy
Options:
- NoSpot: Create a standard pay-as-you-go instance
- SpotAsPriceGo: System bids automatically; instance price follows current market rates
- SpotWithPriceLimit: Set a maximum bid price for the instance

Tags.description_cn:
伸缩配置创建实例的标签。标签以键值对方式传入，最多传入20组标签。Key命名规则如下：
- Key命名规则如下：
	
	- 不能以`volc:`或`sys:`的任意大小写组合开头。
         tip
        `volc:`或`sys:`开头为系统预留标签键，禁止创建。
        
	- 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“\_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
	- 长度限制在1～128个字符之间。
	> 同一伸缩配置的标签键不允许重复。
- Value命名规则如下：
	- 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“\_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
	- 允许为空，长度限制在0～256个字符之间。
Tags.description_en:
Tags for instances created by the auto scaling configuration. Tags are passed as key-value pairs, with up to 20 pairs allowed. Key naming rules:
- Key naming rules:
    - Cannot start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`
     tip
    Keys starting with `volc:` or `sys:` are reserved for system use and cannot be created
    
    - Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
    - Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
    > Tag keys cannot be duplicated within the same auto scaling configuration
- Value naming rules:
    - Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
    - Can be empty; length must be between 0 and 256 characters

UserData.description_cn:
实例自定义数据。设置的自定义数据必须经过Base64编码，且Base64编码前的自定义数据大小不能超过16KB。
不填则默认为空。
UserData.description_en:
Instance custom data
Custom data must be Base64 encoded and no larger than 16KB before encoding
If left blank, the value is empty by default

Volumes.N.DeleteWithInstance.description_cn:
云盘是否随实例释放：
- 参数 - N：表示云盘的序号，序号为“1”表示系统盘；序号为“2”或大于“2”表示数据盘。取值：1 - 15。
- 参数 - DeleteWithInstance：云盘是否随实例释放。
    - true：云盘随实例释放。
    - false：云盘不随实例释放。
- 取值为false时对系统盘无效，系统盘默认随实例释放，不允许保留。
Volumes.N.DeleteWithInstance.description_en:
Cloud Disk Release with Instance:
- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk sequence number. '1' refers to the system disk; '2' or greater refers to a data disk. Valid values: 1–15
- Parameter - DeleteWithInstance: Specifies whether the cloud disk is released with the instance
    - true: The cloud disk is released with the instance
    - false: The cloud disk is not released with the instance
- Setting this parameter to false does not apply to the system disk. The system disk is always released with the instance and cannot be retained

Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceIOPS.description_cn:
通过此参数可配置云盘额外性能包IOPS性能大小，仅ESSD FlexPL支持。
- 参数 - N：表示云盘的序号，序号为“1”表示系统盘，序号为“2”或大于“2”表示数据盘，仅数据盘支持额外性能包。取值：2～16
- 取值 -ExtraPerformanceIOPS 表示第N个云盘的额外性能包IOPS大小：
  - IOPS: 1-50000
  - Balance: 1-50000
Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceIOPS.description_en:
Use this parameter to configure the IOPS size for the extra performance package of a cloud disk. Only ESSD FlexPL is supported.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk sequence number. '1' refers to the system disk; '2' or greater refers to data disks. Only data disks support the extra performance package. Valid values: 2–16
- Value - ExtraPerformanceIOPS: Specifies the extra performance package IOPS size for the Nth cloud disk:
  - IOPS: 1–50000
  - Balance: 1–50000

Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB.description_cn:
通过此参数可配置云盘额外性能包吞吐性能大小，单位MB/s，仅ESSD FlexPL支持。
- 参数 - N：表示云盘的序号，序号为“1”表示系统盘，序号为“2”或大于“2”表示数据盘，仅数据盘支持额外性能包。取值：2～16
- 取值 -ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB 表示第N个云盘的额外性能包吞吐大小：
  - Throughput：1-650
Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB.description_en:
Use this parameter to configure the extra performance package throughput for cloud disks, measured in MB/s. Only ESSD FlexPL is supported.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk sequence number. '1' refers to the system disk; '2' or greater refers to data disks. Only data disks support extra performance packages. Valid values: 2–16
- Value - ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB: Specifies the extra performance package throughput for the Nth disk:
  - Throughput: 1–650

Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceTypeId.description_cn:
通过此参数可为云盘购买额外性能，仅ESSD FlexPL支持。
- 参数 - N：表示云盘的序号，序号为“1”表示系统盘，序号为“2”或大于“2”表示数据盘，仅数据盘支持额外性能包。取值：2～16
- 取值 -ExtraPerformanceTypeId 表示第N个云盘的额外性能包类型：
  - IOPS:IOPS型，使用ExtraPerformanceIOPS参数
  - Balance: 均衡型，使用ExtraPerformanceIOPS参数
  - Throughput：吞吐量型，使用ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB参数
Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceTypeId.description_en:
Use this parameter to purchase additional performance for cloud disks. Only ESSD FlexPL is supported
- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk sequence number. '1' refers to the system disk; '2' or greater refers to data disks. Only data disks support additional performance packages. Value range: 2–16
- Value - ExtraPerformanceTypeId specifies the type of additional performance package for the Nth disk:
  - IOPS: IOPS type, use the ExtraPerformanceIOPS parameter
  - Balance: balanced type, use the ExtraPerformanceIOPS parameter
  - Throughput: throughput type, use the ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB parameter

Volumes.N.Size.description_cn:
云盘的容量，单位为GiB。
- 参数 - N：表示云盘的序号，序号为“1”表示系统盘；序号为“2”或大于“2”表示数据盘。取值：1 ～ 15。
- 取值 - Size：表述第N个云盘的容量，单位为GiB。
	- 系统盘取值范围：10 - 500。
	- 数据盘取值范围：10 - 8192。
- 多个云盘之间用&分隔。
Volumes.N.Size.description_en:
Cloud disk capacity, measured in GiB
- Parameter - N: Indicates the cloud disk number. '1' refers to the system cloud disk; '2' or greater refers to a data cloud disk. Valid values: 1 to 15
- Value - Size: Specifies the capacity of the Nth cloud disk in GiB
    - System cloud disk range: 10 to 500
    - Data cloud disk range: 10 to 8192
- Use '&' to separate multiple cloud disks

Volumes.N.VolumeType.description_cn:
云盘的类型：
- 参数 - N：表示云盘的序号，序号为“1”表示系统盘，序号为“2”或大于“2”表示数据盘。取值：1 ～ 15。
- 参数 - VolumeType：表示第N个云盘的类型，取值：
    - PTSSD：性能型SSD。
    - ESSD_PL0：极速型SSD PL0。
- 多个云盘之间用&分隔。
Volumes.N.VolumeType.description_en:
Cloud disk types:
- Parameter - N: Indicates the serial number of the cloud disk. '1' represents the system disk; '2' or greater represents a data disk. Value range: 1 to 15.
- Parameter - VolumeType: Specifies the type of the Nth cloud disk. Possible values:
    - PTSSD: Performance SSD.
    - ESSD_PL0: Ultra-fast SSD PL0.
- Separate multiple cloud disks with '&'.

ZoneId.description_cn: 伸缩配置可用区ID。
ZoneId.description_en: Scaling configuration availability zone ID

ActiveScalingConfigurationId.description_cn: 伸缩组绑定的伸缩配置的ID。您可以调用[DescribeScalingConfigurations](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109824) 接口查询伸缩配置ID。
ActiveScalingConfigurationId.description_en: ID of the scaling configuration bound to the scaling group. You can call the [DescribeScalingConfigurations](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109824) API to query the scaling configuration ID.

DefaultCooldown.description_cn:
执行一次伸缩活动（添加或移出ECS实例）结束后的冷却时间。
冷却时间内，该伸缩组不执行其它的伸缩活动，仅针对云监控报警任务触发的伸缩活动和伸缩规则有效。
取值范围：5 ~ 86400，单位：秒。
DefaultCooldown.description_en:
Cooldown period after a scaling activity (adding or removing ECS instances) completes
During the cooldown period, the scaling group does not perform other scaling activities. Only scaling activities triggered by Cloud Monitor alarms and scaling rules take effect
Valid range: 5 to 86400 seconds

DesireInstanceNumber.description_cn:
伸缩组中期望运行的实例个数。更多介绍请参见 [期望实例数](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/97218)。
- 修改期望实例数后，将立即触发一次健康检查行为，组中的实例个数也将会随之变化。
- 取值：不小于最小实例数MinInstanceNumber且不大于最大实例数MaxInstanceNumber。
DesireInstanceNumber.description_en:
Number of expected instances running in the scaling group. For more information, see [Expected Instance Count](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/97218)
- After you modify the expected instance count, a health check is triggered immediately and the number of instances in the group will change accordingly
- Value must be no less than the minimum instance count (MinInstanceNumber) and no greater than the maximum instance count (MaxInstanceNumber)

HealthCheckType.description_cn:
伸缩组的健康检查方式。取值范围：
- NONE（默认）：不做实例健康状态检查。
- ECS：对伸缩组内的ECS实例做健康检查。
HealthCheckType.description_en:
Health check type for the scaling group. Available options:
- NONE (default): No health status checks for instances
- ECS: Perform health status checks on ECS instances in the scaling group

InstanceTerminatePolicy.description_cn:
实例移除策略，取值：
- OldestInstance：移出最早加入 （**包括自动创建和手动添加**）伸缩组的实例。
- NewestInstance：移出最晚加入（**包括自动创建和手动添加**）伸缩组的实例。
- OldestScalingConfigurationWithOldestInstance（默认）：移出最早与伸缩组绑定的伸缩配置中，最早由伸缩组 **自动创建** 的实例。
- OldestScalingConfigurationWithNewestInstance：移出 最早与伸缩组绑定的伸缩配置中，最晚由伸缩组 **自动创建** 的实例。
InstanceTerminatePolicy.description_en:
Instance removal policy options:
- OldestInstance: Remove the earliest instance added to the scaling group (**includes both automatically created and manually added instances**)
- NewestInstance: Remove the latest instance added to the scaling group (**includes both automatically created and manually added instances**)
- OldestScalingConfigurationWithOldestInstance (default): Remove the earliest instance **automatically created** by the scaling group in the oldest scaling configuration bound to the group
- OldestScalingConfigurationWithNewestInstance: Remove the latest instance **automatically created** by the scaling group in the oldest scaling configuration bound to the group

InstancesDistribution.CompensateWithOnDe.description_cn:
是否允许使用按量实例补充抢占式容量。当因价格、库存等原因无法创建足够的抢占式实例时，是否允许使用按量实例补充抢占式容量。取值：
- true: 允许。
- false: 不允许。
InstancesDistribution.CompensateWithOnDe.description_en:
Allow pay-as-you-go instances to supplement preemptible capacity. When there are not enough preemptible instances due to price or inventory, allow pay-as-you-go instances to supplement preemptible capacity. Options:
- true: Allow
- false: Do not allow

InstancesDistribution.OnDemandBaseCapaci.description_cn:
伸缩组中按量计费实例个数的最小值，取值范围：0~2000。当组中按量计费实例个数少于该值时，将优先创建按量计费的实例。
 tip
该参数仅当伸缩组绑定的[伸缩配置来源](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/88737)的计费类型为抢占式类型时生效，且该参数不影响最终创建的实例数量，实例数量仍有最大/最小/期望实例数限制。
InstancesDistribution.OnDemandBaseCapaci.description_en:
Minimum number of pay-as-you-go instances in the auto scaling group. Range: 0–2000. If the number of pay-as-you-go instances in the group falls below this value, pay-as-you-go instances will be created first.
 tip
This parameter only takes effect when the billing type of the [scaling configuration source](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/88737) bound to the auto scaling group is preemptible. It does not affect the final number of instances, which is still limited by the maximum, minimum, and desired instance counts.

InstancesDistribution.OnDemandPercentage.description_cn:
伸缩组满足最小按量实例数要求后，超出的实例中按量实例应占的比例，取值范围：0～100。伸缩组满足最小按量实例数要求后，超出的实例中按量实例应占的比例，取值范围：0～100。
 tip
该参数仅当伸缩组绑定的[伸缩配置来源](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/88737)的计费类型为抢占式类型时生效。
InstancesDistribution.OnDemandPercentage.description_en:
Proportion of pay-as-you-go instances among excess instances after meeting the minimum pay-as-you-go instance requirement; value range: 0–100
Proportion of pay-as-you-go instances among excess instances after meeting the minimum pay-as-you-go instance requirement; value range: 0–100
 tip
This parameter is effective only when the billing type of the [scaling configuration source](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/88737) bound to the scaling group is preemptible.

InstancesDistribution.SpotInstanceRemedy.description_cn:
是否允许抢占式实例到期替换。开启则表示在抢占式实例被回收前5分钟左右，伸缩组将主动新建新的抢占式实例替换掉当前抢占式实例。取值：
- true: 允许。
- false: 不允许。
InstancesDistribution.SpotInstanceRemedy.description_en:
Allow preemptible instance replacement at expiration. When enabled, the scaling group will proactively create a new preemptible instance to replace the current one about 5 minutes before it is reclaimed. Options:
- true: Allow
- false: Do not allow

LaunchTemplateId.description_cn: 实例启动模板ID，配置后表示选择启动模版作为伸缩配置来源。
LaunchTemplateId.description_en: Instance launch template ID. When configured, the launch template is used as the source for scaling configuration

LaunchTemplateOverrides.N.InstanceType.description_cn:
指定实例规格。
- 参数 - N：表示实例规格的序号，取值为1 ～ 10。
- 取值 - InstanceType：表示实例规格。
- 多个实例规格之间用&分隔。
- 填写后，会覆盖启动模板中原本的实例规格。
 tip 
本参数仅当LaunchTemplateId参数存在取值时生有效。
LaunchTemplateOverrides.N.InstanceType.description_en:
Specify instance types
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the instance type, with values from 1 to 10
- Value - InstanceType: Indicates the instance type
- Use & to separate multiple instance types
- After you specify this parameter, it will overwrite the original instance type in the launch template
 tip 
This parameter is only effective when the LaunchTemplateId parameter has a value

LaunchTemplateOverrides.N.PriceLimit.description_cn:
指定抢占式实例规格每小时的最高价格。
- 参数 - N：表示实例规格的序号，取值为1 ～ 10。
- 取值 - PriceLimit：表示抢占式实例规格每小时的最高价格。取值：大于0，且最大不超过3位小数。
- 多个价格之间用&分隔。
 tip
本参数仅当`LaunchTemplateId`参数存在取值，且启动模版的计费模式为设置出价上限的抢占式实例（即SpotWithPriceLimit）时有效。
LaunchTemplateOverrides.N.PriceLimit.description_en:
Specify the maximum hourly price for spot instance types
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the instance type, with values from 1 to 10
- Value - PriceLimit: Specifies the maximum hourly price for the spot instance type. Value must be greater than 0 and can have up to three decimal places
- Separate multiple prices with &
 tip
This parameter is only valid when the `LaunchTemplateId` parameter is set and the launch template's billing mode is spot instance with price limit (SpotWithPriceLimit)

LaunchTemplateVersion.description_cn:
实例启动模板的版本。取值：
- 模板的某个版本号。
- Default：始终使用模板默认版本。
- Latest：始终使用模板最新版本。
 tip
本参数仅当LaunchTemplateId参数存在取值时生有效。
LaunchTemplateVersion.description_en:
Version of the instance launch template. Possible values:
- A specific template version number
- Default: Always use the default template version
- Latest: Always use the latest template version
 tip
This parameter is only valid when the LaunchTemplateId parameter is specified.

MaxInstanceNumber.description_cn: 伸缩组中实例个数的最大值，默认取值0 ～ 100。
MaxInstanceNumber.description_en: Maximum number of instances in the scaling group, default range is 0 to 100

MinInstanceNumber.description_cn: 伸缩组中实例个数的最小值，默认取值0 ～ 100。
MinInstanceNumber.description_en: Minimum number of instances in the scaling group; default value: 0 to 100

MultiAZPolicy.description_cn:
多子网伸缩组的扩缩容策略。取值：
- PRIORITY：优先级策略。
- BALANCE：均衡分布策略。

选择策略后的实例扩缩容情况请参见[创建伸缩组](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/88723)中的“扩缩容”参数说明。
MultiAZPolicy.description_en:
Scaling policies for multi-subnet scaling groups. Options:
- PRIORITY: Priority policy
- BALANCE: Balanced distribution policy

For details on how instances scale under each policy, see the 'Scaling' parameter description in [Create Scaling Group](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/88723).

ScalingGroupId.description_cn: 伸缩组ID。您可以调用[DescribeScalingGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109814) 接口查询伸缩组ID。
ScalingGroupId.description_en: Scaling group ID. You can call the [DescribeScalingGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109814) API to query the scaling group ID.

ScalingGroupName.description_cn:
伸缩组名称，同一地域下伸缩组名称唯一，取值:
- 只能以中文、字母开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线和中划线。
- 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符 。
- 暂不支持特殊字符。
ScalingGroupName.description_en:
Scaling group name must be unique within the same region. Naming rules:
- Must start with a Chinese character or letter
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
- Special characters are not supported for now

SubnetIds.N.description_cn:
伸缩组中实例主网卡的子网ID列表，修改后与修改前的子网ID必须属于同一私有网络。您可以调用[DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497)接口查询子网ID和子网所属的VPC信息。
参数 - N：表示子网的序号，支持多选。多个子网需属于同一个VPC，同一可用区只允许选择一个子网。
SubnetIds.N.description_en: List of subnet IDs for the primary network interface of instances in the auto scaling group. The subnet IDs before and after modification must belong to the same private network. You can use the [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) API to query subnet IDs and their associated VPC information. Parameter - N: Indicates the subnet sequence number and supports multiple selections. All selected subnets must belong to the same VPC, and only one subnet can be selected per availability zone.

AdjustmentType.description_cn:
伸缩规则的伸缩行为， 适用于简单规则和步进规则，取值：
- QuantityChangeInCapacity：增加或减少指定数量的实例。
- PercentChangeInCapacity：增加或减少指定比例的实例。
- TotalCapacity： 将当前伸缩组的实例数量调整到指定数量。
AdjustmentType.description_en:
Scaling actions for scaling rules apply to both simple and step rules. Options:
- QuantityChangeInCapacity: Increase or decrease a specified number of instances
- PercentChangeInCapacity: Increase or decrease a specified percentage of instances
- TotalCapacity: Adjust the number of instances in the current scaling group to a specified number

AdjustmentValue.description_cn:
伸缩行为的调整数值， 适用于简单规则和步进规则，取值：
- 当AdjustmentType参数取值为QuantityChangeInCapacity时：-100 ~ 100，不允许为0，单位：个。
- 当AdjustmentType参数取值为PercentChangeInCapacity时：-100 ~ 10000，不允许为0，单位：%。
- 当AdjustmentType参数取值为TotalCapacity时：默认为0 ~ 100，单位：个。
 tip
单次调用本接口最多可以调整的实例个数不允许超过300个。
AdjustmentValue.description_en:
Adjustment value for scaling actions, applicable to simple and step rules. Valid values:
- When AdjustmentType is QuantityChangeInCapacity: -100 to 100 (cannot be 0), unit: instances.
- When AdjustmentType is PercentChangeInCapacity: -100 to 10000 (cannot be 0), unit: %.
- When AdjustmentType is TotalCapacity: default is 0 to 100, unit: instances.
 tip
You are not allowed to adjust more than 300 instances per API call.

AlarmPolicy.Condition.ComparisonOperator.description_cn:
单指标告警时的规则表达式对象。

- \>：大于
	
- <：小于
	
- \=：等于
	
 tip
仅当`ScalingPolicyType`取值为Alarm时有效，且必须配置`AlarmPolicy.Condition.x`或`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`相关参数，当二者同时配置时，仅`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`生效。
AlarmPolicy.Condition.ComparisonOperator.description_en:
Rule expression object for single-metric alarms

- >: greater than
- <: less than
- =: equal to

 tip
Valid only when `ScalingPolicyType` is set to Alarm. You must configure the related parameters of either `AlarmPolicy.Condition.x` or `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`. If both are set, only `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x` takes effect.

AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName.description_cn:
单指标告警时的监控指标名称，取值：

- CpuTotal\_Max：带内CPU使用率最大值，表示伸缩组中所有实例CPU使用率的最大值。
	
- CpuTotal\_Min：带内CPU使用率最小值。
	
- CpuTotal\_Avg：带内CPU使用率平均值。
	
- MemoryUsedUtilization\_Max：带内内存使用率最大值。
	
- MemoryUsedUtilization\_Min：：带内内存使用率最小值。
	
- MemoryUsedUtilization\_Avg：：带内内存使用率平均值。
	
- Instance\_CpuBusy\_Max：带外CPU利用率最大值。
	
- Instance\_CpuBusy\_Min：带外CPU利用率最小值。
	
- Instance\_CpuBusy\_Avg：带外CPU利用率平均值。
- Instance_NetTxBits_Avg: 带外网络流出速率平均值。
- Instance_NetRxBits_Avg: 带外网络流入速率平均值。
- Instance_NetTxPackets_Avg: 带外网络发送包速率平均值。
- Instance_NetRxPackets_Avg: 带外网络接收包速率平均值。	
- SystemDiskReadBytes\_Avg: 带内系统盘读带宽平均值。
	
- SystemDiskWriteBytes\_Avg: 带内系统盘写带宽平均值。
	
- SystemDiskReadIOPS\_Avg: 带内系统盘读IOPS平均值。
	
- SystemDiskWriteIOPS\_Avg: 带内系统盘写IOPS平均值。
	
- NetTcpConnection\_Avg: 带内TCP连接数平均值。
	
 tip
仅当`ScalingPolicyType`取值为Alarm时有效，且必须配置`AlarmPolicy.Condition.x`或`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`相关参数，当二者同时配置时，仅`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`生效。
AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName.description_en:
Monitoring metric names for single-metric alarms. Possible values:

- CpuTotal_Max: Maximum in-band CPU utilization. Shows the highest CPU utilization among all instances in the scaling group
- CpuTotal_Min: Minimum in-band CPU utilization
- CpuTotal_Avg: Average in-band CPU utilization
- MemoryUsedUtilization_Max: Maximum in-band memory utilization
- MemoryUsedUtilization_Min: Minimum in-band memory utilization
- MemoryUsedUtilization_Avg: Average in-band memory utilization
- Instance_CpuBusy_Max: Maximum out-of-band CPU utilization
- Instance_CpuBusy_Min: Minimum out-of-band CPU utilization
- Instance_CpuBusy_Avg: Average out-of-band CPU utilization
- Instance_NetTxBits_Avg: Average out-of-band network egress rate
- Instance_NetRxBits_Avg: Average out-of-band network ingress rate
- Instance_NetTxPackets_Avg: Average out-of-band network packet send rate
- Instance_NetRxPackets_Avg: Average out-of-band network packet receive rate
- SystemDiskReadBytes_Avg: Average in-band system disk read bandwidth
- SystemDiskWriteBytes_Avg: Average in-band system disk write bandwidth
- SystemDiskReadIOPS_Avg: Average in-band system disk read IOPS
- SystemDiskWriteIOPS_Avg: Average in-band system disk write IOPS
- NetTcpConnection_Avg: Average in-band TCP connection count

 tip
This is only valid when `ScalingPolicyType` is set to Alarm. You must configure the relevant `AlarmPolicy.Condition.x` or `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x` parameters. If both are configured, only `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x` takes effect.

AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit.description_cn:
单指标告警时的监控指标阈值的单位。取值：

- 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName参数取值为CPU/内存使用率时: Percent。
	
- 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName参数取值为系统盘读/写带宽时: Bytes/Second(IEC)。
	
- 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName参数取值为系统盘读/写IOPS时: Count/Second。
	
- 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName参数取值为TCP连接数时: Count。
- 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName参数取值为网络流入/流出速率时: Bits/Second(IEC)。
- 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName参数取值为网络收发包速率时: Packet/Second。	
 tip
仅当`ScalingPolicyType`取值为Alarm时有效，且必须配置`AlarmPolicy.Condition.x`或`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`相关参数，当二者同时配置时，仅`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`生效。
AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit.description_en:
Unit for monitoring metric threshold in single-metric alarms. Options:

- If the AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName parameter is set to CPU or memory usage: Percent
- If the AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName parameter is set to system disk read/write bandwidth: Bytes/Second (IEC)
- If the AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName parameter is set to system disk read/write IOPS: Count/Second
- If the AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName parameter is set to TCP connections: Count
- If the AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName parameter is set to network inbound/outbound rate: Bits/Second (IEC)
- If the AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName parameter is set to network packet rate: Packet/Second
 tip
Valid only when `ScalingPolicyType` is set to Alarm. You must configure the relevant `AlarmPolicy.Condition.x` or `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x` parameters. If both are configured, only `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x` takes effect.

AlarmPolicy.Condition.Threshold.description_cn:
单指标告警时的监控指标的阈值，取值：

- 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit取值为Percent时：1 ～ 100。
	
- 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit取值为Bytes/Second(IEC)时：大于0的整数。
	
- 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit取值为Count/Second时：大于0的整数。
	
- 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit取值为Count时：大于0的整数。
- 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit取值为Bits/Second(IEC)时：大于0的整数。
- 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit取值为Packet/Second时：大于0的整数。	
 tip
仅当`ScalingPolicyType`取值为Alarm时有效，且必须配置`AlarmPolicy.Condition.x`或`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`相关参数，当二者同时配置时，仅`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`生效。
AlarmPolicy.Condition.Threshold.description_en:
Threshold for the monitoring metric in single-metric alarms:

- If AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit is Percent: 1 to 100
- If AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit is Bytes/Second (IEC): any integer greater than 0
- If AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit is Count/Second: any integer greater than 0
- If AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit is Count: any integer greater than 0
- If AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit is Bits/Second (IEC): any integer greater than 0
- If AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit is Packet/Second: any integer greater than 0
 tip
Valid only when `ScalingPolicyType` is set to Alarm. You must configure the relevant `AlarmPolicy.Condition.x` or `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x` parameters. If both are configured, only `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x` takes effect.

AlarmPolicy.ConditionOperator.description_cn:
多指标告警时的判定条件。

- &&：多个指标同时成立才判定为触发告警。
	
- ||（默认）：任意指标满足条件就判定为触发告警。
	
 tip
仅当`ScalingPolicyType`取值为Alarm时有效，且配置`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`相关参数时生效。
AlarmPolicy.ConditionOperator.description_en:
Criteria for triggering alerts with multiple metrics

- &&: The alert is triggered only when all metrics meet the conditions
- || (default): The alert is triggered when any metric meets the condition

 tip
Effective only when `ScalingPolicyType` is set to Alarm and the `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x` parameters are configured

AlarmPolicy.Conditions.N.ComparisonOpera.description_cn:
多指标告警时的规则表达式对象。

- \>：大于
	
- <：小于
	
- \=：等于
	
 tip
仅当`ScalingPolicyType`取值为Alarm时有效，且必须配置`AlarmPolicy.Condition.x`或`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`相关参数，当二者同时配置时，仅`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`生效。
AlarmPolicy.Conditions.N.ComparisonOpera.description_en:
Rule expression object for multi-metric alarms

- >: greater than
- <: less than
- =: equal to

 tip
Only valid when `ScalingPolicyType` is set to Alarm. You must configure either the related parameter(s) `AlarmPolicy.Condition.x` or `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`. If both are set, only `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x` takes effect.

AlarmPolicy.Conditions.N.MetricName.description_cn:
多指标告警时的监控指标名称。

- 取值：
	- CpuTotal\_Max：带内CPU使用率最大值。
		
	- CpuTotal\_Min：带内CPU使用率最小值。
		
	- CpuTotal\_Avg：带内CPU使用率平均值。
    - Instance_NetTxBits_Avg: 带外网络流出速率平均值。
    - Instance_NetRxBits_Avg: 带外网络流入速率平均值。
    - Instance_NetTxPackets_Avg: 带外网络发送包速率平均值。
    - Instance_NetRxPackets_Avg: 带外网络接收包速率平均值。		
	- MemoryUsedUtilization\_Max：带内内存使用率最大值。
		
	- MemoryUsedUtilization\_Min：带内内存使用率最小值。
		
	- MemoryUsedUtilization\_Avg：带内内存使用率平均值。
		
	- Instance\_CpuBusy\_Max：带外CPU利用率最大值。
		
	- Instance\_CpuBusy\_Min：带外CPU利用率最小值。
		
	- Instance\_CpuBusy\_Avg：带外CPU利用率平均值。
		
	- SystemDiskReadBytes\_Avg: 带内系统盘读带宽平均值。
		
	- SystemDiskWriteBytes\_Avg: 带内系统盘写带宽平均值。
		
	- SystemDiskReadIOPS\_Avg: 带内系统盘读IOPS平均值。
		
	- SystemDiskWriteIOPS\_Avg: 带内系统盘写IOPS平均值。
		
	- NetTcpConnection\_Avg: 带内TCP连接数平均值。
		
- 参数 - N：表示指标的序号，取值：1 - 5。
	
- 多个实例规格之间用&分隔。
	
 tip
仅当`ScalingPolicyType`取值为Alarm时有效，且必须配置`AlarmPolicy.Condition.x`或`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`相关参数，当二者同时配置时，仅`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`生效。
AlarmPolicy.Conditions.N.MetricName.description_en:
Monitoring metric names for multi-metric alarms

- Values:
    - CpuTotal_Max: Maximum in-band CPU usage
    - CpuTotal_Min: Minimum in-band CPU usage
    - CpuTotal_Avg: Average in-band CPU usage
    - Instance_NetTxBits_Avg: Average out-of-band network outbound rate
    - Instance_NetRxBits_Avg: Average out-of-band network inbound rate
    - Instance_NetTxPackets_Avg: Average out-of-band network outbound packet rate
    - Instance_NetRxPackets_Avg: Average out-of-band network inbound packet rate
    - MemoryUsedUtilization_Max: Maximum in-band memory usage
    - MemoryUsedUtilization_Min: Minimum in-band memory usage
    - MemoryUsedUtilization_Avg: Average in-band memory usage
    - Instance_CpuBusy_Max: Maximum out-of-band CPU utilization
    - Instance_CpuBusy_Min: Minimum out-of-band CPU utilization
    - Instance_CpuBusy_Avg: Average out-of-band CPU utilization
    - SystemDiskReadBytes_Avg: Average in-band system disk read bandwidth
    - SystemDiskWriteBytes_Avg: Average in-band system disk write bandwidth
    - SystemDiskReadIOPS_Avg: Average in-band system disk read IOPS
    - SystemDiskWriteIOPS_Avg: Average in-band system disk write IOPS
    - NetTcpConnection_Avg: Average in-band TCP connection count

- Parameter - N: Indicates the metric sequence number, values range from 1 to 5

- Use & to separate multiple instance specifications

 tip
Valid only when `ScalingPolicyType` is set to Alarm. You must configure either `AlarmPolicy.Condition.x` or `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`. If both are configured, only `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x` takes effect.

AlarmPolicy.Conditions.N.MetricUnit.description_cn:
多指标告警时的监控指标阈值的单位。
- 取值：
   - 当AlarmPolicy.Conditions.MetricName参数取值为CPU/内存使用率时: Percent。
	
   - 当AlarmPolicy.Conditions.MetricName参数取值为系统盘读/写带宽时: Bytes/Second(IEC)。
	
   - 当AlarmPolicy.Conditions.MetricName参数取值为系统盘读/写IOPS时: Count/Second。
	
   - 当AlarmPolicy.Conditions.MetricName参数取值为TCP连接数时: Count。
   - 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName参数取值为网络流入/流出速率时: Bits/Second(IEC)。
   - 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName参数取值为网络收发包速率时: Packet/Second。
- 参数 - N：表示指标的序号，取值：1 - 5。
	
- 多个实例规格之间用&分隔。
	
 tip
仅当`ScalingPolicyType`取值为Alarm时有效，且必须配置`AlarmPolicy.Condition.x`或`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`相关参数，当二者同时配置时，仅`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`生效。
AlarmPolicy.Conditions.N.MetricUnit.description_en:
Unit for monitoring metric thresholds in multi-metric alarms
- Values:
   - When the AlarmPolicy.Conditions.MetricName parameter is set to CPU/Memory Usage Rate: Percent
   - When the AlarmPolicy.Conditions.MetricName parameter is set to System Disk Read/Write Bandwidth: Bytes/Second (IEC)
   - When the AlarmPolicy.Conditions.MetricName parameter is set to System Disk Read/Write IOPS: Count/Second
   - When the AlarmPolicy.Conditions.MetricName parameter is set to TCP Connections: Count
   - When the AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName parameter is set to Network Inbound/Outbound Rate: Bits/Second (IEC)
   - When the AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricName parameter is set to Network Packet Rate: Packet/Second
- Parameter - N: Indicates the metric sequence number, values: 1 - 5
- Use & to separate multiple instance specifications

 tip
Valid only when `ScalingPolicyType` is set to Alarm. You must configure the relevant `AlarmPolicy.Condition.x` or `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x` parameters. If both are configured, only `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x` takes effect.

AlarmPolicy.Conditions.N.Threshold.description_cn:
多指标告警时的监控指标的阈值。
- 取值：

   - 当AlarmPolicy.Conditions.MetricUnit取值为Percent时：1 ～ 100。
	
   - 当AlarmPolicy.Conditions.MetricUnit取值为Bytes/Second(IEC)时：大于0的整数。
	
   - 当AlarmPolicy.Conditions.MetricUnit取值为Count/Second时：大于0的整数。
	
   - 当AlarmPolicy.Conditions.MetricUnit取值为Count时：大于0的整数。
   - 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit取值为Bits/Second(IEC)时：大于0的整数。
   - 当AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit取值为Packet/Second时：大于0的整数。
- 参数 - N：表示指标的序号，取值：1 - 5。
	
- 多个实例规格之间用&分隔。
	
 tip
仅当`ScalingPolicyType`取值为Alarm时有效，且必须配置`AlarmPolicy.Condition.x`或`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`相关参数，当二者同时配置时，仅`AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x`生效。
AlarmPolicy.Conditions.N.Threshold.description_en:
Thresholds for monitoring metrics in multi-metric alarms
- Value range:
   - When AlarmPolicy.Conditions.MetricUnit is Percent: 1 to 100
   - When AlarmPolicy.Conditions.MetricUnit is Bytes/Second (IEC): any integer greater than 0
   - When AlarmPolicy.Conditions.MetricUnit is Count/Second: any integer greater than 0
   - When AlarmPolicy.Conditions.MetricUnit is Count: any integer greater than 0
   - When AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit is Bits/Second (IEC): any integer greater than 0
   - When AlarmPolicy.Condition.MetricUnit is Packet/Second: any integer greater than 0
- Parameter - N: indicates the metric index, valid values: 1 to 5
- Use & to separate multiple instance specifications

 tip
Valid only when `ScalingPolicyType` is set to Alarm. You must configure the relevant `AlarmPolicy.Condition.x` or `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x` parameters. If both are configured, only `AlarmPolicy.Conditions.x` takes effect.

AlarmPolicy.Effective.description_cn:
指定报警任务的生效时间段。
* 不填表示在所有时间都生效。
* 如需在特定时间生效，请使用[Cron表达式](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/101113)配置，适用于在业务高峰期关闭缩容等场景。
AlarmPolicy.Effective.description_en:
Specify the active time period for the alert task.
* Leave blank to make it active at all times.
* To activate during specific times, use a [Cron expression](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/101113). This is useful for scenarios like disabling scaling during peak business hours, etc.

AlarmPolicy.EvaluationCount.description_cn:
当监控指标数据连续几次达到阈值时，即触发伸缩行为。取值：1 ～ 180。
 tip
仅当ScalingPolicyType取值为Alarm时有效且为必填项。
AlarmPolicy.EvaluationCount.description_en:
Triggers scaling when the monitoring metric reaches the threshold for several consecutive occurrences. Value range: 1 to 180
 tip
Valid and required only when ScalingPolicyType is set to Alarm

AlarmPolicy.RuleType.description_cn:
报警任务的类型，取值：
- Static：表示由agent采集的静态监控。
 tip
仅当ScalingPolicyType取值为Alarm时有效且为必填项。
AlarmPolicy.RuleType.description_en:
Alarm task type. Possible values:
- Static: Indicates static monitoring collected by the agent
 tip
Only valid and required when ScalingPolicyType is set to Alarm

Cooldown.description_cn:
伸缩规则的冷却时间。 取值：0 ~ 86400，单位：秒。
 tip
当伸缩规则的冷却时间和伸缩组的冷却时间冲突时，伸缩规则的冷却时间更为优先。
Cooldown.description_en:
The cooldown time of the scaling rule ranges from 0 to 86400 seconds.
 tip
If the cooldown time of the scaling rule conflicts with that of the scaling group, the scaling rule cooldown time takes priority.

ScalingPolicyId.description_cn: 伸缩规则的ID。您可以调用[DescribeScalingPolicies](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109829) 查询伸缩规则ID。
ScalingPolicyId.description_en: The scaling policy ID. You can call [DescribeScalingPolicies](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109829) to query the scaling policy ID.

ScheduledPolicy.LaunchTime.description_cn:
表示任务的触发时间。
- 当ScalingPolicyType取值为Scheduled时，表示定时任务的触发时间。
- 当ScalingPolicyType取值为Recurrence时：
    - 如果未指定ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType时，则表示仅按照此处指定的日期和时间执行一次。
    - 如果指定了ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType，则表示周期任务的开始时间。
    - 仅支持选择自创建/修改当日起90日内的时间。
- 当ScalingPolicyType取值为Alarm时，本参数无效。
ScheduledPolicy.LaunchTime.description_en:
Indicates the trigger time for the task
- If ScalingPolicyType is set to Scheduled, this is the trigger time for a scheduled task
- If ScalingPolicyType is set to Recurrence:
    - If ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType is not specified, the task runs once at the specified date and time
    - If ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType is specified, this is the start time for a recurring task
    - Only times within 90 days from the creation or modification date are supported
- If ScalingPolicyType is set to Alarm, this parameter is not valid

ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceEndTime.description_cn:
表示周期任务的结束时间。仅支持选择自创建当日起365日内的时间。设置为空，表示本任务永不停止。
 tip
当ScalingPolicyType取值为Recurrence时有效。
ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceEndTime.description_en:
Specifies the end time for the recurring task. You can only select a date within 365 days from the creation date. Leave blank to keep this task running indefinitely.
 tip
Only effective when ScalingPolicyType is set to Recurrence.

ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType.description_cn:
表示周期任务的重复周期，取值：
- Daily：每XX天执行一次。
- Weekly：选择每周中的几天，每天执行一次。
- Monthly：选择每月中XX号到XX号，每天执行一次。
- Cron：按照指定的Cron表达式执行。
 tip
当ScalingPolicyType取值为Recurrence时有效。
ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType.description_en:
Specifies the recurrence pattern for scheduled tasks. Options:
- Daily: Runs once every XX days
- Weekly: Select specific days of the week to run once per day
- Monthly: Select a date range within the month to run once per day
- Cron: Runs according to the specified Cron expression
 tip
Effective only when ScalingPolicyType is set to Recurrence

ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceValue.description_cn:
表示重复执行周期任务的数值。
- 当ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType参数取值为Daily时，只能填写一个值，取值：1 ~ 31。
- 当ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType参数取值为Weekly时，可以填入多个值，使用英文逗号（,）分隔。星期一到星期日的取值依次为：1,2,3,4,5,6,7。
- 当ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType参数取值为Monthly时，格式为A-B。A、B的取值范围均为1~31，且B必须大于等于A。
- 当ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType参数取值为Cron 时，表示UTC+8时间，支持分、时、日、月、星期的5域表达式，支持通配符英文逗号（,）、英文问号（?）、连词符（-）、星号（*）、井号（#）、斜线（/）、L和W。
 tip
当ScalingPolicyType取值为Recurrence时有效。
ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceValue.description_en:
Specifies the value for recurring scheduled tasks
- If ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType is set to Daily, enter a single value from 1 to 31
- If ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType is set to Weekly, you can enter multiple values separated by commas (,). Values for Monday to Sunday are: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7
- If ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType is set to Monthly, use the format A-B. Both A and B must be between 1 and 31, and B must be greater than or equal to A
- If ScheduledPolicy.RecurrenceType is set to Cron, times are in UTC+8. Supports five-field expressions for minute, hour, day, month, and week. Wildcards supported: comma (,), question mark (?), hyphen (-), asterisk (*), hash (#), slash (/), L, and W
 tip
Valid only when ScalingPolicyType is set to Recurrence

DecreaseDesiredCapacity.description_cn:
是否修改期望实例数，仅当所选伸缩组设置了期望实例数时有效。
- true（默认）：完成删除行为后，期望实例数会自动减少期望删除的实例数量。例如，原期望实例数为5个，选择删除2个实例，那么，完成删除行为后，期望实例数变更为3个。
- false：期望实例数不变，完成删除行为后，再次执行实例数量检查时，伸缩组会自动扩容至期望实例数。
DecreaseDesiredCapacity.description_en:
Whether to modify desired instance count. This option is only available if the selected scaling group has a desired instance count set
- true (default): After deletion, the desired instance count automatically decreases by the number of instances deleted. For example, if the original desired instance count is 5 and you delete 2 instances, the desired instance count changes to 3 after deletion
- false: The desired instance count remains unchanged. After deletion, when the instance count is checked again, the scaling group automatically scales out to reach the desired instance count

ForceDelete.description_cn:
当`DecreaseDesiredCapacity`参数取值false，且删除实例后伸缩组实例数小于最小实例数时，是否仍强制删除实例。取值:
- false（默认）：不强制删除。
- true：强制删除。
ForceDelete.description_en:
When the `DecreaseDesiredCapacity` parameter is set to false and deleting an instance causes the number of instances in the scaling group to fall below the minimum, specify whether to still force delete the instance. Options:
- false (default): Do not force delete
- true: Force delete

InstanceIds.N.description_cn:
实例ID列表。您可以调用[DescribeScalingInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109831)查询指定伸缩组中的实例ID。
- 参数 - N：表示伸缩组的序号，取值1 ～ 20。
- 多个实例ID之间用&分隔。
InstanceIds.N.description_en:
Instance ID list. You can call [DescribeScalingInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109831) to query instance IDs in the specified scaling group.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the scaling group, with values from 1 to 20.
- Separate multiple instance IDs with &.

LifecycleHook.description_cn:
伸缩组删除实例时是否触发缩容生命周期挂钩。取值范围：
- true：触发。
- false（默认）：不触发。
LifecycleHook.description_en:
Whether to trigger the scale-in lifecycle hook when deleting an instance from the scaling group
Options:
- true: Trigger
- false (default): Do not trigger

RemoveMode.description_cn:
手动删除实例的操作模式，取值：
- release（默认）：所选实例直接被释放。
- recycle：所选实例转变为停机不计费状态。
 tip
本参数仅当`ScalingMode`也为recycle时生效。

具体实例的删除操作，和伸缩组的实例回收模式`ScalingMode`相关，您可以调用[DescribeScalingGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109814)接口查询伸缩组的实例回收模式。
- `ScalingMode`为release，`RemoveMode`为release：实例被释放。
- `ScalingMode`为release，`RemoveMode`为recycle：实例被释放。
- `ScalingMode`为recycle，`RemoveMode`为release：实例被释放。
- `ScalingMode`为recycle，`RemoveMode`为recycle：实例转变为停机不计费状态。
RemoveMode.description_en:
Manual instance deletion mode. Options:
- release (default): The selected instance is released directly
- recycle: The selected instance changes to stopped (no billing)
 tip
This parameter takes effect only when `ScalingMode` is also set to recycle

The specific deletion behavior depends on the instance recycling mode (`ScalingMode`) of the scaling group. You can call the [DescribeScalingGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6617/109814) API to check the recycling mode of the scaling group.
- `ScalingMode` is release, `RemoveMode` is release: The instance is released
- `ScalingMode` is release, `RemoveMode` is recycle: The instance is released
- `ScalingMode` is recycle, `RemoveMode` is release: The instance is released
- `ScalingMode` is recycle, `RemoveMode` is recycle: The instance changes to stopped (no billing)

- Separate multiple tag keys with &.

Naming rules:
- Must not start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`.
     tip

- Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@".
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.
> Duplicate tag keys are not allowed for the same resource.

AmortizedDay.description_en: Allocation date: use the format YYYY-MM-DD; only single-day queries are supported; the earliest query date is 2023-04-01. Specifying the allocation date can improve query performance; we recommend specifying this parameter

AmortizedMonth.description_cn: 分摊月：格式为YYYY-MM；仅支持单月查询；所查分摊月至多距今 24 个月；最早只能查询2023-04；资源实际使用日期对应的自然月；如4月27日购买包月实例，根据实际使用日期分摊到了2025年5月1日，则该条成本明细的归属分摊月为2025年5月；

For example, if a subscription instance is purchased on April 27 and, based on the actual usage date, the cost is allocated to May 1, 2025, then the cost detail belongs to the allocation month of May 2025.

Offset.description_en: Used in paginated queries to specify 'from which record in the result set to start returning' (i.e., how many records to skip). NeedRecordNum.description_cn: 是否需要访问列表的总记录数：用于前端分页；1：表示需要； 0：表示不需要；默认为不需要，Total返回-1

Offset.description_cn: 用于在分页查询中指定“从结果集的第几条记录开始返回”（也就是先跳过多少条记录），通常与 **limit** 搭配使用实现翻页：例如每页 `limit=300` 时，第 1 页传 `offset=0` 获取第 1–300 条，第 2 页传 `offset=300` 获取第 301–600 条，第 3 页传 `offset=600` 获取第 601–900 条；因此每往后一页，`offset` 按固定步长累加：`offset = offset + limit`（等价于 `offset = (page-1) * limit`）。
Offset.description_en: Specifies the record number in the result set from which to start returning data in paginated queries (i.e., how many records to skip). Typically used with **limit** for pagination: for example, with `limit=300`, page 1 uses `offset=0` to get records 1–300, page 2 uses `offset=300` to get records 301–600, and page 3 uses `offset=600` to get records 601–900. For each subsequent page, increment `offset` by a fixed step: `offset = offset + limit` (equivalent to `offset = (page-1) * limit`)

 tip

BillingType.description_en:
Instance billing methods are as follows:
- POST: Pay-as-you-go
- MIX: Annual/Monthly Subscription

 tip
Annual/monthly subscription BMQ instances use a hybrid billing model. Compute resources are billed on an annual or monthly subscription basis, while storage resources use CloudFS accelerated storage and are billed pay-as-you-go.
For more details on billing, see [Billing Information](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6820/123869).

- LATEST：基准消费位置为最近消费位点。

When the reset method is OFFSET, this parameter is required. It specifies the baseline consumption point for re-consuming messages. Available values:
- EARLIEST: The baseline consumption point is the earliest position
- CURRENT: The baseline consumption point is the current position
- LATEST: The baseline consumption point is the latest position

- OFFSET：根据指定的 offset 重置消费位点，即从指定的位点开始消费，可以通过 **offsetType** 参数指定 offset。
ResetBy.description_en:
Reset method. Available options:
- TIMESTAMP: Specify a past or future time to start consuming from the position at that time
- OFFSET: Reset the consumption position by offset. Start consuming from the specified position. You can specify the offset using the **offsetType** parameter

ResetValue.description_cn:

- 选择重置方式为 TIMESTAMP 时，该值为重新消费的时间点。例如 1722224612000。
- 选择重置方式为 OFFSET 时，该值为相对于 OffsetType 中基准位点的 相对偏移量。例如 100。

- If you select TIMESTAMP as the reset method, this value is the time to resume consumption, for example: 1722224612000
- If you select OFFSET as the reset method, this value is the relative offset from the reference point in OffsetType, for example: 100

BrowserCache.description_cn:
表示 "浏览器缓存" 特性的配置。在该配置中，您可以创建一个规则列表，说明如下：

- 规则在列表中出现的顺序表示规则的优先级。列表中第一条规则的优先级最高。
- 当收到一个用户请求时，CDN 按规则的优先级，从高到低将规则与请求匹配。如果一条规则匹配了请求，CDN 就停止处理其余规则。
BrowserCache.description_en:
Configuration for the "browser cache" feature In this configuration, you can create a list of rules as follows:

- Each rule includes match condition configuration and action configuration
- The list can contain up to 50 rules
- The order of rules in the list determines their priority. The first rule in the list has the highest priority
- When a user request is received, CDN matches the rules against the request in order of priority, from highest to lowest. If a rule matches the request, CDN stops processing the remaining rules

Cache.description_cn:
表示 "缓存规则" 特性的配置。该特性默认为禁用，表示不创建自定义规则。

- 列表中最多可以包含 50 条规则。
- 列表中规则的顺序定义了规则的优先级。列表中第一条规则的优先级最高。 
- 当收到一个用户请求时，CDN 按规则的优先级，从高到低将规则与请求匹配。如果一条规则匹配了请求，CDN 就停止处理其余规则。

CDN 中有一条 [默认缓存规则](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6454/99842#%E9%BB%98%E8%AE%A4%E7%BC%93%E5%AD%98%E8%A7%84%E5%88%99)，，用于匹配任何未能匹配其他规则的用户请求。该默认规则始终生效，并且优先级最低。您**无需**在配置该特性时指定该默认规则。
Cache.description_en:
Represents the configuration for the "Cache Rule" feature. This feature is disabled by default, meaning no custom rules are created.

- The list can contain up to 50 rules
- The order of rules in the list determines their priority. The first rule in the list has the highest priority
- When a user request is received, the CDN matches the rules to the request in order of priority, from highest to lowest. If a rule matches the request, the CDN stops processing the remaining rules

The CDN includes a [default cache rule](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6454/99842#%E9%BB%98%E8%AE%A4%E7%BC%93%E5%AD%98%E8%A7%84%E5%88%99) that matches any user request not matched by other rules. This default rule is always active and has the lowest priority. You **do not need** to specify this default rule when configuring this feature.

Domain.description_en:
Indicates a domain name you need to add. You can add up to 200 acceleration domain names under the primary account. If you need to add more than 200 domain names, please [submit a ticket](https://console.volcengine.com/ticket/createTicketV2/).

You can add Chinese domain names. When specifying a Chinese domain name, you must convert the Chinese characters in the domain name to punycode before entering. The domain name you add must also meet the following additional requirements:

- The domain name must not exceed 100 characters in length
- The domain name cannot contain uppercase letters
- The domain name must not include the following suffixes: `zjgslb.com`, `yangyi19.com`, `volcgslb.com`, `veew-alb-cn1.com`, `bplgslb.com`, `bplslb.com`, `ttgslb.com`

You can only choose one configuration method.

OriginCertCheck.description_cn:
表示 "源站证书校验" 特性的配置。要使用此特性，请 [提交工单](https://console.volcengine.com/ticket/createTicketV2/)。

该特性启用后，CDN 会校验源站证书的合法性，包括证书是否已被吊销、证书是否由可信 CA 签发、证书与源站域名是否匹配等。CDN 内置了常见可信 CA 的根证书。

该特性还支持双向认证，使源站对 CDN 身份进行校验。您需要在 CDN 中指定相应的客户端证书。
OriginCertCheck.description_en:
Represents the configuration for the "Origin Certificate Verification" feature. To use this feature, please [submit a ticket](https://console.volcengine.com/ticket/createTicketV2/).

When this feature is enabled, the CDN verifies the validity of the origin certificate, including whether the certificate has been revoked, whether it was issued by a trusted CA, and whether the certificate matches the origin domain name. The CDN has built-in root certificates from common trusted CAs.

This feature also supports mutual authentication, allowing the origin to verify the identity of the CDN. You need to specify the corresponding client certificate in the CDN.

OriginHost.description_cn:
如果源站服务器上有多个站点，该参数表示回源请求访问的站点域名。该参数对所有源站配置生效，但是优先级低于源站配置中 `OriginHost` 参数。

该参数的默认值与 `Domain` 相同。

如果源站是一个对象存储桶，您无需指定该参数。其默认值与源站配置中的 `Address` 相同。
OriginHost.description_en:
If the origin server hosts multiple sites, this parameter specifies the domain name the origin request will access. This parameter applies to all origin server configurations, but has lower priority than the OriginHost parameter in the origin server settings.

The default value for this parameter is the same as Domain.

If the origin server is an object storage bucket, you do not need to specify this parameter. Its default value is the same as Address in the origin server configuration.

OriginIPv6.description_cn:
表示 "IPv6 回源" 的配置。该参数有以下取值：

- `ipv6_first`：表示 CDN 始终尝试获取源站域名的 IPv6 地址。如果无法获取该 IP 地址，CDN 才尝试获取源站域名的 IPv4 地址。
	
- `ipv4_first`：表示 CDN 始终尝试获取源站域名的 IPv4 地址。如果无法获取该 IP 地址，CDN 才尝试获取源站域名的 IPv6 地址。
	
- `followclient`：表示 CDN 尝试获取与用户请求相同类型的 IP 地址。

该参数的默认值是 `followclient`。

由于海外部分 CDN 回源节点不支持向 IPv6 地址发送回源请求，该功能仅适用于位于中国内地的回源节点。
OriginIPv6.description_en:
Configuration for the "IPv6 origin fetch" feature This parameter has the following values:

- `ipv6_first`: CDN always tries to obtain the IPv6 address of the origin domain. If it cannot obtain this IP address, CDN then tries to obtain the IPv4 address of the origin domain.

- `ipv4_first`: CDN always tries to obtain the IPv4 address of the origin domain. If it cannot obtain this IP address, CDN then tries to obtain the IPv6 address of the origin domain.

- `followclient`: CDN tries to obtain the same type of IP address as the user's request.

The default value for this parameter is `followclient`.

Because some overseas CDN origin nodes do not support sending origin requests to IPv6 addresses, this feature is only available for origin nodes located in Mainland China.

OriginProtocol.description_cn:
表示回源请求使用的协议。该参数有以下取值：

- `http`：表示回源请求使用 HTTP 协议。
	
- `https`：表示回源请求使用 HTTPS 协议。
	
- `followclient`：表示回源协议与用户请求使用的协议相同。
OriginProtocol.description_en:
Specifies the protocol used for origin requests. This parameter supports the following values:

- `http`: Origin requests use the HTTP protocol
- `https`: Origin requests use the HTTPS protocol
- `followclient`: The origin protocol matches the protocol used in the user's request

OriginRange.description_cn:
表示 "回源 Range" 特性的配置。该参数有以下取值：

- `true`：表示启用该特性。
- `false`：表示禁用该特性。

该参数的默认值是 `false`。请求分片大小默认是 1 MB。

如果 `Range` 结构体中 `Switch` 为 `true`，则该特性为启用，即使 `OriginRange` 为 `false`。
OriginRange.description_en:
Configuration for the "Origin Range" feature. This parameter has the following values:

- `true`: Enables this feature
- `false`: Disables this feature

The default value for this parameter is `false`. The default request shard size is 1 MB.

If `Switch` in the `Range` struct is set to `true`, this feature is enabled even if `OriginRange` is `false`.
