待删除标签的 Key 的列表信息。

支持一次传入多个标签键，多个标签键间用英文逗号（,）分隔。最多同时可传入 20 个标签键。
TagKeys.description_en:
Information about the tag keys to delete

You can enter multiple tag keys at once, separated by commas. You can enter up to 20 tag keys at a time.

TaskIds.description_cn: 任务 ID 列表信息。最多支持同时传入 20 个任务 ID。
TaskIds.description_en:
Task ID List Information
You can enter up to 20 task IDs at a time

Tables.description_cn: 表名。多个表间需使用英文逗号（,）隔开。
Tables.description_en: Table name. Separate multiple tables with English commas (,)

TaskId.description_cn:
任务 ID。

您可以调用 [DescribeTransmissionTasks](../6390/76193) 接口查询任务 ID。
TaskId.description_en:
Task ID

You can call the [DescribeTransmissionTasks](../6390/76193) API to query the task ID

Description.description_cn: 消费组的描述，帮助您辨识消费组的用途。
Description.description_en: The consumer group description helps you identify its purpose.

GroupName.description_cn:
消费组名称。

您可以调用 [DescribeSubscriptionGroups](../6390/129222) 接口查询订阅消费组列表。
GroupName.description_en:
Consumer Group Name

You can call the [DescribeSubscriptionGroups](../6390/129222) API to query the list of subscription consumer groups.

Password.description_cn:
设置消费组账号密码。密码规则：

- 长度需在 8~32 个字符内。
- 至少包含大写字母、小写字母、数字或特殊字符中的三种类型。特殊字符包含 `_#!@$%^&*()+=-`。
Password.description_en:
Set consumer group account password
Password requirements:

- Must be 8–32 characters long
- Must include at least three of the following: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, or special characters. Allowed special characters: `_#!@$%^&*()+=-`

TaskId.description_cn:
任务 ID。

您可以调用 [DescribeTransmissionTasks](../6390/76193) 接口查询任务 ID。
TaskId.description_en:
Task ID

You can call the [DescribeTransmissionTasks](../6390/76193) API to query the task ID

Username.description_cn:
设置消费组账号。命名规则：

- 长度需在 2~16 个字符内。
- 以字母开头，字母或数字结尾。
- 由数字、大写字母、小写字母、下划线（\_）组成。
Username.description_en:
Set consumer group account. Naming rules:

- Must be 2–16 characters long
- Start with a letter and end with a letter or number
- Only numbers, uppercase letters, lowercase letters, and underscores (_) are allowed

AutoPlacement.description_cn:
专有宿主机是否加入自动部署资源池，取值：
- On：加入自动部署资源池。创建实例时可以不指定DDH，由系统从自动部署池中选择合适的DDH部署实例。
- Off（默认）：不加入自动部署资源池。您需自行在DDH上部署实例，即创建实例时指定DDH。

创建实例操作请参见[RunInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/76275)。
AutoPlacement.description_en:
Whether to add the dedicated host to the automatic deployment resource pool. Options:
- On: Add to the automatic deployment resource pool. When creating an Instance, you do not need to specify a DDH. The system will select a suitable DDH from the pool to deploy the Instance.
- Off (default): Do not add to the automatic deployment resource pool. You need to deploy the Instance on a DDH yourself, that is, specify the DDH when creating the Instance.

For instructions on creating an Instance, see [RunInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/76275).

AutoRenew.description_cn:
专有宿主机到期后是否自动续费。
- true：自动续费。
- false（默认）：不自动续费。
AutoRenew.description_en:
Automatically renew dedicated host after expiration?
- true: Automatically renew
- false (default): Do not automatically renew

AutoRenewPeriod.description_cn:
每次自动续费的时长。
 - 当参数`AutoRenew`取值为`True`时，该参数有效。
- `PeriodUnit`取值为`Month`时，`AutoRenewPeriod`取值为1、2、3、6、12，默认值为1。
AutoRenewPeriod.description_en:
Duration of each auto-renewal
- This parameter is valid only when `AutoRenew` is set to `True`
- When `PeriodUnit` is set to `Month`, `AutoRenewPeriod` can be 1, 2, 3, 6, or 12; the default is 1

ChargeType.description_cn:
专有宿主机的计费类型，取值：
PrePaid：包年包月。
ChargeType.description_en:
Billing type for dedicated hosts. Values:
PrePaid: subscription (monthly or yearly)

ClientToken.description_cn:
保证请求幂等性。由客户端自动生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一，避免当调用API超时或服务器内部错误时，客户端多次重试导致重复性操作。
取值：仅支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if the API call times out or a server error occurs and the client retries. Value: Only ASCII characters are supported, with a maximum length of 64 characters.

Count.description_cn:
创建数量，取值范围：1～100。
传入0时，会默认为1。
Count.description_en:
Quantity to create, range: 1–100
If 0 is entered, it defaults to 1

CpuOvercommitRatio.description_cn:
CPU超分比，用于提升DDH的可用vCPU数。一台DDH的可用vCPU数 = 物理CPU核数 * 2 * CPU超分比。
- 取值范围：1～4。
- 默认值：支持配置的最大超分倍数。
CpuOvercommitRatio.description_en:
CPU overcommit ratio, used to increase the available vCPUs on a DDH. Available vCPUs per DDH = number of physical CPU cores × 2 × CPU overcommit ratio
- Value range: 1–4
- Default: maximum supported overcommit ratio

DedicatedHostClusterId.description_cn:
专有宿主机集群ID。
您可以调用[DescribeDedicatedHostClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1253698)查询专有宿主机集群。
DedicatedHostClusterId.description_en:
Dedicated Host Cluster ID
You can call [DescribeDedicatedHostClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1253698) to query dedicated host clusters

DedicatedHostName.description_cn:
专有宿主机的名称。
- 不能以数字、下划线“_”、中划线“-”开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线“_”和中划线“-”。
- 长度限制为1～128个字符。
- 暂不支持特殊字符。
DedicatedHostName.description_en:
Dedicated host name
- Cannot start with a digit, underscore "_", or hyphen "-"
- Only Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores "_", and hyphens "-" are allowed
- Length must be 1–128 characters
- Special characters are not supported at this time

DedicatedHostRecovery.description_cn:
专有宿主机处于临时不可用（TempUnavailable）状态时，是否开启宕机自动迁移，取值：
- On：开启宕机自动迁移。开启后，宿主机宕机时会自动迁移至健康的DDH。
- Off（默认）：不开启宕机自动迁移。可以调用[RedeployDedicatedHost](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1253695)手动更换物理机。
DedicatedHostRecovery.description_en:
Whether to enable automatic failover migration when the dedicated host is in the TempUnavailable state:
- On: Enable automatic failover migration. When enabled, the host will automatically migrate to a healthy DDH if it fails
- Off (default): Disable automatic failover migration. You can manually replace the physical host by calling [RedeployDedicatedHost](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1253695)

DedicatedHostTypeId.description_cn:
专有宿主机规格。
可以通过[DescribeDedicatedHostTypes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1253690)接口获取。
DedicatedHostTypeId.description_en:
Dedicated Host Specifications
You can obtain them through the [DescribeDedicatedHostTypes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1253690) API

Description.description_cn:
专有宿主机的描述，默认值为空字符串。
- 必须以字母或中文开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、点“.”、空格、下划线“_”、中划线“-”、等号“=”、英文逗号“,”、中文逗号“，”和中文句号“。”
- 长度限制在255个字符以内。
Description.description_en:
Description for the dedicated host. Default value is an empty string
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period (.), space, underscore (_), hyphen (-), equals sign (=), English comma (,), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。) are allowed
- Maximum length is 255 characters
Description.example_cn: 用于测试的专有宿主机

DryRun.description_cn:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
- true：发送检查请求，不会创建专有宿主机。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制和资源库存。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码DryRunOperation。
      当`DryRun`取值为true时，若传入了`Count`参数，则取值必须为1。
   
- false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建专有宿主机。
DryRun.description_en:
Whether to perform a dry run for this request. Values:
- true: Performs a dry run request without creating a dedicated host. Checks include required parameters, request format, business limits, and resource availability. If the check fails, returns the corresponding error. If the check passes, returns the error code DryRunOperation.
      When `DryRun` is set to true, if the `Count` parameter is provided, its value must be 1.
   
- false (default): Sends a normal request. If the check passes, a dedicated host is created directly.

Period.description_en:
Resource Purchase Duration (Months)
Available values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 24, 36

PeriodUnit.description_cn:
购买资源的时长单位。
取值：Month
PeriodUnit.description_en:
Unit of duration for purchasing resources
Value: Month

ZoneId.description_cn:
专有宿主机所在可用区ID。
您可以调用[DescribeZones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/120518)查询一个地域下的可用区信息。
ZoneId.description_en:
The availability zone ID where the dedicated host is located
You can call [DescribeZones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/120518) to query availability zone information within a region.

AutoRenew.description_cn:
实例到期后是否自动续费，取值：
- true：自动续费。
- false（默认）：不自动续费。

仅当参数`InstanceChargeType`取值为`PrePaid`时生效。
AutoRenew.description_en:
Whether the Instance is automatically renewed after expiration. Valid values:
- true: Auto-renew
- false (default): Do not auto-renew

This parameter takes effect only when `InstanceChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`.

AutoRenewPeriod.description_cn:
每次自动续费的时长。
- 仅当参数`AutoRenew`取值为`True`时，该参数生效，默认值为1。
- `PeriodUnit`取值为`Month`时，该参数取值为1、2、3、6、12。
AutoRenewPeriod.description_en:
Duration of each auto-renewal
- This parameter takes effect only when `AutoRenew` is set to `True`; the default value is 1
- When `PeriodUnit` is set to `Month`, valid values are 1, 2, 3, 6, or 12

BatchCreateInMultiZone.description_cn:
是否支持随机多可用区部署，取值：
- true：批量创建的ECS实例部署在多个可用区上。
- false（默认）：批量创建的ECS实例部署在单个可用区上。

当`ZoneId`为空时该字段生效。
BatchCreateInMultiZone.description_en:
Whether to support random multi-availability zone deployment:
- true: Batch-created ECS Instance(s) are deployed across multiple availability zones
- false (default): Batch-created ECS Instance(s) are deployed in a single availability zone

This field takes effect only when `ZoneId` is empty.

ClientToken.description_cn:
保证请求幂等性。由客户端自动生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一，避免当调用API超时或服务器内部错误时，客户端多次重试导致重复性操作。
取值：仅支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a parameter value to ensure that each request has a unique value, preventing duplicate operations if the API call times out or the server returns an internal error and the client retries. Value: ASCII characters only, up to 64 characters.

Count.description_cn: 创建数量，取值范围：1～100；传入0时，会默认为1。
Count.description_en: Quantity to create, range: 1–100; if set to 0, defaults to 1

CreditSpecification.description_cn:
突发性能实例的运行模式，取值：
- Standard：标准模式。
- Unlimited：无性能约束模式（暂不支持）。

- 仅当`InstanceTypeId`取值为ecs.t2系列，即突发性能实例时该参数生效。
- 不传或传入空值时，突发性能实例默认为`Standard`标准模式。
CreditSpecification.description_en:
Burstable performance instance operating modes. Valid values:
- Standard: Standard mode
- Unlimited: No performance constraints (not supported yet)

- This parameter takes effect only when `InstanceTypeId` is set to the ecs.t2 series, that is, for burstable performance instances.
- If not specified or left empty, burstable performance instances default to `Standard` mode.

DeploymentSetGroupNumber.description_cn: 当ECS实例要加入或调整的部署集策略为部署集组高可用策略（AvailabilityGroup）时，可以通过该参数指定实例在部署集中的分组号，取值范围：1～3。
DeploymentSetGroupNumber.description_en: When the deployment set policy for an ECS instance is set to AvailabilityGroup, you can use this parameter to specify the group number for the instance within the deployment set. Valid values: 1 to 3

DeploymentSetId.description_cn: 实例需要加入的部署集ID。
DeploymentSetId.description_en: Deployment set ID for the instance to join

Description.description_cn:
实例的描述，默认为空字符串。
- 必须以字母或中文开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、点号“.”、空格、下划线“_”、中划线“-”、等号“=”、英文逗号“,”、中文逗号“，”和中文句号“。”
- 长度限制在255个字符以内。
Description.description_en:
Instance description. Defaults to an empty string
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Can only include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period (.), space, underscore (_), hyphen (-), equals sign (=), English comma (,), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
- Maximum length: 255 characters

DryRun.description_cn:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
- true：发送检查请求，不会创建实例。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制和ECS库存。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码DryRunOperation。

当`DryRun`取值为`true`时，若传入了`Count`参数，则取值必须为1。

- false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建实例。
DryRun.description_en:
Whether to perform a dry run for this request. Options:
- true: Sends a validation request without creating an Instance. The validation checks required parameters, request format, business restrictions, and ECS inventory. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, the error code DryRunOperation is returned.

When `DryRun` is set to `true`, if the `Count` parameter is provided, its value must be 1.

- false (default): Sends a normal request. If the check passes, the Instance is created directly.

EipAddress.BandwidthMbps.description_cn:
公网IP的带宽上限，默认值为1，单位：Mbps。
- `ChargeType`传入`PayByBandwidth`：取值范围1～500。
- `ChargeType`传入`PayByTraffic`：取值范围1～200。
EipAddress.BandwidthMbps.description_en:
Bandwidth limit for public IP. Default value: 1, unit: Mbps
- If `ChargeType` is set to `PayByBandwidth`: range is 1–500
- If `ChargeType` is set to `PayByTraffic`: range is 1–200

EipAddress.BandwidthPackageId.description_cn:
共享带宽包的ID，表示将公网IP加入到共享带宽包。
- 您可以调用[DescribeBandwidthPackages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6623/100685)接口，查询共享带宽包的ID。
- 公网IP加入到共享带宽包必须同时满足如下条件：
  - 二者的安全防护类型相同。
  - 二者的地域相同。
  - 公网IP的计费方式必须是按量计费。
  - 共享带宽包为IPv4类型。
EipAddress.BandwidthPackageId.description_en:
The ID of the shared bandwidth package, indicating the public IP will be added to this shared bandwidth package
- You can call the [DescribeBandwidthPackages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6623/100685) API to query the shared bandwidth package ID
- To add a public IP to a shared bandwidth package, all of the following conditions must be met:
  - Both must have the same security protection type
  - Both must be in the same region
  - The public IP must use pay-as-you-go billing
  - The shared bandwidth package must be of IPv4 type

EipAddress.ChargeType.description_cn:
公网IP的计费方式，取值：
- PayByBandwidth（默认）：按量计费-按带宽上限计费。
- PayByTraffic：按量计费-按实际流量计费。
- PrePaid：包年包月。

实例的计费类型`InstanceChargeType`取值为`PostPaid`时，该参数取值不能为`PrePaid`。
EipAddress.ChargeType.description_en:
Billing methods for public IP addresses:
- PayByBandwidth (default): Pay-As-You-Go by bandwidth cap
- PayByTraffic: Pay-As-You-Go by actual data transfer
- PrePaid: Subscription (monthly or yearly)

When the Instance billing type (`InstanceChargeType`) is set to `PostPaid`, this parameter cannot be set to `PrePaid`.

EipAddress.ISP.description_cn:
公网IP的线路类型，默认为BGP。取值：
- BGP：BGP（多线）。
- 若您的账号已申请并开通了静态单线权限，则可传入如下取值：
  - ChinaMobile：中国移动静态单线。
  - ChinaTelecom：中国电信静态单线。
  - ChinaUnicom：中国联通静态单线。
- 若您的账号已申请并开通了BGP单线权限，则可传入SingleLine_BGP。
- 若您的账号已申请并开通了静态BGP权限，则可传入Static_BGP。
EipAddress.ISP.description_en:
Line type for public IP. Default is BGP
Available values:
- BGP: BGP (multi-line)
- If your account has static single line access, you can use:
  - ChinaMobile: China Mobile static single line
  - ChinaTelecom: China Telecom static single line
  - ChinaUnicom: China Unicom static single line
- If your account has SingleLine_BGP access, you can use SingleLine_BGP
- If your account has Static_BGP access, you can use Static_BGP

EipAddress.ReleaseWithInstance.description_cn:
公网IP是否随实例删除，仅按量计费公网IP生效。取值：
- true：公网IP随实例删除。当实例被系统自动回收（退订24小时后、到期回收等）或被调用[DeleteInstance](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70465)、[DeleteInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/101070)接口删除时，公网IP随实例一同释放。
- false（默认）：公网IP不随实例删除。
EipAddress.ReleaseWithInstance.description_en:
Whether the public IP is released with the Instance. Only applies to pay-as-you-go public IPs. Options:
- true: The public IP is released with the Instance. When the Instance is automatically recycled by the system (such as 24 hours after unsubscription or upon expiration) or deleted using the [DeleteInstance](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70465) or [DeleteInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/101070) APIs, the public IP is released together with the Instance
- false (default): The public IP is not released with the Instance

EipAddress.SecurityProtectionInstanceId.description_cn:
DDoS原生防护（企业版）ID。
- 您可以调用[DescInstanceList](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6352/1263659)接口，查询DDoS原生防护（企业版）的ID。
- 当`SecurityProtectionTypes`传入`AntiDDoS_Enhanced`时，此参数必须传入。
EipAddress.SecurityProtectionInstanceId.description_en:
DDoS Native Protection (Enterprise Edition) ID
- You can call the [DescInstanceList](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6352/1263659) API to query the DDoS Native Protection (Enterprise Edition) ID.
- This parameter is required when `SecurityProtectionTypes` is set to `AntiDDoS_Enhanced`.

EipAddress.SecurityProtectionTypes.N.description_cn:
公网IP的安全防护类型。
- 参数 - N：表示安全防护类型的序号，当前仅支持取1。
- 取值：
  - AntiDDoS_Enhanced：申请增强防护类型的公网IP，可加入到DDoS原生防护（企业版）实例。

        - 若. `EipAddress.SecurityProtectionTypes.N`传入`AntiDDoS_Enhanced`，则`EipAddress.ChargeType`不能为`PrePaid`，且`EipAddress.ISP`必须传入`BGP`。
    - 增强防护类型公网IP正在邀测中，如需试用，请联系客户经理申请。
    
  - 不填则表示申请默认防护类型的公网IP。
EipAddress.SecurityProtectionTypes.N.description_en:
Security protection types for public IP addresses
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the security protection type. Currently, only 1 is supported
- Values:
  - AntiDDoS_Enhanced: Apply for a public IP address with enhanced protection. It can be added to a DDoS Native Protection (Enterprise Edition) Instance.

        - If `EipAddress.SecurityProtectionTypes.N` is set to `AntiDDoS_Enhanced`, `EipAddress.ChargeType` cannot be `PrePaid`, and `EipAddress.ISP` must be set to `BGP`
    - Enhanced protection public IP addresses are currently in invite-only testing. If you want to try it, contact your account manager to apply.
    
  - Leave blank to apply for a public IP address with default protection

Hostname.description_cn:
实例主机名，即实例操作系统内部的计算机名。
- Linux实例：
- 允许使用字母、数字、点号“.”或中划线“-”。
- 不能以中划线、点号开头或结尾，且不能连续使用中划线和点号。
- Linux系统长度限制在2～63个字符之间。

- Windows实例：
- 允许使用字母、数字或中划线“-”，不能完全是数字。
- 不能以中划线开头或结尾，且不能连续使用中划线。
- Windows系统长度限制在2～15个字符之间。

- 如不填，则遵循 iv- + 初始主机名 规则自动生成，例如
iv-3tigy72q3u3vj0******。
- 初始主机名生成逻辑：
- Linux：提取实例IDi-之后的全部字符。
- Windows：提取实例IDi-之后的后12位字符。

- 批量创建实例时，支持使用`name_prefix[begin_number,bits]name_suffix`格式自定义设置有序主机名，具体操作请参见[批量设置有序的实例名称或主机名称](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/81260)。
Hostname.description_en:
Instance hostname refers to the computer name within the instance operating system.

- Linux instance:
  - Letters, numbers, periods ("."), and hyphens ("-") are allowed
  - Cannot start or end with a hyphen or period, and hyphens and periods cannot appear consecutively
  - Length must be between 2 and 63 characters

- Windows instance:
  - Letters, numbers, and hyphens ("-") are allowed; the name cannot be all numbers
  - Cannot start or end with a hyphen, and hyphens cannot appear consecutively
  - Length must be between 2 and 15 characters

- If left blank, the system automatically generates a hostname following the iv- + initial hostname rule, for example: iv-3tigy72q3u3vj0******
- Initial hostname generation logic:
  - Linux: Uses all characters after 'i-' in the instance ID
  - Windows: Uses the last 12 characters after 'i-' in the instance ID

- When creating instances in batches, you can customize sequential hostnames using the `name_prefix[begin_number,bits]name_suffix` format. For details, see [Batch set sequential instance names or hostnames](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/81260)

HpcClusterId.description_cn:
实例所属的高性能计算集群ID。
仅当创建高性能计算型实例时，该参数生效且为必填项。
HpcClusterId.description_en:
High-performance computing cluster ID of the instance
This parameter is required and only applies when creating a high-performance computing instance.

ImageId.description_cn:
启动实例时使用的镜像ID。
您可以调用[DescribeImages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70808)接口，在`InstanceType`参数中传入期望创建的实例规格，查询支持该规格使用的镜像及其ID信息。
ImageId.description_en:
Image ID used to launch the instance
You can call the [DescribeImages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70808) API and provide the desired instance specification in the `InstanceType` parameter to query images and their ID information that support that specification

ImageReleaseVersion.description_cn:
使用的镜像具体版本号。
- 该参数仅选用公共镜像时生效。
- 若为空，将使用镜像的最新版本。
ImageReleaseVersion.description_en:
Specific image version number.
- This parameter only applies when using a public image.
- If left blank, the latest image version will be used.

InstallRunCommandAgent.description_cn:
创建实例时是否安装云助手Agent，取值：
- true：创建时安装。
- false（默认）：创建时不安装。
有关云助手的更多信息请参见[云助手概述](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/129236)。
InstallRunCommandAgent.description_en:
Install Cloud Assistant Agent when creating the Instance:
- true: Install during creation
- false (default): Do not install during creation
For more information about Cloud Assistant, see [Cloud Assistant Overview](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/129236).

InstanceChargeType.description_cn:
实例和云盘的计费类型，取值：
- PostPaid：按量计费。
- PrePaid：包年包月。请确认您的账号支持余额支付或者信控支付，否则将返回InvalidInstanceChargeType的错误提示。
InstanceChargeType.description_en:
Billing types for instances and cloud disks:
- PostPaid: Pay-As-You-Go
- PrePaid: Yearly/Monthly Subscription
Make sure your account supports balance payment or credit payment. Otherwise, you will receive an InvalidInstanceChargeType error message

InstanceName.description_cn:
实例的名称。
- 以字母或中文开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线“_”、中划线“-”和点号“.”。
- 长度限制为1～128个字符。
- 若实例已设置`SuffixIndex`有序后缀，则实例名称长度包含有序后缀。
- 批量创建实例时，支持使用`name_prefix[begin_number,bits]name_suffix`格式自定义设置有序实例名称，具体操作请参见[批量设置有序的实例名称或主机名称](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/81260)。
InstanceName.description_en:
Instance Name
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores "_", hyphens "-", and periods "."
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
- If the instance has an ordered suffix set by `SuffixIndex`, the instance name length includes the ordered suffix
- When creating instances in batches, you can use the `name_prefix[begin_number,bits]name_suffix` format to customize ordered instance names. For details, see [Batch set ordered instance or host names](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/81260)

InstanceType.description_cn: 默认参数描述
InstanceType.description_en: Default Parameter Description

InstanceTypeId.description_cn:
实例规格。
- 产品选型：您可以参考[实例规格介绍](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70840)或者调用[DescribeInstanceTypes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/92769)查看实例规格的性能数据，也可以参考[实例选型最佳实践](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/74174)了解如何选择实例规格。
- 查询库存：您可以调用[DescribeAvailableResource](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/76279)查询可用区中计算资源的库存信息。
InstanceTypeId.description_en:
Instance Specifications
- Product selection: You can refer to the [Instance Specifications Overview](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70840) or call [DescribeInstanceTypes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/92769) to view performance data for each instance specification. You can also refer to [Best Practices for Instance Selection](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/74174) to learn how to choose the right instance specification.
- Check inventory: You can call [DescribeAvailableResource](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/76279) to check the inventory of computing resources in the available zones.

KeepImageCredential.description_cn:
是否保留镜像设置，取值：
- true：保留镜像设置，保留后将使用镜像预设的密码或密钥对登录实例。
- false（默认）：不保留镜像设置。
- 仅自定义镜像、共享镜像支持该功能。
- 该参数取值为`true`时，请勿传入`PassWord`和`KeyPairName`。
KeepImageCredential.description_en:
Retain image settings. Options:
- true: Retain image settings. The instance will use the preset password or key pair from the image for login.
- false (default): Do not retain image settings.
- Only custom images and shared images support this feature.
- When this parameter is set to `true`, do not specify `PassWord` or `KeyPairName`.

KeyPairName.description_cn:
如需使用“SSH密钥”方式登录实例，请指定已创建密钥对的名称。
您可以调用[DescribeKeyPairs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/120446)查看已创建的密钥对；如无可用，请调用[CreateKeyPair](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/120445)创建密钥对。
- Windows实例不支持SSH密钥方式，即使传入了该参数，仍旧只生效密码`Password`。
- Linux实例支持密码或密钥对登录。调用该接口时如果同时设置了密钥对`KeyPairName`和密码`Password`，则仅生效密钥对`KeyPairName`。
KeyPairName.description_en:
To log in to an Instance using an SSH key, specify the name of an existing key pair.
You can call [DescribeKeyPairs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/120446) to view existing key pairs. If none are available, call [CreateKeyPair](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/120445) to create a new key pair.
- Windows Instances do not support SSH key login. Even if you provide this parameter, only the password (`Password`) is used.
- Linux Instances support login with either a password or a key pair. If you set both `KeyPairName` and `Password` when calling this API, only the key pair (`KeyPairName`) will be used.

NetworkInterfaces.N.Ipv6AddressCount.description_cn:
为主网卡分配的私网IPv6地址数量，仅支持取1。
- 传入该参数，系统会自动从网卡所属子网中，分配相应数量的空闲私网IPv6地址，作为网卡的私网IPv6地址。
- 创建实例时仅支持为主网卡分配IPv6地址，若要为辅助网卡分配IPv6地址，可参考 [CreateNetworkInterface](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70758)。
- 参数 - N：表示网卡的序号，N = 1表示主网卡；N ≥ 2表示辅助网卡，故传入N ≥ 2时，该参数将被忽略。
为网卡分配IPv6地址正在邀测中，暂仅支持完成 [企业认证](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6261/64937)的账号申请试用，如需试用，请联系客户经理。
NetworkInterfaces.N.Ipv6AddressCount.description_en:
Number of private IPv6 addresses assigned to the primary NIC. Only 1 is supported
- When you specify this parameter, the system automatically assigns the same number of available private IPv6 addresses from the subnet associated with the NIC as the NIC's private IPv6 addresses
- You can assign an IPv6 address only to the primary NIC when creating an instance. To assign an IPv6 address to a secondary NIC, see [CreateNetworkInterface](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70758)
- Parameter - N: Indicates the NIC index. N = 1 refers to the primary NIC; N ≥ 2 refers to secondary NICs. If you specify N ≥ 2, this parameter will be ignored
Assigning IPv6 addresses to NICs is currently in invite-only testing. Only accounts that have completed [Enterprise Verification](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6261/64937) can apply for a trial. To request access, contact your account manager

NetworkInterfaces.N.SecurityGroupIds.N.description_cn:
网卡关联的安全组ID。
- 第一个N：表示网卡的序号，N = 1表示主网卡；N ≥ 2表示辅助网卡。
- 第二个N：表示网卡关联的安全组的序号，取值范围：1～5。
- 多个安全组ID之间用&分隔。
NetworkInterfaces.N.SecurityGroupIds.N.description_en:
Security group IDs associated with the network interface
- The first N indicates the network interface number: N = 1 for the primary network interface; N ≥ 2 for secondary network interfaces
- The second N indicates the security group sequence number for the network interface, ranging from 1 to 5
- Separate multiple security group IDs with &

NetworkInterfaces.N.SubnetId.N.description_cn:
实例的私有网络子网ID列表。
- 第一个N ：表示网卡的序号，N = 1表示主网卡；N ≥ 2表示辅助网卡。
- 第二个N ：表示该网卡对应的私有网络子网列表。
- 多个私有网络子网ID之间用&分隔。
如果传入多个可用区的私有网络子网ID列表，系统将选取与“随机可用区”功能推荐的可用区相匹配的子网进行绑定。
NetworkInterfaces.N.SubnetId.N.description_en:
Private network subnet ID list for the Instance
- The first N: Indicates the network interface index. N = 1 indicates the primary network interface; N ≥ 2 indicates secondary network interfaces
- The second N: Indicates the list of private network subnets for that network interface
- Use & to separate multiple private network subnet IDs
If you provide subnet ID lists from multiple availability zones, the system will select and bind the subnet that matches the availability zone recommended by the 'Random Availability Zone' feature

Password.description_cn:
如需使用“密码”方式登录实例，请通过该参数指定实例的管理员账号初始登录密码。其中Linux管理员账号为root，Windows管理员账号为Administrator。
密码复杂度要求如下：
- 长度限制在8～30之间。
- 密码只能由大写字母、小写字母、数字和特殊字符组成，且必须包含至少三项。
- 特殊字符可以使用：`~!@#$%^&*()_-+=|{}[]:;'<>,.?/
- 不能以“/”和“$6$”开头。
登录凭证支持“密码”、“密钥对”、“保留镜像设置”三种方式，使用“密码”方式登录实例时，建议增加密码复杂度以提高安全性。
Password.description_en:
To log in to the Instance using the 'Password' method, specify the initial administrator password for the Instance with this parameter. The Linux administrator account is root, and the Windows administrator account is Administrator.
Password complexity requirements:
- Length must be between 8 and 30 characters
- Passwords can only contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters, and must include at least three of these types
- Allowed special characters: `~!@#$%^&*()_-+=|{}[]:;'<>,.?/
- Passwords cannot start with '/' or '$6$'
Login credentials support three methods: 'Password', 'Key Pair', and 'Retain Image Settings'. When using the 'Password' method to log in to the Instance, we recommend increasing password complexity for better security.

Period.description_cn:
购买资源的时长（月）。
- 取值：1、2、3、4、5、6、7、8、9、12、24、36、48、60
- 默认值：1
仅当参数`InstanceChargeType`取值为`PrePaid`时，该参数生效且为必选值。
Period.description_en:
Duration (months)
- Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 24, 36, 48, 60
- Default: 1
This parameter is required and only takes effect when `InstanceChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`.

PeriodUnit.description_cn:
购买资源的时长单位，取值：Month（默认）。
仅当`InstanceChargeType`取值为`PrePaid`时，该参数生效且为必选值。
PeriodUnit.description_en:
The unit for the resource purchase duration. Value: Month (default)
This parameter is valid and required only when `InstanceChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`.

Placement.Affinity.description_cn:
针对节省停机模式的ECS实例，停止后会释放部分资源，本参数用于选择专有宿主机实例重新启动时是否仍固定部署在原宿主机上。取值：

- Host：启用节省停机模式的实例重新启动时，仍会部署在原宿主机上。

- Default（默认）：启用节省停机模式的实例重新启动时，会优先迁移到支持自动部署的宿主机；若支持自动部署的宿主机资源不足，则在原宿主机上进行启动。
Placement.Affinity.description_en:
For ECS dedicated host instances in stopped with savings mode, some resources are released after the instance stops. This parameter lets you choose whether to keep the dedicated host instance deployed on the original dedicated host when it restarts. Options:

- Host: When you restart a dedicated host instance in stopped with savings mode, it remains on the original dedicated host.
- Default (default): When you restart a dedicated host instance in stopped with savings mode, the instance will preferentially migrate to a dedicated host that supports automatic deployment. If there are insufficient resources on such hosts, the instance will start on the original dedicated host.

Placement.DedicatedHostClusterId.description_cn:
实例所在的专有宿主机集群ID。
您可以调用[DescribeDedicatedHostClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1253698)接口查询宿主机集群ID。
Placement.DedicatedHostClusterId.description_en: This is the dedicated host cluster ID where the instance resides. You can call the [DescribeDedicatedHostClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1253698) API to query the dedicated host cluster ID.

Placement.DedicatedHostId.description_cn:
实例所在的专有宿主机ID。
您可以调用[DescribeDedicatedHosts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1253691)接口查询专有宿主机列表。
Placement.DedicatedHostId.description_en:
Dedicated host ID where the instance resides
You can call the [DescribeDedicatedHosts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1253691) API to query the list of dedicated hosts

Placement.Tenancy.description_cn:
是否在专有宿主机上创建实例，取值：
- Default（默认）：创建普通云服务器实例。
- Host：创建专有宿主机实例。若您不指定`Placement.DedicatedHostId`，则由系统自动选择专有宿主机放置实例。
专有宿主机上支持创建的实例规格请参见[规格介绍](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1253643)。
Placement.Tenancy.description_en:
Choose whether to create the instance on a dedicated host:
- Default: Create a regular cloud server instance
- Host: Create a dedicated host instance. If you do not specify `Placement.DedicatedHostId`, the system will automatically select a dedicated host for the instance
For supported instance specifications on dedicated hosts, see [Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1253643).

ProjectName.description_cn:
资源所属项目，一个资源只能归属于一个项目。
- 只能包含字母、数字、下划线“_”、点“.”和中划线“-”。
- 长度限制在64个字符以内。
ProjectName.description_en:
Project for this resource: Each resource can belong to only one project
- Use only letters, numbers, underscores (_), dots (.), and hyphens (-)
- Maximum length: 64 characters

SecurityEnhancementStrategy.description_cn:
是否开启安全加固，取值：
- Active：开启安全加固，仅对公共镜像生效。
- InActive：关闭安全加固，对所有镜像类型生效。
SecurityEnhancementStrategy.description_en:
Whether to enable security hardening. Options:
- Active: Applies to public images only
- Inactive: Applies to all image types

SpotPriceLimit.description_cn:
抢占式实例的每小时最高价格，支持最大3位小数。
仅当`SpotStrategy`取值为`SpotWithPriceLimit`时，该参数生效。
SpotPriceLimit.description_en:
Maximum hourly price for spot instance, supports up to three decimal places
This parameter is effective only when `SpotStrategy` is set to `SpotWithPriceLimit`

SpotStrategy.description_cn:
按量计费实例的抢占式策略，取值：
- NoSpot（默认）：表示创建正常按量计费实例。
- SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格的抢占式实例。
- SpotWithPriceLimit：设置出价上限的抢占式实例。
- 当`InstanceChargeType`取值为`PostPaid`时，该参数生效。
- 抢占式实例的出价模式请参见[购买抢占式实例](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/155935)。
SpotStrategy.description_en:
Preemptible policy for pay-as-you-go Instances. Options:
- NoSpot (default): Create a standard pay-as-you-go Instance
- SpotAsPriceGo: System sets the bid automatically, following the current market price for preemptible Instances
- SpotWithPriceLimit: Preemptible Instance with a custom bid limit
- This parameter takes effect when `InstanceChargeType` is set to `PostPaid`
- For details on preemptible Instance bidding modes, see [Purchase Preemptible Instances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/155935)

SuffixIndex.description_cn: 有序后缀的起始序号，取值：1～999，默认值为1。
SuffixIndex.description_en: Starting number for ordered suffix; range: 1–999, default: 1

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
用户标签的标签键。
- 参数 - N：表示标签键的序号，取值范围：1～20。
- 多个标签键之间用&分隔。

命名规则如下：
- 不能以`volc:`或`sys:`的任意大小写组合开头。
- 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
- 长度限制在1～128个字符之间。
同一资源的标签键不允许重复。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for user tags
- Parameter - N: Indicates the index of the tag key, valid range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag keys with &

Naming rules:
- Must not start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`
- Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
Tag keys for the same resource must be unique

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
用户标签的标签值。
- 参数 - N：表示标签值的序号，取值范围：1～20。
- 多个标签值之间用&分隔。

命名规则如下：
- 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
- 允许为空，长度限制在0～256个字符之间。
如果传入该参数，则必须先传入`Tags.N.Key`。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value for the user tag
- Parameter - N: Indicates the tag value's sequence number, range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag values with &

Naming rules:
- Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
- Can be empty; length must be 0–256 characters
If you specify this parameter, you must first specify `Tags.N.Key`

UniqueSuffix.description_cn:
表示当创建多台实例时，是否为`Hostname`和`InstanceName`自动添加有序后缀，取值：
- true：开启有序后缀。
- false（默认）：关闭有序后缀。
- 开启有序后缀时，若`Hostname`为空，系统将自动生成主机名，主机名后无有序后缀。
- 开启有序后缀时，若为`Hostname`、`InstanceName`指定了`[begin_number,bits]`命名格式，则最终生效情况请参见[批量设置有序的实例名称或主机名称](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/81260#openapi)。
UniqueSuffix.description_en:
Indicates whether to automatically add a sequential suffix to `Hostname` and `InstanceName` when creating multiple instances. Options:
- true: Enable sequential suffix
- false (default): Disable sequential suffix
- If sequential suffix is enabled and `Hostname` is empty, the system will automatically generate a hostname without a sequential suffix
- If sequential suffix is enabled and you specify the `[begin_number,bits]` naming format for `Hostname` or `InstanceName`, see [Set sequential instance or host names in bulk](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/81260#openapi) for how the names will ultimately be set

UserData.description_cn:
实例自定义数据。设置的自定义数据必须经过Base64编码，且Base64编码前的自定义数据大小不能超过16KB。
不填则默认为空。
UserData.description_en: Instance custom data. The custom data must be Base64-encoded and cannot exceed 16 KB before encoding. If left blank, the default is empty.

Volumes.N.DeleteWithInstance.description_cn:
云盘是否随实例释放，取值：
- true（默认）：云盘随实例释放。
- false：云盘不随实例释放。
- 参数 - N：表示云盘的序号，取值范围：1～16。N = 1表示系统盘，系统盘默认随实例释放，不可保留；N ≥ 2表示数据盘，可选择是否随实例释放。
- 多个云盘之间用&分隔。
Volumes.N.DeleteWithInstance.description_en:
Whether the cloud disk is released with the instance. Values:
- true (default): The cloud disk is released with the instance
- false: The cloud disk is not released with the instance
- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk sequence number. Value range: 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk, which is always released with the instance and cannot be retained; N ≥ 2 refers to data disks, which can be set to release with the instance or not
- Use & to separate multiple cloud disks

Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceIOPS.description_cn:
云盘额外IOPS性能大小，仅ESSD FlexPL数据盘支持，单位为次/秒。

`ExtraPerformanceTypeId`为`Balance`或`IOPS`时需设置该参数。各个类型的额外性能取值范围如下：
- IOPS型：1～50000。
- Balance型：1～50000。

- 参数 - N：表示云盘的序号，取值范围：1～16。N = 1表示系统盘，故N传入1时，该参数将被忽略。N ≥ 2表示数据盘，可正常传入该参数。
- 多个云盘之间用&分隔。
Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceIOPS.description_en:
Extra IOPS performance for cloud disks, supported only by ESSD FlexPL data disks. Unit: operations/second

Set this parameter when `ExtraPerformanceTypeId` is set to `Balance` or `IOPS`. The valid value ranges for each type are:
- IOPS type: 1–50000
- Balance type: 1–50000

- Parameter - N: Indicates the cloud disk sequence number. Valid values: 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk; when N is 1, this parameter is ignored. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks; you can set this parameter for data disks.
- Use & to separate multiple cloud disks.

Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB.description_cn:
云盘额外吞吐性能大小，单位MB/s，仅ESSD FlexPL数据盘支持。

`ExtraPerformanceTypeId`为`Throughput`时需设置该参数。
取值范围：1～650。

- 参数 - N：表示云盘的序号，取值范围：1～16。N = 1表示系统盘，故N传入1时，该参数将被忽略。N ≥ 2表示数据盘，可正常传入该参数。
- 多个云盘之间用&分隔。
Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB.description_en:
Extra disk throughput (MB/s). Supported only for ESSD FlexPL data disks.

Set this parameter when `ExtraPerformanceTypeId` is set to `Throughput`.
Value range: 1–650.

- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk sequence number. Valid values: 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk; if N is set to 1, this parameter will be ignored. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks; you can set this parameter normally.
- Use & to separate multiple disks.

Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceTypeId.description_cn:
云盘额外性能的类型，仅ESSD FlexPL数据盘支持。取值：
- Balance：均衡型额外性能。
- IOPS：IOPS型额外性能。
- Throughput：吞吐量型额外性能。

关于额外性能的更多介绍，请参见[云盘额外性能](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1174767)。

- 参数 - N：表示云盘的序号，取值范围：1～16。N = 1表示系统盘，故N传入1时，该参数将被忽略。N ≥ 2表示数据盘，可正常传入该参数。
- 多个云盘之间用&分隔。
Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceTypeId.description_en:
Types of extra disk performance supported only by ESSD FlexPL data disks. Options:
- Balance: Balanced extra performance
- IOPS: IOPS-based extra performance
- Throughput: Throughput-based extra performance

For more information about extra performance, see [Extra Disk Performance](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1174767).

- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk index, valid values: 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk; when N is 1, this parameter is ignored. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks; you can set this parameter for data disks.
- Use & to separate multiple disks.

Volumes.N.Size.description_cn:
云盘的容量，单位为GiB。N的取值范围1～16，N = 1表示系统盘，N ≥ 2表示数据盘。多个云盘之间用&分隔。

云盘容量的取值范围：
- 系统盘：
- ESSD_PL0：20～2048
- ESSD_FlexPL：20～2048
默认值：max{40 ，ImageId对应的镜像容量}。


- 数据盘：
- ESSD_PL0：10～32768
- ESSD_FlexPL：10～32768
如果不传入该参数，则使用`Volumes.N.SnapshotId`对应的快照大小作为数据盘的容量大小。若未传入`Volumes.N.SnapshotId`，则报错LimitExceeded.DataVolumeSize。
Volumes.N.Size.description_en:
Cloud disk capacity, in GiB. N ranges from 1 to 16. N = 1 indicates a system disk; N ≥ 2 indicates a data disk. Use & to separate multiple cloud disks.

Cloud disk capacity ranges:
- System disk:
  - ESSD_PL0: 20–2048
  - ESSD_FlexPL: 20–2048
Default: max{40, the image size for the specified ImageId}.


- Data disk:
  - ESSD_PL0: 10–32768
  - ESSD_FlexPL: 10–32768
If this parameter is not specified, the data disk capacity uses the snapshot size of `Volumes.N.SnapshotId`. If `Volumes.N.SnapshotId` is not provided, an error LimitExceeded.DataVolumeSize is returned.

Volumes.N.SnapshotId.description_cn:
使用快照创建云盘，仅支持创建数据盘。您可以调用[DescribeSnapshots](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/104884)接口查询快照ID。
- 参数 - N：表示云盘的序号，取值范围：1～16。N = 1表示系统盘，故N传入1时，该参数将被忽略。N ≥ 2表示数据盘，可正常传入目标数据盘快照ID。
- 多个云盘之间用&分隔。
- 仅极速型SSD支持通过快照创建云盘，性能型SSD不支持快照相关功能。
- 仅状态为“可用”的快照支持创建新云盘，“创建中”、“回滚中”、“删除中”及“错误”状态下的快照不支持创建新云盘。
Volumes.N.SnapshotId.description_en:
Create a cloud disk from a snapshot. Only data disks are supported. You can use the [DescribeSnapshots](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/104884) API to query the snapshot ID.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the cloud disk. Valid values: 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk; when N is set to 1, this parameter is ignored. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks; you can specify the target data disk snapshot ID.
- Use & to separate multiple cloud disks.
- Only Ultra SSDs support creating cloud disks from snapshots. Performance SSDs do not support snapshot-related features.
- Only snapshots in the 'Available' state can be used to create new cloud disks. Snapshots in 'Creating', 'Rolling Back', 'Deleting', or 'Error' states cannot be used to create new cloud disks.

Volumes.N.VolumeType.description_cn:
云盘的类型，取值：
- ESSD_PL0（默认）：极速型SSD PL0
- ESSD_FlexPL：极速型SSD FlexPL
- 参数 - N：表示云盘的序号，取值范围：1～16。N = 1表示系统盘，N ≥ 2表示数据盘。
- 多个云盘之间用&分隔。
Volumes.N.VolumeType.description_en:
Cloud disk type, possible values:
- ESSD_PL0 (default): Ultra-fast SSD PL0
- ESSD_FlexPL: Ultra-fast SSD FlexPL
- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk number, value range: 1–16. N = 1 indicates the system disk; N ≥ 2 indicate data disks
- Separate multiple cloud disks with &

ZoneId.description_cn:
实例所在可用区ID。
您可以调用[DescribeZones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/120518)查询一个地域下的可用区信息。
ZoneId.description_en:
Instance availability zone ID
You can call [DescribeZones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/120518) to query availability zone information within a region.

ClientToken.description_cn:
保证请求幂等性。由客户端自动生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一，避免当调用API超时或服务器内部错误时，客户端多次重试导致重复性操作。
取值：仅支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if the API call times out or a server error occurs and the client retries. Value: supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters.

IamRoleName.description_cn:
实例IAM角色名称。
您可以使用[ListRoles](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/65019)查询您已创建的实例IAM角色。
IamRoleName.description_en:
Instance IAM Role Name
You can use [ListRoles](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/65019) to view the instance IAM roles you have created

InstanceIds.N.description_cn:
实例ID，最多支持100个ID。
- 参数 - N：表示实例的序号。
- 多个Instance ID之间用&分隔。
InstanceIds.N.description_en:
Instance ID, supports up to 100 IDs
- Parameter - N: indicates the instance sequence number
- Separate multiple Instance IDs with &

ClientToken.description_cn:
保证请求幂等性。由客户端自动生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一，避免当调用API超时或服务器内部错误时，客户端多次重试导致重复性操作。
取值：仅支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if the API call times out or a server error occurs and the client retries. Value: ASCII characters only, up to 64 characters

InstanceIds.description_cn: 实例id
InstanceIds.description_en: Instance ID

InstanceIds.N.description_cn:
实例ID，最多支持100个。
- 参数 - N：表示实例的序号。
- 多个Instance ID之间用&分隔。
InstanceIds.N.description_en:
Supports up to 100 instance IDs
- Parameter - N: indicates the instance's sequence number
- Separate multiple instance IDs with &

KeyPairId.description_cn:
密钥对唯一ID，可以调用[DescribeKeyPairs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/120446)接口查询。
- `KeyPairName`与`KeyPairId`不允许同时为空。
- 如果同时设置了`KeyPairName`与`KeyPairId`，则优先生效`KeyPairId`。
KeyPairId.description_en:
The unique ID of the key pair. You can query it using the [DescribeKeyPairs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/120446) API.
- `KeyPairName` and `KeyPairId` cannot both be empty.
- If both `KeyPairName` and `KeyPairId` are set, `KeyPairId` takes precedence.

KeyPairName.description_cn:
密钥对名称。
- `KeyPairName`与`KeyPairId`不允许同时为空。
- 如果同时设置了`KeyPairName`与`KeyPairId`，则优先生效`KeyPairId`。
KeyPairName.description_en:
Key pair name
- `KeyPairName` and `KeyPairId` cannot both be empty
- If both `KeyPairName` and `KeyPairId` are set, `KeyPairId` takes priority

CopyImageTags.description_cn:
是否复制源镜像标签。取值：
- false（默认）：不复制
- true：复制
复制共享镜像时，本参数不生效。
CopyImageTags.description_en:
Whether to copy source image tags. Values:
- false (default): Do not copy
- true: Copy
This parameter does not take effect when copying shared images

Description.description_cn:
目标镜像描述，不填默认与源自定义镜像一致。填写规范如下：
- 必须以字母或汉字开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线“_”、中划线“-”、等号“=”、英文逗号“,”、英文句号“.”、中文逗号“，”、中文句号“。”和空格。
- 长度限制为0～255个字符。
Description.description_en:
Target image description. If left blank, it will default to the source custom image description. Please follow these rules:
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), equal signs (=), English commas (,), periods (.), Chinese commas (，), Chinese periods (。), and spaces
- Length must be 0 to 255 characters

DestinationRegion.description_cn:
目标区域，指定目标镜像所在区域。
* 跨地域复制镜像时，目标地域不能与源自定义镜像所在地域相同。
* 同地域复制共享镜像时，目标地域需与源共享镜像所在地域相同。
DestinationRegion.description_en:
Target region, specify the region where the target image is located.
* When copying images across regions, the target region must not be the same as the region where the source custom image is located.
* When copying shared images within the same region, the target region must be the same as the region where the source shared image is located.

ImageId.description_cn: 源自定义镜像ID。您可以调用[DescribeImages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70808)接口并传入`Visibility=private`参数，查询获取自定义镜像ID。
ImageId.description_en: Source custom image ID. Call the [DescribeImages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70808) API and set the `Visibility=private` parameter to query and obtain the custom image ID.

ImageName.description_cn:
目标自定义镜像名称。命名规范如下：
- 必须以字母或汉字开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线“_”、中划线“-”、英文句号“.”。
- 长度限制为1～128个字符。
ImageName.description_en:
Custom image name. Naming rules:
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscore (_), hyphen (-), and period (.)
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

ProjectName.description_cn:
镜像所属项目。
调用接口账号若仅拥有部分项目权限，本参数必填。授权账号操作项目详情，可查看[管理项目权限](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/173422)。
ProjectName.description_en:
Project
If the API account only has permissions for certain projects, this parameter is required. To authorize an account to operate on project details, see [Manage Project Permissions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/173422).

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
目标镜像标签的标签键。
- 参数 - N：表示标签键的序号，取值范围：1～20。
- 多个标签键之间用&分隔。

命名规则如下：
- 不能以volc:或sys:的任意大小写组合开头。
- 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
- 长度限制在1～128个字符之间。
- `CopyImageTags`参数值为`true`时，本参数不生效。
- 同一资源的标签键不允许重复。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for the target image tag
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, valid values: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag keys with &

Naming rules:
- Cannot start with any case combination of volc: or sys:
- Can only contain letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
- This parameter is ignored if the `CopyImageTags` parameter is set to `true`
- Tag keys for the same resource must be unique

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
目标镜像标签的标签值。
- 参数 - N：表示标签值的序号，取值范围：1～20。
- 多个标签值之间用&分隔。
命名规则如下：
- 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
- 允许为空，长度限制在0～256个字符之间。
- `CopyImageTags`参数值为`true`时，本参数不生效。
- 如果传入该参数，则必须先传入`Tags.N.Key`。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag values of the target image
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value, valid range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag values with &
Naming rules:
- Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following English symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
- Can be empty; length must be between 0 and 256 characters
- When the `CopyImageTags` parameter is set to `true`, this parameter does not take effect
- If this parameter is provided, `Tags.N.Key` must be provided first

CommandContent.description_cn:
命令内容。

- 请根据`ContentEncoding`参数传入相应命令内容。
- 请确保在编码前的脚本首行，按如下规范指定了脚本解释器。规则如下：
	- Shell脚本：首行需为`#!/bin/bash`。
	- Python脚本：首行需为`#!/usr/bin/python`。
- 命令内容不能超过16KB。
- `EnableParameter=true`时，命令内容支持使用自定义参数。规则如下：
	- 自定义参数用`{{}}`包含的方式定义。
	- 在`{{}}`内参数名前后的空格以及换行符会被忽略。
CommandContent.description_en:
Command content

- Enter the command content according to the `ContentEncoding` parameter
- Make sure the first line of your script specifies the interpreter as follows before encoding:
    - For shell scripts: The first line must be `#!/bin/bash`
    - For Python scripts: The first line must be `#!/usr/bin/python`
- Command content must not exceed 16 KB
- When `EnableParameter=true`, command content supports custom parameters:
    - Define custom parameters using double curly braces `{{}}`
    - Spaces and line breaks before and after parameter names inside `{{}}` are ignored

ContentEncoding.description_cn:
命令内容是否经过Base64编码处理。取值：

- Base64（默认）：经过Base64编码处理。
- PlainText： 未进行编码处理。
ContentEncoding.description_en:
Whether the command content is Base64 encoded. Options:

- Base64 (default): Encoded with Base64
- PlainText: Not encoded

Description.description_cn:
命令描述，默认为空字符串。

- 字符长度0~256。
- 不限制特殊字符。
Description.description_en:
Command description, defaults to an empty string

- Character length: 0–256
- Special characters allowed

EnableParameter.description_cn:
创建的命令是否使用自定义参数。取值：

- false：默认，表示不使用自定义参数。
- True：表示使用自定义参数。
EnableParameter.description_en:
Specifies whether the created command uses custom parameters

Possible values:

- False: Default, does not use custom parameters
- True: Uses custom parameters

Name.description_cn:
命令名称。需符合如下规则：

- 字符长度1~32。
- 不限制特殊字符。
Name.description_en:
Command Name
Must comply with the following rules:
- Length: 1–32 characters
- Special characters allowed

ParameterDefinitions.N.DecimalPrecision.description_cn:
自定义参数值（数值）允许的小数点后位数。

- `DecimalPrecision`取值范围：0~10。
- `Type=Digit`时必填，且`Required`参数为`true`时默认为`0`。
ParameterDefinitions.N.DecimalPrecision.description_en:
Number of decimal places allowed for custom parameter values (numeric)

- 'DecimalPrecision' range: 0–10
- Required when 'Type=Digit'; defaults to 0 if 'Required' is set to true

ParameterDefinitions.N.MaxLength.description_cn:
自定义参数值（字符串）的最大长度。

- `MaxLength`取值范围：1~1000。
- `Type=String`时必填，且`Required`参数为`true`时默认为`1000`。
- 本参数值需大于`MinLength`。
ParameterDefinitions.N.MaxLength.description_en:
Maximum length for custom parameter values (string)

- `MaxLength` range: 1–1000
- Required when `Type=String`; defaults to 1000 if `Required` is set to `true`
- This value must be greater than `MinLength`

ParameterDefinitions.N.MaxValue.description_cn:
自定义参数值（数值）的最大值。

- `MaxValue`取值范围：-1000000~1000000。
- `Type=Digit`时必填，且`Required`参数为`true`时默认为`1000000`。
- 本参数值需小于`MinValue`。
ParameterDefinitions.N.MaxValue.description_en:
Maximum value for custom parameter (numeric)

- `MaxValue` range: -1000000 to 1000000
- This field is required when `Type=Digit`
- If `Required` is true, the default value is 1000000
- This value must be less than `MinValue`

ParameterDefinitions.N.MinLength.description_cn:
自定义参数值（字符串）的最小长度。

- `MinLength`取值范围：1~1000。
- `Type=String`时必填，且`Required`参数为`true`时默认为`1`。
- 本参数值需小于`MaxLength`。
ParameterDefinitions.N.MinLength.description_en:
Minimum length for custom parameter value (string)

- `MinLength` range: 1–1000
- Required when `Type=String`; defaults to 1 if `Required` is set to `true`
- The value of `MinLength` must be less than `MaxLength`

ParameterDefinitions.N.MinValue.description_cn:
自定义参数值（数值）的最小值。

- `MinValue`取值范围：-1000000~1000000。
- `Type=Digit`时必填，且`Required`参数为`true`时默认为`-1000000`。
- 本参数值需小于`MaxValue`
ParameterDefinitions.N.MinValue.description_en:
Minimum value for custom parameter (numeric)

- `MinValue` range: -1000000 to 1000000
- This field is required when `Type=Digit`. If `Required` is true, the default value is -1000000
- This value must be less than `MaxValue`

ParameterDefinitions.N.Name.description_cn:
自定义参数名称，需要在脚本中通过{{Param}}定义 。命名规则：

- 单个参数名不能超过64字节。
- 遵循Shell变量命名规则，a-zA-Z0-9-\_的组合。首个字符不能以数字开头。中间不能有空格，可以使用下划线。
ParameterDefinitions.N.Name.description_en:
Custom parameter names must be defined in the script using {{Param}}. Naming rules:

- Each parameter name must not exceed 64 bytes
- Follow shell variable naming rules: use a combination of a-z, A-Z, 0-9, and underscores (_)
- The first character cannot be a number
- No spaces allowed; use underscores to separate words

ParameterDefinitions.N.Required.description_cn:
是否必填。取值：

- true：必填。
- false：非必填。
ParameterDefinitions.N.Required.description_en:
Whether required. Values:

- true: Required
- false: Optional

ParameterDefinitions.N.Type.description_cn:
自定义参数类型。取值：

- String：表示自定义参数类型为`String`（字符串）类型。
- Digit：表示自定义参数类型为`Digit`（数值）类型。
ParameterDefinitions.N.Type.description_en:
Custom parameter types. Options:

- String: Indicates that the custom parameter type is `String` (string) type
- Digit: Indicates that the custom parameter type is `Digit` (number) type

ProjectName.description_cn: 资源所属项目，一个资源只能归属于一个项目。
ProjectName.description_en: Project the resource belongs to. Each resource can belong to only one project.

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
用户标签的标签键。
- 参数 - N：表示标签键的序号，取值范围：1～20。
- 多个标签键之间用&分隔。

命名规则如下：
  - 不能以`volc:`或`sys:`的任意大小写组合开头。
  - 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
  - 长度限制在1～128个字符之间。
同一资源的标签键不允许重复。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for user tags
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag keys with &

Naming rules:
  - Cannot start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`
  - Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
  - Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
Tag keys for the same resource must be unique

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
用户标签的标签值。
- 参数 - N：表示标签值的序号，取值范围：1～20。
- 多个标签值之间用&分隔。

命名规则如下：
  - 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
  - 允许为空，长度限制在0～256个字符之间。
如果传入该参数，则必须先传入`Tags.N.Key`。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value for the user tag
- Parameter - N: Indicates the index of the tag value, valid range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag values with &

Naming rules:
  - Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
  - Can be empty; length must be between 0 and 256 characters
If you provide this parameter, you must first provide `Tags.N.Key`.

Timeout.description_cn:
创建的命令在ECS实例中执行时最大的超时时间，单位为**秒**。

- 取值范围：30~86400。
- 默认值：60。
Timeout.description_en:
Maximum timeout for the created command when executed on an ECS instance, in seconds

- Range: 30–86400
- Default: 60

Type.description_cn:
命令的类型。取值：

- Shell：表示创建一个在Linux实例中运行的Shell脚本。
- Python：表示创建一个Python脚本。
- Bat：表示创建一个Bat脚本。
- PowerShell：表示创建一个PowerShell脚本。
Type.description_en:
Command type. Available values:

- Shell: Create a Shell script that runs on a Linux Instance
- Python: Create a Python script
- Bat: Create a Bat script
- PowerShell: Create a PowerShell script

WorkingDir.description_cn: 创建的命令在ECS实例中运行的目录。Linux实例默认为`/home`。
WorkingDir.description_en: Directory where the created command runs in the ECS instance. The default for Linux instances is `/home`.

ClientToken.description_cn:
保证请求幂等性。由客户端自动生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一，避免当调用API超时或服务器内部错误时，客户端多次重试导致重复性操作。
取值：仅支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if the API call times out or a server error occurs and the client retries. Value: ASCII characters only, up to 64 characters

DedicatedHostClusterName.description_cn:
专有宿主机集群的名称。
- 不能以数字、中划线、下划线开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线和中划线。
- 长度限制为1～128个字符。
- 暂不支持特殊字符。
DedicatedHostClusterName.description_en:
Dedicated Host Cluster Name
- Cannot start with a number, hyphen, or underscore
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens
- Length must be 1–128 characters
- Special characters are not supported for now

Description.description_cn:
专有宿主机集群的描述，默认值为空字符串。
- 必须以字母或中文开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、点号“.”、空格、下划线“_”、中划线“-”、等号“=”、英文逗号“,”、中文逗号“，”和中文句号“。”
- 长度限制在255个字符以内。
Description.description_en:
Description of the dedicated host cluster, default value is an empty string.  
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character.  
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, periods ".", spaces, underscores "_", hyphens "-", equal signs "=", English commas ",", Chinese commas "，", and Chinese periods "。".  
- Limited to a maximum of 255 characters.
Description.example_cn: 用于测试的专有宿主机集群

ZoneId.description_cn:
专有宿主机集群所在的可用区ID。
可以调用[DescribeZones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/120518)查询一个地域下的可用区信息。
ZoneId.description_en:
Availability Zone ID of the dedicated host cluster
Use [DescribeZones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/120518) to query available zones in a region

保证请求幂等性。由客户端自动生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一，避免当调用API超时或服务器内部错误时，客户端多次重试导致重复性操作。

Value: Only ASCII characters are supported, up to 64 characters.

DeploymentSetName.description_cn:
部署集名称。
- 不能以数字、中划线、下划线开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线和中划线。
- 长度限制为1～128个字符。
DeploymentSetName.description_en:
Deployment Set Name
- Cannot start with a digit, hyphen, or underscore
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens
- Length must be 1–128 characters

Description.description_cn:
部署集描述。
- 必须以字母或中文开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、点“.”、空格、下划线“_”、中划线“-”、等号“=”、英文逗号“,”、中文逗号“，”和中文句号“。”
- 长度限制在255个字符以内。
传入空字符串时，将清空原有描述信息。
Description.description_en:
Deployment Set Description
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period '.', space, underscore '_', hyphen '-', equals sign '=', English comma ',', Chinese comma '，', and Chinese period '。' are allowed
- Maximum length is 255 characters
Submitting an empty string will clear the existing description

Granularity.description_cn:
部署粒度，取值：
- host：物理机
- rack：机架
- switch：交换机

`Strategy`取值为`AvailabilityGroup`时，该参数如需传入`rack`或`switch`，需联系客户经理申请。
Granularity.description_en:
Deployment granularity options:
- host: physical machine
- rack: rack
- switch: switch

If `Strategy` is set to `AvailabilityGroup`, you must contact your account manager to apply for using `rack` or `switch` as parameter values.

GroupCount.description_cn:
为部署集组高可用策略设置分组数量。
- 取值范围：1～7。
- 默认值：7
`Strategy`取值为`AvailabilityGroup`时，需传入该参数。
GroupCount.description_en:
Set the number of groups for the high availability strategy of the deployment set group.
- Value range: 1–7.
- Default value: 7
This parameter is required when `Strategy` is set to `AvailabilityGroup`.

Strategy.description_cn:
部署策略，取值：
- Availability（默认）：高可用策略。
- AvailabilityGroup：部署集组高可用策略。
Strategy.description_en:
Deployment strategy options:
- Availability (Default): High availability strategy
- AvailabilityGroup: Deployment set group high availability strategy

Description.description_cn:
高性能计算集群描述，默认为空字符串。
- 必须以字母或中文开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线和中划线。
- 长度限制在0～255之间。
Description.description_en:
High-performance computing cluster description, defaults to an empty string
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens are allowed
- Length must be between 0 and 255 characters

Name.description_cn:
高性能计算集群名称。
- 必须以字母或中文开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线和中划线。
- 长度限制在1～128之间。
Name.description_en:
High Performance Computing Cluster Name
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

ProjectName.description_cn:
资源所属项目，一个资源只能归属于一个项目。
- 只能包含字母、数字、下划线“_”、点“.”和中划线“-”。
- 长度限制在64个字符以内。
ProjectName.description_en:
The project to which the resource belongs; each resource can only belong to one project.
- Only letters, numbers, underscores "_", periods ".", and hyphens "-" are allowed.
- Maximum length is 64 characters.

RdmaBigpodId.description_en: Specify RdmaBigpod. Access is allowed only for whitelisted users

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
用户标签的标签键。
- 参数 - N：表示标签键的序号，取值范围：1～20。
- 多个标签键之间用&分隔。
命名规则如下：
- 不能以`volc:`或`sys:`的任意大小写组合开头。
- 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
- 长度限制在1～128个字符之间。
同一资源的标签键不允许重复。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for user tags
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, valid range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag keys with &
Naming rules:
- Cannot start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`
- Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following English symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
Tag keys for the same resource must be unique

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
用户标签的标签值。
- 参数 - N：表示标签值的序号，取值范围：1～20。
- 多个标签值之间用&分隔。
命名规则如下：
- 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
- 允许为空，长度限制在0～256个字符之间。
如果传入该参数，则必须先传入`Tags.N.Key`。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Value of the user tag.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value, range: 1–20.
- Separate multiple tag values with &.
Naming rules:
- Only letters, numbers, spaces, and English symbols "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@" are allowed.
- Can be empty; length must be between 0 and 256 characters.
If this parameter is provided, `Tags.N.Key` must be provided first.

Type.description_cn: 集群类型。
Type.description_en: Cluster Type

ZoneId.description_cn:
高性能计算集群所属可用区ID。
您可以调用[DescribeZones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/120518)查询一个地域下的可用区信息。
ZoneId.description_en:
Availability zone ID of the high performance computing cluster
You can call [DescribeZones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/120518) to query availability zone information for a region

CreateWholeImage.description_cn:
是否创建整机镜像。取值：
- false：默认值，不创建整机镜像。
- true：创建整机镜像。
CreateWholeImage.description_en: Create full machine image? Possible values: - false: Default value, do not create a full machine image - true: Create a full machine image

Description.description_cn:
镜像描述。
- 必须以字母、汉字开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线“_”、中划线“-”、等号“=”、英文逗号“,”、英文句号“.”、中文逗号“，”、中文句号“。”和空格。
- 长度限制为0～255个字符。
- 不填默认为空。
Description.description_en:
Image description
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Can only include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), equals signs (=), English commas (,), periods (.), Chinese commas (，), Chinese periods (。), and spaces
- Length: 0–255 characters
- If left blank, defaults to empty

ImageName.description_cn:
镜像名称。
- 必须以字母、汉字开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线“_”、中划线“-”、英文句号“.”。
- 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符。
ImageName.description_en:
Image Name
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.)
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例ID。您可以调用[DescribeInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70466)接口查询获取实例ID。
本参数与`SnapshotId`、`SnapshotGroupId`参数，三选一必填。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID. You can call the [DescribeInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70466) API to query and obtain the instance ID.
You must provide one of the following: this parameter, `SnapshotId`, or `SnapshotGroupId`.

NeedDetection.description_cn:
是否进行镜像检测。取值：
- true：默认值，进行检测。
- false：不进行检测。
镜像检测功能正在邀测中，如需试用，请联系客户经理申请。
NeedDetection.description_en:
Enable mirror detection. Options:
- true: Default, enable detection
- false: Disable detection
Mirror detection is currently in invitation-only testing. To request access, please contact your account manager

ProjectName.description_cn:
资源所属项目。
调用接口账号若仅拥有部分项目权限，本参数必填。授权账号操作项目详情，可查看[管理项目权限](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/173422)。
ProjectName.description_en:
Project for this resource
If the API account only has access to some projects, this parameter is required. To view or manage project permissions, see [Manage Project Permissions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/173422).

SnapshotGroupId.description_cn:
快照一致性组ID，表示使用快照一致性组创建自定义镜像。您可以调用[DescribeSnapshotGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1214845)接口查询获取。
本参数与`SnapshotId`、`InstanceId`参数，三选一必填。
SnapshotGroupId.description_en:
Snapshot consistency group ID. Use this to create a custom image from a snapshot consistency group. You can query this value using the [DescribeSnapshotGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1214845) API.
You must provide exactly one of these parameters: this parameter, `SnapshotId`, or `InstanceId`.

SnapshotId.description_cn:
系统盘快照ID，表示使用系统盘快照创建自定义镜像。您可以调用[DescribeSnapshots](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/104884)接口查看获取。
本参数与`InstanceId`、`SnapshotGroupId`参数，三选一必填。
SnapshotId.description_en:
System disk snapshot ID. Use a system disk snapshot to create a custom image. You can call the [DescribeSnapshots](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/104884) API to view or obtain the snapshot ID.
You must specify one of the following: this parameter, `InstanceId`, or `SnapshotGroupId`.

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
镜像标签的标签键。
- 参数 - N：表示标签键的序号，取值范围：1～20。
- 多个标签键之间用&分隔。
- 命名规则如下：

   - 长度限制在1～128个字符之间。
- 同一资源的标签键不允许重复。

Tag key for image tags
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, range: 1–20

   - Cannot start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`

   - Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
- Tag keys for the same resource must be unique

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:

   -  只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
   - 允许为空，长度限制在0～256个字符之间。
- 如果传入该参数，则必须先传入Tags.N.Key。

- Parameter - N: Indicates the index of the tag value, ranging from 1 to 20

Description.description_cn:
密钥对的描述，默认值为空字符串。
- 必须以字母或中文开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、点“.”、空格、下划线“_”、中划线“-”、等号“=”、英文逗号“,”、中文逗号“，”和中文句号“。”
- 长度限制在255个字符以内。
Description.description_en:
Description of the key pair. Default is an empty string
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period (.), space, underscore (_), hyphen (-), equals sign (=), English comma (,), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
- Maximum length is 255 characters

KeyPairName.description_cn:
密钥对名称。
- 不可与已有名称重复。
- 长度限制在 2～64 个字符之间。
- 允许使用点号“.”分隔字符成多段，每段允许使用大小写字母、数字或连字符“-”。
- 不能以“-”和“.”开头或结尾，不能连续使用“-”或者“.”。
KeyPairName.description_en:
Key pair name
- Must be unique
- Length must be between 2 and 64 characters
- You can use periods (.) to separate segments; each segment can contain letters, numbers, or hyphens (-)
- Cannot start or end with a hyphen (-) or period (.), and cannot contain consecutive hyphens or periods

ProjectName.description_cn:

- 长度限制在64个字符以内。
ProjectName.description_en:

- Use only letters, numbers, underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-)
- Maximum length: 64 characters

DeploymentSetGroupNumber.description_cn: 当ECS实例要加入或调整的部署集策略为部署集组高可用策略（AvailabilityGroup）时，可以通过该参数指定实例在部署集中的分组号。
DeploymentSetGroupNumber.description_en: When an ECS instance needs to join or adjust a deployment set with the AvailabilityGroup policy, you can use this parameter to specify the group number of the instance within the deployment set.

DeploymentSetId.description_cn: 实例需要加入的部署集ID。
DeploymentSetId.description_en: Deployment set ID to add the instance to

Description.description_cn:
实例的描述，取值：
- 不能以数字、中划线开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线和中划线。
- 长度限制在0 ~ 255之间。
- 不填默认为空字符串。
Description.description_en:
Instance description. Value must meet the following requirements:
- Cannot start with a number or hyphen
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens
- Length must be between 0 and 255 characters
- If left blank, defaults to an empty string

Eip.Bandwidth.description_cn:
公网IP的带宽上限，单位：Mbps。

- 取值范围：1～500。

- 默认值：1。

 tip
配置Eip.Bandwidth或Eip.ISP后，伸缩组创建实例时即会分配公网IP，默认按照按量计费-按固定带宽计费。
Eip.Bandwidth.description_en:
Maximum bandwidth for public IP, unit: Mbps

- Value range: 1–500
- Default value: 1

 tip
When you configure Eip.Bandwidth or Eip.ISP, the scaling group assigns a public IP to the Instance when it is created. By default, billing is pay-as-you-go—based on fixed bandwidth.

Eip.BandwidthPackageId.description_cn:
共享带宽包的ID，表示将公网IP加入到共享带宽包。 您可以调用 [DescribeBandwidthPackages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6623/100685) 接口，查询共享带宽包的ID。 公网IP加入到共享带宽包必须同时满足如下条件：

- 二者的安全防护类型相同。

- 二者的线路类型相同。

- 共享带宽包为IPv4类型。
Eip.BandwidthPackageId.description_en:
Shared bandwidth package ID, used to add a public IP to a shared bandwidth package. You can call the [DescribeBandwidthPackages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6623/100685) API to query the shared bandwidth package ID. To add a public IP to a shared bandwidth package, the following conditions must be met:

- Both must have the same security protection type
- Both must have the same line type
- The shared bandwidth package must be of IPv4 type

Eip.BillingType.description_cn:
公网IP的计费方式，取值：

- 2：按量计费-按带宽上限计费。

- 3：按量计费-按实际流量计费。
Eip.BillingType.description_en:
Public IP billing method possible values:

- 2: Pay-As-You-Go (by bandwidth cap)
- 3: Pay-As-You-Go (by actual traffic)

Eip.ISP.description_cn:
公网IP的线路类型，取值：

- BGP：BGP（多线）。

- 若您的账号已申请并开通了静态单线权限，则可传入如下取值：

    - ChinaMobile：中国移动静态单线。

    - ChinaTelecom：中国电信静态单线。

    - ChinaUnicom：中国联通静态单线。

 tip
配置Eip.Bandwidth或Eip.ISP后，伸缩组创建实例时即会分配公网IP，默认按照按量计费-按固定带宽计费。
Eip.ISP.description_en:
Public IP line type options:

- BGP: BGP (multi-line)

- If your account has applied for and enabled static single-line permission, you can use the following values:
    - ChinaMobile: China Mobile static single-line
    - ChinaTelecom: China Telecom static single-line
    - ChinaUnicom: China Unicom static single-line

 tip
When you configure Eip.Bandwidth or Eip.ISP, the scaling group assigns a public IP when creating an Instance. By default, billing is pay-as-you-go with fixed bandwidth pricing.

Eip.ReleaseWithInstance.description_cn:
公网IP是否随实例删除，仅按量计费公网IP生效。取值： 
- true：公网IP随实例删除。当实例被系统自动回收（退订24小时后、到期回收等）或被调用[DeleteInstance](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70465)、[DeleteInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/101070)接口删除时，公网IP随实例一同释放。 
- false（默认）：公网IP不随实例删除。
Eip.ReleaseWithInstance.description_en:
Whether the public IP is released when the Instance is deleted applies only to pay-as-you-go public IPs. Options: 
- true: The public IP is released with the Instance. When the Instance is automatically recycled by the system (such as 24 hours after unsubscribing or upon expiration) or deleted using the [DeleteInstance](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70465) or [DeleteInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/101070) APIs, the public IP is released together with the Instance. 
- false (default): The public IP is not released when the Instance is deleted.

Eip.SecurityProtectionInstanceId.description_cn:
DDoS原生防护（企业版）ID。

- 您可以调用[DescInstanceList](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6352/1282916)接口，查询DDoS原生防护（企业版）的ID。

- 当SecurityProtectionTypes.N传入AntiDDoS\_Enhanced时，此参数必须传入。
Eip.SecurityProtectionInstanceId.description_en:
DDoS Native Protection (Enterprise Edition) ID.

- You can call the [DescInstanceList](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6352/1282916) API to query the ID of DDoS Native Protection (Enterprise Edition).

- When SecurityProtectionTypes.N is set to AntiDDoS_Enhanced, this parameter is required.

Eip.SecurityProtectionTypes.N.description_cn:
公网IP的安全防护类型。

- 参数 - N：表示安全防护类型的序号，当前仅支持取1。

- 取值：

    - AntiDDoS\_Enhanced：申请增强防护类型的公网IP，可加入到DDoS原生防护（企业版）实例。

 tip

- 若传入AntiDDoS\_Enhanced，则EipAddress.ChargeType不能为PrePaid，且EipAddress.ISP必须传入BGP。

- 增强防护类型公网IP正在邀测中，如需试用，请[提交工单](https://console.volcengine.com/workorder/create/)或联系客户经理申请。
Eip.SecurityProtectionTypes.N.description_en:
Security protection types for public IP addresses

- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the security protection type. Currently, only 1 is supported

- Value:

    - AntiDDoS_Enhanced: Apply for a public IP address with enhanced protection. Can be added to a DDoS Native Protection (Enterprise Edition) instance

 tip

- If AntiDDoS_Enhanced is specified, EipAddress.ChargeType cannot be PrePaid, and EipAddress.ISP must be set to BGP

- Enhanced protection public IP addresses are currently in invitation-only testing. To request a trial, please [submit a ticket](https://console.volcengine.com/workorder/create/) or contact your account manager

HostName.description_cn:
实例的主机名，取值：

- 允许使用点号“.”分隔字符成多段。

- 每段中允许使用字母、数字或中划线“-”。

- 不能以中划线“-”或点号“.”开头或结尾，且不能连续使用中划线或点号。

- Linux系统的主机名长度限制为2～59个字符。

- Windows系统的主机名长度限制为2～10个字符，不能包含点号“.”，且不能完全是数字。

如不填，则遵循以下规则自动生成：

- 结构：iv- + 初始主机名，例如iv-3tigy72q3u3vj0\*\*\*\*\*\*。

- 初始主机名生成逻辑：

- Linux：提取实例IDi-之后的全部字符。

- Windows：提取实例IDi-之后的后12位字符。
HostName.description_en:
Instance hostname requirements:

- You can use periods (.) to separate the hostname into segments
- Each segment can contain letters, numbers, or hyphens (-)
- The hostname cannot start or end with a hyphen (-) or period (.), and hyphens or periods cannot appear consecutively
- For Linux, the hostname must be 2 to 59 characters long
- For Windows, the hostname must be 2 to 10 characters long, cannot contain periods (.), and cannot be entirely numeric

If not specified, the hostname is generated automatically as follows:

- Format: iv- + initial hostname, for example iv-3tigy72q3u3vj0******
- Initial hostname generation:
  - Linux: uses all characters after 'i-' in the Instance ID
  - Windows: uses the 12 characters immediately following 'i-' in the Instance ID

HpcClusterId.description_cn: 当创建高性能计算GPU型实例时，请指定高性能计算集群ID。
HpcClusterId.description_en: Specify the high-performance computing cluster ID when creating a high-performance computing GPU-type instance

ImageId.description_cn: 启动实例时使用的镜像ID，您可以通过 [DescribeImages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70808) 接口查询可以使用的镜像资源。
ImageId.description_en: Image ID used to launch the Instance. You can query available image resources through the [DescribeImages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70808) API.

InstanceChargeType.description_cn:
实例和云盘的计费类型，取值：
- PostPaid（默认）：按量计费。
- PrePaid：包年包月。
- Esi：弹性预约实例。
- Segmented：时段型弹性预约实例。
 tip
时段型弹性预约实例功能正在邀测中，如需试用，请联系客户经理申请。
InstanceChargeType.description_en:
Billing types for instances and cloud disks:
- PostPaid (default): Pay-as-you-go
- PrePaid: Subscription (annual or monthly)
- Esi: Elastic reservation instance
- Segmented: Time-based elastic reservation instance
 tip
The time-based elastic reservation instance feature is currently in invitation-only testing. If you would like to try it, please contact your account manager to apply.

InstanceName.description_cn:
实例的名称，取值：
- 不能以数字、中划线、下划线开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线和中划线。
- 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符。
- 暂不支持特殊字符，不填默认为空字符串。
InstanceName.description_en:
Instance name requirements:
- Cannot start with a number, hyphen, or underscore
- Only supports Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
- Special characters are not supported for now; if left blank, defaults to an empty string

InstanceTypeId.description_cn:
实例的计算规格，当前仅支持指定一个计算规格。
实例规格的更多信息，请参见[实例规格介绍](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70840)；也可以调用 [DescribeInstanceTypes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/92769) 接口获取最新的规格列表。
InstanceTypeId.description_en: Only one compute specification can be set for an instance. For more information about instance specifications, see [Instance Specifications Overview](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70840). You can also call the [DescribeInstanceTypes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/92769) API to get the latest specification list.

KeepImageCredential.description_cn:
是否保留镜像设置，取值： 
- true：保留镜像设置，保留后将使用镜像预设的密码或密钥对登录实例。 
- false（默认）：不保留镜像设置。 
 
- 仅自定义镜像、共享镜像支持该功能。 
- 该参数取值为`true`时，请勿传入`KeyPairName`。
KeepImageCredential.description_en:
Retain image settings. Options:
- true: Retain image settings. The instance will use the preset password or key pair from the image for login
- false (default): Do not retain image settings
- This feature is only supported for custom images and shared images
- If this parameter is set to `true`, do not specify `KeyPairName`

KeyPairName.description_cn:
使用“SSH密钥对”登录实例时，请输入密钥对的名称。
 tip
如果同时设置了KeyPairName和Password，则仅生效KeyPairName。
KeyPairName.description_en:
When logging in to an Instance using an SSH key pair, enter the name of the key pair.
 tip
If both KeyPairName and Password are set, only KeyPairName will take effect.

LaunchTemplateName.description_cn:
实例启动模板名称。取值：
- 不能以数字、中划线、下划线开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线和中划线。
- 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符。
- 暂不支持特殊字符。
LaunchTemplateName.description_en:
Instance launch template name
Allowed values:
- Cannot start with a digit, hyphen, or underscore
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens
- Length must be 1 to 128 characters
- Special characters are currently not supported

LaunchTemplateProjectName.description_cn:
实例启动模版所属项目，默认为default。一个资源只能归属于一个项目。

- 只能包含字母、数字、下划线“\_”、点“.”和中划线“-”。

- 长度限制在64个字符以内。
LaunchTemplateProjectName.description_en:
The project to which the instance launch template belongs. Default is "default". Each resource can belong to only one project

- Only letters, numbers, underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-) are allowed
- Maximum length is 64 characters

LaunchTemplateTags.N.Key.description_cn:
实例启动模版的标签键。

- 参数 - N：表示标签键的序号。取值范围：1～20

- 多个标签键之间用&分隔。

命名规则如下：

- 不能以volc:的任意大小写组合开头。

- 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“\_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。

- 长度限制在1～128个字符之间。

 tip
同一资源的标签键不允许重复。
LaunchTemplateTags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag keys for instance launch templates

- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key. Value range: 1–20

- Separate multiple tag keys with &

Naming rules:

- Must not start with any case combination of volc:

- Can only contain letters, numbers, spaces, and the following English symbols: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"

- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

 tip
Tag keys for the same resource must be unique

LaunchTemplateTags.N.Value.description_cn:
实例启动模版的标签值。

- 参数 - N：表示标签值的序号。取值范围：1～20

- 多个标签值之间用&分隔。

命名规则如下：

- 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“\_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。

- 允许为空，长度限制在0～256个字符之间。

 tip
如果传入该参数，则必须传入LaunchTemplateTags.N.Key。
LaunchTemplateTags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag values for the instance launch template.

- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value. Valid range: 1–20

- Multiple tag values are separated by &.

Naming rules:

- Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following English symbols are allowed: '_', '.', ':', '/', '=', '+', '-', '@'.

- Can be empty; length must be between 0 and 256 characters.

 tip
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify LaunchTemplateTags.N.Key.

NetworkInterfaces.N.SecurityGroupIds.N.description_cn:
网卡关联的安全组ID：
- 参数 - N：表示网卡的序号，序号为“1”表示主网卡；序号为“2”或大于“2”表示辅助网卡。
- 参数 - N：表示第N个网卡关联的安全组的序号，最多支持同时绑定5个安全组，取值：1 - 5。
- 取值 - SecurityGroupIds：表示第N个网卡关联的第N个安全组的ID。
- 多个安全组ID之间用&分隔。
NetworkInterfaces.N.SecurityGroupIds.N.description_en:
Security group IDs associated with NICs:
- Parameter - N: Indicates the NIC index. Index '1' refers to the primary NIC; index '2' or higher refers to secondary NICs.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the index of the security group associated with the Nth NIC. Up to 5 security groups can be bound at the same time. Valid values: 1–5.
- Value - SecurityGroupIds: Indicates the ID of the Nth security group associated with the Nth NIC.
- Separate multiple security group IDs with &.

NetworkInterfaces.N.SubnetId.description_cn:
实例的私有网络子网ID，创建实例时，支持同时绑定辅助网卡：
- 参数 - N：表示网卡的序号，序号为“1”表示主网卡；序号为“2”或大于“2”表示辅助网卡。
- 取值 - SubnetId：表示第N个网卡的子网ID。
- 多个私有网络子网ID之间用&分隔。
NetworkInterfaces.N.SubnetId.description_en:
Private subnet ID for the instance. When creating an instance, you can bind auxiliary network interfaces:
