DryRun.description_cn:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
- true：发送检查请求，不会更换系统。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
- false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接更换系统。
DryRun.description_en:
Whether to only pre-check this request. Options:
- true: Send a pre-check request without changing the system. Checks include required parameters, request format, and business restrictions. If the check fails, returns the corresponding error. If the check passes, returns the error code `DryRunOperation`.
- false (default): Send a normal request. If the check passes, the system will be changed directly.

ImageId.description_cn: 更换操作系统时使用的镜像ID。您可以调用[DescribeImages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70808)接口查询获取。
ImageId.description_en: Image ID used when changing the operating system. You can obtain it by calling the [DescribeImages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70808) API.

ImageReleaseVersion.description_cn:
使用的镜像具体版本号。
- 该参数仅选用公共镜像时生效。
- 若为空，将使用镜像的最新版本。
ImageReleaseVersion.description_en:
Specific version number of the image being used
- This parameter takes effect only when you select a public image
- If left empty, the latest version will be used

InstanceId.description_cn: 实例ID。您可以调用[DescribeInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70466)接口查询获取。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70466) API to query and obtain it

KeepImageCredential.description_cn:
使用镜像预设密码/密钥对登录实例。取值：
- true：使用镜像预设密码/密钥对登录。
- false（默认）：不使用镜像预设密码/密钥对登录。
- 仅自定义镜像、共享镜像支持使用该功能。
- 该参数为`true`时，请勿传入`PassWord`和`KeyPairName`。
KeepImageCredential.description_en:
Log in to the Instance using the image's preset password or key pair. Values:
- true: Use the image's preset password or key pair to log in
- false (default): Do not use the image's preset password or key pair to log in
- Only custom images and shared images support this feature
- If this parameter is set to `true`, do not provide `PassWord` or `KeyPairName`

KeyPairName.description_cn:
重置密钥对。您可以调用[DescribeKeyPairs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/120446)接口查询获取。
- 仅对Linux操作系统的实例生效。
- `KeepImageCredential`为`false`时，本参数与`Password`不能同时为空。
- 若同时设置了密钥对`KeyPairName`和密码`Password`，则仅生效密钥对`KeyPairName`。
KeyPairName.description_en:
Reset key pair. You can call the [DescribeKeyPairs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/120446) API to query and obtain key pairs.
- Applies only to Linux Instances
- When `KeepImageCredential` is set to `false`, either this parameter or `Password` must be provided
- If both `KeyPairName` and `Password` are set, only `KeyPairName` takes effect

Password.description_cn:
重置密码，密码规则如下：
- 长度限制在8 ～ 30之间
- 密码只能由大写字母、小写字母、数字和特殊字符组成，且必须包含至少三项
特殊字符可以使用：`~!@#$%^&*()_-+=|{}[]:;'<>,.?/
- 不能以“/”和“$6$”开头
- 登录凭证支持“密码”、“密钥对”、“保留镜像设置”三种方式，使用“密码”方式登录实例时，建议增加密码复杂度以提高安全性。
- `KeepImageCredential`为`false`时，本参数与`KeyPairName`不能同时为空。
Password.description_en:
Reset Password
Password requirements:
- Length must be between 8 and 30 characters
- Password can only contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters, and must include at least three of these types
  Allowed special characters: `~!@#$%^&*()_-+=|{}[]:;'<>,.?/
- Cannot start with '/' or '$6$'
- Login credentials support three methods: password, key pair, or keep image settings. When logging in to an Instance using a password, we recommend increasing password complexity for better security
- When `KeepImageCredential` is set to `false`, this parameter and `KeyPairName` cannot both be empty

Description.description_cn: 异常问题的详细描述。
Description.description_en: Detailed description of the abnormal issue

DeviceNames.N.description_cn:
相同异常问题的磁盘挂载的设备名列表，最多支持100个设备名。
- 参数 - N：表示设备名的序号。
- 多个设备名之间用&分隔。
DeviceNames.N.description_en:
List of device names for disk mounts with the same exception issue; supports up to 100 device names
- Parameter - N: indicates the sequence number of the device name
- Separate multiple device names with &

DiskIds.N.description_cn:
相同异常问题的磁盘ID列表，最多支持100个磁盘ID。
- 参数 - N：表示磁盘ID的序号。
- 多个磁盘ID之间用&分隔。
如果是本地盘实例，请填写磁盘设备对应的SN。
DiskIds.N.description_en:
List of disk IDs with the same exception issue; supports up to 100 disk IDs
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the disk ID
- Separate multiple disk IDs with &
If this is a local disk instance, enter the SN of the disk device

EndTime.description_cn: 实例异常问题结束时间，格式为RFC3339。
EndTime.description_en: End time of instance abnormal issue, format: RFC3339

InstanceIds.N.description_cn:
异常问题的实例ID列表，最多支持100个。取值范围：
- 参数 - N：表示实例ID的标识。
- 多个实例ID之间用&分隔。
InstanceIds.N.description_en:
Supports up to 100 instance IDs for abnormal issues
Format:
- Parameter-N: indicates the identifier for an instance ID
- Separate multiple instance IDs with &

Reason.description_cn:
异常问题对实例造成的影响，取值范围：
- instance-hang：实例不可用，或无法连接。
- instance-stuck-in-status：实例长时间停留在某一个状态，如Starting或Stopping状态。
- abnormal-network：实例发生网络异常。
- abnormal-local-disk：实例挂载的本地盘出现异常。
- abnormal-cloud-disk：实例挂载的云盘或共享块存储出现异常。
- abnormal-GPU-device：GPU实例的GPU卡出现异常。
- abnormal-RDMA-device：HPC实例RDMA网卡出现异常。
- others：其他异常类型，当以上影响类型不符合条件时，您可以设置Reason=others并在Description中描述更多异常信息。
Reason.description_en:
Impact of abnormal issues on the instance. Possible values:
- instance-hang: Instance is unavailable or cannot be connected
- instance-stuck-in-status: Instance remains in the same status for an extended period, such as Starting or Stopping
- abnormal-network: Instance experiences network abnormality
- abnormal-local-disk: The local disk attached to the instance is abnormal
- abnormal-cloud-disk: The cloud disk or shared block storage attached to the instance is abnormal
- abnormal-GPU-device: The GPU card in a GPU instance is abnormal
- abnormal-RDMA-device: The RDMA network card in an HPC instance is abnormal
- others: Other types of abnormalities. If none of the above apply, set Reason=others and provide more details in Description

StartTime.description_cn: 实例异常问题开始时间，格式为RFC3339。
StartTime.description_en: Start time of instance abnormal issue (RFC3339 format)

CommandContent.description_cn:
命令内容。
- 请确保编码前的脚本，首行指定了脚本解释器。规则如下：
	- Shell脚本：首行需为`#!/bin/bash`。
	- Python脚本：首行需为`#!/usr/bin/python`。
- 命令内容不能超过16KB。
CommandContent.description_en:
Command content.
- Before encoding, make sure the script specifies the interpreter on the first line. The rules are as follows:
	- For shell scripts: the first line must be `#!/bin/bash`.
	- For Python scripts: the first line must be `#!/usr/bin/python`.
- Command content cannot exceed 16KB.

ContentEncoding.description_cn:
命令内容是否经过Base64编码处理。取值：

- Base64（默认）：经过Base64编码处理。
- PlainText： 未进行编码处理。
ContentEncoding.description_en:
Whether the command content is Base64 encoded. Options:

- Base64 (default): Encoded with Base64
- PlainText: Not encoded

EnableParameter.description_cn:
创建的命令是否使用自定义参数。取值：

- false：默认，表示不使用自定义参数。
- true：表示使用自定义参数。
EnableParameter.description_en:
Specifies whether the created command uses custom parameters. Options:

- false: Default; does not use custom parameters
- true: Uses custom parameters

Frequency.description_cn:
执行频率。仅`RepeatMode=Rate`时本参数必填。请按如下格式传入Rate表达式指定执行周期：

- <执行间隔数值><执行间隔单位>
	- 执行间隔单位：支持分钟（m）、小时（h）和天（d），适用于在固定时间间隔执行作业的场景。
	- 时间间隔数值范围：5～60（分钟），1～24（小时），1～7（天），且间隔需大于作业的超时时间。
- 执行间隔基于固定频率，与作业实际执行需要的时间无关。
- 创建作业后基于`LaunchTime`执行一次，根据间隔设置确定下一次执行时间。
Frequency.description_en:
Execution frequency. This parameter is required only when `RepeatMode=Rate`. Specify the execution cycle using a rate expression in the following format:

- <interval value><interval unit>
    - Interval unit: Supports minutes (m), hours (h), and days (d). Use for jobs that run at fixed intervals.
    - Interval value range: 5–60 (minutes), 1–24 (hours), 1–7 (days). The interval must be longer than the job's timeout period.
- The execution interval is based on a fixed frequency and is not affected by the actual job duration.
- After the job is created, it runs once at `LaunchTime`. The next execution time is determined by the specified interval.

InstanceIds.N.description_cn:
实例ID列表，最多支持200个ID。您可以调用[DescribeInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70466)接口查询获取实例ID。

- 参数 - N：表示实例的序号。
- 多个Instance ID之间用`&`分隔。
若指定了多台实例，但其中存在实例不满足执行条件时（例如：实例处于关机等不可用状态），都需要重新指定。
InstanceIds.N.description_en:
Instance ID list, supporting up to 200 IDs. You can use the [DescribeInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70466) API to query and obtain Instance IDs.

- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the instance
- Separate multiple Instance IDs with `&`
If you specify multiple instances and any instance does not meet the execution conditions (for example, the instance is shut down or unavailable), you need to specify all instances again.

InvocationDescription.description_cn: 作业描述，默认为空字符串，不超过256个字符。
InvocationDescription.description_en: Job description, defaults to an empty string, up to 256 characters

InvocationName.description_cn:
作业名称。需符合如下规则：

- 不超过64个字符。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线“\_”、中划线“-”、且不能以数字，中划线开头。
- 同地域下作业名称可重复。
InvocationName.description_en:
Job Name. Must follow these rules:

- No more than 64 characters
- Can only include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-); cannot start with a number or hyphen
- Duplicate job names are allowed within the same region

LaunchTime.description_cn:
执行时间。

- `RepeatMode=Rate`时，需按如下格式传入作业首次执行时间：
	- 时间格式：RFC3339，例如：2022-11-07T11:49:13Z。
- `RepeatMode=Fixed`时，需按如下格式传入作业开始执行时间：
	- 时间格式：RFC3339，例如：2022-11-07T11:49:13Z。
LaunchTime.description_en:
Execution time

- For `RepeatMode=Rate`, enter the initial job execution time in the following format:
  - Time format: RFC3339, for example: 2022-11-07T11:49:13Z
- For `RepeatMode=Fixed`, enter the job start time in the following format:
  - Time format: RFC3339, for example: 2022-11-07T11:49:13Z

ParameterDefinitions.N.DecimalPrecision.description_cn:
自定义参数值（数值）允许的小数点后位数。
- `DecimalPrecision`取值范围：0~10。
- `Type=Digit`时必填，且`Required`参数为`true`时默认为`0`。
ParameterDefinitions.N.DecimalPrecision.description_en:
Number of decimal places allowed for custom parameter values (numeric)
- `DecimalPrecision` range: 0–10
- Required when `Type=Digit`; defaults to 0 if `Required` is set to true

ParameterDefinitions.N.DefaultValue.description_cn:
自定义参数默认值。
请根据`Type`参数指定的参数类型，填写相应类型的默认值。
ParameterDefinitions.N.DefaultValue.description_en:
Custom Parameter Default Value
Enter a default value that matches the type specified by the `Type` parameter.

ParameterDefinitions.N.MaxLength.description_cn:
自定义参数值（字符串）的最大长度。
- `MaxLength`取值范围：1~1000。
- `Type=String`时必填，且`Required`参数为`true`时默认为`1000`。
- 本参数值需大于`MinLength`。
ParameterDefinitions.N.MaxLength.description_en:
Maximum length for custom parameter values (string)
- `MaxLength` range: 1–1000
- Required when `Type=String`; defaults to `1000` if `Required` is set to `true`
- Must be greater than `MinLength`

ParameterDefinitions.N.MaxValue.description_cn:
自定义参数值（数值）的最大值。
- `MaxValue`取值范围：-1000000~1000000。
- `Type=Digit`时必填，且`Required`参数为`true`时默认为`1000000`。
- 本参数值需小于`MinValue`。
ParameterDefinitions.N.MaxValue.description_en:
Maximum value for custom parameter (numeric)
- `MaxValue` range: -1,000,000 to 1,000,000
- Required when `Type=Digit`; defaults to `1,000,000` if `Required` is set to true
- This value must be less than `MinValue`

ParameterDefinitions.N.MinLength.description_cn:
自定义参数值（字符串）的最小长度。
- `MinLength`取值范围：1~1000。
- `Type=String`时必填，且`Required`参数为`true`时默认为`1`。
- 本参数值需小于`MaxLength`。
ParameterDefinitions.N.MinLength.description_en:
Minimum length for custom parameter value (string)
- `MinLength` range: 1–1000
- The `MinLength` field is required when `Type=String`; its default value is 1 if `Required` is set to `true`
- This value must be less than `MaxLength`

ParameterDefinitions.N.MinValue.description_cn:
自定义参数值（数值）的最小值。
- `MinValue`取值范围：-1000000~1000000。
- `Type=Digit`时必填，且`Required`参数为`true`时默认为`-1000000`。
- 本参数值需小于`MaxValue`。
ParameterDefinitions.N.MinValue.description_en:
Minimum value for custom parameter (numeric)
- `MinValue` range: -1000000 to 1000000
- Required when `Type=Digit`; defaults to `-1000000` if `Required` is set to `true`
- This value must be less than `MaxValue`

ParameterDefinitions.N.Name.description_cn:
自定义参数名称，需要在脚本中通过{{Param}}定义 。命名规则：

- 单个参数名不能超过64字节。
- 遵循Shell变量命名规则，a-zA-Z0-9-\_的组合。首个字符不能以数字开头。中间不能有空格，可以使用下划线。
ParameterDefinitions.N.Name.description_en:
Custom parameter names must be defined in the script using {{Param}}. Naming rules:

- Each parameter name must not exceed 64 bytes
- Use only letters (a-z, A-Z), numbers (0-9), and underscores (_)
- The first character cannot be a number
- No spaces allowed; use underscores to separate words

ParameterDefinitions.N.Required.description_cn:
自定义参数是否必填。取值：

- true：必填。
- false：非必填。
必填时，需在`Parameters`参数中传入自定义参数值。
ParameterDefinitions.N.Required.description_en:
Is the custom parameter required? Values:

- true: Required
- false: Optional
If required, you must provide a custom parameter value in the `Parameters` field.

ParameterDefinitions.N.Type.description_cn:
自定义参数类型。取值：

- String：表示自定义参数类型为`String`（字符串）类型。
- Digit：表示自定义参数类型为`Digit`（数值）类型。
ParameterDefinitions.N.Type.description_en:
Custom parameter types. Options:

- String: Indicates that the custom parameter type is `String` (string)
- Digit: Indicates that the custom parameter type is `Digit` (numeric)

Parameters.description_cn:
命令中包含自定义参数时，需通过本参数传入自定义参数的键值对。 例如：命令内容为`echo {{name}}`，则可以通过`Parameter`参数传入键值对`{"name":"Jack"}`。自定义参数将自动替换变量值`name`，得到一条新的命令，实际执行的是`echo Jack`。
自定义参数规则如下： - 自定义参数个数范围为0~60。 - Key不允许为空字符串，最多支持64个字符。 - Value允许为空字符串。 - 自定义参数与原始命令内容在Base64编码后，综合长度不能超过16KB。 - 设置的自定义参数名集合必须为创建命令时定义的参数集的子集。对于未传入的参数，使用默认值代替。
Parameters.description_en:
When a command includes custom parameters, use this parameter to provide key-value pairs for those parameters. For example, if the command is `echo {{name}}`, you can pass the key-value pair `{"name":"Jack"}` using the `Parameter` parameter. The custom parameter will automatically replace the variable `name`, resulting in a new command: `echo Jack`.
Custom parameter rules: - You can set 0 to 60 custom parameters - Keys cannot be empty and can be up to 64 characters - Values can be empty - The combined length of the custom parameters and the original command, after Base64 encoding, cannot exceed 16 KB - The set of custom parameter names must be a subset of the parameter set defined when the command was created. Default values will be used for any parameters not provided

ProjectName.description_cn: 资源所属项目，一个资源只能归属于一个项目。
ProjectName.description_en: Project the resource belongs to. Each resource can belong to only one project.

RecurrenceEndTime.description_cn:
周期结束时间，RFC3339 格式。
仅`RepeatMode`为`Rate`（周期执行作业）时需填写。
RecurrenceEndTime.description_en:
Cycle End Time, RFC3339 format
Only required when `RepeatMode` is set to `Rate` (recurring job)

RepeatMode.description_cn:
设置命令执行的方式。取值：

- Once：默认，表示立即执行作业。
- Rate：周期执行作业，需要通过`Frequency`参数传入Rate表达式指定执行周期。
- Fixed：定时执行作业，需要通过`LaunchTime`参数指定的执行时间。
RepeatMode.description_en:
Set how the command is executed. Options:

- Once: Default. Runs the job immediately
- Rate: Runs the job on a recurring schedule. Specify the interval using a Rate expression in the `Frequency` parameter
- Fixed: Runs the job at a scheduled time. Specify the time using the `LaunchTime` parameter

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
用户标签的标签键。
- 参数 - N：表示标签键的序号，取值范围：1～20。
- 多个标签键之间用&分隔。

命名规则如下：
  - 不能以`volc:`或`sys:`的任意大小写组合开头。
  - 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
  - 长度限制在1～128个字符之间。
同一资源的标签键不允许重复。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for user tags
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag keys with &

Naming rules:
  - Cannot start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`
  - Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
  - Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
Tag keys for the same resource must be unique

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
用户标签的标签值。
- 参数 - N：表示标签值的序号，取值范围：1～20。
- 多个标签值之间用&分隔。

命名规则如下：
  - 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
  - 允许为空，长度限制在0～256个字符之间。
如果传入该参数，则必须先传入`Tags.N.Key`。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value for the user tag
- Parameter - N: Indicates the index of the tag value, valid range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag values with &

Naming rules:
  - Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
  - Can be empty; length must be between 0 and 256 characters
If you provide this parameter, you must first provide `Tags.N.Key`.

Timeout.description_cn:
创建的命令在ECS实例中执行时最大的超时时间，单位为**秒**。

- 取值范围：30 ~ 86400。
- 默认值：60。
超时后，会强制终止命令进程。
Timeout.description_en:
Maximum timeout for the created command when executed on an ECS instance, in **seconds**

- Range: 30–86400
- Default: 60
If the timeout is reached, the command process will be forcibly terminated

Type.description_cn:
命令的类型。取值：

- Shell：表示创建一个在Linux实例中运行的Shell脚本。
- Python：表示创建一个Python脚本。
- Bat：表示创建一个Bat脚本。
- PowerShell：表示创建一个PowerShell脚本。
Type.description_en:
Command type. Available values:

- Shell: Create a Shell script that runs on a Linux Instance
- Python: Create a Python script
- Bat: Create a Bat script
- PowerShell: Create a PowerShell script

Username.description_cn:
执行命令时的用户名。
默认值：root。

WorkingDir.description_cn: 创建的命令在ECS实例中运行的目录。Linux实例默认为`/home`。
WorkingDir.description_en: Directory where the created command runs in the ECS instance. The default for Linux instances is `/home`.

AffinityGroupSize.description_cn:
亲和组规格，取值：2。
- 当前仅高性能计算NPU型hpcpci3实例（邀测）支持亲和组。
- 该功能正在邀测中，如需试用，请联系客户经理申请。
AffinityGroupSize.description_en:
Affinity group specification, value: 2
- Currently, only high-performance computing NPU type hpcpci3 Instances (invite-only beta) support affinity groups
- This feature is in invite-only beta. To request access, please contact your account manager

AutoRenew.description_cn:
实例到期后是否自动续费，取值：
- true：自动续费。
- false（默认）：不自动续费。
仅当参数`InstanceChargeType`取值为`PrePaid`时生效。
AutoRenew.description_en:
Whether the instance is automatically renewed after expiration. Values:
- true: Auto-renew
- false (default): Do not auto-renew
This parameter takes effect only when `InstanceChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`.

AutoRenewPeriod.description_cn:
每次自动续费的时长。
- 仅当参数`AutoRenew`取值为`True`时，该参数生效，默认值为1。
- `PeriodUnit`取值为`Month`时，该参数取值为1、2、3、6、12。
AutoRenewPeriod.description_en:
Duration of each auto-renewal
- This parameter takes effect only when `AutoRenew` is set to `True`; the default value is 1
- When `PeriodUnit` is set to `Month`, this parameter can be set to 1, 2, 3, 6, or 12

ClientToken.description_cn:
保证请求幂等性。由客户端自动生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一，避免当调用API超时或服务器内部错误时，客户端多次重试导致重复性操作。
取值：仅支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a parameter value that must be unique among different requests. This prevents duplicate operations if the client retries due to an API timeout or server error. Value: Only ASCII characters are supported and the value cannot exceed 64 characters.

Count.description_cn: 创建数量，取值范围：1～100；传入0时，会默认为1。
Count.description_en: Quantity (range: 1–100); if set to 0, defaults to 1

CpuMaxFrequency.description_cn:
指定CPU最大频率，单位：GHz，取值范围：CPU的主频到睿频之间。
- 当前仅g3al（4xlarge、8xlarge、16xlarge、32xlarge）、c3al（4xlarge、8xlarge、16xlarge、32xlarge）、r3al（4xlarge、8xlarge、16xlarge）、g4i、c4i、r4i、g4ie、c4ie、r4ie实例支持设置该参数。规格的主频/睿频及更多信息，请参见[实例规格介绍](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70840)。
- 该功能正在邀测中，如需使用，请联系客户经理申请。
CpuMaxFrequency.description_en:
Specify the maximum CPU frequency in GHz. Valid range: from the CPU's base frequency to turbo frequency.
- Currently, only g3al (4xlarge, 8xlarge, 16xlarge, 32xlarge), c3al (4xlarge, 8xlarge, 16xlarge, 32xlarge), r3al (4xlarge, 8xlarge, 16xlarge), g4i, c4i, r4i, g4ie, c4ie, and r4ie Instances support this parameter. For details on base/turbo frequency and more information, see [Instance specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70840).
- This feature is currently in invite-only testing. To use it, please contact your account manager to apply.

CpuOptions.TopologyType.description_cn:
CPU拓扑模式。取值：
- ContinuousCoreToHTMapping：HT连续模式。
- DiscreteCoreToHTMapping（默认值）：HT离散模式。
- 该功能正在邀测中，如需使用，请联系客户经理申请。
CpuOptions.TopologyType.description_en:
CPU topology mode. Values:
- ContinuousCoreToHTMapping: HT continuous mode
- DiscreteCoreToHTMapping (default): HT discrete mode
- This feature is currently in invitation-only beta. To use it, please contact your account manager to apply.

CreditSpecification.description_cn:
突发性能实例的运行模式，取值：
- Standard：标准模式。
- Unlimited：无性能约束模式（暂不支持）。
- 仅当`InstanceTypeId`取值为ecs.t2系列，即突发性能实例时该参数生效。
- 不传或传入空值时，突发性能实例默认为`Standard`标准模式。
CreditSpecification.description_en:
Operating mode for burstable performance instances. Valid values:
- Standard: Standard mode
- Unlimited: No performance constraints (not supported yet)
- This parameter takes effect only when `InstanceTypeId` is set to an ecs.t2 series, that is, a burstable performance Instance.
- If not specified or left empty, the burstable performance Instance defaults to Standard mode.

DeletionProtection.description_cn:
实例删除保护属性，指定是否支持通过控制台或API删除实例。取值：
- true：开启实例删除保护。
- false（默认）：关闭实例删除保护。
DeletionProtection.description_en:
Instance deletion protection attribute. Specifies whether deletion of the instance through the console or API is allowed. Values:
- true: Enable instance deletion protection
- false (default): Disable instance deletion protection

DeploymentSetGroupNumber.description_cn: 当ECS实例要加入或调整的部署集策略为部署集组高可用策略（AvailabilityGroup）时，可以通过该参数指定实例在部署集中的分组号，取值范围：1～7。
DeploymentSetGroupNumber.description_en: When an ECS instance is to join or adjust its deployment set policy to AvailabilityGroup, you can use this parameter to specify the instance's group number within the deployment set. Valid values: 1 to 7

DeploymentSetId.description_cn: 实例需要加入的部署集ID。
DeploymentSetId.description_en: Deployment set ID the instance needs to join

Description.description_cn:
实例的描述，默认为空字符串。
- 必须以字母或中文开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、点号“.”、空格、下划线“_”、中划线“-”、等号“=”、英文逗号“,”、中文逗号“，”和中文句号“。”
- 长度限制在255个字符以内。
Description.description_en:
Instance description (default: empty string)
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Can only include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, period (.), space, underscore (_), hyphen (-), equals sign (=), English comma (,), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)
- Maximum length: 255 characters

DryRun.description_cn:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
- true：发送检查请求，不会创建实例。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制和ECS库存。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码DryRunOperation。
    当`DryRun`取值为`true`时，若传入了`Count`或`Mincount`参数，则取值必须为1。
  
- false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建实例。
DryRun.description_en:
Whether to perform a dry run for this request. Valid values:
- true: Sends a validation request without creating an Instance. The validation checks required parameters, request format, business limits, and ECS inventory. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, the error code DryRunOperation is returned.
    When `DryRun` is set to `true`, if you specify the `Count` or `Mincount` parameter, the value must be 1.
  
- false (default): Sends a normal request. If the check passes, the Instance is created directly.

EipAddress.BandwidthMbps.description_cn:
公网IP的带宽上限，默认值为1，单位：Mbps。
- `ChargeType`传入`PayByBandwidth`：取值范围1～500。
- `ChargeType`传入`PayByTraffic`：取值范围1～200。
EipAddress.BandwidthMbps.description_en:
Maximum bandwidth for public IP. Default value: 1. Unit: Mbps
- When `ChargeType` is set to `PayByBandwidth`: range is 1–500
- When `ChargeType` is set to `PayByTraffic`: range is 1–200

EipAddress.BandwidthPackageId.description_cn:
共享带宽包的ID，表示将公网IP加入到共享带宽包。
- 您可以调用[DescribeBandwidthPackages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6623/100685)接口，查询共享带宽包的ID。
- 公网IP加入到共享带宽包必须同时满足如下条件：
  - 二者的安全防护类型相同。
  - 二者的地域相同。
  - 公网IP的计费方式必须是按量计费。
  - 共享带宽包为IPv4类型。
EipAddress.BandwidthPackageId.description_en:
The ID of the shared bandwidth package, required when adding a public IP to a shared bandwidth package
- You can call the [DescribeBandwidthPackages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6623/100685) API to query the shared bandwidth package ID
- To add a public IP to a shared bandwidth package, the following conditions must be met:
  - Both must have the same security protection type
  - Both must be in the same region
  - The public IP must use pay-as-you-go billing
  - The shared bandwidth package must be of IPv4 type

EipAddress.ChargeType.description_cn:
公网IP的计费方式，取值：
- PayByBandwidth（默认）：按量计费-按带宽上限计费。
- PayByTraffic：按量计费-按实际流量计费。
- PrePaid：包年包月。
实例的计费类型`InstanceChargeType`取值为`PostPaid`时，该参数取值不能为`PrePaid`。
EipAddress.ChargeType.description_en:
Billing methods for public IP addresses:
- PayByBandwidth (default): Pay-as-you-go—billed by bandwidth cap
- PayByTraffic: Pay-as-you-go—billed by actual data transfer
- PrePaid: Subscription (monthly or yearly)
When the instance billing type (`InstanceChargeType`) is set to `PostPaid`, this parameter cannot be set to `PrePaid`.

EipAddress.ISP.description_cn:
公网IP的线路类型，默认为BGP。取值：
- BGP：BGP（多线）。
- 若您的账号已申请并开通了静态单线权限，则可传入如下取值：
  - ChinaMobile：中国移动静态单线。
  - ChinaTelecom：中国电信静态单线。
  - ChinaUnicom：中国联通静态单线。
- 若您的账号已申请并开通了BGP单线权限，则可传入SingleLine_BGP。
- 若您的账号已申请并开通了静态BGP权限，则可传入Static_BGP。
EipAddress.ISP.description_en:
Public IP line type. Default is BGP. Available values:
- BGP: BGP (multi-line)
- If your account has applied for and enabled static single line, you can use:
  - ChinaMobile: China Mobile static single line
  - ChinaTelecom: China Telecom static single line
  - ChinaUnicom: China Unicom static single line
- If your account has applied for and enabled BGP single line, you can use SingleLine_BGP
- If your account has applied for and enabled static BGP, you can use Static_BGP

EipAddress.ReleaseWithInstance.description_cn:
公网IP是否随实例删除，仅按量计费公网IP生效。取值：
-  true：公网IP随实例删除。当实例被系统自动回收（退订24小时后、到期回收等）或被调用[DeleteInstance](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70465)、[DeleteInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/101070)接口删除时，公网IP随实例一同释放。
- false（默认）：公网IP不随实例删除。
EipAddress.ReleaseWithInstance.description_en:
Whether the public IP is released with the Instance. Only applies to pay-as-you-go public IPs. Options:
- true: The public IP is released with the Instance. When the Instance is automatically recycled (such as 24 hours after unsubscription or upon expiration) or deleted using the [DeleteInstance](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70465) or [DeleteInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/101070) APIs, the public IP is released together with the Instance
- false (default): The public IP is not released with the Instance

EipAddress.SecurityProtectionInstanceId.description_cn:
DDoS原生防护（企业版）ID。
- 您可以调用[DescInstanceList](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6352/1263659)接口，查询DDoS原生防护（企业版）的ID。
- 当`SecurityProtectionTypes`传入`AntiDDoS_Enhanced`时，此参数必须传入。
EipAddress.SecurityProtectionInstanceId.description_en:
DDoS Native Protection (Enterprise Edition) ID
- You can call the [DescInstanceList](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6352/1263659) API to query the DDoS Native Protection (Enterprise Edition) ID
- When `SecurityProtectionTypes` is set to `AntiDDoS_Enhanced`, this parameter is required

EipAddress.SecurityProtectionTypes.N.description_cn:
公网IP的安全防护类型。
- 参数 - N：表示安全防护类型的序号，当前仅支持取1。
- 取值：
   - AntiDDoS_Enhanced：申请增强防护类型的公网IP，可加入到DDoS原生防护（企业版）实例。
          - 若`EipAddress.SecurityProtectionTypes.N`传入`AntiDDoS_Enhanced`，则`EipAddress.ChargeType`不能为`PrePaid`，且`EipAddress.ISP`必须传入`BGP`。
     - 增强防护类型公网IP正在邀测中，如需试用，请联系客户经理申请。
     
   - 不填则表示申请默认防护类型的公网IP。
EipAddress.SecurityProtectionTypes.N.description_en:
Security protection types for public IP addresses
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the security protection type. Currently, only 1 is supported
- Values:
   - AntiDDoS_Enhanced: Apply for a public IP address with enhanced protection, which can be added to a DDoS Native Protection (Enterprise Edition) Instance
          - If `EipAddress.SecurityProtectionTypes.N` is set to `AntiDDoS_Enhanced`, `EipAddress.ChargeType` cannot be `PrePaid`, and `EipAddress.ISP` must be set to `BGP`
     - Enhanced protection public IP addresses are currently available by invitation only. To request access, please contact your account manager
     
   - Leave blank to request a public IP address with default protection

EnablePrimaryInterfaceHighBandwidthType.description_cn:
主网卡是否支持大带宽类型。取值：
- true：支持。
- false（默认）：不支持。
EnablePrimaryInterfaceHighBandwidthType.description_en:
Does the primary network interface card support high bandwidth types? Values:
- true: Supported
- false (default): Not supported

Hostname.description_cn:
实例主机名，即实例操作系统内部的计算机名。
- Linux实例：
  - 允许使用字母、数字、点号“.”或中划线“-”。
  - 不能以中划线、点号开头或结尾，且不能连续使用中划线和点号。
  - Linux系统长度限制在2～63个字符之间。

- Windows实例：
  - 允许使用字母、数字或中划线“-”，不能完全是数字。
  - 不能以中划线开头或结尾，且不能连续使用中划线。
  - Windows系统长度限制在2～15个字符之间。

- 如不填，则遵循 iv- + 初始主机名 规则自动生成，例如
iv-3tigy72q3u3vj0******。
- 初始主机名生成逻辑：
  - Linux：提取实例IDi-之后的全部字符。
  - Windows：提取实例IDi-之后的后12位字符。

- 批量创建实例时，支持使用`name_prefix[begin_number,bits]name_suffix`格式自定义设置有序主机名，具体操作请参见[批量设置有序的实例名称或主机名称](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/81260)。
Hostname.description_en:
The instance hostname is the computer name used within the instance's operating system.
- Linux instance:
  - Letters, numbers, periods ("."), and hyphens ("-") are allowed
  - Cannot start or end with a hyphen or period
  - Cannot use hyphens or periods consecutively, or use a hyphen and period together
  - Length must be between 2 and 63 characters

- Windows instance:
  - Letters, numbers, and hyphens ("-") are allowed; cannot be all numbers
  - Cannot start or end with a hyphen, and cannot use hyphens consecutively
  - Length must be between 2 and 15 characters

- If left blank, the hostname is automatically generated using the rule iv- + initial hostname, for example: iv-3tigy72q3u3vj0******
- Initial hostname generation logic:
  - Linux: Extract all characters after 'i-' in the instance ID
  - Windows: Extract the last 12 characters after 'i-' in the instance ID

- When creating instances in batches, you can customize sequential hostnames using the format `name_prefix[begin_number,bits]name_suffix`. For details, see [Batch set sequential instance names or hostnames](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/81260)

HpcClusterId.description_cn:
实例所属的高性能计算集群ID。
仅当创建高性能计算GPU型实例时，该参数生效且为必填项。
HpcClusterId.description_en:
High-performance computing cluster ID of the instance
This parameter is required and only applies when creating a high-performance computing GPU instance

HttpTokens.description_cn:
实例元数据的访问模式，是否强制使用加固模式。取值：
- optional（默认）：不强制使用（兼容模式），指既可以通过普通方式直接访问实例元数据，也可以通过基于token鉴权的加固方式进行访问。
- required：强制使用（仅加固模式），即仅支持基于token鉴权的加固方式访问实例元数据。
- 关于元数据的查看方式以及支持查看的元数据项，请参见[查看实例元数据](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/113780)。
- 仅加固模式正在邀测中，如需试用，请联系客户经理申请。
HttpTokens.description_en:
Access mode for instance metadata. Specify whether to enforce hardened mode. Values:
- optional (default): Not enforced (compatibility mode). You can access instance metadata either directly or using the hardened method with token-based authentication.
- required: Enforced (hardened mode only). Only access via the hardened method with token-based authentication is supported.
- For details on how to view metadata and which metadata items are supported, see [View Instance Metadata](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/113780)
- The "hardened mode only" option is currently in invite-only testing. To request access, contact your account manager

ImageId.description_cn:
启动实例时使用的镜像ID。
您可以调用[DescribeImages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70808)接口，在`InstanceTypeId`参数中传入期望创建的实例规格ID，查询支持该规格使用的镜像及其ID信息。
ImageId.description_en:
Image ID used to launch the instance
You can call the [DescribeImages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70808) API and enter the desired instance type ID in the `InstanceTypeId` parameter to query supported images and their IDs for that instance type

ImageReleaseVersion.description_cn:
使用的镜像具体版本号。
- 该参数仅选用公共镜像时生效。
- 若为空，将使用镜像的最新版本。
ImageReleaseVersion.description_en:
Specific image version number
- This parameter only applies when selecting a public image
- If left blank, the latest version of the image will be used

InstallRunCommandAgent.description_cn:
创建实例时是否安装云助手Agent，取值：
- true：创建时安装。
- false（默认）：创建时不安装。
有关云助手的更多信息请参见[云助手概述](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/129236)。
InstallRunCommandAgent.description_en:
Whether to install Cloud Assistant Agent when creating the instance:
- true: Install during creation
- false (default): Do not install during creation
For more information about Cloud Assistant, see [Cloud Assistant Overview](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/129236).

InstanceChargeType.description_cn:
实例和云盘的计费类型，取值：
- PostPaid：按量计费。
- PrePaid：包年包月。请确认您的账号支持余额支付或者信控支付，否则将返回InvalidInstanceChargeType的错误提示。
InstanceChargeType.description_en:
Billing types for instances and cloud disks:
- PostPaid: Pay-as-you-go
- PrePaid: Subscription (yearly or monthly)
Make sure your account supports balance payment or credit payment. Otherwise, you will receive an InvalidInstanceChargeType error message.

InstanceName.description_cn:
实例的名称。
- 以字母或中文开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线“_”、中划线“-”和点号“.”。
- 长度限制为1～128个字符。
 - 若实例已设置`SuffixIndex`有序后缀，则实例名称长度包含有序后缀。
- 批量创建实例时，支持使用`name_prefix[begin_number,bits]name_suffix`格式自定义设置有序实例名称，具体操作请参见[批量设置有序的实例名称或主机名称](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/81260)。
InstanceName.description_en:
Instance Name
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.)
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
- If the instance uses an ordered suffix with `SuffixIndex`, the instance name length includes the ordered suffix
- When creating instances in bulk, you can use the format `name_prefix[begin_number,bits]name_suffix` to customize ordered instance names. For details, see [Set Ordered Instance or Host Names in Bulk](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/81260)

InstanceTypeId.description_cn:
实例规格。
- 产品选型：您可以参考[实例规格介绍](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70840)或者调用[DescribeInstanceTypes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/92769)查看实例规格的性能数据，也可以参考[实例选型最佳实践](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/74174)了解如何选择实例规格。
- 查询库存：您可以调用[DescribeAvailableResource](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/76279)查询可用区中计算资源的库存信息。
InstanceTypeId.description_en:
Instance Specifications
- Product selection: You can refer to the [Instance Specifications Overview](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70840) or call [DescribeInstanceTypes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/92769) to view performance data for each instance specification. For guidance on how to choose an instance specification, see [Best Practices for Instance Selection](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/74174).
- Check inventory: You can call [DescribeAvailableResource](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/76279) to view the available compute resource inventory in each availability zone.

KeepImageCredential.description_cn:
是否保留镜像设置，取值：
- true：保留镜像设置，保留后将使用镜像预设的密码或密钥对登录实例。
- false（默认）：不保留镜像设置。
- 仅自定义镜像、共享镜像支持该功能。
- 该参数取值为`true`时，请勿传入`PassWord`和`KeyPairName`。
KeepImageCredential.description_en:
Retain image settings. Options:
- true: Retain image settings. The instance will use the preset password or key pair from the image for login.
- false (default): Do not retain image settings.
- Only custom images and shared images support this feature.
- When this parameter is set to `true`, do not specify `PassWord` or `KeyPairName`.

KeyPairName.description_cn:
如需使用“SSH密钥”方式登录实例，请指定已创建密钥对的名称。
您可以调用[DescribeKeyPairs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/120446)查看已创建的密钥对；如无可用，请调用[CreateKeyPair](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/120445)创建密钥对。
- Windows实例不支持SSH密钥方式，即使传入了该参数，仍旧只生效密码`Password`。
- Linux实例支持密码或密钥对登录。调用该接口时如果同时设置了密钥对`KeyPairName`和密码`Password`，则仅生效密钥对`KeyPairName`。
KeyPairName.description_en:
To log in to an Instance using SSH key authentication, specify the name of an existing key pair.
You can call [DescribeKeyPairs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/120446) to view existing key pairs. If none are available, call [CreateKeyPair](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/120445) to create a key pair.
- Windows Instances do not support SSH key authentication. Even if you provide this parameter, only the password (`Password`) will be used.
- Linux Instances support login with either a password or a key pair. If you set both `KeyPairName` and `Password` when calling this API, only the key pair (`KeyPairName`) will be used.

MinCount.description_cn:
指定ECS实例最小创建数量，取值范围：1～100。
- 实例最小创建数量`MinCount` ≤ 创建数量`Count`。
- 当库存数量 > 创建数量`Count`，按`Count`创建。
- 当最小创建数量`MinCount` ≤ 库存数量 ≤ 创建数量`Count`，按库存数量创建。
- 当库存数量 < 最小创建数量`MinCount`，会因库存不足而创建失败。
MinCount.description_en:
Set the minimum number of ECS instances to create (range: 1–100)
- The minimum instance creation count (MinCount) must be less than or equal to the creation count (Count)
- If available stock > creation count (Count), create Count instances
- If minimum creation count (MinCount) ≤ available stock ≤ creation count (Count), create the number of instances equal to the available stock
- If available stock < minimum creation count (MinCount), creation fails due to insufficient stock

NetworkInterfaces.N.Ipv6AddressCount.description_cn:
为主网卡分配的私网IPv6地址数量，仅支持取1。
- 传入该参数，系统会自动从网卡所属子网中，分配相应数量的空闲私网IPv6地址，作为网卡的私网IPv6地址。
- 创建实例时仅支持为主网卡分配IPv6地址，若要为辅助网卡分配IPv6地址，可参考 [CreateNetworkInterface](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70758)。
- 参数 - N：表示网卡的序号，N = 1表示主网卡；N ≥ 2表示辅助网卡，故传入N ≥ 2时，该参数将被忽略。
为网卡分配IPv6地址正在邀测中，暂仅支持完成 [企业认证](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6261/64937)的账号申请试用，如需试用，请联系客户经理。
NetworkInterfaces.N.Ipv6AddressCount.description_en:
Number of private IPv6 addresses assigned to the primary network interface card. Only 1 is supported
- When you specify this parameter, the system automatically assigns the same number of available private IPv6 addresses from the subnet to the network interface card, and uses them as its private IPv6 addresses
- You can only assign IPv6 addresses to the primary network interface card when creating an instance. To assign IPv6 addresses to an auxiliary network interface card, see [CreateNetworkInterface](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70758)
- Parameter - N: Indicates the index of the network interface card. N = 1 refers to the primary network interface card; N ≥ 2 refers to an auxiliary network interface card. If you specify N ≥ 2, this parameter will be ignored
Assigning IPv6 addresses to network interface cards is currently in invite-only testing. Only accounts that have completed [enterprise verification](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6261/64937) can apply for a trial. To request access, contact your account manager

NetworkInterfaces.N.PrimaryIpAddress.description_cn:
指定网卡的主IP地址，当前仅支持为主网卡或辅助网卡指定一个主IP地址。
- 参数 - N：表示网卡的序号，N = 1表示主网卡；N ≥ 2表示辅助网卡。
- 多个网卡之间用&分隔。
NetworkInterfaces.N.PrimaryIpAddress.description_en:
Specify the primary IP address for a network interface. Currently, you can specify only one primary IP address, either for the primary network interface or for a secondary network interface.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the interface number. N = 1 refers to the primary network interface; N ≥ 2 refers to secondary network interfaces.
- Use & to separate multiple interfaces

NetworkInterfaces.N.PrivateIpAddresses.N.description_cn:
指定主网卡的辅助IP地址，当前只支持主网卡指定辅助IP。
- 第一个N：表示主网卡的序号，当前仅支持绑定一张主网卡。
- 第二个N：表示主网卡的辅助IP序号，最多可分配的辅助IP地址的数量为该[实例规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70840)的单网卡私有IP数减去一个主私网IP。
- 多个辅助IP之间用&分隔。
NetworkInterfaces.N.PrivateIpAddresses.N.description_en:
Specify the secondary IP addresses for the primary network interface card. Currently, only the primary NIC supports assigning secondary IPs.
- The first N indicates the index of the primary NIC. Only one primary NIC can be bound at this time.
- The second N indicates the index of the secondary IP on the primary NIC. The maximum number of secondary IP addresses you can assign is the number of private IPs supported by the [Instance specification](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70840) for a single NIC, minus one primary private IP.
- Separate multiple secondary IPs with &.

NetworkInterfaces.N.SecurityGroupIds.N.description_cn:
网卡关联的安全组ID。
- 第一个N：表示网卡的序号，N = 1表示主网卡；N ≥ 2表示辅助网卡。
- 第二个N：表示网卡关联的安全组的序号，取值范围：1～5。
- 多个安全组ID之间用&分隔。
NetworkInterfaces.N.SecurityGroupIds.N.description_en:
Security group ID associated with the network interface card.
- The first N indicates the NIC sequence number. N = 1 means the primary NIC; N ≥ 2 means secondary NICs.
- The second N indicates the sequence number of the security group associated with the NIC. Valid values: 1–5.
- Use & to separate multiple security group IDs.

NetworkInterfaces.N.SubnetId.description_cn:
实例的私有网络子网ID，创建实例时，支持同时绑定辅助网卡。
- 参数 - N：表示网卡的序号，N = 1表示主网卡；N ≥ 2表示辅助网卡。
- 多个私有网络子网ID之间用&分隔。
NetworkInterfaces.N.SubnetId.description_en:
Private network subnet ID for the Instance. When creating an Instance, you can also bind secondary network interfaces.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the network interface index. N = 1 indicates the primary network interface; N ≥ 2 indicates secondary network interfaces.
- Separate multiple private network subnet IDs with &.

NetworkOptions.EnableJumboFrame.description_cn:
实例是否开启巨型帧。取值：
- false：不开启巨型帧，该实例的所有网卡MTU值为1500。
- true：开启巨型帧，该实例的所有网卡MTU值为8500。
该功能仅支持部分实例，支持巨型帧的实例请参见[开启/关闭巨型帧](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1217639)。
NetworkOptions.EnableJumboFrame.description_en:
Whether the Instance enables jumbo frames. Values:
- false: Jumbo frames are disabled. All network interfaces of this Instance have an MTU value of 1500.
- true: Jumbo frames are enabled. All network interfaces of this Instance have an MTU value of 8500.
This feature is only supported for certain Instances. For Instances that support jumbo frames, see [Enable/Disable Jumbo Frames](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1217639).

Password.description_cn:
如需使用“密码”方式登录实例，请通过该参数指定实例的管理员账号初始登录密码。其中Linux管理员账号为root，Windows管理员账号为Administrator。
密码复杂度要求如下：
- 长度限制在8～30之间。
- 密码只能由大写字母、小写字母、数字和特殊字符组成，且必须包含至少三项。
- 特殊字符可以使用：`~!@#$%^&*()_-+=|{}[]:;'<>,.?/
- 不能以“/”和“$6$”开头。
登录凭证支持“密码”、“密钥对”、“保留镜像设置”三种方式，使用“密码”方式登录实例时，建议增加密码复杂度以提高安全性。
Password.description_en:
To log in to the Instance using the password method, specify the initial login password for the administrator account with this parameter. The Linux administrator account is root, and the Windows administrator account is Administrator.
Password complexity requirements:
- Length must be between 8 and 30 characters
- Passwords can only contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters, and must include at least three of these types
- Allowed special characters: `~!@#$%^&*()_-+=|{}[]:;'<>,.?/
- Passwords cannot start with "/" or "$6$"
Login credentials support three methods: password, key pair, and reserved image settings. When logging in to the Instance using a password, we recommend increasing password complexity to enhance security.

Period.description_cn:
购买资源的时长（月）。
- 取值：1、2、3、4、5、6、7、8、9、12、24、36、48、60
- 默认值：1
仅当参数`InstanceChargeType`取值为`PrePaid`时，该参数生效且为必选值。
Period.description_en:
Resource purchase duration (months)
- Allowed values: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 24, 36, 48, 60
- Default value: 1
This parameter is required and only takes effect when `InstanceChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`.

PeriodUnit.description_cn:
购买资源的时长单位，取值：Month（默认）。
仅当`InstanceChargeType`取值为`PrePaid`时，该参数生效且为必选值。
PeriodUnit.description_en:
Duration unit for purchasing resources. Value: Month (default).
This parameter is valid and required only when `InstanceChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`.

Placement.Affinity.description_cn:
针对节省停机模式的ECS实例，停止后会释放部分资源，本参数用于选择专有宿主机实例重新启动时是否仍固定部署在原宿主机上。取值：

- Host：启用节省停机模式的实例重新启动时，仍会部署在原宿主机上。

- Default（默认）：启用节省停机模式的实例重新启动时，会优先迁移到支持自动部署的宿主机；若支持自动部署的宿主机资源不足，则在原宿主机上进行启动。
Placement.Affinity.description_en:
For ECS instances in stopped with savings mode, some resources are released after the instance stops. This parameter lets you choose whether to redeploy the instance on the original dedicated host when restarting. Options:

- Host: When you restart an instance in stopped with savings mode, it is redeployed on the original dedicated host
- Default (default): When you restart an instance in stopped with savings mode, the instance is first migrated to a dedicated host that supports auto-deployment if resources are available; if not, it starts on the original dedicated host

Placement.DedicatedHostClusterId.description_cn:
实例所在的专有宿主机集群ID。
您可以调用[DescribeDedicatedHostClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1253698)接口查询宿主机集群ID。
Placement.DedicatedHostClusterId.description_en:
Dedicated host cluster ID where the instance resides
You can call the [DescribeDedicatedHostClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1253698) API to query the host cluster ID

Placement.DedicatedHostId.description_cn:
实例所在的专有宿主机ID。
您可以调用[DescribeDedicatedHosts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1253691)接口查询专有宿主机列表。
Placement.DedicatedHostId.description_en:
Dedicated host ID where the instance resides
Call the [DescribeDedicatedHosts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1253691) API to query the list of dedicated hosts

Placement.Tenancy.description_cn:
是否在专有宿主机上创建实例，取值：
- Default（默认）：创建普通云服务器实例。
- Host：创建专有宿主机实例。若您不指定`Placement.DedicatedHostId`，则由系统自动选择专有宿主机放置实例。
专有宿主机上支持创建的实例规格请参见[规格介绍](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1253643)。
Placement.Tenancy.description_en:
Whether to create an instance on a dedicated host. Options:
- Default: Create a standard cloud server instance
- Host: Create an instance on a dedicated host. If you do not specify `Placement.DedicatedHostId`, the system will automatically select a dedicated host for the instance
For supported instance types on dedicated hosts, see [Instance Types](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1253643)

PrimaryNetworkInterfacePciBus.description_cn:
指定主网卡pci bus，默认为空
取值范围：0
PrimaryNetworkInterfacePciBus.description_en:
Specify primary NIC PCI bus (default: empty)
Value range: 0

ProjectName.description_cn:
资源所属项目，一个资源只能归属于一个项目。
- 只能包含字母、数字、下划线“_”、点“.”和中划线“-”。
- 长度限制在64个字符以内。
ProjectName.description_en: Project to which the resource belongs. Each resource can belong to only one project. Use only letters, numbers, underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-). Maximum length: 64 characters.

SecurityEnhancementStrategy.description_cn:
是否开启安全加固，取值：
- Active：开启安全加固，仅对公共镜像生效。
- InActive：关闭安全加固，对所有镜像类型生效。
SecurityEnhancementStrategy.description_en:
Whether to enable security hardening. Values:
- Active: Enable security hardening; applies to public images only
- Inactive: Disable security hardening; applies to all image types

SpotPriceLimit.description_cn:
抢占式实例的每小时最高价格，支持最大3位小数。
仅当`SpotStrategy`取值为`SpotWithPriceLimit`时，该参数生效。
SpotPriceLimit.description_en:
Maximum hourly price for spot instances, supports up to three decimal places
This parameter takes effect only when `SpotStrategy` is set to `SpotWithPriceLimit`

SpotStrategy.description_cn:
按量计费实例的抢占式策略，取值：
- NoSpot（默认）：表示创建正常按量计费实例。
- SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格的抢占式实例。
- SpotWithPriceLimit：设置出价上限的抢占式实例。
- 当`InstanceChargeType`取值为`PostPaid`时，该参数生效。
- 抢占式实例的出价模式请参见[购买抢占式实例](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/155935)。
SpotStrategy.description_en:
Preemptible strategy for pay-as-you-go Instances. Valid values:
- NoSpot (default): Creates a standard pay-as-you-go Instance
- SpotAsPriceGo: System sets the bid automatically based on the current market price for a preemptible Instance
- SpotWithPriceLimit: Preemptible Instance with a custom bid price limit
- This parameter takes effect only when `InstanceChargeType` is set to `PostPaid`
- For details on preemptible Instance bidding modes, see [Purchase Preemptible Instances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/155935)

SuffixIndex.description_cn: 有序后缀的起始序号，取值：1～999，默认值为1。
SuffixIndex.description_en: Starting number for ordered suffix. Range: 1–999, default: 1

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
用户标签的标签键。
- 参数 - N：表示标签键的序号，取值范围：1～20。
- 多个标签键之间用&分隔。

命名规则如下：
  - 不能以`volc:`或`sys:`的任意大小写组合开头。
  - 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
  - 长度限制在1～128个字符之间。
同一资源的标签键不允许重复。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for user tags
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag keys with &

Naming rules:
  - Cannot start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`
  - Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
  - Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
Tag keys for the same resource must be unique

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
用户标签的标签值。
- 参数 - N：表示标签值的序号，取值范围：1～20。
- 多个标签值之间用&分隔。

命名规则如下：
  - 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
  - 允许为空，长度限制在0～256个字符之间。
如果传入该参数，则必须先传入`Tags.N.Key`。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value for user tags
- Parameter - N: Indicates the index of the tag value, range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag values with &

Naming rules:
  - Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
  - Can be empty; length must be between 0 and 256 characters
If you pass this parameter, you must first pass `Tags.N.Key`

UniqueSuffix.description_cn:
表示当创建多台实例时，是否为`Hostname`和`InstanceName`自动添加有序后缀，取值：
- true：开启有序后缀。
- false（默认）：关闭有序后缀。
- 开启有序后缀时，若`Hostname`为空，系统将自动生成主机名，主机名后无有序后缀。
- 开启有序后缀时，若为`Hostname`、`InstanceName`指定了`[begin_number,bits]`命名格式，则最终生效情况请参见[批量设置有序的实例名称或主机名称](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/81260)。
UniqueSuffix.description_en:
Indicates whether to automatically add a sequential suffix to `Hostname` and `InstanceName` when creating multiple Instances. Values:
- true: Enable sequential suffix
- false (default): Disable sequential suffix
- When sequential suffix is enabled and `Hostname` is empty, the system will automatically generate a hostname without a sequential suffix.
- When sequential suffix is enabled and you specify the `[begin_number,bits]` naming format for `Hostname` or `InstanceName`, see [Batch set sequential instance names or hostnames](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/81260) for details on the final result.

UserData.description_cn:
实例自定义数据。设置的自定义数据必须经过Base64编码，且Base64编码前的自定义数据大小不能超过16KB。
不填则默认为空。
UserData.description_en: Instance custom data. Custom data must be Base64-encoded and cannot exceed 16KB before encoding. If left blank, defaults to empty

Volumes.N.BurstEnabled.description_cn:
是否为云盘开启 Burst（性能突发）功能。
- ture：开启。
- false（默认）：不开启。
Volumes.N.BurstEnabled.description_en:
Enable Burst (performance burst) feature for cloud disk?
- true: Enabled
- false (default): Not enabled

Volumes.N.DeleteWithInstance.description_cn:
云盘是否随实例释放，取值：
- true（默认）：云盘随实例释放。
- false：云盘不随实例释放。
- 参数 - N：表示云盘的序号，取值范围：1～16。N = 1表示系统盘，系统盘默认随实例释放，不可保留；N ≥ 2表示数据盘，可选择是否随实例释放。
- 多个云盘之间用&分隔。
Volumes.N.DeleteWithInstance.description_en:
Whether the cloud disk is released with the instance. Options:
- true (default): The cloud disk is released with the instance
- false: The cloud disk is not released with the instance
- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk number, valid range: 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk, which is always released with the instance and cannot be retained. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks, which can be set to release with the instance or not
- Use & to separate multiple cloud disks

Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceIOPS.description_cn:
云盘额外IOPS性能大小，仅ESSD FlexPL数据盘支持，单位为次/秒。

`ExtraPerformanceTypeId`为`Balance`或`IOPS`时需设置该参数。各个类型的额外性能取值范围如下：
- IOPS型：1～50000。
- Balance型：1～50000。

- 参数 - N：表示云盘的序号，取值范围：1～16。N = 1表示系统盘，故N传入1时，该参数将被忽略。N ≥ 2表示数据盘，可正常传入该参数。
- 多个云盘之间用&分隔。
Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceIOPS.description_en:
Extra IOPS performance size for cloud disks. Only ESSD FlexPL data disks support this feature. Unit: operations/second

Set this parameter when `ExtraPerformanceTypeId` is set to `Balance` or `IOPS`. The valid value ranges for each type are:
- IOPS type: 1–50000
- Balance type: 1–50000

- Parameter N: Indicates the disk sequence number. Valid values: 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk; when N is 1, this parameter is ignored. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks; you can set this parameter for these disks.
- Use & to separate multiple disks.

Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB.description_cn:
云盘额外吞吐性能大小，单位MB/s，仅ESSD FlexPL数据盘支持。

`ExtraPerformanceTypeId`为`Throughput`时需设置该参数。
取值范围：1～650。

- 参数 - N：表示云盘的序号，取值范围：1～16。N = 1表示系统盘，故N传入1时，该参数将被忽略。N ≥ 2表示数据盘，可正常传入该参数。
- 多个云盘之间用&分隔。
Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB.description_en:
Extra disk throughput (MB/s). Supported only for ESSD FlexPL data disks.

Set this parameter when `ExtraPerformanceTypeId` is set to `Throughput`.
Value range: 1–650.

- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk sequence number. Valid values: 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk; if N is 1, this parameter is ignored. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks; you can set this parameter for data disks.
- Use & to separate multiple disks.

Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceTypeId.description_cn:
云盘额外性能的类型，仅ESSD FlexPL数据盘支持。取值：
- Balance：均衡型额外性能。
- IOPS：IOPS型额外性能。
- Throughput：吞吐量型额外性能。

关于额外性能的更多介绍，请参见[云盘额外性能](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1174767)。

- 参数 - N：表示云盘的序号，取值范围：1～16。N = 1表示系统盘，故N传入1时，该参数将被忽略。N ≥ 2表示数据盘，可正常传入该参数。
- 多个云盘之间用&分隔。
Volumes.N.ExtraPerformanceTypeId.description_en:
Types of additional disk performance, supported only by ESSD FlexPL data disks. Options:
- Balance: Balanced performance
- IOPS: IOPS performance
- Throughput: Throughput performance

For more information about additional performance, see [Additional Disk Performance](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1174767).

- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk index, with a valid range of 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk; when N is set to 1, this parameter is ignored. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks; you can set this parameter normally.
- Use & to separate multiple disks.

Volumes.N.Size.description_cn:
云盘的容量，单位为GiB。N的取值范围1～16，N = 1表示系统盘，N ≥ 2表示数据盘。多个云盘之间用&分隔。

云盘容量的取值范围：
- 系统盘：
  - ESSD_PL0：20～2048
  - ESSD_FlexPL：20～2048
    默认值：max{40  ，ImageId对应的镜像容量}。
  
  
- 数据盘：
  - ESSD_PL0：10～32768
  - ESSD_FlexPL：10～32768
    如果不传入该参数，则使用`Volumes.N.SnapshotId`对应的快照大小作为数据盘的容量大小。若未传入`Volumes.N.SnapshotId`，则报错LimitExceeded.DataVolumeSize。
Volumes.N.Size.description_en:
Cloud disk capacity, in GiB. N ranges from 1 to 16. N = 1 indicates a system disk; N ≥ 2 indicates a data disk. Use & to separate multiple cloud disks.

Cloud disk capacity ranges:
- System disk:
  - ESSD_PL0: 20–2048
  - ESSD_FlexPL: 20–2048
    Default value: max{40, the image size of the specified ImageId}.
  

- Data disk:
  - ESSD_PL0: 10–32768
  - ESSD_FlexPL: 10–32768
    If this parameter is not specified, the capacity of the data disk is set to the size of the snapshot specified by `Volumes.N.SnapshotId`. If `Volumes.N.SnapshotId` is not provided, an error LimitExceeded.DataVolumeSize is returned.

Volumes.N.SnapshotId.description_cn:
使用快照创建云盘，仅支持创建数据盘。您可以调用[DescribeSnapshots](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/104884)接口查询快照ID。
- 参数 - N：表示云盘的序号，取值范围：1～16。N = 1表示系统盘，故N传入1时，该参数将被忽略。N ≥ 2表示数据盘，可正常传入目标数据盘快照ID。
- 多个云盘之间用&分隔。
- 仅极速型SSD支持通过快照创建云盘，性能型SSD不支持快照相关功能。
- 仅状态为“可用”的快照支持创建新云盘，“创建中”、“回滚中”、“删除中”及“错误”状态下的快照不支持创建新云盘。
Volumes.N.SnapshotId.description_en:
Create a cloud disk from a snapshot. Only data disks are supported. You can use the [DescribeSnapshots](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/104884) API to query snapshot IDs.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the cloud disk index, valid values: 1–16. N = 1 refers to the system disk; if you set N to 1, this parameter will be ignored. N ≥ 2 refers to data disks; you can specify the target data disk snapshot ID.
- Use & to separate multiple cloud disks.
- Only Ultra SSDs support creating cloud disks from snapshots. Performance SSDs do not support snapshot-related features.
- Only snapshots with the 'Available' status can be used to create new cloud disks. Snapshots in 'Creating', 'Rolling Back', 'Deleting', or 'Error' status cannot be used to create new cloud disks.

Volumes.N.VolumeType.description_cn:
云盘的类型，取值：
- ESSD_PL0（默认）：极速型SSD PL0
- ESSD_FlexPL：极速型SSD FlexPL
- 参数 - N：表示云盘的序号，取值范围：1～16。N = 1表示系统盘，N ≥ 2表示数据盘。
- 多个云盘之间用&分隔。
Volumes.N.VolumeType.description_en:
Cloud disk type options:
- ESSD_PL0 (default): Ultra-fast SSD PL0
- ESSD_FlexPL: Ultra-fast SSD FlexPL
- Parameter N: Indicates the cloud disk number. Valid range: 1–16. N = 1 is the system disk. N ≥ 2 are data disks
- Use & to separate multiple cloud disks

ZoneId.description_en: ID of the availability zone where the instance is located. You can call [DescribeZones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/120518) to query availability zone information in a region.

ClientToken.description_cn:
保证请求幂等性。由客户端自动生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一，避免当调用API超时或服务器内部错误时，客户端多次重试导致重复性操作。
取值：仅支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensure request idempotency. The client automatically generates a unique parameter value for each request to prevent duplicate operations if the API times out or the server returns an internal error and the client retries. Value: ASCII characters only, up to 64 characters.

DryRun.description_cn:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
- true：发送检查请求，不会启动实例。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制和ECS库存。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码DryRunOperation。
- false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接启动实例。
DryRun.description_en:
Whether to only pre-check this request. Values:
- true: Sends a check request without starting the Instance. The check includes required parameters, request format, business restrictions, and ECS inventory. If the check fails, returns the corresponding error. If the check passes, returns the error code DryRunOperation.
- false (default): Sends a normal request. If the check passes, the Instance starts immediately.

DryRun.description_cn:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
- true：发送检查请求，不会停止实例。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制和ECS库存。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码DryRunOperation。
- false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接停止实例。
DryRun.description_en:
Whether to perform a dry run for this request. Valid values:
- true: Sends a check request without stopping the Instance. The check verifies required parameters, request format, business limits, and ECS inventory. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, the error code DryRunOperation is returned.
- false (default): Sends a normal request. If the check passes, the Instance is stopped directly.

ForceStop.description_cn:
是否强制关机，取值：
- true：强制关机。相当于典型的断电操作，所有未写入存储设备的缓存数据会丢失。
- false（默认）：正常关机。
以下类型的实例，`ForceStop`无论取值为`true`还是`false`，实例均会执行强制关机。
- 弹性裸金属实例。
- 高性能计算GPU型ebmhpcpni2l 、ebmhpcpni2、ebmhpchfpni2实例。
  > ebmhpcpni2l 、ebmhpcpni2、ebmhpchfpni2正在邀测中，如需试用，请联系客户经理申请。
ForceStop.description_en:
Whether to force shutdown. Valid values:
- true: Force shutdown. This is equivalent to a typical power-off operation; all cached data not written to storage devices will be lost.
- false (default): Normal shutdown.
For the following types of Instances, `ForceStop` will always perform a forced shutdown, regardless of whether it is set to `true` or `false`.
- Elastic Bare Metal Instances
- High Performance Computing GPU types: ebmhpcpni2l, ebmhpcpni2, ebmhpchfpni2 Instances
  > ebmhpcpni2l, ebmhpcpni2, and ebmhpchfpni2 are currently in invitation testing. If you want to try them, please contact your account manager to apply.

StoppedMode.description_cn:
停机模式，取值：
- KeepCharging：普通停机模式。停机后实例及其相关资源仍被保留且持续计费，费用和停机前一致。
- StopCharging：节省停机模式。停机后实例的计算资源（vCPU、GPU和内存）将被回收且停止计费，所挂载的云盘、镜像、公网IP仍被保留且持续计费。
  有关节省停机的启用条件，请参见[按量计费节省停机模式说明](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/71817)。

默认值：若您在云服务器控制台[开启了默认节省停机模式](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1343921#%E5%BC%80%E5%90%AF%E9%BB%98%E8%AE%A4%E8%8A%82%E7%9C%81%E5%81%9C%E6%9C%BA%E6%A8%A1%E5%BC%8F)，并且符合启用条件，则默认值为`StopCharging`。否则，默认值为`KeepCharging`。
StoppedMode.description_en:
Shutdown mode. Valid values:
- KeepCharging: Standard shutdown mode. After shutdown, the instance and its associated resources are retained and continue to be billed at the same rate as before shutdown.
- StopCharging: Saving shutdown mode. After shutdown, the instance's compute resources (vCPU, GPU, and memory) are released and billing for them stops. Attached cloud disks, images, and public IPs are retained and continue to be billed.
  For activation requirements of saving shutdown mode, see [Description of Pay-As-You-Go Saving Shutdown Mode](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/71817).

Default value: If you have [enabled the default saving shutdown mode](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1343921#%E5%BC%80%E5%90%AF%E9%BB%98%E8%AE%A4%E8%8A%82%E7%9C%81%E5%81%9C%E6%9C%BA%E6%A8%A1%E5%BC%8F) in the cloud server console and meet the activation requirements, the default value is `StopCharging`. Otherwise, the default value is `KeepCharging`.

- 高性能计算GPU型ebmhpcpni2l 、ebmhpcpni2、ebmhpchfpni2实例。
  > ebmhpcpni2l 、ebmhpcpni2、ebmhpchfpni2正在邀测中，如需试用，请联系客户经理申请。
ForceStop.description_en:
Whether to force shutdown. Values:
- true: Force shutdown. This is equivalent to a typical power-off operation; all cached data not written to storage devices will be lost.
- false (default): Normal shutdown.
For the following types of Instances, the `ForceStop` parameter will trigger a forced shutdown regardless of whether it is set to `true` or `false`:
- Elastic Bare Metal Instance.
- High-performance computing GPU instances: ebmhpcpni2l, ebmhpcpni2, ebmhpchfpni2.

- KeepCharging：普通停机模式。停机后实例及其相关资源仍被保留且持续计费，费用和停机前一致。
- StopCharging：节省停机模式。停机后实例的计算资源（vCPU、GPU和内存）将被回收且停止计费，所挂载的云盘、镜像、公网IP仍被保留且持续计费。
  有关节省停机的启用条件，请参见[按量计费节省停机模式说明](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/71817)。

默认值：若您在云服务器控制台[开启了默认节省停机模式](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1343921#%E5%BC%80%E5%90%AF%E9%BB%98%E8%AE%A4%E8%8A%82%E7%9C%81%E5%81%9C%E6%9C%BA%E6%A8%A1%E5%BC%8F)，并且符合启用条件，则默认值为`StopCharging`。否则，默认值为`KeepCharging`。
StoppedMode.description_en:
Shutdown mode. Available values:
- KeepCharging: Standard shutdown mode. After shutdown, the instance and its related resources are retained and continue to be billed at the same rate as before shutdown
- StopCharging: Cost-saving shutdown mode. After shutdown, the instance's compute resources (vCPU, GPU, and memory) are released and billing stops for these resources. Attached cloud disks, images, and public IPs are retained and continue to be billed
  For conditions to enable cost-saving shutdown, see [Pay-As-You-Go Cost-Saving Shutdown Mode Description](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/71817)

Default value: If you have [enabled the default cost-saving shutdown mode](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1343921#%E5%BC%80%E5%90%AF%E9%BB%98%E8%AE%A4%E8%8A%82%E7%9C%81%E5%81%9C%E6%9C%BA%E6%A8%A1%E5%BC%8F) in the ECS console and meet the enabling conditions, the default value is `StopCharging`. Otherwise, the default value is `KeepCharging`.

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
为资源添加的用户标签的标签键。
- 参数 - N：表示标签键的序号，取值范围：1～20。
- 多个标签键之间用&分隔。

命名规则如下：
- 不能以任何大小写形式的`volc:`或`sys:`开头。
> `volc:`或`sys:`开头为系统预留标签键禁止创建。
- 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
- 长度限制在1～128个字符之间。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for user tags added to resources
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag keys with &

Naming rules:
- Cannot start with `volc:` or `sys:` in any letter case
> Tag keys starting with `volc:` or `sys:` are reserved by the system and cannot be created
- Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following English symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
为资源添加的用户标签的标签值。
- 参数 - N：表示标签值的序号，取值范围：1～20。
- 多个标签值之间用&分隔。

命名规则如下：
- 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
- 允许为空，长度限制在0～256个字符之间。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag values for user-defined tags added to a resource
- Parameter - N: Indicates the tag value index, range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag values with &

Naming rules:
- Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: '_', '.', ':', '/', '=', '+', '-', '@'
- Can be empty; length must be between 0 and 256 characters

TagKeys.N.description_cn:
资源要删除的用户标签的标签键。
- 参数 - N：表示标签键的序号，取值范围：1～20。
- 多个标签键之间用&分隔。

命名规则如下：
- 不能以任何大小写形式的`volc:`或`sys:`开头。
> `volc:`或`sys:`开头为系统预留标签键禁止创建。
- 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
- 长度限制在1～128个字符之间。
TagKeys.N.description_en:
The label key of the user tag to be deleted from the resource.
- Parameter - N: Represents the sequence number of the label key, with values ranging from 1 to 20.
- Multiple label keys are separated by &.

Naming rules are as follows:
- Cannot start with `volc:` or `sys:` in any case format.
> Keys starting with `volc:` or `sys:` are reserved for system use and cannot be created.
- Can only include letters, numbers, spaces, and English symbols "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@".
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.

- 参数 - N：表示事件ID的序号。
- 多个事件ID之间用`&`分隔。
EventIds.N.description_en:

- Parameter - N: indicates the sequence number of the event ID
- Separate multiple event IDs with `&`

OperatedEndAt.description_cn:
事件运维时间窗结束时间，默认是收到请求的时间+72小时，格式为RCF3339。
暂仅`SystemMaintenance.Redeploy`（因系统维护实例重新部署）事件可调整运维时间，事件授权时，该参数为必填参数，且不能早于OperatedStartAt。
OperatedEndAt.description_en:
The end time of the event maintenance window defaults to the time the request is received plus 72 hours, in RFC3339 format.
Currently, only the `SystemMaintenance.Redeploy` (instance redeployment due to system maintenance) event allows adjustment of the maintenance window. When authorizing the event, this parameter is required and cannot be earlier than OperatedStartAt.

OperatedStartAt.description_cn:

仅`SystemMaintenance.Redeploy`（因系统维护实例重新部署）事件可调整运维时间，事件授权时，该参数为必填参数，且不能晚于OperatedEndAt。
OperatedStartAt.description_en:
Event maintenance window start time. Defaults to the time the request is received plus 60 hours, in RFC3339 format.
Only the `SystemMaintenance.Redeploy` event (instance redeployment due to system maintenance) allows adjustment of the maintenance window. When authorizing the event, this parameter is required and must not be later than OperatedEndAt.

SameNameFilePolicy.description_cn:
在执行预热或沉降任务时遇到同名文件的策略，取值说明如下：

- `Skip`：自动跳过 TOS 与 NAS 中的同名文件，即对同名文件不执行预热或沉降操作。
