数据拉取的开始时间（基于 update_time字段），start_time 不能早于90天前。
**注意：**  仅在首次请求时生效。当请求中包含 `page_token` 参数时，此参数将被忽略。

EndTime.description_cn: 结束时间

MaxResults.description_cn: 最大返回结果

StartTime.description_cn: 开始事件

InstanceIds.description_cn:
需要绑定标签的实例 ID。
支持一次传入多个实例 ID，最多同时传入 50 个实例 ID。
InstanceIds.description_en:
Instance IDs that need to be bound to tags
You can enter up to 50 instance IDs at a time

Tags.description_cn:
需要绑定的标签键和标签值数组对象。
- 支持一次传入多组标签键值对像，多组标签键值对像间用英文逗号（,）分隔。最多同时传入 20 组标签键值对。
- 标签键值需满足设置规则，详细信息请参见[绑定标签](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/170631)。
Tags.description_en:
Array object of tag keys and values to bind
- You can enter multiple tag key-value pairs at once, separated by English commas (,). Up to 20 pairs can be entered at the same time
- Tag keys and values must follow the configuration rules. For details, see [Binding Tags](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/170631)

AllowListIds.description_cn: 待绑定的白名单ID。
AllowListIds.description_en: Whitelist ID Pending Binding

InstanceIds.description_cn: 待绑定的Kafka实例ID。
InstanceIds.description_en: Kafka instance ID to be bound

AccessPolicy.description_cn:
规则的访问策略。
- 资源类型为Topic时，支持指定“Read”或者“Write”。
- 资源类型为Group时，仅支持“Read”。
- 多个规则之间用“,”分隔。例如：“Read,Write”。

资源类型（ResourceType）为 Group 时，仅支持设置为 Read 权限，不支持 Write 权限。
AccessPolicy.description_en:
Access policy for rules
- When the resource type is Topic, you can specify 'Read' or 'Write'
- When the resource type is Group, only 'Read' is supported
- Separate multiple rules with a comma, for example: 'Read,Write'

When the resource type (ResourceType) is Group, only Read permission is supported; Write permission is not allowed

Ip.description_cn: 规则允许访问的 IP 地址或网段。支持指定为“*”，表示允许任意 IP 访问。多个 IP 之间使用“,”分隔。
Ip.description_en: Specify allowed IP addresses or ranges. Use '*' to allow access from any IP. Separate multiple IPs with commas

PatternType.description_cn:
规则的匹配方式。
- Literal：完全匹配方式。ACL 策略仅匹配名称完全一致的资源。此时需要设置资源名称。
- Prefixed：前缀匹配方式。ACL 策略匹配指定前缀的资源。此时需要设置资源名称前缀。
PatternType.description_en:
Rule Matching Types
- Literal: Exact match. The ACL policy matches resources whose names are exactly the same. In this case, you need to set the resource name.
- Prefixed: Prefix match. The ACL policy matches resources with the specified prefix. In this case, you need to set the resource name prefix.

Resource.description_cn:
绑定的 Topic 或 Group 的资源名称或名称前缀。
- 资源名称匹配方式（PatternType）为完全匹配（Literal）时，此字段用于指定资源名称，表示指定用户对某个资源具备权限。支持设置为“*”，表示 Topic 或 Group类型的全部资源。
- 资源名称匹配方式（PatternType）为前缀匹配（Prefixed）时，此字段用于指定用户对哪些名称前缀的资源具备权限。
Resource.description_en:
Resource name or name prefix for the bound Topic or Group
- When the resource name match type (PatternType) is set to exact match (Literal), use this field to specify the resource name. This grants the specified user permission for that resource. You can set this field to "*" to grant permission for all resources of the Topic or Group type
- When the resource name match type (PatternType) is set to prefix match (Prefixed), use this field to specify which resource name prefixes the user has permission for

ResourceType.description_cn: 规则绑定的资源类型。支持配置“Topic”或者“Group”。
ResourceType.description_en: Resource type bound to the rule. You can configure "Topic" or "Group".

UserName.description_cn: 规则允许访问的 SASL 用户。支持指定为“*”，表示允许任意用户访问。
UserName.description_en: Rules allow access for specified SASL users. You can use '*' to allow access for any user

AllowList.description_cn:
白名单规则列表。
- 支持指定为 IP 地址或者 IP 网段。
- 多个 IP 地址或网段之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
- 每个白名单最多可配置 300 个 IP 地址或网段。
AllowList.description_en:
Whitelist rule list
- Specify IP addresses or IP ranges
- Separate multiple IP addresses or ranges with commas
- Each whitelist can include up to 300 IP addresses or ranges

AllowListDesc.description_cn: 白名单描述。长度不超过200个字符。
AllowListDesc.description_en:
Whitelist description
No more than 200 characters

AllowListName.description_cn:
白名单规则名称。
- 长度为 1～128 个字符。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线和连字符（-）。
- 不能以数字或连字符（-）开头。
- 白名单名称在当前地域下唯一。
AllowListName.description_en:
Whitelist Rule Name
- 1–128 characters
- Can only include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens (-)
- Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
- Must be unique within the current region

ProjectName.description_en: Project Name

Description.description_cn: 消费组描述信息。长度不超过 128 个字符。
Description.description_en: Consumer group description. Maximum length: 128 characters

GroupId.description_cn:
待创建的消费组 ID。
- 长度为 3～128 个字符。
- 只能包含大小写字母、数字、连字符（-）、特殊字符(@)和下划线(_)。
- 至少包含一个字母或数字。
GroupId.description_en:
Consumer group ID to be created
- Must be 3–128 characters long
- Can only contain uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens (-), special character (@), and underscores (_)
- Must contain at least one letter or number

Tags.description_cn:
云资源标签。可以将 Group 通过标签进行归类，便于 Group 的识别和管理。
标签设置规则请参见[标签设置规则](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/1222945#b055b6e8)。
Tags.description_en: Cloud Resource Tags. Use tags to categorize Groups for easier identification and management. For tag setting rules, see [Tag Setting Rules](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/1222945#b055b6e8).

ChargeInfo.description_cn: Kafka 实例的计费类型等计费信息。
ChargeInfo.description_en: Billing type and other billing information for the Kafka instance

ClientToken.description_cn:
保证客户端请求幂等性的标识。 该标识为 1~64 位的 ASCII 字符串，大小写敏感，由客户端生成，应确保不同请求之间该标识具有唯一性。 
如何使用幂等标识，请参考[请求幂等性](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/1167938)。
ClientToken.description_en: Idempotency identifier for client requests. This identifier is a case-sensitive ASCII string of 1 to 64 characters, generated by the client. Make sure the identifier is unique for each request. For details on using the idempotency identifier, see [Request Idempotency](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/1167938).

ComputeSpec.description_cn: 实例的计算规格。您可以通过文档[产品规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/72239)查看计算规格列表。
ComputeSpec.description_en: Instance computing specifications. You can view the list of computing specifications in the [Product Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/72239) documentation.

DiskEncrypted.description_cn: 是否使用磁盘加密，仅用于开白金融用户。
DiskEncrypted.description_en: Enable Disk Encryption? (Only for Whitelisted Financial Users)

EipId.description_cn:
EIP 的 ID。
- 指定 EipId 表示开启实例的公网访问。
-  EIP 提供独立的公网 IP 资源，包括公网 IP 地址与公网出口带宽服务。指定此参数开启公网访问后，公网地址将绑定您的弹性公网 IP（EIP），费用由 EIP 收取。
EipId.description_en:
EIP ID
- Specify EipId to enable public access for the instance
- EIP provides dedicated public IP resources, including public IP addresses and outbound bandwidth services. After you specify this parameter to enable public access, the public address will be bound to your Elastic Public IP (EIP), and charges will be billed to the EIP.

InstanceDescription.description_cn: Kafka 实例的简单描述。长度范围为 1~128 个字符。
InstanceDescription.description_en: Brief description of the Kafka instance; length must be between 1 and 128 characters

InstanceName.description_cn:
Kafka 实例的名称。 需满足以下要求：
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和连字符（-）。
- 不能以数字和连字符（-）开头。
- 长度范围为 1~128 个字符。
如果创建实例时未指定名称，则默认将实例ID作为实例名称。
InstanceName.description_en:
Kafka instance name. Must meet the following requirements:
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
- Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
If you do not specify a name when creating the instance, the instance ID will be used as the instance name by default

IpWhiteList.description_cn:
实例绑定的白名单 ID 列表。绑定白名单后，仅配置在白名单中的 IP 地址与地址段才能访问此实例。
若未设置此参数，新 Kafka 实例将绑定白名单 default，对应 IP 地址为 0.0.0.0，表示允许所有地址访问该 Kafka 实例。
IpWhiteList.description_en: Whitelist ID list bound to the instance. After binding, only IP addresses and address ranges in the whitelist can access this instance. If you do not set this parameter, the new Kafka instance binds to the default whitelist with IP address 0.0.0.0, allowing all addresses to access the Kafka instance.

MetaGroup.description_cn: 元数据组，不同组的实例不能在一个zk上。
MetaGroup.description_en: Metadata group: Instances from different groups cannot be on the same zk

NetworkTypes.description_cn: 网络类型。多选，以逗号分隔。仅innerapi可见。
NetworkTypes.description_en: Network Type. Select multiple options, separated by commas. Visible to innerapi only.

Parameters.description_cn:
Kafka 实例的初始参数配置。
当前支持的参数列表及参数默认值，请参考下表。您也可以通过文档[修改参数配置](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/102156)查看各参数的详细信息。
通过 Postman 等方式调用 API 时，应注意转义，例如 `{\"LogRetentionHours\":\"72\",\"MessageMaxByte\":\"10\",\"MessageTimestampType\":\"CreateTime\",\"OffsetRetentionMinutes\":\"4320\"}`。

Parameters 参数说明

- `"MessageMaxByte":"10"`：最大消息大小。单位为MB，取值范围为1～12。默认为10。
- `"LogRetentionHours":"72"`：消息保留时长。单位为小时，取值范围为0～2160，即消息最久保留90天。默认为72。
- `"OffsetRetentionMinutes":"4320"`：消费位点保留时长。单位为分钟，取值范围为1～10080，即消费位点最久保留7天。默认为4320。
- `"MessageTimestampType":"LogAppendTime"`：消息时间类型，支持设置为`LogAppendTime`和`CreateTime`。LogAppendTime 表示消息写入到服务端的时间；CreateTime 表示Producer 创建消息的时间。
Parameters.description_en:
Initial parameter configuration for Kafka instances

Refer to the table below for the list of supported parameters and their default values. For detailed information on each parameter, see the documentation at [Modify Parameter Configuration](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/102156).

When calling the API using Postman or similar tools, make sure to escape parameters properly. For example: {"LogRetentionHours":"72","MessageMaxByte":"10","MessageTimestampType":"CreateTime","OffsetRetentionMinutes":"4320"}

Parameter descriptions

- "MessageMaxByte":"10": Maximum message size in MB. Valid range: 1–12. Default: 10
- "LogRetentionHours":"72": Message retention period in hours. Valid range: 0–2160 (up to 90 days). Default: 72
- "OffsetRetentionMinutes":"4320": Offset retention period in minutes. Valid range: 1–10080 (up to 7 days). Default: 4320
- "MessageTimestampType":"LogAppendTime": Message timestamp type. Can be set to LogAppendTime or CreateTime. LogAppendTime indicates the time the message is written to the server; CreateTime indicates the time the producer creates the message

PartitionNumber.description_cn:
分区数量。取值范围取决于当前指定的计算规格，您可以通过文档[产品规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/72239)查看指定计算规格支持的分区数量范围。
不同规格提供数量不同的免费分区额度，超过免费额度的部分将另外收取分区费用。每个规格可创建的分区数量范围请参考产品规格，分区的计费方式请参考[计费项](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/109781)。
PartitionNumber.description_en:
Partition quantity. The available range depends on the selected compute specification. For details on the supported partition range for each specification, see the documentation at [Product Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/72239).

Different specifications offer varying free partition quotas. Additional partition fees apply if you exceed the free quota. For the partition quantity range of each specification, refer to Product Specifications. For partition billing details, see [Billing Items](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/109781).

ProjectName.description_cn: 当前创建的 Kafka 实例所属的 IAM 项目。如果未指定 IAM 项目，消息队列 Kafka版会将新实例添加到名为 `default` 的 IAM 项目中。
ProjectName.description_en: The IAM project for the Kafka instance you are creating. If you do not specify an IAM project, Message Queue for Kafka adds the new instance to the IAM project named `default`.

Region.description_cn: 创建实例的时候检查region是否为请求中携带的region, 不填该参数表示不检查。
Region.description_en: Check if the region matches the region in the request when creating an instance; leave this parameter empty to skip the check

SkipCheckVPC.description_cn: 是否跳过vpc检查，内部服务使用。
SkipCheckVPC.description_en: Skip VPC Check? (For internal service use)

StorageSpace.description_cn:
实例的存储空间。单位为 GiB，必须指定为 100 的倍数。
取值范围取决于当前指定的计算规格，您可以通过文档[产品规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/72239)查看指定计算规格支持的存储空间范围和默认存储空间大小。
StorageSpace.description_en:
Instance storage space. Unit: GiB; must be set as a multiple of 100.
The available range depends on the selected compute specification. See the documentation [Product Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/72239) for supported storage ranges and default storage size for each compute specification.

StorageType.description_cn:
Kafka 实例数据存储的云盘类型。可设置为 ESSD_FlexPL 或 ESSD_PL0，默认为 ESSD_FlexPL。关于不同存储类型的详细性能说明，请参考[云盘规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/101839)。
- 对于峰值流量超过 100MB/s 的规格，应使用 ESSD_FlexPL。
- 创建实例后不支持修改存储类型，请谨慎选择。
StorageType.description_en:
Cloud disk type for Kafka instance data storage. You can choose ESSD_FlexPL or ESSD_PL0; ESSD_FlexPL is the default. For detailed performance information about different storage types, see [Cloud Disk Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/101839).
- Use ESSD_FlexPL for specifications with peak traffic over 100 MB/s.
- You cannot change the storage type after the instance is created, so choose carefully.

SubnetId.description_cn: 实例所在的 VPC 子网 ID。
SubnetId.description_en: Instance VPC Subnet ID

Tags.description_cn: 云资源标签。可以将实例通过标签进行归类，便于实例的搜索和资源聚合。详细说明请参考[标签管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/170630)。
Tags.description_en: Cloud Resource Tags. Use tags to organize instances for easier search for instances and resource aggregation. For details, see [Tag Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/170630).

UserName.description_cn:
SASL/PLAIN 用户名称。需要满足以下要求：
- 由小写字母、数字、连字符（-）或下划线组成。
- 长度为 3~64 个字符。 
- 用户名不支持设置为 admin 或 monitor，且实例内用户名称唯一。
UserName.description_en:
SASL/PLAIN username requirements:
- Can only contain lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens (-), or underscores
- Length must be 3 to 64 characters
- Username cannot be admin or monitor, and must be unique within the instance

UserPassword.description_cn:
SASL/PLAIN 用户的密码。需要满足以下要求：
- 长度为 8~32 个字符。
- 由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的任意三种组成。
- 支持的特殊字符包括 !@#$%^&*()_+-=。
UserPassword.description_en:
SASL/PLAIN user password. Must meet the following requirements:
- Length: 8–32 characters
- Must include at least three of the following types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, special characters
- Supported special characters: !@#$%^&*()_+-=

Version.description_cn:
支持的 Kafka 版本。当前支持的版本包括：
- 2.2.2：Kafka 2.2.2 版本。
- 2.8.2：Kafka 2.8.2 版本。
Version.description_en:
Supported Kafka versions
Currently supported versions:
- 2.2.2: Kafka version 2.2.2
- 2.8.2: Kafka version 2.8.2

VpcId.description_cn:
实例所在的私有网络（VPC） ID。

VpcId.description_en:
VPC ID of the instance
- You cannot change the VPC or subnet after the instance is created. Please proceed with caution when creating an instance.
- You can use the DescribeVpcs API to query the list of available VPCs and subnets.

ZoneId.description_cn:
实例所在的可用区 ID。
消息队列 Kafka版实例支持跨 AZ 部署，多个可用区ID之间以逗号（,）间隔。您可以调用 [DescribeAvailabilityZones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/216727) 查询当前地域提供服务的可用区列表。
ZoneId.description_en:
Availability zone ID of the instance
Kafka Message Queue for Kafka supports cross-AZ deployment. Separate multiple availability zone IDs with commas (,). You can call [DescribeAvailabilityZones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/216727) to query the list of availability zones in the current region.

EipId.description_cn: EIP 的 ID。
EipId.description_en: EIP ID

AllAuthority.description_cn:
待创建的 Topic 是否对所有用户开启读写权限。
True：（默认）所有用户都具备此 Topic 读写权限。
False：并非所有用户都具备此 Topic 的读写权限。默认情况下，用户对于此 Topic 的权限沿用用户的默认权限，如果默认权限不满足需求，您也可以通过 AccessPolicies 指定某个用户对于此 Topic 的自定义权限。

ReplicaNumber.description_cn: 分区的副本个数，上限值为 3.

Tags.description_cn:
云资源标签。可以将 Topic 通过标签进行归类，便于 Topic 的识别和管理。
标签设置规则请参见标签设置规则。

AllAuthority.description_cn:

Does the user have, by default, read/write permissions for all Topics

- false: The user does not have, by default, read/write permissions for all Topics

Description.description_cn: SASL 用户描述信息。

InstanceId.description_en: Instance ID associated with the user

- Plain：PLAIN 类型的 SASL 用户。

If you create a PLAIN-type user, it will take effect after a 1-minute delay. Please wait patiently after creation.

- 长度为 3~64 个字符。

SASL username. Must meet the following requirements:

- Length must be 3 to 64 characters
- Cannot be set to admin or monitor, and must be unique within the instance

UserPassword.description_cn:
SASL 用户的密码。应符合以下要求：

- 长度为 8~32 个字符。
- 应至少包含大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的任意三种。
- 支持的特殊字符包括`!@#$%^&*()_+-=`。
UserPassword.description_en:
SASL user password. Must meet the following requirements:

Parameters.description_cn:
Kafka 实例新的参数配置。
当前支持的参数列表及参数默认值，请参考下表 Parameters 参数说明。您也可以通过文档[修改参数配置](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/102156)查看各参数的详细信息。
通过 Postman 等方式调用API时，应注意转义，例如`{\"LogRetentionHours\":\"72\",\"MessageMaxByte\":\"10\",\"MessageTimestampType\":\"CreateTime\",\"OffsetRetentionMinutes\":\"4320\"}`。

Parameters 参数说明

- `"MessageMaxByte":"10"`：最大消息大小。单位为MB，取值范围为1～12。默认为10。
- `"LogRetentionHours":"72"`：消息保留时长。单位为小时，取值范围为0～2160，即消息最久保留90天。默认为72。
- `"OffsetRetentionMinutes":"4320"`：消费位点保留时长。单位为分钟，取值范围为1～10080，即消费位点最久保留7天。默认为4320。
- `"MessageTimestampType":"LogAppendTime"`：消息时间类型，支持设置为`LogAppendTime`和`CreateTime`。LogAppendTime 表示消息写入到服务端的时间；CreateTime 表示Producer 创建消息的时间。
- `"AutoDeleteGroup":"false"`：是否自动删除 Group。默认为 false。`true`表示如果消费者组中的所有消费者处于 Empty 状态，超出消费位点保留时长后，后端服务会自动删除该消费者组；`false`表示消费进度的自动删除不影响消费组的状态，Empty 状态的 Group 不会被自动删除。
Parameters.description_en:
New Kafka instance parameter configuration

For the list of supported parameters and their default values, see the table below: Parameters Description. You can also view detailed information for each parameter in the documentation [Modify Parameter Configuration](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/102156).

When calling the API using Postman or similar tools, make sure to escape parameters, for example: `{"LogRetentionHours":"72","MessageMaxByte":"10","MessageTimestampType":"CreateTime","OffsetRetentionMinutes":"4320"}`.

Parameters Description

- "MessageMaxByte":"10": Maximum message size in MB. Valid values: 1–12. Default is 10
- "LogRetentionHours":"72": Message retention period in hours. Valid values: 0–2160 (up to 90 days). Default is 72
- "OffsetRetentionMinutes":"4320": Offset retention period in minutes. Valid values: 1–10080 (up to 7 days). Default is 4320
- "MessageTimestampType":"LogAppendTime": Message timestamp type. Supports 'LogAppendTime' and 'CreateTime'. LogAppendTime is the time the message is written to the server; CreateTime is the time the Producer creates the message
- "AutoDeleteGroup":"false": Whether to automatically delete the group. Default is false. If set to true, when all consumers in the group are in Empty status and the offset retention period is exceeded, the backend service will automatically delete the consumer group. If set to false, automatic deletion of consumption progress does not affect the group status; groups in Empty status will not be automatically deleted

如何使用幂等标识，请参考[请求幂等性](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/1167938)。
ClientToken.description_en: Identifier to ensure idempotency for client requests. This identifier is an ASCII string of 1–64 characters, case-sensitive, generated by the client. Make sure the identifier is unique for each request. For details on using the idempotency identifier, see [Request Idempotency](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/1167938).

ComputeSpec.description_cn:

仅支持升级实例规格，不支持降级。
ComputeSpec.description_en:
Compute specification after the instance is changed. To upgrade the compute specification, this parameter is required. For a list of available compute specifications for Message Queue for Kafka instances, see [Product Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/72239).
Only instance specification upgrades are supported; downgrades are not supported.

NeedRebalance.description_cn:
是否开启再均衡（Rebalance）。
- true ：（推荐）消息队列 Kafka版会对分区进行再均衡分配。
- false：（默认）若未启用再均衡，您需要为原有的Topic手动增加分区，以使用升配后的新资源。
变更实例的计算规格时才需要选择是否再均衡，仅升级存储规格时无需再均衡。即此参数仅在指定 ComputeSpec 参数时生效。
NeedRebalance.description_en:
Enable Rebalance
- true (recommended): Kafka message queue will redistribute partitions
- false (default): If rebalance is not enabled, you need to manually add partitions to existing topics to use the upgraded resources
Only select whether to enable rebalance when changing the compute specification of an instance. You do not need to enable rebalance when upgrading storage specification. This parameter only takes effect when the ComputeSpec parameter is specified.

PartitionNumber.description_cn:
分区数量。如需提高分区数量，此参数必选。
取值范围取决于当前指定的计算规格，详细说明请参考[产品规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/72239)。
- 仅支持增加分区数量。
- 升级实例规格时增加的分区将额外收取分区费用，分区的计费方式请参考[计费项](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/109781)。
PartitionNumber.description_en:
Partition quantity. This parameter is required if you need to increase the number of partitions.
The value range depends on the current compute specification. For details, see [Product Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/72239).
- Only increasing the partition quantity is supported.
- Additional partitions added when upgrading the instance specification will incur extra partition fees. For partition billing methods, see [Billing Items](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/109781).

RebalanceTime.description_cn:
自动再均衡的执行时间。时间格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS，例如 2023-01-02 15:04:05。应晚于当前时间 5 分钟以上。
- 此参数仅在 NeedRebalance 为 true 时生效。若未设置此参数，更配完成后将立即执行再均衡任务。
- 推荐选择夜晚等业务低峰时进行再均衡，以减少数据迁移对业务的影响。
- 若不指定此参数，表示升级结束后立即执行再均衡。
RebalanceTime.description_en:
Execution time for automatic rebalancing. Use the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, for example, 2023-01-02 15:04:05. The time must be at least 5 minutes later than the current time.
- This parameter takes effect only when NeedRebalance is set to true. If you do not set this parameter, the rebalancing task runs immediately after configuration is complete.
- We recommend scheduling rebalancing during off-peak hours, such as at night, to minimize the impact of data migration on your business.
- If you do not specify this parameter, rebalancing runs immediately after the upgrade.

StorageSpace.description_cn:
实例变更后的存储空间。如需扩容存储空间，此参数必选。
单位为 GiB，必须指定为 100 的倍数。取值范围取决于当前指定的计算规格，详细说明请参考[产品规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/72239)。
仅支持升级实例规格，不支持降级。

Unit: GiB; must be a multiple of 100. The valid range depends on the selected compute specification. For details, see [Product Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/72239)

CleanupPolicy.description_cn:
Topic 的消息清理策略，支持以下三种取值方式：

- ["delete"]：默认的消息清理策略。在磁盘容量充足的情况下，保留在最长保留时间范围内的消息；在磁盘容量不足时，将提前删除旧消息，以保证服务可用性。
说明

Kafka 实例默认的磁盘清理水位为 90%，具体以实际为准，详情请参见设置磁盘清理水位。


- ["compact"]：COMPACT 消息清理策略针对每个消息的 Key 进行整合，对于有相同 Key 的消息，只保留最新的 value 值，旧的记录则会被清除。
- ["delete","compact"]：同时配置 DELETE 和 COMPACT 两种消息清理策略。只要消息满足任一条清理策略时，都将被清除。


如果消息没有 Key，不支持启用 COMPACT 消息清理策略。
CleanupPolicy.description_en:
Topic message cleanup policies support the following three options:

- ["delete"]: The default message cleanup policy. When disk space is sufficient, messages are retained within the maximum retention period. If disk space is low, older messages are deleted early to ensure service availability.

Note

The default disk cleanup threshold for Kafka instances is 90%. Actual values may vary. For details, see Setting Disk Cleanup Threshold.


- ["compact"]: The COMPACT cleanup policy consolidates messages by key. For messages with the same key, only the latest value is kept; older records are removed.
- ["delete","compact"]: Enables both DELETE and COMPACT cleanup policies. Messages are deleted if they meet the criteria of either policy.

The COMPACT cleanup policy cannot be enabled for messages without a key.

Parameters.description_cn:
Kafka 在 Topic 级别的参数配置。
当前支持的参数列表及参数默认值，请参考下表 Topic Parameters 参数说明。您也可以通过文档[修改参数配置](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/102156)查看各参数的详细信息。
通过 Postman 等方式调用 API 时，应注意转义，例如`{\"LogRetentionHours\":\"72\",\"MessageMaxByte\":\"10\",\"MinInsyncReplicaNumber\":\"2\"}`。

Parameters 参数说明

- `"MinInsyncReplicaNumber":"2"`：最小同步副本个数。当同步副本个数小于配置值时，消息将无法写入对应 Topic。配置值越大，数据可靠性增加，但是可用性将会降低。默认值为副本数减 1。考虑到 Topic 的可用性，建议设置为副本数减 1。
- `"MessageMaxByte":"10"`：最大消息大小。单位为 MB，取值范围为 1～12。默认沿用实例的最大消息大小设置。
- `"LogRetentionHours":"72"`：消息保留时长。单位为小时，取值范围为 0～2160，即消息最久保留 90 天。默认沿用实例的消息保留时长设置。
Parameters.description_en:
Kafka topic-level parameter configuration

For the list of supported parameters and their default values, see the table below: Topic Parameters. For detailed information on each parameter, refer to the documentation [Modify Parameter Configuration](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6439/102156).

When calling the API using Postman or similar tools, make sure to escape characters as shown: {\"LogRetentionHours\":\"72\",\"MessageMaxByte\":\"10\",\"MinInsyncReplicaNumber\":\"2\"}.

Parameter descriptions

- "MinInsyncReplicaNumber":"2": Minimum number of in-sync replicas. If the number of in-sync replicas falls below this value, messages cannot be written to the topic. Increasing this value improves data reliability but reduces availability. The default is the number of replicas minus one. For better topic availability, set this to the number of replicas minus one.
- "MessageMaxByte":"10": Maximum message size in MB. Valid range: 1–12. By default, this follows the instance's maximum message size setting.
- "LogRetentionHours":"72": Message retention period in hours. Valid range: 0–2160 (up to 90 days). By default, this follows the instance's message retention period setting.

PartitionNumber.description_cn:
此 Topic 的分区数量。分区数量越大，消费的并发度越大。
该参数只能调大不能调小，且不可超出 Kakfa 实例的剩余可用分区数。
PartitionNumber.description_en: Number of partitions for this topic. The greater the number of partitions, the higher the consumption concurrency. You can only increase this value; you cannot decrease it. Do not exceed the remaining available partition count in the Kafka instance.

ReplicaNumber.description_cn:
分区的副本个数，表示对应数量的副本上备份数据。当其中一个 Broker 故障时仍可保障数据可用性，副本数越大可靠性越高。
- 增加副本数会占用实例磁盘容量，请确保容量充足。
- 增加副本时会占用实例带宽资源，建议在业务低峰期操作。
- 减少副本数会降低数据可用性，请谨慎操作。
- 1 副本 Topic 无法保障数据可靠性且实例升级期间无法进行读写操作，建议选择 2 副本或 3 副本
ReplicaNumber.description_en:
The number of replicas for a partition indicates how many copies of the data are backed up. If one broker fails, data remains available. A higher replica count increases reliability.
- Increasing the replica count uses more instance disk capacity; make sure you have enough capacity.
- Adding replicas consumes instance bandwidth resources; we recommend making changes during business off-peak hours.
- Reducing the replica count lowers data availability; proceed with caution.
- Topics with only 1 replica cannot ensure data reliability and are unavailable for read/write operations during instance upgrades; we recommend using 2 or 3 replicas.

ExtendedConfig.description_cn:
凭据的拓展配置，用于指定非 Generic 类型凭据的属性。长度不超过 1024 字节。

当 SecretType 取值为 Generic 时，用户可自定义，建议使用 JSON 格式的键值对。

当 SecretType 取值为 IAM 时，ExtendedConfig 参数如下：
    UserName（必填）：IAM 用户名称。
    SecretSubType（必填）：凭据子类型，取值： IAMUserAccessKey。
    CustomData（可选）：自定义数据，取值为 JSON 格式的键值对。
    示例：{"UserName":"test","SecretSubType":"IAMUserAccessKey","CustomData":{"desc":"test"}}

当 SecretType 取值为 RDS 时，ExtendedConfig 参数如下：
    DBInstanceId（必填）：RDS 实例 ID。
    SecretSubType（必填）：凭据子类型。取值：
        SingleUser：单账号模式，凭据轮转时，指定账号的口令会被重置为新的随机口令。
        DoubleUsers：双账号模式，凭据轮转时，OLDER 版本的账号口令会被重置为新的随机口令，然后 OLDER 版本会替换为 CURRENT，保证轮转过程中业务不中断。
    CustomData（可选）：自定义数据，取值为 JSON 格式的键值对。
    示例：{"DBInstanceId":"xxx","SecretSubType":"SingleUser","CustomData":{"desc":"test"}}

当 SecretType 取值为 Redis 时，ExtendedConfig 参数如下：
    DBInstanceId（必填）：Redis 实例 ID。
    SecretSubType（必填）：凭据子类型。取值：
        SingleUser：单账号模式，凭据轮转时，指定账号的口令会被重置为新的随机口令。
        DoubleUsers：双账号模式，凭据轮转时，OLDER 版本的账号口令会被重置为新的随机口令，然后 OLDER 版本会替换为 CURRENT，保证轮转过程中业务不中断。
    CustomData（可选）：自定义数据，取值为 JSON 格式的键值对。
    示例：{"DBInstanceId":"xxx","SecretSubType":"DoubleUsers","CustomData":{"desc":"test"}}

当 SecretType 取值为 ECS 时，ExtendedConfig 参数如下：
    InstanceId（必填）：ECS 实例 ID。
    SecretSubType（必填）：凭据子类型。取值：
        Password：ECS 口令。
        SSHKey：ECS SSH 公私钥。
    CustomData（可选）：自定义数据，取值为 JSON 格式的键值对。
    示例：{"InstanceId":"xxx","SecretSubType":"Password","CustomData":{"desc":"test"}}

SecretValue.description_cn:
凭据值，长度不超过 30720 字节。

当 SecretType 取值为 Generic 时，用户可自定义，建议使用 JSON 格式的键值对。

当 SecretType 取值为 IAM 时，SecretValue 格式如下：
    {"AccessKeys":[{"AccessKeyId":"","AccessKeySecret":""}]}
    AccessKeyId：访问密钥 ID。
    AccessKeySecret：访问密钥内容。
    AccessKeys 的数量必须为 1 或者 2，AccessKeyId 必填。

当 SecretType 取值为 RDS 时，SecretValue 格式如下：
    {"Accounts":[{"AccountName":"","AccountPassword":""}]}
    AccountName：RDS 实例的账号名。
    AccountPassword：RDS 实例的账号口令。
    当 SecretSubType 取值为 SingleUser 时，Accounts 数量必须为 1；当  SecretSubType 取值为 DoubleUsers 时，Accounts 数量必须为 2。AccountName 必填，且两个 AccountName 不能一样。

当 SecretType 取值为 Redis 时，SecretValue 格式如下：
    {"Accounts":[{"AccountName":"","AccountPassword":""}]}
    AccountName：Redis 实例的账号名。
    AccountPassword：Redis 实例的账号口令。
    当 SecretSubType 取值为 SingleUser 时，Accounts 数量必须为 1；当  SecretSubType 取值为 DoubleUsers 时，Accounts 数量必须为 2。AccountName 必填，且两个 AccountName 不能一样。

当 SecretType 取值为 ECS 时，SecretValue 格式如下：
    当 SecretSubType 取值为 Password 时：格式为 {"UserName":"","Password":""}
    UserName：登录 ECS 实例的用户名。
    Password：登录 ECS 实例的密码。
    当 SecretSubType 取值为 SSHKey 时：格式为 {"UserName":"","PublicKey":"","PrivateKey":""}
    PublicKey：登录 ECS 实例的 SSH 格式公钥。
    PrivateKey：登录 ECS 实例的私钥。
SecretValue.description_en:
Secret value, up to 30,720 bytes.

When SecretType is set to Generic, you can define the value as needed. We recommend using a JSON key-value pair format.

When SecretType is set to IAM, the SecretValue format is:
    {"AccessKeys":[{"AccessKeyId":"","AccessKeySecret":""}]}
    AccessKeyId: Access key ID
    AccessKeySecret: Access key secret
    The number of AccessKeys must be 1 or 2. AccessKeyId is required.

When SecretType is set to RDS, the SecretValue format is:
    {"Accounts":[{"AccountName":"","AccountPassword":""}]}
    AccountName: Account name for the RDS instance
    AccountPassword: Password for the RDS instance
    If SecretSubType is SingleUser, Accounts must contain 1 item. If SecretSubType is DoubleUsers, Accounts must contain 2 items. AccountName is required, and the two AccountNames must be different.

When SecretType is set to Redis, the SecretValue format is:
    {"Accounts":[{"AccountName":"","AccountPassword":""}]}
    AccountName: Account name for the Redis instance
    AccountPassword: Password for the Redis instance
    If SecretSubType is SingleUser, Accounts must contain 1 item. If SecretSubType is DoubleUsers, Accounts must contain 2 items. AccountName is required, and the two AccountNames must be different.

When SecretType is set to ECS, the SecretValue format is:
    If SecretSubType is Password: {"UserName":"","Password":""}
    UserName: Username for logging in to the ECS instance
    Password: Password for logging in to the ECS instance
    If SecretSubType is SSHKey: {"UserName":"","PublicKey":"","PrivateKey":""}
    PublicKey: SSH public key for logging in to the ECS instance
    PrivateKey: Private key for logging in to the ECS instance

Filters.description_cn:
查询符合指定条件的密钥环，由 Key-Values 键值对组成。
Key
    描述：需要查询的属性。
    类型：String。
    取值：
        KeyringName：密钥环名称。
        KeyringType：密钥环类型。
        Description：密钥环描述。
        CreationDateRange：密钥环创建的时间范围。
        UpdateDateRange：密钥环更新的时间范围。
Values
    描述：属性的具体取值。
    类型：String 列表。
    容量：1~10。
    取值说明：
        Key 取值为 KeyringName 时：支持模糊搜索，不区分大小写，示例：["hello","world"]。
        Key 取值为 KeyringType 时：取值为 CustomKeyring、ManagedKeyring、ServiceKeyring，区分大小写，示例：["CustomKeyring","ManagedKeyring"]。
        Key 取值为 Description 时：支持模糊搜索，不区分大小写，示例：["hello","world"]。
        Key 取值为 CreationDateRange 时：必须填入开始时间和结束时间，示例：["2024-08-13 10:00:00","2024-08-14 10:00:00"]。
        Key 取值为 UpdateDateRange 时：必须填入开始时间和结束时间，示例：["2024-08-13 10:00:00","2024-08-14 10:00:00"]。
Filters 同一个 Key 中的多个 Value 之间的逻辑关系为 OR，不同 Key 之间的逻辑关系为 AND。
例如：输入[{"Key":"KeyringName", "Values":["hello","world"]},{"Key":"KeyringType", "Values":["CustomKeyring"]}]时，语义为：(KeyringName=hello OR KeyringName=world) AND (KeyringType=CustomKeyring)。
Filters.description_en:
Query keyrings that match specified criteria using key-value pairs.

Key
Description: The attribute to query
Type: String
Options:
    KeyringName: Keyring name
    KeyringType: Keyring type
    Description: Keyring description
    CreationDateRange: Keyring creation date range
    UpdateDateRange: Keyring update date range

Values
Description: Specific values for the attribute
Type: List of strings
Capacity: 1–10
Value details:
    When Key is KeyringName: Supports fuzzy search, case-insensitive. Example: ["hello", "world"]
    When Key is KeyringType: Options are CustomKeyring, ManagedKeyring, ServiceKeyring (case-sensitive). Example: ["CustomKeyring", "ManagedKeyring"]
    When Key is Description: Supports fuzzy search, case-insensitive. Example: ["hello", "world"]
    When Key is CreationDateRange: Enter both start and end times. Example: ["2024-08-13 10:00:00", "2024-08-14 10:00:00"]
    When Key is UpdateDateRange: Enter both start and end times. Example: ["2024-08-13 10:00:00", "2024-08-14 10:00:00"]

Filters: Multiple values under the same Key use OR logic; different Keys use AND logic.

For example, input [{"Key":"KeyringName", "Values":["hello","world"]},{"Key":"KeyringType", "Values":["CustomKeyring"]}] means: (KeyringName=hello OR KeyringName=world) AND (KeyringType=CustomKeyring)

Filters.description_cn:
查询符合指定条件的密钥，由 Key-Values 键值对组成。
Key
    描述：需要查询的属性。
    类型：String。
    取值：
        KeyName：密钥名称。
        KeySpec：密钥规格。
        Description：密钥描述。
        KeyState：密钥状态。
        KeyUsage：密钥用途。
        ProtectionLevel：密钥保护级别。
        RotateState：密钥轮转状态。
        Origin：密钥来源。
        CreationDateRange：密钥创建的时间范围。
        UpdateDateRange：密钥更新的时间范围。
Values
    描述：属性的具体取值。
    类型：String 列表。
    容量：1~10。
    取值说明：
        Key 取值为 KeyName 时：支持模糊搜索，不区分大小写，示例：["hello","world"]。
        Key 取值为 KeySpec 时：取值为 SYMMETRIC_256、SYMMETRIC_128、RSA_2048、RSA_3072、RSA_4096、EC_P256K、EC_P256、EC_P384、EC_P521、EC_SM2，区分大小写，示例：["SYMMETRIC_256","SYMMETRIC_128"]。
        Key 取值为 Description 时：支持模糊搜索，不区分大小写，示例：["hello","world"]。
        Key 取值为 KeyState 时：取值为 Enable、Disable、PendingDelete、Archived、PendingImport，区分大小写，示例：["Enable","PendingDelete"]。
        Key 取值为 KeyUsage 时：取值为 ENCRYPT_DECRYPT、SIGN_VERIFY，区分大小写，示例：["ENCRYPT_DECRYPT","SIGN_VERIFY"]。
        Key 取值为 ProtectionLevel 时：取值为 SOFTWARE、HSM，区分大小写，示例：["SOFTWARE","HSM"]。
        Key 取值为 RotateState 时：取值为 Enable、Disable，区分大小写，示例：["Enable","Disable"]。
        Key 取值为 Origin 时：取值为 CloudKMS、External，区分大小写，示例：["CloudKMS","External"]。
        Key 取值为 CreationDateRange 时：必须填入开始时间和结束时间，示例：["2024-08-13 10:00:00","2024-08-14 10:00:00"]。
        Key 取值为 UpdateDateRange 时：必须填入开始时间和结束时间，示例：["2024-08-13 10:00:00","2024-08-14 10:00:00"]。
Filters 同一个 Key 中的多个 Value 之间的逻辑关系为 OR，不同 Key 之间的逻辑关系为 AND。
例如：输入[{"Key":"KeyName", "Values":["hello","world"]},{"Key":"KeySpec", "Values":["EC_SM2"]}]时，语义为：(KeyName=hello OR KeyName=world) AND (KeySpec=EC_SM2)。
Filters.description_en:
Query keys that match specified conditions using key-value pairs.

Key
    Description: The attribute to query.
    Type: String
    Options:
        KeyName: Key name
        KeySpec: Key specification
        Description: Key description
        KeyState: Key status
        KeyUsage: Key usage
        ProtectionLevel: Key protection level
        RotateState: Key rotation status
        Origin: Key origin
        CreationDateRange: Key creation time range
        UpdateDateRange: Key update time range

Values
    Description: Specific values for the attribute.
    Type: List of strings
    Capacity: 1–10
    Value instructions:
        When Key is KeyName: Supports fuzzy search, case-insensitive. Example: ["hello","world"]
        When Key is KeySpec: Options are SYMMETRIC_256, SYMMETRIC_128, RSA_2048, RSA_3072, RSA_4096, EC_P256K, EC_P256, EC_P384, EC_P521, EC_SM2. Case-sensitive. Example: ["SYMMETRIC_256","SYMMETRIC_128"]
        When Key is Description: Supports fuzzy search, case-insensitive. Example: ["hello","world"]
        When Key is KeyState: Options are Enable, Disable, PendingDelete, Archived, PendingImport. Case-sensitive. Example: ["Enable","PendingDelete"]
        When Key is KeyUsage: Options are ENCRYPT_DECRYPT, SIGN_VERIFY. Case-sensitive. Example: ["ENCRYPT_DECRYPT","SIGN_VERIFY"]
        When Key is ProtectionLevel: Options are SOFTWARE, HSM. Case-sensitive. Example: ["SOFTWARE","HSM"]
        When Key is RotateState: Options are Enable, Disable. Case-sensitive. Example: ["Enable","Disable"]
        When Key is Origin: Options are CloudKMS, External. Case-sensitive. Example: ["CloudKMS","External"]
        When Key is CreationDateRange: Enter both start and end time. Example: ["2024-08-13 10:00:00","2024-08-14 10:00:00"]
        When Key is UpdateDateRange: Enter both start and end time. Example: ["2024-08-13 10:00:00","2024-08-14 10:00:00"]

Filters.description_cn:
查询符合指定条件的凭据，由 Key-Values 键值对组成。
Key
    描述：需要查询的属性。
    类型：String。
    取值：
        SecretName：凭据名称。
        Trn：凭据 Trn。
        SecretType：凭据类型。
        SecretState：凭据状态。
        ManagedState：是否为托管凭据。
        OwningService：托管的云服务。
        RotationState：凭据轮转状态。
        Description：凭据描述。
        CreationDateRange：凭据创建的时间范围。
        UpdateDateRange：凭据更新的时间范围。
Values
    描述：属性的具体取值。
    类型：String 列表。
    容量：1~10。
    取值说明：
        Key 取值为 SecretName 时：支持模糊搜索，不区分大小写，示例：["hello","world"]。
        Key 取值为 Trn 时：支持模糊搜索，不区分大小写，示例：["kms","secret"]。
        Key 取值为 SecretType 时：取值为 Generic、IAM、RDS、Redis、ECS，区分大小写，示例：["ECS","IAM"]。
        Key 取值为 SecretState 时：取值为 Enable、Disable、PendingDelete，区分大小写，示例：["Enable","PendingDelete"]。
        Key 取值为 ManagedState 时：取值为 true、false，区分大小写，示例：["true"]。
        Key 取值为 OwningService 时：支持模糊搜索，不区分大小写，示例：["kms","tos"]。
        Key 取值为 RotationState 时：取值为 Enable、Disable、Rotating，区分大小写，示例：["Enable","Rotating"]。
        Key 取值为 Description 时：支持模糊搜索，不区分大小写，示例：["hello","world"]。
        Key 取值为 CreationDateRange 时：必须填入开始时间和结束时间，示例：["2024-08-13 10:00:00","2024-08-14 10:00:00"]。
        Key 取值为 UpdateDateRange 时：必须填入开始时间和结束时间，示例：["2024-08-13 10:00:00","2024-08-14 10:00:00"]。
Filters 同一个 Key 中的多个 Value 之间的逻辑关系为 OR，不同 Key 之间的逻辑关系为 AND。
例如：输入[{"Key":"SecretName", "Values":["hello","world"]},{"Key":"SecretType", "Values":["ECS"]}]时，语义为：(SecretName=hello OR SecretName=world) AND (SecretType=ECS)。
Filters.description_en:
Query credentials that meet specified conditions, composed of key-value pairs.
Key
    Description: Attribute to query.
    Type: String
    Values:
        SecretName: Credential name
        Trn: Credential Trn
        SecretType: Credential type
        SecretState: Credential state
        ManagedState: Whether the credential is managed
        OwningService: Managed cloud service
        RotationState: Credential rotation state
        Description: Credential description
        CreationDateRange: Time range when the credential was created
        UpdateDateRange: Time range when the credential was updated
Values
    Description: Specific values for the attribute
    Type: List of strings
    Capacity: 1–10
    Value details:
        When Key is SecretName: Supports fuzzy search, case-insensitive. Example: ["hello","world"]
        When Key is Trn: Supports fuzzy search, case-insensitive. Example: ["kms","secret"]
        When Key is SecretType: Values are Generic, IAM, RDS, Redis, ECS; case-sensitive. Example: ["ECS","IAM"]
        When Key is SecretState: Values are Enable, Disable, PendingDelete; case-sensitive. Example: ["Enable","PendingDelete"]
        When Key is ManagedState: Values are true, false; case-sensitive. Example: ["true"]
        When Key is OwningService: Supports fuzzy search, case-insensitive. Example: ["kms","tos"]
        When Key is RotationState: Values are Enable, Disable, Rotating; case-sensitive. Example: ["Enable","Rotating"]
        When Key is Description: Supports fuzzy search, case-insensitive. Example: ["hello","world"]
        When Key is CreationDateRange: Must enter start time and end time. Example: ["2024-08-13 10:00:00","2024-08-14 10:00:00"]
        When Key is UpdateDateRange: Must enter start time and end time. Example: ["2024-08-13 10:00:00","2024-08-14 10:00:00"]
Filters: Multiple values within the same Key use OR logic; different Keys use AND logic.
For example: When input is [{"Key":"SecretName", "Values":["hello","world"]},{"Key":"SecretType", "Values":["ECS"]}], the logic is: (SecretName=hello OR SecretName=world) AND (SecretType=ECS).

Percentage.description_en: Percentage of viewing time relative to total time, valid range (0, 100]. For example, if set to 50, queries the number of viewers whose actual viewing time is at least 50% × TotalTime.

PlayStatus.description_cn:
根据直播状态进行筛选。支持以下取值。

1：直播；
2：预告；
3：回放。
例如，取值为 1，将统计直播状态下的用户数量。
PlayStatus.description_en:
Filter by live stream status. Supported values:

1: Live stream
2: Upcoming stream
3: Replay
For example, if you select 1, the number of users in the live stream status will be calculated.

Source.description_cn:
根据页面访问来源进行筛选。支持以下六种取值，默认取值为 0。

-1：全部地址；
0：默认地址；
1：地址 A；
2：地址 B；
3：地址 C；
4：地址 D。
Source.description_en:
Filter by page visit source. Supports six values; the default is 0.

-1: All addresses
0: Default address
1: Address A
2: Address B
3: Address C
4: Address D

StartTime.description_cn:
查询范围的开始时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。
例如，取值为 1652895802，表示查询 2022-05-19 01:43:22 之后的观众数量。
StartTime.description_en: The start time of the query range, provided as a Unix timestamp (in seconds). For example, if the value is 1652895802, you are querying the number of viewers after 2022-05-19 01:43:22.

TotalTime.description_cn:
总时长，作为观看时长占比 Percentage 的分母，单位为秒。

默认取值为 0，表示统计状态为 PlayStatus 的历史总时长。
当推流时长与实际直播时长不一致时，建议设置该值，以提升结果准确性。
例如，A 直播从 12:00 开始推流，14:00 结束推流；其中，前 30 分钟播放预告片，之后 90 分钟为直播时间，则可以将 TotalTime 设置为 5400。
TotalTime.description_en:
Total duration is used as the denominator for the viewing time percentage and is measured in seconds

The default value is 0, which means the historical total duration for PlayStatus is used
If the streaming duration does not match the actual live duration, it is recommended to set this value to improve accuracy
For example, if stream A starts at 12:00 and ends at 14:00, with the first 30 minutes showing a trailer and the next 90 minutes as live content, you can set TotalTime to 5400

- `1`: Filter by device (Cookie)

- `1`：根据 userID 筛选
IsMergeUserId.description_en:
Whether to filter by userID; if userID is not available, filter by device (Cookie)
Only one of the `IsMerge` or `IsMergeUserId` parameters can be used, and its value must be `1`

- `0`: Do not filter by userID
- `1`: Filter by userID

Percentage.description_cn:
观看时长占总时长的百分比，取值范围为 (0,100]。
例如，取值为 50，将查询实际观看时长 ≥ 50%×`TotalTime` 的观众数量。
Percentage.description_en: Percentage of viewing time out of total time, valid range is (0, 100]. For example, if the value is 50, the system counts the number of viewers whose actual viewing time is at least 50% of `TotalTime`.

PlayStatus.description_cn:
根据直播状态进行筛选。支持以下取值：
- `1`：直播
- `2`：预告
- `3`：回放

例如，取值为 `1`，将统计直播状态下的用户数量。
PlayStatus.description_en:
Filter by live stream status. Supported values:
- `1`: Live
- `2`: Upcoming
- `3`: Replay

For example, if you select `1`, the user count for live streams will be calculated.

StartTime.description_cn:
查询范围的开始时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。
例如，取值为 `1652895802`，表示查询 `2022-05-19 01:43:22` 之后的观众数量。
StartTime.description_en:
Start time of the query range, provided as a Unix timestamp (in seconds)
For example, a value of `1652895802` means you are querying the viewer count after `2022-05-19 01:43:22`

TotalTime.description_cn:
总时长，作为观看时长占比 `Percentage` 的分母，单位为秒。
- 默认取值为 `0`，表示统计状态为 `PlayStatus` 的历史总时长。
- 当推流时长与实际直播时长不一致时，建议设置该值，以提升结果准确性。

例如，A 直播从 12:00 开始推流，14:00 结束推流；其中，前 30 分钟播放预告片，之后 90 分钟为直播时间，则可以将 `TotalTime` 设置为 5400。
TotalTime.description_en:
`TotalTime` is used as the denominator when calculating the watch time percentage (`Percentage`), measured in seconds.
- The default value is `0`, which means using the historical total time for the `PlayStatus` statistic.
- If the stream duration does not match the actual live duration, set this value to improve accuracy.

For example, if stream A starts at 12:00 and ends at 14:00, with the first 30 minutes showing a trailer and the next 90 minutes as live content, set `TotalTime` to 5400.

ActivityType.description_cn:

* `0`：视频直播
* `1`：录播直播

* 当通过复制直播间的方式创建新直播间时，新直播间将继承原直播间的直播模式，该参数不生效。
ActivityType.description_en:
Live stream mode. Default value: `0`. Options:
- `0`: Video live stream
- `1`: Recorded live stream
- When creating a new live stream room by copying an existing room, the new room will inherit the original room's live stream mode, and this parameter will not take effect.
- When creating a new live stream room using a live stream template, if this parameter is not provided:
	- If the template is set to standard latency or ultra-low latency, the new room's live stream mode will be video live stream.
	- If the template is set to high latency, the new room's live stream mode will be recorded live stream.

* `false`：否
CopyStream.description_en:

- `false`: No

CoverImage.description_en:
Cover image URL for landscape livestream.
- If you configure the cover image for landscape livestream via the console and it is successful, the URL will not include a protocol header.
- If you configure the cover image via API, the URL will include a protocol header.

CreatorName.description_cn:
创建直播间的账号信息。参数取值为子账号的账号，表示通过指定子账号创建直播间。您可调用 [ListSubAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377760) 接口，通过参数 `Name` 获取子账号的账号。

* 使用主账号调用接口时，不传该参数，则直播间将通过主账号创建。
* 使用子账号调用接口时，直播间将默认通过该子账号创建，该参数不生效。
CreatorName.description_en:
The account used to create the live room. Set this parameter to the sub-account's account to create the live room using the specified sub-account. You can call the [ListSubAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377760) API and use the `Name` parameter to get the sub-account's account.

* If you use the main account to call the API and do not set this parameter, the live room will be created using the main account.
* If you use a sub-account to call the API, the live room will be created by default using that sub-account, and this parameter will not take effect.

EndTime.description_cn:
直播结束时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。支持精确到分钟级。
结束时间取值需大于当前时间和 `LiveTime` 的取值，且与 `LiveTime` 的差值最大为 259,200，即 72 小时。
* 当 `IsAutoEndEnable` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数必选且生效。
* 当通过复制直播间的方式创建新直播间时，新直播间不会复制原直播间的直播结束时间。您可通过该参数配置新直播间的直播结束时间。
EndTime.description_en:
Live end time. Unix timestamp in seconds. Supports minute-level precision.
The end time must be greater than the current time and the value of `LiveTime`, and the difference between the end time and `LiveTime` must not exceed 259,200 seconds (72 hours).
- When `IsAutoEndEnable` is set to `1`, this parameter is required and takes effect.
- When creating a new live room by copying an existing one, the new live room will not inherit the end time of the original live room. You can configure the end time for the new live room using this parameter.

IsAnswerRepetitionEnable.description_cn:
是否开启答题重现功能。默认值为 `0`。
取值如下：

* `0`：不开启
* `1`：开启。直播中发送的答题和简答，将在直播回放的对应时间点自动弹出重现

通过复制直播间的方式或使用直播模板创建直播间时，以被复制的直播间或使用的直播模板中的配置为准，该参数不生效。
IsAnswerRepetitionEnable.description_en:
Enable answer replay. Default value: `0`.
Available values:
- `0`: Disabled
- `1`: Enabled. Answers and short answers sent during the live stream will automatically pop up at the corresponding time in the playback
When creating a live room by copying another room or using a live template, the configuration from the copied room or template will apply. This parameter will not take effect.

IsAutoEndEnable.description_cn:
是否开启自动关播功能。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：关闭
* `1`：开启

当通过复制直播间的方式创建新直播间时，新直播间不会复制原直播间是否开启自动关播功能。您可通过该参数配置新直播间是否开启自动关播功能。
IsAutoEndEnable.description_en:
Enable auto end broadcast. Default value: `0`.
Available values:
- `0`: Disabled
- `1`: Enabled
When creating a new live room by copying another room, the new room will not copy the auto end broadcast setting from the original room. You can use this parameter to configure whether the new live room enables auto end broadcast.

IsAutoStartEnable.description_cn:
是否开启自动开播功能。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：关闭
* `1`：开启。开启后，会在 `LiveTime` 时自动开播，请确保 `LiveTime` 的时间大于当前时间

* 该参数仅在直播模式为录播直播（`ActivityType` 取值为 `1`）时生效。
* 当通过复制直播间的方式创建新直播间时，新直播间不会复制原直播间是否开启自动开播功能。您可通过该参数配置新直播间是否开启自动开播功能。
IsAutoStartEnable.description_en:
Enable auto start. Default value is `0`. Options:
- `0`: Off
- `1`: On. When enabled, the livestream will start automatically at `LiveTime`. Make sure `LiveTime` is later than the current time.
- This parameter only takes effect when the livestream mode is pseudo-live (`ActivityType` set to `1`).
- When creating a new livestream room by copying, the new room will not inherit the auto start setting from the original room. You can use this parameter to configure auto start for the new room.

IsLinkMicEnable.description_cn:
是否允许开启连麦功能。默认值为 `1`。取值如下：

* `0`：关闭
* `1`：开启
IsLinkMicEnable.description_en:
Allow co-hosting feature. Default value is `1`. Values:

* `0`: Off
* `1`: On

IsReplayAutoOnlineEnable.description_cn:
是否开启回放自动上架。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：关闭
* `1`：开启。在直播结束后，自动将直播回放上架到观看页
IsReplayAutoOnlineEnable.description_en:
Enable auto publish playback. Default value is `0`. Options:
- `0`: Off
- `1`: On. After the livestream ends, playback will be automatically published to the viewing page.

LiveLayout.description_cn:
视频布局。默认值为 `2`。取值如下：

* `1`：三分屏。主播画面和视频画面使用不同视频源，主播画面不会遮挡视频画面。详见[三分屏直播](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1359339)
* `2`：纯视频。主播画面和视频画面共用一个视频源，支持调整主播画面位置
LiveLayout.description_en:
Video layout. Default value is `2`. Options:
- `1`: Three-panel. The host screen and video screen use different video sources; the host screen does not block the video screen.
- `2`: Pure video. The host screen and video screen share the same video source; you can adjust the host screen position.

LiveMode.description_cn:
直播延时类型。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：继承直播模板配置的直播延时类型。有关如何创建直播模板，详见[直播模板](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/116615)。
* `1`：超低延时（延时小于 1 秒）
* `2`：普通延时（延时 5-10 秒）

当直播模式为录播直播（`ActivityType` 取值为 `1`）时，该参数不生效。






当通过复制直播间的方式创建新直播间时，新直播间将继承原直播间的直播延时类型，该参数不生效。
LiveMode.description_en:
Live stream delay type. Default value: `0`. Options:
- `0`: Inherit the live stream delay type from the live stream template configuration. For details on creating a live stream template, see [Live Stream Template](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/116615).
- `1`: Ultra-low latency (delay less than 1 second)
- `2`: Standard latency (delay 5–10 seconds)
- `3`: High latency (delay 30–60 seconds). This option is only effective when the recorded live stream is in live + on-demand selection mode
If your recorded live stream is in live + on-demand selection mode, when the live stream mode is recorded live (`ActivityType` value is `1`) and this parameter is set to `3`, your pseudo-live stream will operate in on-demand to pseudo-live mode.
If your pseudo-live stream is in on-demand mode, when the live stream mode is pseudo-live (`ActivityType` value is `1`), your pseudo-live stream will operate in on-demand to pseudo-live mode, and this parameter does not take effect.
You can contact Enterprise Live technical support to check your pseudo-live stream mode.
For more information about on-demand to pseudo-live, see [On-Demand to Pseudo-Live](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1462608).
When creating a new live stream room by copying an existing room, the new room will inherit the original room's live stream delay type, and this parameter will not take effect.

LiveTime.description_cn:
直播开始时间，默认为当前时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。支持精确到分钟级。
开始时间取值需小于 `EndTime` 的取值，且与 `EndTime` 的差值最大为 259,200，即 72 小时。
LiveTime.description_en:
Livestream start time. Defaults to the current time. Unix timestamp in seconds. Supports minute-level precision.
The start time must be less than the value of `EndTime`, and the difference between start and end time can be up to 259,200 seconds (72 hours).

LoopVideos.description_cn:
录播直播视频。视频总大小需小于等于 200 GB。
* 该参数仅在直播模式为录播直播（`ActivityType` 取值为 `1`）时生效。
LoopVideos.description_en:
List of pseudo-live videos.
- Supports up to 50 pseudo-live videos, and the total video size must be less than or equal to 200 GB. If your pseudo-live is converted from on-demand to pseudo-live, only one pseudo-live video can be configured.
- This parameter is only effective when the live mode is pseudo-live (`ActivityType` is set to `1`).

Name.description_cn: 直播间名称。长度为 1 到 150 个字符。

OldId.description_cn:
被复制的直播间的 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
如需通过已创建的直播间复制出新的直播间，该参数必选。
当复制的直播间包含菜单栏配置时，建议在成功调用本接口创建直播间 10 秒后再获取或使用菜单栏配置，否则菜单栏配置可能不完整。
OldId.description_en:
The ID of the livestream room being copied. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
If you want to create a new livestream room by copying an existing one, this parameter is required.
If the copied livestream room includes menu bar configuration, we recommend retrieving or using the menu bar configuration 10 seconds after creation. Otherwise, the menu bar configuration may be incomplete.

SiteTags.description_cn:
直播间分类标签信息列表。 您可以通过 [ListSiteTagAPIV2](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/127586) 接口获取分类标签信息。
当通过复制直播间的方式创建新直播间时，新直播间不会复制原直播间的分类标签信息。您可通过该参数配置新直播间的分类标签信息。
SiteTags.description_en:
List of live room category tags. You can retrieve category tag information using the [ListSiteTagAPIV2](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/127586) API.
When you create a new live room by copying an existing one, the category tags are not copied. Use this parameter to set category tags for the new live room.

TemplateId.description_cn:
直播模板 ID。新创建的直播间与直播模板配置相同。您可通过调用 [GetAccountTemplateAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/171606) 接口获取 ID。不传该参数，则使用默认直播模板，如未设置默认直播模板，则不使用直播模板，直接创建直播间。
如需通过直播模板创建直播间，该参数必选。
* 该参数仅在未配置 `OldId` 时生效。
* 如果直播模板 ID 对应的模板包含大量抽奖配置，并且您想复制通过该模板创建的直播间，请在直播间创建 5 分钟后再进行复制，否则抽奖配置可能复制不完整。
* 当直播模板包含菜单栏配置时，建议在成功调用本接口创建直播间 10 秒后再获取或使用菜单栏配置，否则菜单栏配置可能不完整。
TemplateId.description_en:
Live template ID. Newly created live rooms will have the same configuration as the live template. You can obtain the ID by calling the [GetAccountTemplateAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/171606) interface. If this parameter is not provided, the default live template will be used. If no default live template is set, no live template will be used and the live room will be created directly.
To create a live room using a live template, this parameter is required.
* This parameter is only effective when `OldId` is not configured.
* If the template corresponding to the live template ID contains a large number of lottery configurations and you want to copy a live room created with this template, please copy the live room 5 minutes after creation; otherwise, the lottery configuration may not be fully copied.
* When the live template includes menu bar configuration, it is recommended to obtain or use the menu bar configuration 10 seconds after creation; otherwise, the menu bar configuration may be incomplete.

TextSiteTags.description_cn:
直播间文本标签信息列表。 您可以通过 [ListSiteTagAPIV2](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/127586) 接口获取文本标签信息。
当通过复制直播间的方式创建新直播间时，新直播间不会复制原直播间的文本标签信息。您可通过该参数配置新直播间的文本标签信息。
TextSiteTags.description_en:
Live Room Text Label List. You can use the [ListSiteTagAPIV2](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/127586) API to get text label information.
When you create a new live room by copying an existing one, the text label information from the original room is not copied. You can use this parameter to set text label information for the new live room.

VerticalCoverImage.description_cn:
竖屏直播的封面图 URL。若未设置该参数值，则默认读取 `CoverImage` 的值。

* 若通过控制台配置竖屏直播封面图且配置成功，则封面图的 URL 无协议头。
* 若通过调用 API 接口配置竖屏直播封面图，则封面图的 URL 有协议头。
VerticalCoverImage.description_en:
Portrait live cover image URL. If this parameter is not set, the value of `CoverImage` will be used by default.
- If the portrait live cover image is configured successfully via the console, the cover image URL does not include the protocol header.
- If the portrait live cover image is configured via the API interface, the cover image URL includes the protocol header.

Vid.description_cn:
视频库或直播暂存中视频的 Vid。您可调用 [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684) 接口，通过返回参数 `Vid` 获取视频的 Vid。新创建的直播间状态为**回放**，同时该视频会作为直播间的回放上架观看页。
* 如果传入的 Vid 属于直播暂存中的视频，则该视频会自动存入视频库的默认分类下，请确保您的媒体库容量充足。
* 使用子账号调用接口时，该视频必须对子账号可见，且子账号必须具备**视频库**或**直播暂存**的**仅查看**或**可编辑**权限。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围和权限，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593)。
Vid.description_en:
Vid of the video in the media library or temporarily stored live video. You can call the [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684) API and obtain the Vid from the response parameter `Vid`. The newly created live room will be in **playback** status, and this video will be listed on the viewing page as the playback for the live room.
If the provided Vid belongs to a temporarily stored live video, the video will be automatically saved under the default category in the media library. Please ensure your media library has sufficient capacity.

ViewUrlPath.description_cn:
观看地址中的 path 字段，不填则由系统自动生成。例如观看地址为 `https://live.byteoc.com/5528/3085317`，则 `ViewUrlPath` 取值为 `3085317`。
长度为 1 到 20 个字符。支持以下字符：

* 大写字母 A - Z
* 小写字母 a - z
* 数字
ViewUrlPath.description_en:
The path field in the viewing address. If not specified, the system will generate it automatically. For example, if the viewing address is `https://live.byteoc.com/5528/3085317`, then `ViewUrlPath` is `3085317`.
Length: 1 to 20 characters. Supported characters:
- Uppercase letters A - Z
- Lowercase letters a - z
- Numbers

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. Query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
  When using a sub-account to call the interface, make sure this live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring the visibility scope of the sub-account, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

DeleteAll.description_cn:
是否删除所有敏感词。
- `true`：是
- `false`：否
DeleteAll.description_en:
Delete all sensitive words?
- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No

WordList.description_cn: 需要删除的敏感词。敏感词中不能包含逗号等特殊符号。
WordList.description_en: Sensitive words to delete. Sensitive words cannot contain commas or other special symbols.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。

ActivityId.description_en:
Live room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
  When using a sub-account to call the interface, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.

ChatId.description_cn: 评论 ID。您可以通过 [PollingChatAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100075) 接口查询 ID。
ChatId.description_en:
Comment ID
You can query the ID via the [PollingChatAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100075) interface

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。

ActivityId.description_cn: 直播间 ID。您可通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
ActivityId.description_en: Live Room ID. You can query the ID via [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055).

Id.description_cn: 转推平台 ID。您可通过 [ListLivePromotionsAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/119015) 接口查询 ID。
Id.description_en:
Promotion Platform ID
You can query the ID using the [ListLivePromotionsAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/119015) interface.

MediaLibraryVideoIds.description_cn:
待删除的媒资库视频的 ID。您可调用 [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684) 接口，通过返回参数 `Id` 获取视频 ID。
- 单次接口调用最多支持删除 50 个视频。
- 使用子账号调用接口时，确保视频对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
MediaLibraryVideoIds.description_en:
IDs of the media library videos to delete. You can call the [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684) and get the video IDs from the returned 'Id' parameter.
- You can delete up to 50 videos in a single API call
- When using a sub-account, make sure the videos are visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
  When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

ActivityId.description_cn: 直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
ActivityId.description_en: Live Room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) API.

EnableStatus.description_cn:
是否将该卡片展示在客户端。支持以下两种取值。
- `0`：关闭展示
- `1`：开启展示
EnableStatus.description_en:
Whether to display this card in the client. Supports the following values:

Source.description_en:

-1: Query all

1: Query source A
2: Query source B

4: Query source D

Channel.description_cn:

此参数对点播间不生效。
Channel.description_en:
Channel identifier for the live room. By default, data for all channels is retrieved. You can obtain the channel identifier by calling the [ListChannelAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/166063) API.
This parameter does not apply to on-demand rooms.

LineId.description_cn:
直播频道 ID。获取直播间数据时，可根据直播频道进行筛选，默认获取全部频道的数据。您可通过调用 [ListLiveChannelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1284548) 接口获取直播频道 ID。
此参数对点播间不生效。
LineId.description_en:
Live channel ID. When retrieving live room data, you can filter by live channel. By default, data for all channels is retrieved. You can obtain the live channel ID by calling the [ListLiveChannelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1284548) API.
This parameter does not apply to on-demand rooms.

PlayStatus.description_cn:
获取直播间数据时，可根据直播状态进行筛选。默认值为 `10`。取值如下：

* `1`：直播观看
* `2`：预告观看
* `3`：回放观看
* `10`：页面访问（页面停留）
* `11`：总观看

此参数对点播间不生效。
PlayStatus.description_en:
When retrieving live room data, you can filter by live status. The default value is `10`. Available values:

* `1`: Live viewing
* `2`: Preview viewing
* `3`: Playback viewing
* `10`: Page access (page stay)
* `11`: Total viewing

This parameter does not apply to on-demand rooms.

AvatarUrl.description_en:
Audience Avatar Image
This parameter applies only to iOS/Android/Flutter live streaming SDKs and is effective only when `Mode` is set to 2.

CustomComment.description_cn: 中奖名单中观众昵称右侧的自定义信息，例如中奖者所在的地区。仅当 `Mode` 为 `2`时该参数会生效。
CustomComment.description_en: Custom information displayed to the right of the audience nickname in the winner list, such as the winner's region. This parameter is only effective when `Mode` is set to `2`.

InviteToken.description_cn:
WebSDK 使用直播分享功能时，传入 path（直播分享地址） 上 `inviter_token` 对应的数据。仅当 `Mode` 取值为 `2` 时该参数会生效。
例如：path 为 `https://test.live.com/123/456?inviter_token=abcd`，则传入的 `InviteToken` 为 `abcd`。
InviteToken.description_en:
When using the live stream sharing feature in WebSDK, pass the data corresponding to `inviter_token` from the path (live stream share URL). This parameter is only effective when `Mode` is set to `2`.
For example, if the path is `https://test.live.com/123/456?inviter_token=abcd`, the `InviteToken` to pass is `abcd`.

LevelId.description_cn:
观众等级 ID。可通过 [GetViewerLevelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1763960) 接口获取。仅当 `Mode` 为 `2`时该参数会生效。
如需在集成了 Web 观播 SDK 的观看页展示观众等级，该参数必传。更多有关观众等级的信息，详见[观众等级](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1747880)。
LevelId.description_en:
Viewer Level ID. Can be obtained via the [GetViewerLevelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1763960) API. This parameter is only effective when `Mode` is set to `2`.
To display viewer levels on a page integrated with the Web Viewing SDK, this parameter is required. For more information about viewer levels, see [Viewer Level](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1747880).

Mode.description_cn:
直播间 Token 的类型。

* `1`：公开直播间类型，观众可以直接进入直播间
* `2`：自定义直播间类型，需要同时传入观众昵称和观众 ID
Mode.description_en:
Live Room Token Types

* `1`: Public live room type—viewers can enter the live room directly
* `2`: Custom live room type—requires both viewer nickname and viewer ID

Nickname.description_cn:
观众昵称。
* 当 `Mode` 取值为 `2` 时，该参数必选。
* 为避免个人信息泄露，请勿使用手机号、身份证号等信息作为观众昵称。
Nickname.description_en:
Audience Nickname
* This parameter is required when `Mode` is set to `2`
* To protect personal information, do not use phone numbers, ID numbers, or similar details as your audience nickname

UserIdStr.description_cn:
观众 ID。
* 当 `Mode` 取值为 `2` 时，该参数必选。

UserIdStr.description_en:

* To avoid personal information leakage, do not use phone numbers, ID card numbers, or similar information as the audience ID

FollowerUserName.description_cn:
创建直播间的账号。默认获取所有账号创建的直播间。
如需获取主账号创建的直播间，可将参数值设置为 `admin@bytedance.com`。如需获取子账号创建的直播间，可将参数值设置为子账号的账号。您可通过调用 [ListSubAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377760) 接口，获取子账号的账号。
FollowerUserName.description_en:
Account used to create the live room. By default, retrieves live rooms created by all accounts
To get live rooms created by the main account, set the parameter value to `admin@bytedance.com`. To get live rooms created by a sub-account, set the parameter value to the sub-account's ID. You can call the [ListSubAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377760) API to get the sub-account's ID.

HostAccountId.description_cn: 直播间关联的主播/品牌方账号 ID。您可通过调用 [GetBusinessAccountInfoAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/128800) 接口获取 ID。
HostAccountId.description_en: Host or brand account ID associated with the livestream room. You can get the ID by calling the [GetBusinessAccountInfoAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/128800) interface.

HostAccountName.description_cn: 直播间关联的主播/品牌方名称。您可通过调用 [GetBusinessAccountInfoAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/128800) 接口获取名称。
HostAccountName.description_en: Name of the host or brand associated with the livestream room. You can get the name by calling the [GetBusinessAccountInfoAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/128800) interface.

IsLockPreview.description_cn:
是否查询已锁定预告的直播间。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `-1`：查询所有直播间
- `0`：查询非锁定预告的直播间
- `1`：查询锁定预告的直播间
IsLockPreview.description_en:
Whether to query live rooms with locked previews. Default value is `0`. Possible values:
- `-1`: Query all live rooms
- `0`: Query live rooms without locked previews
- `1`: Query live rooms with locked previews

LiveLayout.description_cn:
视频布局。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：所有视频布局
- `1`：三分屏。主播画面和视频画面使用不同视频源，主播画面不会遮挡视频画面。详见[三分屏直播](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1359339)
- `2`：纯视频。主播画面和视频画面共用一个视频源，支持调整主播画面位置
LiveLayout.description_en:
Video layout. Default value: `0`. Select from the following options:
- `0`: All video layouts
- `1`: Three-way split screen. The host and video use separate video sources, so the host's video does not cover the main video. See [Three-way split screen live streaming](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1359339)
- `2`: Pure video. The host and video share the same video source, and you can adjust the host's position

LiveMode.description_cn:
直播延时类型。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：所有直播 
- `1`：超低延时（延时小于 1 秒）
- `2`：普通延时（延时 5-10 秒）
LiveMode.description_en:
Live stream latency type. Default value is `0`. Available values:
- `0`: All live streams
- `1`: Ultra-low latency (latency less than 1 second)
- `2`: Normal latency (5–10 seconds)

LiveReviewStatus.description_cn:
审核状态。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：全部 
- `1`：审核中 
- `2`：审核通过 
- `3`：审核驳回 
- `4`：审核归档 
- `5`：草稿 
- `6`：无需审核
LiveReviewStatus.description_en:
Review status. Default value is `0`. Available values:
- `0`: All
- `1`: Under review
- `2`: Approved
- `3`: Rejected
- `4`: Archived
- `5`: Draft
- `6`: No review required

LiveTime.description_cn: 查询该开播时间及以后的直播。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。
LiveTime.description_en: Query live streams at and after this broadcast time. Unix timestamp, in seconds

Name.description_cn:
直播间名称。支持模糊查询。
例如，`Name` 取值为 `直播间 A` 时，则返回直播间名称为 `直播间 ABC`、`直播间 a`、`企业直播间 ab` 等包含 `直播间 A` 关键词的直播间列表。
Name.description_en:
Live stream room name. Supports fuzzy search.
For example, if `Name` is set to `直播间 A`, the results will include rooms with names like `直播间 ABC`, `直播间 a`, and `企业直播间 ab` that contain the keyword `直播间 A`.

PageItemCount.description_cn:
分页查询数量，默认值为 `10`。
接口最多支持返回 10,000 条查询结果，即 `PageNo` × `PageItemCount` ≤ 10,000。
PageItemCount.description_en: Items per page, default value is `10` The API supports returning up to 10,000 results in total, i.e. `PageNo` × `PageItemCount` ≤ 10,000

PageNo.description_cn:
分页查询页码，默认值为 `1`。
接口最多支持返回 10,000 条查询结果，即 `PageNo` × `PageItemCount` ≤ 10,000。
PageNo.description_en:
Page number for paginated queries; default value is `1`.
The API supports up to 10,000 results per query (`PageNo` × `PageItemCount` ≤ 10,000).

SearchActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过当前接口返回的 `Id` 获取直播间 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
SearchActivityId.description_en:
Live room ID. You can get the live room ID using the `Id` returned by this API.
When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

SiteTagNews.description_cn: 分类标签信息。您可通过调用 [ListSiteTagAPIV2](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/127586) 接口获取分类标签信息。
SiteTagNews.description_en: Category tag information. You can get category tag information by calling the [ListSiteTagAPIV2](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/127586) API.

SortBy.description_cn:
直播间排序规则。默认值为 `Status`。取值如下：
- `Status`：先按照直播状态排序，再在每个状态下按照直播间的开播时间倒序排序
- `LiveTime`：按照直播间的开播时间排序
- `CreateTime`：按照直播间的创建时间排序
SortBy.description_en:
Live room sorting rules. Default value: `Status`
- `Status`: Sort by live status first, then by live start time in descending order within each status
- `LiveTime`: Sort by live start time
- `CreateTime`: Sort by creation time

SortOrder.description_cn:
直播间排序规则的顺序。默认值为 `Asc`。取值如下：
- `Desc`：倒序
- `Asc`：正序
当 `SortBy` 取值为 `Status` 时，直播状态的正序排序顺序为：直播、预告、回放、已结束。无论 `SortOrder` 取值如何，在每个状态下均按照直播间的开播时间倒序排序。
SortOrder.description_en:
Live room sorting order rules. Default value is `Asc`. Options:
- `Desc`: Descending
- `Asc`: Ascending
When `SortBy` is set to `Status`, the ascending order of live statuses is: Live, Upcoming, Replay, Ended. Regardless of the `SortOrder` value, rooms within each status are sorted by start time in descending order.

Status.description_cn:
直播状态。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：所有
- `1`：直播中
- `2`：预告
- `3`：回放
- `4`：已结束

已结束指直播结束但未上架回放的状态。
Status.description_en:
Live Stream Status. Default value is `0`. Available values:
- `0`: All
- `1`: Live
- `2`: Upcoming
- `3`: Replay
- `4`: Ended

Ended means the live stream has finished but the replay is not yet available.

ViewPageUrl.description_cn: 完整的观看页地址，且地址中不包含参数。例如，参数值必须写为 `https://live.byteoc.com/1234/1234567`，而非`https://live.byteoc.com/1234/1234567?portrait=1`。
ViewPageUrl.description_en: Provide the complete viewing page URL without any parameters. For example, the URL must be written as `https://live.byteoc.com/1234/1234567`, not `https://live.byteoc.com/1234/1234567?portrait=1`

HostAccountId.description_en: The ID of the host or brand account linked to the livestream room. You can obtain the ID using the [GetBusinessAccountInfoAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/128800) interface.

HostAccountName.description_en: The host or brand name associated with the livestream room. Supports fuzzy search. You can obtain the name using the [GetBusinessAccountInfoAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/128800) interface.

Name.description_en: Live room name. Fuzzy search supported.

分页查询数量，默认值为 `10`。

PageItemCount.description_en:
Number of items per page. Default is `10`.
The API can return up to 10,000 results in total per query, that is, `PageNo` × `PageItemCount` ≤ 10,000.

PageNo.description_cn:
分页查询页码，默认值为 `1`。
接口最多支持返回 10,000 条查询结果，即 `PageNo` × `PageItemCount` ≤ 10,000。
PageNo.description_en: Page number for paginated queries, default is `1`. The API supports returning up to 10,000 results in total, that is, `PageNo` × `PageItemCount` ≤ 10,000.

SiteTagNews.description_cn: 分类标签信息。您可以通过 [ListSiteTagAPIV2](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/127586) 接口获取分类标签信息。
SiteTagNews.description_en: Category tag information. You can get category tag information through the [ListSiteTagAPIV2](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/127586) API.

SortBy.description_cn:
直播间排序规则。默认值为 `Status`。取值如下：
- `Status`：先按照直播状态排序，再在每个状态下按照直播间的开播时间倒序排序
- `LiveTime`：按照直播间的开播时间排序
- `CreateTime`：按照直播间的创建时间排序
SortBy.description_en:
Live room sorting rules. Default value: `Status`
- `Status`: Sort by live status first, then by live room start time in descending order within each status
- `LiveTime`: Sort by live room start time
- `CreateTime`: Sort by live room creation time

SortOrder.description_cn:
直播间排序规则的顺序。默认值为 `Asc`。取值如下：
- `Desc`：倒序
- `Asc`：正序
当 `SortBy` 取值为 `Status` 时，直播状态的正序排序顺序为：直播、预告、回放、已结束。无论 `SortOrder` 取值如何，在每个状态下均按照直播间的开播时间倒序排序。
SortOrder.description_en:
Live room sorting order rules. Default value: `Asc`. Options:
- `Desc`: Descending order
- `Asc`: Ascending order
When `SortBy` is set to `Status`, the ascending order of live statuses is: Live, Upcoming, Replay, Ended. Regardless of the `SortOrder` value, rooms within each status are sorted by start time in descending order.

Status.description_cn:
直播状态。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：所有
- `1`：直播中
- `2`：预告
- `3`：回放
- `4`：已结束
Status.description_en:
Live stream status. Default value is `0`. Options:
- `0`: All
- `1`: Live
- `2`: Upcoming
- `3`: Replay
- `4`: Ended

FolderId.description_cn:
视频库中的分类 ID，即获取该分类下的视频信息。默认值为 `0`，表示获取所有分类下的视频信息。您可通过调用 [GetVideoLibraryFolderTree](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1253591) 接口获取 ID。
* 该参数仅在 `SearchType` 取值为 `1` 时生效。
* 使用子账号调用接口时，如需传入该参数，请确保分类对于该子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
FolderId.description_en:
The category ID in the video library, used to retrieve videos under this category. The default value is `0`, which retrieves videos from all categories. You can obtain the ID by calling the [GetVideoLibraryFolderTree](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1253591) API.
* This parameter is only effective when `SearchType` is set to `1`.
* When using a sub-account to call the API and passing this parameter, ensure the category is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

IncludeSubFolder.description_cn:
视频库中的指定分类是否包含子分类。默认值为 `false`。取值如下：

* `true`：包含，即搜索当前分类及其子分类下的所有视频
* `false`：不包含，即仅搜索当前分类下的视频

该参数仅在 `SearchType` 取值为 `1` 时生效。
IncludeSubFolder.description_en:
Specify whether the selected category in the video library includes subcategories. The default value is `false`. Values:

* `true`: Include; search all videos in the current category and its subcategories
* `false`: Do not include; search only videos in the current category

This parameter is only effective when `SearchType` is set to `1`.

IsCloseDated.description_cn:
对于直播暂存中的视频，是否仅筛选 30 天内到期的视频。默认值为 `false`。取值如下：

* `true`：仅筛选 30 天内到期的视频。直播暂存的视频保存时长为 180 天。视频到期后，将被永久删除且无法恢复
* `false`：不筛选，即搜索所有直播暂存中的视频

该参数仅在 `SearchType` 取值为 `2` 时生效。
IsCloseDated.description_en:
For videos in live temporary storage, specify whether to filter only videos expiring within 30 days. The default value is `false`. Values:

* `true`: Filter only videos expiring within 30 days. Videos in live temporary storage are kept for 180 days. Once expired, they are permanently deleted and cannot be recovered
* `false`: No filtering; search all videos in live temporary storage

This parameter is only effective when `SearchType` is set to `2`.

Name.description_cn: 视频名称。支持模糊搜索，英文大小写不敏感。例如，当参数值为 `A` 时，返回`视频 A`、`视频 abc` 等名称的视频。
Name.description_en: Video Name. Supports fuzzy search and is case insensitive for English. For example, if the parameter value is `A`, videos with names like `视频 A` and `视频 abc` will be returned.

OrderKey.description_cn:
视频排序方式。默认按照视频更新时间降序排列。取值如下：
- `create_time`：按照视频创建时间降序排列
- `其他值`：按照视频更新时间降序排列。更新时间指更新视频封面图、名称和互动脚本等的时间
OrderKey.description_en:
Video sorting method. By default, videos are sorted by video update time in descending order. Available values:
- `create_time`: Sort by video creation time in descending order
- Other values: Sort by video update time in descending order. Video update time refers to when the video cover, title, interactive script, etc. are updated

PageNum.description_cn: 分页查询页码。默认值为 `1`。取值大于等于 1。
PageNum.description_en: Page number for paginated queries. Default value: `1`. Value must be greater than or equal to 1.

PageSize.description_cn: 分页查询数量，默认值为 `10`。
PageSize.description_en: Items per page, default value: `10`

SearchType.description_cn:
视频的存储位置。取值如下：

* `1`：视频库
* `2`：直播暂存。直播暂存的视频保存时长为 180 天，过期将被永久删除且无法恢复
SearchType.description_en:
Video storage location. Values:

* `1`: Video library
* `2`: Live temporary storage. Videos in live temporary storage are kept for 180 days and are permanently deleted after expiration, with no recovery possible

SourceType.description_cn:
视频库中视频的来源。默认返回所有来源的视频。取值如下：

* `1`：上传，即本地上传的视频
* `2`：直播录制，即直播结束后自动生成的视频
* `3`：云剪辑，即通过云剪辑功能剪辑后的视频
