ScrollId.description_cn:
滚动查询 ID。滚动查询方式适用于查询 10,000 条以上数据的场景。如需使用滚动查询方式，确保满足以下要求：

首次调用接口查询数据时无需设置该参数值（即参数值为空），第二次调用接口查询时将该参数值设置为首次查询返回参数中 ScrollId 的值，第三次调用接口查询时将该参数值设置为第二次查询返回参数中 ScrollId 的值，依次类推。
说明

当返回参数中的 Data 参数为空时，表示已查询到最后一页。
当 IsMerge 或 IsMergeUserId 取值为 1 时，若调用接口进行滚动查询，则 ScrollId 取值固定为空。
返回参数中 ScrollId 值的失效时间为 20 分钟，即超过 20 分钟该 ScrollId 值会失效，无法使用该值进行下一次查询。
首次调用接口查询数据时将 PageNo 的值设置为 1，第二次调用接口查询时将 PageNo 的值设置为 2，依次类推。
说明

PageNo 的值只能按照顺序依次递增且不支持输入重复的数值。

在调用接口查询数据时，除 ScrollId 和 PageNo 参数外，确保 IsMerge 和 IsMergeUserId 参数的值保持不变。
ScrollId.description_en:
Scroll query ID. Use scroll query when retrieving more than 10,000 records. To use scroll query, make sure you meet the following requirements:

When you call the API for the first time, leave this parameter empty. For the second call, set this parameter to the ScrollId value returned from the first query. For the third call, set it to the ScrollId value returned from the second query, and so on.

Note

If the Data parameter in the response is empty, you have reached the last page.
If IsMerge or IsMergeUserId is set to 1, ScrollId must remain empty when using scroll query.
The ScrollId value in the response expires after 20 minutes. After 20 minutes, you cannot use this ScrollId for the next query.
For the first API call, set PageNo to 1. For the second call, set PageNo to 2, and so on.

Note

PageNo must increase sequentially and cannot be repeated.

When calling the API, except for ScrollId and PageNo, keep the values of IsMerge and IsMergeUserId unchanged.

Source.description_cn:
根据页面访问来源进行筛选。支持以下取值，默认取值为 0。

-1：查询所有
0：查询默认来源
1：查询来源 A
2：查询来源 B
3：查询来源 C
4：查询来源 D
Source.description_en:
Filter by page visit source. The following values are supported; the default is 0:

-1: Query all sources
0: Query default source
1: Query source A
2: Query source B
3: Query source C
4: Query source D

StartTime.description_cn: 查询开始时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为秒
StartTime.description_en: Query start time, Unix timestamp in seconds

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure this live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

Channel.description_cn: 根据渠道标识进行筛选。您可以通过 [ListChannelAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/166063) 接口查询渠道标识，默认查询全部渠道数据。
Channel.description_en: Filter by channel identifier. You can query channel identifiers using the [ListChannelAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/166063) interface. By default, all channel data is queried.

EndTime.description_cn: 查询结束时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。
EndTime.description_en: Query end time, Unix timestamp in seconds

ExternalUserId.description_cn:
根据观众的关联用户 ID，即观众在第三方平台的唯一标识进行筛选。
观众通过不同方式登录直播间，关联用户 ID 的取值如下所示。

* 微信：观众在企业直播微信服务号的 OpenID。
* 企业微信：绑定企业直播的企业内部成员 OpenID。
* 自定义：自定义登录时通过 UserId 传入的值。详见[自定义登录](https://arcosite.bytedance.net/sites/1685000065257/646f10052827b6021d1e8643/editor/646f100d3c798e0217f0f7f8/?docLang=zh)。
* OAuth 2.0：您自有账号系统中用户 ID 对应的字段。
* 飞书：绑定企业直播的飞书企业成员 Open ID。
* 手机号：观众通过手机号注册企业直播后生成的 passport_id。
* 白名单：观众输入的白名单校验信息。

* 如果您集成了观播 SDK，且 SDK 的鉴权模式为自定义模式，关联用户 ID 的取值为调用 [GetSDKTokenAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/105049) 接口时、或调用 [GetActivityLoginSecret](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1927153) 后生成 JWT 时，传入的 `UserIdStr`（观众 ID）。
* `UserId`、`UserIds`、`ExternalUserId`、`InviterId` 和 `InviterExternalId` 的优先级依次递减，即仅当同时满足以下条件时，`ExternalUserId` 生效。
   * 未传入 `UserId` 或传入的 `UserId` 取值不符合要求
   * 未传入 `UserIds` 或传入的 `UserIds` 取值不符合要求
ExternalUserId.description_en:
Filter by the viewer's associated user ID, which is the viewer's unique identifier on a third-party platform.
Viewers log in to the live room in different ways. The values for associated user ID are as follows:

* WeChat: The viewer's OpenID in the enterprise live WeChat service account.
* WeCom: The OpenID of an internal member bound to enterprise live.
* Custom: The value passed through UserId during custom login. See [Custom Login](https://arcosite.bytedance.net/sites/1685000065257/646f10052827b6021d1e8643/editor/646f100d3c798e0217f0f7f8/?docLang=zh).
* OAuth 2.0: The field corresponding to the user ID in your own account system.
* Feishu: The Open ID of a Feishu enterprise member bound to enterprise live.
* Mobile number: The passport_id generated after the viewer registers for enterprise live with a mobile number.
* Allowlist: The allowlist verification information entered by the viewer.

* If you have integrated the viewer SDK and the SDK authentication mode is custom, the value of the associated user ID is the `UserIdStr` (viewer ID) passed when calling the [GetSDKTokenAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/105049) interface or when generating a JWT after calling [GetActivityLoginSecret](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1927153).
* The priority of `UserId`, `UserIds`, `ExternalUserId`, `InviterId`, and `InviterExternalId` decreases in order. `ExternalUserId` takes effect only if all the following conditions are met:
   * `UserId` is not provided or the value of `UserId` does not meet requirements
   * `UserIds` is not provided or the value of `UserIds` does not meet requirements

Extra.description_cn: 根据业务方扩展参数进行筛选。

InviterExternalId.description_cn:
根据分享人的关联用户 ID 进行筛选，返回该分享人邀请的观众行为数据。
分享人通过不同方式登录直播间，关联用户 ID 的取值如下所示。

* 微信：分享人在企业直播微信服务号的 OpenID。
* 企业微信：绑定企业直播的企业内部成员 OpenID。
* 自定义：自定义登录时通过 UserId 传入的值。详见[自定义登录](https://arcosite.bytedance.net/sites/1685000065257/646f10052827b6021d1e8643/editor/646f100d3c798e0217f0f7f8/?docLang=zh)。
* OAuth 2.0：您自有账号系统中用户 ID 对应的字段。
* 飞书：绑定企业直播的飞书企业成员 Open ID。
* 手机号：分享人通过手机号注册企业直播后生成的 passport_id。
* 白名单：分享人输入的白名单校验信息。

* 如果您集成了观播 SDK，且 SDK 的鉴权模式为自定义模式，关联用户 ID 的取值为调用 [GetSDKTokenAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/105049) 接口时、或调用 [GetActivityLoginSecret](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1927153) 后生成 JWT 时，传入的 `UserIdStr`（观众 ID）。
* `UserId`、`UserIds`、`ExternalUserId`、`InviterId` 和 `InviterExternalId` 的优先级依次递减，即仅当同时满足以下条件时，`InviterExternalId` 生效：
   * 未传入 `UserId` 或传入的 `UserId` 取值不符合要求
   * 未传入 `UserIds` 或传入的 `UserIds` 取值不符合要求
   * 未传入 `ExternalUserId`
   * 未传入 `InviterId` 或传入的 `InviterId` 取值不符合要求
InviterExternalId.description_en:
Filter by the inviter's associated user ID to return viewer behavior data for those invited by the inviter.
The inviter can log in to the live room in different ways. The possible values for the associated user ID are as follows:

* WeChat: The inviter's OpenID from the enterprise live WeChat service account.
* Enterprise WeChat: The OpenID of an internal member bound to enterprise live.
* Custom: The value passed in as UserId during custom login. See [Custom Login](https://arcosite.bytedance.net/sites/1685000065257/646f10052827b6021d1e8643/editor/646f100d3c798e0217f0f7f8/?docLang=zh).
* OAuth 2.0: The field corresponding to the user ID in your own account system.
* Feishu: The Open ID of an enterprise member bound to enterprise live.
* Mobile number: The passport_id generated after the inviter registers for enterprise live with a mobile number.
* Allowlist: The allowlist verification information entered by the inviter.

* If you have integrated the Watch SDK and the SDK authentication mode is custom, the associated user ID is the value passed in as `UserIdStr` (viewer ID) when calling the [GetSDKTokenAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/105049) interface or after generating a JWT via [GetActivityLoginSecret](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1927153).
* The priority order for `UserId`, `UserIds`, `ExternalUserId`, `InviterId`, and `InviterExternalId` decreases sequentially. `InviterExternalId` is only effective if all the following conditions are met:
   * `UserId` is not passed in or the value passed in does not meet requirements
   * `UserIds` is not passed in or the value passed in does not meet requirements
   * `ExternalUserId` is not passed in
   * `InviterId` is not passed in or the value passed in does not meet requirements

InviterId.description_cn:
根据分享人的用户 ID 进行筛选，返回该分享人邀请的观众行为数据。取值大于 `0`。
`UserId`、`UserIds`、`ExternalUserId`、`InviterId` 和 `InviterExternalId` 的优先级依次递减，即仅当同时满足以下条件时，`InviterId` 生效：

* 未传入 `UserId` 或传入的 `UserId` 取值不符合要求
* 未传入 `UserIds` 或传入的 `UserIds` 取值不符合要求
* 未传入 `ExternalUserId`
InviterId.description_en:
Filter by the sharer's user ID and return the behavior data of viewers invited by this sharer. The value must be greater than `0`.
The priority of `UserId`, `UserIds`, `ExternalUserId`, `InviterId`, and `InviterExternalId` decreases in order. `InviterId` takes effect only if all the following conditions are met:

* `UserId` is not provided or the value of `UserId` does not meet requirements
* `UserIds` is not provided or the value of `UserIds` does not meet requirements
* `ExternalUserId` is not provided

IsMerge.description_cn:
当同一个设备多次进出直播间时，是否合并为 1 次。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：不合并
* `1`：合并

* `IsMerge` 和 `IsMergeUserId` 取值不可同时为 `1`。
* 当取值为 `1` 时，仅支持通过 `PageNo` 和 `PageItemCount` 进行分页查询，而无法通过 `ScrollId` 进行滚动查询。
IsMerge.description_en:
Whether to merge multiple entries and exits of the same device into one. The default value is `0`. Values are as follows:

* `0`: Do not merge
* `1`: Merge

* The values of `IsMerge` and `IsMergeUserId` cannot both be `1`.
* When the value is `1`, only pagination queries via `PageNo` and `PageItemCount` are supported. Scroll queries via `ScrollId` are not supported.

IsMergeUserId.description_cn:
当同一个观众多次进出直播间时，是否合并为 1 次。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：不合并
* `1`：合并

* `IsMerge` 和 `IsMergeUserId` 取值不可同时为 `1`。
* 当取值为 `1` 时，仅支持通过 `PageNo` 和 `PageItemCount`进行分页查询，而无法通过 `ScrollId` 进行滚动查询。
IsMergeUserId.description_en:
When the same viewer enters and leaves the livestream room multiple times, choose whether to merge these as a single entry. Default value is `0`. Options:

* `0`: Do not merge
* `1`: Merge

* `IsMerge` and `IsMergeUserId` cannot both be set to `1` at the same time
* When set to `1`, only pagination queries using `PageNo` and `PageItemCount` are supported; scroll queries using `ScrollId` are not supported

Name.description_cn: 根据观众昵称进行模糊查询。
Name.description_en: Perform a fuzzy search by audience nickname

PageItemCount.description_cn: 分页查询数量，取值范围为 [1,500]，默认值为 `10`。
PageItemCount.description_en: Page size, range: [1, 500], default: `10`

PageNo.description_cn:
分页查询页码，默认值为 `1`。

* 使用滚动查询时，`PageNo` 取值范围为 [1,2^63-1]。详见请求参数 `ScrollId`。
* 未使用滚动查询时：
   * 若 `IsMerge` 和 `IsMergeUserId` 均为 `0`，则最多支持返回 10,000 条数据，即 `PageNo` × `PageItemCount`≤ 10,000；
   * 若 `IsMerge` 和 `IsMergeUserId` 任一为 `1` ，则不受该限制。
PageNo.description_en:
Pagination page number. The default value is `1`.

* When using scroll queries, the value range for `PageNo` is [1, 2^63-1]. See the request parameter `ScrollId`.
* When not using scroll queries:
   * If both `IsMerge` and `IsMergeUserId` are `0`, up to 10,000 records can be returned, i.e., `PageNo` × `PageItemCount` ≤ 10,000;
   * If either `IsMerge` or `IsMergeUserId` is `1`, this limit does not apply.

PlayStatus.description_cn:
根据直播状态进行筛选。默认值为 `10`。取值如下：

* `1`：直播状态观看，包括超低延时直播和普通延时直播
* `2`：预告状态观看
* `3`：回放状态观看
* `10`：页面停留
* `11`：所有状态总观看
* `12`：普通延时直播观看
* `13`：超低延时直播观看
PlayStatus.description_en:
Filter by live stream status. Default value is `10`. Available options:

* `1`: Live stream viewing, including ultra-low latency and standard latency streams
* `2`: Preview status viewing
* `3`: Playback status viewing
* `10`: Page stay
* `11`: Total viewing across all statuses
* `12`: Standard latency live stream viewing
* `13`: Ultra-low latency live stream viewing

ScrollId.description_cn:
滚动查询 ID。滚动查询方式适用于查询 10,000 条以上数据的场景。如需使用滚动查询方式，确保满足以下要求：

* 首次调用接口查询数据时，不传该参数或传空值，第二次调用接口查询时将该参数值设置为首次查询返回参数中 `ScrollId` 的值，第三次调用接口查询时将该参数值设置为第二次查询返回参数中 `ScrollId` 的值，依次类推。
      * 当返回参数中的 `Data` 参数为空时，表示已查询到最后一页。
   * 返回参数中 `ScrollId` 值的失效时间为 20 分钟，即超过 20 分钟该 `ScrollId` 值会失效，无法使用该值进行下一次查询。
   
* 首次调用接口查询数据时将 `PageNo` 的值设置为 `1`，第二次调用接口查询时将 `PageNo` 的值设置为 `2`，依次类推。
      `PageNo` 的值只能按照顺序依次递增且不支持输入重复的数值。
   
* 在调用接口查询数据时，除 `ScrollId` 和 `PageNo` 参数外，确保 `IsMerge` 和 `IsMergeUserId` 取值固定为 `0`。
ScrollId.description_en:
Scroll query ID. Use the scroll query method for scenarios where you need to retrieve more than 10,000 records. To use scroll query, make sure you meet the following requirements:

* When calling the API for the first time, do not pass this parameter or leave it empty. For the second call, set this parameter to the `ScrollId` value returned from the first query. For the third call, set it to the `ScrollId` value returned from the second query, and so on.
      * If the `Data` parameter in the response is empty, you have reached the last page.
   * The `ScrollId` value in the response expires after 20 minutes. After 20 minutes, the `ScrollId` becomes invalid and cannot be used for the next query.
   
* For the first API call, set `PageNo` to `1`. For the second call, set `PageNo` to `2`, and so on.
      The value of `PageNo` must increase sequentially and cannot be repeated.
   
* When calling the API, except for the `ScrollId` and `PageNo` parameters, make sure `IsMerge` and `IsMergeUserId` are always set to `0`.

StartTime.description_cn: 查询开始时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。
StartTime.description_en: Query start time, Unix timestamp (unit: seconds)

UserId.description_cn:
根据观众的用户 ID 进行筛选。
当同时传入 `UserId`、`UserIds`、`ExternalUserId`、`InviterId` 和 `InviterExternalId` 时，`UserId` 的优先级最高，即仅根据观众的用户 ID 进行筛选。
UserId.description_en:
Filter by the viewer's user ID.
When `UserId`, `UserIds`, `ExternalUserId`, `InviterId`, and `InviterExternalId` are all provided, `UserId` has the highest priority, meaning filtering is only based on the viewer's user ID.

UserIds.description_cn:
根据用户 ID 列表进行筛选。最多支持传入 500 个用户 ID。
`UserId`、`UserIds`、`ExternalUserId`、`InviterId` 和 `InviterExternalId` 的优先级依次递减，即仅当未传入 `UserId` 或传入的 `UserId` 取值不符合要求时， `UserIds`生效。
UserIds.description_en:
Filter by user ID list. Supports up to 500 user IDs.
The priority of `UserId`, `UserIds`, `ExternalUserId`, `InviterId`, and `InviterExternalId` decreases in order. `UserIds` takes effect only if `UserId` is not provided or the value of `UserId` does not meet requirements.

ActivityID.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityID.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can query the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) API.
When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on how to configure the sub-account's visibility scope, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

Content.description_cn: 筛选关键字，支持输入中英文字符和数字
Content.description_en: Filter keywords; supports input of Chinese and English characters and numbers

EndTime.description_cn: 筛选结束时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。
EndTime.description_en: <SOURCE_TEXT>Filter end time, Unix timestamp in seconds</SOURCE_TEXT>

Extra.description_cn: 根据业务方扩展参数进行筛选。

PageCount.description_cn: 分页查询数量，默认取值为 `50`
PageCount.description_en: <SOURCE_TEXT>Number of items per page, default value is `50`</SOURCE_TEXT>

PageNo.description_cn: 分页查询页码，默认取值为 `1`
PageNo.description_en: <SOURCE_TEXT>Page number for paginated query, default value is `1`</SOURCE_TEXT>

ReviewStatus.description_cn:
审核状态。默认取值为 `0`。
- `-1`：查询全部
- `0`：未审核
- `1`：审核拒绝
- `2`：审核通过
- `3`：自动通过
ReviewStatus.description_en:
Review status. Default value is `0`.
- `-1`: All statuses
- `0`: Not reviewed
- `1`: Review rejected
- `2`: Review approved
- `3`: Auto approved

SortOrder.description_cn:
排序方式。
- 0：根据报名时间倒序排列
- 1：根据报名时间顺序排列
SortOrder.description_en:
Sort By
- 0: Sort by registration time (descending)
- 1: Sort by registration time (ascending)

StartTime.description_cn: 筛选开始时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。
StartTime.description_en: Filter start time, Unix timestamp in seconds

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
若合并生成的视频文件需要上架到直播间（即 `OnlineStatus` 取值为 `1`），您需要通过该参数指定上架的直播间。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见且子账号具备**回放管理** > **可编辑**权限。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围和权限，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can get the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) API. 
If you need to publish the merged video file to a live room (when `OnlineStatus` is set to `1`), specify the target live room using this parameter. 
When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account and the sub-account has **Playback Management** > **Editable** permissions. For details on configuring sub-account visibility and permissions, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

ForceReplayStatus.description_cn:
在直播状态为预告或已结束时，上架合并生成的视频文件（即 `OnlineStatus` 取值为 `1`），是否将直播状态切换为回放。默认值为 `false`。
- `true`：切换，则直播状态切换为回放并播放上架的回放视频。
- `false`：不切换，则直播状态不变且不播放上架的回放视频。
ForceReplayStatus.description_en:
When the live stream status is scheduled or ended and a merged video file is published (`OnlineStatus` is set to `1`), this setting determines whether to switch the live stream status to playback. Default is `false`.
- `true`: Switches the status to playback and plays the published playback video
- `false`: Keeps the current status and does not play the published playback video

MediaName.description_cn: 合并生成的视频文件名称。名称默认为：合并文件 + "_" + 年月日 + 时分。
MediaName.description_en: Name of the merged video file. The default name is: Merged File + "_" + YYYYMMDD + HHMM

OnlineStatus.description_cn:
是否将合并生成的视频文件上架至指定直播间。若上架，则需要通过 `ActivityId` 参数指定上架的直播间。默认取值为 `0`。
- `0`：不上架
- `1`：上架
OnlineStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether to publish the merged video file to the specified livestream room. To publish, specify the livestream room using the `ActivityId` parameter. The default value is `0`.
- `0`: Do not publish
- `1`: Publish

Vids.description_cn:
待合并的回放视频 Vid 列表。您可以通过 [ListMediasAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100065) 接口获取 Vid。
最多支持合并 10 个视频文件且总时长不可超过 24 小时。
Vids.description_en:
List of playback video Vids to be merged. You can obtain Vids using the [ListMediasAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100065) interface.
You can merge up to 10 video files, with a total duration not exceeding 24 hours.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
  When using a sub-account to call the interface, make sure this live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

AudienceGroupId.description_cn:
直播分组 ID。默认值为 `-2`，即获取所有直播分组中的评论。您可通过调用 [GetAudienceGroupConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1263527) 接口获取 ID。
该参数仅在开启直播分组功能后生效。更多有关直播分组的内容，详见[直播分组](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1279269)。
AudienceGroupId.description_en:
Live group ID. The default value is `-2`, which retrieves comments from all live groups. You can get the ID by calling the [GetAudienceGroupConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1263527) API.
This parameter is only effective after you enable the live group feature. For more information, see [Live Group](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1279269).

ChatId.description_cn:
评论 ID。
首次调用该接口，可将参数值设置为 `0`，获取当前直播间中最新发送的评论。之后调用该接口，可将参数值设置为返回参数 `ChatId` 的值，获取 `ChatId` 之前或之后的评论。
ChatId.description_en:
Comment ID
To retrieve the latest comment in the current live room, set the parameter value to `0` when calling this API for the first time. For subsequent calls, set the parameter value to the returned `ChatId` to get comments before or after that `ChatId`.

Count.description_cn: 获取的评论数量。默认值为 `200`。取值范围为 [1,200]。
Count.description_en: Number of comments to retrieve. Default: `200`. Range: [1,200].

PollingType.description_cn:
评论拉取方式。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：获取 `ChatId` 之后的评论
- `1`：获取 `ChatId` 之前的评论
当 `ChatId` 取值为 `0` 时，该参数不生效，获取当前直播间中最新发送的评论。
PollingType.description_en:
Comment fetch mode. Default value is `0`. Options:
- `0`: Fetch comments after `ChatId`
- `1`: Fetch comments before `ChatId`
When `ChatId` is set to `0`, this parameter is ignored and the most recently sent comments in the current live room are fetched.

ActivityId.description_cn: 直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
ActivityId.description_en: Live room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can find the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
  When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure this live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring the visibility scope of the sub-account, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

AudienceGroupId.description_cn:
直播分组 ID。默认值为 `-2`，即在所有直播分组中发送该条评论。您可通过调用 [GetAudienceGroupConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1263527) 接口获取 ID。
该参数仅在开启直播分组功能后生效。更多有关直播分组的内容，详见[直播分组](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1279269)。
AudienceGroupId.description_en:
Live group ID. The default value is `-2`, which sends the comment to all live groups. You can get the ID by calling the [GetAudienceGroupConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1263527) API.
This parameter takes effect only after the live group feature is enabled. For more details about live groups, see [Live group](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1279269).

Comment.description_cn: 主持人待发送的评论内容。

TopStatus.description_cn:
是否置顶该条评论。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：不置顶
- `1`：置顶
TopStatus.description_en:
Whether to pin this comment. Default value is `0`. Possible values:
- `0`: Do not pin
- `1`: Pin

TopStatusV2.description_cn:
是否置顶该条评论。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：不置顶
* `1`：置顶

说明：相比于TopStatus，如果您的直播间（对于开启观众分组的话则是某个分组） 

* 已置顶的评论数小于3：则继续追加置顶， 而使用TopStatus会先取消其他已置顶的评论后再置顶该条评论数据； 
* 已置顶的评论数等于3：取消最早置顶的那条数据后再置顶该条评论数据；
TopStatusV2.description_en:
Whether to pin this comment. Default value is `0`. Possible values:

* `0`: Do not pin
* `1`: Pin

Note: Compared to TopStatus, if your livestream (or a specific group if audience grouping is enabled)

* If the number of pinned comments is less than 3: This will add another pinned comment. Using TopStatus will first unpin other pinned comments before pinning this one
* If the number of pinned comments equals 3: The earliest pinned comment will be unpinned before pinning this one

UserFormIDList.description_en: Registration ID list. You can query registration IDs using the [ListUserSubmitEnterReviewAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/119533#userformlist) interface

ActivityID.description_en: Live Room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) API.

Content.description_cn:
待发送的自定义系统消息。`MessageType` 的取值不同，自定义系统消息的长度也不同。
- `MessageType` 取值为 `1` 时，长度为 1 到 120 个字符。
- `MessageType` 取值为 `2` 时，长度为 1 到 1200 个字符。
Content.description_en:
Custom system message to be sent. The message length varies based on the value of `MessageType`: 
- If `MessageType` is 1, the length must be between 1 and 120 characters.
- If `MessageType` is 2, the length must be between 1 and 1200 characters.

MessageType.description_cn:
自定义系统消息类型。支持以下取值，默认取值为 `1`。
- `1`：在观看页展示的自定义系统消息。
- `2`：发送给 SDK 的自定义 IM（长链接消息）信令。详见 [Web 观播 SDK 事件](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1185517#custommessage-send)、[iOS 开播 SDK 回调](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/891907#bdlcustomimservice) 、[iOS 观播 SDK 回调](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1185541#bdlcustomimservice) 、[Android 开播 SDK 回调](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/905951#%E8%AE%BE%E7%BD%AE%E7%9B%B4%E6%92%AD%E9%97%B4%E4%BA%8B%E4%BB%B6%E5%9B%9E%E8%B0%83) 、[Android 观播 SDK 回调](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125700#wscustomimlistener)。
MessageType.description_en:
Custom system message type. Supports the following values; the default is `1`:
- `1`: Custom system message displayed on the viewing page
- `2`: Custom IM (long connection message) signaling sent to the SDK. For details, see [Web Viewing SDK Events](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1185517#custommessage-send), [iOS Live Streaming SDK Callback](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/891907#bdlcustomimservice), [iOS Viewing SDK Callback](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1185541#bdlcustomimservice), [Android Live Streaming SDK Callback](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/905951#%E8%AE%BE%E7%BD%AE%E7%9B%B4%E6%92%AD%E9%97%B4%E4%BA%8B%E4%BB%B6%E5%9B%9E%E8%B0%83), [Android Viewing SDK Callback](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125700#wscustomimlistener)

FolderId.description_cn:
分类 ID，即将视频转存到该分类下。默认取值为 `0`，表示将视频转存到默认分类下。
您可以通过 [GetVideoLibraryFolderTree](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1253591) 接口获取 ID。

使用子账号调用接口时，确保分类对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
FolderId.description_en:
Category ID. The video will be saved under this category. The default value is `0`, which saves the video to the default category.
You can get the ID using the [GetVideoLibraryFolderTree](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1253591) API.

When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the category is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

Ids.description_cn:
待转存视频的 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684) 接口查询 ID，即返回参数中的 `Id`。
- 最多支持配置 100 个 ID。
- 使用子账号调用接口时，确保视频对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
Ids.description_en:
ID of the video to be transferred. You can find the ID using the [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684) interface. The ID is returned in the response as `Id`.
- You can configure up to 100 IDs.
- When using a sub-account to call the interface, make sure the video is visible to the sub-account. For details on setting sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

直播间的 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。

The livestream room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the livestream room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

ChatId.description_cn: 评论 ID。您可以通过 [PollingChatAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100075) 接口查询 ID。
ChatId.description_en:
Comment ID
You can query the ID using the [PollingChatAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100075) interface.

TopStatus.description_cn:
置顶或取消置顶。使用该参数对评论置顶，则置顶区的评论上限为 1 条。取值如下：

* `1`：置顶
* `2`：取消置顶

* 使用 `TopStatus` 对评论置顶，则置顶区的评论上限为 1 条。即若置顶区已有评论，使用该字段将先取消已置顶的所有评论，再置顶当前评论。
* `TopStatus` 和 `TopStatusV2` 至少需要传一个，当同时传入时，则以 `TopStatusV2` 为准，即置顶区的评论上限为 3 条。
TopStatus.description_en:
Pin or unpin a comment. Use this parameter to pin a comment; the maximum number of pinned comments is 1. Valid values:

* `1`: Pin
* `2`: Unpin

* When you use `TopStatus` to pin a comment, the maximum number of pinned comments is 1. If there is already a pinned comment, using this field will first unpin all pinned comments, then pin the current comment.
* You must provide at least one of `TopStatus` or `TopStatusV2`. If both are provided, `TopStatusV2` takes precedence, and the maximum number of pinned comments is 3.

TopStatusV2.description_cn:
（推荐）置顶或取消置顶。使用该参数对评论置顶，则置顶区的评论上限为 3 条。取值如下：

* `1`：置顶
* `2`：取消置顶

* 使用 `TopStatusV2` 对评论置顶，则置顶区的评论上限为 3 条。也就是说：
   * 若置顶区的评论数小于 3，使用该参数将继续追加置顶评论。
   * 若置顶区的评论数等于 3，使用该参数将先取消置顶最早被置顶的评论，再置顶当前评论。
* `TopStatus` 和 `TopStatusV2` 至少需要传一个，当同时传入时，则以 `TopStatusV2` 为准，即置顶区的评论上限为 3 条。
TopStatusV2.description_en:
(Recommended) Pin or unpin a comment. Use this parameter to pin a comment; the maximum number of pinned comments is 3. Valid values:

* `1`: Pin
* `2`: Unpin

* When you use `TopStatusV2` to pin a comment, the maximum number of pinned comments is 3. That is:
   * If the number of pinned comments is less than 3, using this parameter will add another pinned comment.
   * If the number of pinned comments is 3, using this parameter will first unpin the earliest pinned comment, then pin the current comment.
* You must provide at least one of `TopStatus` or `TopStatusV2`. If both are provided, `TopStatusV2` takes precedence, and the maximum number of pinned comments is 3.

Status.description_cn:
直播模版状态。支持以下取值：
- `2`：下架
- `3`：上架
- `4`：删除
Status.description_en:
Live streaming template status. Supported values:
- `2`: Removed
- `3`: Listed
- `4`: Deleted

TemplateId.description_cn: 直播模版 ID。您可以通过 [GetAccountTemplateAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/171606) 接口查询 ID。
TemplateId.description_en: Live Template ID. You can query the ID using the [GetAccountTemplateAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/171606) API

直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
When using a sub-account to call the interface, make sure this live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

Announcement.description_cn: 直播描述。当 `IsAnnouncementEnable` 取值为 `1`时，该参数必填。
Announcement.description_en: Live stream description. This parameter is required when `IsAnnouncementEnable` is set to 1

AutoReservationWindowEnable.description_cn:
是否开启直播预约弹窗。支持以下取值，默认取值为 `2`。

* `1`：开启
* `2`：关闭

* 如果设置的参数值不是 `1` 或 `2`，则将参数值作为默认值 `2` 处理。
* 仅当 `IsReservationEnable` 取值为 `1` 时，该配置生效。
AutoReservationWindowEnable.description_en:
Whether to enable the live stream reservation popup. Supported values are as follows; the default value is `2`.

* `1`: Enable
* `2`: Disable

* If the parameter value is not `1` or `2`, it will be treated as the default value `2`.
* This setting only takes effect when `IsReservationEnable` is set to `1`.

AutoStartConfig.description_cn:
自动开播重复开播配置。
仅当 `IsAutoStartEnable` 取值为 `1` 时，该配置生效。
AutoStartConfig.description_en:
Auto Start and Repeat Broadcast Settings
This setting is effective only when `IsAutoStartEnable` is set to `1`.

AutoStartType.description_cn:
自动开播类型。当 `IsAutoStartEnable` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数必填。支持以下取值，默认取值为 `0`。

* `0`：不自动开播
* `1`：自动开始录播直播
* `2`：自动开始拉流直播
AutoStartType.description_en:
Auto Start Broadcast Type. This parameter is required when `IsAutoStartEnable` is set to `1`. Supported values are as follows; the default is `0`:

* `0`: Do not auto start broadcast
* `1`: Auto start recorded broadcast
* `2`: Auto start fetching live broadcast stream

BackgroundColor.description_cn: PC 端背景颜色。遵循 RGB 色彩模型。当 `IsPcBackImageEnable` 取值为 `2` 时，该参数必填。仅支持传入 [GetActivityBasicConfigAPI](/docs/3019/100061)接口中获取的背景颜色。
BackgroundColor.description_en: PC background color. Uses the RGB color model. This parameter is required when `IsPcBackImageEnable` is set to `2`. Only supports passing in background colors obtained from the [GetActivityBasicConfigAPI](/docs/3019/100061) interface.

BindAccountLevelGroupId.description_cn:
要绑定的观众等级库 ID。可通过 [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) 接口获取。
* 仅当 `IsViewerLevelShowEnable` 取值为 `1` 时，该配置生效。
* 使用子账号调用接口时，确保等级库对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
* 为保证系统兼容性，您也可以通过不传该参数、或将该参数设置为 `0` 来绑定系统默认等级库（包含 3 个默认等级配置）。
BindAccountLevelGroupId.description_en:
Viewer level group ID to bind. You can obtain it via the [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) API.
* This setting only takes effect when `IsViewerLevelShowEnable` is set to `1`.
* When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the level group is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).
* To ensure system compatibility, you can either omit this parameter or set it to `0` to bind the system default level group (which includes 3 default level configurations).

ColorThemeIndex.description_cn:
外观主题。支持以下取值，默认为 `dark`。

* `light`：清爽模式
* `dark`：暗黑模式

However, if you have obtained the URL of an image uploaded via the [Enterprise Live Console](https://console.volcengine.com/livesaas/liveManagement/) (for example, by calling [GetActivityBasicConfigAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100061) to get the cover image URL uploaded via the console for a specific live room), then the URL without a protocol header can be used as the parameter value.

IsAvatarShowEnable.description_en:
Show viewer avatars on the viewing page. Default value: `0`. Options:

* `0`: Do not display
* `1`: Display

This parameter only controls whether viewer avatars appear on SaaS viewing pages, pages integrated with the Web Viewing SDK, and viewing pages embedded via iframe. To show viewer avatars in apps using the iOS Viewing SDK, call [landscapeShouldShowAvatar](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1185544#landscapeshouldshowavatar) and [portraitShouldShowAvatar](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1185544#portraitshouldshowavatar). To show viewer avatars in apps using the Android Viewing SDK, call [setLandscapeCommentShouldShowAvatar](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125705#setlandscapecommentshouldshowavatar) and [setPortraitCommentShouldShowAvatar](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125705#setportraitcommentshouldshowavatar).

IsViewerLevelShowEnable.description_cn:
是否开启观众等级功能。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：关闭
* `1`：开启。开启功能后，如需在观看页展示观众等级，请确保同时满足以下条件：
   * 观看限制或鉴权模式为自定义，且传入观众的 `LevelId`（等级 ID）：
      * 方式一（SaaS 观看页和 iframe 嵌入观看页）：调用 [UpdateViewingRestriction](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1333840) 接口，将观看限制设置为自定义，并按照[自定义登录](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93578)中的描述，将回调参数 `LevelId` 作为鉴权参数添加至观看页地址，或您的自有账号系统携带回调参数 `LevelId`从自有账号系统登录页面重定向至企业直播鉴权页面。
      * 方式二（集成了 Web 观播 SDK 的观看页）：将 SDK 的 `mode` 参数取值设置为 `2` ，将鉴权模式设置为自定义，并在调用 [GetSDKTokenAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/105049) 接口获取 token 时，传入观众的 `LevelId`。
   * 已成功绑定观众等级库 ID。
IsViewerLevelShowEnable.description_en:
Enable the audience level feature. Default value is `0`. Options:

* `0`: Off
* `1`: On. After enabling this feature, to display audience levels on the viewing page, ensure all of the following conditions are met:
   * The viewing restriction or authentication mode is set to custom, and the audience's `LevelId` (level ID) is provided:
      * Method 1 (SaaS viewing page and iframe embedded viewing page): Call the [UpdateViewingRestriction](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1333840) API to set the viewing restriction to custom. Then, as described in [Custom Login](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93578), add the callback parameter `LevelId` as an authentication parameter to the viewing page URL, or redirect from your account system login page to the enterprise live authentication page with the callback parameter `LevelId`.
      * Method 2 (viewing page integrated with Web Viewing SDK): Set the SDK's `mode` parameter to `2`, set the authentication mode to custom, and provide the audience's `LevelId` when calling the [GetSDKTokenAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/105049) API to obtain the token.
   * The audience level library ID has been successfully bound.

However, if you have obtained a URL for an image uploaded via the [Enterprise Live Console](https://console.volcengine.com/livesaas/liveManagement/)—for example, by calling [GetActivityBasicConfigAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100061) to get the cover image URL for a live room uploaded through the console—you can use the URL without a protocol header as the parameter value.

ThumbUpEffectUrls.description_en:

However, if you obtain a URL for an image uploaded via the [Enterprise Live Console](https://console.volcengine.com/livesaas/liveManagement/) (for example, by calling [GetActivityBasicConfigAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100061) to get the cover image URL uploaded through the console for a live room), you can use the URL without a protocol prefix as the parameter value.

However, if you have obtained the URL of an image uploaded via the [Enterprise Live Console](https://console.volcengine.com/livesaas/liveManagement/) (for example, by calling [GetActivityBasicConfigAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100061) to get the cover image URL uploaded via the console for a specific live room), then the URL without a protocol header can be used as the parameter value.

- "Key" is the index of the embedded link menu, which you can obtain using the [GetActivityMenuAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/105031) interface. For example, if the index of the embedded link menu `Location` is 2, then "Key" is 2.

ForceReplayStatus.description_cn:
直播状态为**预告**时，上架回放视频（即 `OnlineStatus` 参数的取值为 `1` 时）是否将直播状态切换为**回放**。默认值为 `false`。取值如下：
- `true`：直播状态切换为**回放**，且播放上架的回放视频。
- `false`：直播状态不变，且不播放上架的回放视频。
ForceReplayStatus.description_en:
When the live status is Scheduled, choose whether publishing a playback video (that is, when the `OnlineStatus` parameter is set to `1`) will switch the live status to Playback. The default value is `false`. Options:
- `true`: Switches the live status to Playback and plays the published playback video
- `false`: The live status remains unchanged and the published playback video is not played

MediaId.description_cn: 回放列表视频 ID。您可通过 [ListMediasAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100065) 接口的返回参数 `MediaId` 获取 ID。
MediaId.description_en: Playback list video ID. You can get the ID from the MediaId parameter returned by the [ListMediasAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100065) interface.

OnlineStatus.description_cn:
对回放视频的操作。取值如下：
- `0`：下架回放视频。如果直播状态为**回放**且无其他已上架回放视频，则直播状态会切换为**已结束**。
- `1`：上架回放视频。如果直播状态为**已结束**，则直播状态会切换为**回放**。
- `2`：解绑回放视频。如果直播状态为**回放**且无其他已上架回放视频，则直播状态会切换为**已结束**。
OnlineStatus.description_en:
Playback video operations. Values:
- `0`: Remove playback video. If the live stream status is **Playback** and there are no other listed playback videos, the live stream status changes to **Ended**
- `1`: List playback video. If the live stream status is **Ended**, the live stream status changes to **Playback**
- `2`: Unbind playback video. If the live stream status is **Playback** and there are no other listed playback videos, the live stream status changes to **Ended**

CallbackUrls.description_cn:
回调地址，必须以 HTTPS 或 HTTP 开头。用于接收 `CallbackType` 对应类型的回调消息。
每个回调生效账号最多可配置 10 个回调地址，每个回调地址之间通过分号（;）分隔。
CallbackUrls.description_en:
Callback URL. Must start with HTTPS or HTTP. Used to receive callback messages for the corresponding `CallbackType`.
Each account where the callback is effective can configure up to 10 callback URLs. Separate multiple URLs with a semicolon (;).

SubAccountName.description_cn:
回调生效账号。参数取值为子账号的账号。您可调用  [ListSubAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377760) 接口，通过参数 `Name` 获取子账号的账号。
仅在使用主账号调用接口时该参数生效。调用接口后，主账号会替该子账号新增对应回调消息类型的回调配置，
如果子账号为回调生效账号，则仅当该子账号的资源触发回调时，才会向回调地址发送回调消息。例如，您为卡券领取批量聚合回调设置子账号 A 作为回调生效账号，则只有当观众在子账号 A 创建的直播间领取卡券时，企业直播才会发送回调消息到对应的回调地址。
* 如果该子账号无开发集成的可编辑权限，则无法编辑或删除该回调配置。
* 如果不传该参数或传空值，回调生效账号为调用接口的账号。
SubAccountName.description_en:
Callback Effective Account (parameter). Set this parameter to the sub-account's account name. You can call the [ListSubAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377760) API and use the `Name` parameter to get the sub-account's account name.
This parameter only takes effect when the main account calls the API. After the API call, the main account adds the corresponding callback configuration for the specified callback message type for the sub-account.
If you set a sub-account as the callback effective account, callback messages are sent to the callback address only when resources under that sub-account trigger a callback. For example, if you set sub-account A as the callback effective account for the batch card redemption callback, callback messages are sent to the specified callback address only when viewers redeem cards in live rooms created by sub-account A.
* If the sub-account does not have editable permissions for development integration, you cannot edit or delete this callback configuration.
* If you do not set this parameter or leave it empty, the callback effective account will be the account that calls the API.

InteractionScriptId.description_cn:

* 要获取视频库或直播暂存视频的互动脚本 ID，调用 [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684) 接口；
* 要获取录播直播视频的互动脚本 ID，调用 [ListLoopVideos](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1276081) 接口；
* 您也可调用 [CreateInteractionScript](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1413345) 接口创建空白互动脚本并获取该脚本的 ID。
InteractionScriptId.description_en:
Interaction Script ID

How to obtain:

* To get the Interaction Script ID for videos in the media library or temporarily stored live videos, call the [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684) API
* To get the Interaction Script ID for recorded live videos, call the [ListLoopVideos](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1276081) API
* You can also call the [CreateInteractionScript](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1413345) API to create a blank interaction script and obtain its ID

WhitelistScenes.description_en:

* `1`: The domain URL applies to **live streaming and upload** scenarios
* `2`: The domain URL applies to **preview and playback** scenarios
* `3`: The domain URL applies to **live streaming and upload, preview and playback** scenarios

* `false`：结束任务

* 只有“待开始”的福利任务才能开启，“进行中”的任务才能结束。
Start.description_en:
Start or end a bonus task. Values:

* `true`: Start the task
* `false`: End the task

* Bonus tasks are one-time only. After ending, the status changes to "Ended" and cannot be started again.
* Only bonus tasks with "Pending" status can be started; only tasks "In Progress" can be ended.

BonusList.description_cn: 福利任务中的子任务。最多支持添加 50 个子任务。
BonusList.description_en: Subtasks within the bonus task. You can add up to 50 subtasks.

EndTime.description_cn:
福利任务的结束时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。结束时间取值需大于 `StartTime` 的取值，且与 `StartTime` 的差值最大为 604,800，即 7 天。
当 `TaskRunningType` 为 `2` 时，该参数生效且必填。
EndTime.description_en:
End time of the bonus task. Unix timestamp in seconds. The end time must be greater than the value of `StartTime`, and the difference between `EndTime` and `StartTime` must not exceed 604,800 seconds (7 days).
This parameter is required and takes effect when `TaskRunningType` is set to `2`.

Icon.description_cn: 福利任务图标的 URL，需要包含协议头。不传则使用默认图标。支持传入 PNG、JPG、JPEG 格式的图片，尺寸不超过 160×160px，大小不超过 2 MB。
Icon.description_en: The URL for the bonus task icon must include the protocol. If not provided, the default icon will be used. Supports PNG, JPG, and JPEG image formats. Image size must not exceed 160×160px and 2 MB.

Name.description_cn: 直播福利任务的名称，长度不超过 20 个字符，不能为空。
Name.description_en: Name of the livestream bonus task. Must not exceed 20 characters and cannot be empty.
Name.example_en: Watch the livestream and claim rewards

StartTime.description_cn:
福利任务的开始时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。开始时间取值需大于当前时间。
当 `TaskRunningType` 为 `2` 时，该参数生效且必填。
StartTime.description_en:
Start time of the bonus task. Unix timestamp in seconds. The start time must be greater than the current time.
This parameter is required and takes effect when `TaskRunningType` is set to `2`.

TaskRunningType.description_cn:
直播福利任务开启方式。取值如下：

* `1`：手动开启：任务创建后，您可以随时手动开启任务。
* `2`：计划开启：设置一个具体的开始和结束时间，任务将按计划自动开启。
TaskRunningType.description_en:
How to start the livestream bonus task. Available values:

* `1`: Manual start—After creating the task, you can start it manually at any time.
* `2`: Scheduled start—Set a specific start and end time, and the task will start automatically as scheduled.

ActivityCoupons.description_cn: 卡券互动工具信息列表。
ActivityCoupons.description_en: Cards and Coupons Interactive Tool Information List

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can get the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) API.
When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间的 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Livestream room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the livestream room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

Questionnaire.description_cn: 问卷的配置信息，包含问卷题目、选项等。
Questionnaire.description_en: Questionnaire configuration information, including questionnaire title, options, and more.

ActivityID.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityID.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can get the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) API.
  When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

Animation.description_cn: 红包动效 0-标准动效 1-关闭动效
Animation.description_en: Red Envelope Animation Effects 0 - Standard Animation 1 - Disable Animation

AutoSendTime.description_cn:
定时发送红包的时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。
当 `SendRedPacketType` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数必选。
AutoSendTime.description_en:
Scheduled red packet sending time. Unix timestamp, in seconds.
This parameter is required when `SendRedPacketType` is set to `1`.

AwardCondition.description_cn:
参与条件配置。
观众只有在同时满足开启的参与条件后，才能参与抢红包。
如果开启问卷、投票、签到、答题或简答参与条件，观众必须在本场直播期间完成相关活动，才能被视为有效参与。也就是说，直播间必须处于**直播中**状态，且活动必须在本场直播期间完成。
AwardCondition.description_en:
Participation requirements setup
Viewers can join the red envelope event only if they meet all enabled participation requirements
If survey, poll, check-in, quiz, or short answer requirements are enabled, viewers must complete the related activities during this live session for their participation to count. The live room must be in **Live** status, and activities must be completed during this session

BarragePwd.description_cn: 弹幕口令。传入该参数后，将开启弹幕参与条件，观众必须发送该弹幕口令，才能参与抢红包。
BarragePwd.description_en: Barrage code. Enter this parameter to enable the barrage participation condition. Viewers must send the barrage code to participate in grabbing red envelopes.

BlackUserInfoId.description_cn:
中奖黑名单 ID。您可通过调用 [CreateVipOrBlackListUserInfo](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471378) 接口获取 ID。
中奖黑名单，即无法中奖的人员名单。如果某观众被同时添加进优先中奖名单和中奖黑名单，则该观众无法中奖。
BlackUserInfoId.description_en: Winning blacklist ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [CreateVipOrBlackListUserInfo](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471378) API. The winning blacklist is a list of users who cannot win prizes. If a viewer is added to both the priority winning list and the winning blacklist, that viewer cannot win prizes.

ClaimFailureText.description_cn: 观众未抢到红包时的提示文案。长度为 1 到 100 个字符。不传该参数，默认为**很遗憾，您没有抢到红包**。
ClaimFailureText.description_en: Message shown when the audience fails to grab a red envelope. Length: 1 to 100 characters. If this parameter is not provided, the default is **Unfortunately, you didn't get a red envelope**.
ClaimFailureText.example_cn: 很遗憾，您没有抢到红包
ClaimFailureText.example_en: Sorry, you weren’t able to claim a red envelope

ClaimSuccessText.description_cn: 观众抢到红包时的提示文案。长度为 1 到 100 个字符。不传该参数，现金红包默认为**恭喜你，抢到现金红包**，积分红包默认为**恭喜你，抢到积分红包**。
ClaimSuccessText.description_en: Prompt message shown when a viewer grabs a red envelope. Length must be between 1 and 100 characters. If not specified, the default for cash red envelopes is 'Congratulations, you grabbed a cash red envelope', and for points red envelopes is 'Congratulations, you grabbed a points red envelope'.
ClaimSuccessText.example_en: Congratulations! You received a cash red envelope

CustomRedirectUrl.description_cn:
自定义地址。长度为 1 到 500 个字符。
当 `EnableCustomRedirect` 取值为 `true` 时，该参数必选且生效。
CustomRedirectUrl.description_en:
Custom address (1–500 characters)
This field is required and takes effect when `EnableCustomRedirect` is set to true

DeadLine.description_cn:
开奖倒计时。取值范围为 `[1,999]`，单位为分钟。默认值为 `5`。
当 `OpenRedPacketType` 取值为 `0` 时，该参数必选且生效。
DeadLine.description_en:
Draw countdown. Value range: `[1,999]`, unit: minutes. Default: `5`.
This parameter is required and takes effect when `OpenRedPacketType` is set to `0`.

EnableCustomRedirect.description_cn:
是否开启自定义地址提现跳转功能。默认值为 `false`。取值如下： 
- `true`：开启。开启后，观众点击**立即提现**时，即可跳转至 `CustomRedirectUrl` 配置的自定义地址页面。您需自行在页面发放中奖金额并实现红包提现逻辑
- `false`：关闭
当 `EnableCustomRedirect` 和 `EnableMiniApp` 的取值均为 `true` 时，则：
- 在移动端微信环境下，观众会跳转至微信小程序页面
- 在其他环境下，观众会跳转至自定义地址页面
EnableCustomRedirect.description_en:
Enable custom address withdrawal redirect. Default value is `false`. Options: 
- `true`: Enabled. When enabled, viewers who click **Withdraw Now** will be redirected to the custom address page specified by `CustomRedirectUrl`. You are responsible for distributing the prize amount and implementing the red packet withdrawal logic on that page
- `false`: Disabled
If both `EnableCustomRedirect` and `EnableMiniApp` are set to `true`:
- In the mobile WeChat environment, viewers will be redirected to the WeChat Mini Program page
- In other environments, viewers will be redirected to the custom address page

EnableMiniApp.description_cn:
是否开启微信小程序提现跳转功能。默认值为 `false`。取值如下： 
- `true`：开启。开启后，移动端观众在微信环境下点击**立即提现**时，即可跳转至指定微信小程序页面。您需自行在页面发放中奖金额并实现红包提现逻辑
- `false`：关闭
EnableMiniApp.description_en:
Enable WeChat Mini Program withdrawal redirection. Default value is `false`. Options:
- `true`: Enable. When enabled, mobile users in the WeChat environment can tap **Withdraw Now** to be redirected to the specified WeChat Mini Program page. You are responsible for distributing prize money and implementing the red packet withdrawal logic on that page.
- `false`: Disable

IsOpenSmsNotification.description_cn:
是否开启短信提醒。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：关闭
- `1`：开启。开启后，通过手机号登录直播间的观众，在中奖时会收到企业直播发送的红包中奖提醒短信
IsOpenSmsNotification.description_en:
Enable SMS reminders. Default value: `0`. Options:
- `0`: Off
- `1`: On. When enabled, viewers who log in to the live room with their mobile number will receive a red packet winning notification SMS from Enterprise Live if they win

MiniAppId.description_cn:
微信小程序的 App ID，跳转后的页面属于该微信小程序。长度为 1 到 100 个字符。
完成以下步骤，获取 App ID。
1. 使用微信小程序账号登录[微信公众平台](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/)。
2. 在左侧导航栏，选择**设置**。
3. 在**基本设置**页签下查看 App ID。
 
当 `EnableMiniApp` 取值为 `true` 时，该参数必选且生效。
MiniAppId.description_en:
App ID for the WeChat Mini Program. The redirected page belongs to this Mini Program. Length must be between 1 and 100 characters.

Follow these steps to get the App ID:
1. Log in to the [WeChat Official Platform](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/) using your Mini Program account
2. In the left navigation bar, select **Settings**
3. Under the **Basic Settings** tab, view the App ID

This parameter is required and takes effect when `EnableMiniApp` is set to `true`

MiniAppRedirectUrl.description_cn:
跳转后的页面在微信小程序中的相对路径。 长度为 1 到 500 个字符。
 
当 `EnableMiniApp` 取值为 `true` 时，该参数必选且生效。
MiniAppRedirectUrl.description_en:
Relative path of the redirected page within the WeChat Mini Program. Must be 1–500 characters long.
This parameter is required and takes effect only when `EnableMiniApp` is set to `true`.

Name.description_cn:
自定义红包名称。最多支持输入 20 个字符。如果不传值，则：

* 当 `RewardPointNumber` 取值为正整数（即红包个数为指定数量）时，则展示总金额数，如 “1000.00元”或 “3000积分”。
* 当 `RewardPointNumber` 取值为 `-1`（即红包个数为无限制）时，积分红包的名称为 “99999积分”，现金红包的名称为 “99999元”。
Name.description_en:
Custom red packet name. Supports up to 20 characters. If not provided:

* When `RewardPointNumber` is a positive integer (i.e., the number of red packets is specified), the total amount is displayed, such as "1000.00 yuan" or "3000 points".
* When `RewardPointNumber` is `-1` (i.e., unlimited number of red packets), the name for points red packets is "99999 points", and for cash red packets is "99999 yuan".

OpenRedPacketType.description_cn:
开奖方式。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：自动开奖
- `1`：手动开奖
OpenRedPacketType.description_en:
Draw method. Default value is `0`. Options:
- `0`: Automatic draw
- `1`: Manual draw

RangeStatus.description_cn:
中奖条件。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：所有观众的中奖概率相同
* `1`：未中奖观众优先，即加大在当前直播间 30 天未中奖观众的中奖概率
* `2`：重复中奖限制

当 `RewardPointNumber` 取值为 `-1` 时，该参数仅支持设为 `0`。表示当红包配置中存在不限制红包个数的金额时，则中奖条件仅支持设置为所有观众的中奖概率相同。
RangeStatus.description_en:
Winning conditions. Default value is `0`. Options:

* `0`: All viewers have the same chance of winning
* `1`: Priority for viewers who haven't won—viewers who haven't won in the current livestream in the past 30 days have a higher chance of winning
* `2`: Limit repeat winners

When `RewardPointNumber` is set to `-1`, this parameter can only be set to `0`. This means that if the red packet configuration includes an amount for which the number of packets is unlimited, the winning condition can only be set so that all viewers have the same chance of winning.

RedPacketCoverImage.description_cn: 观看页展示的红包图标的 URL，包含协议头。不传该参数，则使用默认红包图标。
RedPacketCoverImage.description_en: URL for the red envelope icon shown on the viewing page, including protocol header. If not provided, the default red envelope icon is used

RedPacketNumber.description_cn:
金额随机时，设置的红包个数。取值范围为 `[1,2000]`。
当 `AmountCalculationType` 取值为 `0` 时，该参数必选且生效。
RedPacketNumber.description_en:
When the amount is random, set the number of red packets. Value range: `[1,2000]`.
This parameter is required and effective when `AmountCalculationType` is set to `0`.

RedPacketType.description_cn:
红包类型。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：现金红包
* `1`：积分红包 

您可以进行二次开发，按照红包中奖结果，向抢到红包的观众发放积分或让观众完成现金红包提现。详见[接入流程](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/106078#%E6%8E%A5%E5%85%A5%E6%B5%81%E7%A8%8B)。
RedPacketType.description_en:
Red Envelope type. Default value is `0`. Available options:

* `0`: Cash Red Envelope
* `1`: Points Red Envelope

You can perform secondary development to, according to the red envelope winning result, distribute points to viewers who win Red Envelopes or allow viewers to withdraw Cash Red Envelopes. See [Integration Process](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/106078#%E6%8E%A5%E5%85%A5%E6%B5%81%E7%A8%8B).

RepeatedAwardLimit.description_cn:
同一观众在当前直播间 30 天内允许中奖（包括实时抽奖和红包）的次数。取值范围为 `[1,99]`，默认值为 `1`。
当 `RangeStatus` 取值为 `2` 时，该参数必选且生效。
RepeatedAwardLimit.description_en:
Number of times a single viewer can win (including real-time draws and red packets) in this livestream room within 30 days. Range: [1,99], default: 1
This parameter is required and takes effect when `RangeStatus` is set to `2`.

SendRedPacketType.description_cn:
红包的发送方式，默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：手动发送。
* `1`：定时发送。需通过 `AutoSendTime` 参数选择定时发送的时间。
SendRedPacketType.description_en:
Red packet sending method. Default value is `0`. Available values:

* `0`: Manual sending
* `1`: Scheduled sending. Use the `AutoSendTime` parameter to select the scheduled sending time.

TotalAmount.description_cn:
金额随机时，红包总金额或总积分。
* 当  `AmountCalculationType` 取值为 `0` 时，该参数必选且生效。
* 对于不同红包类型，其金额或积分单位不同：
   * 现金红包（`RedPacketType` 取值为 `0`）时，取值范围为 `[10,2000000]`，单位为分
   * 积分红包（`RedPacketType` 取值为 `1`）时，取值范围为 `[1,100000]`，单位可通过 `RewardsPointsUnit` 参数配置
TotalAmount.description_en:
When the amount is random, total red packet amount or total points.
* This parameter is required and effective when `AmountCalculationType` is set to `0`.
* For different red packet types, the unit for amount or points varies:
   * Cash red packet (`RedPacketType` is `0`): value range `[10,2000000]`, unit is cents
   * Points red packet (`RedPacketType` is `1`): value range `[1,100000]`, unit can be configured via the `RewardsPointsUnit` parameter

VipUserInfoId.description_cn:
优先中奖名单 ID。您可通过调用 [CreateVipOrBlackListUserInfo](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471378) 接口获取 ID。
* 当 `RewardPointNumber` 取值为 `-1` 时，该参数不生效。表示当红包配置中存在不限制红包个数的金额时，不支持设置优先中奖名单。
* 当优先中奖名单中的人数大于红包数量，则在优先中奖名单中随机抽奖。
* 当红包数量大于优先中奖名单中的人数时，则优先中奖名单中的观众全部中奖且优先获得较大金额的红包，多出的红包在普通观众中随机抽奖。
* 优先中奖名单中，已登录的观众（仅输入昵称的观众除外）无需手动参与抢红包，如果开奖时正在观看直播，即可收到中奖弹窗通知。
VipUserInfoId.description_en:
Priority winner list ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [CreateVipOrBlackListUserInfo](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471378) API.
* When `RewardPointNumber` is `-1`, this parameter is not effective. This means that when the red packet configuration allows unlimited quantity, setting a priority winner list is not supported.
* If the number of users in the priority winner list exceeds the number of red packets, winners are randomly selected from the priority list.
* If the number of red packets exceeds the number of users in the priority winner list, all users in the priority list win and receive larger red packets first. The remaining red packets are randomly awarded to regular viewers.
* Viewers in the priority winner list who are logged in (excluding those who only entered a nickname) do not need to manually participate in grabbing red packets. If they are watching the live stream when the draw occurs, they will receive a winning notification popup.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
  When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure this live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

CoverImage.description_cn: 直播频道封面图。需要包含协议头。不传则为直播封面图。
CoverImage.description_en: Live channel cover image. Must include protocol prefix. If not provided, the live cover image will be used.

LineLanguage.description_cn:
频道的页面默认语言。观看页可根据观众的 PC 端浏览器语言或移动端系统语言，判断默认播放哪个频道的直播内容。例如频道 A 的语言是简中，PC 端浏览器语言为简中的观众在进入直播间时，观看页会默认播放频道 A 的直播内容。支持以下取值：默认取值为 `other`。
- `cn`：简中
- `en`：英文
- `jp`：日文
- `hant`：繁中
- `ko`：韩文
- `other`：其他
LineLanguage.description_en:
Default language for the channel page. The viewing page selects which channel's live stream to play by detecting the viewer's PC browser language or mobile device system language. For example, if Channel A uses Simplified Chinese and a viewer's PC browser language is set to Simplified Chinese, the viewing page will automatically play Channel A's live stream when the viewer enters the live room. Supported values: Default is `other`.
- `cn`: Simplified Chinese
- `en`: English
- `jp`: Japanese
- `hant`: Traditional Chinese
- `ko`: Korean
- `other`: Other

LineName.description_cn: 直播频道名称。最多支持输入 100 个字符。
LineName.description_en:
Live Channel Name
Up to 100 characters allowed

LlsType.description_cn:
是否开启超低延时功能。支持以下取值，默认取值为 `2`。
- `1`：开启，则选择该频道的观众可以 1 秒以内的超低延时观看直播内容。详见[超低延时直播](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/196662)。
- `2`：关闭
LlsType.description_en:
Whether to enable ultra-low latency. Supported values are as follows; the default is `2`.
- `1`: Enable. Viewers in this channel can watch live content with ultra-low latency of less than 1 second. For details, see [Ultra-Low Latency Live Streaming](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/196662)
- `2`: Disable

MainBackupType.description_cn:
是否开启主备流功能。支持以下取值，默认取值为 `2`。
- `1`：开启，则企业直播会推送该频道的两路直播流至主地址和备地址，同时优先播放主地址的直播流。当主地址的推流断流后，可自动切换至备地址，以保证直播的稳定性。
- `2`：关闭
MainBackupType.description_en:
Enable primary/backup stream feature. Supported values; default is `2`
- `1`: Enable. The enterprise live stream pushes two streams for this channel to the primary and backup addresses, prioritizing playback from the primary address. If the primary stream is interrupted, it can automatically switch to the backup address to help ensure stable streaming
- `2`: Disable

MobileDefaultResolution.description_cn:
移动端观看页的智能清晰度。移动端观众进入直播间时，将默认按照智能清晰度播放直播内容。支持以下取值，如未进行特殊配置，默认取值为 `sd`。
- `origin`：原画
- `bd`：蓝光
- `uhd`：超清
- `hd`：高清
- `sd`：标清
MobileDefaultResolution.description_en:
Smart Clarity for Mobile Viewing Page
When viewers enter a live stream on mobile, content will play in smart clarity by default. The following options are supported; if no special configuration is set, the default value is `sd`.
- `origin`: Original picture
- `bd`: Blu-ray
- `uhd`: Ultra HD
- `hd`: HD
- `sd`: SD

PCDefaultResolution.description_cn:
PC 端观看页的智能清晰度。PC 端观众进入直播间时，将默认按照智能清晰度播放直播内容。支持以下取值，如未进行特殊配置，默认取值为 `hd`。
- `origin`：原画
- `bd`：蓝光
- `uhd`：超清
- `hd`：高清
- `sd`：标清
PCDefaultResolution.description_en:
Smart resolution for PC viewing page. When PC viewers enter the livestream room, the stream plays in smart resolution by default. The following options are supported; if no special configuration is set, the default value is `hd`.
- `origin`: original quality
- `bd`: Blu-ray
- `uhd`: ultra HD
- `hd`: HD
- `sd`: SD

Resolution.description_cn:
频道的可选清晰度。观众仅可在您选择的范围内切换清晰度。清晰度越高，对网络环境要求越高。支持以下取值，默认选择 `auto` 且不支持删除。
- `origin`：原画
- `bd`：蓝光
- `uhd`：超清
- `hd`：高清
- `sd`：标清
- `auto`：智能
Resolution.description_en:
Selectable channel resolutions. Viewers can only switch between the resolutions you choose. Higher resolutions require better network conditions. The following options are supported; the default is `auto` and it cannot be removed.
- `origin`: Original quality
- `bd`: Blu-ray
- `uhd`: Ultra HD
- `hd`: HD
- `sd`: SD
- `auto`: Auto

TimeShiftType.description_cn:
是否开启直播时移功能。支持以下取值，默认取值为 `2`。
- `1`：开启，则选择该频道的观众可以拖动进度条跳转至 8 小时内任意过去时间点观看直播内容。详见[直播时移](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/128810)。
- `2`：关闭
开启多商品讲解功能期间，无法开启直播时移功能。
TimeShiftType.description_en:
Whether to enable live time-shift. Supported values (default: `2`):
- `1`: Enable. Viewers of this channel can drag the progress bar to jump to any point within the past 8 hours to watch live content. See [Live Time-Shift](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/128810) for details.
- `2`: Disable
Live time-shift cannot be enabled while multi-product explanation is active.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure this live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-Account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

EmojiSet.description_cn:
自定义表情专辑的配置信息列表。
最多支持配置 10 个自定义表情专辑。
EmojiSet.description_en:
Custom emoji album configuration list
You can configure up to 10 custom emoji albums

Name.description_cn:
子账号的账号，是子账号的唯一标识。长度为 1 到 64 个字符。支持以下字符： - 大写字母 A - Z - 小写字母 a - z - 数字 - 下划线（_）、短横线（-）、句点（.）、@ 和加号（+） 仅手机号支持加号（+）。 参数值根据 `Type` 取值的不同而不同。
- 当 `Type` 取值为 `1` 时，参数值为邮箱，且必须符合邮箱的格式：`user@example.com`。 - 当 `Type` 取值为 `2` 时，参数值为手机号。目前仅支持中国内地手机号，因此参数值必须以 +86 开头。 - 当 `Type` 取值为 `3` 时，参数值为使用您飞书应用的用户的 `union_id`。`union_id` 是用户在同一应用服务商所开发的多个应用下的身份标识。详见[飞书官方文档](https://open.feishu.cn/document/server-docs/contact-v3/user/field-overview)。 您必须提供您的飞书租户信息以及应用信息，完成相关申请，才可以获取用户的 `union_id`。 - 当 `Type` 取值为 `6` 时，参数值为火山引擎 IAM 用户的用户名。您必须先在火山引擎的**访问控制**页面，或调用 [CreateUser](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/65004) 接口创建 IAM 用户。
Name.description_en:
The sub-account username is the unique identifier for the sub-account. Length must be between 1 and 64 characters. The following characters are supported: - Uppercase letters A–Z - Lowercase letters a–z - Numbers - Underscore (_), hyphen (-), period (.), @, and plus sign (+) Only phone numbers support the plus sign (+). The parameter value varies depending on the value of `Type`.
- If `Type` is `1`, the parameter value must be an email address in the format: `user@example.com`. - If `Type` is `2`, the parameter value must be a phone number. Only mainland China phone numbers are supported, so the value must start with +86. - If `Type` is `3`, the parameter value must be the `union_id` of a user in your Feishu app. The `union_id` is the user's identifier across multiple apps developed by the same service provider. See the [Feishu official documentation](https://open.feishu.cn/document/server-docs/contact-v3/user/field-overview) for details. You must provide your Feishu tenant and app information and complete the required application process to obtain a user's `union_id`. - If `Type` is `6`, the parameter value must be the username of a Volcengine IAM user. You must first create an IAM user on the Volcengine **Access Control** page or by calling the [CreateUser](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/65004) API.

NickName.description_cn:
子账号的昵称。长度为 1 到 16 个字符。支持以下字符：
- 大写字母 A - Z
- 小写字母 a - z
- 数字
- 中文
当 `Type` 取值为 `6` 时，如果该参数取值与 IAM 用户的显示名不同，则子账号创建后，会同步更新 IAM 用户的显示名。
NickName.description_en:
Nickname for the sub-account. Must be 1 to 16 characters long. Supports the following characters:
- Uppercase letters A–Z
- Lowercase letters a–z
- Numbers
- Chinese characters
When `Type` is set to `6`, if this value is different from the IAM user's display name, the IAM user's display name will be updated to match after the sub-account is created.

OrganizationId.description_cn: 子账号所属组织的 ID。默认子账号不属于任何组织。您可通过调用 [ListSubAccountOrganizations](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377763) 接口获取 ID。
OrganizationId.description_en: Organization ID for the sub-account. By default, sub-accounts do not belong to any organization. You can get the ID by calling the [ListSubAccountOrganizations](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377763) API.

RoleIds.description_cn:
子账号所属角色的 ID。不传该参数，则默认设置为**默认子账号**角色。您可通过调用 [ListSubAccountRoles](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377762) 接口获取 ID。
当 `Type` 取值为 `3` 时，如果未设置**默认子账号**角色，则在创建子账号时，会自动添加**默认子账号**角色。
每个子账号最多可被赋予 100 个角色。
RoleIds.description_en:
Role ID for the sub-account. If you do not provide this parameter, the **Default Sub-Account** role is assigned by default. You can get the ID by calling the [ListSubAccountRoles](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377762) API.
When `Type` is set to `3`, if the **Default Sub-Account** role is not assigned, it will be automatically added when creating the sub-account.
Each sub-account can be assigned up to 100 roles

Type.description_cn:
子账号的类型。取值如下：
- `1`：邮箱
- `2`：手机号
- `3`：飞书成员
- `6`：自定义

当取值为 `1`、`2` 或 `3` 时，子账号创建后，会同步创建 IAM 用户。
Type.description_en:
Sub-account type. Possible values:
- `1`: Email
- `2`: Phone number
- `3`: Feishu member
- `6`: Custom

When the value is `1`, `2`, or `3`, an IAM user is created synchronously after the sub-account is created.

CoverImage.description_cn: 点播间的横屏封面图的 URL。需包含协议头。建议图片比例为 16:9，支持上传格式为 JPG、PNG 和 JPEG 的图片。图片大小不超过 2 MB。
CoverImage.description_en: The URL of the video room's landscape cover image. Must include the protocol header. Recommended image ratio is 16:9. Supported upload formats are JPG, PNG, and JPEG. Image size must not exceed 2 MB.

Describe.description_cn: 点播间的描述。最多可输入 150 个字符。
Describe.description_en: Description of the video room. Up to 150 characters allowed.
Describe.example_cn: 这是一个视频教室示例
Describe.example_en: This is a sample video classroom

KnowledgeClassSpecifics.description_en: Video configuration for the video room.

Name.description_cn: 点播间名称。长度为 1 到 20 个字符。
Name.description_en: Video room name. Length: 1 to 20 characters.
Name.example_en: Python Data Analysis: From Introduction to Application

OldVideoRoomId.description_cn: 要复制点播间，您可传入被复制的源点播间的 ID。您可通过调用 [ListVideoRooms](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549713?lang=zh) 接口获取 ID。不传表示创建一个新的点播间。
OldVideoRoomId.description_en: To copy a video room, you can provide the ID of the source video room to be copied. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListVideoRooms](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549713?lang=zh) API. If not provided, a new video room will be created.

VideoRoomClassification.description_cn: 点播间类型。目前需固定传入 `1`，表示知识课程类型的点播间。
VideoRoomClassification.description_en: Video room type. Currently, you must enter `1`, which indicates a knowledge course type video room.

ViewUrlPath.description_cn:
点播间观看地址中的路径标识，用于标识点播间，为 URL path 的最后一段。例如，若观看地址为 `https://live.byteoc.com/5528/3085317`，则 `ViewUrlPath` 的值为 `3085317`。默认不传则由系统自动生成。
长度为 1 到 20 个字符。支持以下字符：

* 大写字母 A - Z
* 小写字母 a - z
* 数字
ViewUrlPath.description_en:
The path identifier in the video room viewing address, used to identify the video room. It is the last segment of the URL path. For example, if the viewing address is `https://live.byteoc.com/5528/3085317`, the value of `ViewUrlPath` is `3085317`. If not provided, the system will generate it automatically.
Length: 1 to 20 characters. Supported characters:

* Uppercase letters A - Z
* Lowercase letters a - z
* Numbers

ViewerLevelConfigs.description_cn: 新增的等级配置信息。若指定的等级库中已存在等级，则新增的等级将按入参顺序继续在已有等级后添加。等级总数量不可超过 100 条。
ViewerLevelConfigs.description_en: New level configuration information. If the specified level library already contains levels, the new levels will be added after the existing ones in the order they are provided in the input. The total number of levels cannot exceed 100.

ViewerLevelGroupId.description_cn:
观众等级库 ID。可通过 [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) 接口获取。
* 使用子账号调用接口时，确保子账号拥有对等级库的可编辑权限。有关如何配置子账号的权限范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
* 为保证系统兼容，您也可通过不传或将该参数设置为 `0` 来指定默认等级库（包含 3 个默认等级配置）。
ViewerLevelGroupId.description_en:
Viewer level library ID. You can obtain it via the [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) API.
* When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the sub-account has editing permissions for the level library. For details on configuring sub-account permission scope, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).
* To ensure system compatibility, you can also leave this parameter empty or set it to `0` to use the default level library (which includes 3 default level configurations).

直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。

AwardUserInfoList.description_cn:
用户信息列表。
企业直播按照以下优先级顺序匹配名单中的观众：`UserId`（用户 ID）、`UserTel`（手机号）、`UserName`（用户昵称）。例如配置了 `UserId`，则无论是否能匹配到观众，均不再按 `UserTel` 或 `UserName` 进行匹配。因此，选择其中之一配置即可。
AwardUserInfoList.description_en:
User information list
Enterprise live streaming matches audience members from the list in the following priority order: `UserId` (user ID), `UserTel` (phone number), `UserName` (nickname). For example, if you configure `UserId`, the system will not match by `UserTel` or `UserName`, regardless of whether a match can be found. You only need to configure one of these fields.

Id.description_en: Priority winner list ID or winner blacklist ID. You can call this API and get the ID from the returned parameters `VipUserInfoId` or `BlackUserInfoId`. Pass this parameter to add user information to the specified list.

InteractionScriptId.description_en:
Interactive Script ID

How to obtain:

* To get the Interactive Script ID for videos in the media library or temporarily stored live videos, call the [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684) interface.
* To get the Interactive Script ID for recorded live videos, call the [ListLoopVideos](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1276081) interface.

LineId.description_en:
Live channel ID. You can query the ID using the [ListLiveChannelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1284548) API.
You must provide at least one of `LineId` or `LineIndex`. If both are provided, `LineId` takes precedence.

LineIndex.description_cn:
直播频道的索引值。索引值越小,位置越靠前。取值范围为 [0,19]。
`LineId` 和 `LineIndex` 至少需要传一个，且同时传入时，`LineId` 的优先级更高。
LineIndex.description_en:
Index value for the live channel. Lower values appear earlier in the list. Valid range: [0,19]
At least one of `LineId` or `LineIndex` must be provided. If both are provided, `LineId` takes priority.

DeleteAll.description_cn:
是否删除所有的手机号。取值如下：
- `0`：仅删除部分手机号
- `1`：删除所有手机号
DeleteAll.description_en:
Do you want to delete all phone numbers?
Options:
- `0`: Delete some phone numbers
- `1`: Delete all phone numbers

DeletePhoneList.description_cn:
待删除的手机号列表。
- 该参数仅在 `DeleteAll` 取值为 `0` 时生效。
- 海外地区和中国香港、中国澳门、中国台湾地区的手机号请遵循以下格式：“+” + 国际电话区号 + 手机号，例如 +1XXXXXXXXXX 表示北美手机号。
DeletePhoneList.description_en:
List of phone numbers to delete.
- This parameter is only effective when `DeleteAll` is set to 0.
- For phone numbers from overseas regions, China Hong Kong, China Macau, and China Taiwan, use the following format: “+” followed by the international country code and phone number. For example, +1XXXXXXXXXX represents a North American phone number.

PermissionOrder.description_cn:
主次观看限制类型。取值如下：
- `1`：删除主观看限制中的手机号
- `2`：删除次观看限制中的手机号
PermissionOrder.description_en:
Primary and secondary viewing restriction types. Possible values:
- `1`: Remove phone number from primary viewing restriction
- `2`: Remove phone number from secondary viewing restriction
