LevelIds.description_en: Set of level IDs to delete. You can obtain level IDs using the [GetViewerLevelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1763960) API. After deletion, the remaining levels keep their original order, and sequence numbers start from 1 and increase sequentially.

ViewerLevelGroupId.description_cn:
观众等级库 ID。可通过 [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) 接口获取。
* 使用子账号调用接口时，确保子账号拥有对等级库的可编辑权限。有关如何配置子账号的权限范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
* 为保证系统兼容，您也可通过不传或将该参数设置为 `0` 来指定默认等级库（包含 3 个默认等级配置）。
ViewerLevelGroupId.description_en:
Viewer level library ID. You can obtain it via the [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) API.
* When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the sub-account has edit permissions for the level library. For details on configuring sub-account permissions, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).
* To ensure system compatibility, you can also omit this parameter or set it to `0` to use the default level library (includes 3 default level configurations).

ViewerLevelGroupId.description_cn:
观众等级库 ID。可通过 [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) 接口获取。
* 使用子账号调用接口时，确保子账号对指定等级库有编辑权限。您可通过 [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) 接口判断子账号是否可编辑指定等级库。有关如何配置子账号的权限范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
* 不支持删除系统默认等级库。
ViewerLevelGroupId.description_en:
Audience Level Library ID. You can obtain it using the [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) API.
* When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the sub-account has edit permissions for the specified level library. You can check whether the sub-account can edit the specified level library using the [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) API. For details on configuring sub-account permissions, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).
* Deleting the system default level library is not supported.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Livestream Room ID. You can get the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
  When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the livestream room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring the visibility scope of the sub-account, see [Sub-Account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

DeleteAll.description_cn:
是否删除名单中的全部用户信息。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：根据 `DeleteUserList` 删除指定用户信息
- `1`：删除全部用户信息
如果不传 `DeleteUserList`，该参数必须取值为 `1`。
DeleteAll.description_en:
Whether to delete all user information in the list. Default value is `0`. Available values:
- `0`: Delete specified user information based on `DeleteUserList`
- `1`: Delete all user information
If `DeleteUserList` is not provided, this parameter must be set to `1`.

DeleteUserList.description_cn:
名单中待删除的用户信息。单次接口调用最多支持删除 2100 条用户信息。
您必须先调用 [GetVipOrBlackListUserInfo](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471379) 获取用户信息，再将待删除的用户信息传入该接口。请确保传入的用户信息与 `GetVipOrBlackListUserInfo` 接口返回的用户信息一致。
当 `DeleteAll` 取值为 `0` 时，该参数必选且生效。
DeleteUserList.description_en:
User information to be deleted from the list. You can delete up to 2,100 user records per API call.
You must first call [GetVipOrBlackListUserInfo](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471379) to retrieve user information, then pass the user information to be deleted to this API. Make sure the user information you provide matches the data returned by the `GetVipOrBlackListUserInfo` API.
This parameter is required and takes effect when `DeleteAll` is set to `0`.

Id.description_cn: 优先中奖名单 ID 或中奖黑名单 ID。您可调用 [CreateVipOrBlackListUserInfo](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471378) 接口，通过返回参数的 `VipUserInfoId` 或 `BlackUserInfoId` 获取 ID。
Id.description_en: Priority winner list ID or winner blacklist ID. You can call the [CreateVipOrBlackListUserInfo](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471378) API and obtain the ID from the response parameters VipUserInfoId or BlackUserInfoId.

VodPlayerConfigId.description_cn: 点播播放器 ID。您可以通过 [ListVodPlayerConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1251470) 接口查询 ID。
VodPlayerConfigId.description_en: VOD player ID. You can query the ID using the [ListVodPlayerConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1251470) API

Domain.description_cn: 待删除的 Web SDK 域名配置，即域名 URL，不包含协议头。例如 `www.example.com` 或泛域名  `*.example.com`。
Domain.description_en: Web SDK domain configuration pending deletion, i.e., domain URL without the protocol header, such as `www.example.com` or wildcard domain `*.example.com`

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Livestream Room ID. You can get the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
  When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the livestream room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring the sub-account's visibility scope, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

DeleteAll.description_cn:
是否删除所有的观众白名单。取值如下：
- `0`：仅删除部分白名单
- `1`：删除所有白名单
DeleteAll.description_en:
Do you want to delete all audience whitelist entries?
Values:
- `0`: Delete some audience whitelist entries only
- `1`: Delete all audience whitelist entries

DeleteUserList.description_cn:
待删除的白名单信息列表。白名单信息即观众的邮箱、手机号等信息，长度为 1 到 100 个字符。
该参数仅在 `DeleteAll` 取值为 `0` 时生效。
DeleteUserList.description_en:
List of whitelist entries to delete. Whitelist entries include viewer email addresses, phone numbers, and similar information, with a length of 1 to 100 characters
This parameter is only effective when `DeleteAll` is set to 0

PermissionOrder.description_cn:
主次观看限制类型。取值如下：
 - `1`：删除主观看限制中的观众白名单
 - `2`：删除次观看限制中的观众白名单
PermissionOrder.description_en:
Primary and secondary viewing restriction type. Values:
 - `1`: Remove audience whitelist from primary viewing restriction
 - `2`: Remove audience whitelist from secondary viewing restriction

ActivityID.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityID.description_en:
Live room ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055).
When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on how to configure the visibility range for sub-accounts, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

RedPacketID.description_cn:
红包 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityRedPacket](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471376) 或 [CreateActivityRedPacket](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1468057) 接口获取 ID。
红包开奖时，请确保：

* 红包为已发送状态。即调用 [ListActivityRedPacket](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471376) 接口获取红包 ID 时，`RedPacketStatus` 的取值为 `1`。
* 红包的开奖方式为手动开奖，即调用 [ListActivityRedPacket](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471376) 接口获取红包 ID 时，`OpenRedPacketType` 的取值为 `1`。
RedPacketID.description_en:
Red packet ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListActivityRedPacket](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471376) or [CreateActivityRedPacket](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1468057) APIs.
When drawing a red packet, make sure that:

* The red packet has been sent. That is, when you call [ListActivityRedPacket](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471376) to get the red packet ID, the value of `RedPacketStatus` is `1`.
* The red packet draw method is set to manual. That is, when you call [ListActivityRedPacket](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471376) to get the red packet ID, the value of `OpenRedPacketType` is `1`.

InteractionScriptId.description_cn:
互动脚本 ID。获取方式：

* 要获取视频库或直播暂存视频的互动脚本 ID，调用 [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684) 接口；
* 要获取录播直播视频的互动脚本 ID，调用 [ListLoopVideos](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1276081) 接口。
InteractionScriptId.description_en:
Interactive Script ID. How to obtain:

* To get the Interactive Script ID for videos in the video library or temporarily stored live videos, call the [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684) API.
* To get the Interactive Script ID for recorded live videos, call the [ListLoopVideos](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1276081) API.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can get the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure this live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

ExplainStatus.description_cn:
讲解状态。取值如下：
- `1`：开始讲解
- `2`：讲解结束 
仅在开启直播时移功能时，该参数生效。有关如何开启直播时移功能，详见[直播时移](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/128810)。
ExplainStatus.description_en:
Explanation status. Possible values:
- `1`: Start explanation
- `2`: End explanation
This parameter is only effective when live stream time-shifting is enabled. For details on enabling live stream time-shifting, see [Live Stream Time-Shifting](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/128810).

FloatingStatus.description_cn:
是否浮窗展示商品卡片。取值如下：
- `1`：浮窗展示
- `2`：非浮窗展示
仅在未开启直播时移功能时，该参数生效。
FloatingStatus.description_en:
Whether to display the product card in a floating window. Values:
- `1`: Floating window display
- `2`: Non-floating window display
This parameter is only effective when the live shift feature is disabled.

ProductId.description_cn: 商品卡片 ID。您可调用 [GetActivityProducts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131805) 接口，通过 `Products` 参数中的 `Id` 获取 ID。
ProductId.description_en: Product Card ID. You can call the [GetActivityProducts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131805) API and get the ID from the `Id` field in the `Products` parameter.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can get the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) API.
  When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

DataType.description_cn:
直播间数据类型。目前仅支持取值 `1`，即直播间的以下基础数据。
- 页面访问数据：访问人次、访问人数、访问人数峰值、累计访问时长、人均访问时长、人均访问次数
- 播放器观看数据：预告、直播、回放和总观看的观看人次、观看人数、观看人数峰值、累计观看时长、人均观看时长和人均观看次数
DataType.description_en:
Live room data type. Currently, only the value `1` is supported, which provides the following basic live room metrics:
- Page visit data: total visits, unique visitors, peak visitor count, total visit duration, average visit duration per user, average visits per user
- Player viewing data: For each of preview, live, replay, and overall viewing, the following metrics are provided: total views, unique viewers, peak viewer count, total viewing duration, average viewing duration per user, and average views per user

ActivityId.description_cn:
要封禁的直播间的 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
ID of the live room to be banned. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can query the ID using [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055).
  When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure this live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring the visibility scope of sub-accounts, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

EndTime.description_cn:
切片的结束时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。结束时间取值需同时满足以下条件：
- 大于 `StartTime` 的取值，且与 `StartTime` 的差值最大为 86,400，即 24 小时。
- 小于等于当前时间。
EndTime.description_en:
End time of the slice. Unix timestamp in seconds. The end time must meet all of the following conditions:
- Greater than the value of `StartTime`, and the difference from `StartTime` must not exceed 86,400 seconds (24 hours)
- Less than or equal to the current time

IsBackup.description_cn:
是否为备流，默认为主流。支持以下取值。有关如何开启主备流功能，详见[直播频道管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/66779)。
- `ture`：是
- `false`：否
IsBackup.description_en:
Is this a backup stream? The default is main stream. Supported values are as follows. For details on enabling the main/backup stream feature, see [Live Channel Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/66779).
- `ture`: Yes
- `false`: No

LineId.description_cn: 直播频道 ID。您可以通过 [ListLiveChannelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1284548) 接口查询 ID。
LineId.description_en: Live Channel ID. You can query the ID using the [ListLiveChannelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1284548) API.

StartTime.description_cn:
切片的开始时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。开始时间取值需同时满足以下条件：

- 大于等于`当前时间 - 1,209,600`，即当前时间 14 天及之前的某个时间点。
- 小于 `EndTime` 的取值，且与 `EndTime` 的差值最大为 86,400，即 24 小时。
StartTime.description_en:
Start time of the slice. Unix timestamp in seconds. The start time must meet both of the following conditions:

- Greater than or equal to `current time - 1,209,600`, which means any time within the past 14 days
- Less than `EndTime`, and the difference between start time and `EndTime` must not exceed 86,400 seconds (24 hours)

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID 或点播间 ID。获取方式如下：

* 您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055?lang=zh) 接口获取直播间 ID
* 您可通过调用 [ListVideoRooms](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549713?lang=zh) 接口获取点播间 ID

使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间或点播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593?lang=zh#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live streaming room ID or video-on-demand room ID. You can obtain it as follows:

* Call the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055?lang=zh) to get the live streaming room ID
* Call the [ListVideoRooms](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549713?lang=zh) to get the video-on-demand room ID

When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the live streaming room or video-on-demand room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring the visibility range of sub-accounts, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593?lang=zh#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

Vid.description_cn:
直播间或点播间中的视频 `Vid`。获取方式如下：

* 要获取直播间的视频 `Vid`，您可通过调用 [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684?lang=zh) 接口获取视频的 `Vid` 和视频关联的直播间信息
* 要获取点播间的视频 `Vid`，您可通过调用 [ListVideoRoomMedias](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549787?lang=zh) 接口获取指定点播间视频的 `Vid`
Vid.description_en:
Video `Vid` in a live streaming room or video-on-demand room. You can obtain it as follows:

* To get the video `Vid` in a live streaming room, call the [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684?lang=zh) to obtain the video's `Vid` and the associated live streaming room information
* To get the video `Vid` in a video-on-demand room, call the [ListVideoRoomMedias](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549787?lang=zh) to obtain the `Vid` of the specified video-on-demand room video

TimeRange.description_cn:
查询指定时间范围的统计数据。
- `7day`：最近 7 天
- `30day`：最近 30 天
- `90day`：最近 90 天
- `180day`：最近 180 天
TimeRange.description_en:
View statistics for a specified time range
- `7day`: Last 7 days
- `30day`: Last 30 days
- `90day`: Last 90 days
- `180day`: Last 180 days

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure this live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

ExternalId.description_cn:
关联用户 ID，即观众在第三方平台的唯一标识。
观众通过不同方式登录直播间，关联用户 ID 的取值如下所示。

* 微信：观众在企业直播微信服务号的 OpenID。
* 企业微信：绑定企业直播的企业内部成员 OpenID。
* 自定义：自定义登录时通过 `UserId` 传入的值。详见[自定义登录](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93578)。
* OAuth 2.0：您自有账号系统中用户 ID 对应的字段。
* 飞书：绑定企业直播的飞书企业成员 Open ID。
* 手机号：观众通过手机号注册企业直播后生成的 passport_id。
* 白名单：观众输入的白名单校验信息。

* 如果您集成了观播 SDK，且 SDK 的鉴权模式为自定义模式，关联用户 ID 的取值为调用 [GetSDKTokenAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/105049) 接口时、或调用 [GetActivityLoginSecret](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1927153) 后生成 JWT 时，传入的 `UserIdStr`（观众 ID）。
* 至少传入 `UserId` 和 `ExternalId` 其中之一。如果同时传入，则 `UserId` 优先级更高。
ExternalId.description_en:
Associated User ID is the unique identifier for a viewer on a third-party platform.
Viewers can log in to the livestream room in different ways. The value of the associated user ID is as follows:

* WeChat: The viewer's OpenID for the enterprise livestream WeChat service account
* WeCom: The OpenID of an internal member bound to the enterprise livestream
* Custom: The value passed in via `UserId` during custom login. See [Custom Login](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93578)
* OAuth 2.0: The field corresponding to the user ID in your own account system
* Feishu: The Open ID of a Feishu enterprise member bound to the enterprise livestream
* Mobile Number: The passport_id generated after the viewer registers for enterprise livestream with a mobile number
* Allowlist: The allowlist verification information entered by the viewer

* If you have integrated the Audience SDK and the SDK authentication mode is set to custom, the value of the associated user ID is the `UserIdStr` (viewer ID) passed in when calling the [GetSDKTokenAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/105049) interface or when generating a JWT after calling [GetActivityLoginSecret](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1927153)
* You must provide at least one of `UserId` or `ExternalId`. If both are provided, `UserId` takes precedence

PageItemCount.description_cn: 使用分页查询时，分页查询数量，取值范围为 [1,2000]，默认值为 `1000`。当取值大于 2000 时，默认只返回 2000 条足迹数据。
PageItemCount.description_en: When using pagination query, the number of items per page. The value range is [1,2000], and the default value is `1000`. If the value is greater than 2000, only 2000 footprint records will be returned by default

PageNo.description_cn:
使用分页查询时，分页查询的页码，默认值为 `1`。
接口最多支持返回 10,000 条查询结果，即 `PageNo` × `PageItemCount`≤ 10,000。
PageNo.description_en:
When using pagination query, the page number for pagination. The default value is `1`
The API supports up to 10,000 query results, that is, `PageNo` × `PageItemCount` ≤ 10,000

ScrollId.description_cn:
滚动查询 ID。滚动查询方式适用于查询 10,000 条以上数据的场景。如需使用滚动查询方式，查询方式如下：
首次调用接口查询数据时，该参数传`空值`，第二次调用接口查询时将该参数值设置为首次查询返回参数中 `ScrollId` 的值，第三次调用接口查询时将该参数值设置为第二次查询返回参数中 `ScrollId` 的值，依次类推。
* 当返回参数中的 `UserTrackData` 参数为空时，表示已查询到最后一页。
* 返回参数中 `ScrollId` 值的失效时间为 20 分钟，即超过 20 分钟该 `ScrollId` 值会失效，无法使用该值进行下一次查询。
* 滚动查询方式的优先级更高，即当传入`ScrollId` 参数时，`PageNo` 参数将不再生效。
ScrollId.description_en:
Scroll query ID. The scroll query method is suitable for scenarios where you need to query more than 10,000 records. To use the scroll query method, follow these steps:
When you call the API for the first time, set this parameter to `null`. For the second call, set this parameter to the `ScrollId` value returned from the first query. For the third call, set this parameter to the `ScrollId` value returned from the second query, and so on.
* If the `UserTrackData` parameter in the response is empty, it means you have reached the last page
* The `ScrollId` value in the response expires after 20 minutes. If more than 20 minutes pass, the `ScrollId` value becomes invalid and cannot be used for the next query
* The scroll query method has higher priority. When the `ScrollId` parameter is provided, the `PageNo` parameter will no longer take effect

Channel.description_en: Filter by channel identifier. By default, all channel data is queried. You can use the [ListChannelAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/166063) to query channel identifiers.

PageAdvertiseTypes.description_cn:
营销推广类型。支持以下取值，默认查询所有类型。
- `1`：页头广告
- `2`：页中广告
- `3`：浮标广告
- `4`：商品卡片
- `5`：商品列表（即商品卡片菜单）

支持同时查询多种类型，类型之间通过英文逗号隔开。例如同时查询页头广告和页中广告，则取值为 `1,2`。
PageAdvertiseTypes.description_en:
Marketing promotion type. Supports the following values: all types are queried by default.
- `1`: header ad
- `2`: mid-page ad
- `3`: floating icon ad
- `4`: product card
- `5`: product list (product card menu)

You can query multiple types at once by separating values with commas. For example, to query both header and mid-page ads, use `1,2`.

PageNumber.description_cn:
分页查询页码，默认取值为 `1`。
- 使用滚动查询时，不需要传入该参数。
- 未使用滚动查询时，接口最多支持返回 10,000 条查询结果，即 `PageNumber`×`PageSize`≤10,000。
PageNumber.description_en:
Page number for paginated queries, defaults to `1`
- You do not need to provide this parameter when using scroll queries
- If not using scroll queries, the API can return up to 10,000 results (`PageNumber` × `PageSize` ≤ 10,000)

PageSize.description_cn: 分页查询数量。取值范围为 [1,1000]，默认取值为 `10`。
PageSize.description_en: Items per page. Range: [1,1000], default: `10`

PageToken.description_cn:
滚动查询 ID。滚动查询方式适用于查询 10,000 条以上数据的场景。
使用滚动查询方式时，首次调用接口查询数据时将该参数值设置为 `init`，第二次调用接口查询时将该参数值设置为首次查询返回参数中 `PageToken` 的值，第三次调用接口查询时将该参数值设置为第二次查询返回参数中 `PageToken` 的值，依次类推。当查询到最后分页，没有更多数据时，返回 `finish`。
- 返回参数中 `PageToken` 值的失效时间为 3 分钟，即超过 3 分钟该 `PageToken` 值会失效，无法使用该值进行下一次查询。
- 滚动查询过程中，请勿变更除 `PageSize` 参数外的查询条件，否则会导致接口查询失败。如需变更滚动查询条件，则需重新进行滚动查询。
PageToken.description_en:
Scroll query ID. Use scroll query for scenarios where you need to retrieve more than 10,000 records.
When using scroll query, set this parameter to `init` for the first API call. For the second call, set it to the `PageToken` value returned from the first query. For the third call, use the `PageToken` from the second query, and so on. When you reach the last page and there is no more data, the response returns `finish`.
- The `PageToken` in the response expires after 3 minutes. If you wait longer than 3 minutes, the token becomes invalid and cannot be used for the next query.
- During scroll queries, do not change any query conditions except for the `PageSize` parameter. Changing other conditions will cause the query to fail. If you need to modify the scroll query conditions, start a new scroll query.

SortField.description_cn: 排序维度。取值固定为 `ClickTime`，即观众点击广告或商品卡片等的时间。
SortField.description_en: Sorting Dimension. Value is fixed as `ClickTime`, which is the time when a viewer clicks an ad, product card, or similar item

SortMode.description_cn:

- `asc`：升序
- `desc`：降序
SortMode.description_en:

ExternalId.description_cn:
分享人的关联用户 ID，即在第三方平台的唯一标识。
您可以根据该 ID 识别企业自身的用户身份，以便于按需实现用户洞察和进行数据分析。
该参数的取值与分享人自定义登录时通过 `UserId` 传入的值一致。有关 `UserId` 的详细信息，详见[自定义登录](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93578)。
您必须传入该参数或该接口的 `UserId` 参数。如果同时传入两者，则仅 `UserId` 生效。
ExternalId.description_en:
The associated user ID of the sharer serves as a unique identifier on third-party platforms. You can use this ID to identify your enterprise's users, so you can gain user insights and perform data analysis as needed. This parameter matches the value passed through `UserId` during the sharer's custom login. For details about `UserId`, see [Custom Login](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93578).
You must provide either this parameter or the `UserId` parameter for this API. If both are provided, only `UserId` will take effect.

UserId.description_cn:
用户 ID，分享人在企业直播的唯一标识。

UserId.description_en:

You must provide either this parameter or the `ExternalId` parameter. If you provide both, only `UserId` will be used.

UnionId.description_en: Feishu sub-account. You can obtain a sub-account on the [Enterprise Live Streaming Console](https://console.volcengine.com/livesaas/liveManagement/) by navigating to Account Center > Permission Management > User Management.

ActivityCreator.description_cn:
创建直播间的账号。
- 本参数和 `ActivityIds` 参数至少需要传一个。若两者同时传入，则 `ActivityIds` 参数的优先级更高，即仅查询 `ActivityIds` 字段中直播间的连麦时长使用情况。
- 使用子账号调用接口时，如果未传入 `ActivityIds`，则默认查询该子账号创建的所有直播间的连麦时长使用情况，该参数不生效。
ActivityCreator.description_en:
Account that created the live streaming room.
- You must provide at least one of these parameters: this parameter or `ActivityIds`. If both are provided, the `ActivityIds` parameter takes precedence; only the connection duration usage for live streaming rooms specified in the `ActivityIds` field will be queried.
- When calling the API with a sub-account, if `ActivityIds` is not provided, the query will default to all live streaming rooms created by the sub-account, and this parameter will not take effect.

ActivityIds.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
- 最多支持同时查询 100 个直播间。
- 本参数和 `ActivityCreator` 参数至少需要传一个。若两者同时传入，则本参数的优先级更高，即仅查询该字段中直播间的连麦时长使用情况。
- 使用子账号调用接口时，如需传入该参数，请确保直播间对于该子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityIds.description_en:
Live room ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
- You can query up to 100 live rooms at the same time.
- You must provide at least one of this parameter or the `ActivityCreator` parameter. If both are provided, this parameter takes priority, and only the co-hosting duration usage for the live rooms specified in this field will be queried.
- When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account if you need to pass this parameter. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

EndDay.description_cn:

- 大于等于 `StartDay` 的取值。
- 小于等于 `T-1`，其中 T 表示当前日期。
EndDay.description_en:
Query end date (UTC+8). Format: `yyyymmdd`. The end date must meet both of the following conditions:
- Greater than or equal to the value of `StartDay`
- Less than or equal to `T-1`, where T is the current date

StartDay.description_cn:
查询开始日期（UTC+8）。格式为 `yyyymmdd`。查询开始日期需同时满足以下条件：
- 大于等于 `T-31`，其中 T 表示当前日期。
- 小于等于 `EndDay` 的取值。
StartDay.description_en:
Query start date (UTC+8). Format: `yyyymmdd`. The start date must meet both of the following conditions:
- Greater than or equal to `T-31`, where T is the current date
- Less than or equal to the value of `EndDay`

ActivityCreator.description_cn:

EndDay.description_en:

- Less than or equal to `T-1`, where T is the current date

StartDay.description_cn:
查询开始日期（UTC+8）。格式为 `yyyymmdd`。查询开始日期需同时满足以下条件：

StartDay.description_en:
Query start date (UTC+8). Format: `yyyymmdd`. The query start date must meet both of the following conditions:
- Greater than or equal to `T-31`, where T is the current date
- Less than or equal to the value of `EndDay`

* You can call the [ListVideoRooms](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549713?lang=zh) interface to obtain the on-demand room ID

Vid.description_en:

* To get the `Vid` of an on-demand room video, you can call the [ListVideoRoomMedias](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549787?lang=zh) interface to obtain the `Vid` of the specified on-demand room video

EndLiveTime.description_cn:

EndLiveTime.description_en: Query end time. Use a Unix timestamp in seconds. `EndLiveTime` must be greater than or equal to `StartLiveTime`, and the difference between `EndLiveTime` and `StartLiveTime` must not exceed 15,552,000 seconds (180 days).

PageNumber.description_cn:
分页查询页码，默认取值为 `1`。
- 使用滚动查询时，不需要传入该参数。
- 未使用滚动查询时，接口最多支持返回 10,000 条查询结果，即 `PageNumber`×`PageSize`≤10,000。
PageNumber.description_en:
Page number for paginated queries; default value is `1`
- You do not need to provide this parameter when using scroll queries
- If you are not using scroll queries, the API supports up to 10,000 results in total per request, that is, `PageNumber` × `PageSize` ≤ 10,000

PageSize.description_cn: 分页查询数量，取值范围为 [1,1000]，默认取值为 `20`。
PageSize.description_en: Items per page, range: [1,1000], default: `20`

PageToken.description_cn:
滚动查询 ID。滚动查询方式适用于查询 10,000 条以上数据的场景。
使用滚动查询方式时，首次调用接口查询数据时将该参数值设置为 `init`，第二次调用接口查询时将该参数值设置为首次查询返回参数中 `PageToken` 的值，第三次调用接口查询时将该参数值设置为第二次查询返回参数中 `PageToken` 的值，依次类推。当查询到最后分页，没有更多数据时，返回 `finish`。
- 返回参数中 `PageToken` 值的失效时间为 3 分钟，即超过 3 分钟该 `PageToken` 值会失效，无法使用该值进行下一次查询。
- 滚动查询过程中，请勿变更除 `PageSize` 参数外的查询条件，否则会导致接口查询失败。如需变更滚动查询条件，则需重新进行滚动查询。
PageToken.description_en:
Scroll query ID. Use scroll query for scenarios where you need to retrieve more than 10,000 records.
When using scroll query, set this parameter to `init` for the first API call. For the second call, set it to the `PageToken` value returned from the first query. For the third call, use the `PageToken` from the second query, and so on. When you reach the final page and there is no more data, the response returns `finish`.
- The `PageToken` in the response expires after 3 minutes. If you wait longer than 3 minutes, the token becomes invalid and cannot be used for the next query.
- During scroll queries, do not change any query conditions except for the `PageSize` parameter. Changing other conditions will cause the query to fail. If you need to modify the scroll query conditions, start a new scroll query.

PageToken.description_cn:
滚动查询 ID。滚动查询方式适用于查询 10,000 条以上数据的场景。
使用滚动查询方式时，首次调用接口查询数据时将该参数值设置为 `init`，第二次调用接口查询时将该参数值设置为首次查询返回参数中 `PageToken` 的值，第三次调用接口查询时将该参数值设置为第二次查询返回参数中 `PageToken` 的值，依次类推。当查询到最后分页，没有更多数据时，返回 `finish`。
* 返回参数中 `PageToken` 值的失效时间为 3 分钟，即超过 3 分钟该 `PageToken` 值会失效，无法使用该值进行下一次查询。
* 滚动查询过程中，请勿变更除 `PageSize` 参数外的查询条件，否则会导致接口查询失败。如需变更滚动查询条件，则需重新进行滚动查询。
PageToken.description_en:
Scroll query ID. Use scroll queries when retrieving more than 10,000 records.

* The `PageToken` value in the response expires after 3 minutes. If more than 3 minutes pass, the `PageToken` becomes invalid and cannot be used for the next query.
* During a scroll query, do not change any query parameters except for `PageSize`. Changing other parameters will cause the API call to fail. If you need to modify the scroll query conditions, start a new scroll query.

SearchKeyWord.description_cn:
根据观众的唯一标识或用户 ID 进行查询。唯一标识支持模糊查询。

观众通过不同方式登录直播间，其唯一标识的取值如下所示。
- 公开：观众昵称。	
- 密码：观众昵称。	
- 邀请码：观众昵称。	
- 白名单：观众登录时输入的白名单信息。	
- 飞书：飞书昵称。	
- 微信：观众昵称。	
- 企业微信：观众昵称。	
- 手机号：观众登录时输入的手机号。	
- 自定义：自定义登录时通过 `UserId` 传入的值。详见[自定义登录](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93578#%E5%9B%9E%E8%B0%83%E5%8F%82%E6%95%B0)。	
- OAuth 2.0：您自有账号系统中用户 ID 对应的字段。
如果您集成了 Web 观播 SDK，且 SDK 的鉴权模式为自定义模式（即 `mode` = `2`），唯一标识的取值为调用 [GetSDKTokenAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/105049) 接口时传入的 `UserIdStr`（观众 ID）。
SearchKeyWord.description_en:
Query by viewer’s unique identifier or user ID. Fuzzy search is supported for unique identifiers.

The viewer’s unique identifier varies depending on the login method:
- Public: Viewer’s nickname
- Password: Viewer’s nickname
- Invitation code: Viewer’s nickname
- Whitelist: Whitelist information entered by the viewer during login
- Feishu: Feishu nickname
- WeChat: Viewer’s nickname
- WeCom: Viewer’s nickname
- Mobile number: Mobile number entered by the viewer during login
- Custom: Value passed via `UserId` during custom login. See [Custom Login](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93578#%E5%9B%9E%E8%B0%83%E5%8F%82%E6%95%B0)
- OAuth 2.0: The field corresponding to the user ID in your own account system
If you have integrated the Web Viewer SDK and set the authentication mode to custom (`mode` = `2`), the unique identifier is the `UserIdStr` (viewer ID) passed when calling the [GetSDKTokenAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/105049) interface.

SubAccountName.description_cn:
按回调生效账号筛选。默认返回所有回调生效账号的回调配置信息。

* 参数取值为 `admin@bytedance.com` 时，仅返回回调生效账号为主账号的回调配置信息。
* 参数取值为子账号的账号时，仅返回回调生效账号为该子账号的回调配置信息。您可通过调用 [ListSubAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377760) 接口，获取子账号的账号。
SubAccountName.description_en:
Filter by callback effective account. By default, returns callback configuration information for all callback effective accounts

* If the parameter value is `admin@bytedance.com`, only returns callback configuration information for the main account
* If the parameter value is a sub-account, only returns callback configuration information for that sub-account. You can call the [ListSubAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377760) API to obtain the account of the sub-account

1. 当传入 `CommentId` 且该 `CommentId` 存在时，则根据 `CommentId` 进行定位。
2. 当未传入 `CommentId` 或传入的 `CommentId` 不存在时，则根据 `SendTime` 进行定位。
3. 当未传入 `SendTime` 时，则根据 `PageNumber` 进行定位。
CommentId.description_en:
Comment ID. You can call the [AddInteractionScriptComments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1413348) API and use the `LatestCommentId` returned to get the comment ID. 
If you pass this parameter, the system locates the page containing the comment with the specified ID and updates the returned `PageNumber` value accordingly.
Different input parameters will result in different page numbers in the response. The rules are as follows:
1. If you pass `CommentId` and it exists, the system locates the page by `CommentId`.
2. If you do not pass `CommentId` or the provided `CommentId` does not exist, the system locates the page by `SendTime`.
3. If you do not pass `SendTime`, the system locates the page by `PageNumber`.

PageNumber.description_en:
Page number where the comment is located. Default value is `1`. Must be greater than or equal to 1.
The page number may vary depending on the parameters you provide. The rules are as follows:
1. If you provide `CommentId` and it exists, the page is determined by `CommentId`.
2. If you do not provide `CommentId` or it does not exist, the page is determined by `SendTime`.
3. If you do not provide `SendTime`, the page is determined by `PageNumber`.

SendTime.description_cn:

传入的参数不同，返回结果中定位的页码也存在差异。规则如下所示：
1. 当传入 `CommentId` 且该 `CommentId` 存在时，则根据 `CommentId` 进行定位。
2. 当未传入 `CommentId` 或传入的 `CommentId` 不存在时，则根据 `SendTime` 进行定位。
3. 当未传入 `SendTime` 时，则根据 `PageNumber` 进行定位。
SendTime.description_en:
Time when the comment was sent, measured in seconds. For example, if the parameter value is `10`, the system locates the page containing the first comment sent at or after the 10th second of video playback, and updates the `PageNumber` parameter accordingly.
The page number returned depends on the input parameters. The rules are as follows:
1. If `CommentId` is provided and exists, the system locates the page by `CommentId`.
2. If `CommentId` is not provided or does not exist, the system locates the page by `SendTime`.
3. If `SendTime` is not provided, the system locates the page by `PageNumber`.

PageItemCount.description_en:
Items per page. Default: 100. Range: [1, 1000].
The API supports up to 1000 results per query; that is, `PageNo` × `PageItemCount` ≤ 1000.

PageNo.description_cn:

PageNo.description_en:

Status.description_cn:
按域名配置状态筛选。默认值为`0`。取值如下：

* `0`：全部状态
* `1`：配置中，即已添加 Web SDK 域名配置，但域名尚未加入白名单。
* `2`：已生效，即域名已加入白名单。
* `3`：已失效，即域名白名单已过期或出现异常。
Status.description_en:
Filter by domain configuration status. Default value is `0`. Possible values:

* `0`: All statuses
* `1`: Configuring—Web SDK domain configuration added, but the domain is not yet whitelisted
* `2`: Active—domain is whitelisted
* `3`: Expired—domain whitelist has expired or is abnormal

QuestionnaireId.description_en: Questionnaire ID. You can obtain the questionnaire ID via the [ListActivityQuestionnaire](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2372072?lang=zh) API.

QuestionnairePublishId.description_cn:
当问卷为手动发送或者定时发送时，问卷的发送 ID。
* 当问卷为手动发送或者定时发送时，该参数生效且必传。您可以调用 [ListActivityQuestionnaire](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2372072?lang=zh) 接口，通过 `TriggerTime` 参数获取问卷的发送时机。
* 通过手动或定时发送的问卷，下线后不支持再次发布。
* 当问卷发送时机为观众进入直播时发送或直播结束发送时，则无需传入该参数。且该类问卷下线后，可调用 [PublishActivityQuestionnaire](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2372070?lang=zh) 接口再次发布。
QuestionnairePublishId.description_en:
When the questionnaire is sent manually or scheduled, the questionnaire send ID.
* This parameter is required and takes effect only when the questionnaire is sent manually or scheduled. You can call the [ListActivityQuestionnaire](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2372072?lang=zh) API and use the `TriggerTime` parameter to get the questionnaire send timing.
* For questionnaires sent manually or scheduled, you cannot republish them after taking them offline.
* If the questionnaire is sent when viewers enter the livestream or after the livestream ends, you do not need to provide this parameter. For these questionnaires, you can call the [PublishActivityQuestionnaire](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2372070?lang=zh) API to republish after taking them offline.

ViewerLevelGroupId.description_cn:
观众等级库 ID。可通过 [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) 接口获取。
* 使用子账号调用接口时，确保子账号拥有对等级库的可编辑权限。有关如何配置子账号的权限范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
* 为保证系统兼容，您也可通过不传或将该参数设置为 `0` 来指定默认等级库（包含 3 个默认等级配置）。
ViewerLevelGroupId.description_en:
Viewer level library ID. You can obtain it using the [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) API.
* When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the sub-account has edit permissions for the level library. For details on configuring sub-account permission scopes, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).
* To ensure system compatibility, you can also leave this parameter empty or set it to `0` to use the default level library (which includes 3 default level configurations).

ViewerLevelOrderedIds.description_cn:
所有等级配置 ID 的集合，入参顺序即为新的展示次序。可通过 [GetViewerLevelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1763960) 接口获取所有等级配置 ID。
在一个观众等级库中，观众等级的顺序越靠前，对应的等级越低。
ViewerLevelOrderedIds.description_en:
A collection of all level configuration IDs. The order of the input parameters determines the new display sequence. You can get all level configuration IDs through the [GetViewerLevelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1763960) API.
In a viewer level library, the closer a viewer level is to the front of the list, the lower the level.

该参数仅在开启直播分组功能后生效。更多有关直播分组的内容，详见[直播分组](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1279269)。
AudienceGroupId.description_en:
Live group ID. Default value is `-2`, which sends bot comments to all live groups. You can get the ID by calling the [GetAudienceGroupConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1263527) API.
This parameter only takes effect after the live group feature is enabled. For more details about live groups, see [Live Groups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1279269).

Amount.description_cn:
本次下单的人数，默认值为 `1`，需填写 ≥ 1 的整数。

* 当 `Amount` 取值为 `1` 时，表示本次调用产生 1 人下单。
* `Amount` 取值为 `3` 时，表示本次调用产生 3 人下单。

企业直播服务端会每 5 秒统计并向观播端的聊天区推送一次当前下单的总人数。
例如：在 5 秒内您调用了 10 次本接口，且每次 `Amount` 均为 `1` ，则累计下单人数为 10，聊天区将显示“xxx 等 10 人已下单 x 号商品”。
Amount.description_en:
Number of people placing an order in this transaction. The default value is `1`. Please enter an integer ≥ 1.

* When `Amount` is set to `1`, this call records 1 person placing an order.
* When `Amount` is set to `3`, this call records 3 people placing an order.

The enterprise live streaming server counts and pushes the total number of people who have placed an order to the chat area on the viewer side every 5 seconds.
For example: If you call this API 10 times within 5 seconds and each time `Amount` is `1`, the total number of people placing an order will be 10. The chat area will display: "xxx and 10 people have placed an order for product x".

UserName.description_en: Displays the viewer nickname in the purchase message. Length must be 1 to 15 characters. If this parameter is not provided or left empty, the default is `小*`.

直播间 ID 或点播间 ID。获取方式如下：

* 您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055?lang=zh) 接口获取直播间 ID
* 您可通过调用 [ListVideoRooms](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549713?lang=zh) 接口获取点播间 ID

使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间或点播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593?lang=zh#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live room ID or on-demand room ID. You can obtain it as follows:

* You can call the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055?lang=zh) to get the live room ID
* You can call the [ListVideoRooms](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549713?lang=zh) to get the on-demand room ID

When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the live room or on-demand room is visible to the sub-account. For details on how to configure the visibility range of a sub-account, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593?lang=zh#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

* 要获取直播间的视频 `Vid`，您可通过调用 [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684?lang=zh) 接口获取视频的 `Vid` 和视频关联的直播间信息
* 要获取点播间的视频 `Vid`，您可通过调用 [ListVideoRoomMedias](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549787?lang=zh) 接口获取指定点播间视频的 `Vid`
Vid.description_en:
The video `Vid` in the live room or on-demand room. You can obtain it as follows:

* To get the video `Vid` for a live room, you can call the [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684?lang=zh) to get the video's `Vid` and the associated live room information
* To get the video `Vid` for an on-demand room, you can call the [ListVideoRoomMedias](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549787?lang=zh) to get the `Vid` of the specified on-demand room video

福利任务中的子任务。最多支持添加 50 个子任务。
若不传入该值，则不更新子任务。
BonusList.description_en:
Sub-tasks in the bonus task. You can add up to 50 sub-tasks.
If this value is not provided, the sub-tasks will not be updated.

EndTime.description_cn:
福利任务的结束时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。结束时间取值需大于 `StartTime` 的取值，且与 `StartTime` 的差值最大为 604,800，即 7 天。
若不传入该值，则不更新结束时间。
EndTime.description_en:
Bonus task end time. Unix timestamp in seconds. The end time must be greater than the value of `StartTime`, and the difference between `EndTime` and `StartTime` can be up to 604,800 seconds (7 days).
If this value is not provided, the end time will not be updated.

Icon.description_en: The URL for the welfare task icon must include the protocol. If not provided, the default icon will be used. Supports PNG, JPG, and JPEG image formats. Image dimensions must not exceed 160×160px, and file size must not exceed 2 MB.

Id.description_en: Live bonus task ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityBonusTasks](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2121529) interface.

直播福利任务的名称，长度不超过 20 个字符，不能为空。

Name.description_en:

If this value is not provided, the task name will not be updated.
Name.example_en: Watch the live stream and get great rewards

StartTime.description_cn:

若不传入该值，则不更新开始时间。
StartTime.description_en:
Bonus task start time. Unix timestamp in seconds. The start time must be greater than the current time.
If this value is not provided, the start time will not be updated.

TaskRunningType.description_cn:
直播福利任务开启方式。取值如下：

* `1`：手动开启：任务创建后，您可以随时手动开启任务。
* `2`：计划开启：设置一个具体的开始和结束时间，任务将按计划自动开启。

若不传入该值，则不更新开启方式。
TaskRunningType.description_en:
Live bonus task activation method. The values are:

* `1`: Manual activation: After the task is created, you can manually activate it at any time.
* `2`: Scheduled activation: Set a specific start and end time, and the task will be automatically activated as scheduled.

If this value is not provided, the activation method will not be updated.

- `false`：不支持
AllowCloseIcon.description_en:

AutoSendTime.description_en:
Scheduled coupon delivery time. Unix timestamp in seconds.
This parameter is required when `SendCouponType` is set to `1`.

Count.description_en: Number of issued coupons. Valid values: -1 or any integer from 1 to 1,000,000. -1 means unlimited

CouponId.description_cn:

使用子账号调用接口时，确保卡券对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
CouponId.description_en:
Coupon ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListCoupons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1357821) API.

When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the coupon is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring the visibility scope for sub-accounts, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

CutOffTime.description_cn:
定时截止时间，需晚于当前时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。
该参数仅在 `Rule` 取值为 `3` 时生效。
CutOffTime.description_en:
Scheduled deadline time must be later than the current time. Enter as a Unix timestamp in seconds.
This parameter is only effective when `Rule` is set to 3.

Duration.description_cn:
倒计时。取值范围为 [1,300]。单位为分钟。
该参数仅在 `Rule` 取值为 `2` 时生效。
Duration.description_en:
Countdown. Value range: [1, 300]. Unit: minutes.
This parameter is only effective when `Rule` is set to 2.

Id.description_cn:
卡券互动工具 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityCoupons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1357828) 接口获取 ID。
仅未发送状态的卡券互动工具支持更新，即 [ListActivityCoupons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1357828) 接口中返回参数 `Status` 的取值为 `0` 时。
Id.description_en:
Coupon interaction tool ID. You can get the ID by calling the [ListActivityCoupons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1357828) API.
Only coupon interaction tools in the unsent state can be updated. This means the `Status` parameter returned by the [ListActivityCoupons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1357828) API must be `0`.

IsViewerLevelLimit.description_cn:
是否开启观众等级参与条件。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：不开启。卡券的领取不受观众等级限制。
* `1`：开启。在卡券被发送至观看页后，满足观众等级条件的用户才能看见并领取卡券。
IsViewerLevelLimit.description_en:
Enable audience level participation condition. Default value is `0`. The options are:

* `0`: Disabled. Coupon claiming is not restricted by audience level.
* `1`: Enabled. After the coupon is sent to the viewing page, only users who meet the audience level condition can see and claim the coupon.

IsWatchLiveLimit.description_cn:
是否开启观看直播参与条件。取值如下：
- `0`：不开启。在卡券被发送至观看页后，观众可直接领取卡券，而无需先观看直播。
- `1`：开启。在卡券被发送至观看页后，观众必须先观看直播，才能领取卡券。
IsWatchLiveLimit.description_en:
Whether to enable the livestream participation requirement.
Options:
- `0`: Disabled. After the coupon is sent to the viewing page, viewers can claim the coupon directly without watching the livestream first.
- `1`: Enabled. After the coupon is sent to the viewing page, viewers must watch the livestream before they can claim the coupon.

Rule.description_cn:
领取卡券的截止时间。取值如下：
- `0`：无时间限制。卡券互动工具被发送至观看页后，观众可随时领取卡券
- `1`：卡券在手动停止发放前，均支持领取
- `2`：卡券互动工具被发送至观看页后的指定分钟数内，均支持领取卡券
- `3`：卡券在截止时间前，均支持领取
Rule.description_en:
Coupon claim deadline. Possible values:
- `0`: No time limit. Viewers can claim coupons at any time after the coupon interaction tool is sent to the viewing page
- `1`: Coupons can be claimed until manual distribution is stopped
- `2`: Coupons can be claimed within the specified number of minutes after the coupon interaction tool is sent to the viewing page
- `3`: Coupons can be claimed before the deadline

SendCouponType.description_cn:
卡券发送方式。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：手动发送。后续可调用 [SendActivityCoupon](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1357829) 接口发送卡券。
* `1`：定时发送。需通过 `AutoSendTime`参数选择定时发送的时间。
SendCouponType.description_en:
Coupon delivery method. The default value is `0`. Available values:

* `0`: Manual delivery. You can call the [SendActivityCoupon](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1357829) API to send coupons later
* `1`: Scheduled delivery. Use the `AutoSendTime` parameter to select the scheduled delivery time

ViewerLevelConfigIds.description_cn:
开启观众等级参与条件后，观众需满足的观众等级的 ID 列表。
传入观众等级 ID 之前，请确保当前直播间已绑定观众等级库，且传入的观众等级 ID 属于该等级库。
建议先调用 [GetActivityBasicConfigAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100061) 接口，获取当前直播间绑定的等级库 ID （`BindAccountLevelGroupId`）；再调用 [GetViewerLevelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1763960) 接口，获取等级库中的等级 ID（`LevelId`）。
当 `IsViewerLevelLimit` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数必选。
ViewerLevelConfigIds.description_en: After enabling viewer level participation requirements, viewers must have the viewer level IDs listed here. Before entering viewer level IDs, make sure the current livestream is already bound to a viewer level library, and that the viewer level IDs you enter belong to that library. It is recommended to first call the [GetActivityBasicConfigAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100061) to get the ID of the viewer level library that is bound to the current livestream (`BindAccountLevelGroupId`), then call [GetViewerLevelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1763960) to get the level IDs (`LevelId`) in the library. When `IsViewerLevelLimit` is set to `1`, this parameter is required.

HostAccountId.description_cn:
待与直播间关联的主播账号 ID。您可以通过 [ListHostAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1265790) 接口查询 ID。

HostAccountId.description_en:

- To enable the audience follow host feature, set the live room viewing restriction to Custom. See [Custom Account](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93578) for details.

IsBusinessAccountEnable.description_cn:

- `0`：关闭
- `1`：开启，观看页即可展示主播账号的相关信息。
IsBusinessAccountEnable.description_en:

Id.description_cn:
视频 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684) 接口获取 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保视频对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。

Video ID. You can get the ID by calling the [ListActivityMediaAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/125684) interface.
When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the video is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring the sub-account visibility scope, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

InteractionScriptId.description_cn:
视频绑定的互动脚本 ID。您可调用 [CreateInteractionScript](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1413345) 接口创建空白互动脚本并获取互动脚本 ID。
绑定互动脚本后，在视频作为录播直播播放到指定时间节点时，会按照脚本中配置的上下架时间、讲解起止时间和商品信息展示商品，从而降低运营人力成本、提高商品曝光率、丰富直播带货场景。
一个互动脚本仅支持绑定一个媒资库视频或录播直播视频。
InteractionScriptId.description_en:
Interaction script ID bound to the video. You can call the [CreateInteractionScript](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1413345) API to create a blank interaction script and obtain its script ID.

After binding an interaction script, when the video is played as a recorded live stream at specified time points, products will be displayed according to the script’s configured availability times, explanation periods, and product information. This helps reduce operational workload, increase product exposure, and enrich live commerce scenarios.

Each interaction script can only be bound to one media library video or recorded live stream video.

Animation.description_en: Red packet animation effect 0 - Standard animation 1 - Animation off

AutoSendTime.description_cn:
定时发送红包的时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。
仅当 `SendRedPacketType` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数必选。
AutoSendTime.description_en:
Scheduled red packet sending time. Unix timestamp in seconds.
This parameter is required only when `SendRedPacketType` is set to `1`.

AwardCondition.description_cn:
参与条件配置。
观众只有在同时满足开启的参与条件后，才能参与抢红包。
如果开启问卷、投票、签到、答题或简答参与条件，观众必须在本场直播期间完成相关活动，才能被视为有效参与。也就是说，直播间必须处于**直播中**状态，且活动必须在本场直播期间完成。
AwardCondition.description_en:
Participation Requirement Settings
Viewers can join the red envelope event only if they meet all enabled participation requirements.
If survey, poll, check-in, quiz, or short answer requirements are enabled, viewers must complete the related activities during the current live stream for their participation to count. The live room must be in **Live** status, and activities must be completed within the same live session.

BarragePwd.description_cn: 弹幕口令。传入该参数后，将开启弹幕参与条件，观众必须发送该弹幕口令，才能参与抢红包。
BarragePwd.description_en: Barrage Code. After you enter this parameter, viewers must send the barrage code to participate in grabbing red envelopes

BlackUserInfoId.description_cn:
中奖黑名单 ID。您可通过调用 [CreateVipOrBlackListUserInfo](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471378) 接口获取 ID。
中奖黑名单，即无法中奖的人员名单。如果某观众被同时添加进优先中奖名单和中奖黑名单，则该观众无法中奖。
BlackUserInfoId.description_en: Winner blacklist ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [CreateVipOrBlackListUserInfo](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471378) API. The winner blacklist is a list of users who cannot win prizes. If a viewer is added to both the priority winner list and the winner blacklist, the viewer cannot win.

ClaimFailureText.description_cn: 观众未抢到红包时的提示文案。长度为 1 到 100 个字符。不传该参数，默认为**很遗憾，您没有抢到红包**。
ClaimFailureText.description_en: Prompt message shown when the audience fails to grab a red envelope. Length: 1 to 100 characters. If this parameter is not provided, the default is **Unfortunately, you didn't get a red envelope**.
ClaimFailureText.example_cn: 很遗憾，您没有抢到红包
ClaimFailureText.example_en: Sorry, you didn't manage to grab a red envelope

ClaimSuccessText.description_cn: 观众抢到红包时的提示文案。长度为 1 到 100 个字符。不传该参数，现金红包默认为**恭喜你，抢到现金红包**，积分红包默认为**恭喜你，抢到积分红包**。
ClaimSuccessText.description_en: Prompt message shown when a viewer claims a red envelope. Length: 1 to 100 characters. If this parameter is not provided, the default message for a cash red envelope is **Congratulations, you have claimed a cash red envelope**, and for a points red envelope is **Congratulations, you have claimed a points red envelope**.
ClaimSuccessText.example_en: Congratulations, you grabbed a cash red envelope

CustomRedirectUrl.description_cn:
自定义地址。长度为 1 到 500 个字符。
当 `EnableCustomRedirect` 取值为 `true` 时，该参数必选且生效。
CustomRedirectUrl.description_en:
Custom address (1–500 characters)
This field is required and takes effect when `EnableCustomRedirect` is set to true

DeadLine.description_cn:
开奖倒计时。取值范围为 `[1,999]`，单位为分钟。默认值为 `5`。
当 `OpenRedPacketType` 取值为 `0` 时，该参数必选且生效。
DeadLine.description_en:
Draw countdown. Value range: [1,999] (minutes). Default: 5
This parameter is required and active when OpenRedPacketType is set to 0.

EnableCustomRedirect.description_cn:
是否开启自定义地址提现跳转功能。默认值为 `false`。取值如下： 
- `true`：开启。开启后，观众点击**立即提现**时，即可跳转至 `CustomRedirectUrl` 配置的自定义地址页面。您需自行在页面发放中奖金额并实现红包提现逻辑
- `false`：关闭
当 `EnableCustomRedirect` 和 `EnableMiniApp` 的取值均为 `true` 时，则：
- 在移动端微信环境下，观众会跳转至微信小程序页面
- 在其他环境下，观众会跳转至自定义地址页面
EnableCustomRedirect.description_en:
Enable custom withdrawal redirect. Default value is `false`. Options: 
- `true`: Enabled. When enabled, viewers who click **Withdraw Now** are redirected to the custom address page specified by `CustomRedirectUrl`. You are responsible for distributing the prize amount and implementing the red packet withdrawal logic on this page
- `false`: Disabled
If both `EnableCustomRedirect` and `EnableMiniApp` are set to `true`:
- On mobile WeChat, viewers are redirected to the WeChat Mini Program page
- In other environments, viewers are redirected to the custom address page

EnableMiniApp.description_cn:
是否开启微信小程序提现跳转功能。默认值为 `false`。取值如下： 
- `true`：开启。开启后，移动端观众在微信环境下点击**立即提现**时，即可跳转至指定微信小程序页面。您需自行在页面发放中奖金额并实现红包提现逻辑
- `false`：关闭
EnableMiniApp.description_en:
Enable WeChat Mini Program withdrawal redirect. Default value is `false`. Options:
- `true`: Enable. When enabled, mobile users in the WeChat environment can tap **Withdraw Now** to go to the specified WeChat Mini Program page. You are responsible for distributing prize money and implementing the red packet withdrawal logic on that page.
- `false`: Disable

IsOpenSmsNotification.description_cn:
是否开启短信提醒。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：关闭
- `1`：开启。开启后，通过手机号登录直播间的观众，在中奖时会收到企业直播发送的红包中奖提醒短信
IsOpenSmsNotification.description_en:
Enable SMS notifications. Default value: `0`. Options:
- `0`: Off
- `1`: On. When enabled, viewers who log in to the live room with their phone number will receive a red packet winning notification SMS from Enterprise Live when they win

MiniAppId.description_cn:
微信小程序的 App ID，跳转后的页面属于该微信小程序。长度为 1 到 100 个字符。
完成以下步骤，获取 App ID。
1. 使用微信小程序账号登录[微信公众平台](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/)。
2. 在左侧导航栏，选择**设置**。
3. 在**基本设置**页签下查看 App ID。
 
当 `EnableMiniApp` 取值为 `true` 时，该参数必选且生效。
MiniAppId.description_en:
App ID for the WeChat Mini Program. The redirected page belongs to this Mini Program. Length must be between 1 and 100 characters.

Follow these steps to get the App ID:
1. Log in to the [WeChat Official Platform](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/) using your WeChat Mini Program account.
2. In the left navigation bar, select **Settings**.
3. On the **Basic Settings** tab, view the App ID.
This parameter is required and will take effect when `EnableMiniApp` is set to `true`.

MiniAppRedirectUrl.description_cn:
跳转后的页面在微信小程序中的相对路径。 长度为 1 到 500 个字符。
 
当 `EnableMiniApp` 取值为 `true` 时，该参数必选且生效。
MiniAppRedirectUrl.description_en:
Relative path of the redirected page in the WeChat Mini Program. Length must be between 1 and 500 characters
This parameter is required and takes effect when `EnableMiniApp` is set to `true`

Name.description_cn:
自定义红包名称。最多支持输入 20 个字符。如果不传值，则：

* 当 `RewardPointNumber` 取值为正整数（即红包个数为指定数量）时，则展示总金额数，如 “1000.00元”或 “3000积分”。
* 当 `RewardPointNumber` 取值为 `-1`（即红包个数为无限制）时，积分红包的名称为 “99999积分”，现金红包的名称为 “99999元”。
Name.description_en:
Custom red packet name. Supports up to 20 characters. If not provided:

* When `RewardPointNumber` is a positive integer (i.e., the number of red packets is a specified quantity), the total amount is displayed, such as "1000.00 yuan" or "3000 points"
* When `RewardPointNumber` is `-1` (i.e., unlimited number of red packets), the name for points red packets is "99999 points", and for cash red packets is "99999 yuan"

OpenRedPacketType.description_cn:
开奖方式。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：自动开奖
- `1`：手动开奖
OpenRedPacketType.description_en:
Draw method. Default value is `0`. Available options:
- `0`: Automatic draw
- `1`: Manual draw

RangeStatus.description_cn:
中奖条件。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：所有观众的中奖概率相同
- `1`：未中奖观众优先，即加大在当前直播间 30 天未中奖观众的中奖概率
- `2`：重复中奖限制
RangeStatus.description_en:
Winning conditions. Default value: `0`
- `0`: All viewers have an equal chance of winning
- `1`: Priority for viewers who haven't won, i.e. viewers who haven't won in the past 30 days in this livestream have a higher chance of winning
- `2`: Restriction on repeat winning

RedPacketCoverImage.description_cn:
观看页展示的红包图标的 URL。不传该参数，则使用默认红包图标。
通常情况下，需要传入带协议头的 URL 作为参数值。但如果您获取到了通过[企业直播控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/livesaas/liveManagement/)上传的图片的 URL（例如通过调用 [GetActivityRedPacket](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471375) 获取到了某直播间通过控制台上传的红包图标 URL），则该不带有协议头的 URL 可作为该参数的参数值。
RedPacketCoverImage.description_en: URL for the red packet icon displayed on the viewing page. If you do not provide this parameter, the default red packet icon is used. Normally, provide a URL that includes the protocol header. However, if you have obtained a URL for an image uploaded via the [Enterprise Live Streaming Console](https://console.volcengine.com/livesaas/liveManagement/) (for example, by calling [GetActivityRedPacket](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471375) to get the red packet icon URL uploaded via the console for a specific live stream), you can use the URL without the protocol header as the parameter value.

RedPacketID.description_cn: 红包 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityRedPacket](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471376) 接口获取 ID。
RedPacketID.description_en: Red Packet ID. You can get the ID by calling the [ListActivityRedPacket](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471376) API.

RedPacketNumber.description_cn:
金额随机时，设置的红包个数。取值范围为 `[1,2000]`。
当 `AmountCalculationType` 取值为 `0` 时，该参数必选且生效。
RedPacketNumber.description_en:
When the amount is random, set the number of red packets. Value range: `[1,2000]`.
This parameter is required and takes effect when `AmountCalculationType` is set to `0`.

RedPacketType.description_cn:
红包类型。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：现金红包
- `1`：积分红包
您可以进行二次开发，按照红包中奖结果，向抢到红包的观众发放积分或让观众完成现金红包提现。详见[接入流程](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/106078#%E6%8E%A5%E5%85%A5%E6%B5%81%E7%A8%8B)。
RedPacketType.description_en:
Red packet type. Default value is `0`. Options:
- `0`: Cash red packet
- `1`: Points red packet
You can further develop the feature so that, based on the red packet winning result, you can award points to viewers who grab a red packet or allow viewers to withdraw cash red packets. For details, see [Integration Process](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/106078#%E6%8E%A5%E5%85%A5%E6%B5%81%E7%A8%8B).

RepeatedAwardLimit.description_cn:
同一观众在当前直播间 30 天内允许中奖（包括实时抽奖和红包）的次数。取值范围为 `[1,99]`。默认值为 `1`。
当 `RangeStatus` 取值为 `2` 时，该参数必选且生效。
RepeatedAwardLimit.description_en:
Number of times a single viewer can win prizes (including real-time draws and red packets) in this live stream room within 30 days. Value range: `[1,99]`. Default: `1`.
This parameter is required and takes effect when `RangeStatus` is set to `2`.

SendRedPacketType.description_cn:
红包的发送方式，默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：手动发送。
* `1`：定时发送。需通过 `AutoSendTime`参数选择定时发送的时间。
SendRedPacketType.description_en:
Red packet sending method. Default value: `0`. Available values:

* `0`: Manual send
* `1`: Scheduled send. Use the `AutoSendTime` parameter to select the scheduled sending time

TotalAmount.description_cn:
金额随机时，红包总金额或总积分。
* 当  `AmountCalculationType` 取值为 `0` 时，该参数必选且生效。
* 对于不同红包类型，其金额或积分单位不同：
   * 现金红包（`RedPacketType` 取值为 `0`）时，取值范围为 `[10,2000000]`，单位为分
   * 积分红包（`RedPacketType` 取值为 `1`）时，取值范围为 `[1,100000]`，单位可通过 `RewardsPointsUnit` 参数配置
TotalAmount.description_en:
When the amount is random, total red packet amount or total points.
* This parameter is required and takes effect when `AmountCalculationType` is set to `0`.
* For different red packet types, the unit for amount or points varies:
   * Cash red packet (`RedPacketType` set to `0`): value range `[10,2000000]`, unit is fen (Chinese cent)
   * Points red packet (`RedPacketType` set to `1`): value range `[1,100000]`, unit can be configured via the `RewardsPointsUnit` parameter

VipUserInfoId.description_cn:
优先中奖名单 ID。您可通过调用 [CreateVipOrBlackListUserInfo](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471378)接口获取 ID。
* 当 `RewardPointNumber` 取值为 `-1` 时，该参数不生效。表示当红包配置中存在不限制红包个数的金额时，不支持设置优先中奖名单。
* 当优先中奖名单中的人数大于红包数量，则在优先中奖名单中随机抽奖。
* 当红包数量大于优先中奖名单中的人数时，则优先中奖名单中的观众全部中奖且优先获得较大金额的红包，多出的红包在普通观众中随机抽奖。
* 优先中奖名单中，已登录的观众（仅输入昵称的观众除外）无需手动参与抢红包，如果开奖时正在观看直播，即可收到中奖弹窗通知。
VipUserInfoId.description_en:
Priority winner list ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [CreateVipOrBlackListUserInfo](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1471378) API.
* When `RewardPointNumber` is set to `-1`, this parameter is not effective. If the red packet configuration allows unlimited red packet quantity, setting a priority winner list is not supported.
* If the number of users in the priority winner list exceeds the number of red packets, winners are randomly selected from the priority winner list.
* If the number of red packets exceeds the number of users in the priority winner list, all users in the priority winner list win and receive the larger red packets first. The remaining red packets are randomly awarded to regular viewers.
* Logged-in viewers in the priority winner list (excluding those who only entered a nickname) do not need to manually participate in the red packet draw. If they are watching the live stream during the draw, they will receive a winning notification popup.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
  When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

ActivityId.description_cn: 直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID
You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can get the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
  When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

BanStatus.description_cn:
封禁或解除封禁。取值如下：
- `0`：解除封禁
- `1`：封禁
当 `BanType` 取值为 `0` 或未传入 `BanType` 时，该参数必选且生效。
BanStatus.description_en:
Ban or unban. Possible values:
- `0`: Unban
- `1`: Ban
When `BanType` is set to `0` or not provided, this parameter is required and will take effect.

BanType.description_cn:
操作类型。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：封禁或解除封禁
- `1`：踢出
BanType.description_en:
Operation type. Default value is `0`. Possible values:
- `0`: Ban or unban
- `1`: Kick out

Cookies.description_cn:
封禁、踢出或解除封禁的设备 ID 列表。您可调用 [ListUserBehaviorDataAPIV2](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/167660) 接口，通过返回参数 `Cookie` 获取设备 ID。
建议仅在观众未登录直播间时，使用设备 ID 进行封禁。
* 由于获取的设备 ID 为 Long 类型，请先将取值从 Long 类型转换为 String 类型，再传入该参数。
* `UserIds` 、`Cookies`  和 `ExternalUserIds` 至少有一个必选。
Cookies.description_en:
List of device IDs that are banned, kicked out, or unbanned. You can call the [ListUserBehaviorDataAPIV2](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/167660) API and get the device ID from the returned `Cookie` parameter.
We recommend using device IDs for banning only when viewers are not logged in to the live room.
* Since the device ID is of type Long, convert the value from Long to String before passing it to this parameter.
* At least one of `UserIds`, `Cookies`, or `ExternalUserIds` is required

ExternalUserIds.description_cn:
封禁、踢出或解除封禁的关联用户 ID 列表。关联用户 ID 是观众在第三方平台的唯一标识。您可以根据该 ID 识别企业自身的用户身份，以便于按需实现用户洞察和进行数据分析。观众通过不同方式登录直播间时，关联用户 ID 取值不同，具体取值情况详见[数据统计](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/148172#%E8%A7%82%E4%BC%97%E8%A1%8C%E4%B8%BA%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE)。
最多支持传入 50 个关联用户 ID。
ExternalUserIds.description_en:
List of associated user IDs that have been banned, kicked out, or unbanned. An associated user ID uniquely identifies a viewer on a third-party platform. You can use this ID to identify your organization's users as needed for user insights and data analysis. The value of the associated user ID varies depending on how the viewer logs in to the live room. For details, see [Data Statistics](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/148172#%E8%A7%82%E4%BC%97%E8%A1%8C%E4%B8%BA%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE).
Up to 50 associated user IDs are supported.

UserIds.description_cn:
封禁、踢出或解除封禁的用户 ID 列表。您可调用 [ListUserBehaviorDataAPIV2](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/167660) 接口，通过返回参数 `UserId` 获取用户 ID。
除观众未登录直播间的情况外，均推荐使用用户 ID 进行封禁。
`UserIds` 、`Cookies`  和 `ExternalUserIds` 至少有一个必选。
UserIds.description_en:
List of user IDs to ban, kick, or unban. You can call the [ListUserBehaviorDataAPIV2](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/167660) API and obtain user IDs from the returned `UserId` parameter.
Except when viewers have not logged into the live room, we recommend using user IDs for banning.
At least one of `UserIds`, `Cookies`, or `ExternalUserIds` is required.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID 或点播间 ID。获取方式如下：

* 您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055?lang=zh) 接口获取直播间 ID
* 您可通过调用 [ListVideoRooms](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549713?lang=zh) 接口获取点播间 ID

使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间或点播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593?lang=zh#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live room ID or on-demand room ID. Obtain as follows:

* You can get the live room ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055?lang=zh) interface
* You can get the on-demand room ID by calling the [ListVideoRooms](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549713?lang=zh) interface

When using a sub-account to call the interface, make sure the live room or on-demand room is visible to the sub-account. For details on how to configure the visibility scope of a sub-account, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593?lang=zh#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

IsBilingualEnabled.description_cn:
是否开启中英双语生成。支持以下取值：

* `true`：开启。开启后，后续 AI 总结将自动生成中英双语的视频摘要和知识点总结。观众的观看页将默认显示当前 PC 端浏览器默认语言或移动端系统语言的内容
* `false`：关闭

本参数和 `PublishMode` 参数至少需要传一个。未传入的参数将保持当前配置不变。
IsBilingualEnabled.description_en:
Whether to enable bilingual (Chinese and English) generation. Supported values:

* `true`: Enable. When enabled, subsequent AI summaries will automatically generate bilingual video summaries and key point summaries. The viewer page will display content in the default language of the current PC browser or mobile system
* `false`: Disable

At least one of this parameter or the `PublishMode` parameter must be provided. Parameters not provided will retain their current configuration.

PublishMode.description_cn:
视频总结生成后是否自动发布。支持以下取值：

* `1`：自动发布。AI 生成内容后直接发布
* `2`：手动发布。设为手动发布后，您可以在 AI 生成内容后继续编辑内容

本参数和 `IsBilingualEnabled` 参数至少需要传一个。未传入的参数将保持当前配置不变。
PublishMode.description_en:
Whether to automatically publish the video summary after it is generated. Supported values:

* `1`: Auto publish. The AI-generated content will be published directly
* `2`: Manual publish. When set to manual, you can continue editing the content after the AI generates it

At least one of this parameter or the `IsBilingualEnabled` parameter must be provided. Parameters not provided will retain their current configuration.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间的 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) API.
When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

ExternalUserId.description_cn:
观众的关联用户 ID，即在第三方平台的唯一标识。观众通过不同方式登录直播间，关联用户 ID 的取值如下所示。

* 微信：观众在企业直播微信服务号的 OpenID。
* 企业微信：绑定企业直播的企业内部成员 OpenID。
* 自定义：自定义登录时通过 `UserId` 传入的值。详见[自定义登录](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93578)。
* OAuth 2.0：您自有账号系统中用户 ID 对应的字段。
* 飞书：绑定企业直播的飞书企业成员 Open ID。
* 手机号：观众通过手机号注册企业直播后生成的 passport_id。
* 白名单：观众输入的白名单校验信息。

* 如果您集成了观播 SDK，且 SDK 的鉴权模式为自定义模式，关联用户 ID 的取值为调用 [GetSDKTokenAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/105049) 接口时、或调用 [GetActivityLoginSecret](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1927153) 后生成 JWT 时，传入的 `UserIdStr`（观众 ID）。
* 本参数和 `UserId` 参数至少需要传一个。若两者同时传入，`UserId` 参数的优先级更高。
ExternalUserId.description_en:
The associated user ID of the viewer, which is the unique identifier on a third-party platform. The value of the associated user ID depends on how the viewer logs in to the live room:

* WeChat: The viewer's OpenID in the Enterprise Live WeChat service account.
* WeCom: The OpenID of an internal member bound to Enterprise Live.
* Custom: The value passed in via `UserId` during custom login. See [Custom Login](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93578).
* OAuth 2.0: The field corresponding to the user ID in your own account system.
* Feishu: The Open ID of a Feishu enterprise member bound to Enterprise Live.
* Mobile number: The passport_id generated after the viewer registers for Enterprise Live with a mobile number.
* Allowlist: The allowlist verification information entered by the viewer.

* If you have integrated the Viewer SDK and the SDK authentication mode is custom, the value of the associated user ID is the `UserIdStr` (viewer ID) passed in when calling the [GetSDKTokenAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/105049) API or after generating a JWT via [GetActivityLoginSecret](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1927153).
* You must provide at least one of this parameter or `UserId`. If both are provided, the `UserId` parameter takes precedence.

LevelId.description_cn: 为指定观众绑定的新观众等级 ID。可通过 [GetViewerLevelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1763960) 接口获取。
LevelId.description_en: The new viewer level ID to bind to the specified viewer. You can obtain it through the [GetViewerLevelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1763960) API.

UserId.description_cn:
观众 ID，观众在企业直播的唯一标识。
本参数和 `ExternalUserId` 参数至少需要传一个。若两者同时传入，本参数的优先级更高。
UserId.description_en:
Viewer ID, the unique identifier for a viewer in Enterprise Live.
You must provide at least one of this parameter or `ExternalUserId`. If both are provided, this parameter takes precedence.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。

开启或关闭答题重现功能。取值如下：

IsAnswerRepetitionEnable.description_en:
Enable or disable the answer replay feature. Values:

ActivityId.description_en:

CannotWatchLiveWhenNotInGroup.description_cn:
是否开启不在分组内的观众无法观看直播功能。支持以下取值：

- `1`：开启
CannotWatchLiveWhenNotInGroup.description_en:
Enable the feature that prevents audiences not in the group from watching the live stream. Supported values:
- `0`: Off
