AudienceGroupUsers.description_cn:
待更新的观众分组信息。
最多支持同时更新 10,000 个观众的分组信息。
AudienceGroupUsers.description_en:
Audience group information to be updated
You can update group information for up to 10,000 audience members at once

CallbackUrls.description_cn:
回调地址，必须以 HTTPS 或 HTTP 开头。用于接收指定类型的回调消息。
* 每个回调生效账号最多可配置 10 个回调地址，每个回调地址之间通过分号（;）分隔。
* 至少传入 `CallbackUrls` 和 `SubAccountName` 其中之一。
CallbackUrls.description_en:
Callback URL. Must start with HTTPS or HTTP. Used to receive specified types of callback messages.
* Each enabled account can configure up to 10 callback URLs. Separate multiple URLs with a semicolon (;)
* You must provide at least one of `CallbackUrls` or `SubAccountName`

Id.description_cn:
回调配置的唯一标识符。您可通过调用 [ListCallbackConfigs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1756927) 接口获取 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保回调配置对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
Id.description_en:
Unique identifier for the callback configuration. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListCallbackConfigs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1756927) API.
When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the callback configuration is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

SubAccountName.description_cn:
回调生效账号。参数取值为子账号的账号。您可调用  [ListSubAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377760) 接口，通过参数 `Name` 获取子账号的账号。
仅在使用主账号调用接口时该参数生效。调用接口后，主账号会替该子账号新增对应回调消息类型的回调配置，
如果子账号为回调生效账号，则仅当该子账号的资源触发回调时，才会向回调地址发送回调消息。例如，您为卡券领取批量聚合回调设置子账号 A 作为回调生效账号，则只有当观众在子账号 A 创建的直播间领取卡券时，企业直播才会发送回调消息到对应的回调地址。
* 如果该子账号无开发集成的可编辑权限，则无法编辑或删除该回调配置。
* 如果不传该参数或传空值，回调生效账号为调用接口的账号。
* 至少传入 `CallbackUrls` 和 `SubAccountName` 其中之一。
SubAccountName.description_en:
Callback effective account. Set this parameter to the account of a sub-account. You can call the [ListSubAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377760) API and use the `Name` parameter to get the sub-account's account.

This parameter only takes effect when you call the API using the main account. After you call the API, the main account adds the corresponding callback configuration for the specified callback message type on behalf of the sub-account.

If a sub-account is set as the callback effective account, callback messages are only sent to the callback URL when resources under that sub-account trigger a callback. For example, if you set sub-account A as the callback effective account for batch card claim aggregation callbacks, only when viewers claim cards in live rooms created by sub-account A will Enterprise Live send callback messages to the specified callback URL.

* If the sub-account does not have editable permissions for development integration, you cannot edit or delete this callback configuration.
* If you do not set this parameter or leave it empty, the callback effective account defaults to the account used to call the API.
* You must provide at least one of `CallbackUrls` or `SubAccountName`.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间的 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Livestream room ID. You can obtain the ID via the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
When calling the API with a sub-account, ensure the livestream room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

AutoSendTime.description_cn:
定时发送时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。该时间至少需在当前时间的一分钟之后。
仅当 `SendType` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数生效且必填。
AutoSendTime.description_en:
Scheduled send time. Unix timestamp, in seconds. This time must be at least one minute after the current time.
This parameter is effective and required only when `SendType` is set to `1`.

CannotWatchLivePrompt.description_cn:
踢出提示文案。默认值为 `因长时间未签到，已暂停观看`。长度为 1 到 50 个字符。
仅当 `CannotWathcLiveWhenNotCheckIn` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数生效。
CannotWatchLivePrompt.description_en:
Kick-out prompt text. Default value: `Paused viewing due to prolonged failure to check in`. Length: 1 to 50 characters.
This parameter is effective only when `CannotWatchLiveWhenNotCheckIn` is set to `1`.
CannotWatchLivePrompt.example_cn: 因长时间未签到，已暂停观看
CannotWatchLivePrompt.example_en: Viewing paused due to not checking in for a long time

CannotWatchLiveWhenNotCheckIn.description_cn:
未按时签到的观众是否会被踢出直播间。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：

* `0`：不被踢出
* `1`：被踢出，将无法继续观看直播
CannotWatchLiveWhenNotCheckIn.description_en:
Whether viewers who do not check in on time will be kicked out of the livestream room. Default value: `0`. Available values:

* `0`: Not kicked out
* `1`: Kicked out and unable to continue watching the livestream

CheckInId.description_cn:
签到 ID。

* 要新增签到时，不传该参数或将该参数设为空。
* 要更新签到配置时，传入待更新的签到 ID。您可以通过 [GetCheckInListAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/171603?lang=zh) 接口获取 ID。
CheckInId.description_en:
Check-in ID.

* To add a new check-in, do not pass this parameter or set it to empty.
* To update check-in settings, pass the check-in ID to be updated. You can obtain the ID via the [GetCheckInListAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/171603?lang=zh) interface.

CheckInInfo.description_cn: 签到提示文案。默认值为 `请输入姓名`。长度为 1 到 20 个字符。
CheckInInfo.description_en: Check-in prompt text. Default value: `Please enter your name`. Length: 1 to 20 characters.

CheckInName.description_cn: 签到名称。长度为 1 到 20 个字符。

CommentContent.description_cn:
签到后自动发送的评论文案。长度为 1 到 100 个字符。默认值为 `#用户昵称#已签到`。您可以在文案中插入以下变量，每个变量仅允许使用一次：

* `#用户昵称#`：观众的实际昵称。例如：如果用户昵称为“观众 A”，则该用户签到后默认发送的文案为“观众 A已签到”。
* `#签到时间#`：观众完成签到的时间，格式为 `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm`，例如 2024-03-12 10:32。
* `#签到标题#`：当前签到的名称（即 `CheckInName` 的值）。

仅当 `IsSendComment` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数生效。
CommentContent.description_en:
Comment text automatically sent after check-in. Length: 1 to 100 characters. Default value: `#UserNickname# checked in`. You can insert the following variables in the text, each variable can be used only once:

* `#UserNickname#`: The viewer's actual nickname. For example, if the user's nickname is "Viewer A", the default comment sent after check-in will be "Viewer A checked in".
* `#CheckInTime#`: The time the viewer completed check-in, formatted as `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm`, for example 2024-03-12 10:32.
* `#CheckInTitle#`: The name of the current check-in (i.e., the value of `CheckInName`).

This parameter is effective only when `IsSendComment` is set to `1`.

Deadline.description_cn:
签到倒计时中的分钟数。取值范围为 `[0,999]`，单位为分钟。默认值为 `0`。
总倒计时时长为 `Deadline` 和 `DeadlineSecond` 两个参数设置的时间之和。
Deadline.description_en:
Number of minutes in the check-in countdown. Value range: `[0,999]`, unit: minutes. Default value: `0`.
The total countdown duration is the sum of the times set by the `Deadline` and `DeadlineSecond` parameters.

DeadlineSecond.description_cn:
签到倒计时中的秒数。取值范围为 `[0,59]`，单位为秒。默认值为 `0`。
* 当 `Deadline`取值为 `0` 时，该参数必选且生效，且取值范围为 `[30,59]`。
* 总倒计时时长为 `Deadline` 和 `DeadlineSecond` 两个参数设置的时间之和。
DeadlineSecond.description_en:
Seconds in the check-in countdown. Value range: `[0,59]`, unit: seconds. Default value: `0`.
* When `Deadline` is set to `0`, this parameter is required and effective, and the value range is `[30,59]`.
* The total countdown duration is the sum of the times set by the `Deadline` and `DeadlineSecond` parameters.

IsSendComment.description_cn:
签到后是否会在聊天区发送评论。默认值为`0`，即不发送。取值如下：

* `0`：不发送
* `1`：发送
IsSendComment.description_en:
Whether to send a comment in the chat area after check-in. Default value: `0`, meaning do not send. Available values:

* `0`: Do not send
* `1`: Send

NeedPersonInfo.description_cn:
是否需要用户填写签到信息。默认值为`0`。取值如下：

* `0`：不需要
* `1`：需要
NeedPersonInfo.description_en:
Whether users are required to fill in check-in information. Default value: `0`. Values:

* `0`: Not required
* `1`: Required

SendType.description_cn:
签到发送类型。默认值为`0`。取值如下：

* `0`：手动发送
* `1`：自动发送
SendType.description_en:
Check-in send type. Default value: `0`. Values:

* `0`: Manual send
* `1`: Automatic send

Description.description_cn: 卡券描述，长度为 1 到 500 个字符。
Description.description_en: The coupon description must be between 1 and 500 characters long.

Id.description_cn:
卡券 ID。您可通过调用 [ListCoupons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1357821) 接口获取 ID。

使用子账号调用接口时，确保卡券对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
Id.description_en:
Coupon ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListCoupons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1357821) API.

When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the coupon is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

IsBlockRepeatPickup.description_cn: 卡券领取限制 0-无限制 1-9999对应领取的限制次数
IsBlockRepeatPickup.description_en: Coupon redemption limit: 0 means no restriction; 1–9999 corresponds to the allowed number of redemptions

IsRepeatPickupEnable.description_cn:
卡券是否允许重复领取。取值如下：
- `0`：不允许。观众只能领取一次当前卡券，领取后，在任一直播间点击该卡券，均会提示已领取过该卡券。
- `1`：允许。观众可以在任一直播间多次领取当前卡券。
IsRepeatPickupEnable.description_en:
Allow multiple claims for coupons. Values:
- `0`: Not allowed. Viewers can claim this coupon only once. After claiming, clicking the coupon in any live room will show a message indicating it has already been claimed.
- `1`: Allowed. Viewers can claim this coupon multiple times in any live room.

Name.description_cn: 卡券名称，长度为 1 到 100 个字符。
Name.description_en: Card name must be 1 to 100 characters long

Pic.description_cn:
卡券图片的 URL，需包含协议头。
支持配置大小不超过 2 MB 的 JPG 或 PNG 格式的图片。建议图片尺寸为 160*160。
Pic.description_en:
Coupon image URL must include the protocol header
Supports JPG or PNG format images up to 2 MB
Recommended image size: 160 x 160 pixels

ThirdPartyId.description_cn:
关联卡券 ID，即您自有商城系统中的卡券 ID。长度为 1 到 200 个字符。
通过该 ID，可将当前卡券绑定您商城系统中的卡券，方便后续卡券的发放以及在商城内的核销。
ThirdPartyId.description_en:
Associated coupon ID from your e-commerce system (1–200 characters)
Use this ID to bind the current coupon to one in your e-commerce system, making subsequent coupon distribution and redemption within your e-commerce system easier

VodPlayerConfigId.description_cn: 点播播放器 ID。您可以通过 [ListVodPlayerConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1251470) 接口查询 ID。
VodPlayerConfigId.description_en: VOD player ID. You can query the ID using the [ListVodPlayerConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1251470) API.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
  When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure this live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring the sub-account's visibility scope, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

EnableFloating.description_cn:
是否开启浮层展示。支持以下取值，默认取值为 `false`。
- `true`：开启。点击浮标广告后，将在当前直播页面展开广告，观众可在看直播的同时查看广告。该选项仅在移动端观看页面生效。
- `false`：关闭。点击浮标广告后，将打开新的浏览器标签页展示广告，观众无法同时观看直播与广告。
EnableFloating.description_en:
Enable floating layer display. Supports the following values; the default is `false`.
- `true`: Enabled. After clicking the floating ad, the ad expands on the current live stream page, allowing viewers to watch the stream and view the ad at the same time. This option is only effective on mobile viewing pages.
- `false`: Disabled. After clicking the floating ad, a new browser tab opens to display the ad, and viewers cannot watch the stream and view the ad simultaneously.

HomeUrl.description_cn: 浮标广告的跳转链接。需要包含 https 协议头。
HomeUrl.description_en: Redirect link for floating ad. Must start with https://

ImageUrl.description_cn:
浮标广告图片地址。需要包含 https 协议头。
首次通过该接口更新浮标广告配置信息时，该参数必传。
ImageUrl.description_en:
Floating ad image URL: must start with https://
This parameter is required when updating the floating ad configuration for the first time through this interface

IsCloseEnable.description_cn:
观众是否可以关闭浮标广告。支持以下取值，默认取值为 `0`。
- `0`：可以关闭
- `1`：不可以关闭
IsCloseEnable.description_en:
Can viewers close floating ads? Supported values (default is `0`):
- `0`: Can be closed
- `1`: Cannot be closed

IsEnable.description_cn:
是否开启浮标广告。支持以下取值，默认取值为 `0`。
- `0`：关闭
- `1`：开启
IsEnable.description_en: Enable floating ad. Supported values: `0` (Off), `1` (On). Default is `0`

GetFollowDataUrl.description_cn: 查询接口 URL。您需要自行开发该接口，用于查询用户是否关注主播。详见[关注主播接口](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/129234)。
GetFollowDataUrl.description_en: Query API URL. You need to develop this API to check whether a user follows the streamer. See [Follow Streamer API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/129234) for details.

UpdateFollowDataUrl.description_cn: 更新接口 URL。您需要自行开发该接口，用于更新用户关注主播状态。详见[关注主播接口](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/129234)。
UpdateFollowDataUrl.description_en: Update API URL. You need to develop this API to update the user's follow status for streamers. See [Follow Streamer API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/129234) for details.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可通过调用 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口获取 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can get the ID by calling the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
When using a sub-account to call the interface, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring the visibility scope of the sub-account, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

Advertisements.description_cn:
页中广告信息。
* 单次接口调用新增和更新的页中广告总数上限为 30。
* 页中广告在观看页的播放顺序与数组中的顺序一致。
Advertisements.description_en:
In-page ad information
* You can add or update a combined total of up to 30 in-page ads per API call
* In-page ads play in the same order as they appear in the array on the viewing page

EnableFloating.description_cn:
是否开启浮层展示。取值如下：

* `true`：开启。观众在移动端点击页中广告后，在当前观看页以浮层形式展示广告页面。观众可以在观看直播的同时查看广告。
* `false`：关闭。观众点击页中广告后，页面自动跳转至新的浏览器标签页展示广告页面。观众无法同时观看直播与广告。
EnableFloating.description_en:
Enable floating layer display. Options:

* `true`: Enable. When viewers tap an in-page ad on mobile, the ad page appears as a floating layer over the current stream. Viewers can watch the live stream and view the ad at the same time.
* `false`: Disable. When viewers tap an in-page ad, the ad page opens in a new browser tab. Viewers cannot watch the live stream and view the ad simultaneously.

IsEnable.description_cn:
是否开启页中广告。开启后，观看页展示页中广告。取值如下：

* `0`：关闭
* `1`：开启
IsEnable.description_en:
Enable in-page ads. When enabled, in-page ads are shown on the viewing page. Available options:

* `0`: Off
* `1`: On

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure this live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

Config.description_cn:
互动脚本录制配置。
直播期间无法更新互动脚本录制配置，请在直播开始前完成配置。
Config.description_en:
Interactive Script Recording Settings
You cannot update interactive script recording settings during a live stream. Please complete your settings before the stream starts.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
  使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) API.
  When using a sub-account to call the API, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

CoverImage.description_cn: 直播频道封面图。需要包含协议头。
CoverImage.description_en: Live Channel Cover Image Must Include the Protocol Header

LineId.description_cn:
直播频道 ID。您可以通过 [ListLiveChannelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1284548) 接口查询 ID。
`LineId` 和 `LineIndex` 至少需要传一个，且同时传入时，`LineId` 的优先级更高。
LineId.description_en:
Live channel ID. You can query the ID using the [ListLiveChannelConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1284548) API.
You must provide at least one of `LineId` or `LineIndex`. If both are provided, `LineId` takes precedence.

LineIndex.description_cn:
直播频道的索引值。索引值越小,位置越靠前。取值范围为 [0,19]。
`LineId` 和 `LineIndex` 至少需要传一个，且同时传入时，`LineId` 的优先级更高。
LineIndex.description_en:
Index value of the live channel. Lower values appear earlier in the list. Valid range: [0, 19]
You must provide at least one of `LineId` or `LineIndex`. If both are provided, `LineId` takes priority.

LineLanguage.description_cn:
频道的页面默认语言。观看页可根据观众的 PC 端浏览器语言或移动端系统语言，判断默认播放哪个频道的直播内容。例如频道 A 的语言是简中，PC 端浏览器语言为简中的观众在进入直播间时，观看页会默认播放频道 A 的直播内容。支持以下取值：
- `cn`：简中
- `en`：英文
- `jp`：日文
- `hant`：繁中
- `ko`：韩文
- `other`：其他
LineLanguage.description_en:
Default language for the channel page. The viewing page will automatically play the default channel's live stream based on the viewer's PC browser language or mobile device system language. For example, if Channel A's language is Simplified Chinese and a viewer's PC browser language is set to Simplified Chinese, the viewing page will default to playing Channel A's live stream when the viewer enters. Supported values:
- `cn`: Simplified Chinese
- `en`: English
- `jp`: Japanese
- `hant`: Traditional Chinese
- `ko`: Korean
- `other`: Other

LineName.description_cn: 直播频道名称。最多支持输入 100 个字符。
LineName.description_en:
Live Channel Name
You can enter up to 100 characters

LlsType.description_cn:
是否开启超低延时功能。支持以下取值：
- `1`：开启，则选择该频道的观众可以 1 秒以内的超低延时观看直播内容。详见[超低延时直播](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/196662)。
- `2`：关闭
LlsType.description_en:
Whether to enable ultra-low latency. Supported values:
- `1`: Enable. Viewers in this channel can watch live content with latency under 1 second. See [Ultra-Low Latency Live Streaming](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/196662) for details.
- `2`: Disable

MainBackupType.description_cn:
是否开启主备流功能。支持以下取值：
- `1`：开启，则企业直播会推送该频道的两路直播流至主地址和备地址，同时优先播放主地址的直播流。当主地址的推流断流后，可自动切换至备地址，以保证直播的稳定性。
- `2`：关闭
MainBackupType.description_en:
Enable main/backup stream feature. Supported values:
- `1`: Enable. The enterprise live broadcast will push two streams for this channel to both the main and backup addresses. The main address stream is played first. If the main stream is interrupted, it will automatically switch to the backup address to ensure live broadcast stability
- `2`: Disable

MobileDefaultResolution.description_cn:
移动端观看页的智能清晰度。移动端观众进入直播间时，将默认按照智能清晰度播放直播内容。支持以下取值：
- `origin`：原画
- `bd`：蓝光
- `uhd`：超清
- `hd`：高清
- `sd`：标清
MobileDefaultResolution.description_en:
Smart quality for mobile viewing pages. When mobile viewers enter a live room, the stream plays by default in smart quality. Supported values:
- `origin`: Original quality
- `bd`: Blu-ray
- `uhd`: Ultra HD
- `hd`: HD
- `sd`: SD

PCDefaultResolution.description_cn:
PC 端观看页的智能清晰度。PC 端观众进入直播间时，将默认按照智能清晰度播放直播内容。支持以下取值：
- `origin`：原画
- `bd`：蓝光
- `uhd`：超清
- `hd`：高清
- `sd`：标清
PCDefaultResolution.description_en:
Smart clarity for PC viewing page. When viewers enter a livestream room on PC, the stream defaults to smart clarity mode. Supported values:
- `origin`: Original quality
- `bd`: Blu-ray
- `uhd`: Ultra HD
- `hd`: HD
- `sd`: SD

Resolution.description_cn:
频道的可选清晰度。观众仅可在您选择的范围内切换清晰度。清晰度越高，对网络环境要求越高。支持以下取值，默认选择 `auto` 且不支持删除。
- `origin`：原画
- `bd`：蓝光
- `uhd`：超清
- `hd`：高清
- `sd`：标清
- `auto`：智能
Resolution.description_en:
Selectable channel video quality. Viewers can only switch between the quality levels you choose. Higher quality requires better network conditions. The following options are supported; `auto` is selected by default and cannot be removed.
- `origin`: Original picture
- `bd`: Blu-ray
- `uhd`: Ultra HD
- `hd`: HD
- `sd`: SD
- `auto`: Smart

TimeShiftType.description_cn:
是否开启直播时移功能。支持以下取值：
- `1`：开启，则选择该频道的观众可以拖动进度条跳转至 8 小时内任意过去时间点观看直播内容。详见[直播时移](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/128810)。
- `2`：关闭
开启多商品讲解功能期间，无法开启直播时移功能。
TimeShiftType.description_en:
Enable live stream time-shift. Supported values:
- `1`: Enable. Viewers can drag the progress bar to jump to any point within the past 8 hours to watch previous live content. See [Live Stream Time-Shift](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/128810) for details
- `2`: Disable
You cannot enable live stream time-shift while multi-product presentation is active

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) interface.
When using a sub-account to call the interface, make sure this live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

IsStartAllLine.description_cn:
是否开启当前直播间所有直播频道的录播直播。默认值为 `false`。取值如下：

* `true`：全部开启
* `false`：仅开启当前直播频道

* 当 `IsStartLoopVideo` 取值为 `2` 时，无需传入该参数。
* 未传入 `LineId` 参数时，本参数必传且取值必须为 `true`。
* `LineId` 和 `IsStartAllLine` 同时传入时，`IsStartAllLine` 的优先级更高。
IsStartAllLine.description_en:
Enable recorded/live playback for all live channels in the current live room. Default value is `false`. Options:

* `true`: Enable for all live channels
* `false`: Enable only for the current live channel

* If `IsStartLoopVideo` is set to `2`, you do not need to provide this parameter
* If the `LineId` parameter is not provided, this parameter is required and must be set to `true`
* If both `LineId` and `IsStartAllLine` are provided, `IsStartAllLine` takes precedence

IsStartLoopVideo.description_cn:
是否开始录播直播。取值如下：

* `1`：开始
* `2`：关闭
IsStartLoopVideo.description_en:
Whether to start recording live stream. Values:

* `1`: Start
* `2`: Close

LineId.description_cn:
直播频道 ID。您可通过调用 [GetStreamsAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100059) 接口获取 ID。
确保直播间内仅存在一个直播频道。
LineId.description_en:
Live Channel ID. You can get the ID by calling the [GetStreamsAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100059) interface.
Make sure there is only one live channel in the live room.

ActivityId.description_cn:
直播间 ID。您可以通过 [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) 接口查询 ID。
使用子账号调用接口时，确保该直播间对子账号可见。有关如何配置子账号的可见范围，详见[子账号管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2)。
ActivityId.description_en:
Live Room ID. You can query the ID using the [ListActivityAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100055) API.
When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring the sub-account's visibility scope, see [Sub-Account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

AutoEndTime.description_cn:
录播直播自动结束时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。支持精确到分钟级开播。
在录播直播自动开始和结束的时间段内，录播直播视频列表会循环播放。
该参数取值需大于 `AutoStartTime` 的取值，且与 `AutoStartTime` 的差值最大为 259,200，即 72 小时。
当 `PlayType` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数必选且生效。
AutoEndTime.description_en:
Set the automatic end time for recorded live streams using a Unix timestamp in seconds. The stream supports minute-level precision for its start time.

During the period between the automatic start and end times, the recorded live stream video list will loop.

This value must be greater than `AutoStartTime`, and the difference between this value and `AutoStartTime` cannot exceed 259,200 seconds (72 hours).

This parameter is required and takes effect when `PlayType` is set to `1`.

AutoStartTime.description_cn:
录播直播自动开始时间。Unix 时间戳，单位为秒。支持精确到分钟级开播。
在录播直播自动开始和结束的时间段内，录播直播视频列表会循环播放。
该参数取值需同时满足以下条件：
- 大于等于`当前时间 + 300`，即当前时间 5 分钟及之后的某个时间点。
- 小于 `AutoEndTime` 的取值，且与 `AutoEndTime` 的差值最大为 259,200，即 72 小时。
当 `PlayType` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数必选且生效。
AutoStartTime.description_en:
Recorded live stream auto start time. Unix timestamp in seconds. Supports starting at minute-level precision.
During the auto start and end time period, the recorded live stream video list will loop playback.
This parameter must meet all of the following conditions:
- Greater than or equal to `current time + 300`, which means at least 5 minutes after the current time
- Less than the value of `AutoEndTime`, and the difference between this value and `AutoEndTime` must not exceed 259,200 seconds (72 hours)
This parameter is required and takes effect when `PlayType` is set to `1`

IsShowProgram.description_cn:
是否在观看页展示节目单，即录播直播视频列表。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：
- `0`：不展示  
- `1`：展示。仅在视频列表中存在 2 个及以上视频时，支持展示节目单
IsShowProgram.description_en:
Show program list on viewing page (recorded and live video list). Default value: `0`. Options:
- `0`: Do not show
- `1`: Show. Program list can only be displayed when there are two or more videos in the list

LineId.description_cn:
直播频道 ID。您可通过调用 [GetStreamsAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100059)接口获取 ID。
确保直播间内仅存在一个直播频道。
LineId.description_en:
Live channel ID. You can get the ID by calling the [GetStreamsAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100059) interface.
Make sure there is only one live channel in the streaming room.

LoopNumber.description_cn:
录播直播次数。默认值为 `1`。取值范围为 [1,50]。例如，参数取值为 `3`，则录播直播开始后，录播直播视频列表会循环播放 3 次。
当 `PlayType` 取值为 `0` 时，该参数必选且生效。
LoopNumber.description_en:
Recorded live stream play count. Default value: `1`. Range: [1, 50]. For example, if the parameter is set to `3`, after the recorded live stream starts, the video list will loop and play 3 times.
This parameter is required and takes effect when `PlayType` is set to `0`.

LoopVideos.description_cn: 录播直播视频信息。视频总大小需小于等于 200 GB。
LoopVideos.description_en:
Recorded and live video information
Total video size must be 200 GB or less

PlayType.description_cn:
录播直播类型。默认值为 `0`。取值如下：  
- `0`：按次数录播直播
- `1`：按时间段录播直播
如果您在控制台的**观看页管理** > **基础信息**页面打开**自动开播**开关并选择**开始录播直播**，或者调用 [UpdateActivityBasicConfigAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100060) 接口并将 `IsAutoStartEnable` 和 `AutoStartType` 的参数值均设置为 `1`，则：
- 当 `PlayType` 取值为 `0` 时，将按照**基础信息**页面设置的直播时间或 `UpdateActivityBasicConfigAPI` 接口中的 `LiveTime`（直播开始时间）自动开始录播直播。
- 当 `PlayType` 取值为 `1` 时，将根据以下规则进行处理：
	- 如果**基础信息**页面设置的直播时间或 `UpdateActivityBasicConfigAPI` 接口中的 `LiveTime`（直播开始时间）小于等于当前接口的 `AutoStartTime`（录播直播自动开始时间），则根据直播时间或 `LiveTime` 自动开始录播直播，并在到达 `AutoEndTime`（录播直播自动结束时间）时自动结束录播直播。
	- 如果**基础信息**页面设置的直播时间或 `UpdateActivityBasicConfigAPI` 接口中的 `LiveTime`（直播开始时间）大于当前接口的 `AutoStartTime`（录播直播自动开始时间）且小于 `AutoEndTime`（录播直播自动结束时间），则根据 `AutoStartTime` 和 `AutoEndTime` 开始和结束录播直播。
	- 如果**基础信息**页面设置的直播时间或 `UpdateActivityBasicConfigAPI` 接口中的 `LiveTime`（直播开始时间）大于等于当前接口的 `AutoEndTime`（录播直播自动结束时间），则不进行录播直播。
PlayType.description_en:
Recorded live streaming type. Default value is `0`. Options:  
- `0`: Recorded live streaming by number of sessions
- `1`: Recorded live streaming by time period
If you enable **Auto Start** and select **Start Recorded Live Streaming** on the **Watch Page Management** > **Basic Info** page in the console, or call the [UpdateActivityBasicConfigAPI](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/100060) and set both `IsAutoStartEnable` and `AutoStartType` to `1`, then:
- When `PlayType` is `0`, recorded live streaming will automatically start at the time set on the **Basic Info** page or the `LiveTime` specified in the API.
- When `PlayType` is `1`, the following rules apply:
	- If the time set on the **Basic Info** page or the `LiveTime` in the API is less than or equal to the current API's `AutoStartTime`, recorded live streaming will start automatically at that time and end automatically at `AutoEndTime`.
	- If the time set on the **Basic Info** page or the `LiveTime` in the API is greater than `AutoStartTime` and less than `AutoEndTime`, recorded live streaming will start and end according to `AutoStartTime` and `AutoEndTime`.
	- If the time set on the **Basic Info** page or the `LiveTime` in the API is greater than or equal to `AutoEndTime`, recorded live streaming will not start.

ProgramName.description_cn:
节目单名称。长度为 1 到 8 个字符。
当 `IsShowProgram` 取值为 `1` 时，该参数必选且生效。

Program list name

* `1`：已售罄

OutOfStock.description_en:
Indicates whether all products associated with the specified product card are sold out. When products are sold out, the product image and redirect image on the viewing page will display the 'Sold Out' label. Possible values:

* `0`: Not sold out
* `1`: Sold out

If the product price is hidden, sold-out products are not supported. You can call the [GetActivityProducts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131805) API to check whether the product price is hidden. Call the [HideProductPrice](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1827284) API to update the hidden status of the product price.

Product.description_en:
Product card configuration information

This ensures that the parameter values are not cleared or replaced with default values. You can call the [GetActivityProducts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1131805) API and retrieve product card configuration information from the `Product` response parameter.
* When `Action` is set to `3`, only the `Id` parameter in the product card configuration is effective.

ReorderIndex.description_cn:
新增或更新商品卡片时，如果商品卡片的序号（`Index` 取值）与当前商品卡片菜单下已有的商品卡片序号相同，是否重新排序菜单下的商品卡片。默认值为 `false`。取值如下：

* `true`：重新排序商品卡片，将已有的商品卡片的序号向后顺延。例如，当前商品卡片菜单下存在商品卡片 A、B 和 C，序号分别为 1、2 和 3，当新增一个序号为 2 的商品卡片，则商品卡片 A 的序号为 1，新增商品卡片的序号为 2，商品卡片 B 的序号为 3，商品卡片 C 的序号为 4。
* `false`：不重新排序商品卡片，可能存在相同序号的商品卡片。相同序号的商品卡片排序随机。
ReorderIndex.description_en:
When adding or updating a product card, if the card's index (`Index` value) matches the index of an existing product card in the current menu, choose whether to reorder the product cards in the menu. The default value is `false`. Options:

* `true`: Reorder product cards and shift the indexes of existing cards back. For example, if the menu contains product cards A, B, and C with indexes 1, 2, and 3, and you add a new product card with index 2, card A will have index 1, the new card will have index 2, card B will have index 3, and card C will have index 4
* `false`: Do not reorder product cards. Cards with the same index may exist, and their order will be random

对于飞书成员类型（`Type` 取值为 `3`）的子账号而言，如果参数值不包含**默认子账号**角色，则会自动添加**默认子账号**角色。
每个子账号最多可被赋予 100 个角色。
RoleIds.description_en:
The IDs of the roles assigned to the sub-account. If you pass an empty array, the system will automatically assign the Default Sub-Account Role. You can obtain role IDs by calling the [ListSubAccountRoles](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1377762) API.

For sub-accounts of the Lark member type (where `Type` is set to `3`), if the parameter does not include the Default Sub-Account Role, the system will automatically add it.

Each sub-account can have up to 100 roles assigned.

* To get the `Vid` of an on-demand room video, call the [ListVideoRoomMedias](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/2549787?lang=zh) interface to obtain the `Vid` of a specified on-demand room video

When calling the API with a sub-account, make sure the live room is visible to the sub-account. For details on configuring sub-account visibility, see [Sub-account Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593?lang=zh#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

* 要更新指定等级库，传入指定等级库的 ID。可通过 [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) 接口获取。

ViewerLevelGroupId.description_en:
Pass the parameter based on the following scenarios:

* To create a new level group, set the parameter value to `0` or leave it empty.
* To update an existing level group, enter the ID of the target level group. You can get the ID using the [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) API.
      When updating a level group with a sub-account, make sure the sub-account has edit permissions for the target level group. You can check if the sub-account can edit the level group using the [ListAccountViewerLevelGroup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/1829002) API. For details on configuring sub-account permissions, see [Sub-account management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/3019/93593#%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2).

Country.description_cn:
设置调度区域所属国家或地区的代码。
您可以调用 [ListViews](../6766/161891) 接口查询所有国家或地区代码。
Country.description_en:
Set the code for the country or region of the scheduling area.
You can call the [ListViews](../6766/161891) API to query all country or region codes.

DnsScheduleId.description_cn:
指定调度实例的 ID。
调度实例 ID 是多云CDN为调度实例生成的唯一标识符。您可以调用 [ListDnsSchedules](../6766/149885) 接口查询所有调度实例的 ID。
DnsScheduleId.description_en:
Specify the scheduling instance ID.
The scheduling instance ID is a unique identifier generated by Multi-Cloud CDN for the scheduling instance. You can call the [ListDnsSchedules](../6766/149885) API to query all scheduling instance IDs.

Isp.description_cn:
设置调度区域对应的运营商的代码。
您可以调用 [ListViews](../6766/161891) 接口查询所有运营商代码。
- 该参数只适用于 `Country` 为 `CN` 的情形。
- 该参数值允许设置为空。例如，当 `Country` 值为除 `CN` 外的其他值时，您可以将该参数的值设置为空。
Isp.description_en:
Set the code of the carrier corresponding to the scheduling region.
You can call the [ListViews](../6766/161891) API to query all carrier codes.
- This parameter only applies when `Country` is set to `CN`.
- You can leave this parameter empty. For example, if `Country` is set to a value other than `CN`, you can leave this parameter empty.

Province.description_cn:
设置调度区域所属中国行政区域（省、自治区、直辖市、特别行政区）的代码。
您可以调用 [ListViews](../6766/161891) 接口查询所有行政区域代码。
- 该参数只适用于 `Country` 为 `CN` 的情形。
- 该参数值允许设置为空。例如，当 `Country` 值为除 `CN` 外的其他值时，您可以将该参数的值设置为空。
Province.description_en:
Set the code for the Chinese administrative region (province, autonomous region, municipality directly under the central government, or special administrative region) to which the scheduling area belongs.
You can call the [ListViews](../6766/161891) API to query all administrative region codes.
- This parameter only applies when `Country` is set to `CN`.
- You can leave this parameter empty. For example, if `Country` is set to a value other than `CN`, you can leave this parameter empty.

WeightItems.description_cn: 为当前调度区域设置的流量分配比例。
WeightItems.description_en: Traffic Allocation Ratio Set for Current Scheduling Area

DnsScheduleId.description_cn:
指定静态调度策略所属调度实例的 ID。
调度实例 ID 是多云CDN为调度实例生成的唯一标识符。您可以调用 [ListDnsSchedules](../6766/149885) 接口查询所有调度实例的 ID。
DnsScheduleId.description_en:
Specify the ID of the scheduling instance for the static scheduling policy.
The scheduling instance ID is a unique identifier generated by Multi-Cloud CDN for each scheduling instance. You can call the [ListDnsSchedules](../6766/149885) API to view all scheduling instance IDs.

WeightId.description_cn:
指定要删除的静态调度策略的 ID。

调度策略 ID 是多云CDN为调度策略分配的唯一标识符。您可以调用 [DescribeDnsScheduleStaticWeights](../6766/1217698) 接口查询调度实例下所有静态调度策略的 ID。
WeightId.description_en:
Specify the ID of the static scheduling policy to delete.

The scheduling policy ID is the unique identifier assigned by Multi-Cloud CDN for each scheduling policy. You can call the [DescribeDnsScheduleStaticWeights](../6766/1217698) API to query the IDs of all static scheduling policies under a scheduling instance.

Id.description_cn:
要查询的告警策略 ID。
您可以调用 [ListAlertStrategies](/docs/6766/1262137) 接口获取所有告警策略的 ID。
Id.description_en:
Alert strategy ID to query
You can call the [ListAlertStrategies](/docs/6766/1262137) API to get all alert strategy IDs

ProjectName.description_en: Project Name

Domain.description_cn:
指定要查询的加速域名。

- `Domain` 和 `DomainId` 不允许同时为空，否则日志查询请求会失败。
- 如果您指定了 `Domain`，则必须同时指定 `Vendor` 和 `SubProduct`。
Domain.description_en:
Specify the acceleration domain name to query

- `Domain` and `DomainId` cannot both be empty; otherwise, the log query request will fail
- If you specify `Domain`, you must also specify `Vendor` and `SubProduct`

DomainId.description_cn:
指定要查询的加速域名的 ID。

- 您可以调用 [ListCdnDomains](/docs/6766/165536) 接口查询所有加速域名的 ID。
- 如果您指定了 `DomainId`，则不能指定 `Domain`、`Vendor` 和 `SubProduct`。
DomainId.description_en:
Specify the ID of the accelerated domain name to query.

- You can call the [ListCdnDomains](/docs/6766/165536) API to query the IDs of all accelerated domain names.
- If you specify `DomainId`, you cannot specify `Domain`, `Vendor`, or `SubProduct`.

EndTime.description_cn:
指定一个时间段的终点，查询时间段内（不包含终点）的数据。使用时间戳表示，单位为秒。

不同云服务商平台允许查询的日志时间跨度不同。若您设置的时间段不符合云服务商平台的要求（超出允许的时间跨度），那么日志查询请求会失败。更多信息，请参见[日志查询限制](/docs/6766/113545#log-query-limit)。
EndTime.description_en:
Specify the end of a time range to query data within that range (excluding the end point). Use timestamps in seconds.

Different cloud service platforms allow different log query time spans. If the time range you set does not meet the platform's requirements (exceeds the allowed time span), the log query request will fail. For more information, see [Log Query Limit](/docs/6766/113545#log-query-limit).

Pagination.description_cn: 对查询结果进行分页并返回特定页码上的访问日志。
Pagination.description_en: Paginate query results and return access logs for a specific page

StartTime.description_cn:
指定一个时间段的起点，查询时间段内（包含起点）的日志。使用时间戳表示，单位为秒。
不同云服务商平台允许查询的日志时间范围不同。若您设置的时间起点不符合云服务商平台的要求（超出最长可查询时间），那么日志查询请求会失败。更多信息，请参见[日志查询限制](/docs/6766/113545#log-query-limit)。
StartTime.description_en:
Specify the start of a time range to query logs within that period (including the start time). Use a timestamp in seconds.
Different cloud service platforms allow queries within different log time ranges. If the start time you set does not meet the platform's requirements (exceeds the maximum queryable period), the log query will fail. For more information, see [Log query limits](/docs/6766/113545#log-query-limit).

SubProduct.description_cn:
指定一个产品类型。
如果您指定了 `Domain`，则必须同时指定 `Vendor` 和 `SubProduct`。



该参数有以下取值：

- `cdn`（默认）：内容分发网络（CDN）
- `ucdn`：UCloud UCDN
- `cloudfront`：AWS CloudFront
- `amd`：Akamai AMD
- `dsa`：Akamai DSA
- `media_cdn`：Google Cloud Media CDN
- `dcdn`：全站加速（DCDN）
- `ecdn`：腾讯云 ECDN
- `edgeone`：腾讯云 EdgeOne
SubProduct.description_en:
Specify a product type.
If you specify `Domain`, you must also specify `Vendor` and `SubProduct`.


This parameter supports the following values:

- `cdn` (default): Content Delivery Network (CDN)
- `ucdn`: UCloud UCDN
- `cloudfront`: AWS CloudFront
- `amd`: Akamai AMD
- `dsa`: Akamai DSA
- `media_cdn`: Google Cloud Media CDN
- `dcdn`: Whole-site Acceleration (DCDN)
- `ecdn`: Tencent Cloud ECDN
- `edgeone`: Tencent Cloud EdgeOne

该参数有以下取值：

- `aliyun`：阿里云

- `aws`：AWS

- `jingdong`：京东云
- `gcp`：Google Cloud
- `chinamobile`：中国移动
- `ctcdn`：天翼云CDN+

Vendor.description_en:
Specify a cloud service provider and send a log query request to its platform.
If you specify `Domain`, you must also specify `Vendor` and `SubProduct`.


This parameter supports the following values:
- `builtin`: Built-in acceleration
- `aliyun`: Alibaba Cloud
- `tencent`: Tencent Cloud

- `volcengine`: Volcengine

- `qiniu`: Qiniu Cloud
- `ucloud`: UCloud
- `akamai`: Akamai
- `baishan`: Baishan Cloud
- `aws`: AWS
- `baidu`: Baidu AI Cloud
- `jingdong`: JD Cloud
- `gcp`: Google Cloud
- `chinamobile`: China Mobile
- `ctcdn`: Tianyi Cloud CDN+
- `azure`: Azure

BizNodeIds.description_cn: 业务树节点id，最多50个，按nodeid精确匹配查询
BizNodeIds.description_en: Specify up to 50 business tree node IDs for exact match query

CdnTypes.description_cn:
指定一个或多个业务类型，查询对应业务类型的数据。多个业务类型间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。默认返回云服务商下所有业务类型的数据。该参数有以下取值：

- `Web`：网页/小文件加速
- `Video`：音视频点播加速
- `Download`：大文件下载加速
- `Dynamic`：动态加速
- `Hybrid`：混合加速
- `Live`：直播加速
- `Default`：未配置
CdnTypes.description_en:
Specify one or more business types to query the corresponding data. Separate multiple business types with a comma (,). By default, returns data for all business types under the cloud service provider. Valid values for this parameter are:

- `Web`: Web page/small file acceleration
- `Video`: Audio and video on-demand acceleration
- `Download`: Large file download acceleration
- `Dynamic`: Dynamic acceleration
- `Hybrid`: Hybrid acceleration
- `Live`: Live streaming acceleration
- `Default`: Not configured

CloudAccountIds.description_cn:
指定一个或多个云服务商的账号 ID，查询对应云服务商账号的数据。多个账号 ID 间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。默认返回所有账号的数据。
账号 ID 是您将云服务商账号添加到多云CDN后，多云CDN为账号分配的唯一 ID。您可以调用 [ListCloudAccounts](../6766/155786) 接口获取所有云服务商账号 ID。
CloudAccountIds.description_en:
Specify one or more cloud service provider account IDs to query data for the corresponding accounts. Separate multiple account IDs with a comma (,). By default, data for all accounts is returned.
An account ID is the unique ID assigned by Multi-Cloud CDN when you add a cloud service provider account. You can call the [ListCloudAccounts](../6766/155786) API to get all cloud service provider account IDs.

Country.description_cn:
指定一个或多个国家及地区代码用来筛选数据。多个代码之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。最多可以指定 30 个代码。
- 只有在 `Vendors` 只包含 `builtin` 的前提下，该参数才会生效。
- 您可以调用 [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](/docs/6766/165507) 接口查询国家及地区代码。
Country.description_en:
Specify one or more country or region codes to filter data. Separate multiple codes with a comma (,). You can specify up to 30 codes.
- This parameter only takes effect when `Vendors` contains only `builtin`.
- You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](/docs/6766/165507) API to query country and region codes.

DomainIds.description_cn:
指定一个或多个加速域名的 ID，查询对应加速域名的数据。多个加速域名 ID 间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。最多允许设置 50 个加速域名 ID。默认返回所有加速域名的数据。
加速域名 ID 是多云CDN为（从云服务商平台同步的）加速域名分配的唯一标识符。加速域名 ID 在“云服务商/云产品/域名”维度是唯一的。您可以调用 [ListCdnDomains](../6766/165536) 接口获取所有加速域名的 ID。
DomainIds.description_en:
Specify one or more acceleration domain IDs to query data for the corresponding acceleration domains. Separate multiple domain IDs with a comma (,). You can set up to 50 acceleration domain IDs. By default, data for all acceleration domains is returned.
An acceleration domain ID is a unique identifier assigned by Multi-Cloud CDN to each acceleration domain synchronized from cloud service provider platforms. The acceleration domain ID is unique within the 'Cloud Service Provider/Cloud Product/Domain' scope. You can call the [ListCdnDomains](../6766/165536) API to get all acceleration domain IDs.

Domains.description_cn:
指定一个或多个加速域名，查询对应加速域名的数据。多个加速域名间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。最多允许设置 50 个加速域名。默认返回所有加速域名的数据。
您可以调用 [ListCdnDomains](../6766/165536) 接口获取所有加速域名。
Domains.description_en:
Specify one or more acceleration domain names to query their data. Separate multiple domain names with a comma (,). You can set up to 50 acceleration domain names. By default, data for all acceleration domain names is returned.
You can call the [ListCdnDomains](../6766/165536) API to get all acceleration domain names.

EndTime.description_cn:
指定一个时间段的终点，查询该时间段内（不包含终点）的数据。使用时间戳表示，单位为秒。
时间段按照您设置的 `Interval` 值向前规整。示例：假设 `Interval` 为 5 分钟（对应秒级时间戳 300），那么 `1644163200` 和 `1644163499` 都会规整为 `1644163200`。
EndTime.description_en:
Specify the end point of a time range to query data within that range (excluding the end point). Use timestamps in seconds.
The time range is normalized backward based on the `Interval` value you set. Example: If `Interval` is 5 minutes (which equals a timestamp of 300 seconds), both `1644163200` and `1644163499` will be normalized to `1644163200`.

GroupBy.description_cn:
指定一种返回数据的分组方式。默认返回汇总数据，即不对数据进行分组。该参数有以下取值：

- `vendor`：按云服务商对数据分组
- `cloud_account_id`：按云服务商账号对数据分组
- `sub_product`：按子产品类型对数据分组
- `cdn_type`：按业务类型对数据分组
- `domain`：按域名对数据分组（仅在 Domains 不为空时支持该取值）
- `domain_id`：按域名 ID 对数据分组（仅在 DomainIds 不为空时支持该取值）
GroupBy.description_en:
Specify a method for grouping returned data. By default, aggregated data is returned, meaning no grouping is applied. This parameter supports the following values:

- `vendor`: Group data by cloud service provider
- `cloud_account_id`: Group data by cloud service provider account
- `sub_product`: Group data by sub-product type
- `cdn_type`: Group data by business type
- `domain`: Group data by domain name (supported only when Domains is not empty)
- `domain_id`: Group data by domain ID (supported only when DomainIds is not empty)

Interval.description_cn:
指定返回数据的时间间隔。该参数有以下取值：

- `1min`：每 1 分钟返回一个数据。查询的时间段必须在 1 天内，才支持该取值。
- `5min`：每 5 分钟返回一个数据。查询的时间段必须在 31 天内，才支持该取值。
- `hour`：每 1 小时返回一个数据。查询的时间段必须在 90 天内，才支持该取值。
- `day`：每 1 天返回一个数据。查询的时间段至少为 2 天，且最多为 90 天，才支持该取值。
Interval.description_en:
Specify the interval for returned data. This parameter supports the following values:

- `1min`: Returns one data point every 1 minute. This value is only supported if the query period is within 1 day.
- `5min`: Returns one data point every 5 minutes. This value is only supported if the query period is within 31 days.
- `hour`: Returns one data point every 1 hour. This value is only supported if the query period is within 90 days.
- `day`: Returns one data point every 1 day. This value is only supported if the query period is at least 2 days and up to 90 days.

IpVersion.description_cn:
指定一个网络层协议用来筛选客户端请求数据。该参数有以下取值：`ipv4`、`ipv6`。
只有在 `Vendors` 只包含 `builtin` 的前提下，该参数才会生效。
IpVersion.description_en:
Specify a network layer protocol to filter client request data. This parameter supports the following values: `ipv4`, `ipv6`.
This parameter only takes effect when `Vendors` contains only `builtin`.

IsTrimLatestData.description_cn: 是否剔除最新的数据点不完整的数据。默认值为 `false`。
IsTrimLatestData.description_en: Whether to exclude incomplete data for the latest data point. Default value is `false`.

Isp.description_cn:
指定一个或多个运营商代码用来筛选数据。（仅适用于中国内地区域。）多个代码之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。最多可以指定 5 个代码。


- 只有在 `Vendors` 只包含 `builtin`，`Country` 为 `CN` 且指定了 `Region` 的前提下，该参数才会生效。
- 您可以调用 [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](/docs/6766/165507) 接口查询运行商代码。
Isp.description_en:
Specify one or more operator codes to filter data (only applicable to mainland China). Separate multiple codes with a comma (,). You can specify up to 5 codes.

- This parameter is effective only when `Vendors` contains only `builtin`, `Country` is set to `CN`, and `Region` is specified
- You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](/docs/6766/165507) API to query operator codes

Metric.description_cn:
指定一个要查询的指标。该参数有以下取值：

- `flux`：流量（byte）
- `bandwidth`：带宽（bps）
- `request`: 请求数
- `status_all`：2xx、3xx、4xx、5xx 状态码的汇总数量
- `status_2xx`：2xx 状态码的汇总数量和某个具体 2xx 状态码（如 200、201 等）的数量
- `status_3xx`：3xx 状态码的汇总数量和某个具体 3xx 状态码（如 301、302 等）的数量
- `status_4xx`：4xx 状态码的汇总数量和某个具体 4xx 状态码（如 400、404 等）的数量
- `status_5xx`：5xx 状态码的汇总数量和某个具体 5xx 状态码（如 500、502 等）的数量
- `hitrate`: 流量命中率（ %，保留两位小数）
- `request_hitrate`：请求命中率（ %，保留两位小数）
Metric.description_en:
Specify a metric to query. This parameter supports the following values:

- `flux`: Traffic (bytes)
- `bandwidth`: Bandwidth (bps)
- `request`: Number of requests
- `status_all`: Total count of 2xx, 3xx, 4xx, and 5xx status codes
- `status_2xx`: Total count of 2xx status codes and the count for specific 2xx codes (such as 200, 201, etc.)
- `status_3xx`: Total count of 3xx status codes and the count for specific 3xx codes (such as 301, 302, etc.)
- `status_4xx`: Total count of 4xx status codes and the count for specific 4xx codes (such as 400, 404, etc.)
- `status_5xx`: Total count of 5xx status codes and the count for specific 5xx codes (such as 500, 502, etc.)
- `hitrate`: Traffic hit rate (%; two decimal places)
- `request_hitrate`: Request hit rate (%; two decimal places)

PrefixBizNodeIds.description_cn: 业务树节点id，最多5个，按nodeid对应的path前缀匹配查询
PrefixBizNodeIds.description_en: Business tree node IDs, up to 5; query by matching the path prefix for each node ID

PrefixBizNodePaths.description_cn: 业务树节点path，最多5个, 按path前缀匹配查询, 此参数还不支持
PrefixBizNodePaths.description_en: Business tree node path (up to 5 paths); supports query by path prefix match. This parameter is not supported yet

ProjectName.description_en: Volcano project name, Single Choice

ProjectNames.description_cn: 火山project name，最多50个，精确匹配查询
ProjectNames.description_en: Volcano project names (up to 50), exact match search

ProjectPaths.description_cn: 火山project path，最多50个, 前缀匹配查询
ProjectPaths.description_en: Volcano Project Path, Up to 50, Prefix Match Search

Protocol.description_cn:
指定一个应用层协议用来筛选客户端请求数据。该参数有以下取值：`http`、`https`、quic。
只有在 `Vendors` 只包含 `builtin` 的前提下，该参数才会生效。
Protocol.description_en:
Specify an application layer protocol to filter client request data. Valid values: `http`, `https`, quic.
This parameter only takes effect when `Vendors` contains only `builtin`.

Region.description_cn:
指定一个或多个中国省级行政区代码用来筛选数据。多个代码之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。最多可以指定 10 个代码。
- 只有在 `Vendors` 只包含 `builtin` 且 `Country` 为 `CN` 的前提下，该参数才会生效。
- 您可以调用 [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](/docs/6766/165507) 接口查询省级行政区代码。
Region.description_en:
Specify one or more Chinese provincial administrative region codes to filter data. Separate multiple codes with commas (,). You can specify up to 10 codes.
- This parameter is only effective when `Vendors` contains only `builtin` and `Country` is set to `CN`.
- You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](/docs/6766/165507) API to query provincial administrative region codes.

StartTime.description_cn:
指定一个时间段的起点，查询该时间段内（包含起点）的数据。使用时间戳表示，单位为秒。
时间段按照您设置的 `Interval` 值向前规整。示例：假设 `Interval` 为 5 分钟（对应秒级时间戳 300），那么 `1644163200` 和 `1644163499` 都会规整为 `1644163200`。
StartTime.description_en:
Specify the start point of a time period to query data within that period (including the start point). Use timestamps in seconds.
The time period is normalized backward based on the 'Interval' value you set. Example: If 'Interval' is 5 minutes (which equals a timestamp of 300 seconds), both '1644163200' and '1644163499' will be normalized to '1644163200'.

SubProducts.description_cn:
指定一个或多个产品类型，查询对应产品的数据。多个产品类型间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。默认返回云服务商下所有支持的产品的数据。该参数有以下取值：

- `cdn`：内容分发网络（CDN）
- `ucdn`：UCloud UCDN
- `cloudfront`：AWS CloudFront
- `amd`：Akamai AMD
- `dsa`：Akamai DSA
- `media_cdn`：Google Cloud Media CDN
- `dcdn`：全站加速（DCDN）
- `ecdn`：腾讯云 ECDN
- `edgeone`：腾讯云 EdgeOne
SubProducts.description_en:
Specify one or more product types to query data for the corresponding products. Separate multiple product types with a comma (,). By default, data for all supported products under the cloud service provider is returned. Valid values for this parameter are:

- `cdn`: Content Delivery Network (CDN)
- `ucdn`: UCloud UCDN
- `cloudfront`: AWS CloudFront
- `amd`: Akamai AMD
- `dsa`: Akamai DSA
- `media_cdn`: Google Cloud Media CDN
- `dcdn`: Whole-site Acceleration (DCDN)
- `ecdn`: Tencent Cloud ECDN
- `edgeone`: Tencent Cloud EdgeOne

TagKVPrefixes.description_cn: 标签key以及对应的标签value前缀列表，对应标签按前缀匹配查询，value前缀列表中的多个前缀按or关系查询，value前缀列表长度最大5
TagKVPrefixes.description_en: Tag key and corresponding list of tag value prefixes. Tags are queried by prefix matching; multiple prefixes in the value prefix list are queried using OR logic. The value prefix list can contain up to 5 prefixes

TagKVs.description_cn: 标签key以及对应的标签value列表，value列表长度最大20，key必须以STAT_i_开头(i取值1-4)，如STAT_1_K1
TagKVs.description_en: The label key and its corresponding label value list. The value list can contain up to 20 items. The key must start with STAT_i_ (where i is 1–4), for example, STAT_1_K1.

TopLevelDomains.description_en: Filter by top-level domain, such as a.com, b.com

Vendors.description_cn:
指定一个或多个云服务商，查询对应云服务商的数据。多个云服务商间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。默认返回所有云服务商的数据。该参数有以下取值：
- `builtin`：内置加速
- `aliyun`：阿里云
- `tencent`：腾讯云
- `ksyun`：金山云
- `huawei`：华为云
- `volcengine`：火山引擎
- `wangsu`：网宿科技
- `qiniu`：七牛云
- `ucloud`：UCloud
- `akamai`：Akamai
- `baishan`：白山云
- `aws`：AWS
- `baidu`：百度智能云
- `jingdong`：京东云
- `gcp`：Google Cloud
- `chinamobile`：中国移动
- `ctcdn`：天翼云CDN+
- `azure`：Azure
Vendors.description_en:
Specify one or more cloud service providers to query their data. Separate multiple providers with a half-width comma (,). By default, data from all providers is returned. Valid values for this parameter are:
- `builtin`: Built-in acceleration
- `aliyun`: Alibaba Cloud
- `tencent`: Tencent Cloud
- `ksyun`: Kingsoft Cloud
- `huawei`: Huawei Cloud
- `volcengine`: Volcano Engine
- `wangsu`: Wangsu Technology
- `qiniu`: Qiniu Cloud
- `ucloud`: UCloud
- `akamai`: Akamai
- `baishan`: Baishan Cloud
- `aws`: AWS
- `baidu`: Baidu Smart Cloud
- `jingdong`: JD Cloud
- `gcp`: Google Cloud
- `chinamobile`: China Mobile
- `ctcdn`: Tianyi Cloud CDN+
- `azure`: Azure

BizNodeIds.description_cn: 业务树节点id，最多50个，按nodeid精确匹配查询
BizNodeIds.description_en: Business tree node IDs (up to 50), queried by exact nodeid match

CdnTypes.description_cn:
指定一个或多个业务类型，查询对应业务类型的数据。多个业务类型间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。默认返回云服务商下所有业务类型的数据。该参数有以下取值：

- `Web`：网页/小文件加速
- `Video`：音视频点播加速
- `Download`：大文件下载加速
- `Dynamic`：动态加速
- `Hybrid`：混合加速
- `Live`：直播加速
- `Default`：未配置
CdnTypes.description_en:
Specify one or more business types to query data for the corresponding business types. Separate multiple business types with a half-width comma (,). By default, data for all business types under the cloud service provider is returned. This parameter supports the following values:

- `Web`: Web page/small file acceleration
- `Video`: Audio and video on-demand acceleration
- `Download`: Large file download acceleration
- `Dynamic`: Dynamic acceleration
- `Hybrid`: Hybrid acceleration
- `Live`: Live streaming acceleration
- `Default`: Not configured

CloudAccountIds.description_cn:
指定一个或多个云服务商的账号 ID，查询对应云服务商账号的数据。多个账号 ID 间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。默认返回所有账号的数据。
账号 ID 是您将云服务商账号添加到多云CDN后，多云CDN为账号分配的唯一 ID。您可以调用 [ListCloudAccounts](../6766/155786) 接口获取所有云服务商账号 ID。
CloudAccountIds.description_en:
Specify one or more cloud service provider account IDs to query data for those accounts. Separate multiple account IDs with a comma (,). By default, data for all accounts is returned.
An account ID is the unique ID assigned by Multi-Cloud CDN after you add a cloud service provider account. You can call the [ListCloudAccounts](../6766/155786) API to get all cloud service provider account IDs.

DomainIds.description_cn:
指定一个或多个域名的 ID，查询对应域名的数据。多个域名 ID 间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。最多允许设置 50 个域名 ID。默认返回所有域名的数据。
加速域名 ID 是多云CDN为（从云服务商平台同步的）加速域名分配的唯一标识符。加速域名 ID 在“云服务商/云产品/域名”维度是唯一的。您可以调用 [ListCdnDomains](../6766/165536) 接口获取所有域名的 ID。
DomainIds.description_en:
Specify one or more domain IDs to query data for the corresponding domains. Separate multiple domain IDs with a comma (,). You can set up to 50 domain IDs. By default, data for all domains is returned.
An acceleration domain ID is a unique identifier assigned by Multi-Cloud CDN to each acceleration domain (synchronized from the cloud service provider platform). The acceleration domain ID is unique within the 'cloud service provider/cloud product/domain' scope. You can call the [ListCdnDomains](../6766/165536) API to get all domain IDs.

Domains.description_cn:
指定一个或多个域名，查询对应域名的数据。多个域名间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。最多允许设置 50 个域名。默认返回所有域名的数据。
您可以调用 [ListCdnDomains](../6766/165536) 接口获取所有域名。
Domains.description_en:
Specify one or more domain names to query their data. Separate multiple domain names with a comma (,). You can set up to 50 domain names. By default, data for all domain names is returned.
You can call the [ListCdnDomains](../6766/165536) API to get all domain names.

EndTime.description_cn:
指定一个时间段的终点，查询该时间段内（不包含终点）的数据。使用时间戳表示，单位为秒。
时间段按照您设置的 `Interval` 值向前规整。示例：假设 `Interval` 为 5 分钟（对应秒级时间戳 300），那么 `1644163200` 和 `1644163499` 都会规整为 `1644163200`。
EndTime.description_en: Specify the end time of a time range to query data within that range (excluding the end time). Use timestamps in seconds. The time range is rounded down to the nearest interval based on the `Interval` value you set. Example: If `Interval` is 5 minutes (which equals 300 seconds), both `1644163200` and `1644163499` will be rounded down to `1644163200`.

GroupBy.description_cn:
指定一种返回数据的分组方式。默认返回汇总数据，即不对数据进行分组。该参数有以下取值：

- `vendor`：按云服务商对数据分组
- `cloud_account_id`：按云服务商账号对数据分组
- `sub_product`：按子产品类型对数据分组
- `cdn_type`：按业务类型对数据分组
- `domain`：按域名对数据分组（仅在 `Domains` 不为空时支持该取值）
- `domain_id`：按域名 ID 对数据分组（仅在 `DomainIds` 不为空时支持该取值）
GroupBy.description_en:
Specify a method for grouping returned data. By default, summary data is returned, meaning no grouping is applied. This parameter supports the following values:

- `vendor`: group data by cloud service provider
- `cloud_account_id`: group data by cloud account
- `sub_product`: group data by sub-product type
- `cdn_type`: group data by business type
- `domain`: group data by domain name (supported only when `Domains` is not empty)
- `domain_id`: group data by domain ID (supported only when `DomainIds` is not empty)

Interval.description_cn:
指定返回数据的时间间隔。该参数有以下取值：

- `1min`：每 1 分钟返回一个数据。查询的时间段必须在 1 天内，才支持该取值。
- `5min`：每 5 分钟返回一个数据。查询的时间段必须在 31 天内，才支持该取值。
- `hour`：每 1 小时返回一个数据。查询的时间段必须在 90 天内，才支持该取值。
- `day`：每 1 天返回一个数据。查询的时间段至少为 2 天，且最多为 90 天，才支持该取值。
Interval.description_en:
Specify the interval for returning data. This parameter supports the following values:

- `1min`: Returns one data point every 1 minute. Supported only if the query period is within 1 day
- `5min`: Returns one data point every 5 minutes. Supported only if the query period is within 31 days
- `hour`: Returns one data point every 1 hour. Supported only if the query period is within 90 days
- `day`: Returns one data point every 1 day. Supported only if the query period is at least 2 days and up to 90 days

IsTrimLatestData.description_cn: 是否剔除最新的数据点不完整的数据。默认值为 `false`。
IsTrimLatestData.description_en: Whether to exclude incomplete data for the latest data point. Default value is `false`.

Metric.description_cn:

- `bandwidth`：带宽（bps）
- `request`: 请求数
- `status_all`：2xx、3xx、4xx、5xx 状态码的汇总数量
- `status_2xx`：2xx 状态码的汇总数量和某个具体 2xx 状态码（如 200、201 等）的数量
- `status_3xx`：3xx 状态码的汇总数量和某个具体 3xx 状态码（如 301、302 等）的数量
- `status_4xx`：4xx 状态码的汇总数量和某个具体 4xx 状态码（如 400、404 等）的数量
- `status_5xx`：5xx 状态码的汇总数量和某个具体 5xx 状态码（如 500、502 等）的数量
Metric.description_en:
Specify a metric to query. This parameter supports the following values:

- `flux`: Traffic (byte)

- `request`: Number of requests
- `status_all`: Total count of 2xx, 3xx, 4xx, and 5xx status codes
- `status_2xx`: Total count of 2xx status codes and the count for specific 2xx codes (such as 200, 201, etc.)

PrefixBizNodeIds.description_cn: 业务树节点id，最多5个，按nodeid对应的path前缀匹配查询
PrefixBizNodeIds.description_en: Business tree node IDs (up to 5); query by matching the path prefix corresponding to each node ID

PrefixBizNodePaths.description_cn: 业务树节点path，最多5个, 按path前缀匹配查询, 此参数还不支持
PrefixBizNodePaths.description_en: Business tree node paths (up to 5). Query by matching path prefix. This parameter is not supported yet

ProjectName.description_en: Project Name (Volcano), Radio Button

ProjectNames.description_cn: 火山project name，最多50个，精确匹配查询
ProjectNames.description_en: Volcano project names (up to 50), exact match query

ProjectPaths.description_cn: 火山project path，最多50个, 前缀匹配查询
ProjectPaths.description_en: Volcano Project Path, Up To 50 Paths, Prefix Match Query

StartTime.description_cn:
指定一个时间段的起点，查询该时间段内（包含起点）的数据。使用时间戳表示，单位为秒。
时间段按照您设置的 `Interval` 值向前规整。示例：假设 `Interval` 为 5 分钟（对应秒级时间戳 300），那么 `1644163200` 和 `1644163499` 都会规整为 `1644163200`。
StartTime.description_en:
Specify the start of a time period to query data within that period (including the start point). Use a timestamp in seconds.
The time period is normalized backward based on the `Interval` value you set. Example: If `Interval` is 5 minutes (which equals a timestamp of 300 seconds), both `1644163200` and `1644163499` will be normalized to `1644163200`.

SubProducts.description_cn:
指定一个或多个子产品类型，查询对应子产品的数据。多个子产品类型间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。默认返回云服务商下所有子产品的数据。该参数有以下取值：

- `cdn`：内容分发网络（CDN）
- `ucdn`：UCloud UCDN
- `cloudfront`：AWS CloudFront
- `amd`：Akamai AMD
- `dsa`：Akamai DSA
- `media_cdn`：Google Cloud Media CDN
- `dcdn`：全站加速（DCDN）
- `ecdn`：腾讯云 ECDN
- `edgeone`：腾讯云 EdgeOne
SubProducts.description_en:
Specify one or more sub-product types to query the corresponding data. Separate multiple sub-product types with a comma (,). By default, data for all sub-products under the cloud service provider is returned. This parameter supports the following values:

- `cdn`: Content Delivery Network (CDN)
- `ucdn`: UCloud UCDN
- `cloudfront`: AWS CloudFront
- `amd`: Akamai AMD
- `dsa`: Akamai DSA
- `media_cdn`: Google Cloud Media CDN
- `dcdn`: Whole-site Acceleration (DCDN)
- `ecdn`: Tencent Cloud ECDN

Domain.description_en:
Specify the acceleration domain name to query. Only one domain name is supported.
Note:

DomainId.description_cn:

DomainId.description_en:

EndTime.description_cn:
指定一个结束时间，以查询从 `StartTime` 所指定的开始时间（含）到该结束时间（不含）范围内的数据。使用时间戳格式，单位为秒。
说明：不同云服务商平台允许查询的数据时间跨度不同。若您设置的时间范围不符合云服务商平台的要求（如超出允许的时间跨度），那么查询会失败。
EndTime.description_en:
Specify an end time to query data from the start time set by `StartTime` (inclusive) up to, but not including, the end time. Use the timestamp format in seconds.
Note: Different cloud service providers allow different time ranges for data queries. If the time range you set does not meet the requirements of the cloud service provider (for example, if it exceeds the allowed range), the query will fail.

SortBy.description_cn:
指定返回数据的排序方式。该参数有以下取值：
- `request`（默认）：按请求次数从大到小排序
- `flux`：按流量从大到小排序
SortBy.description_en:
Specify the sorting method for returned data. This parameter supports the following values:
- `request` (default): Sort by number of requests in descending order
- `flux`: Sort by traffic in descending order

StartTime.description_cn:
指定一个开始时间，以查询从该开始时间（含）到 `EndTime` 所指定的结束时间（不含）范围内的数据。使用时间戳格式，单位为秒。
说明：不同云服务商平台允许查询的数据时间范围不同。若您设置的开始时间不符合云服务商平台的要求（如超出最长可查询时间），那么查询会失败。
StartTime.description_en:
Specify a start time to query data from that time (inclusive) up to the end time defined by `EndTime` (exclusive). Use the timestamp format in seconds.
Note: Different cloud service providers allow queries over different time ranges. If the start time you set does not meet the provider's requirements (for example, if it exceeds the maximum queryable period), the query will fail.

SubProduct.description_cn:
指定一个产品类型。
说明：如果您指定了 Domain，则必须同时指定 Vendor 和 SubProduct。
SubProduct.description_en:

Note: If you specify Domain, you must also specify Vendor and SubProduct.

Vendor.description_en:

EndTime.description_cn:
指定一个结束时间，以查询从 `StartTime` 所指定的开始时间（含）到该结束时间（不含）范围内的数据。使用时间戳格式，单位为秒。
说明：不同云服务商平台允许查询的数据时间跨度不同。若您设置的时间范围不符合云服务商平台的要求（如超出允许的时间跨度），那么查询会失败。
EndTime.description_en:
Specify an end time to query data from the start time defined by `StartTime` (inclusive) up to the end time (exclusive). Use the timestamp format in seconds.
Note: Different cloud service providers allow different query time spans. If the time range you set does not meet the provider's requirements (such as exceeding the allowed time span), the query will fail.

指定返回数据的排序方式。该参数有以下取值：

- `status_3xx`：按 3XX 状态码数量从大到小排序

SortBy.description_en:
Specify how to sort returned data. This parameter supports the following values:
- `request` (default): Sort by number of requests, descending
- `flux`: Sort by traffic, descending
- `status_2xx`: Sort by number of 2XX status codes, descending
- `status_3xx`: Sort by number of 3XX status codes, descending
- `status_4xx`: Sort by number of 4XX status codes, descending
- `status_5xx`: Sort by number of 5XX status codes, descending

StartTime.description_cn:
指定一个开始时间，以查询从该开始时间（含）到 `EndTime` 所指定的结束时间（不含）范围内的数据。使用时间戳格式，单位为秒。
说明：不同云服务商平台允许查询的数据时间范围不同。若您设置的开始时间不符合云服务商平台的要求（如超出最长可查询时间），那么查询会失败。
StartTime.description_en:
Specify a start time to query data from the start time (inclusive) to the end time specified by `EndTime` (exclusive). Use the timestamp format in seconds.
Note: Different cloud service providers allow queries for different time ranges. If the start time you set does not meet the provider's requirements (such as exceeding the maximum queryable period), the query will fail.

SubProduct.description_cn:
指定一个产品类型。

Note: If you specify Domain, you must also specify Vendor and SubProduct.

CloudAccountId.description_cn:

CloudAccountId.description_en:
Specify the ID of the cloud service provider account to query. You can specify one or more account IDs. Separate multiple account IDs with commas
You can call the [ListCloudAccounts](../6766/155786) API to query all cloud service provider account IDs in the multi-cloud CDN.

ProjectName.description_en: Project Name

TaskId.description_cn:

TaskId.description_en:

Id.description_cn:

Id.description_en:
ID of the scheduling instance to query
The scheduling instance ID is the unique identifier assigned by Multi-Cloud CDN to each scheduling instance. You can call the [ListDnsSchedules](../6766/149885) API to query all scheduling instance IDs.

DnsScheduleId.description_cn:
要查询的调度实例的 ID。
调度实例 ID 是多云CDN为调度实例生成的唯一标识符。您可以调用 [ListDnsSchedules](../6766/149885) 接口查询所有调度实例的 ID。
DnsScheduleId.description_en:
ID of the scheduling instance to query
The scheduling instance ID is a unique identifier generated by Multi-Cloud CDN for each scheduling instance. You can call the [ListDnsSchedules](../6766/149885) API to query all scheduling instance IDs.

DnsScheduleId.description_cn:
要查询的调度实例的 ID。
调度实例 ID 是多云CDN为调度实例生成的唯一标识符。您可以调用 [ListDnsSchedules](../6766/149885) 接口查询所有调度实例的 ID。
DnsScheduleId.description_en:
ID of the scheduling instance to query
The scheduling instance ID is a unique identifier generated by Multi-Cloud CDN for each scheduling instance. You can call the [ListDnsSchedules](../6766/149885) API to query all scheduling instance IDs.

DnsScheduleId.description_cn:
调度实例 ID。
您可以调用 [ListDnsSchedules](/docs/6766/149885) 接口获取所有调度实例的 ID。
DnsScheduleId.description_en:
Schedule Instance ID
You can call the [ListDnsSchedules](/docs/6766/149885) API to get the IDs of all schedule instances.

DomainId.description_cn:
通过云服务商加速域名 ID，指定要停用的加速 CNAME。
您可以调用 [DescribeDnsSchedule](/docs/6766/161447) 接口获取指定调度实例包含的所有加速域名的 ID。
DomainId.description_en:
Specify the accelerated CNAME to be disabled using the accelerated domain name ID from your cloud service provider.
You can call the [DescribeDnsSchedule](/docs/6766/161447) API to get the IDs of all accelerated domain names included in a specific scheduling instance.

DnsScheduleId.description_cn:
调度实例 ID。
您可以调用 [ListDnsSchedules](/docs/6766/149885) 接口获取所有调度实例的 ID。
DnsScheduleId.description_en:
Schedule Instance ID
You can call the [ListDnsSchedules](/docs/6766/149885) API to get the IDs of all schedule instances.

DomainId.description_cn:
通过云服务商加速域名 ID，指定要恢复的加速 CNAME。
您可以调用 [DescribeDnsSchedule](/docs/6766/161447) 接口获取指定调度实例包含的所有加速域名的 ID。
DomainId.description_en:
Use the accelerated domain name ID from your cloud service provider to specify the accelerated CNAME you want to restore.
You can call the [DescribeDnsSchedule](/docs/6766/161447) API to get the IDs of all accelerated domain names included in the specified scheduling instance.

Level.description_cn:

- `warning`：警告
- `critical`：严重
Level.description_en:
Specify a level to query policies with the corresponding alert level. This parameter supports the following values:
- `info`: notification
- `warning`: warning
- `critical`: critical

Name.description_cn: 指定一个名称，查询与该名称模糊匹配的策略。

Pagination.description_en: Paginate query results and return strategies on the specified page

ProjectName.description_en: Project Name

ResourceType.description_en: Resource Type (Not yet supported, OpenApi not available)

- `Enabled`：运行中
- `Disabled`：未启用
Status.description_en:
Specify a status to query policies in that status. This parameter supports the following values:
- `Enabled`: Running
- `Disabled`: Not enabled

BizNodeIds.description_cn:
指定一个或多个多云CDN业务节点的 ID，查询属于指定业务的加速域名。
“业务”是多云CDN用来对资源进行分组和权限管理的工具。更多信息，请参见[权限管理](../6766/673071)。
BizNodeIds.description_en: Specify one or more multi-cloud CDN business node IDs to query acceleration domains belonging to the specified business. "Business" is a tool in multi-cloud CDN for grouping resources and managing permissions. For more information, see [Permission Management](../6766/673071).

CdnType.description_cn:
指定一个或多个业务类型，查询具有该业务类型属性的加速域名。该参数有以下取值：

- `Download`：大文件下载加速
- `Video`：音视频点播加速
- `Web`：网页/小文件加速
- `Dynamic`：动态与静态内容混合加速
- `Live`：直播加速
- `Default`：未配置
CdnType.description_en:
Specify one or more business types to query acceleration domains with the corresponding business type attribute. This parameter supports the following values:

- `Download`: Large file download acceleration
- `Video`: Audio and video on-demand acceleration
- `Web`: Web page/small file acceleration
- `Dynamic`: Mixed acceleration for dynamic and static content
- `Live`: Live streaming acceleration
- `Default`: Not configured

CloudAccountId.description_cn:
指定一个云服务商账号的 ID，查询通过该账号同步的加速域名。
账号 ID 是多云CDN为云服务商账号生成的唯一 ID。只用于多云CDN平台。您可以调用 [ListCloudAccounts](../6766/155786) 接口查询所有云服务商账号的 ID。
CloudAccountId.description_en:
Specify the ID of a cloud service provider account to query accelerated domains synchronized via this account.
Account ID is the unique identifier generated by Multi-Cloud CDN for cloud service provider accounts. It is only used on the Multi-Cloud CDN platform. You can call the [ListCloudAccounts](../6766/155786) API to query all cloud service provider account IDs.

ExactName.description_cn: 指定一个加速域名，查询与该域名精确匹配的加速域名的信息。
ExactName.description_en: Specify an acceleration domain name to query information about the acceleration domain name that exactly matches it

ExcludedVendor.description_cn: 指定一个或多个云服务商，查询不属于指定云服务商的加速域名。该参数的取值与 `Vendor` 参数相同。
ExcludedVendor.description_en: Specify one or more cloud service providers. The system will query acceleration domains not associated with the specified providers. This parameter uses the same value as the `Vendor` parameter.

Filters.description_cn: 指定数据筛选条件，查询满足筛选条件的加速域名。
Filters.description_en: Specify data filter criteria to query acceleration domain names that meet the filter criteria

Name.description_cn: 指定一个加速域名，查询与该域名模糊匹配的加速域名的信息。
Name.description_en: Specify an acceleration domain name to query information about other acceleration domain names that are fuzzy matches to it

Pagination.description_cn: 对查询结果进行分页并返回特定页码上的加速域名。
Pagination.description_en: Paginate query results and return accelerated domain names on the specified page

ProjectName.description_cn: 项目名（支持传多个，多个用英文“,”分割）
ProjectName.description_en: Project Name (supports multiple project names; separate with English commas)

Region.description_cn:

- `Domestic`：中国内地
- `Global`：全球
- `OverSea`：全球（不含中国内地）
Region.description_en:
Specify one or more acceleration regions to query acceleration domain names with the corresponding region attribute. This parameter supports the following values:

- `Domestic`: Mainland China
- `Global`: Global
- `OverSea`: Global (excluding Mainland China)

ScheduleCreated.description_cn: 是否只查询开启多云流量调度的域名。默认值为 `false`。
ScheduleCreated.description_en: Whether to only query domains with multi-cloud traffic scheduling enabled. Default value is `false`.

SortOrder.description_cn: 排序顺序。Asc：顺序、Desc：倒序
SortOrder.description_en: Sort order. Asc: ascending, Desc: descending

Status.description_cn:
指定一个或多个状态，查询处于指定状态的加速域名。该参数有以下取值：

- `Deploying`：部署中
- `DeployingFailed`：部署失败
- `Locked`：已封禁
- `Locking`：封禁中
- `Offline`：已停用
- `Online`：已启用
- `ReviewFailed`：审核失败
- `Reviewing`：审核中
- `Stopping`：停用中
Status.description_en:
Specify one or more statuses to query acceleration domain names in the selected statuses. This parameter supports the following values:

- `Deleting`: Deleting
- `Deploying`: Deploying
- `DeployingFailed`: Deployment failed
- `Locked`: Locked
- `Locking`: Locking
- `Offline`: Disabled
- `Online`: Enabled
- `ReviewFailed`: Review failed
- `Reviewing`: Under review
- `Stopping`: Stopping

SubProducts.description_cn:
指定一个或多个云产品，查询属于指定云产品的加速域名。该参数有以下取值：

- `cdn`：内容分发网络（CDN）
- `ucdn`：UCloud UCDN
- `cloudfront`：AWS CloudFront
- `amd`：Akamai AMD
- `dsa`：Akamai DSA
- `media_cdn`：Google Cloud Media CDN
- `dcdn`：全站加速（DCDN）
- `ecdn`：腾讯云 ECDN
- `edgeone`：腾讯云 EdgeOne
SubProducts.description_en:
Specify one or more cloud products to query acceleration domains associated with the selected products. This parameter supports the following values:

- `cdn`: Content Delivery Network (CDN)
- `ucdn`: UCloud UCDN
- `cloudfront`: AWS CloudFront
- `amd`: Akamai AMD
- `dsa`: Akamai DSA
- `media_cdn`: Google Cloud Media CDN
- `dcdn`: Whole-site Acceleration (DCDN)
- `ecdn`: Tencent Cloud ECDN
- `edgeone`: Tencent Cloud EdgeOne

TagFilterConnective.description_cn:

- `And`（默认）：逻辑与（与所有标签都匹配才算满足条件）
- `Or`：逻辑或（与任意一个标签匹配就算满足条件)
TagFilterConnective.description_en:
Specifies the logical connection between tags. This parameter supports the following options:
- `And` (default): Logical AND (matches only if all tags match)
- `Or`: Logical OR (matches if any tag matches)

TagFilters.description_cn: 标签过滤器。标签key之间为“且”的关系，同一个标签key的value之间为“或”的关系
TagFilters.description_en: Tag filter. Tag keys are connected by 'AND', while values under the same tag key are connected by 'OR'

Vendor.description_cn:

- `builtin`：内置加速
- `aliyun`：阿里云

VolcProjects.description_en:
Specify one or more IAM projects to query accelerated domain names belonging to the specified projects. If you do not set this parameter, all accelerated domain names are returned by default.
Volcengine uses projects to group and manage resources. Accelerated domain names synchronized from your cloud provider's CDN to Multi-Cloud CDN are assigned to the **default** project by default. You can change the project assignment of resources on the **Resource Management > Project** page in the [Access Control Console](https://console.volcengine.com/iam/resourcemanage/project).

SortBy.description_cn:
设置返回的云服务商账号的排序方式。该参数有以下取值：
- `CreatedAt`：按创建时间进行升序排序
- `UpdatedAt`：按最新一次更新时间进行升序排序
- `LastSyncAt`：按最近一次域名同步时间进行升序排序
- `-CreatedAt`（默认）：按创建时间进行降序排序
- `-UpdatedAt`：按最新一次更新时间进行降序排序
- `-LastSyncAt`：按最近一次域名同步时间进行降序排序

支持设置多个排序方式，不同排序方式的优先级由设置的顺序决定。例如，`["-CreatedAt", "UpdatedAt"]`表示优先按照创建时间进行降序排序，其次按照更新时间进行升序排序。
SortBy.description_en:
Set the sorting method for returned cloud service provider accounts. This parameter supports the following options:
- `CreatedAt`: Sort by creation time in ascending order
- `UpdatedAt`: Sort by most recent update time in ascending order
- `LastSyncAt`: Sort by most recent domain sync time in ascending order
- `-CreatedAt` (default): Sort by creation time in descending order
- `-UpdatedAt`: Sort by most recent update time in descending order
- `-LastSyncAt`: Sort by most recent domain sync time in descending order

You can set multiple sorting methods. The priority of each method is determined by the order in which they are set. For example, ["-CreatedAt", "UpdatedAt"] means sorting first by creation time in descending order, then by update time in ascending order.

If you do not specify a time range or specify an invalid time range, the API returns tasks created in the past 24 hours by default.

Area.description_cn:
设置您希望海外文件预热生效的国家或地区代码。
- 您可以调用[ListViews](/docs/6766/161891)接口获取国家或地区的代码列表（`Countries.Code`）。
- 允许指定多个国家或地区代码。多个代码间以半角逗号（,）分隔。

任务提交成功后，多云CDN将利用所选择国家或地区的终端向云服务商边缘节点发起请求，请求 `Urls` 参数所指定的文件。

国家或地区越多，边缘请求产生的边缘流量越多。
Area.description_en:
Set the country or region codes where you want overseas file preheating to take effect
- You can call the [ListViews](/docs/6766/161891) API to get the list of country or region codes (`Countries.Code`)
- You can specify multiple country or region codes, separated by half-width commas (,)

After you submit the task, Multi-Cloud CDN uses clients in the selected countries or regions to request the files specified by the `Urls` parameter from the cloud provider's edge nodes

Selecting more countries or regions will generate more edge traffic

TopAccountId.description_cn: 火山引擎账号ID,内部透传,OpenAPI中隐藏该字段
TopAccountId.description_en: Volcengine account ID, internal passthrough, this field is hidden in OpenAPI

Urls.description_cn:
设置要预取的文件 URL 列表。
- URL 必须以 `http://` 或者 `https://` 开头。
- 多个 URL 间使用换行符（`\n`）分隔。最多可设置 100 个 URL。
- 单日提交的所有海外文件预热任务包含的 URL 总数不超过 1,000 个。
- URL 中的域名必须是从支持的海外云服务商产品同步到多云CDN的加速域名。加速域名的加速状态必须是“已启用”或“部署中”。
		您可以调用[ListCdnDomains](/docs/6766/165536)接口查询同步到多云CDN的加速域名。（将请求参数 `Vendor` 设置为 `["akamai","aws","azure"]`。）
Urls.description_en:
Configure the list of file URLs to prefetch
- URLs must start with `http://` or `https://`
- Separate multiple URLs with a line break (`\n`). You can set up to 100 URLs
- The total number of URLs included in all overseas file prefetch tasks submitted in a single day must not exceed 1,000
- Each URL must contain an accelerated domain name synced from supported overseas cloud service provider products to Multi-Cloud CDN. The acceleration status of the domain name must be "Enabled" or "Deploying"
    You can call the [ListCdnDomains](/docs/6766/165536) API to query accelerated domain names synced to Multi-Cloud CDN (set the request parameter `Vendor` to `["akamai","aws","azure"]`).

Vendor.description_cn:

- 该参数有以下取值：`akamai`、`aws`、`azure`
- 允许指定多个云服务商。多个云服务商之间以半角逗号（,）分隔。
Vendor.description_en:

- You can specify multiple cloud service providers, separated by commas (,)

2. Global：全球，
3. Oversea：海外。

Urls.description_cn:

* 不能以数字、中划线（-）开头。

ProjectName.description_cn:

* 若该参数留空，新建  Mem0 记忆项目会加入默认（即`default`）项目。
* 项目是一个虚拟的概念，包括一组资源、用户和角色。通过项目可以对一组资源进行统一的查看和管理，并且控制项目内用户和角色对这些资源的权限。更多详情，请参见[资源管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/94333)。

* 按年购买：`12`，`24`，`36`。

SubnetId.description_cn:
设置 Mem0 记忆项目的子网 ID。
* 当开启 VPC 访问时（即 `EnableVPC` 为 

`true` ）时，该参数必填。

* 子网具有可用区属性，必须选择目标私有网络中与 Mem0 记忆项目属于同一可用区下的子网。
* 子网是私有网络内的 IP 地址块私有网络中的所有云资源都必须部署在子网内，子网为云资源分配私网 IP 地址，您可以调用 [CreateSubnet](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70496) 接口创建子网。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) 接口查询指定可用区内的所有子网列表信息，包括子网 ID。

Tags.description_cn:

若该参数留空，新建 Mem0 记忆项目默认不绑定任何标签。

VpcId.description_cn:

* 当开启 VPC 访问时（即 `EnableVPC` 为

* 建议 Mem0 记忆项目与需要连接的 ECS 实例在同一私有网络，否则它们无法通过内网互通来实现最佳性能。您可以调用 [CreateVpc](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70492) 接口创建私有网络。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) 接口查询符合指定条件的私有网络信息，包括私有网络 ID。
