SSLAction.description_cn:
对 SSL 加密功能进行对应操作。取值范围如下：

- `Open`（默认）：开通 SSL 加密功能。
- `Close`：关闭 SSL 加密功能。
- `Update`：更新 SSL 证书有效期。

仅当 SSL 加密功能已开通后，才支持更新 SSL 证书有效期操作。您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceSSL](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/149774) 接口查看实例的 SSL 功能是否已开通。
SSLAction.description_en:
Perform the corresponding operation for the SSL encryption feature. The available values are:

- `Open` (default): Enable SSL encryption feature
- `Close`: Disable SSL encryption feature
- `Update`: Update the SSL certificate validity period

You can only update the SSL certificate validity period after the SSL encryption feature is enabled. Call the [DescribeDBInstanceSSL](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/149774) API to check whether the SSL encryption feature is enabled for your instance.

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100741) 接口查询目标地域下所有 MongoDB 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID.
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100741) API to query basic information for all MongoDB instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

InstanceType.description_cn:
MongoDB 的实例类型，取值范围如下：

* `ReplicaSet`：副本集。
* `ShardedCluster`：分片集群 。
InstanceType.description_en:
MongoDB instance type. Options:

* `ReplicaSet`: replica set
* `ShardedCluster`: sharded cluster

MongosNodeNumber.description_cn:
Mongos 节点的数量。取值范围：2~32。
* Mongos 节点数量需大于等于 3 时，才支持减少。最多支持减少至 2 个节点。
* 仅当 `InstanceType` 为 `ShardedCluster` 时，该参数生效。
* 若该参数留空或与实例当前节点数相同，表示不修改当前实例的 Mongos 节点数量。
MongosNodeNumber.description_en:
Number of Mongos nodes. Value range: 2~32.
* Reducing the number of Mongos nodes is supported only when there are at least 3 nodes. You can reduce to a minimum of 2 nodes.
* This parameter is effective only when `InstanceType` is `ShardedCluster`.
* If this parameter is left empty or matches the current number of nodes, the Mongos node count will not be changed.

MongosNodeSpec.description_cn:
Mongos 节点的规格码。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeNodeSpecs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100734) 接口查询可创建 MongoDB 实例的支持的节点规格信息，包括节点规格码。
* 仅当 `InstanceType` 为 `ShardedCluster` 时，该参数生效。
* 若该参数留空或与实例当前节点规格相同，表示不修改当前实例的节点规格。
MongosNodeSpec.description_en:
Mongos node specification code.
* You can call the [DescribeNodeSpecs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100734) API to query supported node specifications for MongoDB instances, including specification codes.
* This parameter is effective only when `InstanceType` is `ShardedCluster`.
* If this parameter is left empty or matches the current node specification, the node specification will not be changed.

NodeSpec.description_cn:
实例的规格码。其中：

* 当实例类型为副本集（即 `InstanceType` 取值为 `ReplicaSet`）时，该参数表示副本集实例的计算节点规格（如 `mongo.2c4g`）。
* 当实例类型为分片集群（即 `InstanceType` 取值为 `ShardedCluster`）时，该参数表示 Shard 节点的规格（如 `mongo.shard.2c4g`）。

* 您可以调用 [DescribeNodeSpecs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100734) 接口查看实例规格信息，包括规格码。
* 若该参数留空或与实例当前节点规格相同，表示不修改当前实例的节点规格。
NodeSpec.description_en:
Instance specification code. Details:

* If the instance type is ReplicaSet (that is, `InstanceType` is set to `ReplicaSet`), this parameter specifies the compute node specification for the replica set instance (for example, `mongo.2c4g`).
* If the instance type is ShardedCluster (that is, `InstanceType` is set to `ShardedCluster`), this parameter specifies the specification for the Shard node (for example, `mongo.shard.2c4g`).

* You can call the [DescribeNodeSpecs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100734) API to view instance specification information, including the specification code.
* If this parameter is left empty or is the same as the current instance node specification, you will not change the current instance node specification.

ShardNumber.description_cn:
分片集群中 Shard 分片的数量。取值范围：2~32。
* 当前仅支持增加，不支持减少 Shard 分片数量。
* 仅当 `InstanceType` 为 `ShardedCluster` 时，该参数生效。
* 若该参数留空或与实例当前分片数相同，表示不修改当前实例的 Shard 分片数量。
ShardNumber.description_en:
Number of shards in the sharded cluster. Value range: 2~32.
* Only increases are supported; decreasing the number of shards is not supported.
* This parameter is effective only when `InstanceType` is `ShardedCluster`.
* If this parameter is left empty or matches the current number of shards, the number of shards will not be changed.

StorageSpaceGB.description_cn:
存储空间，单位：GiB。
* 如果需要变更存储空间，为保证变更后的实例能正常运行，变更后的存储空间容量需大于或等于已使用空间的 1.2 倍。
* 当 `InstanceType` 为 `ReplicaSet` 时，`StorageSpaceGB` 参数值即为实例的总存储空间。
* 当 `InstanceType` 为 `ShardedCluster` 时，整个实例的总容量 = `StorageSpaceGB` 参数值 × Shard 分片数。
* 若该参数留空或与实例当前存储空间相同，表示不修改当前实例的存储空间。
StorageSpaceGB.description_en:
Storage space, unit: GiB.
* To ensure the instance runs properly after modification, the new storage space must be at least 1.2 times the used space.
* When `InstanceType` is `ReplicaSet`, the `StorageSpaceGB` parameter is the total storage space for the instance.
* When `InstanceType` is `ShardedCluster`, total capacity = `StorageSpaceGB` parameter × number of shards.
* If this parameter is left empty or matches the current storage space, the storage space will not be changed.

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100741) 接口查询目标地域下所有 MongoDB 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100741) API to query basic information about all MongoDB instances in the target region, including the instance ID

ParameterObjects.description_cn:
需要修改的参数列表。
如需修改多个参数，必须保证多个参数的 `ParameterRole` 取值均一致。
ParameterObjects.description_en:
Parameters to Modify
If you want to modify multiple parameters, make sure their `ParameterRole` values are the same.

All.description_cn:
是否解绑指定实例上的所有标签。取值范围如下：

- `true`：解绑指定实例上的所有标签。
- `false`（默认）：不解绑指定实例上的所有标签。

仅当 `TagKeys` 取值为空时，`All` 参数才生效。
All.description_en:
Whether to unbind all tags from the specified instance. Valid values:

- `true`: Unbind all tags from the specified instance
- `false` (default): Do not unbind all tags from the specified instance

The `All` parameter takes effect only when `TagKeys` is empty.

InstanceIds.description_cn:
需要解绑标签的实例 ID。

- 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](../6447/100741) 接口查询目标地域下所有 MongoDB 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
- 支持一次传入多个实例 ID，多个 ID 间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
InstanceIds.description_en:
Instance IDs to unbind from tag

- You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](../6447/100741) API to query basic information for all MongoDB instances in the target region, including instance IDs.
- You can provide multiple instance IDs at once, separated by commas (,).

TagKeys.description_cn:
需要删除的标签键。

- 支持一次传入多个标签键，多个标签键间用英文逗号（,）分隔。最多同时传入 20 个标签键。
- 若该参数留空表示不解绑任何标签。
TagKeys.description_en:
Tag keys to delete

- You can enter multiple tag keys at once, separated by commas (,). Up to 20 tag keys can be entered at the same time
- Leave this field empty to avoid unbinding any tags

AccountName.description_cn:
数据库账号名称。

您可以调用 [DescribeDBAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100755) 接口查询目标实例下的账号信息，包括账号名称。
AccountName.description_en:
Database Account Name

You can call the [DescribeDBAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100755) API to query account information for the target instance, including the account name.

AccountPassword.description_cn:
数据库账号的密码。密码需同时满足如下要求：
- 只能为大小写字母、数字及以下特殊字符 `_#!@$%^&*()+=-`。
- 长度为 8~32 个字符。
- 至少包含大写字母、小写字母、数字或特殊字符中的任意三种。
- 不允许使用极易被破解的弱密码（如 `Admin@123`）。
- 修改密码可能导致正在使用当前账号的数据库连接中断，请谨慎操作。
- 若您在密码中使用了特殊字符，在连接实例时可能需要对特殊字符进行转义。更多详情，请参见[需要转义的特殊字符](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/177071#%E5%BD%93%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E4%B8%B2%E4%B8%AD%E8%B4%A6%E5%8F%B7%E5%AF%86%E7%A0%81%E5%8C%85%E5%90%AB%E4%BA%86%E7%89%B9%E6%AE%8A%E5%AD%97%E7%AC%A6%E6%97%B6%EF%BC%8C%E4%B8%BA%E4%BD%95%E4%BC%9A%E5%AF%BC%E8%87%B4%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E5%A4%B1%E8%B4%A5%EF%BC%9F)。
- 关于 MongoDB 中禁止使用的弱密码详情，请参见[弱密码列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/71101#%E5%BC%B1%E5%AF%86%E7%A0%81%E5%88%97%E8%A1%A8)。
AccountPassword.description_en:
Password for the database account. The password must meet all of the following requirements:
- Only uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and the following special characters are allowed: `_#!@$%^&*()+=-`
- Length must be between 8 and 32 characters
- Must include at least three of the following: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, or special characters
- Weak passwords that are easy to guess (such as `Admin@123`) are not allowed
- Changing the password may interrupt database connections that are currently using this account. Proceed with caution
- If your password contains special characters, you may need to escape them when connecting to an instance. For more details, see [Special characters that require escaping](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/177071#%E5%BD%93%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E4%B8%B2%E4%B8%AD%E8%B4%A6%E5%8F%B7%E5%AF%86%E7%A0%81%E5%8C%85%E5%90%AB%E4%BA%86%E7%89%B9%E6%AE%8A%E5%AD%97%E7%AC%A6%E6%97%B6%EF%BC%8C%E4%B8%BA%E4%BD%95%E4%BC%9A%E5%AF%BC%E8%87%B4%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E5%A4%B1%E8%B4%A5%EF%BC%9F)
- For details about weak passwords that are not allowed in MongoDB, see [Weak password list](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/71101#%E5%BC%B1%E5%AF%86%E7%A0%81%E5%88%97%E8%A1%A8)

AuthDB.description_cn:
账号所属的数据库。
若不设置该参数，默认需要修改密码的账号属于 admin 库。
AuthDB.description_en:
Database to which the account belongs
If you do not set this parameter, by default, accounts that need to change their password belong to the admin database.

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。

您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100741) 接口查询目标地域下所有 MongoDB 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID

You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100741) API to query basic information for all MongoDB instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

ResetDBAccount.description_cn:
是否将 root 账号的权限重置为出初始状态（即补全超级管理员账号允许被授予的权限）。取值范围如下：
- `false`（默认值）：不重置。
- `true`：重置。
- 该参数仅对 admin 库中的 root 账号（即 `AuthDB` 为 `admin` 且 `AccountName` 为 `root`）生效。
- 关于超级管理员账号允许授予的完整权限详情，请参见[数据库与账号权限](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/71101#%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E5%BA%93%E4%B8%8E%E8%B4%A6%E5%8F%B7%E6%9D%83%E9%99%90)。
ResetDBAccount.description_en:
Reset root account permissions to their initial state (restores all permissions allowed for the super administrator account). Value options:
- `false` (default): Do not reset
- `true`: Reset
- This parameter only applies to the root account in the admin database (where `AuthDB` is `admin` and `AccountName` is `root`).
- For details on all permissions allowed for the super administrator account, see [Database and account permissions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/71101#%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E5%BA%93%E4%B8%8E%E8%B4%A6%E5%8F%B7%E6%9D%83%E9%99%90).

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100741) 接口查询目标地域下所有 MongoDB 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100741) API to query basic information for all MongoDB instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

AutoRenew.description_cn:
是否开启自动续费，取值范围如下：

* `false`（默认）：不开启自动续费。
* `true`：开启自动续费。

当 `ChargeType` 取值为 `Prepaid` 时，该参数必填。
AutoRenew.description_en:
Enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

* `false` (default): Auto-renewal is disabled.
* `true`: Auto-renewal is enabled.

This parameter is required when `ChargeType` is set to `Prepaid`.

BackupId.description_cn:
源实例的备份文件 ID，用于按备份文件恢复时指定所用备份。
* `BackupId` 和 `RestoreTime` 参数必须选择一个传入。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeBackups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100761) 接口查询指定实例下所有的备份信息，包括备份 ID。
* 当前仅副本集实例支持按备份集恢复到新实例，分片集群实例不支持。更多关于按备份文件恢复到新实例的信息，请参见[按备份文件恢复](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/71003)。
BackupId.description_en:
Backup file ID of the source instance, used to specify the backup for restoration by backup file.
* Either the `BackupId` or `RestoreTime` parameter must be provided.
* You can call the [DescribeBackups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100761) API to query all backup information for a specified instance, including backup IDs.
* Currently, only replica set instances support restoring to a new instance by backup set. Sharded cluster instances are not supported. For more information about restoring to a new instance by backup file, see [Restore by Backup File](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/71003).

ChargeType.description_cn:
实例计费类型，取值范围如下：
- `PostPaid`（默认）：按量计费（也称后付费）。
- `Prepaid`：包年包月（也称预付费）。

关于计费类型的更多说明，请参见[计费类型](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/102430)。
ChargeType.description_en:
Instance billing type. Available values:
- `PostPaid` (default): Pay-as-you-go (also known as postpaid)
- `Prepaid`: Yearly/monthly subscription (also known as prepaid)

For more information about billing types, see [Billing Types](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/102430).

ConfigServerNodeSpec.description_cn:
分片集群中 ConfigServer 节点的规格码。默认值为 `mongo.config.2c4g`。
* 仅当实例类型为分片集群（即 `InstanceType` 取值为 `ShardedCluster`）时，该参数生效。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeNodeSpecs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100734) 接口查看分片集群的实例规格信息，包括规格码。
ConfigServerNodeSpec.description_en:
Specification code for the ConfigServer node in a sharded cluster. The default value is `mongo.config.2c4g`.
* This parameter is effective only when the instance type is a sharded cluster (that is, `InstanceType` is set to `ShardedCluster`).
* You can call the [DescribeNodeSpecs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100734) API to view specification information for sharded cluster instances, including specification codes.

ConfigServerStorageSpaceGB.description_cn:
分片集群中 ConfigServer 的存储空间，单位：GiB。步长为 10，默认值：20。
* 仅当实例类型为分片集群（即 `InstanceType` 取值为 `ShardedCluster`）时，该参数生效。
* 节点规格不同，对应支持的存储空间上限也不同，您可以调用 [DescribeNodeSpecs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100734) 接口查看 MongoDB 实例的规格信息，包括不同节点支持的存储空间规格。
* 为保证恢复后的新实例能正常运行，新实例的存储空间容量需**大于或等于原实例已使用空间的 1.2 倍**。更多详情，请参见[按备份文件恢复](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/71003)或[按时间点恢复](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/71013)。
ConfigServerStorageSpaceGB.description_en:
Storage space for ConfigServer in a sharded cluster, unit: GiB. Increment: 10. Default: 20
* This parameter only takes effect when the instance type is a sharded cluster (that is, `InstanceType` is set to `ShardedCluster`)
* The maximum supported storage varies by node specification. You can call the [DescribeNodeSpecs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100734) API to view MongoDB instance specifications, including supported storage sizes for different nodes
* To ensure the new instance created from a backup can run properly, its storage capacity must be **greater than or equal to 1.2 times the used space of the original instance**. For more details, see [Restore from Backup File](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/71003) or [Point-in-Time Recovery](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/71013)

DBEngine.description_cn:
数据库引擎。
无需设置。恢复后新实例的数据库引擎与源实例保持一致，取值固定为 `MongoDB`。
DBEngine.description_en:
Database engine.
No configuration required. The database engine of the restored new instance will be the same as the source instance, and is fixed as `MongoDB`.

DBEngineVersion.description_cn:
数据库引擎版本。
无需设置。恢复后新实例的数据库版本与源实例保持一致，例如源实例为 MongoDB 5.0，新实例也必须为 MongoDB 5.0。
DBEngineVersion.description_en:
Database Engine Version
No need to set. After recovery, the new instance uses the same database version as the source instance. For example, if the source instance is MongoDB 5.0, the new instance must also be MongoDB 5.0.

InstanceName.description_cn:
实例名称。名称需同时满足如下要求：

* 不能以数字、中划线（-）开头。
* 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）。
* 长度需为 2~64 个字符。

* 若该参数不填，实例 ID 默认作为实例名称。
* 您可以根据需要自定义实例名称，实例名称无唯一性要求。
InstanceName.description_en:
Instance name. The name must meet all of the following requirements:

* Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-).
* Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
* Length must be 2–64 characters.

* If this parameter is not specified, the instance ID will be used as the default instance name.
* You can customize the instance name as needed. Instance names do not need to be unique.

InstanceType.description_cn:
MongoDB 的实例类型。取值范围如下：

* `ReplicaSet`：副本集。
* `ShardedCluster`：分片集群。

新实例需和源实例的实例类型保持一致。例如源实例类型为分片集群，新实例也必须为分片集群。
InstanceType.description_en:
MongoDB instance type. Value options:

* `ReplicaSet`: Replica set
* `ShardedCluster`: Sharded cluster

The new instance must have the same instance type as the source instance. For example, if the source instance type is sharded cluster, the new instance must also be a sharded cluster.

MongosNodeNumber.description_cn:
分片集群中 Mongos 节点的数量。取值范围：2~32。
当实例类型为分片集群（即 `InstanceType` 取值为 `ShardedCluster`）时，该参数必填。
MongosNodeNumber.description_en:
The number of Mongos nodes in the sharded cluster. Value range: 2~32.
This parameter is required when the instance type is a sharded cluster (that is, when `InstanceType` is set to `ShardedCluster`).

MongosNodeSpec.description_cn:
分片集群中 Mongos 节点的规格码。
* 当实例类型为分片集群（即 `InstanceType` 取值为 `ShardedCluster`）时，该参数必填。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeNodeSpecs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100734) 接口查看分片集群的实例规格信息，包括规格码。
MongosNodeSpec.description_en:
Specification code for the Mongos node in the sharded cluster.
* This parameter is required when the instance type is a sharded cluster (that is, when `InstanceType` is set to `ShardedCluster`).
* You can call the [DescribeNodeSpecs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100734) API to view the instance specifications for sharded clusters, including the specification code.

NodeAvailabilityZone.description_cn:
添加只读节点信息，包括只读节点所在的可用区和数量。
该参数留空表示不在实例中添加任何只读节点。
NodeAvailabilityZone.description_en:
Add read-only node information, including the availability zone where the read-only nodes are located and the number of read-only nodes
Leaving this parameter blank means no read-only nodes will be added to the instance

NodeNumber.description_cn:
节点数量，其中：

* 当源实例类型为副本集（即 `InstanceType` 取值为 `ReplicaSet`）时，该参数表示恢复后新副本集实例的计算节点数量。
* 当源实例类型为分片集群（即 `InstanceType` 取值为 `ShardedCluster`）时，该参数表示恢复后新分片集群实例中，每个 Shard 分片中的节点数量。

当前每个副本集实例和每个 Shard 分片均仅支持 3 个节点，取值固定为`3`。
NodeNumber.description_en:
Number of nodes:

* If the source instance type is a replica set (that is, `InstanceType` is set to `ReplicaSet`), this parameter specifies the number of compute nodes in the new replica set instance after recovery.
* If the source instance type is a sharded cluster (that is, `InstanceType` is set to `ShardedCluster`), this parameter specifies the number of nodes in each Shard of the new sharded cluster instance after recovery.

Currently, each replica set instance and each Shard only support 3 nodes. The value is fixed at `3`.

NodeSpec.description_cn:
实例的规格码。其中：

* 当源实例类型为副本集（即 `InstanceType` 取值为 `ReplicaSet`）时，该参数表示恢复后新副本集实例的计算节点规格。
* 当源实例类型为分片集群（即 `InstanceType` 取值为 `ShardedCluster`）时，该参数表示恢复后新分片集群实例 Shard 节点的规格。

您可以调用 [DescribeNodeSpecs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100734) 接口查看实例规格信息，包括规格码。
NodeSpec.description_en:
Instance specification code:

* If the source instance type is a replica set (that is, `InstanceType` is set to `ReplicaSet`), this parameter specifies the compute node specification for the new replica set instance after recovery
* If the source instance type is a sharded cluster (that is, `InstanceType` is set to `ShardedCluster`), this parameter specifies the Shard node specification for the new sharded cluster instance after recovery

You can call the [DescribeNodeSpecs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100734) API to view instance specification information, including specification codes

Number.description_cn: 需要创建的实例数量。取值为大于等于 1 的正整数，默认值为1。
Number.description_en: Number of instances to create. Enter a positive integer greater than or equal to 1; default is 1

Period.description_cn:
包年包月实例的购买时长，其中：

* 当 `PeriodUnit` 为 `Year` 时，`Period` 取值为 1~3。
* 当 `PeriodUnit` 为 `Month` 时，`Period` 取值为 1~9。

当 `ChargeType` 取值为 `Prepaid` 时，该参数必填。
Period.description_en:
Subscription duration for annual/monthly instances:

* When `PeriodUnit` is `Year`, `Period` can be set to 1–3
* When `PeriodUnit` is `Month`, `Period` can be set to 1–9

This parameter is required when `ChargeType` is set to `Prepaid`

PeriodUnit.description_cn:
指定包年包月实例为包年或者包月类型。取值如下：

- `Year`：包年。
- `Month`：包月。

当 `ChargeType` 取值为 `Prepaid` 时，该参数必填。
PeriodUnit.description_en:
Specify the subscription type for the instance. Available options:

- `Year`: annual subscription
- `Month`: monthly subscription

This parameter is required when `ChargeType` is set to `Prepaid`.

Port.description_cn:
为恢复后的新实例设置私网连接地址的端口号，取值范围：1000~65535。
* 若该参数留空，实例私网连接地址默认使用 3717 端口。
* 实例创建成功后，您还可以通过 [ModifyDBEndpointPort](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/1275710) 接口修改连接地址的端口号。关于修改端口号的更多详情，请参见[修改端口号](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/132377)。
Port.description_en:
Set the port number for the private network connection address of the restored new instance. Value range: 1000~65535.
* If this parameter is left empty, the instance's private network connection address uses port 3717 by default.
* After the instance is created, you can also modify the connection address port number via the [ModifyDBEndpointPort](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/1275710) API. For more details, see [Modify Port Number](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/132377).

ProjectName.description_cn:
选择实例所属的项目。若该参数留空，新建实例会默认加入 default 项目。
项目是一个虚拟的概念，包括一组资源、用户和角色。通过项目可以对一组资源进行统一的查看和管理，并且控制项目内用户和角色对这些资源的权限。更多详情，请参见[资源管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/94333)。
ProjectName.description_en:
Select the project to which the instance belongs. If this parameter is left blank, the new instance will be added to the default project.
A project is a virtual concept that includes a group of resources, users, and roles. Projects allow unified viewing and management of resources, and control user and role permissions within the project. For more details, see [Resource Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/94333).

RestoreTime.description_cn:
用于指定按时间点恢复时所需要恢复的时间点，格式为 *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z（UTC）。
* `BackupId` 和 `RestoreTime` 参数必须选择一个传入。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeRecoverableTime](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100769) 接口查询指定实例所支持的可恢复时间段。
* 建议选择 7 天内的时间点进行恢复，恢复时间点超过 7 天，会影响主备实例的读写性能。更多关于按时间点恢复到新实例的信息，请参见[按时间点恢复](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/71013)。
RestoreTime.description_en:
Specifies the point in time to restore to during point-in-time recovery. Format: *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z (UTC).
* You must provide either the `BackupId` or `RestoreTime` parameter.
* You can call the [DescribeRecoverableTime](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100769) API to query the recoverable time range supported by the specified instance.
* We recommend restoring to a point within the last 7 days. Restoring to a point older than 7 days may affect the read/write performance of primary and secondary instances. For more information about point-in-time recovery to a new instance, see [Point-in-Time Recovery](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/71013).

ShardNumber.description_cn:
分片集群中 Shard 分片的数量。取值范围：2~32。
当实例类型为分片集群（即 `InstanceType` 取值为 `ShardedCluster`）时，该参数必填。
ShardNumber.description_en:
Number of shard partitions in the sharded cluster. Value range: 2~32.
This parameter is required when the instance type is a sharded cluster (that is, when `InstanceType` is set to `ShardedCluster`).

SrcDBInstanceId.description_cn:
备份恢复所用源实例的实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100741) 接口查询目标地域下所有 MongoDB 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
SrcDBInstanceId.description_en:
The instance ID of the source instance used for backup and recovery.
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100741) API to query basic information for all MongoDB instances in the target region, including instance IDs.

StorageSpaceGB.description_cn:
副本集实例的总存储空间，或分片集群中单个 Shard 分片的存储空间，单位：GiB，步长为 10。
* 若实例类型为分片集群（即 `InstanceType` 取值为 `ShardedCluster`）时，创建成功后整个实例的总容量为单个 Shard 分片的存储空间乘以 Shard 分片数。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeNodeSpecs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100734) 接口查看 MongoDB 实例的规格信息，包括不同节点支持的存储空间规格。
* 为保证恢复后的新实例能正常运行，新实例的存储空间容量需**大于或等于原实例已使用空间的 1.2 倍**。更多详情，请参见[按备份文件恢复](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/71003)或[按时间点恢复](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/71013)。
StorageSpaceGB.description_en:
Total storage space for a replica set instance, or storage space for a single Shard in a sharded cluster, unit: GiB, increment: 10
* If the instance type is a sharded cluster (that is, `InstanceType` is set to `ShardedCluster`), the total capacity of the instance after creation is the storage space per Shard multiplied by the number of Shards
* You can call the [DescribeNodeSpecs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100734) API to view MongoDB instance specifications, including supported storage sizes for different nodes
* To ensure the new instance created from a backup can run properly, its storage capacity must be **greater than or equal to 1.2 times the used space of the original instance**. For more details, see [Restore from Backup File](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/71003) or [Point-in-Time Recovery](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/71013)

SubnetId.description_cn:
子网 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) 接口查询指定私有网络下的子网列表信息，包括子网 ID。
SubnetId.description_en:
Subnet ID.
You can call the [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) API to query the list of subnets under a specified VPC, including subnet IDs.

SuperAccountName.description_cn: 数据库账号名称。当前仅支持在创建实例时设置超级管理员账号，账号名称固定为 `root`。
SuperAccountName.description_en: Database account name. Currently, only the super administrator account can be set when creating an instance, and the account name is fixed as `root`.

SuperAccountPassword.description_cn:
root 账号的密码。密码需同时满足如下条件：

* 至少包含大写字母、小写字母、数字或特殊字符中的任意三种。
* 特殊字符包括 `!@#$%^&*()_+-=`。
* 长度为 8~32 个字符。
* 不允许使用极易被破解的弱密码（如 `Admin@123`）。

* 若该参数留空，表示不为 root 账号设置密码，此时系统会自动为 root 账号生成一个密码来保证实例访问安全性。
* 您也可以在实例创建后，通过 [ResetDBAccount](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100756) 接口来修改 root 账号的密码。
* 若您在密码中使用了特殊字符，在连接实例时可能需要对特殊字符进行转义。更多详情，请参见[需要转义的特殊字符](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/177071#%E5%BD%93%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E4%B8%B2%E4%B8%AD%E8%B4%A6%E5%8F%B7%E5%AF%86%E7%A0%81%E5%8C%85%E5%90%AB%E4%BA%86%E7%89%B9%E6%AE%8A%E5%AD%97%E7%AC%A6%E6%97%B6%EF%BC%8C%E4%B8%BA%E4%BD%95%E4%BC%9A%E5%AF%BC%E8%87%B4%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E5%A4%B1%E8%B4%A5%EF%BC%9F)。
* 关于 MongoDB 中禁止使用的弱密码详情，请参见[弱密码列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/71101%E5%BC%B1%E5%AF%86%E7%A0%81%E5%88%97%E8%A1%A8)。
SuperAccountPassword.description_en:
Password for the root account. The password must meet all of the following requirements:

* Must include at least three of the following: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, or special characters.
* Special characters include `!@#$%^&*()_+-=`.
* Length must be 8–32 characters.
* Weak passwords that are easily cracked (such as `Admin@123`) are not allowed.

* If this parameter is left blank, no password will be set for the root account. In this case, the system will automatically generate a password for the root account to ensure instance security.
* You can also modify the root account password after instance creation using the [ResetDBAccount](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100756) API.
* If you use special characters in the password, you may need to escape them when connecting to the instance. For details, see [Special characters that require escaping](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/177071#%E5%BD%93%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E4%B8%B2%E4%B8%AD%E8%B4%A6%E5%8F%B7%E5%AF%86%E7%A0%81%E5%8C%85%E5%90%AB%E4%BA%86%E7%89%B9%E6%AE%8A%E5%AD%97%E7%AC%A6%E6%97%B6%EF%BC%8C%E4%B8%BA%E4%BD%95%E4%BC%9A%E5%AF%BC%E8%87%B4%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E5%A4%B1%E8%B4%A5%EF%BC%9F).
* For details about weak passwords prohibited in MongoDB, see the [Weak password list](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/71101%E5%BC%B1%E5%AF%86%E7%A0%81%E5%88%97%E8%A1%A8).

Tags.description_cn:
需要绑定的标签键和标签值数组对象。
该参数留空表示新建实例不绑定任何标签。
Tags.description_en:
Array object of tag keys and tag values to bind.
Leaving this parameter empty means the new instance will not be bound to any tags.

VpcId.description_cn:
私有网络 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) 接口查询当前账号下的所有私有网络列表信息，包括私有网络 ID。
VpcId.description_en:
Private network ID.
You can call the [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) API to query the list of all private networks under your account, including the private network ID.

ZoneId.description_cn:
新实例所在可用区的 ID。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeAvailabilityZones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100733) 接口查看当前账号下所有可创建 MongoDB 实例的可用区信息，包括可用区 ID。
* 如果您需要为新建的实例部署多可用区，您可以同时传入三个可用区 ID，多个可用区之间用英文逗号（,）隔开。更多详情，请参见[多可用区同城容灾解决方案](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/128833)。
ZoneId.description_en:
ID of the availability zone where the new instance is located.
* You can call the [DescribeAvailabilityZones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100733) API to view all available zones under your current account for creating MongoDB instances, including availability zone IDs.
* If you need to deploy the new instance across multiple availability zones, you can specify up to three availability zone IDs, separated by commas (,). For more details, see [Multi-AZ Disaster Recovery Solution](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/128833).

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。

您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100741) 接口查询目标地域下所有 MongoDB 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID

You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100741) API to query basic information for all MongoDB instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

NodeId.description_cn:
需要进行主从切换的从节点 ID。

必须传入从节点（即 `NodeRole` 为 `Secondary`）的节点 ID，不支持将隐藏节点（即 `NodeRole` 为 `Hidden`）切换为主节点。您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100738) 接口查询目标实例分片集群实例下所有节点的信息，包括节点角色。
NodeId.description_en:
ID of the secondary node to be switched to primary

You must provide the ID of a secondary node (where `NodeRole` is `Secondary`). Switching a hidden node (where `NodeRole` is `Hidden`) to primary is not supported. You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100738) API to view information about all nodes in the target instance's shard cluster, including node roles.

AccountDBPrivileges.description_cn:
需要为账号修改的数据库权限列表。
- 若不设置该参数，默认不修改账号在任何数据库的任何权限。
- 修改账号权限可能会导致当前账号连接对应数据库时，出现访问无权限等报错从而影响业务，请谨慎操作。
- 不允许同时将 `AccountDBPrivileges` 和 `AccountDesc` 参数留空。
AccountDBPrivileges.description_en:
List of database permissions to modify for the account
- If you do not set this parameter, the account's permissions for all databases remain unchanged
- Modifying account permissions may cause errors when connecting to the database, such as "no access permission," which can affect your business. Proceed with caution
- Do not leave both `AccountDBPrivileges` and `AccountDesc` parameters empty at the same time

AccountDesc.description_cn:
修改账号描述。备注信息需同时满足如下条件：
- 长度为 0~256 个字符。
- 可以包含数字、中文、英文、下划线（_）、短横线（-）。

- 若不设置该参数，默认不会修改账号的原备注信息。
- 不允许同时将 `AccountDBPrivileges` 和 `AccountDesc` 参数留空。
AccountDesc.description_en:
Modify the account remark. The remark must meet all of the following requirements:
- Length: 0–256 characters
- May include numbers, Chinese characters, English letters, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)

- If you do not set this parameter, the original account remark will remain unchanged by default
- You cannot leave both the `AccountDBPrivileges` and `AccountDesc` parameters empty

AccountName.description_cn:
需要修改权限或账号描述的账号名称。

您可以调用 [DescribeDBAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100755) 接口查询目标 MongoDB 实例下的所有账号信息，包括账号名称。
AccountName.description_en:
Account name(s) for which you want to modify permissions or descriptions

You can call the [DescribeDBAccounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100755) API to query all account information for the target MongoDB instance, including account names.

AuthDB.description_cn:
账号所属的数据库。
若不设置该参数，默认需要修改权限的账号属于 admin 库。
AuthDB.description_en:
The database to which the account belongs.
If you do not set this parameter, the account whose permissions need to be modified will belong to the admin database by default.

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100741) 接口查询目标地域下所有 MongoDB 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6447/100741) API to query basic information about all MongoDB instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

ResourceType.description_cn:
资源类型，取值如下：

* EIP：公网IP。
* NAT：NAT网关。
* CLB：传统型负载均衡。
* VPN：VPN网关。
* TR：中转路由器。
* PL：私网连接。
* DC：专线连接。

Description.description_cn:
网络路径描述信息。

* 长度限制为0~ 255个字符。
* 不填默认为空字符串。
* 需要以字母、中文或数字开头。可包含英文逗号（,）、点号（.）、下划线（_）、空格（ ）、等号（=）、短横线（-）、中文逗号（，）、中文句号（。）。

PathName.description_cn:
路径名称。

* 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符。
* 需要以字母、中文或数字开头，可包含点号（.）、下划线（_）和短横线（-）。

PrivateIP.description_cn:
自定义源私网IP地址，未传递则默认使用SourceIP。
仅用于容器网络路径分析场景，作为实际源IP地址。

Protocol.description_cn:
协议类型。取值如下：

* TCP
* UDP
* ICMP

Save.description_cn:
是否保存网络路径分析结果。取值如下：

* true：保存。
* false（默认）：不保存。

SourceIP.description_cn:
源IP地址。
若SourceType传入ECS，仅用于指定主网卡或辅助网卡的主私网IP地址。

SourceType.description_cn:
源资源类型。取值如下：

* ECS：云服务器。
* PublicIP：公网IP。
* DCG：专线网关。
* TRIPSec：TR类型IPSEC连接。
* VGW：VPN网关。

TargetType.description_cn:
目的资源类型。取值如下：

* ECS：云服务器。
* CLB：传统型负载均衡。
* PublicIP：公网IP。
* DCG：专线网关。
* TRIPSec：TR类型IPSC连接。
* VGW：VPN网关。
* PrivateIP：私网IP。

PageSize.description_cn: 分页查询时每页的行数。最大值为100，默认值为10。

ResourceType.description_cn:
资源类型，取值如下：

* EIP：公网IP。
* NAT：NAT网关。
* CLB：传统型负载均衡。
* VPN：VPN网关。
* TR：中转路由器。
* PL：私网连接。
* DC：专线网关。

InstanceIds.N.description_cn: ECS实例ID

BeginTime.description_cn:
起始时间戳，单位 ms。
默认时间跨度5分钟，最大时间跨度24小时

Direction.description_cn:
网络流量方向。取值如下：

* in：入云方向。
* out：出云方向。

> ResourceType为CEN、TR时，填out。

EndTime.description_cn: 结束时间戳，单位 ms。

MetricName.description_cn:
指标名。取值如下：

* bps：每秒比特数。
* pps：每秒包数。

ResourceType.description_cn:
资源类型。取值如下：

* EIP：弹性公网IP流量。
* CEN：云企业网流量。
* TR：中转路由器流量。
* DCG：专线网关流量。

BeginTime.description_cn:
起始时间戳，单位 ms。
默认时间跨度5分钟，最大时间跨度24小时。

Direction.description_cn:
网络流量方向。取值如下：

* in：入云方向。
* out：出云方向。

> ResourceType为CEN、TR时，填out。

EndTime.description_cn: 结束时间戳，单位 ms。

GroupBy.description_cn:
流量统计排序的维度，取值如下：

* 公网流量分析：
   * Tuple1：一元组（云端IP）。
   * Tuple2：二元组（源和目的IP）。
   * Tuple5：五元组（源和目的IP、源和目的端口、协议）。
   * Protocol：协议。
   * Country：客户端所属国家。
   * City：客户端所属城市。
   * ISP：客户端所属运营商。
   * SourcePort：源端口（仅当Direction为out时支持）。
   * DestinationPort：目的端口（仅当Direction为in时支持）。
* 跨域流量分析：
   * Tuple1：一元组（源IP）。
   * Tuple2：二元组（源和目的IP）。
   * PeerRegion：对端地域。
   * InstanceId：云企业网或中转路由器实例ID。
* 混合云流量分析：
   * Tuple1：一元组（云端IP）。
   * Tuple2：二元组（源和目的IP）。
   * InstanceId：专线网关实例ID。

ResourceType.description_cn:
资源类型，取值如下：

* EIP：弹性公网IP流量。
* CEN：云企业网流量。
* TR：中转路由器流量。
* DCG：专线网关流量。

SortBy.description_cn:
排序的指标。取值如下：

* ByteCount：流量字节数。
* PacketCount：流量包数。

SortOrder.description_cn:
排序方式，取值如下：

* asc：按正序排序。
* desc（默认）：按逆序排序。

TopCount.description_cn:
排序后靠前数据的条数。

* 取值范围：1-100。
* 默认值：10。

DnatEntryName.description_cn: DNAT规则的名称。需要以字母、中文或数字开头，可包含点号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符。 不填默认是DNAT规则的ID。
DnatEntryName.description_en: DNAT rule name. Must start with a letter, Chinese character, or number; can include periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Length must be between 1 and 128 characters. If left blank, the DNAT rule ID is used by default.

ExternalIp.description_cn:
NAT网关用于网络地址转换的IP地址。
- 当NAT网关为公网NAT网关时，传入其绑定的公网IP地址。
- 当NAT网关为私网NAT网关时，传入其中转IP地址。
ExternalIp.description_en:
IP address used by the NAT gateway for network address translation
- For a public NAT gateway, enter its associated public IP address
- For a private NAT gateway, enter its transit IP address

ExternalPort.description_cn:
接收来自外部请求的端口或端口段。
- 当PortType 传入any，则本参数必须传入any，表示所有端口。
- 当PortType 传入specified：
  - 端口范围为1～65535。
  - 若InternalPort传入端口段，则ExternalPort也必须传入端口段，且二者的端口数量相同，起止端口之间用短横线（-）分隔，例如InternalPort传入20-25，ExternalPort传入30-35。
ExternalPort.description_en:
This parameter specifies the external port or port range for incoming requests
- If PortType is set to any, this parameter must also be set to any
- If PortType is set to specified:
  - Port range must be 1–65535
  - If InternalPort is a port range, ExternalPort must also be a port range with the same number of ports. Use a hyphen (-) to separate the start and end ports. For example, if InternalPort is set to 20-25, ExternalPort should be set to 30-35

InternalIp.description_en: Private IP address of cloud server instance

InternalPort.description_cn:
云服务器实例私网IP的端口或端口段。
- 当PortType 传入any，则本参数必须传入any，表示所有端口。
- 当PortType 传入specified：
  - 端口范围为1～65535。
  - 若传入端口段，则起止端口之间用短横线（-）分隔，例如20-25。
InternalPort.description_en:
Port or port range for the private network IP of the cloud server instance
- If PortType is set to any, this parameter must also be set to any, indicating all ports
- If PortType is set to specified:
  - The valid port range is 1–65535
  - For a port range, use a hyphen (-) to separate the start and end ports, for example, 20-25

NatGatewayId.description_cn: DNAT规则所属的NAT网关ID。您可以调用 DescribeNatGateways 接口，查询NAT网关的ID。
NatGatewayId.description_en: NAT Gateway ID associated with the DNAT rule. Use the DescribeNatGateways API to query the NAT Gateway ID

PortType.description_cn:
DNAT规则的端口类型。
- specified（默认）：指定端口。
- any：任意端口。即DNAT IP映射。
PortType.description_en:
Port type for DNAT rules
- Specified (default): Use a specified port
- Any: Use any port, i.e., DNAT IP mapping

Protocol.description_cn:
协议类型。取值如下：
- 当PortType 传入specified，可以传入如下取值：
  - tcp：转发TCP协议的报文。
  - udp：转发UDP协议的报文。
- 当PortType 传入any，则本参数必须传入any，表示转发所有协议的报文。
Protocol.description_en:
Protocol type. Possible values:
- If PortType is set to specified, you can select:
  - tcp: forwards TCP protocol packets
  - udp: forwards UDP protocol packets
- If PortType is set to any, this parameter must also be set to any, which forwards all protocol packets

BillingType.description_cn:
NAT网关的计费方式。取值如下：
- 1 ：包年包月。
- 2（默认值）：按量计费-按规格计费。
- 3：按量计费-按使用量计费。
    
当NetworkType 传入intranet时，本参数仅支持且必须传入3。
BillingType.description_en:
NAT Gateway billing method. Available values:
- 1: Subscription.
- 2 (default): Pay-as-you-go by specification.
- 3: Pay-as-you-go by usage.

When NetworkType is set to intranet, only value 3 is supported and required.

ClientToken.description_cn:
保证请求幂等性。由客户端自动生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一，避免当调用API超时或服务器内部错误时，客户端多次重试导致重复性操作。取值：
- 仅支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
ClientToken.description_en:
Ensures request idempotency. The client automatically generates a parameter value to ensure uniqueness across requests, preventing repeated operations when the API call times out or the server encounters an internal error and the client retries multiple times. Value:
- Only ASCII characters are supported, and cannot exceed 64 characters.

Description.description_cn:
NAT网关的描述。
- 需要以字母、中文或数字开头。
- 可包含英文逗号（,）、点号（.）、下划线（_）、空格（ ）、等号（=）、短横线（-）、中文逗号（，）、中文句号（。）。
- 长度限制为1 ～ 255个字符。不填默认空字符串。
Description.description_en:
Description of the NAT Gateway.
- Must start with a letter, Chinese character, or number.
- Can include English comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。).
- Length limit: 1 to 255 characters. If not specified, defaults to an empty string.

DirectMode.description_cn:
NAT网关的直通模式，取值如下：
 - true（默认）：直通模式NAT网关。 
- false：非直通NAT网关。
DirectMode.description_en:
NAT Gateway passthrough mode. Values:
 - true (default): Passthrough mode NAT Gateway.
- false: Non-passthrough NAT Gateway.

NatGatewayName.description_cn:
NAT网关的名称。
- 需要以字母、中文或数字开头，可包含点号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
- 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符。不填默认是NAT网关实例的ID。
NatGatewayName.description_en:
Name of the NAT Gateway.
- Must start with a letter, Chinese character, or number. Can include period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-).
- Length limit: 1 to 128 characters. If not specified, defaults to the NAT Gateway instance ID.

NetworkType.description_cn:
NAT网关类型。取值如下：
- internet（默认）：公网NAT网关。
- intranet：私网NAT网关。
NetworkType.description_en:
NAT Gateway type. Values:
- internet (default): Public NAT Gateway.
- intranet: Private NAT Gateway.

Period.description_cn:
购买包年包月NAT网关的时长，默认1。
- 当PeriodUnit传入Month，Period取值范围：1 ~ 9、12、24、36。  
- 当PeriodUnit传入Year，Period取值范围：1 ~ 3。
Period.description_en:
Duration for purchasing a subscription NAT Gateway, default is 1.
- If PeriodUnit is Month, Period can be: 1 ~ 9, 12, 24, 36.
- If PeriodUnit is Year, Period can be: 1 ~ 3.

PeriodUnit.description_cn:
购买包年包月NAT网关时长的单位，默认Month。
- Month ：月。 
- Year ：年。
PeriodUnit.description_en:
Unit for the subscription NAT Gateway duration, default is Month.
- Month: Month.
- Year: Year.

ProjectName.description_cn: NAT网关所属项目的名称。不填默认加入default项目
ProjectName.description_en: Project name for the NAT Gateway. If left blank, it will be added to the default project

Spec.description_cn:
NAT网关的规格。
- Small（默认）：小型。
- Medium：中型。
- Large：大型。 
当BillingType 传入3时，不支持传入本参数。
Spec.description_en:
NAT Gateway specification.
- Small (default): Small.
- Medium: Medium.
- Large: Large.
If BillingType is 3, this parameter is not supported.

SubnetId.description_cn:
NAT网关所在子网的ID。
- 传入的子网，必须是VpcId传入的私有网络的子网。 
- 子网内至少有一个可用的私网IP。系统自动生成的NAT网关网卡将占用该子网一个私网IP。 
- 子网所在的可用区需要已部署NAT网关资源。您可调用DescribeSubnets查询私有网络下子网所在的可用区，同时您可以调用[ListNatGatewayAvailableZones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6404/149450)查询下当前地域下有NAT网关资源的可用区。子网所在可用区将作为NAT网关的主可用区，并自动关联备可用区。当主可用区发生故障时，NAT网关自动切换到备可用区。
SubnetId.description_en:
ID of the subnet where the NAT Gateway is located.
- The subnet provided must belong to the private network specified by VpcId.
- The subnet must have at least one available private IP. The automatically generated NAT Gateway network interface will occupy one private IP in this subnet.
- The subnet's availability zone must have deployed NAT Gateway resources. You can call DescribeSubnets to query the availability zone of the subnet under the private network, and you can also call [ListNatGatewayAvailableZones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6404/149450) to check which availability zones in the current region have NAT Gateway resources. The subnet's availability zone will be used as the primary availability zone for the NAT Gateway and will automatically associate with a backup availability zone. If the primary availability zone fails, the NAT Gateway will automatically switch to the backup availability zone.

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
NAT网关用户标签的标签键（Key）。
- 参数 - N - 参数：表示标签键（Key）的序号，取值范围：1～50，且N应按照连续的从小到大的顺序。 
- 多个标签键（Key）之间用&分隔。 不能以volc:开头，包括任意大小写形式。 
- 长度取值范围为1~128字符，允许输入各国语言文字、数字、空格（ ）、下划线（_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、中划线（-）和@（@）。 若标签键开头或结尾存在空格，系统会自动为其去除。
同一资源的标签键不允许重复。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
NAT Gateway user tag key (Key).
- Parameter - N - Parameter: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key (Key). Value range: 1–50, and N must be in consecutive ascending order.
- Multiple tag keys (Key) are separated by &. Cannot start with volc:, including any case variations.
- Length range: 1–128 characters. Supports input of characters from any language, numbers, spaces ( ), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and at signs (@). If there are spaces at the beginning or end of the tag key, the system will automatically remove them.
Tag keys must be unique for the same resource.

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
NAT网关用户标签的标签值（Value）。
- 参数 - N - 参数：表示标签值（Value）的序号，取值范围：1～50，且N应按照连续的从小到大的顺序。
- 多个标签值（Value）之间用&分隔。 
- 长度取值范围为0～256字符，不填默认为空。 
- 允许输入各国语言文字、数字、空格（ ）、下划线（_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、中划线（-）和@（@）。 
- 大小写敏感。 
- 若标签值（Value）开头或结尾存在空格，系统会自动为其去除。 
如果传入该参数，则必须先传入Tags.N.Key。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
NAT Gateway user tag value (Value).
- Parameter - N - Parameter: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value (Value). Value range: 1–50, and N must be in consecutive ascending order.
- Multiple tag values (Value) are separated by &.
- Length range: 0–256 characters. If not specified, defaults to empty.
- Supports input of characters from any language, numbers, spaces ( ), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and at signs (@).
- Case sensitive.
- If there are spaces at the beginning or end of the tag value (Value), the system will automatically remove them.
If this parameter is provided, Tags.N.Key must be specified first.

VpcId.description_cn: NAT网关所在私有网络的ID。
VpcId.description_en: ID of the private network where the NAT gateway is located

NatIp.description_cn:
中转IP的地址。
若不填，则系统自动从私网NAT网关所在子网随机分配一个空闲的IP地址。
NatIp.description_en:
Relay IP address
If left blank, the system randomly assigns an available IP address from the subnet of the private NAT gateway.

NatIpDescription.description_cn:
中转IP的描述。
- 长度限制为0~  255个字符。
- 不填默认为空字符串。
- 需要以字母、中文或数字开头。可包含英文逗号（,）、点号（.）、下划线（_）、空格（ ）、等号（=）、短横线（-）、中文逗号（，）、中文句号（。）。
NatIpDescription.description_en:
Transit IP description
- Length must be between 0 and 255 characters
- Defaults to an empty string if left blank
- Must start with a letter, Chinese character, or number. May include: English comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。)

NatIpName.description_cn:
中转IP的名称。
- 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符。
- 需要以字母、中文或数字开头，可包含点号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
- 不填默认为中转IP的ID。
NatIpName.description_en:
Transit IP name
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
- Must start with a letter, Chinese character, or number; can include periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
- If left blank, defaults to the transit IP ID

ConnectionLimit.description_cn: 并发连接数，取值范围1～1000000，单位：个。

CpsLimit.description_cn: 新建连接数上限，取值范围：1～150000，单位：个/秒。

InboundMbpsLimit.description_cn:
入方向带宽限速值，单位：Mbps。
限速上限值为NAT网关实例带宽上限，填0表示不限速。
InboundMbpsLimit.description_en:
Inbound bandwidth limit value, unit: Mbps.
The upper limit is the maximum bandwidth of the NAT gateway instance; enter 0 for unlimited bandwidth.

InternalIp.description_cn:
限速IP地址。
当IsDefault取值为true时，不支持传入本参数。
InternalIp.description_en:
Rate limiting IP address.
When IsDefault is set to true, this parameter cannot be specified.

IsDefault.description_cn:
限速规则类型是否为默认规则类型，取值如下：
- true：限速规则类型为默认规则。 
- false：限速规则类型为自定义规则。
IsDefault.description_en:
Is the rate limiting rule type the default rule type? Values:
- true: The rate limiting rule type is the default rule
- false: The rate limiting rule type is a custom rule

NatGatewayId.description_cn:
NAT网关的ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeNatGateways](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6404/79664?lang=zh) 接口，查询NAT网关的ID。
NatGatewayId.description_en:
NAT gateway ID.
You can call the [DescribeNatGateways](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6404/79664?lang=zh) API to query the NAT gateway ID.

OutboundMbpsLimit.description_cn:
出方向带宽限速值，单位：Mbps。
限速上限值为NAT网关实例带宽上限，填0表示不限速。
OutboundMbpsLimit.description_en:
Outbound bandwidth throttling value, unit: Mbps.
The maximum throttling value is the NAT gateway instance bandwidth limit; enter 0 for no throttling.

EipId.description_cn:
公网NAT网关绑定公网IP的ID。多个公网IP的ID之间用英文逗号分隔。
您可以调用 [DescribeEipAddresses](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6402/71035) 接口，查询公网IP的ID。
- 传入单个IP，SNAT规则将关联该公网IP，业务连接都通过该公网IP访问公网。
- 传入多个公网IP，SNAT规则将关联多个公网IP，业务连接通过对其五元组哈希算法后分配到的公网IP访问公网。
NatGatewayId 传入公网NAT网关时，此参数必选。

- 当SNAT规则关联多个公网IP时，建议将公网IP加入共享带宽包，避免业务因其中的单个公网IP带宽达到上限而导致流量丢包。
EipId.description_en:
The ID of the public IP bound to the public NAT gateway. Use commas to separate multiple public IP IDs
You can call the DescribeEipAddresses API to query public IP IDs
- If you enter a single IP, the SNAT rule will associate with that public IP, and all connections will access the internet through it
- If you enter multiple public IPs, the SNAT rule will associate with all specified public IPs. Connections will access the internet through the public IP assigned by a five-tuple hash algorithm
Note:
- This parameter is required when NatGatewayId is set to a public NAT gateway
- If you associate multiple public IPs with an SNAT rule, we recommend adding them to a shared bandwidth package to prevent packet loss if the bandwidth limit of a single public IP is reached. The shared bandwidth package is currently in invite-only testing. To request access, please contact your account manager

NatGatewayId.description_cn:
SNAT规则所属的NAT网关ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeNatGateways](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6404/79664) 接口，查询NAT网关的ID。
NatGatewayId.description_en: NAT Gateway ID associated with the SNAT rule. You can call the DescribeNatGateways API to query the NAT Gateway ID.

NatIpId.description_cn:
私网NAT网关的中转IP的ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeNatIps](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6404/1156156) 接口，查询中转IP的ID。
不填表示传入默认中转IP。
NatIpId.description_en:
Relay IP ID of the private NAT gateway
Leave blank to use the default relay IP

SnatEntryName.description_cn:
SNAT规则的名称。
- 需要以字母、中文或数字开头，可包含点号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
- 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符。不填默认是SNAT规则的ID。
SnatEntryName.description_en:
Name of the SNAT rule.
- Must start with a letter, Chinese character, or number, and can contain periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters. If not specified, the default is the SNAT rule ID.

SourceCidr.description_cn:
指定SNAT规则的网段。不同粒度对应不同的网段，具体说明如下：
- 私有网络粒度：指定NAT网关所在私有网络的网段。私有网络内所有未绑定公网IP的云服务器实例支持通过SNAT规则访问公网。 
- 子网粒度：指定子网的网段（如192.XX.XX.0/24）。指定子网内所有未绑定公网IP的云服务器实例支持通过SNAT规则访问公网。 
- 云服务器粒度：指定云服务器的网段（如192.XX.XX.20/32）。指定的未绑定公网IP的云服务器实例支持通过SNAT规则访问公网。 
- 自定义网段粒度：指定自定义网段（如192.XX.XX.0/26），指定自定义网段内所有未绑定公网IP的云服务器实例支持通过SNAT规则访问公网。 
SubnetId和SourceCidr两个参数必须且只能传入一个。若传入SubnetId，则不能传入SourceCidr。若传入SourceCidr，则不能传入SubnetId。 指定的网段与已存在的SNAT规则的网段不能重复。
SourceCidr.description_en:
Specify the network segment for the SNAT rule. Different granularities correspond to different network segments, as follows:

Private network granularity: Specify the network segment of the private network where the NAT gateway is located. All cloud server instances in this private network without a public IP can access the internet through the SNAT rule.

Subnet granularity: Specify the subnet segment (for example, 192.XX.XX.0/24). All cloud server instances in this subnet without a public IP can access the internet through the SNAT rule.

Cloud server granularity: Specify the segment of the cloud server (for example, 192.XX.XX.20/32). The specified cloud server instance without a public IP can access the internet through the SNAT rule.

Custom segment granularity: Specify a custom segment (for example, 192.XX.XX.0/26). All cloud server instances within this custom segment without a public IP can access the internet through the SNAT rule.

Note: You must specify either SubnetId or SourceCidr, but not both. If you enter SubnetId, do not enter SourceCidr. If you enter SourceCidr, do not enter SubnetId. The specified network segment cannot overlap with the network segments of existing SNAT rules.

SubnetId.description_cn:
SNAT规则关联子网的ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) 接口，查询子网的ID。
SubnetId 和SourceCidr 两个参数必须且只能传入一个。
SubnetId.description_en:
ID of the subnet associated with the SNAT rule.
You can call the [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) API to query the subnet ID.
You must specify either SubnetId or SourceCidr, but not both.

NatGatewayId.description_cn:
NAT网关的ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeNatGateways](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6404/79664)接口，查询NAT网关的ID。
NatGatewayId.description_en: The ID of the NAT gateway. You can call the [DescribeNatGateways](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6404/79664) API to query the NAT gateway ID.

SnatEntryId.description_en: ID of SNAT rule to delete

DnatEntryIds.N.description_cn:
DNAT规则的ID。
- 参数 - N：表示DNAT规则ID的序号，单次调用数量上限20个ID。 
- 多个ID之间请使用&分隔。
DnatEntryIds.N.description_en:
ID of the DNAT rule.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the DNAT rule ID. Up to 20 IDs can be specified per call.
- Use & to separate multiple IDs.

ExternalIp.description_cn:
NAT网关用于网络地址转换的IP地址。
- 当NAT网关为公网NAT网关时，传入其绑定的公网IP地址。
- 当NAT网关为私网NAT网关时，传入其中转IP地址。
ExternalIp.description_en:
IP address used by the NAT gateway for network address translation
- For a public NAT gateway, enter its bound public IP address
- For a private NAT gateway, enter its transit IP address

ExternalPort.description_cn: 接收来自外部请求的端口或端口段。
ExternalPort.description_en: Ports or port ranges that receive external requests

InternalIp.description_en: Private IP address of cloud server instance

InternalPort.description_cn: 云服务器实例私网IP的端口或端口段。
InternalPort.description_en: Port or port range of the cloud server instance's private IP

PageNumber.description_en: Page number of the list, default value is 1

PageSize.description_cn: 每页的行数，最大值为100，默认值为20。
PageSize.description_en: Rows per page: maximum 100, default 20

PortType.description_cn:
DNAT规则的端口类型。
- specified：指定端口。
- any：任意端口。即DNAT IP映射。
PortType.description_en:
Port Type for DNAT Rules
- Specified: Specified port
- Any: Any port (DNAT IP mapping)

Protocol.description_cn:
协议类型。
- tcp：转发TCP协议的报文。

EipId.description_cn:
公网NAT网关绑定公网IP的ID。多个公网IP的ID之间用英文逗号分隔。
您可以调用 [DescribeEipAddresses](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6402/71035) 接口，查询公网IP的ID。
- 传入单个IP，SNAT规则将关联该公网IP，业务连接都通过该公网IP访问公网。
- 传入多个公网IP，SNAT规则将关联多个公网IP，业务连接通过对其五元组哈希算法后分配到的公网IP访问公网。
当SNAT规则关联多个公网IP时，建议将公网IP加入共享带宽包，避免业务因其中的单个公网IP带宽达到上限而导致流量丢包。
EipId.description_en: The ID of the public IP bound to the public NAT gateway. Separate multiple public IP IDs with commas. You can call the [DescribeEipAddresses](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6402/71035) API to query the public IP ID. If you enter a single IP, the SNAT rule will be associated with that public IP, and all business connections will access the public network through it. If you enter multiple public IPs, the SNAT rule will be associated with multiple public IPs. Business connections will access the public network through the public IP assigned by the five-tuple hash algorithm.  When a SNAT rule is associated with multiple public IPs, it is recommended to add the public IPs to a shared bandwidth package to avoid packet loss caused by bandwidth limits on any single public IP.

- Use & to separate multiple tag values
- Length range is 0–256 characters; if not specified, defaults to empty
- Supports characters from any language, numbers, spaces ( ), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and at signs (@)
- Case sensitive
- If the tag value starts or ends with a space, the system will automatically remove it
> If this parameter is provided, Tags.N.Key must be specified first

- 长度取值范围为1~128字符，允许输入各国语言文字、数字、空格（ ）、下划线（\_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、中划线（-）和@（@）。
- 若标签键开头或结尾存在空格，系统会自动为其去除。
> 同一资源的标签键不允许重复。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Resource tag key
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, value range: 1–20
- Use & to separate multiple tag keys
- Cannot start with volc: or sys:, including any case variations
- Length range is 1–128 characters; supports characters from any language, numbers, spaces ( ), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and at signs (@)
- If the tag key starts or ends with a space, the system will automatically remove it
> Tag keys for the same resource must be unique

- true：当该私网域名及其子域名的解析状态码为 NOERROR 且本地解析返回为空时，触发公网递归解析规则，由公网递归 DNS 服务器返回查询结果。
- false：（默认）上述场景下不触发公网递归解析，直接返回空结果。

ZoneName.description_cn: 域名。可以是二级域名或多级域名。私网解析 PrivateZone 不支持以 `ivolces.com` 或 `privatelink.volces.com` 结尾的域名。

ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency. If you set this parameter, the result will always be the same for repeated API calls with identical request parameters. Only ASCII characters are allowed, and the value cannot exceed 64 characters.

Host.description_en: Domain prefix for the subdomain. See [Add DNS record](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/162461) for format requirements.

Line.description_cn:
为该解析记录指定生效线路。当客户端发起 DNS 查询时，PrivateZone 会根据客户端源 IP 所属的线路匹配对应的解析结果。 取值范围由域名是否开启智能解析决定： | 域名是否开启智能解析（[CreatePrivateZone](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/163105) 时 `LineMode`） | 取值说明 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | **未开启**（`LineMode=0`） | 不传 / `default` | 仅支持默认线路。未传时按 `default` 处理。 | | **已开启**（`LineMode=4`） | `default` | 默认线路。在未命中任何 AZ 线路或自定义线路时返回。建议至少为该域名保留一条 `default` 线路的记录作为兜底。 | | **已开启**（`LineMode=4`） | AZ 线路 | 按地域及可用区划分的线路。取值来自 [ListAvailabilityZones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/2520845?lang=zh) 返回的 `AzLine` 参数，格式为 `region;az`，例如 `cn-beijing;cn-beijing-a`。 | | **已开启**（`LineMode=4`） | 自定义线路 | 您创建的自定义线路，用于将解析结果与自定义的 IP 网段绑定。取值来自 [ListCustomLines](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/2520846?lang=zh) 返回的 `Line` 参数，例如 `custom-101`。
如果您尚未创建任何自定义线路，请先调用 [CreateCustomLine](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6758/2520850) 创建后再在本接口引用。 |

- INBOUND：入站终端节点，把来自外部的 DNS 查询请求转发到解析器。
Direction.description_en:
DNS request forwarding direction for endpoint nodes

- OUTBOUND (default): Outbound endpoint nodes forward DNS queries from within the VPC to external DNS servers
- INBOUND: Inbound endpoint nodes forward DNS queries from external sources to the resolver

EndpointType.description_cn:
终端节点类型。
- IPv4：IPv4 节点。
- DualStack：双栈节点。
EndpointType.description_en:
Terminal node type
- IPv4: IPv4 node
- DualStack: Dual-stack node

IpConfigs.description_cn: 终端节点的可用区、子网和 IP 配置。
IpConfigs.description_en: Endpoint Availability Zone, Subnet, and IP Configuration

Name.description_cn: 终端节点的名称。支持 UTF-8 格式。

SecurityGroupID.description_cn:
适用于终端节点 IP 地址的安全组 ID。终端节点默认会使用预设安全组：

- 对于出站终端节点：入方向拒绝流量通行；出方向放通 `0.0.0.0/0` 的 TCP 53 端口和 UDP 53 端口
- 对于入站终端节点：入方向放通 `0.0.0.0/0` 的 TCP 53 端口和 UDP 53 端口；出方向拒绝流量通行。
SecurityGroupID.description_en:
Security group ID for endpoint IP addresses. Endpoints use a default security group:

- For outbound endpoints: inbound traffic is denied; outbound traffic is allowed for TCP port 53 and UDP port 53 to `0.0.0.0/0`
- For inbound endpoints: inbound traffic is allowed for TCP port 53 and UDP port 53 from `0.0.0.0/0`; outbound traffic is denied

TagFilters.description_cn:
域名的标签。您需要指定：

- N：表示 `TagFilters` 的序号，取值范围：1～10。`N` 应按照从小到大的顺序，且必须为连续的数字。
- 标签键：例如 `"Key":"k1"`。如果您指定多个标签键，私网解析 PrivateZone 会查询同时包含所有指定标签键的域名。
- 标签值：例如 `Values":["v1", "v2"]`。标签值数组的长度取值范围为 1～3。

您可不传入 `Values`，表示查询时 `Values` 不作为查询条件。如果您把仅包含空字符串的数组传入 `Values` ，私网解析 PrivateZone 会查询 `Values` 为空的标签。如果一个 `Values` 包含多个值，这些值之间的关系为逻辑或（OR）。
TagFilters.description_en:
Domain name tags. You need to specify:

- N: The sequence number of `TagFilters`, ranging from 1 to 10. N must be consecutive numbers in ascending order.
- Tag key: For example, `"Key":"k1"`. If you specify multiple tag keys, PrivateZone will query domain names that contain all specified tag keys.
- Tag values: For example, `Values["v1", "v2"]`. The length of the tag values array must be between 1 and 3.

You can omit `Values`, which means it will not be used as a query condition. If you pass an array containing only an empty string to `Values`, PrivateZone will query tags with empty `Values`. If `Values` contains multiple values, the values are combined using a logical OR.

VpcTrns.description_en: The [TRN](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/1134319) of one or more VPCs associated with the domain name. Format: `trn:vpc:region:accountId:vpc/vpcId`. If you need to verify whether a sub-user has permission to operate on the project where the VPC associated with the domain name is located, you must provide this parameter.

TagFilters.description_cn:
终端节点的标签。您需要指定：

- N：表示 `TagFilters` 的序号，取值范围：1～10。`N` 应按照从小到大的顺序，且必须为连续的数字。
- 标签键：例如 `"Key":"k1"`。如果您指定多个标签键，私网解析 PrivateZone 会查询同时包含所有指定标签键的终端节点。
- 标签值：例如 `Values":["v1", "v2"]`。标签值数组的长度取值范围为 1～3。

您可不传入 `Values`，表示查询时 `Values` 不作为查询条件。如果您把仅包含空字符串的数组传入 `Values` ，私网解析 PrivateZone 会查询 `Values` 为空的标签。如果一个 `Values` 包含多个值，这些值之间的关系为逻辑或（OR）。
TagFilters.description_en:
Tags for endpoint nodes. You need to specify:

- N: The index of `TagFilters`, ranging from 1 to 10. N must be consecutive and in ascending order
- Tag key: For example, `"Key":"k1"`. If you specify multiple tag keys, PrivateZone will query endpoint nodes that contain all specified tag keys
- Tag value: For example, `"Values":["v1", "v2"]`. The tag value array must contain 1 to 3 items

You can omit `Values` to exclude it from the query conditions. If you pass an array containing only an empty string to `Values`, PrivateZone will query tags where `Values` is empty. If `Values` contains multiple values, the relationship between them is logical OR

Name.description_cn: 转发规则的名称。私网解析 PrivateZone 会按照该参数对转发规则的名称进行模糊查询。如果您不传入该参数，则该参数不作为查询条件。
Name.description_en: Forwarding rule name. PrivateZone performs a fuzzy search on forwarding rule names based on this parameter. If you do not provide this parameter, it will not be used as a search condition.

PageNumber.description_cn: 页码。API 返回该页码所包含的域名。该参数的默认值是 1。
PageNumber.description_en: Page number. The API returns the domain names included on this page number. The default value for this parameter is 1.

PageSize.description_cn: 每页包含的域名数量。 系统会将获取的域名进行分页显示。页数是由获取的域名总数和 PageSize 确定。 该参数的默认值是 10，最大值是 500。
PageSize.description_en:
Number of domain names per page
The system displays retrieved domain names in a paginated format
The number of pages is determined by the total number of domain names and the PageSize
The default value for this parameter is 10, and the maximum value is 500

ProjectName.description_cn: 转发规则所属的项目名称。如果您不传入该参数，该参数不作为查询条件。
ProjectName.description_en: Project name associated with the forwarding rule. If you do not provide this parameter, it will not be used as a query condition.

TagFilters.description_cn:
转发规则的标签。您需要指定：

- N：表示 `TagFilters` 的序号，取值范围：1～10。`N` 应按照从小到大的顺序，且必须为连续的数字。
- 标签键：例如 `"Key":"k1"`。如果您指定多个标签键，私网解析 PrivateZone 会查询同时包含所有指定标签键的转发规则。
- 标签值：例如 `Values":["v1", "v2"]`。标签值数组的长度取值范围为 1～3。

您可不传入 `Values`，表示查询时 `Values` 不作为查询条件。如果您把仅包含空字符串的数组传入 `Values` ，私网解析 PrivateZone 会查询 `Values` 为空的标签。如果一个 `Values` 包含多个值，这些值之间的关系为逻辑或（OR）。
TagFilters.description_en:
Tags for forwarding rules. You need to specify:

- N: The sequence number of `TagFilters`, ranging from 1 to 10. N must be consecutive numbers in ascending order
- Tag key: For example, `"Key":"k1"`. If you specify multiple tag keys, PrivateZone will query forwarding rules that contain all specified tag keys
- Tag values: For example, `Values["v1", "v2"]`. The tag values array must contain 1 to 3 items

You can omit `Values` to indicate that tag values are not used as query criteria. If you pass an array containing only an empty string to `Values`, PrivateZone will query tags where `Values` is empty. If `Values` contains multiple values, these values are combined with a logical OR

ZoneName.description_cn: 转发规则所关联的主域名。私网解析 PrivateZone 会按照该参数对主域名进行模糊查询。例如，您把该参数设置为 `example.com`，则对 `example.com` 以及 `example.com` 的所有子域名的 DNS 请求都会被转发。如果您不传入该参数，则该参数不作为查询条件。
ZoneName.description_en: Primary domain name associated with the forwarding rule. PrivateZone performs a fuzzy search for the primary domain name based on this parameter. For example, if you set this parameter to `example.com`, DNS requests for `example.com` and all its subdomains will be forwarded. If you do not provide this parameter, it will not be used as a query condition.

PageNumber.description_cn: 页码。API 返回该页码所包含的授权信息。默认值为 1。

PageSize.description_cn: 每页包含的授权信息数量。系统会将获取的授权信息进行分页显示，页数由授权信息总数和 PageSize 确定。默认值为 10，最大值为 500。

MaxResults.description_cn: 返回值中标签的数量，默认为 10，最大为 100。
MaxResults.description_en: Number of tags in the return value; default is 10, maximum is 100

NextToken.description_cn: 分页查询凭证，用于标记分页的位置。您在初次调用该 API 时无需设置该参数。非初次调用该 API 时，该参数的取值为上一次 API 调用时该 API 返回的 NextToken 参数值。
NextToken.description_en: The pagination token parameter marks the position in paginated queries. You do not need to set this parameter when calling the API for the first time. For subsequent calls, set this parameter to the value of NextToken returned by the previous API call.

TagFilters.description_cn:
资源的标签。您需要指定：

- N：表示 `TagFilters` 的序号，取值范围：1～10。`N` 应按照从小到大的顺序，且必须为连续的数字。
- 标签键：例如 `"Key":"k1"`。如果您指定多个标签键，私网解析 PrivateZone 会查询同时包含所有指定标签键的资源。
- 标签值：例如 `Values":["v1", "v2"]`。标签值数组的长度取值范围为 1～3。

您可不传入 `Values`，表示查询时 `Values` 不作为查询条件。如果您把仅包含空字符串的数组传入 `Values`，私网解析 PrivateZone 会查询 `Values` 为空的标签。如果一个 `Values` 包含多个值，这些值之间的关系为逻辑或（OR）。
TagFilters.description_en:
Resource tags. You need to specify:

- N: The index of the `TagFilters`, with a value range of 1–10. N must be in ascending order and must be consecutive numbers.
- Tag key: For example, `"Key":"k1"`. If you specify multiple tag keys, PrivateZone will query resources that contain all specified tag keys.
- Tag value: For example, `"Values":["v1", "v2"]`. The length of the tag value array must be between 1 and 3.

You can omit `Values` to indicate that tag values are not used as query criteria. If you pass an array containing only an empty string to `Values`, PrivateZone will query tags where `Values` is empty. If `Values` contains multiple values, the relationship between them is logical OR.

TagType.description_cn:

- system：系统标签。

如果您不传入该参数，私网解析 PrivateZone 会查询全部类型的标签。
TagType.description_en:
Tag types

- custom: User tag
- system: System tag

If you do not provide this parameter, private network resolution PrivateZone will query all tag types

NodataFallback.description_cn:
针对私网域名在解析状态码为 NOERROR 且本地解析为空的场景，是否回退到公网递归解析。
只有开启递归解析开关时（RecursionMode = true），该参数才生效。


- true：当该私网域名及其子域名的解析状态码为 NOERROR 且本地解析返回为空时，触发公网递归解析规则，由公网递归 DNS 服务器返回查询结果。
- false：（默认）上述场景下不触发公网递归解析，直接返回空结果。
NodataFallback.description_en: When resolving private network domain names, if the resolution status code is noerror and local resolution returns empty, external recursive resolution will be performed; you must enable the recursion switch for it to take effect

RecursionMode.description_cn:
