DiagnosticsType.description_en:
Type of connection for diagnostics. Options:
- `PrivateLink`: Private network connection
- `PublicLink`: Public network connection

When this field is used as a request parameter, the default value is `PrivateLink`.

EcsInstanceIds.description_cn:
云服务器 ID。
- 私网连接诊断时，即 DiagnosticsType 取值为 `PrivateLink` 时必填。
- 最多可填写 50 个云服务器 ID，云服务器 ID 不能重复。
EcsInstanceIds.description_en:
Cloud Server ID.
- Required for private network diagnostics, that is, when DiagnosticsType is set to `PrivateLink`.
- You can enter up to 50 Cloud Server IDs. IDs must be unique.

EndpointId.description_cn: 进行连接诊断的终端 ID。
EndpointId.description_en: Terminal ID for connection diagnostics

PublicIpAddresses.description_cn:
公网 IP 地址。
- 公网连接诊断时，即 DiagnosticsType 取值为 `PublicLink` 时必填。
- 最多可填写 50 个公网 IP，公网 IP 不能重复。
PublicIpAddresses.description_en:
Public IP address.
- Required for public network diagnostics, that is, when DiagnosticsType is set to `PublicLink`.
- You can enter up to 50 public IP addresses. IP addresses must be unique.

InstanceIds.description_cn:
需要绑定标签的实例 ID。

支持一次传入多个实例 ID，多个 ID 间用英文逗号（,）分隔。单次最多同时传入 20 个实例 ID，单个实例最多绑定 50 个标签。
InstanceIds.description_en:
Instance ID to bind tags

You can enter multiple instance IDs at once, separated by commas (,). You can enter up to 20 instance IDs at a time. Each instance can have up to 50 tags.

Tags.description_cn:
需要绑定的标签键和标签值数组对象。

支持一次传入多组标签键值对象，多组标签键值对象间用英文逗号（,）分隔。单次最多同时传入 20 组标签键值对，单个实例最多绑定 50 个标签。
Tags.description_en:
Array object of tag keys and tag values that need to be bound

You can submit multiple tag key-value objects at once, separated by commas. You can submit up to 20 tag key-value objects per request, and each instance can have up to 50 tags.

AllowListIds.description_cn:
需要绑定实例的白名单 ID。

- 您可以调用 [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170675) 接口查询指定地域下所有的白名单列表信息，包括白名单 ID。
- 支持一次传入多个白名单 ID，多个 ID 间用英文逗号（,）分隔。单次最多可传入 100 个白名单 ID。
- 不支持同时传入多个实例 ID 和白名单，即仅允许一次将多个实例同时绑定到同一个白名单，或将一个实例同时绑定到多个白名单。
AllowListIds.description_en:
Whitelist ID to be bound to the instance

- You can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170675) API to query all whitelists in a specified region, including whitelist IDs
- You can enter multiple whitelist IDs at once, separated by commas (,). Up to 100 whitelist IDs can be entered at a time
- You cannot enter multiple instance IDs and whitelist IDs at the same time. You can only bind multiple instances to the same whitelist at once, or bind one instance to multiple whitelists at once

InstanceIds.description_cn:
需要绑定白名单的实例 ID。

- 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170652) 接口查询目标地域下所有 MySQL 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
- 支持一次传入多个实例 ID，多个 ID 间用英文逗号（,）分隔。单次最多可传入 200 个实例 ID。
- 不支持同时传入多个实例 ID 和白名单，即仅允许一次将多个实例同时绑定到同一个白名单，或将一个实例同时绑定到多个白名单。
InstanceIds.description_en:
Instance IDs to be bound to the whitelist.

- You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170652) API to query basic information of all MySQL instances in the target region, including instance IDs.
- You can enter multiple instance IDs at once, separated by commas (,). Up to 200 instance IDs can be entered at a time.
- You cannot specify multiple instance IDs and multiple whitelists at the same time. You can only bind multiple instances to the same whitelist at once, or bind one instance to multiple whitelists at once.

DisassociateAllowListInfos.description_cn: 非白会话所属的实例和白名单信息。
DisassociateAllowListInfos.description_en: Instances and allowlist information associated with non-allowlist sessions.

InstanceIds.description_cn:
需清理非白会话的实例的 ID。
- 最多可传入 10 个实例 ID。
- 实例 ID 之间使用（,）分隔。
InstanceIds.description_en:
ID of the instance whose non-allowlist sessions need to be cleared.
- You can specify up to 10 instance IDs
- Separate instance IDs with commas (,)

ProjectName.description_cn:
所属的项目。
如您调用接口使用的 AK/SK 属于某个子账号，且该子账号只拥有某个项目的权限，需要传入该请求参数。
ProjectName.description_en:
Associated Project
If the AK/SK you use to call the API belongs to a sub-account that only has access to a specific project, you must provide this request parameter

Region.description_cn:
复制参数模板的目标地域。
如不设置该字段，则将参数模板复制到当前地域。
Region.description_en:
Target Region for Copying Parameter Template
If you do not set this field, the parameter template will be copied to the current region.

AllowList.description_cn:
输入 IP 地址或 CIDR 格式的 IP 地址段。

- 每个白名单分组中最多支持设置 300 个 IP 地址或 CIDR 格式的 IP 地址段。
- 不允许设置重复的地址，多个地址间用英文逗号（,）隔开。
- 设置`0.0.0.0/0`，表示允许所有地址访问。
- 设置`127.0.0.1`，表示禁止所有地址访问。
- 同时设置`0.0.0.0/0`和`127.0.0.1`，表示允许所有地址访问。
- 设置 CIDR `192.168.1.0/24`，表示允许该网段内的 IP 地址访问。
- 设置`192.168.1.1`，表示仅允许该 IP 地址访问。
- 该字段不能与 UserAllowList 字段同时使用。
AllowList.description_en:
Enter an IP address or a CIDR-formatted IP address range

- Each whitelist group supports up to 300 IP addresses or CIDR-formatted IP address ranges
- Duplicate addresses are not allowed; separate multiple addresses with English commas (,)
- Setting `0.0.0.0/0` allows access from all addresses
- Setting `127.0.0.1` blocks access from all addresses
- Setting both `0.0.0.0/0` and `127.0.0.1` allows access from all addresses
- Setting CIDR `192.168.1.0/24` allows access from IP addresses within that subnet
- Setting `192.168.1.1` allows access only from that IP address
- This field cannot be used together with the UserAllowList field

AllowListCategory.description_cn:
白名单分类。取值：

- `Ordinary`：普通白名单。
- `Default`：默认白名单。

该参数作为请求参数时，默认值为 `Ordinary`。
AllowListCategory.description_en:
Whitelist category. Possible values:

- `Ordinary`: Ordinary whitelist
- `Default`: Default whitelist

When used as a request parameter, the default value is `Ordinary`

AllowListDesc.description_cn: 白名单的备注信息，长度不可超过 200 个字符。
AllowListDesc.description_en: Whitelist remark cannot exceed 200 characters

AllowListName.description_cn:
白名单名称，名称需同时满足如下要求：

- 不能以数字或中划线（-）开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）。
- 长度需为 1~128 个字符。
AllowListName.description_en:
Whitelist name requirements (must meet all of the following):

- Must not start with a number or hyphen (-)
- Can only include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

AllowListType.description_cn: 白名单内的 IP 地址类型。当前仅支持 IPv4 地址。
AllowListType.description_en: Type of IP address in the whitelist Only IPv4 addresses are supported

ProjectName.description_cn:
所属的项目。
如您调用接口使用的 AK/SK 属于某个子账号，且该子账号只拥有某个项目的权限，需要传入该请求参数。
ProjectName.description_en:
Associated Project
If the AK/SK you use to call the API belongs to a sub-account and that sub-account only has permission for a specific project, you must provide this request parameter.

SecurityGroupBindInfos.description_cn:
白名单关联的安全组的信息。
该字段不能与 SecurityGroupIds 同时使用。
SecurityGroupBindInfos.description_en:
Information about security groups associated with the whitelist
This field cannot be used together with SecurityGroupIds

SecurityGroupIds.description_cn:
需要关联的安全组 ID 列表。

- 您可以调用 [DescribeSecurityGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70753) 接口查询安全组信息，包括安全组 ID。单个白名单单次最多可选择添加 10 个安全组。
- 该字段不能与 SecurityGroupBindInfos 同时使用。
SecurityGroupIds.description_en:
List of security group IDs to associate

- You can call the [DescribeSecurityGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70753) API to query security group information, including security group IDs. You can add up to 10 security groups to a single whitelist at a time
- This field cannot be used together with SecurityGroupBindInfos

UserAllowList.description_cn:
安全组之外的、需要加入白名单的 IP 地址。可输入 IP 地址或 CIDR 格式的 IP 地址段。

该字段不能与 AllowList 字段同时使用。
UserAllowList.description_en:
IP addresses outside the security group that need to be whitelisted. Enter an IP address or an IP address range in CIDR format.

This field cannot be used together with the AllowList field.

BackupMeta.description_cn:
创建逻辑备份类型的库表备份时，用于指定要备份的库表信息。
- 进行逻辑备份（BackupMethod=Logical），且备份方式为指定库表备份（BackupType 参数未传入值）时，该参数必填。其他备份类型和备份方式，该参数取值无效。
- 数量限制：创建指定库表备份时，库的数量上限为 5000，每个库的表的数量上限为 5000。
BackupMeta.description_en:
When creating a logical backup of database tables, use this to specify the database and table information to be backed up.
- For logical backups (BackupMethod=Logical) with the backup method as specified database table backup (BackupType parameter not provided), this parameter is required. For other backup types and methods, this parameter is not applicable.
- Quantity limits: When creating a specified database table backup, the maximum number of databases is 5000, and the maximum number of tables per database is 5000.

BackupMethod.description_cn:
实例的存储类型不同时，支持的备份类型不同：
- 如实例的存储类型为本地盘，可选择物理备份 `Physical`（默认值） 或逻辑备份 `Logical`。
- 如实例的存储类型为云盘，仅可选择快照备份 `Snapshot`。
BackupMethod.description_en:
Supported backup types vary by instance storage type:
- If the instance storage type is local disk, you can choose physical backup `Physical` (default) or logical backup `Logical`.
- If the instance storage type is cloud disk, only snapshot backup `Snapshot` is available.

BackupName.description_cn:
设置备份的名称。命名规则如下：
- 不能以中划线（-）开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）。
- 长度需要在 1~128 个字符之间。

如不设置，则采用备份 ID 作为备份名称。
BackupName.description_en:
Set the backup name. Naming rules are as follows:
- Cannot start with a hyphen (-).
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.

If not set, the backup ID will be used as the backup name.

BackupType.description_cn:
备份方式。

- 取值范围：
	- 如备份类型为物理备份 `Physical` 或快照备份 `Snapshot`时，备份方式选择为全量备份 `Full`（默认值）或增量备份 `HighFrequencyIncrement`。
	- 如选择备份类型为逻辑备份 `Logical`，备份方式则应选择为全库备份 `DumpAll`；为指定库表备份的备份集时，无需传入该参数，仅需在 BackupMeta 参数中指定数据库和表。
BackupType.description_en:
Backup method.

- Value range:
	- If the backup type is physical backup `Physical` or snapshot backup `Snapshot`, choose full backup `Full` (default) or incremental backup `HighFrequencyIncrement`.
	- If the backup type is logical backup `Logical`, choose full database backup `DumpAll`; for backup sets of specified database tables, you do not need to provide this parameter, just specify the databases and tables in the BackupMeta parameter.

DataBackupTime.description_cn: 用于支持“运维操作结束后，如果还在备份窗口内，重新发起备份”的特性
DataBackupTime.description_en: Used to support the feature of re-initiating backup after maintenance operations if still within the backup window

AccountDesc.description_cn: 账号信息描述信息，长度不超过 256 个字符。
AccountDesc.example_cn: 这是一段账号的描述信息。

AccountName.description_cn:
数据库账号名称。命名规则如下：

- 长度为 2~32 个字符。
- 以字母开头，以字母或数字结尾。
- 由字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）组成。
- 账号名称在实例内必须是唯一的。
- 不能使用某些预留字，被禁用的预留字请参见[禁用词列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/66162)。

在高权限账号名称中可使用关键字 root 和 admin。
AccountName.description_en:
Database account name. Naming rules:

- Must be 2–32 characters long
- Starts with a letter and ends with a letter or number
- Can include letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
- Account name must be unique within the instance
- Certain reserved words cannot be used. For disabled reserved words, see the [disabled words list](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/66162)

You can use the keywords root and admin in high-privilege account names

AccountPassword.description_cn:
数据库账号的密码。规则如下：

- 长度为 8~32 个字符。
- 由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的至少三种组成。
- 特殊字符为 `!#$%&()*+,-.=?@^_|/`。
AccountPassword.description_en:
Password for the database account. Rules:

- Must be 8–32 characters long
- Must contain at least three of the following: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, special characters
- Allowed special characters: `!#$%&()*+,-.=?@^_|/`

AccountPrivileges.description_cn:
账号的指定数据库权限信息。

当 AccountType 取值为 `Super` 时，无需为 AccountPrivileges 传值。
AccountPrivileges.description_en:
Specified database permission information for the account

When AccountType is set to `Super`, you do not need to provide a value for AccountPrivileges

AccountType.description_cn:
数据库账号类型，取值范围如下：

- `Super`：高权限账号，一个实例只能创建一个。
- `Normal`：普通账号。
AccountType.description_en:
Database account types. Available values:

- `Super`: High-privilege account. Only one can be created per instance
- `Normal`: Standard account

AuthenticationType.description_cn:
数据库账号的鉴权类型。取值：
- `MySQLNative`：MySQL 本地认证。
- `IAM`：IAM 认证。

- 该参数作为请求参数时，默认值为 `MySQLNative`。
- 仅支持在创建账号时为账号指定鉴权类型，创建账号后则不支持修改。
- 建议仅在应用程序每秒新建 IAM 数据库认证连接数小于 200 时，选择 IAM 验证方式。
- 主账号下的所有实例每秒新建的 IAM 数据库身份验证连接总数不能超过 20000，超出限制会被限流，无法建立新的连接。	
- 选择 IAM 的验证方式后，应用程序会在连接数据库时使用生成的临时 Token 进行验证。频繁创建 IAM 数据库身份验证连接会超出连接数限额，建议您通过连接池统一管理连接，既能让应用程序重用现有的连接，也能降低频繁创建连接导致的 IAM 身份验证开销。
AuthenticationType.description_en:
Authentication type for database accounts. Possible values:
- `MySQLNative`: MySQL native authentication
- `IAM`: IAM authentication

- When used as a request parameter, the default value is `MySQLNative`
- You can only specify the authentication type when creating an account; it cannot be changed after the account is created
- We recommend using IAM authentication only if your application creates fewer than 200 new IAM database authentication connections per second
- The total number of new IAM database authentication connections created per second across all instances under the primary account must not exceed 20,000. If this limit is exceeded, throttling will occur and new connections cannot be established
- After selecting IAM authentication, your application will use a generated temporary Token for authentication when connecting to the database. Frequent creation of IAM database authentication connections may exceed the connection limit. We recommend managing connections centrally through a connection pool so your application can reuse existing connections and reduce the overhead caused by frequent IAM authentication

DryRun.description_cn:
是否预览创建账号的 SQL 语句。取值：
- `true`：是。
- `false`：否。默认值。
- 取值为 `true` 时，会返回 CreateAccountSQL 字段（实际不会创建账号）。取值为 `false` 或不传时，返回为 null。
- 如为账号授予了指定数据库的权限，而数据库的名称包含了下划线（\_），则在 CreateAccountSQL 字段中返回的 SQL 语句中，下划线（\_）会被转义为（\\\\_）。
DryRun.description_en:
Whether to preview the SQL statements for creating the account. Options:
- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No (default)
- If set to `true`, the CreateAccountSQL field will be returned (the account will not actually be created). If set to `false` or not provided, the return value is null
- If you grant permissions to a specified database and the database name contains an underscore (_), the SQL statements returned in the CreateAccountSQL field will escape the underscore (_) as (\\_)

Host.description_cn:
指定账号访问数据库的 IP 地址。默认值为 %。

- 若指定 Host 为 %，允许该账号从任意 IP 地址访问数据库。
- 支持使用通配符设定可访问数据库的 IP 地址段。如指定 Host 为 192.10.10.%，则表示该账号可从 `192.10.10.0`~`192.10.10.255` 之间的 IP 地址访问数据库。
- 指定的 Host 需要添加在实例所绑定的白名单中，否则无法正常访问实例。可调用 [ModifyAllowList](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170677) 接口将 Host 添加到白名单。

如创建的账号类型为高权限账号，主机 IP 只能指定为 `%`。即 AccountType 取值为 `Super` 时，Host 的取值只能为 `%`。
Host.description_en:
Specify the IP address for the account to access the database. The default value is %.

- If Host is set to %, the account can access the database from any IP address
- You can use wildcards to define IP address ranges that can access the database. For example, if Host is set to 192.10.10.%, the account can access the database from IP addresses between `192.10.10.0` and `192.10.10.255`
- The specified Host must be added to the allowlist bound to the instance, or the account will not be able to access the instance. You can call the [ModifyAllowList](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170677) API to add the Host to the allowlist

If you create a high-privilege account, the host IP can only be set to `%`. That is, when AccountType is `Super`, Host can only be `%`.

AutoUpgradeMinorVersion.description_cn:
实例内核小版本的升级策略。取值：
- `Auto`：自动升级。当发布新的内核小版本时，实例将在设置的[可维护时间段](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/171477?lang=zh)内，自动升级至最新的内核小版本。
- `Manual`：手动升级。当发布新的内核小版本时，您需要在控制台手动至最新的内核小版本。具体操作，请参见[手动升级实例内核小版本](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/1337250?lang=zh)。
若实例的内核小版本超出维护周期时，系统会暂时忽略内核小版本的升级策略设定，自动为实例升级内核小版本。
AutoUpgradeMinorVersion.description_en:
Upgrade policy for instance kernel minor versions. Options:
- `Auto`: Automatic upgrade. When a new kernel minor version is released, the instance will automatically upgrade to the latest kernel minor version during the configured [maintenance window](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/171477?lang=zh).
- `Manual`: Manual upgrade. When a new kernel minor version is released, you need to manually upgrade to the latest kernel minor version in the console. For details, see [Manually upgrade instance kernel minor version](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/1337250?lang=zh).
If the kernel minor version of the instance exceeds the maintenance cycle, the system will temporarily ignore the kernel minor version upgrade policy and automatically upgrade the instance kernel minor version.

ChargeInfo.description_cn: 蓝绿部署中绿色实例的计费配置。
ChargeInfo.description_en: Billing configuration of the green instance in a blue-green deployment.
ChargeInfo.example_en: Please refer to the request example.

DBEngineVersion.description_cn:
绿色实例的兼容版本。取值：
- `MySQL_5_7`：MySQL 5.7 版本。
- `MySQL_8_0`：MySQL 8.0 版本。
DBEngineVersion.description_en:
Compatible versions for green instances. Options:
- `MySQL_5_7`: MySQL 5.7 version.
- `MySQL_8_0`: MySQL 8.0 version.

DBParamGroupId.description_cn:
为蓝绿部署中绿色实例应用的参数模板 ID。
- 如果蓝色实例和绿色实例的数据库兼容版本一致且不设置该参数时，则继承蓝色实例的参数配置。
- 如果蓝色实例和绿色实例的数据库兼容版本不一，该参数必填。
DBParamGroupId.description_en:
Parameter template ID applied to green instances in blue-green deployment.
- If the database compatibility version of blue and green instances is the same and this parameter is not set, the parameter configuration of the blue instance is inherited.
- If the database compatibility version of blue and green instances differs, this parameter is required.

DeletionProtection.description_cn:
是否启用实例的删除保护功能。取值：
- `Enabled`：是。
- `Disabled`：否。默认值。
DeletionProtection.description_en:
Whether to enable deletion protection for the instance. Values:
- `Enabled`: Yes.
- `Disabled`: No (default).

InstanceId.description_cn: 蓝绿部署中蓝色实例的 ID。
InstanceId.description_en: ID of the blue instance in the blue-green deployment.

InstanceName.description_cn:
绿色实例名称。实例名称的命名规则如下：
- 不能以数字、中划线开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线和中划线。
- 长度限制在 1~128 之间。

如果不设置绿色实例名称，默认会以`${蓝色实例名}-green-${uuid6}` 的格式对绿色实例进行命名，并在超过 128 字符时截断。
InstanceName.description_en:
Name of the green instance. Naming rules:
- Cannot start with a digit or hyphen.
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens.
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.

If you do not set a name for the green instance, it will be named by default in the format `${blue instance name}-green-${uuid6}` and truncated if it exceeds 128 characters.

InstanceType.description_cn:
绿色实例的实例类型。取值：
- `DoubleNode`，双节点类型。
- `MultiNode`，多节点类型。
- `SingleNode`，单节点类型。

- 如蓝色实例的实例类型为单节点，可为绿色实例选择单节点或双节点的实例类型。
- 如蓝色实例的实例类型为双节点，可为绿色实例选择双节点或多节点的实例类型。
- 如蓝色实例的实例类型为多节点，只能为绿色实例选择多节点的实例类型。
InstanceType.description_en:
Instance types for green instances. Options:
- `DoubleNode`: Double node type.
- `MultiNode`: Multi node type.
- `SingleNode`: Single node type.

- If the blue instance type is single node, you can select single node or double node type for the green instance.
- If the blue instance type is double node, you can select double node or multi node type for the green instance.
- If the blue instance type is multi node, you can only select multi node type for the green instance.

MinorVersion.description_cn: 蓝绿部署中绿色实例的内核小版本。可选择蓝色实例的内核小版本或最新的内核小版本。
MinorVersion.description_en: Minor kernel version for the green instance in a blue-green deployment. You can select the minor kernel version of the blue instance or the latest minor kernel version.

NodeInfo.description_cn: 蓝绿部署中绿色实例的规格配置。
NodeInfo.description_en: Specification configuration for the green instance in a blue-green deployment.
NodeInfo.example_en: Please refer to the request example.

PrivateIpAddress.description_cn: 指定实例的默认终端在指定私有网络和子网下的 IP 地址。
PrivateIpAddress.description_en: The default endpoint IP address of the specified instance in the specified VPC and subnet.

ProxyNodeCustom.description_cn:
蓝绿部署中绿色实例的代理核数。
- 绿色实例代理功能的开启状态默认与蓝色实例保持一致。如蓝色实例的代理功能为开启，绿色实例代理核数默认与蓝色实例保持一致。
- 在蓝色实例代理功能关闭的情况下，若将 `CpuNum` 参数的取值设置为大于 0，则绿色实例将强制开启代理功能，设置的值即为代理服务的 CPU 核数。
- 在蓝色实例代理功能开启的情况下，若将 `CpuNum`参数的取值设置为 0，则绿色实例将强制关闭代理功能。
ProxyNodeCustom.description_en:
Proxy CPU cores for green instances in blue-green deployment.
- The proxy feature status for green instances is enabled by default to match blue instances. If the proxy feature is enabled for blue instances, the proxy CPU cores for green instances are set to match blue instances by default.
- If the proxy feature for blue instances is disabled and the `CpuNum` parameter is set to a value greater than 0, the proxy feature for green instances will be forcibly enabled, and the specified value will be used as the number of CPU cores for the proxy service.
- If the proxy feature for blue instances is enabled and the `CpuNum` parameter is set to 0, the proxy feature for green instances will be forcibly disabled.
ProxyNodeCustom.example_en: Please refer to the request example.

ServiceArea.description_cn: 可选售卖区、公共服务区
ServiceArea.description_en: Optional sales zone, public service zone

StorageSpace.description_cn: 蓝绿部署中绿色实例的存储空间。取值应不小于蓝色实例的存储空间。
StorageSpace.description_en: Storage space for the green instance in a blue-green deployment. The value must not be less than the storage space of the blue instance.

StorageType.description_cn:
实例的存储类型。取值范围：
- `LocalSSD`：本地盘。
- `CloudESSD_FlexPL`：FlexPL 云盘。
- `CloudESSD_PL0`：PL0 云盘。
- 如需设定 StorageSpace 参数，StorageType 参数为必传。
- 当 InstanceType 取值为 `SingleNode` 时，StorageType 取值只能为 `CloudESSD_FlexPL` 或 `CloudESSD_PL0`。
- 在不同接口中，该参数取值范围不同。具体规则如下：
	- 在以下接口中作为请求参数时，StorageType 的取值只能为 `LocalSSD`。
		- RestoreToCrossRegionInstance
	  - RestoreToNewInstanceFromUserTos
		
- 在部分接口中作为请求参数时，该参数的取值范围与原实例的存储类型有关，具体规则如下：
	- 原实例的存储类型为 `LocalSSD` 或 `CloudESSD_FlexPL` 时，不支持变更存储类型。
	- 原实例的存储类型为 `CloudESSD_PL0` 时，可取值为 `CloudESSD_PL0` 或 `CloudESSD_FlexPL`。
	涉及的接口是：
		- RebuildDBInstance
		- RestoreToNewInstance
		- ModifyDBNodeSpec
StorageType.description_en:
Instance storage type. Value options:
- `LocalSSD`: Local disk.
- `CloudESSD_FlexPL`: FlexPL cloud disk.
- `CloudESSD_PL0`: PL0 cloud disk.
- If you need to set the StorageSpace parameter, the StorageType parameter is required.
- When InstanceType is set to `SingleNode`, StorageType can only be `CloudESSD_FlexPL` or `CloudESSD_PL0`.
- The value range of this parameter varies by interface. Specific rules are as follows:
	- When used as a request parameter in the following interfaces, StorageType can only be `LocalSSD`.
		- RestoreToCrossRegionInstance
		- RestoreToNewInstanceFromUserTos

- In some interfaces, when used as a request parameter, the value range of this parameter depends on the storage type of the original instance. Specific rules are as follows:
	- If the original instance storage type is `LocalSSD` or `CloudESSD_FlexPL`, changing the storage type is not supported.
	- If the original instance storage type is `CloudESSD_PL0`, you can set it to `CloudESSD_PL0` or `CloudESSD_FlexPL`.
	The relevant interfaces are:
		- RebuildDBInstance
		- RestoreToNewInstance
		- ModifyDBNodeSpec

SubnetId.description_cn:
子网 ID。

SubnetId.description_en:
Subnet ID

If not set, uses the same subnet as the blue instance.

AutoAddNewNodes.description_cn:
当终端类型为读写终端或只读终端时，支持设置新节点是否自动加入。取值：

- `true`：自动加入。
- `false`：不自动加入（默认）。
AutoAddNewNodes.description_en:
When the terminal type is read-write or read-only, you can set whether new nodes join automatically. Options:

- `true`: Join automatically
- `false`: Do not join automatically (default)

ConnectAllSlaveNodes.description_cn: 多节点的只读终端是否关联所有的从节点
ConnectAllSlaveNodes.description_en: Is the read-only terminal in a multi-node setup associated with all slave nodes?

ConnectionMode.description_cn:
连接终端类型。取值：
- `Proxy`：代理终端（默认）。
- `Direct`：直连终端。

- 可调用 [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170653) 接口查询实例数据库代理功能的开启状态。 
	- 如实例的数据库代理功能已开启，可以取值为 `Proxy` 或 `Direct`。
	- 如实例的数据库代理功能未开启，仅可以取值为 `Direct`。
- 不支持调整多节点实例连接终端的类型。
ConnectionMode.description_en:
Connection terminal type. Values:
- `Proxy`: Proxy terminal (default)
- `Direct`: Direct terminal

- You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170653) API to check whether the database proxy feature is enabled for the instance.
	- If the database proxy feature is enabled, you can set the value to `Proxy` or `Direct`.
	- If the database proxy feature is disabled, you can only set the value to `Direct`.
- Changing the connection terminal type is not supported for multi-node instances.

ConnectionPoolType.description_cn:
代理终端的连接池类型。取值：
- `Transaction`：事务级连接池。默认值。
- `Direct`：直连模式。

- 单节点实例不支持该功能。
- ConnectionMode 参数取值为 Proxy，此参数必填；取值为 Direct 时，参数无效。
ConnectionPoolType.description_en:
Connection pool type for proxy endpoints. Values:
- `Transaction`: Transaction-level connection pool. Default value.
- `Direct`: Direct connection mode.

- This feature is not supported for single-node instances.
- When the ConnectionMode parameter is set to Proxy, this parameter is required. If set to Direct, this parameter is invalid.

Description.example_en: This is a note about connecting the terminal.

`ConnectionMode` 参数取值为 `Proxy`，此参数必填；取值为 `Direct` 时，参数无效。

IdleConnectionReclaim.description_en:
Enable idle connection recycling for the proxy terminal. Values:
- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No (default)
When the ConnectionMode parameter is set to Proxy, this parameter is required. If set to Direct, this parameter is invalid.

ImplicitTransSplit.description_cn:
是否开启事务分离。取值：
- `true`：是。
- `false`：否。默认值。

`ConnectionMode` 参数取值为 `Proxy`，此参数必填；取值为 `Direct` 时，参数无效。
ImplicitTransSplit.description_en:
Enable transaction separation. Values:
- `true`: Yes.
- `false`: No. Default value.

When the `ConnectionMode` parameter is set to `Proxy`, this parameter is required. If set to `Direct`, this parameter is invalid.

MasterNodeRouting.description_cn:
是否开启主节点路由。取值：
- `true`：是。
- `false`：否。默认值。

`ConnectionMode` 参数取值为 `Proxy`，此参数必填；取值为 `Direct` 时，参数无效。
MasterNodeRouting.description_en:
Enable main node routing. Values:
- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No (default)

When the `ConnectionMode` parameter is set to `Proxy`, this parameter is required. If set to `Direct`, this parameter is invalid.

MasterProtectorTimeout.description_cn:
过载保护超时时间。取值范围为 60~7200 之间的整数，默认值为 60，单位为秒。

`ConnectionMode` 参数取值为 `Proxy`，此参数必填；取值为 `Direct` 时，参数无效。。
MasterProtectorTimeout.description_en:
Overload protection timeout. Value range: integer between 60 and 7200. Default value: 60. Unit: seconds.

When the `ConnectionMode` parameter is set to `Proxy`, this parameter is required. If set to `Direct`, this parameter is invalid.

MultiStatementsMode.description_cn:
代理终端的 Multi-Statements 模式。取值：
- `Strict`：Strict 模式。默认值。
- `Loose`：Loose 模式。

Nodes.description_cn:

Nodes.description_en:
List of node IDs for configuring connection endpoints
Required when EndpointType is Custom

- To add the primary node to the endpoint, do not enter the primary node's ID; just enter Primary
- Separate multiple node IDs with English commas (,)

OverloadProtection.description_cn:
是否开启过载保护。取值：
- `true`：是。默认值。
- `false`：否。

`ConnectionMode` 参数取值为 `Proxy`，此参数必填；取值为 `Direct` 时，参数无效。
OverloadProtection.description_en:
Enable overload protection. Values:
- `true`: Yes. Default value.
- `false`: No.

When the `ConnectionMode` parameter is set to `Proxy`, this parameter is required. If set to `Direct`, this parameter is invalid.

ReadOnlyNodeDistributionType.description_cn:
读权重分配模式。当开通读写分离设置为 `true` 时需要传入此参数。在 CreateDBEndpoint 和 ModifyDBEndpoint 接口中做请求参数时，取值范围如下：
- `LoadSchedule`：负载调度。
- `RoundRobinCustom`：自定义权重的轮询调度。
- `RoundRobinAuto`：自动分配权重的轮询调度。

在 DescribeDBInstanceDetail 接口中做返回参数时，取值范围如下：
- `Default`：按规格权重自动分配。
- `Custom`：自定义分配权重。
- `RoundRobin`：轮询调度。
- `LoadSchedule`：负载调度。
- `RoundRobinCustom`：自定义权重的轮询调度。
- `RoundRobinAuto`：自动分配权重的轮询调度。

- 多节点实例仅支持取值为 `RoundRobinAuto`。
- 单节点实例不支持该功能。
- `ConnectionMode` 参数取值为 `Proxy`，此参数必填；取值为 `Direct` 时，参数无效。
ReadOnlyNodeDistributionType.description_en:
Read weight allocation mode. This parameter is required when read/write splitting is enabled (`true`). When used as a request parameter in the CreateDBEndpoint and ModifyDBEndpoint APIs, the value range is:
- `LoadSchedule`: Load scheduling.
- `RoundRobinCustom`: Custom weight round-robin scheduling.
- `RoundRobinAuto`: Automatic weight round-robin scheduling.

When used as a response parameter in the DescribeDBInstanceDetail API, the value range is:
- `Default`: Automatic allocation based on specification weight.
- `Custom`: Custom weight allocation.
- `RoundRobin`: Round-robin scheduling.
- `LoadSchedule`: Load scheduling.
- `RoundRobinCustom`: Custom weight round-robin scheduling.
- `RoundRobinAuto`: Automatic weight round-robin scheduling.

- Multi-node instances only support `RoundRobinAuto`.
- This feature is not supported for single-node instances.
- When the `ConnectionMode` parameter is set to `Proxy`, this parameter is required. If set to `Direct`, this parameter is invalid.

ReadOnlyNodeMaxDelayTime.description_cn:
只读节点延迟阈值。取值范围为 1~3600，默认为 30，单位为秒。
`ConnectionMode` 参数取值为 `Proxy`，此参数必填；取值为 `Direct` 时，参数无效。
ReadOnlyNodeMaxDelayTime.description_en:
Read-only node latency threshold. Value range: 1–3600. Default: 30. Unit: seconds.
When the `ConnectionMode` parameter is set to `Proxy`, this parameter is required. If set to `Direct`, this parameter is invalid.

ReadOnlyNodeWeight.description_cn:
自定义读权重分配策略。
`ConnectionMode` 参数取值为 `Proxy`，此参数必填；取值为 `Direct` 时，参数无效。
ReadOnlyNodeWeight.description_en:
Custom read weight allocation policy.
When the `ConnectionMode` parameter is set to `Proxy`, this parameter is required. If set to `Direct`, this parameter is invalid.

ReadWriteMode.description_cn:
连接终端的读写模式。取值：

- `ReadWrite`：读写。
- `ReadOnly`：只读。

该参数作为请求参数时，默认值为 `ReadWrite`。
ReadWriteMode.description_en:
Read/write mode for the connection terminal. Options:

- `ReadWrite`: Read and write
- `ReadOnly`: Read only

When used as a request parameter, the default value is `ReadWrite`.

ReadWriteSpliting.description_cn:

ReadWriteSpliting.description_en:

EipId.description_en: EIP ID. Use [DescribeEipAddressAttributes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6402/71040) to query the basic information of the EIP.

EndpointId.description_cn: 实例连接终端 ID。
EndpointId.description_en: Instance Connection Terminal ID

AllowListIds.description_cn: 白名单 ID。如需绑定多个白名单，白名单 ID 用英文逗号（,）分隔。一个实例最多可绑定 100 个白名单。
AllowListIds.description_en: Whitelist ID. To bind multiple whitelists, separate each whitelist ID with an English comma (,). You can bind up to 100 whitelists to a single instance.

AutoUpgradeMinorVersion.description_cn:
实例内核小版本的升级策略。取值：
- `Auto`：自动升级。当发布新的内核小版本时，实例将在设置的[可维护时间段](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/171477?lang=zh)内，自动升级至最新的内核小版本。
- `Manual`：手动升级。当发布新的内核小版本时，您需要在控制台手动至最新的内核小版本。具体操作，请参见[手动升级实例内核小版本](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/1337250?lang=zh)。
若实例的内核小版本超出维护周期时，系统会暂时忽略内核小版本的升级策略设定，自动为实例升级内核小版本。
AutoUpgradeMinorVersion.description_en:
Kernel minor version upgrade policy. Options:
- `Auto`: Automatic upgrade. When a new kernel minor version is released, the instance will automatically upgrade to the latest kernel minor version during the configured [maintenance window](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/171477?lang=zh).
- `Manual`: Manual upgrade. When a new kernel minor version is released, you need to manually upgrade the instance to the latest kernel minor version in the console. For details, see [Manually upgrade kernel minor version](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/1337250?lang=zh).
If the kernel minor version of the instance exceeds the maintenance cycle, the system will temporarily ignore the configured upgrade policy and automatically upgrade the kernel minor version for the instance.

DBEngineVersion.description_en:
Compatible versions. Options:

- `MySQL 8.4`: MySQL 8.4 version

DBParamGroupId.description_en: Parameter template ID. The default value is the default parameter template for the corresponding database engine version.

DeletionProtection.description_en:
Whether to enable deletion protection for the instance
Options:
- Enabled: Yes

EnableExternalReplication.description_en:
Enable native replication

Database engine type

InstanceName.description_cn:
实例名称。实例名称的命名规则如下：

- 不能以数字、中划线开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线和中划线。
- 长度应在 1~128 个字符之间。
	
- 如果不填实例名称，则实例名称与实例 ID 一致。
- 云数据库 MySQL 版最多支持批量创建 50 个实例。批量创建时，
	- 如果不填写实例名称，批量创建的实例均会采用实例 ID 作为实例名称。
		
	- 如果填写了实例名称，则会自动在实例名称后加序号。如指定实例名称为“测试实例”，批量创建 3 个，这 3 个实例的名称将分别为“测试实例-1”、“测试实例-2”和“测试实例-3”。
		
	- 支持使用特定语法为实例指定有序的实例名称，该语法为`name_prefix[begin_number,bits]name_suffix`。如指定实例名称为“名称前缀\[0,2\]名称后缀”，批量创建 3 个，这 3 个实例的名称将分别为“名称前缀00名称后缀”、“名称前缀01名称后缀”和“名称前缀02名称后缀”。更多详细信息，请参见[有序实例名称设置规则](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/1588799)。
InstanceName.description_en:
Instance name. Naming rules for instance names:

- Cannot start with a number or hyphen
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens
- Must be 1–128 characters long

- If you do not specify an instance name, the instance name will be the same as the instance ID
- Cloud Database MySQL Edition supports creating up to 50 instances at once. When creating instances in batch:
    - If you do not specify an instance name, each instance will use its instance ID as the instance name
    - If you specify an instance name, a sequence number will be added automatically. For example, if you set the instance name to 'Test Instance' and create 3 instances in batch, their names will be 'Test Instance-1', 'Test Instance-2', and 'Test Instance-3'
    - You can use a specific syntax to assign ordered instance names: `name_prefix[begin_number,bits]name_suffix`. For example, if you set the instance name to 'Prefix[0,2]Suffix' and create 3 instances in batch, their names will be 'Prefix00Suffix', 'Prefix01Suffix', and 'Prefix02Suffix'. For more details, see [Ordered Instance Name Rules](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/1588799)

InstanceTags.description_cn:
实例标签。
- 每个 MySQL 实例最多可绑定 50 个标签。
- 单次操作中最多可添加 20 个标签。
InstanceTags.description_en:
Instance Tags
- You can assign up to 50 tags to each MySQL instance
- You can add up to 20 tags in a single operation

InstanceType.description_cn:
绿色实例的实例类型。取值：
- `DoubleNode`，双节点类型。
- `MultiNode`，多节点类型。
- `SingleNode`，单节点类型。

- 如蓝色实例的实例类型为单节点，可为绿色实例选择单节点或双节点的实例类型。
- 如蓝色实例的实例类型为双节点，可为绿色实例选择双节点或多节点的实例类型。
- 如蓝色实例的实例类型为多节点，只能为绿色实例选择多节点的实例类型。
InstanceType.description_en:
Instance type for the green instance. Options:
- `DoubleNode`: Double-node type
- `MultiNode`: Multi-node type
- `SingleNode`: Single-node type

- If the blue instance type is single-node, you can select single-node or double-node type for the green instance.
- If the blue instance type is double-node, you can select double-node or multi-node type for the green instance.
- If the blue instance type is multi-node, you can only select multi-node type for the green instance.

InternalAccountPassword.description_cn: @sdk_hide_next_linesharding专用，用以指定内部账号byte_rds_admin/byte_rds_proxy的密码
InternalAccountPassword.description_en: @sdk_hide_next_line For sharding only; used to specify the password for internal accounts byte_rds_admin/byte_rds_proxy

LowerCaseTableNames.description_cn:
表名是否区分大小写，默认取值为“1”。后端忽略大小写。
取值范围：

- `0`：表名被存储成固定且表名称大小写敏感。
- `1`：表名将被存储成小写且表名称大小写不敏感。
LowerCaseTableNames.description_en:
Table name case sensitivity. Default value: 1. Case is ignored by the backend

Value options:

- 0: Table names are stored as entered and are case-sensitive
- 1: Table names are stored in lowercase and are case-insensitive

MaintenanceWindow.description_cn: 在创建实例时指定实例的可维护时间段。该字段为可选，不设置时默认为一周内每一天的 UTC18:00Z-21:59Z（即北京时间 02:00-05:59）。
MaintenanceWindow.description_en: Specify the maintenance window when creating an instance. This field is optional; if not set, the default is 18:00Z–21:59Z UTC (02:00–05:59 Beijing time) every day of the week.

Port.description_cn:
默认终端的私网端口。端口号的取值范围为 1000~65534，默认值为 3306。
创建新的连接终端或开启新地址时，将使用默认终端的私网端口实时配置为默认端口。
Port.description_en:
Default terminal's private network port. Port number range: 1000–65534, default value: 3306
When you create a new connection terminal or enable a new address, the default terminal's private network port is used and configured in real time as the default port

PrivateIpAddress.description_cn:
指定实例的默认终端在指定私有网络和子网下的 IP 地址。
如不设定，则自动为实例的默认终端分配指定私有网络和子网下的 IP 地址。
PrivateIpAddress.description_en:
The IP address of the default terminal of the specified instance in the specified private network and subnet.
If not set, the default terminal of the instance will automatically be assigned an IP address in the specified private network and subnet.

ProjectName.description_cn: 实例所属的项目。如需在创建时指定项目，需确保项目已存在。可通过调用 [ListProjects](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/1131880) 接口查询项目列表，也可通过调用 [CreateProject](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/1131879) 接口创建新的项目。
ProjectName.description_en: Project to which the instance belongs. To specify a project during creation, make sure the project already exists. You can view the project list by calling the [ListProjects](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/1131880) API, or create a new project by calling the [CreateProject](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/1131879) API.

ProxyNodeCustom.description_cn:
实例的数据库代理配置。
- 该字段仅在 InstanceType 取值为 `MultiNode` 时必选。
- 该字段在 InstanceType 取值为 `DoubleNode` 或 `SingleNode` 时不生效。
ProxyNodeCustom.description_en:
Instance database proxy configuration
- This field is required only when InstanceType is set to `MultiNode`.
- This field does not apply when InstanceType is set to `DoubleNode` or `SingleNode`.

ServiceArea.description_cn: 可选售卖区、公共服务区
ServiceArea.description_en: Optional Sales Area, Public Service Area

StorageSpace.description_cn: 不同存储类型、不同规格对应的存储空间取值范围不同，关于存储空间取值范围的详细信息，请参见[产品规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/74505)。单位为 GiB，步长 10GiB。
StorageSpace.description_en: The available storage space range varies by storage type and specification. For details, see [Product Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/74505). Unit: GiB, step size: 10 GiB.

StorageType.description_cn:
实例的存储类型。取值范围：
- `LocalSSD`：本地盘。
- `CloudESSD_FlexPL`：FlexPL 云盘。
- `CloudESSD_PL0`：PL0 云盘。
- 如需设定 StorageSpace 参数，StorageType 参数为必传。
- 当 InstanceType 取值为 `SingleNode` 时，StorageType 取值只能为 `CloudESSD_FlexPL` 或 `CloudESSD_PL0`。
- 在不同接口中，该参数取值范围不同。具体规则如下：
	- 在以下接口中作为请求参数时，StorageType 的取值只能为 `LocalSSD`。
		- RestoreToCrossRegionInstance
	  - RestoreToNewInstanceFromUserTos
		
- 在部分接口中作为请求参数时，该参数的取值范围与原实例的存储类型有关，具体规则如下：
	- 原实例的存储类型为 `LocalSSD` 或 `CloudESSD_FlexPL` 时，不支持变更存储类型。
	- 原实例的存储类型为 `CloudESSD_PL0` 时，可取值为 `CloudESSD_PL0` 或 `CloudESSD_FlexPL`。
	涉及的接口是：
		- RebuildDBInstance
		- RestoreToNewInstance
		- ModifyDBNodeSpec
StorageType.description_en:
Instance storage type. Valid values:
- `LocalSSD`: local disk.
- `CloudESSD_FlexPL`: FlexPL cloud disk.
- `CloudESSD_PL0`: PL0 cloud disk.
- If you need to set the StorageSpace parameter, the StorageType parameter is required.
- When InstanceType is set to `SingleNode`, StorageType can only be `CloudESSD_FlexPL` or `CloudESSD_PL0`.
- The valid values for this parameter vary by API. Rules are as follows:
	- When used as a request parameter in the following APIs, StorageType can only be `LocalSSD`:
		- RestoreToCrossRegionInstance.
		- RestoreToNewInstanceFromUserTos.

- In some APIs, the valid values for this parameter depend on the storage type of the original instance. Rules are as follows:
	- If the original instance storage type is `LocalSSD` or `CloudESSD_FlexPL`, changing the storage type is not supported.
	- If the original instance storage type is `CloudESSD_PL0`, you can set it to `CloudESSD_PL0` or `CloudESSD_FlexPL`.
	The relevant APIs are:
		- RebuildDBInstance.
		- RestoreToNewInstance.
		- ModifyDBNodeSpec.

SubnetId.description_cn: 子网 ID。 可调用 [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) 通过指定 VpcId 和 ZoneId （主节点或备节点所在的可用区）查询可用的子网。
SubnetId.description_en: Subnet ID. Call [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) and specify VpcId and ZoneId (the availability zone of the primary or standby node) to query available subnets

SuperAccountName.description_cn:
高权限账号名称。不传此参数默认不创建高权限账号。
高权限账号名称命名规则如下： - 账号长度为 2~32 个字符。 - 以字母开头，以字母或数字结尾。 - 由字母、数字、下划线（\_）或中划线（-）组成。 - 不能使用某些预留字，被禁用的预留字请参见[禁用词列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/66162)。 - 账号名称在实例内必须是唯一的。
SuperAccountName.description_en:
High-privilege account name. If you do not provide this parameter, a high-privilege account will not be created by default.
Naming rules for high-privilege account names: - Account name must be 2–32 characters long - Must start with a letter and end with a letter or number - Can contain letters, numbers, underscores (_), or hyphens (-) - Certain reserved words cannot be used. For a list of disabled reserved words, see [Disabled Words List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/66162) - Account name must be unique within the instance

SuperAccountPassword.description_cn:
高权限账号的密码。密码规则如下：

- 长度为 8~32 个字符。
- 由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的至少三种组成。
- 特殊字符为 `!#$%&()*+,-.=?@^_|/`。
SuperAccountPassword.description_en:
Password for the high-privilege account. Password rules:

- Length: 8–32 characters
- Must include at least three of the following: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, special characters
- Allowed special characters: `!#$%&()*+,-.=?@^_|/`

VpcId.description_cn:
私有网络（VPC） ID。可调用 [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) 查询。
不支持使用共享 VPC。
VpcId.description_en:
Private network (VPC) ID. You can use [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) to query.
Shared VPCs are not supported.

WithIopsLimit.description_cn: @sdk_hide_next_line用于灾备实例和跨域实例，是否开启IOPS限制
WithIopsLimit.description_en: @sdk_hide_next_line Should IOPS limit be enabled for disaster recovery and cross-region instances?

WithoutProxyPLB.description_cn: @sdk_hide_next_linesharding专用，不仅会移除proxy, 也不会申请plb和终端
WithoutProxyPLB.description_en: @sdk_hide_next_line Not only removes proxy for sharding, but also does not request PLB or terminal

ZoneId.description_cn:
可用区ID。
建议您在 NodeInfoObject 中通过 ZoneId 参数设置实例各个节点的可用区。
ZoneId.description_en:
Availability zone ID.
We recommend setting the availability zone for each node of the instance using the ZoneId parameter in NodeInfoObject.

DryRun.description_cn: @sdk_hide_next_line是否DryRun. 为true表示只生成预调度计划, 不实际执行
DryRun.description_en: @sdk_hide_next_line Indicates whether it is DryRun. If true, it only generates a pre-scheduling plan and does not execute

EstimateOnly.description_cn:
是否发起变配评估。取值：
- `true`：是。
- `false`：否。默认值。
	
如果发起，则按照其他字段确定的规格配置进行变配评估，实际不会执行变配动作。发起变配评估后，会返回 EstimationResult 参数，说明此次变配的影响。
EstimateOnly.description_en:
Initiate configuration change assessment. Values:
- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No (default)

If initiated, the system assesses the configuration change based on the specifications determined by other fields, but does not actually perform the change. After assessment, the EstimationResult parameter is returned to indicate the impact of the change.

RequestSource.description_cn:
请求来源。取值：
- `EventType_Web`：来自 Web。
- `EventType_OpenAPI`：来自 Open API。
RequestSource.description_en:
Request Source. Values:
- `EventType_Web`: From Web
- `EventType_OpenAPI`: From Open API

SpecifiedSwitchEndTime.description_cn:
指定时间段执行时，时间段的结束时间（UTC 时间）。格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`。

- SwitchType 取值为 `SpecifiedTime` 时，该参数为必填参数。
- 指定时间段的最短时长为一小时五十九分钟。
- 不支持跨天设置时间段，即任务执行的起始时间和结束时间不超过 24 小时。
SpecifiedSwitchEndTime.description_en:
End time of the time window (UTC) when executing within a specified period. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.

- This parameter is required when SwitchType is set to `SpecifiedTime`.
- The minimum duration for the specified time window is one hour and fifty-nine minutes.
- Cross-day time windows are not supported; the task's start and end times must be within the same calendar day.

SpecifiedSwitchStartTime.description_cn:
指定时间段执行时，时间段的起始时间（UTC 时间）。格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`。

- SwitchType 取值为 `SpecifiedTime` 时，该参数为必填参数。
- 任务执行的起始时间不得晚于当前日期后的第 7 日。
SpecifiedSwitchStartTime.description_en:
Start time of the time window (UTC) when executing within a specified period. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.

- This parameter is required when SwitchType is set to `SpecifiedTime`.
- The task start time cannot be later than the 7th day after the current date.

SwitchType.description_cn:
执行时间，取值：

- `Immediate`：立即切换（默认）。
- `MaintainTime`：可维护时间段内进行切换。
- `SpecifiedTime`：指定时间段内进行切换。

- 可调用 [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170653) 接口查询实例的可维护时间段。
- 取值为 `SpecifiedTime` 时，需要在参数 SpecifiedSwitchStartTime 和 SpecifiedSwitchEndTime 中设定时间段的起止时间。
SwitchType.description_en:
Execution time. Valid values:

- `Immediate`: Switch immediately (default)
- `MaintainTime`: Switch during the maintenance window
- `SpecifiedTime`: Switch within the specified time window

- You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170653) API to query the maintenance window of the instance.
- If set to `SpecifiedTime`, you must specify the start and end times in the SpecifiedSwitchStartTime and SpecifiedSwitchEndTime parameters.

CharacterSetName.description_cn: 数据库字符集。目前支持的字符集包含：utf8、utf8mb4（默认）、latin1、ascii。
CharacterSetName.description_en: Database character set. Supported character sets: utf8, utf8mb4 (default), latin1, ascii

DBDesc.description_cn: 数据库的描述信息，长度不超过 256 个字符。该字段可选，若不设置该字段，或设置了该字段但描述信息长度为 0 ，则描述信息为空。
DBDesc.description_en: Database description, up to 256 characters. This field is optional. If you do not set this field, or set it with a description of zero length, the description will be empty.
DBDesc.example_cn: 这是一段数据库的描述信息。
DBDesc.example_en: This is a section of database description information

DBName.description_cn:
数据库名称。命名规则如下：

- 名称唯一。
- 长度为 2~64 个字符。
- 以字母开头，以字母或数字结尾。
- 由字母、数字、下划线（_）或中划线（-）组成。
- 不能使用某些预留字，包括 root、admin 等。被禁用的预留字请参见[禁用词列表](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/66162)。
DBName.description_en:
Database name: naming rules

- Must be unique
- Length: 2–64 characters
- Start with a letter and end with a letter or number
- Can include letters, numbers, underscores (_), or hyphens (-)
- Certain reserved words, such as root and admin, cannot be used. For disabled reserved words, see [Disabled Words List](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/66162)

AutoUpgradeMinorVersion.description_cn:
实例内核小版本的升级策略。取值：
- `Auto`：自动升级。当发布新的内核小版本时，实例将在设置的[可维护时间段](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/171477?lang=zh)内，自动升级至最新的内核小版本。
- `Manual`：手动升级。当发布新的内核小版本时，您需要在控制台手动至最新的内核小版本。具体操作，请参见[手动升级实例内核小版本](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/1337250?lang=zh)。
若实例的内核小版本超出维护周期时，系统会暂时忽略内核小版本的升级策略设定，自动为实例升级内核小版本。
AutoUpgradeMinorVersion.description_en:
Upgrade policy for instance kernel minor versions. Options:
- `Auto`: Automatic upgrade. When a new kernel minor version is released, the instance will automatically upgrade to the latest kernel minor version during the configured [maintenance window](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/171477?lang=zh).
- `Manual`: Manual upgrade. When a new kernel minor version is released, you need to manually upgrade to the latest kernel minor version in the console. For details, see [Manually upgrade instance kernel minor version](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/1337250?lang=zh).
If the kernel minor version of the instance exceeds the maintenance cycle, the system will temporarily ignore the configured upgrade policy and automatically upgrade the kernel minor version for the instance.

DeletionProtection.description_cn:
是否启用实例的删除保护功能。取值：
- `Enabled`：是。
- `Disabled`：否。默认值。
DeletionProtection.description_en:
Enable deletion protection for the instance. Options:
- `Enabled`: Yes
- `Disabled`: No (default)

InstanceName.description_cn:
实例名称。实例名称的命名规则如下：
- 不能以数字、中划线开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线和中划线。
- 长度限制在 1~128 之间。

如不设定，则会以实例 ID 对实例进行命名。
InstanceName.description_en:
Instance name. Naming rules:
- Cannot start with a number or hyphen
- Can only include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

If not set, the instance will be named using its instance ID

PrivateIpAddress.description_cn:
指定实例的默认终端在指定私有网络和子网下的 IP 地址。
如不设定，则自动为实例的默认终端分配指定私有网络和子网下的 IP 地址。
PrivateIpAddress.description_en:
Specify the default terminal's IP address for the instance within the designated private network and subnet.
If not set, the default terminal's IP address will be automatically assigned within the specified private network and subnet.

ProxyNodeCustom.description_cn:
实例的数据库代理配置。
- 当主实例为多节点实例时，该字段为必选。
- 当主实例为双节点实例时，不支持进行数据库代理配置。
ProxyNodeCustom.description_en:
Database proxy configuration for the instance
- This field is required for multi-node primary instances
- Database proxy configuration is not supported for dual-node primary instances

StorageSpace.description_cn: 灾备实例的存储空间。每个规格对应的存储空间取值范围不同，关于存储空间取值范围的详细信息，请参见[产品规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/74505)。单位为 GiB，步长 10 GiB。
StorageSpace.description_en: Storage space for disaster recovery instances. The available storage space range varies by specification. For details on storage space ranges, see [Product Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/74505). Unit: GiB, increment: 10 GiB

StorageType.description_cn:
实例的存储类型。取值范围：
- `LocalSSD`：本地盘。
- `CloudESSD_FlexPL`：FlexPL 云盘。
- `CloudESSD_PL0`：PL0 云盘。
- 如需设定 StorageSpace 参数，StorageType 参数为必传。
- 当 InstanceType 取值为 `SingleNode` 时，StorageType 取值只能为 `CloudESSD_FlexPL` 或 `CloudESSD_PL0`。
- 在不同接口中，该参数取值范围不同。具体规则如下：
	- 在以下接口中作为请求参数时，StorageType 的取值只能为 `LocalSSD`。
		- RestoreToCrossRegionInstance
	  - RestoreToNewInstanceFromUserTos
		
- 在部分接口中作为请求参数时，该参数的取值范围与原实例的存储类型有关，具体规则如下：
	- 原实例的存储类型为 `LocalSSD` 或 `CloudESSD_FlexPL` 时，不支持变更存储类型。
	- 原实例的存储类型为 `CloudESSD_PL0` 时，可取值为 `CloudESSD_PL0` 或 `CloudESSD_FlexPL`。
	涉及的接口是：
		- RebuildDBInstance
		- RestoreToNewInstance
		- ModifyDBNodeSpec
StorageType.description_en:
Instance storage type. Valid values:
- `LocalSSD`: Local disk
- `CloudESSD_FlexPL`: FlexPL cloud disk
- `CloudESSD_PL0`: PL0 cloud disk
- If you need to set the StorageSpace parameter, the StorageType parameter is required
- When InstanceType is set to `SingleNode`, StorageType can only be `CloudESSD_FlexPL` or `CloudESSD_PL0`
- The valid values for this parameter vary by API. The specific rules are as follows:
	- When used as a request parameter in the following APIs, StorageType can only be `LocalSSD`:
		- RestoreToCrossRegionInstance
		- RestoreToNewInstanceFromUserTos
	
- In some APIs, when used as a request parameter, the valid values for this parameter depend on the storage type of the original instance. The specific rules are as follows:
	- If the original instance storage type is `LocalSSD` or `CloudESSD_FlexPL`, changing the storage type is not supported
	- If the original instance storage type is `CloudESSD_PL0`, the valid values are `CloudESSD_PL0` or `CloudESSD_FlexPL`
	The related APIs are:
		- RebuildDBInstance
		- RestoreToNewInstance
		- ModifyDBNodeSpec

SubnetId.description_cn: 子网 ID。 可调用 [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) 通过指定 VpcId 和 ZoneId （主节点或备节点所在的可用区）查询可用的子网。
SubnetId.description_en: Subnet ID. Call [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) and specify VpcId and ZoneId (the availability zone of the primary or standby node) to query available subnets

VpcId.description_cn:
私有网络（VPC） ID。可调用 [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) 查询。
不支持使用共享 VPC。
VpcId.description_en:
Private network (VPC) ID. You can use [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) to query
Shared VPCs are not supported

AccountId.description_cn: @sdk_hide_next_line模版所属租户（仅跨域创建模版时使用）
AccountId.description_en: @sdk_hide_next_line Tenant of the template (only used when creating templates across domains)

EngineType.description_cn:
数据库引擎类型。取值：
- `InnoDB`：InnoDB 引擎。
- `RocksDB`：RocksDB 引擎。

作为请求参数时，默认值为 `InnoDB`。
EngineType.description_en:
Database engine type
Values:
- `InnoDB`: InnoDB engine
- `RocksDB`: RocksDB engine

When used as a request parameter, the default value is `InnoDB`

ProjectName.description_cn:
所属的项目。
如您调用接口使用的 AK/SK 属于某个子账号，且该子账号只拥有某个项目的权限，需要传入该请求参数。
ProjectName.description_en:
Project
If the AK/SK you use to call the API belongs to a sub-account that only has permission for one project, you must provide this request parameter

TemplateCategory.description_cn: 模板类别，取值为 `DBEngine`（数据库引擎参数）。
TemplateCategory.description_en: Template type, value is `DBEngine` (database engine parameters)

TemplateParams.description_cn: 参数模板中所包含的参数。
TemplateParams.description_en: Parameters included in the parameter template

TemplateType.description_cn: 参数模板的数据库类型，默认值为 `Mysql`。
TemplateType.description_en: Database type for the parameter template; default value is `Mysql`

TemplateTypeVersion.description_cn:
参数模板的数据库版本，取值范围：

- `MySQL_5_7`：默认值，MySQL 5.7 版本。
- `MySQL_8_0`：MySQL 8.0 版本。
TemplateTypeVersion.description_en:
Database version for the parameter template. Available options:

- `MySQL_5_7`: Default value, MySQL 5.7 version
- `MySQL_8_0`: MySQL 8.0 version

EffectiveTime.description_cn:
指定资源包的生效时间为“指定时间”时，即 EffectiveTimeType 取值为 `Specified` 需传入。时间格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC 时间）。
如指定的生效时间早于当前时间，会按当前时间向前取整点时间，作为资源包的生效时间。
EffectiveTime.description_en:
When the activation time for the resource package is set to 'specified time', that is, when EffectiveTimeType is set to `Specified`, you must provide this parameter. The time format is `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC time).
If the specified activation time is earlier than the current time, the system will round down to the nearest hour based on the current time and use that as the activation time for the resource package.

EffectiveTimeType.description_cn:
生效时间类型。取值：
- `Immediate`：立即生效。
- `Specified`：指定时间生效。
EffectiveTimeType.description_en:
Effective time type. Values:
- `Immediate`: Effective immediately
- `Specified`: Effective at a specified time

PackageSpec.description_cn:
资源包规格。如 PackageType 取值为 `StoragePackage`，则 PackageSpec 的取值范围为：
- `100`：100 GiB。
- `200`：200 GiB。
- `300`：300 GiB。
- `500`：500 GiB。
- `1000`：1000 GiB。
- `2000`：2000 GiB。
- `5000`：5000 GiB。
- `10000`：10000 GiB。
PackageSpec.description_en:
Resource package specifications. If PackageType is set to `StoragePackage`, the valid values for PackageSpec are:
- `100`: 100 GiB
- `200`: 200 GiB
- `300`: 300 GiB
- `500`: 500 GiB
- `1000`: 1000 GiB
- `2000`: 2000 GiB
- `5000`: 5000 GiB
- `10000`: 10000 GiB

PackageType.description_cn: 资源包的类型。当前仅支持取值为 `StoragePackage`，即存储包。
PackageType.description_en: Resource package type. Currently, only `StoragePackage` is supported, which refers to a storage package.

AllowListId.description_cn:
白名单 ID。

您可以调用 [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170675) 接口查询指定地域下所有的白名单列表信息，包括白名单 ID。
AllowListId.description_en:
Whitelist ID

You can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170675) API to query information about all whitelists in a specified region, including whitelist IDs.

ProjectName.description_cn:
所属的项目。
如您调用接口使用的 AK/SK 属于某个子账号，且该子账号只拥有某个项目的权限，需要传入该请求参数。
ProjectName.description_en:
Associated Project
If the AK/SK you use to call the API belongs to a sub-account that only has access to a specific project, you need to specify this request parameter

AccountName.description_cn: 数据库账号名称。
AccountName.description_en: Database Account Name

Host.description_cn: 账号访问数据库的 IP 地址。默认值为 %。
Host.description_en: IP address for account access to the database. Default value: %

InstanceId.description_cn: 蓝绿部署中蓝色实例的 ID。
InstanceId.description_en: ID of the blue instance in the blue-green deployment

EndpointId.description_cn: 终端 ID。
EndpointId.description_en: Terminal ID

Domain.description_cn: 数据库的访问域名。
Domain.description_en: Database Access Domain Name

EipId.description_cn: EIP 的 ID。可使用 [DescribeEipAddressAttributes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6402/71040) 查询 EIP 的基本信息。
EipId.description_en: EIP ID. Use [DescribeEipAddressAttributes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6402/71040) to query basic EIP information

EndpointId.description_cn: 实例连接终端 ID。
EndpointId.description_en: Instance Connection Terminal ID

DataKeepDays.description_cn: 备份保留天数。取值范围为 7~3650 天，默认为 7 天。
DataKeepDays.description_en: Backup retention period. Range: 7–3650 days; default: 7 days.

DataKeepPolicy.description_cn:
实例释放后保留该实例备份的策略。取值为： 
- `Last`：保留最后一个备份。默认值。 
- `All`：保留实例所有备份。
- `None`：不保留备份。
DataKeepPolicy.description_en:
Backup retention policy after instance release. Options:
- `Last`: Keep the most recent backup (default)
- `All`: Keep all backups of the instance
- `None`: Do not keep any backups

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。

- 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170652) 接口查询实例信息，包括实例 ID。
- 仅按量计费实例支持使用该接口删除。包年包月实例需要在费用中心的退订管理控制台进行退订。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID

- You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170652) API to query instance information, including the instance ID.
- Only pay-as-you-go instances support deletion via this API. For subscription instances, please unsubscribe in the Billing Center's Unsubscription Management Console.

KeepCrossBackupEnableAfterReleased.description_cn:
是否保留跨地域备份。取值：

- `true`：是。
- `false`：否。
云盘实例暂不支持该功能。
KeepCrossBackupEnableAfterReleased.description_en:
Do you want to retain cross-region backup? Values:

- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No
Cloud disk instances do not currently support this feature.

DBNodeIds.description_cn:
待删除的节点 ID 列表。
- DBNodeIds 中指定的节点必须属于 InstanceId 中指定的实例。
- 对于双节点实例，主节点和备节点不允许删除，只读节点可选 0~10 个。
- 对于多节点实例，主节点不允许删除，备节点最多可有 8 个，最少需有 1 个。建议预留一个不承载业务的独立备节点，以便在必要时将其切换为主节点。若因未设置独立备节点致使所有备节点主备延迟过高，进而导致主节点切换失败，云数据库 MySQL 版不承担相关责任。
DBNodeIds.description_en:
List of node IDs to be deleted.
- The nodes specified in DBNodeIds must belong to the instance specified in InstanceId.
- For dual-node instances, primary and standby nodes cannot be deleted; you can select up to 10 read-only nodes for deletion.
- For multi-node instances, the primary node cannot be deleted. Standby nodes must have at least 1 and at most 8. It is recommended to reserve an independent standby node that does not handle any workloads, so it can be switched to the primary node when necessary. If no independent standby node is set and all standby nodes experience high primary-standby latency, resulting in a failed primary node switch, Volcano Engine MySQL is not responsible for any resulting issues.

DryRun.description_cn: @sdk_hide_next_line是否DryRun. 为true表示只生成预调度计划, 不实际执行
DryRun.description_en: @sdk_hide_next_line Indicates whether this is a DryRun. If true, only generates the pre-scheduling plan without executing it

EstimateOnly.description_cn:
是否发起变配评估。取值：
- `true`：是。
- `false`：否。默认值。
	
如果发起，则按照其他字段确定的规格配置进行变配评估，实际不会执行变配动作。发起变配评估后，会返回 EstimationResult 参数，说明此次变配的影响。
EstimateOnly.description_en:
Whether to initiate configuration change evaluation. Values:
- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No (default)

If enabled, the system evaluates the configuration change based on other field settings but does not actually perform the change. After initiating the evaluation, the EstimationResult parameter is returned to indicate the impact of the change.

RequestSource.description_cn:
请求来源。取值：
- `EventType_Web`：来自 Web。
- `EventType_OpenAPI`：来自 Open API。
RequestSource.description_en:
Request Source
Possible values:
- `EventType_Web`: From Web
- `EventType_OpenAPI`: From Open API

SpecifiedSwitchEndTime.description_cn:
指定时间段执行时，时间段的结束时间（UTC 时间）。格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`。

- SwitchType 取值为 `SpecifiedTime` 时，该参数为必填参数。
- 指定时间段的最短时长为一小时五十九分钟。
- 不支持跨天设置时间段，即任务执行的起始时间和结束时间不超过 24 小时。
SpecifiedSwitchEndTime.description_en:
When executing during a specified time window, the end time of the window (UTC time). Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.

- When SwitchType is set to `SpecifiedTime`, this parameter is required.
- The minimum duration for the specified time window is one hour and fifty-nine minutes.
- Cross-day time windows are not supported; the start and end times must be within the same day (not exceeding 24 hours apart).

SpecifiedSwitchStartTime.description_cn:
指定时间段执行时，时间段的起始时间（UTC 时间）。格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`。

- SwitchType 取值为 `SpecifiedTime` 时，该参数为必填参数。
- 任务执行的起始时间不得晚于当前日期后的第 7 日。
SpecifiedSwitchStartTime.description_en:
When executing during a specified time window, the start time of the window (UTC time). Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.

- When SwitchType is set to `SpecifiedTime`, this parameter is required.
- The task start time must be within 7 days from the current date.

SwitchType.description_cn:
执行时间，取值：

- `Immediate`：立即切换（默认）。
- `MaintainTime`：可维护时间段内进行切换。
- `SpecifiedTime`：指定时间段内进行切换。

- 可调用 [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170653) 接口查询实例的可维护时间段。
- 取值为 `SpecifiedTime` 时，需要在参数 SpecifiedSwitchStartTime 和 SpecifiedSwitchEndTime 中设定时间段的起止时间。
SwitchType.description_en:
Execution time. Options:

- `Immediate`: Switch immediately (default)
- `MaintainTime`: Switch during the maintenance window
- `SpecifiedTime`: Switch during the specified time window

- You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170653) API to query the maintenance window for the instance.
- If the value is `SpecifiedTime`, you must set the start and end times in the SpecifiedSwitchStartTime and SpecifiedSwitchEndTime parameters.

BackupId.description_cn:
备份 ID。

您可调用 [DescribeBackups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170684) 接口查询指定实例的备份文件列表，获取备份 ID 并确认备份的到期时间。
BackupId.description_en:
Backup ID

You can call the [DescribeBackups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170684) API to query the backup file list for a specified instance, obtain the backup ID, and check the backup expiration time.

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。

您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170652) 接口查询实例信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID

You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170652) API to query instance information, including the instance ID.

KeepAccountPrivileges.description_cn:
选择是否在删除数据库时保留该数据库所绑定账号对同名数据库的权限。取值：
- `true`：是。
- `false`：否。默认值。

此选项不会影响全局权限（*.*）。
KeepAccountPrivileges.description_en:
Choose whether to retain the permissions of accounts bound to this database for other databases with the same name when deleting this database. Values:
- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No (default)

This option does not affect global permissions (*.*).

ProjectName.description_cn:
所属的项目。
如您调用接口使用的 AK/SK 属于某个子账号，且该子账号只拥有某个项目的权限，需要传入该请求参数。
ProjectName.description_en:
Project

TemplateId.description_cn:
参数模板 ID。

仅支持删除用户创建的模板，系统模板不支持删除。
TemplateId.description_en:
Parameter Template ID

You can only delete templates created by users. System templates cannot be deleted.

AllowListId.description_en:
Whitelist ID
You can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170675) API to retrieve information about all whitelists in a specified region, including whitelist IDs

ProjectName.description_cn:
所属的项目。
如您调用接口使用的 AK/SK 属于某个子账号，且该子账号只拥有某个项目的权限，需要传入该请求参数。
ProjectName.description_en:
Project
If the AK/SK you use to call the API belongs to a sub-account that only has access to a specific project, you need to provide this request parameter

IPAddress.description_cn:
按 IP 地址查询白名单。支持传入多个 IP 地址，多个 IP 地址使用英文逗号（,）分隔。

如果白名单包含了多个 IP 地址的任意子集，该白名单就会被返回。
IPAddress.description_en:
Query whitelist by IP address. You can enter multiple IP addresses, separated by English commas (,).

If a whitelist contains any subset of the entered IP addresses, it will be returned.

InstanceId.description_cn:

您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170652) 接口查询目标地域下所有 MySQL 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID. When you specify InstanceId, the DescribeAllowLists API returns the allowlist bound to the specified instance.

You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170652) API to query basic information for all MySQL instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

ProjectName.description_cn:
所属的项目。
如您调用接口使用的 AK/SK 属于某个子账号，且该子账号只拥有某个项目的权限，需要传入该请求参数。
ProjectName.description_en:
Associated project
If the AK/SK you use to call the API belongs to a sub-account and that sub-account only has permission for a specific project, you need to provide this request parameter.

QueryDefault.description_cn:
是否仅查询默认白名单。取值：
- `true`：是。
- `false`：否。默认值。
QueryDefault.description_en:
Whether to query only the default whitelist
Values:
- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No (default)

QueryInstance.description_cn: 查询实例所绑定的白名单。
QueryInstance.description_en: Query the allowlist bound to the instance.

RegionId.description_cn:
地域 ID。

如通过该参数指定了地域，则会返回指定地域下满足其他查询条件的白名单列表。如未指定，则返回为空。您可以调用 [DescribeRegions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170644) 接口查询可创建 MySQL 实例的地域信息，包括地域 ID。
RegionId.description_en:
Region ID

If you specify a region with this parameter, the returned allowlist will include only those in the specified region that meet other query criteria. If not specified, the result will be empty. You can call the [DescribeRegions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170644) API to query the available regions for creating MySQL instances, including the region ID.

WithIpList.description_cn:
是否返回白名单包含的 IP 地址和 IP 地址段的列表。取值：
- `true`：是。
- `false`：否。默认值。
WithIpList.description_en:
Whether to return the list of IP addresses and IP address ranges included in the whitelist. Options:
- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No (default)

AllNode.description_cn: 是否返回所有节点的参数变化
AllNode.description_en: Whether to return parameter changes for all nodes

InstanceId.description_en: Instance ID to which the parameter template will be applied

RegionId.description_cn: 地域ID
RegionId.description_en: Region ID

SpecFamily.description_cn:
实例规格类型。取值：

- `General`，通用型规格。
- `Shared`：共享型规格。
SpecFamily.description_en:
Instance specification type. Value range:

- `General`: General specification
- `Shared`: Shared specification

StorageType.description_cn:
实例的存储类型。取值范围：
- `LocalSSD`：本地盘。
- `CloudESSD_FlexPL`：FlexPL 云盘。
- `CloudESSD_PL0`：PL0 云盘。
- 如需设定 StorageSpace 参数，StorageType 参数为必传。
- 当 InstanceType 取值为 `SingleNode` 时，StorageType 取值只能为 `CloudESSD_FlexPL` 或 `CloudESSD_PL0`。
- 在不同接口中，该参数取值范围不同。具体规则如下：
	- 在以下接口中作为请求参数时，StorageType 的取值只能为 `LocalSSD`。
		- RestoreToCrossRegionInstance
	  - RestoreToNewInstanceFromUserTos
		
- 在部分接口中作为请求参数时，该参数的取值范围与原实例的存储类型有关，具体规则如下：
	- 原实例的存储类型为 `LocalSSD` 或 `CloudESSD_FlexPL` 时，不支持变更存储类型。
	- 原实例的存储类型为 `CloudESSD_PL0` 时，可取值为 `CloudESSD_PL0` 或 `CloudESSD_FlexPL`。
	涉及的接口是：
		- RebuildDBInstance
		- RestoreToNewInstance
		- ModifyDBNodeSpec
StorageType.description_en:
Instance storage type. Value range:
- `LocalSSD`: Local disk
- `CloudESSD_FlexPL`: FlexPL cloud disk
- `CloudESSD_PL0`: PL0 cloud disk
- If you need to set the StorageSpace parameter, the StorageType parameter is required
- When InstanceType is set to `SingleNode`, StorageType can only be `CloudESSD_FlexPL` or `CloudESSD_PL0`
- The value range of this parameter varies by API. The specific rules are as follows:
	- When used as a request parameter in the following APIs, StorageType can only be `LocalSSD`:
		- RestoreToCrossRegionInstance
		- RestoreToNewInstanceFromUserTos

- When used as a request parameter in some APIs, the value range of this parameter depends on the storage type of the original instance. The specific rules are as follows:
	- If the original instance storage type is `LocalSSD` or `CloudESSD_FlexPL`, changing the storage type is not supported
	- If the original instance storage type is `CloudESSD_PL0`, the value can be `CloudESSD_PL0` or `CloudESSD_FlexPL`
	The related APIs are:
		- RebuildDBInstance
		- RestoreToNewInstance
		- ModifyDBNodeSpec

InstanceId.description_cn: 实例 ID。指定后可查询该实例可用于跨地域备份的地域。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
After specifying the instance ID, you can query the regions available for cross-region backup for this instance

RegionId.description_cn: 发起跨地域备份的实例所在的地域 ID。
RegionId.description_en: Region ID where the instance initiating cross-region backup is located

BackupId.description_cn:
数据备份 ID 或者日志备份的文件名。
如果查询的是数据备份加密的密钥，该字段的值为备份文件的 BackupId，可通过调用 [DescribeBackups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170684) 接口获取。如果查询的是日志备份加密的密钥，该字段的值为备份文件的 FileName，可通过调用 [DescribeBinlogFiles](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/773296) 接口获取。
BackupId.description_en:
Data backup ID or log backup file name

If you are querying the encryption key for a data backup, enter the BackupId of the backup file. You can obtain this value by calling the [DescribeBackups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/170684) API. If you are querying the encryption key for a log backup, enter the FileName of the backup file. You can obtain this value by calling the [DescribeBinlogFiles](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6313/773296) API.
BackupId.example_en:
- BackupId example: f1f2284117a344a38370c37b841fec75
- FileName example: binlog-1683420632178737071-binlog.000044

ProjectName.description_en: Instance Project

BackupEndTime.description_cn:
备份创建最晚时间。接受如下格式的 UTC 时间：
- `2022-01-02T15:04:05Z` 会转换成 `2022-01-02 15:04:05` 格式的本地时间。
- 如果传入的不是指定 UTC 格式的时间则原样返回。
BackupEndTime.description_en:
Latest backup creation time. Accepts UTC time in the following format:
- `2022-01-02T15:04:05Z` is converted to local time in the format `2022-01-02 15:04:05`.
- If the input is not in the specified UTC format, it is returned as is.

BackupId.description_cn:
备份 ID。

无默认值。不传该字段时返回其他字段所限定的查询条件下所有备份。
BackupId.description_en:
Backup ID

No default value. If you do not provide this field, all backups matching the other query criteria will be returned.

BackupMethod.description_cn:
备份类型，取值：

- `Physical`：物理备份。
- `Logical`：逻辑备份。
- `Snapshot`：快照备份。

无默认值。不传该字段时返回其他字段所限定的查询条件下所有状态的备份。
BackupMethod.description_en:
Backup type. Options:

- `Physical`: Physical backup
- `Logical`: Logical backup
- `Snapshot`: Snapshot backup

No default value. If this field is not provided, backups of all statuses matching other query conditions are returned.

BackupName.description_cn: 备份的名称。若您未设置备份名称，此处将返回备份 ID。
BackupName.description_en: Backup name. If you have not set a backup name, the backup ID will be returned here.

BackupStartTime.description_cn:
备份创建最早时间。接受如下格式的 UTC 时间：
- `2022-01-02T15:04:05Z` 会转换成 `2022-01-02 15:04:05` 格式的本地时间。
- 如果传入的不是指定 UTC 格式的时间则原样返回。
BackupStartTime.description_en:
Earliest backup creation time. Accepts UTC time in the following format:
- `2022-01-02T15:04:05Z` will be converted to local time in the format `2022-01-02 15:04:05`
- If the input is not in the specified UTC format, returns the input as is

BackupStatus.description_cn:
备份状态，取值：

- `Success`：成功。
- `Failed`：失败。
- `Running`：执行中。


无默认值。不传该字段时返回其他字段所限定的查询条件下所有状态的备份。
BackupStatus.description_en:
Backup status. Possible values:

- `Success`: Successful
- `Failed`: Failed
- `Running`: In progress

No default value. If this field is not provided, backups of all statuses matching other query conditions will be returned.

BackupType.description_cn:
备份方式，取值：
- `Full`：物理备份类型下的全量备份或逻辑备份类型下的库表备。
- `Increment`：物理备份类型下的增量备份。
- `DumpAll`：逻辑备份类型下的全库备份。

无默认值。不传该字段时返回其他字段所限定的查询条件下所有方式的备份。
BackupType.description_en:
Backup mode. Possible values:
- `Full`: Full backup for physical backup type, or database/table backup for logical backup type
- `Increment`: Incremental backup for physical backup type
- `DumpAll`: Full database backup for logical backup type

No default value. If this field is not provided, backups of all modes matching other query criteria will be returned

CreateType.description_cn:
备份的创建者。取值：

StorageType.description_cn:

- `CloudESSD_PL0`：PL0 云盘。

	  - RestoreToNewInstanceFromUserTos

	- 原实例的存储类型为 `LocalSSD` 或 `CloudESSD_FlexPL` 时，不支持变更存储类型。
	- 原实例的存储类型为 `CloudESSD_PL0` 时，可取值为 `CloudESSD_PL0` 或 `CloudESSD_FlexPL`。
	涉及的接口是：
		- RebuildDBInstance
		- RestoreToNewInstance
		- ModifyDBNodeSpec
StorageType.description_en:
Instance storage type. Valid values:
- `LocalSSD`: Local disk.
- `CloudESSD_FlexPL`: FlexPL cloud disk.
- `CloudESSD_PL0`: PL0 cloud disk.
- If you need to set the StorageSpace parameter, the StorageType parameter is required.
- When InstanceType is set to `SingleNode`, StorageType can only be set to `CloudESSD_FlexPL` or `CloudESSD_PL0`.
- The valid values for this parameter vary by API. The specific rules are as follows:
	- When used as a request parameter in the following APIs, StorageType can only be set to `LocalSSD`.
		- RestoreToCrossRegionInstance
		- RestoreToNewInstanceFromUserTos

- In some APIs, the valid values for this parameter depend on the storage type of the original instance. The specific rules are as follows:
	- If the original instance storage type is `LocalSSD` or `CloudESSD_FlexPL`, changing the storage type is not supported.
	- If the original instance storage type is `CloudESSD_PL0`, StorageType can be set to `CloudESSD_PL0` or `CloudESSD_FlexPL`.
	The relevant APIs are:
		- RebuildDBInstance
		- RestoreToNewInstance
		- ModifyDBNodeSpec

- `CloudESSD_PL0`: PL0 cloud disk
- If you need to set the StorageSpace parameter, the StorageType parameter is required
- When InstanceType is set to `SingleNode`, StorageType can only be `CloudESSD_FlexPL` or `CloudESSD_PL0`
- The valid values for this parameter vary by API. The specific rules are as follows:
	- When used as a request parameter in the following APIs, StorageType can only be `LocalSSD`:
		- RestoreToCrossRegionInstance
		- RestoreToNewInstanceFromUserTos
	
- In some APIs, when used as a request parameter, the valid values for this parameter depend on the storage type of the original instance. The specific rules are as follows:
	- If the original instance storage type is `LocalSSD` or `CloudESSD_FlexPL`, changing the storage type is not supported
	- If the original instance storage type is `CloudESSD_PL0`, the value can be `CloudESSD_PL0` or `CloudESSD_FlexPL`
	The related APIs are:
		- RebuildDBInstance
		- RestoreToNewInstance
		- ModifyDBNodeSpec
