- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No

No default value; if this parameter is not provided, the original setting will not be changed.

IncrementBackupFrequency.description_cn:
增量备份的方式为高频增量时的备份频率。取值可为：`1`、`2`、`4`、`6` 或 `12`，单位：小时。
- 无默认值。不传入该参数时则不修改原设定。
- 该参数仅在 HourlyIncrBackupEnable 取值为 `true` 时生效。
IncrementBackupFrequency.description_en:
Specifies the backup frequency when using high-frequency incremental backups. Valid values: `1`, `2`, `4`, `6`, or `12` (unit: hours).
- No default value. If this parameter is not provided, the original setting will not be changed.
- This parameter only takes effect when HourlyIncrBackupEnable is set to `true`.

WALLogSpaceLimitEnable.description_cn:
本地剩余可用空间保护功能状态。开启时，会在实例总存储空间占用率超过 80% 或者剩余空间不足 5GB 时，自动开始清除最早的本地 WAL 日志，直至总空间占用率低于 80% 且剩余空间大于 5GB。取值范围：
- `true`：开启。
- `false`：关闭。
无默认值。不传入该参数时则不修改原设定。
WALLogSpaceLimitEnable.description_en:
Local available space protection status. When enabled, if total instance storage usage exceeds 80% or available space drops below 5 GB, the system automatically deletes the oldest local WAL logs until usage falls below 80% and available space is above 5 GB. Valid values:
- `true`: Enabled
- `false`: Disabled
No default value. If this parameter is not provided, the original setting remains unchanged.

AccountName.description_cn:
账号名称。

仅支持修改普通账号的权限。
AccountName.description_en:
Account Name

You can only modify permissions for regular accounts.

AccountPrivileges.description_cn:
账号权限信息。取值：

- `Login`：登录权限。
- `Inherit`：继承权限。
- `CreateRole`：创建角色权限。
- `CreateDB`：创建数据库权限。

- 不支持修改高权限账号权限。
- 可在一次调用中赋予多个权限。
AccountPrivileges.description_en:
Account permission information. Possible values:

- `Login`: Login permission
- `Inherit`: Inherit permission
- `CreateRole`: Create role permission
- `CreateDB`: Create database permission

- You cannot modify permissions for high-privilege accounts
- You can assign multiple permissions in a single request

DomainPrefix.description_cn:
新的访问地址前缀。访问地址前缀应满足以下规则：

- 由小写字母、数字和中划线（-）组成。
- 至少包含 8 个字符，总长度（含后缀）不得超过 63 个字符。
- 以小写字母开头，以小写字母或数字结尾。
DomainPrefix.description_en:
New Access Address Prefix
The access address prefix must meet the following requirements:

- Consist of only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens (-)
- Include at least 8 characters; total length (including suffix) must not exceed 63 characters
- Start with a lowercase letter and end with a lowercase letter or number

EndpointId.description_cn: 待修改连接地址的连接终端 ID。如不设定，默认选择默认终端。
EndpointId.description_en:
ID of the connection terminal whose address will be modified
If not specified, the default terminal is selected

Port.description_cn: 端口的端口号。取值范围为 1000~65534。
Port.description_en: Port number (1000–65534)

PrivateDomainVersion.description_cn:
私网地址类型。取值：
- `LocalDomain`：本地域域名。
- `CrossRegionDomain`：可跨地域访问域名。
PrivateDomainVersion.description_en:
Private network address type
Values:
- `LocalDomain`: Domain name for local region
- `CrossRegionDomain`: Domain name accessible across regions

SubnetId.description_cn: SubnetId
SubnetId.description_en: Subnet ID

DNSVisibility.description_cn:
是否开启公网解析。

- `false`：默认值，火山引擎私网解析。
- `true`：火山引擎私网以及公网解析。
DNSVisibility.description_en:
Enable public network resolution

- `false`: Default, Volcengine private network resolution only
- `true`: Volcengine private and public network resolution

EndpointId.description_cn: 实例连接终端 ID。如不设定，默认选择默认终端。
EndpointId.description_en: Instance connection terminal ID. If not set, the default terminal is selected by default.

NetworkType.description_cn: 网络类型，取值为 `Private`（私网地址）。

EndpointId.description_cn: 实例连接终端 ID。
EndpointId.description_en: Instance Connection Terminal ID

EndpointName.description_cn:
实例连接终端名称。连接终端的命名规则如下：

- 不能以数字、中划线（-）开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）。
- 长度为 1~64 个字符。
EndpointName.description_en:
Instance connection terminal name. Naming rules for connection terminals:

- Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
- Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-) are allowed
- Length must be 1–64 characters

EndpointId.description_cn:
实例已开启读写分离功能的连接终端的 ID。
当前仅默认终端支持读写分离功能。
EndpointId.description_en:
ID of the connection endpoint of the instance with read/write splitting enabled
Currently, only the default endpoint supports read/write splitting

ReadWriteProxyConnection.description_cn:
连接终端开启读写分离后，为终端设置的代理连接数。
- 代理连接数的取值下限为 20。
- 代理连接数的取值上限取决于实例主节点的规格，不同规格支持的代理连接数上限不同，详细信息请参见[产品规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6438/79219)。
ReadWriteProxyConnection.description_en:
The number of proxy connections configured for the terminal after read/write splitting is enabled.
- The minimum value for proxy connections is 20.
- The maximum value depends on the instance's primary node specifications. Each specification supports a different maximum number of proxy connections. For details, see [Product Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6438/79219).

EndpointId.description_cn: 实例连接终端 ID。
EndpointId.description_en: Instance connection terminal ID

ReadOnlyNodeDistributionType.description_cn:
只读权重分配模式。取值：

- `Default`：标准权重分配（默认值）。
- `Custom`：自定义权重分配。
ReadOnlyNodeDistributionType.description_en:
Read-only weight allocation mode. Options:

- `Default`: Standard weight allocation (default)
- `Custom`: Custom weight allocation

ReadOnlyNodeWeight.description_cn:
自定义读权重分配，即传入主节点和只读节点的读请求权重。以 100 递增，最大值为 40000。

- 当 `ReadOnlyNodeDistributionType` 取值为 `Custom` 时，需要传入此参数。
- 主节点需要传入 `NodeType` 为 `Primary`，只读节点需要传入 `NodeID`。
- 权重不可全部设置为 0。
ReadOnlyNodeWeight.description_en:
Customize read weight allocation by specifying the read request weights for the primary node and read-only nodes. Increase weights in increments of 100, up to a maximum of 40,000.

- When `ReadOnlyNodeDistributionType` is set to `Custom`, you must provide this parameter
- For the primary node, specify `NodeType` as `Primary`; for read-only nodes, specify `NodeID`
- You cannot set all weights to 0

WriteNodeHaltWriting.description_cn:
是否禁止终端将写请求发送给写节点（目前仅主节点为写节点）。取值：
- `true`：是。
- `false`：否。

为避免没有可用的连接终端承载写业务，需在实例有其他读写终端时才能开启此配置。
WriteNodeHaltWriting.description_en:
Whether to prevent terminals from sending write requests to write nodes (currently, only the primary node is a write node). Values:
- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No

To avoid having no available terminal to handle write operations, enable this setting only when other read-write terminals exist in the instance.

EndpointId.description_cn: 实例连接终端 ID。
EndpointId.description_en: Instance Connection Terminal ID

ReadOnlyNodeMaxDelayTime.description_cn: 只读节点的最大延迟阈值，当只读节点延迟时间超过该值时，读取流量不发往该节点。单位为秒，取值范围为 0~3600。
ReadOnlyNodeMaxDelayTime.description_en: Maximum latency threshold for read-only nodes. If a read-only node's latency exceeds this value, read traffic will not be routed to that node. Unit: seconds. Range: 0–3600.

EndpointId.description_cn: 实例连接终端 ID。
EndpointId.description_en: Instance terminal connection ID

ReadOnlyNodeDistributionType.description_cn:
读权重分配模式。开启读写分离时，即 `ReadWriteSpliting` 设置为 `true` 时可以传入此参数。取值：

- `Default`：自动分配，根据连接终端下各只读节点的内存大小确定节点的权重。默认值。
- `Custom`：自定义权重分配。在 ReadOnlyNodeWeight 字段中对各节点的读权重进行自定义设置。
ReadOnlyNodeDistributionType.description_en:
Read weight allocation mode. You can specify this parameter when read/write splitting is enabled (that is, when `ReadWriteSpliting` is set to `true`). Options:

- `Default`: Automatically allocates weights based on the memory size of each read-only node under the endpoint. This is the default value.
- `Custom`: Custom weight allocation. Set the read weight for each node in the `ReadOnlyNodeWeight` field.

ReadOnlyNodeMaxDelayTime.description_cn:
只读节点的最大延迟阈值，当只读节点延迟时间超过该值时，读流量不发往该节点。单位为秒，取值范围为 0~3600，默认值为 30。

读写类型的终端，且开启读写分离后支持设置此参数。
ReadOnlyNodeMaxDelayTime.description_en:
Maximum latency threshold for read-only nodes. If a read-only node's latency exceeds this value, read traffic will not be routed to that node. Unit: seconds. Range: 0–3600. Default: 30.

This parameter is supported for read-write endpoints when read-write splitting is enabled.

ReadOnlyNodeWeight.description_cn:
自定义读权重分配，即传入主节点和只读节点的读请求权重。以 100 递增，最大值为 40000。

- 当 `ReadOnlyNodeDistributionType` 取值为 `Custom` 时，需要传入此参数。
- 主节点需要传入 `NodeType` 为 `Primary`，只读节点需要传入 `NodeID`。
- 权重不可全部设置为 0。
ReadOnlyNodeWeight.description_en:
Customize read weight allocation by assigning read request weights to the primary node and read-only nodes. Increase weights in increments of 100, up to a maximum of 40,000.

- When `ReadOnlyNodeDistributionType` is set to `Custom`, you must provide this parameter
- For the primary node, specify `NodeType` as `Primary`; for read-only nodes, specify `NodeID`
- You cannot set all weights to 0

ReadWriteProxyConnection.description_cn:
终端开启读写分离后，为终端设置的代理连接数。
- 代理连接数的取值下限为 20。
- 代理连接数的取值上限取决于实例主节点的规格，不同规格支持的代理连接数上限不同，详细信息请参见[产品规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6438/79219)。
ReadWriteProxyConnection.description_en:
The number of proxy connections set for the terminal after read/write splitting is enabled
- The minimum value for proxy connections is 20
- The maximum value depends on the instance's primary node specifications; different specifications support different maximum proxy connections. For details, see [Product Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6438/79219)

ReadWriteSpliting.description_cn:
是否开启读写分离。取值：

- `true`：开启读写分离。
- `false`：不开启通读写分离。
ReadWriteSpliting.description_en:
Enable read/write splitting

Values:

- `true`: Enable read/write splitting
- `false`: Do not enable read/write splitting

WriteNodeHaltWriting.description_cn:
是否禁止终端将写请求发送给写节点（目前仅主节点为写节点）。取值：
- `true`：是。
- `false`：否。

为避免没有可用的连接终端承载写业务，需在实例有其他读写终端时才能开启此配置。
WriteNodeHaltWriting.description_en:
Whether to prevent terminals from sending write requests to the write node (currently, only the primary node is a write node). Options:
- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No

To avoid having no available terminal to handle write operations, enable this setting only when the instance has other read-write terminals.

DryRun.description_cn: 是否预检此次请求
DryRun.description_en: Pre-check This Request?

NodeInfo.description_cn:
需要迁移的节点和拟迁移到的目的可用区。

- 仅支持将单可用区实例迁移为多可用区实例。
- 仅支持迁移备节点或只读节点，也支持同时迁移备节点和只读节点。
NodeInfo.description_en:
Nodes to be migrated and their target availability zone

- Only single-zone instances can be migrated to multi-zone instances
- You can migrate standby nodes, read-only nodes, or both at the same time

AutoRenew.description_cn:
预付费场景下是否自动续费。

- `true`：自动续费。
- `false`：不自动续费 (默认)。
AutoRenew.description_en:
Whether to enable auto-renewal for prepaid plans

- `true`: Auto-renew
- `false`: Do not auto-renew (default)

ChargeType.description_cn:
付费类型。取值为 `PrePaid`（包年包月）。

仅支持将按量计费类型的实例转为包年包月类型的实例。
ChargeType.description_en:
Payment type. Value: `PrePaid` (annual/monthly subscription)

You can only convert pay-as-you-go instances to annual/monthly subscription instances

Period.description_cn:
预付费场景下的购买时长。默认值：1。取值范围：
- 当 PeriodUnit 取值为 `Month` 时，Period 的取值范围为 1~9。
- 当 PeriodUnit 取值为 `Year` 时，Period 的取值范围为 1~3。
Period.description_en:
Purchase duration for prepaid scenarios. Default value: 1. Valid range:
- If PeriodUnit is set to `Month`, Period can be 1–9.
- If PeriodUnit is set to `Year`, Period can be 1–3.

PeriodUnit.description_cn:
预付费场景下的购买周期。

- `Month`：包月（默认）。
- `Year`：包年。
PeriodUnit.description_en:
Purchase cycle in prepaid scenarios

- `Month`: Monthly (default)
- `Year`: Yearly

GlobalReadOnly.description_cn:
是否开启实例全局只读。

- `true`：开启。
- `false`：关闭。

无默认值，不传值时会忽略请求。
GlobalReadOnly.description_en:
Enable global read-only mode for instance

- `true`: Enable
- `false`: Disable

No default value. If not specified, the request will be ignored.

DayKind.description_cn: 可维护周期的粒度，取值为 `Week`，周。
DayKind.description_en: Granularity of the maintainable cycle: Week (周)

DayOfWeekMaintenanceTime.description_cn: 实例的可维护时间段设置。

InstanceNewName.description_cn:
实例新名称。实例新名称的设定规则如下：

- 不能以数字、中划线开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线和中划线。
- 长度限制在 1 ~ 128 之间。
InstanceNewName.description_en:
New instance name

Rules for setting the new instance name:

- Cannot start with a number or hyphen
- Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens are allowed
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

Parameters.description_cn: 参数值对象，用户基于默认参数模板自定义的参数值。
Parameters.description_en: Parameter value object: user-defined parameter values based on the default parameter template
Parameters.example_en: Please refer to the request example

ForceEncryption.description_cn:
是否开启 SSL 强制加密功能，取值：

- `true`：是。
- `false`：否。

- 仅在实例已开启 SSL 加密功能时生效。
- 不支持同时传入 ReloadSSLCertificate 与 SSLEnable。
ForceEncryption.description_en:
Enable SSL enforced encryption. Valid values:

- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No

- Only effective when SSL encryption is enabled for the instance
- ReloadSSLCertificate and SSLEnable cannot be specified together

ReloadSSLCertificate.description_cn:
更新 SSL 证书有效期。取值为 `true`，即更新 SSL 证书有效期。

- 仅在实例已开启 SSL 加密功能时生效。
- 不支持同时传入 ReloadSSLCertificate 与 SSLEnable。
ReloadSSLCertificate.description_en:
Update SSL certificate validity period. Set to `true` to update the SSL certificate validity period.

- Only effective when SSL encryption is enabled for the instance
- You cannot pass both ReloadSSLCertificate and SSLEnable at the same time

SSLEnable.description_cn:
是否开启 SSL 加密功能，取值：

- `true`：是。
- `false`：否。
SSLEnable.description_en:
Whether to enable SSL encryption. Possible values:

- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No

DryRun.description_cn: 是否预检此次请求
DryRun.description_en: Pre-check This Request

EstimateOnly.description_cn:
是否发起变配评估。取值：
- `true`：是。
- `false`：否。默认值。
	
如果发起，则按照其他字段确定的规格配置进行变配评估，实际不会执行变配动作。发起变配评估后，会返回 EstimationResult 参数，说明此次变配的影响。
EstimateOnly.description_en:
Whether to initiate a configuration change assessment. Options:
- `true`: Yes
- `false`: No (default)

If initiated, the assessment is performed based on the specifications determined by other fields, but no actual configuration change is executed. After initiating the assessment, the EstimationResult parameter is returned, indicating the impact of the configuration change.

ModifyType.description_cn:
变配方式。取值为：

- `Usually`：常规变配，即立即变配。默认值。
- `Temporary`：弹性升配，即临时升配。

仅当实例的计费类型为包年包月实例时，支持为该参数取值为 `Temporary`。可通过调用 [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6438/1159936) 接口查询实例的计费类型。
ModifyType.description_en:
Configuration change mode. Available values:

- `Usually`: Regular configuration change (immediate change, default)
- `Temporary`: Flexible upgrade (temporary upgrade)

The `Temporary` option is only available for instances billed annually or monthly. You can check the billing type by calling the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6438/1159936) API.

NodeInfo.description_cn:
实例规格配置。Primary 节点有且只有 1 个，Secondary 节点有且只有 1 个，Read-Only 节点可选 0~10 个。

- 该参数与 `StorageSpace` 二者必选其一，且这两个参数可同时修改。
- 只需在该参数中传入变配涉及的节点。
NodeInfo.description_en:
Instance specification configuration
Primary node: 1 only
Secondary node: 1 only
Read-Only nodes: Optional, 0–10

- You must select at least one of this parameter or `StorageSpace`; both can be modified at the same time
- Only include nodes involved in the configuration change in this parameter

NodeSpec.description_cn: 实例规格代码，历史兼容需要
NodeSpec.description_en: Instance specification code required for historical compatibility

RollbackTime.description_cn:
还原时间，时间格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.sssZ`（UTC 时间）。

- 当 ModifyType 取值为 `Temporary` 时，该参数为必选。
- 该参数仅在 ModifyType 取值为 `Temporary` 时生效。
- 设置的还原时间的时间点与调用接口的时间点相差应不超过 2 分钟，实际的还原时间的时间点以调用接口的时间点为准。
- 可多次发起临时升配延长临时升配期，但总时长不能超过 30 天（以第一次发起临时升配的时间为准）。
- 可多次发起临时升配，但不允许缩短临时升配期。如实例已处于临时升配期：
	- 新的还原时间不能早于已生效的还原时间。
	- 距离包年包月实例的到期时间不足五天时，不允许再次发起临时升配。
RollbackTime.description_en:
Restore time. The time format is `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.sssZ` (UTC)

- This parameter is required when ModifyType is set to `Temporary`
- This parameter only takes effect when ModifyType is set to `Temporary`
- The difference between the restore time and the time you call the API must not exceed 2 minutes. The actual restore time is based on the time you call the API
- You can extend the temporary upgrade period multiple times, but the total duration cannot exceed 30 days (counted from the time of the first temporary upgrade)
- You can initiate temporary upgrades multiple times, but you cannot shorten the temporary upgrade period. If the instance is already in a temporary upgrade period:
    - The new restore time cannot be earlier than the effective restore time
    - If there are less than five days remaining before the annual/monthly subscription instance expires, you cannot initiate another temporary upgrade

SpecifiedSwitchEndTime.description_cn:
指定时间段执行时时间段的结束时间。时间格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`。
- SwitchType 取值为 `SpecifiedTime` 时，该参数为必填参数。
- 指定时间段的最短时长为一小时五十九分钟。
SpecifiedSwitchEndTime.description_en:
End time for executing within the specified time period. The time format is `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.
- When SwitchType is set to `SpecifiedTime`, this parameter is required.
- The minimum duration for the specified time period is one hour and fifty-nine minutes.

SpecifiedSwitchStartTime.description_cn: 指定时间段执行时时间段的起始时间。时间格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`。
SpecifiedSwitchStartTime.description_en: Start time for executing within the specified time period. The time format is `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`.

StorageSpace.description_cn:
实例存储空间。取值范围为 \[20, 3000\]，单位为 GB，步长为 10GB。

- 该参数与 `NodeInfo` 二者必选其一，且这两个参数可同时修改。

- 当 ModifyType 取值为 `Temporary` 时，不支持设置该参数。
StorageSpace.description_en:
Instance storage space. Range: [20, 3000] GB, in increments of 10 GB

- You must specify either this parameter or `NodeInfo`. You can modify both parameters at the same time

- When ModifyType is set to `Temporary`, this parameter cannot be configured

StorageType.description_cn:
实例存储类型。取固定值 `LocalSSD`（本地 SSD 盘）。

- 该参数与 `NodeInfo` 二者必选其一，且这两个参数可同时修改。
- 当 ModifyType 取值为 `Temporary` 时，不支持设置该参数。
StorageType.description_en:
Instance storage type. Fixed value: `LocalSSD` (local SSD disk).

- You must specify at least one of this parameter or `NodeInfo`; both can be modified at the same time.
- This parameter cannot be set when ModifyType is `Temporary`.

SwitchType.description_cn:
执行时间，取值：

- `Immediate`：立即切换（默认）。
- `MaintainTime`：可维护时间段内进行切换。
- `SpecifiedTime`：指定时间段内进行切换。

- 可调用 [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6438/1159936) 接口查询实例的可维护时间段。
- 取值为 `SpecifiedTime` 时，需要在参数 SpecifiedSwitchStartTime 和 SpecifiedSwitchEndTime 中设定时间段的起止时间。
SwitchType.description_en:
Execution time options:

- `Immediate`: Switch immediately (default)
- `MaintainTime`: Switch during the maintenance window
- `SpecifiedTime`: Switch within the specified time period

- You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6438/1159936) API to query the maintenance window for the instance.
- If set to `SpecifiedTime`, you must specify the start and end times in the SpecifiedSwitchStartTime and SpecifiedSwitchEndTime parameters.

DBName.description_cn: 数据库名称。可调用 [DescribeDatabases](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6438/1158742) 接口查询数据库列表。
DBName.description_en: Database Name. Call the [DescribeDatabases](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6438/1158742) API to view the database list.

Owner.description_cn:
数据库 Owner。

实例只读账号、被禁用了 DDL 权限的高权限账号或被禁用了 DDL 权限的普通账号不能作为数据库的 Owner。
Owner.description_en:
Database Owner

Instance read-only accounts, privileged accounts with DDL privileges disabled, or regular accounts with DDL privileges disabled cannot be the database Owner.

TemplateDesc.description_cn: 参数模板的新的描述信息。最多支持 200 个字符。
TemplateDesc.description_en: New description for the parameter template. Up to 200 characters supported
TemplateDesc.example_cn: 这是一段参数模板的描述信息。
TemplateDesc.example_en: This is a description for the parameter template.

TemplateParams.description_cn:
参数模板中的参数配置。
- 如包含了原参数模板中已有的参数，则参数值以新传入的为准。
- 如包含了原参数模板中没有的参数，则会在参数模板中新增参数。
TemplateParams.description_en:
Parameter configuration in the parameter template
- If the configuration includes parameters already in the original template, the new values will override the existing ones
- If the configuration includes parameters not in the original template, those parameters will be added to the template
TemplateParams.example_en: Please refer to the request example

ModifyBeginTime.description_cn:
指定时间段执行时时间段的起始时间。时间格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC 时间）。
将任务的修改为指定时间段执行时，即 TaskEventOperation 取值为 `ChangeToSpecifiedTime` 时，必填。
ModifyBeginTime.description_en:
Start time of the specified time period for execution. The time format is `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC time).
When changing the task to execute within a specified time period, that is, when TaskEventOperation is set to `ChangeToSpecifiedTime`, this field is required.

ModifyEndTime.description_cn:
指定时间段执行时时间段的结束时间。时间格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC 时间）。
将任务的修改为指定时间段执行时，即 TaskEventOperation 取值为 `ChangeToSpecifiedTime` 时，必填。
ModifyEndTime.description_en:
End time of the specified time period for execution. The time format is `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC time).
When changing the task to execute within a specified time period, that is, when TaskEventOperation is set to `ChangeToSpecifiedTime`, this field is required.

TaskEventOperation.description_cn:
修改任务的修改类型。取值：

- `ChangeToSpecifiedTime`：修改为指定时间段执行。
- `ChangeToMaintainTime`：修改为可维护时间段执行。
- `ImmediateExecute`：立即执行。
- `ImmediateSwitch`：立即切换。
取值为 `ChangeToSpecifiedTime` 时，需要指定 ModifyBeginTime 和 ModifyEndTime。
TaskEventOperation.description_en:
Type of modification for the task. Valid values:

- `ChangeToSpecifiedTime`: Change to execute within a specified time period
- `ChangeToMaintainTime`: Change to execute within a maintenance window
- `ImmediateExecute`: Execute immediately
- `ImmediateSwitch`: Switch immediately
When the value is `ChangeToSpecifiedTime`, you must specify ModifyBeginTime and ModifyEndTime.

ModifyBeginTime.description_cn:
指定时间段执行时时间段的起始时间。时间格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC 时间）。
将任务的修改为指定时间段执行时，即 TaskEventOperation 取值为 `ChangeToSpecifiedTime` 时，必填。
ModifyBeginTime.description_en:
Start time for the specified execution period. Time format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC).
Required when changing the task to execute during a specified period, that is, when TaskEventOperation is set to `ChangeToSpecifiedTime`.

ModifyEndTime.description_cn:
指定时间段执行时时间段的结束时间。时间格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC 时间）。
将任务的修改为指定时间段执行时，即 TaskEventOperation 取值为 `ChangeToSpecifiedTime` 时，必填。
ModifyEndTime.description_en:
End time for the specified execution period. Time format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC).
Required when changing the task to execute during a specified period, that is, when TaskEventOperation is set to `ChangeToSpecifiedTime`.

ProjectName.description_en: Project name

TaskEventOperation.description_cn:
修改任务的修改类型。取值：
- `ChangeToSpecifiedTime`：修改为指定时间段执行。取值为 `ChangeToSpecifiedTime` 时，需要指定 ModifyBeginTime 和 ModifyEndTime。
- `ChangeToMaintainTime`：修改为可维护时间段执行。
- `ImmediateExecute`：立即执行。
- `Cancel`：取消任务。

仅处于**待切换**状态的任务支持修改。
TaskEventOperation.description_en:
Task modification type. Options:
- `ChangeToSpecifiedTime`: Change to execute during a specified period. When set to `ChangeToSpecifiedTime`, you must specify ModifyBeginTime and ModifyEndTime.
- `ChangeToMaintainTime`: Change to execute during the maintenance window.
- `ImmediateExecute`: Execute immediately.
- `Cancel`: Cancel the task.

Only tasks in the **Pending Switch** status can be modified.

All.description_cn:
是否解绑资源上全部的标签。取值范围：

- `true`：解绑全部标签。
- `false`：默认值，不解绑全部标签。

当请求中 TagKeys 为空时，该参数才有效。
All.description_en:
Whether to unbind all tags from the resource. Value options:

- `true`: Unbind all tags
- `false`: Default value; do not unbind all tags

This parameter is only effective when TagKeys is empty in the request.

InstanceIds.description_cn:
需要解绑标签的实例 ID。
支持一次传入多个实例 ID，最多同时传入 20 个实例 ID。
InstanceIds.description_en:
Instance IDs that need to have tags unbound
You can enter up to 20 instance IDs at once

TagKeys.description_cn:
待移除的标签的键。

支持一次传入多个标签的键，进行批量解绑。单次最多解绑 20 个标签。
TagKeys.description_en:
Keys of tags to remove

You can enter multiple tag keys at once to unbind them in batch. You can unbind up to 20 tags per operation.

AccountName.description_cn:
数据库账号名称。账号名称的设置规则如下：

- 长度 2~63 个字符。
- 由字母、数字、下划线（_）或中划线（-）组成。
- 以字母开头，字母或数字结尾。
- 不能使用保留关键字，所有被禁用的关键词请参见[禁用关键词](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6438/80243)。
AccountName.description_en:
Database account name. The account name must follow these rules:

- Length: 2–63 characters
- Can include letters, numbers, underscores (_), or hyphens (-)
- Must start with a letter and end with a letter or number
- Reserved keywords are not allowed. For a full list of disabled keywords, see [Disabled Keywords](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6438/80243)

AccountPassword.description_cn:
为数据库账号重置的新密码。数据库账号密码的设置规则如下：

- 长度为 8~32 个字符。
- 由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的任意三种组成。
- 特殊字符为 `!@#$%^*()&_+-=`。
AccountPassword.description_en:
New password for the database account. The password must meet the following requirements:

- Length: 8–32 characters
- Must include at least three of the following: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, special characters
- Allowed special characters: `!@#$%^*()&_+-=`

ApplyScope.description_cn:
重启场景，取值：

- `AllNode`：所有节点。默认值。
- `CustomNode`：自定义只读节点。
ApplyScope.description_en:
Restart Scenario options:

- `AllNode`: All nodes (default)
- `CustomNode`: Custom read-only nodes

CustomNodeIds.description_cn:
要重启的只读节点的 ID。

- 当 `ApplyScope` 取值为 `AllNode` 时，会重启整个实例，不能设置 CustomNodeIds 参数。
- 当 `ApplyScope` 取值为 `CustomNode` 时，需要为该参数传入待重启的只读节点 ID。
CustomNodeIds.description_en:
ID of the read-only node to restart

- If `ApplyScope` is set to `AllNode`, the entire instance will restart and you cannot set the CustomNodeIds parameter
- If `ApplyScope` is set to `CustomNode`, enter the ID of the read-only node to restart for this parameter

DryRun.description_cn: 是否预检此次请求
DryRun.description_en: Pre-check this request

BackupId.description_cn: 用于恢复的备份 ID。
BackupId.description_en: Backup ID for recovery

Databases.description_cn:
待恢复的数据库信息。
单次最多可选择 50 个库进行恢复。
Databases.description_en:
Database Information to Restore
You can select up to 50 databases to restore at a time.

SourceDBInstanceId.description_en: Instance ID associated with the backup

TargetDBInstanceAccount.description_cn:
目标实例中用于作为新恢复的数据库 Owner 的账号。
仅支持选择未被禁用 DDL 权限的高权限账号。
TargetDBInstanceAccount.description_en:
Account in the target instance to be set as the owner of the newly restored database
Only high-privilege accounts with enabled DDL permissions can be selected

TargetDBInstanceId.description_cn:
恢复的目标实例的 ID。
SourceDBInstanceId 与 TargetDBInstanceId 的值可相同。如 SourceDBInstanceId 与 TargetDBInstanceId 的值相同，则将数据恢复至原实例。
TargetDBInstanceId.description_en:
Target instance ID to restore
SourceDBInstanceId and TargetDBInstanceId can be the same. If they are the same, data will be restored to the original instance.

AllowListIds.description_cn: 白名单 ID。如需绑定多个白名单，白名单 ID 用英文逗号（,）分隔。一个实例最多可绑定 100 个白名单。
AllowListIds.description_en: Whitelist ID. To bind multiple whitelists, separate each whitelist ID with an English comma (,). You can bind up to 100 whitelists to a single instance.

BackupId.description_cn:
原实例的备份文件 ID，使用该备份文件中保存的数据创建新实例。可通过调用 [DescribeBackups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6438/1158713) 查询指定实例的备份文件列表信息。

应至少传入 BackupId 与 RestoreTime 中的一个。如果同时传入 BackupId 和 RestoreTime，会以 BackupId 为准。
BackupId.description_en:
Backup file ID of the original instance. Use the data saved in this backup file to create a new instance. You can call [DescribeBackups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6438/1158713) to view the list of backup files for a specified instance.

You must provide at least one of BackupId or RestoreTime. If you provide both, BackupId takes precedence.

InstanceName.description_cn:
实例名称。规则：

- 不能以数字、中划线开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线和中划线。
- 长度限制在 1~128之间。
InstanceName.description_en:
Instance name
Rules:
- Cannot start with a number or hyphen
- Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens are allowed
- Length must be between 1 and 128

MaintenanceWindow.description_cn: 实例可维护时间段的详细信息。
MaintenanceWindow.description_en: Details of the instance maintenance window.

NodeInfo.description_cn: 实例规格配置。Primary 节点有且只有 1 个，Secondary 节点有且只有 1 个，Read-Only 节点可选 0~10 个。
NodeInfo.description_en:
Instance specification configuration:
• Primary node: exactly 1
• Secondary node: exactly 1
• Read-Only nodes: optional, 0–10 allowed

ProjectName.description_cn: 所属项目。当该参数留空时，新建的实例默认加入 default 项目。
ProjectName.description_en: Project. If left blank, the new instance is added to the default project by default.

RestoreTime.description_cn:
原实例日志备份保留时间内的任意时间点，格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC 时间）。可通过调用 [DescribeRecoverableTime](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6438/1158721) 查询指定实例可恢复的时间范围。

该参数与 BackupId 参数二者必须选择其一。
RestoreTime.description_en:
Any time point within the log backup retention period of the original instance, in the format `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC). You can call [DescribeRecoverableTime](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6438/1158721) to query the recoverable time range for the specified instance.

You must select either this parameter or the BackupId parameter.

SrcInstanceId.description_cn: 备份文件所属原实例的 ID。
SrcInstanceId.description_en: ID of the original instance associated with the backup file

StorageSpace.description_cn: 实例存储空间。取值范围：\[20, 3000\]，单位：GB，步长 10GB。默认值为原实例空间大小。
StorageSpace.description_en:
Instance Storage Space
Range: [20, 3000] GB, in increments of 10 GB
Default: original instance storage size

StorageType.description_cn: 实例存储类型。取固定值 `LocalSSD`（本地 SSD 盘）。
StorageType.description_en: Instance storage type. Fixed value: `LocalSSD` (local SSD disk)

SubnetId.description_cn:
子网 ID。
- 仅支持选择实例所在可用区的子网。
- 可以调用 [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) 接口查询指定私有网络和可用区内的所有子网信息。 
- 可以调用 [CreateSubnet](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70496) 接口创建新的子网。
SubnetId.description_en:
Subnet ID
- You can only select subnets in the same availability zone as the instance
- You can call the [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) API to query all subnet information in the specified VPC and availability zone
- You can call the [CreateSubnet](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70496) API to create a new subnet

Tags.description_cn:
标签数组对象。

支持一次传入多组标签键值对象。单次最多同时传入 20 组标签键值对，单个实例最多绑定 50 个标签。
Tags.description_en:
Tag array object

You can add multiple tag key-value objects at a time. You can add up to 20 tag key-value objects at once, and each instance can have up to 50 tags.

VpcId.description_cn:
使用此参数指定实例使用的私有网络。
- 如您使用 ECS 来连接 PostgreSQL 实例，则需使用和 ECS 实例相同的私有网络，否则 ECS 实例将无法通过私网连接到  PostgreSQL 实例。
- 可调用 [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) 接口查询可用的私有网络。
 - 可调用 [CreateVpc](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70492) 接口创建新的私有网络。
VpcId.description_en:
Use this parameter to specify the private network for the instance.
- If you use ECS to connect to a PostgreSQL instance, make sure to use the same private network as your ECS instance. Otherwise, the ECS instance cannot connect to the PostgreSQL instance via the private network.
- Call the [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) API to view available private networks.
- Call the [CreateVpc](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70492) API to create a new private network.

AccountName.description_cn: 数据库账号名称。
AccountName.description_en: Database Account Name

TemplateDesc.description_cn: 模板的描述信息，便于后续模板的应用与管理。最多支持 200 个字符。
TemplateDesc.description_en: Template description helps with future use and management. Supports up to 200 characters.
TemplateDesc.example_cn: 这是一段参数模板的描述信息。
TemplateDesc.example_en: This is a description for the parameter template.

TemplateName.description_cn:
新参数模板的名称。模板名称应满足以下规则：

- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）。

- 长度为 2~64 个字符。

- 不能以数字或中划线（-）开头。
TemplateName.description_en:
Name for the new parameter template
Template name must follow these rules:

- Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-) are allowed
- Length must be between 2 and 64 characters
- Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
TemplateName.example_cn: 从实例导出的参数模板

AllowListDesc.description_cn: 白名单的描述信息。长度在 200 字符以内。默认值为空字符串。
AllowListDesc.description_en: Whitelist description. Maximum 200 characters. Default value is an empty string.
AllowListDesc.example_cn: 这是一段合并生成白名单的描述信息。
AllowListDesc.example_en: This is a description about merging and generating the whitelist

AllowListName.description_cn:
合并生成的白名单的名称。命名规则如下：

- 在当前地域内，白名单名称唯一。
- 以中文、字母或下划线（_）开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）。
- 长度为 1~128 个字符。
AllowListName.description_en:
Name of the merged whitelist. Naming rules:

- Whitelist names must be unique within the current region
- Must start with a Chinese character, letter, or underscore (_)
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
- Length must be 1 to 128 characters

InstanceIds.description_cn:
需合并生成白名单的实例 的 ID。

最多支持对 300 个实例的白名单进行合并生成。
InstanceIds.description_en:
IDs of instances whose whitelists will be merged/generated

You can merge or generate whitelists for up to 300 instances

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感且不超过 127 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate submissions. The client generates this parameter value. It must be unique for each request, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

InstanceIds.description_cn:
需要绑定标签的实例 ID。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
* 支持一次传入多个实例 ID，多个 ID 间用英文逗号（,）分隔。最多同时传入 20 个实例 ID。
InstanceIds.description_en:
Instance IDs that need to be bound to tags
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including instance IDs
* You can provide multiple instance IDs at once, separated by commas (,). Up to 20 instance IDs can be provided at the same time

Tags.description_cn: 需要绑定的标签键和标签值数组对象。
Tags.description_en: Array object of tag keys and tag values that need to be bound

AllowListIds.description_cn:
需要绑定实例的白名单 ID。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/108835) 接口查询指定地域下所有的白名单列表信息，包括白名单 ID。
* 支持一次传入多个白名单 ID，多个 ID 间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
* 不支持同时传入多个实例 ID 和白名单，即仅允许一次将多个实例同时绑定到同一个白名单，或将一个实例同时绑定到多个白名单。
AllowListIds.description_en:
Whitelist ID that needs to be bound to the instance
* You can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/108835) API to view all whitelists in a specified region, including whitelist IDs
* You can enter multiple whitelist IDs at once, separated by commas (,)
* You cannot enter multiple instance IDs and multiple whitelist IDs at the same time. You can either bind multiple instances to a single whitelist, or bind one instance to multiple whitelists in a single operation

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感且不超过 127 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate request submissions. The client generates this parameter value; it must be unique across requests, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

InstanceIds.description_cn:
需要绑定白名单的实例 ID。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
* 支持一次传入多个实例 ID，多个 ID 间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
* 不支持同时传入多个实例 ID 和白名单，即仅允许一次将多个实例同时绑定到同一个白名单，或将一个实例同时绑定到多个白名单。
InstanceIds.description_en:
Instance IDs to be bound to the whitelist
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including instance IDs.
* You can enter multiple instance IDs at once, separated by commas (,).
* You cannot enter multiple instance IDs and multiple whitelists at the same time. You can either bind multiple instances to the same whitelist at once, or bind one instance to multiple whitelists at once.

AllowList.description_cn:
输入 IP 地址或 CIDR 格式的地址段。
* `AllowList` 和 `SecurityGroupBindInfos` 参数不可同时为空。
* 不允许设置重复的地址，多个地址间用英文逗号（,）隔开。
* 设置 `0.0.0.0/0`，表示允许所有地址访问；设置 `127.0.0.1`，表示禁止所有地址访问；同时设置 `0.0.0.0/0`和`127.0.0.1`，表示允许所有地址访问。
* 设置 CIDR `192.168.1.0/24`，表示允许该网段内的 IP 地址访问；设置 `192.168.1.1`，表示仅允许该 IP 地址访问。
AllowList.description_en:
Enter an IP address or a CIDR block
* The `AllowList` and `SecurityGroupBindInfos` parameters cannot both be empty
* Duplicate addresses are not allowed; separate multiple addresses with an English comma (,)
* Setting `0.0.0.0/0` allows access from all addresses; setting `127.0.0.1` blocks access from all addresses; setting both `0.0.0.0/0` and `127.0.0.1` allows access from all addresses
* Setting the CIDR `192.168.1.0/24` allows access from IP addresses within that block; setting `192.168.1.1` allows access only from that IP address

AllowListCategory.description_cn:
白名单的类型。取值范围如下：

* `Ordinary`（默认值）：普通白名单。
* `Default`：默认白名单。

每个火山引擎账号在每个地域最多可设定一个默认白名单。新设置的默认白名单会自动顶替原有默认白名单，即原有默认白名单会自动变为非默认白名单。更多详情，请参见[约束与限制](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71560#%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD%E7%89%B9%E6%80%A7%E9%99%90%E5%88%B6)。
AllowListCategory.description_en:
Whitelist type. Available values:

* `Ordinary` (default): Ordinary whitelist
* `Default`: Default whitelist

Each Volcano Engine account can set at most one default whitelist per region. When you set a new default whitelist, it automatically replaces the previous one, which then becomes a non-default whitelist. For more details, see [Constraints and limitations](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71560#%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD%E7%89%B9%E6%80%A7%E9%99%90%E5%88%B6).

AllowListDesc.description_cn:

Set the database version for the green instance.
The database version of the green instance must be greater than that of the blue instance. For example, if the blue instance uses version 5.0, the green instance can use version 6.0 or 7.0.

TargetInstanceName.description_cn:
设置目标实例（即绿色实例）的名称。名称需同时满足如下要求：

* 不能以数字、中划线（-）开头。
* 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）。
* 长度需为 1~128 个字符。

* 若不设置绿色实例的名称，则默认以`<蓝色实例名称>-green-<六位随机码>`作为绿色实例的实例名称。
   例如，蓝色实例名称为 `redistest`，那么为该实例创建绿色实例时，绿色实例的默认名称可能为 `redistest-green-b4bf10`。
* 缓存数据库 Redis 版实例名称的长度不能超过 128 个字符，而 `-green-<六位随机码>` 会占用固定的 13 个字符。因此，绿色实例名称中 `<蓝色实例名称>`部分最多只保留蓝色名称的前 115 个字符来适配总长度限制。
TargetInstanceName.description_en:
Set the name of the target instance (i.e., the green instance). The name must meet the following requirements:

* Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
* Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
* Length must be 1–128 characters

* If you do not set a name for the green instance, the default name will be `<blue instance name>-green-<six-digit random code>`.
   For example, if the blue instance name is `redistest`, then when creating a green instance for this instance, the default name may be `redistest-green-b4bf10`.
* The instance name for Redis cache database cannot exceed 128 characters, and `-green-<six-digit random code>` will occupy a fixed 13 characters. Therefore, the `<blue instance name>` part in the green instance name can retain up to the first 115 characters of the blue name to fit the total length limit.

RoleName.description_cn:
账号所属角色。支持如下默认角色：

* `Administrator`：允许对所有 Key 使用所有 Redis 实例已支持的命令。
* `ReadWrite`：允许对所有 Key 使用除 `admin` 类之外的所有命令。
* `ReadOnly`：允许对所有 Key 使用 `read` 类中的所有命令。
* `NotDangerous`：允许对所有 Key 使用除 `dangerous` 类之外的所有命令。
* `NotWrite`：允许对所有 KEY 使用除 `write` 类之外的所有命令。

* 关于各角色对应 ACL 规则支持的具体命令详情，请参见 [ACL 语法](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/166234#acl-%E8%AF%AD%E6%B3%95)。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceAclCategories](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1347919) 接口查询目标 Redis 实例支持的命令类别，以及调用[DescribeDBInstanceAclCommands](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1347918) 接口查询指定命令类别下支持的命令详情。
RoleName.description_en:
Account roles. The following default roles are supported:

* `Administrator`: Allows all supported commands on all Keys in the Redis instance
* `ReadWrite`: Allows all commands except those in the `admin` category on all Keys
* `ReadOnly`: Allows all commands in the `read` category on all Keys
* `NotDangerous`: Allows all commands except those in the `dangerous` category on all Keys
* `NotWrite`: Allows all commands except those in the `write` category on all Keys

* For details on the specific commands supported by each role's ACL rules, see [ACL Syntax](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/166234#acl-%E8%AF%AD%E6%B3%95).
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceAclCategories](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1347919) API to query the command categories supported by the target Redis instance, and call the [DescribeDBInstanceAclCommands](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1347918) API to query the details of commands supported under a specified command category.

* Each instance supports binding up to 1000 IP addresses or IP address ranges in CIDR format.

* For more details about availability zone deployment schemes, see [Multi-AZ Disaster Recovery Solution](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70863).

NoAuthMode.description_en:

* Parameter values are case-insensitive.
* After the instance is created, you can also call the [ModifyDBInstanceVpcAuthMode](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/99795) API to enable or disable passwordless access. For more information, see [Passwordless Access](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/94328).

NodeNumber.description_cn:
每个分片中的节点数。取值范围为 1~6。
* 每个账号在每个地域下默认最多可创建 4 个 256 MiB 规格（即 `ShardCapacity` 取值为 `256`）的节点，若您需要调整 256 MiB 规格节点的购买配额 （上限为 10 个），请参见[账号配额](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71560#%E8%B4%A6%E5%8F%B7%E9%85%8D%E9%A2%9D)。
* 取值为`1`时，表示创建单节点实例；取值大于`1`时，表示创建主备实例。单节点实例和主备实例支持的功能特性不同，关于两种类型实例的功能特性差异详情，请参见[功能特性差异](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/97275#%E4%B8%BB%E5%A4%87%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B%E5%92%8C%E5%8D%95%E8%8A%82%E7%82%B9%E7%B1%BB%E5%9E%8B%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B%E6%94%AF%E6%8C%81%E7%9A%84%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD%E7%89%B9%E6%80%A7%E6%9C%89%E4%BD%95%E5%B7%AE%E5%88%AB%EF%BC%9F)。
NodeNumber.description_en:
Number of nodes per shard. Value range: 1–6
* By default, each account can create up to 4 nodes of the 256 MiB specification (that is, `ShardCapacity` set to `256`) in each region. To adjust the purchase quota for 256 MiB nodes (maximum 10), see [Account Quota](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71560#%E8%B4%A6%E5%8F%B7%E9%85%8D%E9%A2%9D)
* When the value is `1`, a single-node instance is created; when greater than `1`, a master-replica instance is created. Single-node and master-replica instances support different features. For details on the differences, see [Feature Differences](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/97275#%E4%B8%BB%E5%A4%87%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B%E5%92%8C%E5%8D%95%E8%8A%82%E7%82%B9%E7%B1%BB%E5%9E%8B%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B%E6%94%AF%E6%8C%81%E7%9A%84%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD%E7%89%B9%E6%80%A7%E6%9C%89%E4%BD%95%E5%B7%AE%E5%88%AB%EF%BC%9F)

ParameterGroupId.description_cn:
需要应用到新实例的参数模板。
* 缓存数据库 Redis 版为每个数据库版本都创建了一份默认的系统参数模板，模板中包含了该版本支持设置的所有参数和默认参数值。若该参数留空，默认会根据您设置的数据库版本 （即 `EngineVersion`），以及实例类型是否为单节点（即 `NodeNumber` 是否为 `1`）为新建实例选择并应用对应版本的系统参数模板。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeParameterGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1415106) 接口查询当前账号和地域下的所有参数模板的基本信息，包括参数模板 ID。
ParameterGroupId.description_en:
Parameter template to be applied to the new instance.
* Redis provides a default system parameter template for each database version, which includes all configurable parameters and their default values for that version. If this parameter is left blank, the system will select and apply the corresponding version's system parameter template based on your specified database version (`EngineVersion`) and whether the instance is single-node (`NodeNumber` is `1`).
* You can call the [DescribeParameterGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1415106) API to query basic information about all parameter templates under your account and region, including parameter template IDs.

Password.description_cn:
设置默认数据库 default 账号的密码。设置的密码需同时满足如下要求：

* 长度为 8~64 个字符。
* 至少包含大写字母、小写字母、数字或特殊字符中的任意 2 种。
* 支持如下特殊字符：

```Plain Text
()`~!@#$%^&*-+=_|{}[];<>,.?
```

* 若该参数留空，表示不为 default 账号设置密码，此时系统会自动为 default 账号生成一个密码来保证实例访问安全性。任何账号都无法获取该随机密码，因此在连接实例前，您需通过 [ModifyDBAccount](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71733) 接口重置 default 账号的密码。
* 您还可以根据业务需要，通过 [CreateDBAccount](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/69656) 接口设置新的账号和密码。
* 若需使用免密访问功能，您需要先通过 [ModifyDBInstanceVpcAuthMode](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/99795) 接口开启免密访问。
Password.description_en:
Set the password for the default database account. The password must meet the following requirements:

* Length: 8–64 characters
* Must include at least two of the following: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, or special characters
* Supports the following special characters:

```Plain Text
()`~!@#$%^&*-+=_|{}[];<>,.?
```

* If this parameter is left blank, no password will be set for the default account. In this case, the system will automatically generate a password for the default account to ensure instance security. No account can retrieve this random password, so you must reset the default account password via the [ModifyDBAccount](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71733) API before connecting to the instance.
* You can also set a new account and password as needed via the [CreateDBAccount](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/69656) API.
* To use passwordless access, you must first enable passwordless access via the [ModifyDBInstanceVpcAuthMode](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/99795) API.

PointBasicTosPrefix.description_cn: 备份点的basic tos prefix,批量创建实例时，用于实例context设置
PointBasicTosPrefix.description_en: The basic tos prefix of the backup point is used to set the instance context during batch instance creation

Port.description_cn:
自定义私网连接地址的端口号，取值范围：1024~65535。
* 若该参数留空，私网连接地址默认使用 6379 端口。
* 实例创建成功后，您还可以修改私网地址的端口号。端口号修改方法，请参见[修改端口号](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/81348)。
Port.description_en:
Customize the port number for the private network connection address. Value range: 1024~65535.
* If this parameter is left blank, the private network connection address uses port 6379 by default.
* After the instance is created, you can also modify the port number of the private network address. For instructions, see [Modify Port Number](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/81348).

ProjectName.description_cn:
选择实例所属的项目。若该参数留空，新建实例会加入默认（即`default`）项目。
项目是一个虚拟的概念，包括一组资源、用户和角色。通过项目可以对一组资源进行统一的查看和管理，并且控制项目内用户和角色对这些资源的权限。更多详情，请参见[资源管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/94333)。
ProjectName.description_en:
Select the project to which the instance belongs. If this parameter is left blank, the new instance will be added to the default (i.e., `default`) project.
A project is a virtual concept that includes a group of resources, users, and roles. Projects allow unified viewing and management of resources, and control the permissions of users and roles within the project for those resources. For more details, see [Resource Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/94333).

PublicZoneConsulVisit.description_cn: 是否启用通过公共服务区功能

PublicZoneVisit.description_cn: 是否开启公共服务区访问

PurchaseMonths.description_cn:
购买时长，单位：月。取值范围如下：

* 按月购买：`1`，`2`，`3`，`4`，`5`，`6`，`7`，`8`，`9`。
* 按年购买：`12`，`24`，`36`。

当`ChargeType`为`PrePaid`时，该参数必填。
PurchaseMonths.description_en:
Purchase duration, in months. Value options:

* Monthly purchase: `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5`, `6`, `7`, `8`, `9`
* Annual purchase: `12`, `24`, `36`

When `ChargeType` is `PrePaid`, this parameter is required.

RegionId.description_cn:
地域 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeRegions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65752) 接口查询 Redis 实例支持的所有地域信息，包括地域 ID。
RegionId.description_en:
Region ID.
You can call the [DescribeRegions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65752) API to query all region information supported by Redis instances, including region IDs.

RestoreInfoGetFromDataBase.description_cn: 标记恢复实例数据的备份点是否需要从数据库中获取,批量创建实例时，用于实例context设置
RestoreInfoGetFromDataBase.description_en: Indicates whether to retrieve the backup point for restoring instance data from the database; used for setting instance context during batch creation

SealZoneVisit.description_en: Do you want to enable sales area access?

ShardCapacity.description_cn:
每个分片的内存容量，单位：MiB。取值范围如下：

* 未启用分片集群（即 `ShardedCluster` 取值为 `0`）时，每分片内存容量可选取值为：256，512，1024，2048，4096，8192，16384，32768，24576，65536。
* 启用分片集群（即 `ShardedCluster` 取值为 `1`）时，每分片内存容量可选取值为：1024，2048，4096，8192，16384。

* 当创建单节点实例（即 `NodeNumber` 取值为 `1`）时，不支持选择 256 MiB 规格的内存容量。
* 关于 Redis 产品规格的更多详情，请参见[产品规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72111)。
ShardCapacity.description_en:
Memory capacity per shard, in MiB. Value options:

* When sharded cluster is not enabled (`ShardedCluster` set to `0`), available values per shard: 256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384, 32768, 24576, 65536
* When sharded cluster is enabled (`ShardedCluster` set to `1`), available values per shard: 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384

* When creating a single-node instance (`NodeNumber` set to `1`), 256 MiB memory capacity is not supported
* For more details on Redis product specifications, see [Product Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72111)

ShardNumber.description_cn:
实例中的分片数量。取值范围为 2~256。
仅当 `ShardedCluster` 取值为 `1`（即启用分片集群）时，需要指定该参数。
ShardNumber.description_en:
Number of shards in the instance. Value range: 2–256.
This parameter is required only when `ShardedCluster` is set to `1` (enabled).

ShardedCluster.description_cn:
是否启用分片集群。取值范围如下：

* `0`：不启用。
* `1`：启用。

关于缓存数据库 Redis 版的产品架构更多信息，请参见[产品架构](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72062)。
ShardedCluster.description_en:
Whether to enable sharded cluster. Value range:

* `0`: Disabled
* `1`: Enabled

For more information about the product architecture of Redis, see [Product Architecture](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72062).

StorageInnerVisit.description_cn: 是否存储内网访问访问

SubnetId.description_cn:
设置实例的子网 ID。
* 子网具有可用区属性，必须选择目标私有网络中与实例属于同一可用区下的子网。
* 子网是私有网络内的 IP 地址块私有网络中的所有云资源都必须部署在子网内，子网为云资源分配私网 IP 地址，您可以调用 [CreateSubnet](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70496) 接口创建子网。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) 接口查询指定可用区内的所有子网列表信息，包括子网 ID。
SubnetId.description_en:
Set the subnet ID for the instance.
* Subnets have availability zone attributes. You must select a subnet in the target VPC that is in the same availability zone as the instance.
* A subnet is an IP address block within a VPC. All cloud resources in the VPC must be deployed within a subnet. Subnets assign private IP addresses to cloud resources. You can call the [CreateSubnet](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70496) API to create a subnet.
* You can call the [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) API to query all subnet list information in a specified availability zone, including subnet IDs.

Tags.description_cn:
需要绑定的标签键和标签值数组对象。
若该参数留空，新建实例默认不绑定任何标签。
Tags.description_en:
Array of tag keys and tag values to bind.
If this parameter is left empty, the new instance will not bind any tags by default.

VpcId.description_cn:
设置实例的私有网络 ID。
* 建议 Redis 实例与需要连接的 ECS 实例在同一私有网络，否则它们无法通过内网互通来实现最佳性能。您可以调用 [CreateVpc](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70492) 接口创建私有网络。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) 接口查询符合指定条件的私有网络信息，包括私有网络 ID。
VpcId.description_en:
Set the instance's VPC ID.
* It is recommended that the Redis instance and the ECS instance to be connected are in the same VPC; otherwise, they cannot communicate over the internal network for optimal performance. You can create a VPC using the [CreateVpc](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70492) API.
* You can query VPC information that meets specified criteria, including VPC ID, using the [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) API.

AllowListIds.description_cn:
白名单 ID 列表。新建实例会被绑定到指定白名单。
您可以调用 [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1393071) 接口查询当前账号下指定地域内的所有 IP 白名单信息，包括白名单 ID 信息。关于企业版白名单的更多信息，请参见[创建白名单](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1255848)。
AllowListIds.description_en:
Whitelist ID list. The system binds newly created instances to the specified whitelist.
You can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1393071) API to query all IP whitelist information, including whitelist IDs, for the specified region under your account. For more details about enterprise edition whitelists, see [Create Whitelist](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1255848).

AutoRenew.description_cn:
是否开启自动续费。取值范围如下： 

* `true`：开启。 
* `false`（默认值）：不开启。

仅当 `ChargeType` 为 `PrePaid` 时，该参数生效。
AutoRenew.description_en:
Enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

* `true`: Enable
* `false` (default): Disable

This parameter is effective only when `ChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`.

ChargeType.description_cn:
计费类型。取值范围如下： 

* `PostPaid`：按量计费。 
* `PrePaid`：包年包月。

关于计费类型的更多信息，请参见[计费类型](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1355136)。
ChargeType.description_en:
Billing type. Available options:

* `PostPaid`: Pay-as-you-go
* `PrePaid`: Subscription (annual/monthly)

For more information about billing types, see [Billing types](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1355136).

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感且不超过 127 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate submissions. The client generates this parameter value. It must be unique for each request, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

ConfigureNodes.description_cn: 节点所属的可用区列表。
ConfigureNodes.description_en: List of availability zones for the node

DataLayout.description_cn:
指定新建实例的数据存储形态，取值范围如下： 

* `RAM`：内存型。 
* `Hybrid`：混存型。 

关于企业版实例数据存储形态的更多信息，请参见[数据存储形态](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1258077#%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E5%AD%98%E5%82%A8%E5%BD%A2%E6%80%81)。
DataLayout.description_en:
Specify the data storage type for the new instance. Available options:

* `RAM`: Memory type
* `Hybrid`: Hybrid type

For more information about data storage types for enterprise edition instances, see [Data Storage Types](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1258077#%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E5%AD%98%E5%82%A8%E5%BD%A2%E6%80%81).

DeletionProtection.description_cn:
开启或关闭实例删除保护功能。取值范围如下： 

* `disabled`（默认值）：关闭。 
* `enabled`：开启。

若该参数不填，默认关闭实例删除保护功能。关于实例删除保护的更多信息，请参见[实例删除保护](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1255845)。
DeletionProtection.description_en:
Enable or disable instance deletion protection. Valid values:

* `disabled` (default): Disabled
* `enabled`: Enabled

If this parameter is not specified, instance deletion protection is disabled by default. For more information, see [Instance Deletion Protection](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1255845).

FlashPerShard.description_cn:
设置单分片的高速存储容量，单位：MiB。 
取值范围：10240~30720（即 10GiB~30GiB），步长为 10240MiB，（即 10GiB）。
仅当实例的数据存储形态为混存型（即 `DataLayout` 为 `Hybrid`）时，该参数生效。
FlashPerShard.description_en:
Set the high-speed storage capacity for a single shard in MiB.
Range: 10240–30720 (10GiB–30GiB), increment: 10240MiB (10GiB).
This parameter is only effective when the instance data storage type is hybrid (i.e., `DataLayout` is set to `Hybrid`).

Initiator.description_cn: 请求发起者，为空表示SDK发起，"WEB"表示前端页面调用
Initiator.description_en: Leave blank to indicate the request is initiated by the SDK. Enter 'WEB' to indicate the request is initiated by the frontend page.

InstanceName.description_cn:
实例名称。名称需同时满足如下要求： 

* 不能以数字、中划线（-）开头。 
* 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）。 
* 长度需要在 1~128 个字符内。

若该参数留空，默认将实例 ID 作为实例名称。
InstanceName.description_en:
Instance name
The name must meet all of the following requirements:

* Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
* Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
* Must be 1–128 characters long

If this parameter is left blank, the instance ID will be used as the instance name by default

MaintenanceTime.description_cn: 实例的可维护时间段, xx:00-yy:00，最小2小时
MaintenanceTime.description_en: Instance maintenance window, xx:00-yy:00, minimum 2 hours

Modules.description_cn:
设置需要加载的模块。支持的模块类型如下： 

* `RedisJSON`
* `RedisBloom`
* `RediSearch`
* `RedisTimeSeries`

* 仅当创建数据存储类型为内存型实例（即 `DataLayout` 为 `RAM`）时，支持使用 `RediSearch` 和 `RedisTimeSeries` 模块。
* 若该参数留空，默认不会加载任何模块。更多关于 Redis 模块的详情，请参见[数据模块](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1258077#%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E6%A8%A1%E5%9D%97)。
Modules.description_en:
Set the modules to load. Supported module types:

* `RedisJSON`
* `RedisBloom`
* `RediSearch`
* `RedisTimeSeries`

* `RediSearch` and `RedisTimeSeries` modules are only available when the data store type is an in-memory instance (that is, when `DataLayout` is set to `RAM`).
* If this parameter is left blank, no modules will be loaded by default. For more details about Redis modules, see [Data Modules](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1258077#%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E6%A8%A1%E5%9D%97).

MultiAZ.description_cn:
设置实例的可用区部署方案。取值范围如下： 

* `disabled`（默认值）：单可用区部署方案。 
* `enabled`：多可用区部署方案。

关于可用区部署方案的更多说明，请参见[多可用区同城容灾解决方案](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1285437)。
MultiAZ.description_en:
Set the instance's availability zone deployment scheme. Valid values:

* `disabled` (default): Single availability zone deployment
* `enabled`: Multi-availability zone deployment

For more details about availability zone deployment schemes, see [Multi-availability zone same-city disaster recovery solution](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1285437).

NeedRecoverPoint.description_cn: 是否需要恢复数据,是否需要做种数据
NeedRecoverPoint.description_en: Do we need to restore data? Do we need to seed data?

Password.description_cn:
设置默认数据库 default 账号的密码。密码需同时满足如下要求： 

* 长度为 8~32 个字符。 
* 至少包含大写字母、小写字母、数字或特殊字符中的任意 2 种。 
* 支持如下特殊字符：
   ```Plain Text
   ()`~!@#$%^&*-+=_|{}[];<>,.?
   ```


* 若该参数留空，表示不为 default 账号设置密码，此时系统会自动为 default 账号生成一个密码来保证实例访问安全性。任何账号都无法获取该随机密码，因此在连接实例前，您需先[重置](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1255833) default 账号的密码。
* 您也可以在实例创建后，根据业务需要创建新的账号和密码，具体操作步骤，请参见[创建与管理账号](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1262348)。
Password.description_en:
Set the password for the default database account. The password must meet all of the following requirements:

* Length must be 8–32 characters
* Must include at least two of the following: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, or special characters
* The following special characters are supported:
   ```Plain Text
   ()`~!@#$%^&*-+=_|{}[];<>,.?
   ```

* If you leave this field blank, no password will be set for the default account. The system will automatically generate a password to secure instance access. No account can retrieve this random password, so you must [reset](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1255833) the default account password before connecting to the instance.
* After the instance is created, you can also create new accounts and passwords as needed. For detailed steps, see [Create and manage accounts](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1262348).

Port.description_cn: 实例的私网连接端口号，默认6379
Port.description_en: Instance's private network port number (default: 6379)

ProjectName.description_cn:
选择实例所属的项目。若该参数留空，新建实例会加入默认（即 `default` ）项目。
项目是一个虚拟的概念，包括一组资源、用户和角色。通过项目可以对一组资源进行统一的查看和管理，并且控制项目内用户和角色对这些资源的权限。更多详情，请参见[资源管理](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/94333)。
ProjectName.description_en:
Select the project for the instance. If left blank, the new instance will be added to the default (`default`) project.
A project is a virtual concept that includes a group of resources, users, and roles. Projects let you view and manage resources together, and control user and role permissions within the project. For more details, see [Resource Management](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6649/94333).

PurchaseMonths.description_cn:
购买时长，单位：月。取值范围如下： 

* 按月购买：`1`，`2`，`3`，`4`，`5`，`6`，`7`，`8`，`9`。 
* 按年购买：`12`，`24`，`36`。

当 `ChargeType` 为 `PrePaid` 时，该参数必填。
PurchaseMonths.description_en:
Purchase duration, in months. Valid values:

* Monthly: `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5`, `6`, `7`, `8`, `9`
* Yearly: `12`, `24`, `36`

This parameter is required when `ChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`

RamPerShard.description_cn:
设置单分片的 RAM 容量，单位：MiB。 
当前单分片 RAM 容量仅支持 8192MiB（即 8GiB ）。
RamPerShard.description_en:
Set RAM capacity per shard (MiB)
Currently, only 8192 MiB (8 GiB) is supported for each shard

RegionId.description_cn:
地域 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeRegions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/71730) 接口查询 Redis 实例支持的所有地域信息，包括地域 ID。
RegionId.description_en:
Region ID
You can call the [DescribeRegions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/71730) API to view all supported region information for Redis instances, including region IDs.

ShardNumber.description_cn: 实例中的分片数量。取值范围：1、2、4、8、16、32。
ShardNumber.description_en: Number of shards in the instance. Allowed values: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32

SubnetId.description_cn:
设置实例的子网 ID。
* 子网具有可用区属性，必须选择目标私有网络中与实例属于同一可用区下的子网。
* 子网是私有网络内的 IP 地址块私有网络中的所有云资源都必须部署在子网内，子网为云资源分配私网 IP 地址，您可以调用 [CreateSubnet](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70496) 接口创建子网。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) 接口查询指定可用区内的所有子网列表信息，包括子网 ID。
SubnetId.description_en:
Set the subnet ID for the instance.
* Subnets have an availability zone attribute. You must select a subnet in the target VPC that is in the same availability zone as the instance.
* A subnet is an IP address block within a VPC. All cloud resources in the VPC must be deployed in a subnet. Subnets assign private IP addresses to cloud resources. You can call the [CreateSubnet](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70496) API to create a subnet.
* You can call the [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) API to query the list of all subnets in a specified availability zone, including subnet IDs.

Tags.description_cn:
需要绑定的标签键和标签值数组对象。
若该参数留空，新建实例默认不绑定任何标签。
Tags.description_en:
An array object containing the tag keys and tag values to bind
If left empty, the new instance does not bind any tags by default

VpcId.description_cn:
设置实例的私有网络 ID。
* 建议 Redis 实例与需要连接的 ECS 实例在同一私有网络，否则它们无法通过内网互通来实现最佳性能。您可以调用 [CreateVpc](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70492) 接口创建私有网络。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) 接口查询符合指定条件的私有网络信息，包括私有网络 ID。
VpcId.description_en:
Set the private network ID for the instance.
* For best performance, we recommend placing the Redis instance and the ECS instance it connects to in the same private network. Otherwise, they cannot communicate over the internal network. You can use the [CreateVpc](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70492) API to create a private network.
* Use the [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) API to query private network information that meets your criteria, including the private network ID.

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information about all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

ScanKeyNumPerSecond.description_cn: 每秒扫描过期 key 数量。取值范围：2000~100000 内的整数。
ScanKeyNumPerSecond.description_en: Number of expired keys scanned per second. Enter an integer between 2000 and 100000

TimeoutMinutes.description_cn: 扫描超时时间。取值范围：30~1440 内的整数，单位：分钟。

Description.description_cn:

若不设置该参数，新建参数模板的备注信息默认为空。
Description.description_en:
The remark for the parameter template cannot exceed 200 characters.
If you do not set this parameter, the remark for the new parameter template will be empty by default.

EngineVersion.description_cn:

* `7.0`：Redis 7.0。
* `6.0`：Redis 6.0。
* `5.0`：Redis 5.0。
EngineVersion.description_en:
Redis database versions supported by the parameter template. Available options:

* `7.0`: Redis 7.0
* `6.0`: Redis 6.0
* `5.0`: Redis 5.0

Name.description_cn:
参数模板名称。名称需同时满足如下要求：

* 不能以数字、中划线（-）开头。
* 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）。
* 长度需为 2~64 个字符。
Name.description_en:
Parameter template name. The name must meet all of the following requirements:

* Cannot start with a digit or hyphen (-)
* Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
* Must be 2–64 characters long

ParamValues.description_cn:
新建参数模板中需要包含的参数信息列表。
* 每个参数模板中需至少存在一个参数。
* 更多关于 Redis 支持的参数详情，请参见[参数支持](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72120)。
ParamValues.description_en:
List of parameter information to include in new parameter templates.
* Each parameter template must include at least one parameter
* For more details about supported Redis parameters, please see [Parameter Support](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72120)

ApplyImmediately.description_cn:
是否立即执行配置变更操作。取值范围如下：

* `true`：立即变更。
* `false`：在可维护时间段内执行变更。

关于可维护时间段的更多信息，请参见[设置可维护时间段](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70848)。
ApplyImmediately.description_en:
Apply configuration changes immediately? Valid values:

* `true`: Apply changes immediately
* `false`: Apply changes during the maintenance window

For more information about the maintenance window, see [Set Maintenance Window](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70848).

BackupPointName.description_cn:
为变更前创建的全量备份设置备份名称。备份名称需同时满足如下条件:

* 以中文、字母、下划线（_）开头。
* 长度为 1-128 个字符。
* 由中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）组成。

* 仅当选择了需要在变更前创建备份（即`CreateBackup`为`true`）时，该参数生效。
* 若不设置备份名称，默认使用备份 ID 作为名称。
BackupPointName.description_en:
Set a backup name for the full backup created before the change. The backup name must meet all of the following requirements:

* Starts with a Chinese character, letter, or underscore (_)
* Length is 1–128 characters
* Can include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)

* This parameter is only effective if you choose to create a backup before the change (that is, if `CreateBackup` is set to `true`).
* If you do not set a backup name, the backup ID will be used as the name by default.

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感且不超过 127 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate submissions. The client generates this parameter value, which must be unique across different requests, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

CreateBackup.description_cn: * 是否在变更前创建全量备份。取值范围如下：`true`：创建备份。`false`（默认值）：不创建。
CreateBackup.description_en: * Whether to create a full backup before making changes Value range: `true`: create backup; `false` (default): do not create backup

NodesNumberToDecrease.description_cn:
设置单分片中需要减少的节点数。
每个分片支持 2~6 个节点，即 2 <= （当前节点数 - 减少节点数） <= 6。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) 接口查询指定实例的详情信息，包括每个分片中当前节点数。
* 每个账号在每个地域下默认最多可创建 4 个 256MiB 规格的节点，若您需要调整 256MiB 规格节点的购买配额 （上限为 10 个），请参见[约束与使用限制](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71560#%E8%B4%A6%E5%8F%B7%E9%85%8D%E9%A2%9D)。
NodesNumberToDecrease.description_en:
Set the number of nodes to remove from a single shard
Each shard supports 2 to 6 nodes. After reducing nodes, the total must satisfy: 2 <= (current node count - nodes to remove) <= 6
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) API to query details for a specific instance, including the current node count in each shard
* By default, each account can create up to 4 nodes of the 256MiB specification per region. To adjust the purchase quota for 256MiB nodes (maximum 10), see [Constraints and usage limits](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71560#%E8%B4%A6%E5%8F%B7%E9%85%8D%E9%A2%9D)

BackupPointName.description_cn:
为待删除实例的最终备份设置备份名称。若不设置备份名称，默认使用备份 ID 作为名称。
如需设置备份名称，名称需同时满足如下条件:

* 以中文、字母、下划线（_）开头。
* 长度为 1-128 个字符。
* 由中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）组成。

* 该参数仅对**按量计费**的**主备实例**生效，即实例的 `InstanceClass` 为 `PrimarySecondary` 且 `ChargeType` 为 `PostPaid`。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) 接口查询指定实例的详情信息，包括实例类型和计费类型。
BackupPointName.description_en:
Set a backup name for the final backup of the instance to be deleted. If you do not specify a backup name, the backup ID will be used by default.

To set a backup name, make sure the name meets all of the following requirements:

* Starts with a Chinese character, letter, or underscore (_)
* Contains 1–128 characters
* Consists of Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)

* This parameter applies only to **pay-as-you-go** **primary-secondary instances**, where `InstanceClass` is `PrimarySecondary` and `ChargeType` is `PostPaid`.
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) API to view details of a specific instance, including instance type and billing type.

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感且不超过 127 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate submissions. The client must generate this parameter value, which must be unique for each request, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

CreateBackup.description_cn:
删除实例时是否创建一个最终备份。取值范围如下：

* `true`（默认值）：创建。
* `false`：不创建。

* 该参数仅对主备节点实例生效。单节点实例不支持持久性和备份功能，删除单节点实例时默认不会创建任何备份，删除后所有数据将被彻底清除且不可再恢复，请谨慎操作。关于单节点实例的更多详情，请参见[产品架构](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72062#%E4%BA%A7%E5%93%81%E6%9E%B6%E6%9E%84)。
* 若该参数留空，删除主备实例时默认会创建一个最终备份来保存删除前的所有数据，您可以在实例删除后，调用 [DescribeBackups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65766) 接口查看该实例的所有备份集（包括已删除实例的备份集）信息。
CreateBackup.description_en:
Create a final backup when deleting an instance. Possible values:

* `true` (default): Create a backup
* `false`: Do not create a backup

* This parameter applies only to master-replica node instances. Single-node instances do not support persistence or backup. When you delete a single-node instance, no backup is created by default. All data will be permanently deleted and cannot be recovered. Please proceed with caution. For more details about single-node instances, see [Product Architecture](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72062#%E4%BA%A7%E5%93%81%E6%9E%B6%E6%9E%84).
* If you leave this parameter empty, a final backup will be created by default when deleting a master-replica instance to save all data before deletion. After the instance is deleted, you can call the [DescribeBackups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65766) API to view all backup sets for the instance, including backups of deleted instances.

为待删除实例的最终备份设置备份名称。如需设置备份名称，名称需同时满足如下条件:

* 以中文、字母、下划线（_）开头。
* 长度为 1-128 个字符。
* 由中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）组成。

* 该参数仅当**按量计费**实例选择了在删除实例前创建全量备份（即 `CreateBackup` 为 `true` ）时生效；包年包月实例删除前创建的最终备份名称即为备份 ID。
* 若不设置备份名称，默认使用备份 ID 作为名称。
BackupPointName.description_en:
Set a backup name for the final backup of the instance to be deleted. If you want to set a backup name, make sure it meets all of the following requirements:

* Starts with a Chinese character, letter, or underscore (_)
* Length is 1–128 characters
* Can include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)

* This parameter is only effective for pay-as-you-go instances when you choose to create a full backup before deleting the instance (that is, when `CreateBackup` is set to `true`). For subscription instances, the final backup name created before deletion is the backup ID.
* If you do not set a backup name, the backup ID will be used as the default name.

ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate submissions. The client generates this parameter value, which must be unique across requests, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

CreateBackup.description_cn:
是否在删除实例前创建全量备份。取值范围如下：

* `true`（默认值）：创建备份。
* `false`：不创建。

* 该参数仅对**按量计费**（即  `ChargeType` 为 `PostPaid`）的实例生效；包年包月（即  `ChargeType` 为 `PrePaid`）实例删除前必须创建一个最终备份，不支持设置该参数。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeEnterpriseDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1168033) 接口查询指定实例的详情信息，包括实例类型和计费类型。
