* `true` (default): Create a backup
* `false`: Do not create

* This parameter applies only to **Pay-As-You-Go** instances (where `ChargeType` is `PostPaid`). For Subscription instances (where `ChargeType` is `PrePaid`), a final backup must be created before deletion and this parameter cannot be set.
* You can call the [DescribeEnterpriseDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1168033) API to query details of a specified instance, including instance type and billing type.

Initiator.description_cn: 请求发起者，内部发起时必填

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1254216) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1254216) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

ParameterGroupId.description_cn:
参数模板 ID。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeParameterGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1415106) 接口查询当前账号和地域下所有的参数模板基本信息，包括参数模板 ID。
* 仅自定义参数模板（即 `Source` 取值为 `User`）支持删除，系统参数模板（即 `Source` 取值为 `System`）不可删除。
* 模板删除后无法恢复，建议谨慎操作。更多详情，请参见[删除参数模板](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1131869)。
ParameterGroupId.description_en:
Parameter template ID.
* You can call the [DescribeParameterGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1415106) API to query basic information for all parameter templates under your account and region, including the parameter template ID.
* Only custom parameter templates (where `Source` is `User`) can be deleted; system parameter templates (where `Source` is `System`) cannot be deleted.
* Deleted templates cannot be restored. It is recommended to proceed with caution. For more details, see [Delete Parameter Template](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1131869).

AllowListId.description_cn:
白名单 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/108835) 接口查询当前账号下在指定地域内的所有白名单列表信息，包括白名单 ID。
AllowListId.description_en:
Allowlist ID
You can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/108835) API to view all allowlists for your account in the specified region, including allowlist IDs

ProjectName.description_en: ProjectName is used for Project authentication processing and filtering

IPAddress.description_cn:
根据 IP 地址筛选出满足条件的白名单。
使用 `IPAddress` 查询时，会精确匹配该 IP 地址以及包含该 IP 地址的 IP 地址段进行筛选。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用 IP 地址对查询结果进行筛选。
* 支持同时传入多个 IP 地址，最多同时传入 50 个 IP 地址。多个 IP 地址间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
IPAddress.description_en:
Filter the whitelist that meets the criteria by IP address.
When you query with `IPAddress`, the system matches the exact IP address and any IP address ranges that include it.
* Leave this parameter blank to disable IP address filtering
* You can enter up to 50 IP addresses at once, separated by English commas (,)

IPSegment.description_cn:
根据 IP 地址段筛选出满足条件的白名单。
使用 `IPSegment` 查询时，会精确匹配该 IP 地址段进行筛选。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用 IP 地址段对查询结果进行筛选。
* 支持同时传入多个 IP 地址段，最多同时传入 50 个 IP 地址段。多个 IP 地址段间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
IPSegment.description_en:
Filter the whitelist by IP address range
When you query with `IPSegment`, the filter precisely matches entries within the specified IP address range
* If you leave this parameter blank, the results are not filtered by IP address range
* You can enter up to 50 IP address ranges at once, separated by commas (,)

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用实例 ID 条件进行筛选。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information about all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.
* If you leave this parameter blank, the instance ID filter will not be applied.

ProjectName.description_cn:
白名单所属的项目名称。
若该参数留空，表示不使用白名单的项目名称条件进行筛选。
ProjectName.description_en:
Whitelist Project Name
Leave this field blank to skip filtering by whitelist project name

QueryDefault.description_cn:
根据白名单类型筛选是否仅查询默认白名单。取值范围如下：

* `true`：是，仅查询默认白名单。
* `false`：否，仅查询普通白名单。

若该参数留空，表示不使用白名单类型条件进行筛选，即会返回所有类型的白名单信息。
QueryDefault.description_en:
Filter by whitelist type to determine whether to query only the default whitelist. Valid values:

* `true`: Yes, query only the default whitelist
* `false`: No, query only the regular whitelist

If this parameter is left empty, whitelist type filtering is not applied and information for all whitelist types is returned

RegionId.description_cn:
地域 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeRegions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询 Redis 实例支持的所有地域信息，包括地域 ID。
RegionId.description_en:
Region ID
You can call the [DescribeRegions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query all region information supported by Redis instances, including region IDs

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。指定后可查询该实例可用于跨地域备份的地域。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID. After specifying, you can view the regions available for cross-region backup for this instance.
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to view basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

BackupType.description_cn:
恢复方式。取值范围如下：

* `Full`（默认值）：全量恢复，即按备份集恢复。
* `Inc`：增量恢复，即按时间点恢复。

* 若需要按时间点恢复（即 `BackupType` 为 `Inc`），需先开启数据闪回功能。更多详情，请参见[按时间点恢复到原实例](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/79880#%E6%81%A2%E5%A4%8D%E5%88%B0%E5%8E%9F%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B)。
* 您可以调用 [StartContinuousBackup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71803) 接口为指定实例开启数据闪回功能。
BackupType.description_en:
Recovery mode. Available options:

* `Full` (default): Full recovery, restores from the backup set
* `Inc`: Incremental recovery, restores to a specific point in time

* To restore to a specific point in time (`BackupType` set to `Inc`), you must enable the data flashback feature first. For details, see [Restore to original instance by point in time](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/79880#%E6%81%A2%E5%A4%8D%E5%88%B0%E5%8E%9F%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B).
* You can call the [StartContinuousBackup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71803) API to enable data flashback for a specified instance.

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to view basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID

BackupPointId.description_cn:
目标备份文件的备份 ID。
您可以调用  [DescribeBackups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65766) 接口查看指定实例的备份集信息列表，包括各备份文件的备份 ID 信息。
BackupPointId.description_en:
Backup ID of the target backup file
You can call the [DescribeBackups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65766) API to view the backup set information list for a specified instance, including the backup ID information for each backup file

InstanceBasicInfo.description_cn: 指定备份点的实例信息，backuppointinfo会返回该字段
InstanceBasicInfo.description_en: Instance information for the specified backup point; backuppointinfo returns this field

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID

PointPrefix.description_cn: 备份点基础路径，backuppointinfo会返回该字段，可能为空
PointPrefix.description_en: Backup point base path; backuppointinfo returns this field, which may be empty

PointStartTime.description_cn: 指定备份点的channeldate，用于openapi的新增参数，与BasicChannelDate的作用和赋值是一致的
PointStartTime.description_en: Specifies the channeldate of the backup point. It is used as a new parameter in openapi, with the same function and assignment as BasicChannelDate.

BackupPointId.description_cn:
备份文件的备份 ID。支持模糊查询。
* 仅当查询范围为当前账号（即 `Scope` 取值为 `AccountInstances`）时，该参数生效。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用备份 ID 筛选。
BackupPointId.description_en:
Backup file backup ID. Fuzzy search supported.
* This parameter is valid only when the query scope is the current account (`Scope` is set to `AccountInstances`).
* If this parameter is left blank, backup ID filtering is not applied.

BackupPointName.description_cn:
备份名称，支持模糊查询。
* 当备份查询范围为单个实例（即 `Scope` 取值为 `OneInstance`）时，该参数不生效。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用备份名称筛选。
BackupPointName.description_en:
Backup name, supports fuzzy search.
* When the backup query scope is a single instance (that is, when `Scope` is set to `OneInstance`), this parameter is not applicable.
* If this parameter is left blank, the backup name will not be used for filtering.

BackupStrategyList.description_cn:
备份方式列表。取值范围如下：

* `ManualBackup`：手动备份。
* `AutomatedBackup`：自动备份。

* 支持同时传入多个备份方式，多个备份方式间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用备份方式筛选。
BackupStrategyList.description_en:
Backup method list. The value range is as follows:

* `ManualBackup`: Manual backup
* `AutomatedBackup`: Automated backup

* Multiple backup methods can be specified at the same time, separated by commas (,).
* If this parameter is left blank, backup method filtering is not applied.

EndTime.description_cn:
查询结束时间。格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
* 若设置了查询开始时间（即 `StartTime`），该参数必填。
* 查询结束时间需晚于开始时间。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用时间范围筛选。
EndTime.description_en:
Query end time. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC).
* If a query start time (`StartTime`) is set, this parameter is required.
* The query end time must be later than the start time.
* If this parameter is left blank, time range filtering is not applied.

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
* 当备份查询范围为单个实例（即 `Scope` 取值为`OneInstance`）时，该参数必填。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用实例 ID 筛选。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID.
* When the backup query scope is a single instance (`Scope` is set to `OneInstance`), this parameter is required.
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including instance IDs.
* If this parameter is left blank, instance ID filtering is not applied.

OrderBy.description_cn: 排序依据，取值：OrderBy_E的string值，当前仅支持StartTime和InstanceId，替换掉原来的常量
OrderBy.description_en: Sorting basis. Value: string value of OrderBy_E. Currently, only StartTime and InstanceId are supported, replacing the previous constants

OrderType.description_cn: 排序方式，取值：枚举OrderType_E的string值，替换掉原来的常量
OrderType.description_en: Sort order. Value: string value of enum OrderType_E, replaces the original constant

PageNumber.description_cn:
备份集信息列表的页码，取值为不超过 Integer 数据类型的最大值，起始值为 1。
* 若设置了该参数，每页记录数（即 `PageSize`）也必填。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用页码范围筛选。
PageNumber.description_en:
Page number for the backup set information list. The value must not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. The starting value is 1.
* If this parameter is set, the number of records per page (`PageSize`) is also required.
* If this parameter is left blank, page range filtering is not applied.

PageSize.description_cn:
每页记录数。取值为 1~1000 间的整数。
* 若设置了页码（即 `PageNumber`），该参数必填。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用每页记录数筛选。
PageSize.description_en:
Records per page. Value: integer between 1 and 1000.
* If a page number (`PageNumber`) is set, this parameter is required.
* If this parameter is left blank, records per page will not be used for filtering.

ProjectName.description_cn:
备份所属的项目。
* 仅当查询范围为当前账号（即 `Scope` 取值为 `AccountInstances`）时，该参数生效。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用项目名称筛选。
ProjectName.description_en:
Project to which the backup belongs.
* This parameter is only applicable when the query scope is the current account (that is, when `Scope` is set to `AccountInstances`).
* If this parameter is left blank, the project name will not be used for filtering.

Scope.description_cn:
备份查询范围。取值范围如下：

* `OneInstance`（默认值）：查询单个实例内的备份。
* `AccountInstances`：查询当前账号下的备份。
Scope.description_en:
Backup query scope. The value range is as follows:

* `OneInstance` (default): Query backups within a single instance.
* `AccountInstances`: Query backups under the current account.

Search.description_en: Search by instance ID or name

StartTime.description_cn:
查询开始时间。格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
* 若设置了该参数，查询结束时间（即`EndTime`）参数也必填。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用时间范围筛选。
StartTime.description_en:
Query start time. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC).
* If this parameter is set, the query end time (`EndTime`) parameter is also required.
* If this parameter is left blank, time range filtering is not applied.

Status.description_cn:
备份状态。取值范围如下：

* `Creating`：创建中。
* `Available`：可用。
* `Unavailable`：不可用。
* `Deleting`：删除中。

更多关于备份状态的说明，请参见[备份状态](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/83041#%E5%A4%87%E4%BB%BD%E7%8A%B6%E6%80%81)。
Status.description_en:
Backup status. The value range is as follows:

* `Creating`: Creating
* `Available`: Available
* `Unavailable`: Unavailable
* `Deleting`: Deleting

For more information about backup status, see [Backup Status](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/83041#%E5%A4%87%E4%BB%BD%E7%8A%B6%E6%80%81).

TargetInstanceStatuses.description_en: Status of the instance to which the backup point belongs

Context.description_cn: 可选。查询上下文，首次查询为空
Context.description_en: Optional. Query context is empty on first query

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

KeyType.description_cn:
指定用于过滤大 Key 查询结果的数据类型。支持如下数据类型：

* `string`
* `list`
* `set`
* `zset`
* `hash`

若该参数留空，表示不使用数据类型进行过滤。
KeyType.description_en:
Specify the data type to filter large key query results. Supported data types:

* `string`
* `list`
* `set`
* `zset`
* `hash`

Leave this parameter blank to disable data type filtering

OrderBy.description_cn:
指定查询结果的排序条件。支持如下排序条件：

* `ValueSize`（默认值）：按内存占用对大 Key 查询结果进行排序。
* `ValueLen`：按元素数量对大 Key 查询结果进行排序。
OrderBy.description_en:
Specify the sorting criteria for query results. The following options are supported:

* `ValueSize` (default): Sorts large key query results by memory usage
* `ValueLen`: Sorts large key query results by number of elements

OrderType.description_en: Optional. Sort order: desc or asc. Default is desc

PageSize.description_cn: 每页记录数，取值范围为 1~100 间的整数。
PageSize.description_en: Records per page must be an integer between 1 and 100

QueryEndTime.description_cn:
查询结束时间，格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
* 若该参数留空，实际查询结束时间默认为当前时间。
* 查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间，时间间隔不超过 24 小时。
QueryEndTime.description_en:
Query end time, format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC)
* If this parameter is left blank, the actual query end time defaults to the current time
* The end time must be later than the start time, and the time range cannot exceed 24 hours

QueryStartTime.description_cn:
查询开始时间，格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
* 最多支持查看最近 15 天内的大 Key 分布情况。
* 若该参数留空，实际查询开始时间默认为当前时间 24 小时前的时间。
   例如，当前时间为 2023 年 03 月 27 号 16:30:00，若 `QueryStartTime` 不填，那么实际查询开始时间为 2023 年 03 月 26 号 16:30:00。
* 查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间，时间间隔不超过 24 小时。
QueryStartTime.description_en:
Query start time, format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC)
* You can view the distribution of large keys for up to the past 15 days
* If this parameter is left blank, the actual query start time defaults to 24 hours before the current time
  For example, if the current time is March 27, 2023, 16:30:00, and `QueryStartTime` is not set, the actual query start time will be March 26, 2023, 16:30:00
* The query end time must be later than the query start time, and the time range cannot exceed 24 hours

ExcludeCompleted.description_cn:
是否查询已处于完成（包括切换完成 `SWITCHOVER_COMPLETED`和删除完成`DELETE_COMPLETED`）状态的蓝绿部署任务。取值范围如下：

* `false`（默认值）：不查询。
* `true`：查询。
ExcludeCompleted.description_en:
Whether to query blue-green deployment tasks that are already completed (including switchover completed `SWITCHOVER_COMPLETED` and delete completed `DELETE_COMPLETED`). Value options are as follows:

* `false` (default): Do not query
* `true`: Query

InstanceId.description_cn:
已创建蓝绿部署任务的蓝色或绿色实例的实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID of the blue or green instance with a created blue-green deployment task
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information about all Redis instances in the target region, including instance IDs

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

BackupPointId.description_cn:
备份时间点当时的备份 ID。支持模糊查询。
* 仅当查询范围为当前账号（即 `Scope` 取值为 `AccountInstances`）时，该参数生效。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用备份 ID 筛选。
BackupPointId.description_en:
Backup ID at the backup time point. Supports fuzzy search.
* This parameter is only effective when the query scope is the current account (i.e., `Scope` is set to `AccountInstances`).
* If this parameter is left blank, backup ID filtering is not applied.

BackupPointName.description_cn:
备份时间点当时的备份名称，支持模糊查询。
* 当备份查询范围为单个实例（即 `Scope` 取值为 `OneInstance`）时，该参数不生效。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用备份名称筛选。
BackupPointName.description_en:
Backup name at the backup time point; supports fuzzy search.
* When the backup query scope is a single instance (i.e., `Scope` is set to `OneInstance`), this parameter is not effective.
* If this parameter is left blank, backup name filtering is not applied.

BackupStrategyList.description_cn:
备份方式列表。取值范围如下：

* `ManualBackup`：手动备份。
* `AutomatedBackup`：自动备份。

* 支持同时传入多个备份方式，多个备份方式间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用备份方式筛选。
BackupStrategyList.description_en:
Backup type list. The available values are:

* `ManualBackup`: Manual backup.
* `AutomatedBackup`: Automated backup.

* Multiple backup types can be entered at the same time, separated by commas (,).
* If this parameter is left blank, backup type filtering is not applied.

EndTime.description_cn:
查询结束时间。格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
* 若设置了查询开始时间（即 `StartTime`），该参数必填。
* 查询结束时间需晚于开始时间。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用时间范围筛选。

Context.description_cn:
Fatlog 日志记录查询结果的上下文，需要加载更多 Fatlog 日志记录时使用。
调用 DescribeFatLogs 接口后，您可以根据返回参数 `ListOver` 的值来确定是否还有未加载的 Fatlog 日志记录：

* 若 `ListOver` 的值为 `false`，表示还有符合查询条件的 Fatlog 日志记录未加载完，您可以再次调用 DescribeFatLogs 接口，并使用上一次接口调用时返回参数中的 `Context` 值来查看剩余的 Fatlog 日志记录。
* 若 `ListOver` 的值为 `true`，表示已加载完全部符合查询条件的 Fatlog 日志记录。
Context.description_en:
The context of the Fatlog log query result, used when loading more Fatlog log records.
After calling the DescribeFatLogs API, you can determine whether there are remaining Fatlog log records to load based on the value of the returned parameter `ListOver`:

* If `ListOver` is `false`, there are still Fatlog log records matching the query conditions that have not been loaded. You can call the DescribeFatLogs API again and use the `Context` value returned in the previous API call to view the remaining Fatlog log records.
* If `ListOver` is `true`, all Fatlog log records matching the query conditions have been loaded.

* 支持同时传入多个节点 ID 进行查询，多个节点 ID 间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeNodeIds](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/127841) 接口查询目标 Redis 实例下所有的节点 ID 信息。
* `NodeIds` 的字符串总长度不可以超过 1024 个字节，建议传入的节点数量不超过 8 个。
NodeIds.description_en:
Node ID to query Fatlog logs.
* If this parameter is left empty, the Fatlog log details for all nodes in the target instance are queried by default.
* You can query multiple node IDs at the same time. Separate multiple node IDs with commas (,).
* You can call the [DescribeNodeIds](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/127841) API to query all node ID information for the target Redis instance.
* The total length of the `NodeIds` string must not exceed 1024 bytes. It is recommended to query no more than 8 nodes at a time.

PageSize.description_cn: 每页记录数，取值范围为 1~1000。
PageSize.description_en: Records per page. Value range: 1–1000.

QueryEndTime.description_cn:
查询结束时间，格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
* 若该参数留空，实际查询结束时间默认为当前时间。
* 查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间。
QueryEndTime.description_en:
Query end time, format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC).
* If this parameter is left empty, the actual query end time defaults to the current time.
* The query end time must be later than the query start time.

QueryStartTime.description_cn:
查询开始时间，格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
若该参数留空，实际查询开始时间默认为当前时间 3 天前的时间。
例如，当前时间为 2026 年 03 月 04 号 16:30:00，若 `QueryStartTime` 不填，那么实际查询开始时间为 2026 年 03 月 01 号 16:30:00。
QueryStartTime.description_en:
Query start time, format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC).
If this parameter is left empty, the actual query start time defaults to 3 days before the current time.
For example, if the current time is March 4, 2026, 16:30:00, and `QueryStartTime` is not specified, the actual query start time is March 1, 2026, 16:30:00.

Context.description_cn: 可选。查询上下文，首次查询为空
Context.description_en: Optional. Query context is empty for the first query

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID

KeyType.description_cn:
指定用于过滤热 Key 查询结果的数据类型。支持如下数据类型：

* `string`
* `list`
* `set`
* `zset`
* `hash`

若该参数留空，表示不使用数据类型进行过滤。
KeyType.description_en:
Specify the data type to filter hot key query results. Supported data types:

* `string`
* `list`
* `set`
* `zset`
* `hash`

Leave this parameter blank to not use data type filtering.

OrderBy.description_cn: 可选。排序依据，暂未使用
OrderBy.description_en: Optional. Sorting criteria, not used yet

OrderType.description_cn: 可选。排序方式，暂未使用
OrderType.description_en: Optional. Sort order (not in use yet)

PageSize.description_cn: 每页记录数，取值范围为 1~1000 间的整数。
PageSize.description_en: Records per page must be an integer between 1 and 1000

QueryEndTime.description_cn:
查询结束时间，格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
* 若该参数留空，实际查询结束时间默认为当前时间。
* 查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间，时间间隔不超过 15 天。
QueryEndTime.description_en:
Query end time, format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC)
* If this parameter is left blank, the query end time defaults to the current time
* The query end time must be later than the query start time, and the time interval cannot exceed 15 days

QueryStartTime.description_cn:
查询开始时间，格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
* 最多支持查看最近 15 天内的热 Key 分布情况。
* 若该参数留空，实际查询开始时间默认为当前时间 1 小时前的时间。
   例如，当前时间为 2023 年 03 月 27 号 16:30:00，若 `QueryStartTime` 不填，那么实际查询开始时间为 2023 年 03 月 27 号 15:30:00。
* 查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间，时间间隔不超过 15 天。
QueryStartTime.description_en:
Query start time, format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC)
* You can view hot Key distribution for up to the past 15 days
* If this parameter is left blank, the actual query start time defaults to one hour before the current time
  For example, if the current time is 2023-03-27 16:30:00 and `QueryStartTime` is not set, the actual query start time will be 2023-03-27 15:30:00
* The query end time must be later than the query start time, and the time range cannot exceed 15 days

ShardIds.description_cn:
指定用于过滤热 Key 查询结果的分片 ID 列表。
* 每次最多支持同时传入 40 个分片 ID，多个分片 ID 间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用分片 ID 进行过滤。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceShards](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1148756) 接口查询目标 Redis 实例下各 Shard 分片的详情，包括分片 ID（即返回结果中的 `ShardId` 字段。
ShardIds.description_en:
Specify the list of shard IDs used to filter hot key query results.
* You can provide up to 40 shard IDs at a time, separated by commas (,).
* Leave this parameter blank to disable shard ID filtering.
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceShards](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1148756) API to view details of each shard in the target Redis instance, including the shard ID (shown as the `ShardId` field in the response).

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

OrderBy.description_cn:
这个是前端用，api无需透出。
指定查询结果的排序条件。支持如下排序条件：

* `CreateTime`（默认值）：按任务创建时间排序。
* `StartTime`：按任务开始时间排序。
* `FinishTime`：按任务完成时间排序。
OrderBy.description_en:
For frontend use only; no need to expose this in the API
Specify the sorting criteria for query results. Supported options:

* `CreateTime` (default): Sort by task creation time
* `StartTime`: Sort by task start time
* `FinishTime`: Sort by task completion time

OrderType.description_cn:
这个是前端用，api无需透出。
排序方式。取值范围如下：

* `DESC`（默认值）：降序排列。
* `ASC`：升序排列。
OrderType.description_en:
For frontend use only; not exposed in the API
Sort order. Available values:

* `DESC` (default): descending order
* `ASC`: ascending order

PageNumber.description_cn: 扫描 key 任务列表的页码。取值为不超过 Integer 数据类型的最大值，起始值与默认值均为 1。
PageNumber.description_en: Specify the page number for the key task list. The value must not exceed the maximum for the Integer data type. The starting and default values are both 1.

PageSize.description_cn: 每页记录数。取值为 1~1000 间的整数，默认值为 10。
PageSize.description_en: Records per page. Enter an integer from 1 to 1000; default is 10

QueryEndTime.description_cn:
查询结束时间，格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间。
QueryEndTime.description_en:
Query end time, format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC)
The query end time must be later than the query start time

QueryStartTime.description_cn:
查询开始时间，格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
查询开始时间需早于查询结束时间。
QueryStartTime.description_en:
Query start time, format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC)
The query start time must be earlier than the query end time

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID.
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

ParameterGroupId.description_cn:
参数模板 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeParameterGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1415106) 接口查询当前账号和地域下所有的参数模板基本信息，包括参数模板 ID
ParameterGroupId.description_en:
Parameter Template ID
You can call the [DescribeParameterGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1415106) API to view basic information about all parameter templates under your account and region, including the parameter template ID

EngineVersion.description_cn:
参数模板适用的 Redis 数据库版本。取值范围如下；

* `7.0`：Redis 7.0。
* `6.0`：Redis 6.0。
* `5.0`：Redis 5.0。

若该参数留空，表示不使用参数模板的数据库版本号条件进行筛选。
EngineVersion.description_en:
Applicable Redis database versions for the parameter template

* `7.0`: Redis 7.0
* `6.0`: Redis 6.0
* `5.0`: Redis 5.0

If this parameter is left blank, the database version will not be used as a filtering condition for the parameter template.

PageNumber.description_cn: 参数模板信息列表的页码。取值为不超过 Integer 数据类型的最大值，起始值均为 1。
PageNumber.description_en: Page number for the parameter template information list. Value must not exceed the maximum for the Integer data type. The starting value is always 1.

PageSize.description_cn: 每页记录数。取值为 1~100 间的整数。
PageSize.description_en: Records per page: Enter an integer between 1 and 100

Source.description_cn:
参数模板的创建来源，取值范围如下：

* `User`：用户创建（即自定义模板）。
* `System`：系统创建（即系统模板）。

若该参数留空，表示不使用参数模板的创建来源条件进行筛选。
Source.description_en:
Parameter template creation source. Possible values:

* `User`: Created by the user (custom template)
* `System`: Created by the system (system template)

Leave this field empty to ignore the creation source when filtering parameter templates

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information about all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。模糊查询。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用实例 ID 条件进行筛选。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID. Fuzzy search

* You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to view basic information for all Redis instances in the selected region, including their Instance IDs

MaxStartTime.description_cn:
需要查询的计划内事件的最晚执行时间。 格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` （UTC）。
* 若该参数留空，表示不使用最晚计划执行时间进行筛选。
* 查询结束时间需晚于开始时间。
MaxStartTime.description_en:
Latest execution time for scheduled events to query. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC)
* Leave this parameter blank to skip filtering by latest scheduled execution time
* The end time must be later than the start time

MinStartTime.description_cn:
需要查询的计划内事件的最早执行时间。 格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` （UTC）。
若该参数留空，表示不使用最早计划执行时间进行筛选。
MinStartTime.description_en:
The earliest execution time of the scheduled events to be queried. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC)
If this parameter is left empty, the earliest scheduled execution time will not be used for filtering

PageNumber.description_cn: 计划内事件列表的页码。取值为不超过 Integer 数据类型的最大值，起始值为 1。
PageNumber.description_en: Page number for the scheduled event list. Value must not exceed the maximum for the Integer data type. Starts at 1

PageSize.description_cn: 每页记录数。取值为 1~1000 间的整数。
PageSize.description_en: Records per page. Enter an integer between 1 and 1000

RegionId.description_cn:
地域 ID。
若该参数留空，会返回当前账号下所有可用的地域资源信息。
RegionId.description_en:
Region ID
If this parameter is left blank, all available region resource information under your account will be returned.

Context.description_cn:
慢日志记录查询结果的上下文，需要加载更多慢日志记录时使用。
调用 DescribeSlowLogs 接口后，您可以根据返回参数 `ListOver` 的值来确定是否还有未加载的慢日志记录：

* 若 `ListOver` 的值为 `false`，表示还有符合查询条件的慢日志记录未加载完，您可以再次调用 DescribeSlowLogs 接口，并使用上一次接口调用时返回参数中的 `Context` 值来查看剩余的慢日志记录。
* 若 `ListOver` 的值为 `true`，表示已加载完全部符合查询条件的慢日志记录。
Context.description_en:
Context for slow log query results, used when you need to load more slow log records.
After calling the DescribeSlowLogs API, you can check the value of the returned parameter `ListOver` to see if there are more slow log records to load:

* If `ListOver` is `false`, there are still slow log records matching your query that have not been loaded. You can call the DescribeSlowLogs API again and use the `Context` value from the previous response to view the remaining slow log records.
* If `ListOver` is `true`, all slow log records matching your query have been loaded.

DBName.description_cn:
慢日志所在的数据库。
慢日志类型不同，支持的数据库取值范围不同，其中：

* Proxy 节点慢日志：0 到 256 间的任意整数。
* Server 节点慢日志：由于 Server 节点慢日志的数据库为空，故取值仅支持`-`。

若该参数留空，默认返回所有数据库上的慢日志。
DBName.description_en:
Database for slow logs
The supported database values vary by slow log type:

* Proxy node slow logs: Any integer from 0 to 256
* Server node slow logs: Since the database is empty for server node slow logs, only '-' is supported

If this parameter is left blank, slow logs from all databases are returned by default

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

NodeIds.description_cn:
需要查询慢日志的节点 ID。
* 若该参数留空，默认查询目标实例内所有节点的慢日志详情。
* 支持同时传入多个节点 ID 进行查询，多个节点 ID 间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeNodeIds](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/127841) 接口查询目标 Redis 实例下所有的节点 ID 信息。
* `NodeIds`的字符串总长度不可以超过 1024 个字节，建议传入的节点数量不超过 8 个。
NodeIds.description_en:
Node ID(s) required for slow log query
* If this parameter is left blank, slow log details for all nodes in the target instance are queried by default
* You can enter multiple node IDs separated by commas (,)
* To view all node IDs for the target Redis instance, call the [DescribeNodeIds](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/127841) API
* The total length of the NodeIds string must not exceed 1024 bytes; it is recommended to specify no more than 8 nodes

OrderBy.description_cn: 可选。排序依据，暂未使用
OrderBy.description_en: Optional Sort Criteria (not currently in use)

OrderType.description_cn: 可选。排序方式，暂未使用
OrderType.description_en: Optional. Sorting method not currently in use

PageSize.description_cn: 每页记录数，取值范围为 1~1000。
PageSize.description_en: Records per page (range: 1–1000)

QueryEndTime.description_cn:
查询结束时间，格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
* 若该参数留空，实际查询结束时间默认为当前时间。
* 查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间。
QueryEndTime.description_en:
Query end time, format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC)
* If this parameter is left blank, the actual query end time defaults to the current time
* The query end time must be later than the query start time

QueryStartTime.description_cn:
查询开始时间，格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
若该参数留空，实际查询开始时间默认为当前时间 3 天前的时间。
例如，当前时间为 2022 年 08 月 01 号 16:30:00，若 `QueryStartTime` 不填，那么实际查询开始时间为 2022 年 07 月 29 号 16:30:00。
QueryStartTime.description_en:
Query start time, format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC)
If this parameter is left blank, the actual query start time defaults to three days before the current time.
For example, if the current time is August 1, 2022, 16:30:00, and `QueryStartTime` is not set, the actual query start time will be July 29, 2022, 16:30:00.

SlowLogType.description_cn:
慢日志的类型。取值范围如下：

* `Server`：Server 节点慢日志。
* `Proxy`：Proxy 节点慢日志。

* 若该参数留空，默认返回所有节点类型的慢日志。
* 若同时传入 `NodeIds` 和 `SlowLogType`，以 `NodeIds` 取值为准。
SlowLogType.description_en:
Type of slow log. Valid values:

* `Server`: Slow log for Server node
* `Proxy`: Slow log for Proxy node

* If this parameter is left empty, slow logs for all node types are returned by default
* If both `NodeIds` and `SlowLogType` are provided, `NodeIds` takes precedence

InstanceIds.description_cn:
需要查询已绑定标签的实例 ID。
* 支持一次传入多个实例 ID，多个实例之间用英文逗号（,）分隔。最多同时传入 50 个实例 ID。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceIds.description_en:
You need to query instance IDs with bound tags.
* You can enter multiple instance IDs at once, separated by English commas (,). Up to 50 instance IDs can be entered at the same time.
* To view basic information for all Redis instances in a specific region, including instance IDs, call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API.

PageNumber.description_cn: 实例标签信息列表的页码，取值为不超过 Integer 数据类型的最大值，起始值为 1。
PageNumber.description_en: Page number for the instance tag information list. Value must not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type and starts at 1

PageSize.description_cn: 每页记录数，取值范围为 1~1000。
PageSize.description_en: Records per page, range: 1–1000

TagFilters.description_cn:
用于查询筛选的标签键值对数组。
若该参数留空，表示不使用标签条件进行筛选。
TagFilters.description_en:
Array of tag key-value pairs for query filtering
Leave this parameter empty to disable tag-based filtering

RegionId.description_cn:
地域 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeRegions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65752) 接口查询 Redis 实例所有可用的地域资源信息，包括地域 ID。
RegionId.description_en:
Region ID
You can call the [DescribeRegions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65752) API to query all available region resource information for Redis instances, including region IDs

AllowListIds.description_cn:
需要解绑实例的白名单 ID。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/108835) 接口查询指定地域下所有的白名单列表信息，包括白名单 ID。
* 支持一次传入多个白名单 ID，多个 ID 间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
* 不支持同时传入多个实例 ID 和白名单，即每次仅允许将一个白名单中的多个实例同时解绑，或将一个实例同时从多个白名单中解绑。
AllowListIds.description_en:
Enter the whitelist ID(s) you want to unbind from the instance
* You can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/108835) API to view all whitelist information in a specified region, including whitelist IDs
* You can enter multiple whitelist IDs at once, separated by commas (,)
* You cannot enter multiple instance IDs and whitelist IDs at the same time. Each operation allows you to unbind multiple instances from a single whitelist, or unbind a single instance from multiple whitelists

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感且不超过 127 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate request submissions. The client generates this parameter value, which must be unique across different requests, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

InstanceIds.description_cn:
需要解绑白名单的实例 ID。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
* 支持一次传入多个实例 ID，多个 ID 间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
* 不支持同时传入多个实例 ID 和白名单，即每次仅允许将一个白名单中的多个实例同时解绑，或将一个实例同时从多个白名单中解绑。
InstanceIds.description_en:
Instance IDs that need to be unbound from the whitelist.
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to view basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including instance IDs.
* You can enter multiple instance IDs at once, separated by English commas (,).
* Each operation only allows you to either unbind multiple instances from one whitelist, or unbind one instance from multiple whitelists at once.

ApplyImmediately.description_cn:

MultiAZ.description_cn:
设置实例的可用区部署方案。取值范围如下：

* `disabled`：单可用区部署方案。
* `enabled`：多可用区部署方案。

MultiAZ.description_en:
Configure the instance's availability zone deployment scheme. Value options:

* `disabled`: Single availability zone deployment scheme.
* `enabled`: Multi-availability zone deployment scheme.

* If this parameter is left blank, the instance's availability zone deployment scheme will not be modified.
* For more information about availability zone deployment schemes, see [Multi-Availability Zone Disaster Recovery Solution](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70863).

NodeNumber.description_cn:
每个分片中的节点数。取值范围为 2~6。
每个账号在每个地域下默认最多可创建 4 个 256 MiB 规格（即 `ShardCapacity` 取值为 `256`）的节点，若您需要调整 256 MiB 规格节点的购买配额 （上限为 10 个），请参见[账号配额](https://vsop-online.bytedance.net/doc/manage/detail/6293/6293/71560#%E8%B4%A6%E5%8F%B7%E9%85%8D%E9%A2%9D)。
NodeNumber.description_en:
Number of nodes in each shard. Value range: 2–6.
By default, each account can create up to 4 nodes of 256 MiB specification (that is, `ShardCapacity` value is `256`) in each region. If you need to adjust the purchase quota for 256 MiB nodes (maximum 10), see [Account Quota](https://vsop-online.bytedance.net/doc/manage/detail/6293/6293/71560#%E8%B4%A6%E5%8F%B7%E9%85%8D%E9%A2%9D).

ShardCapacity.description_cn:
每个分片的内存容量，单位：MiB。取值范围如下：

* 若实例为未启用分片集群（即 `ShardedCluster` 取值为 `0` ），每分片内存容量可选取值为：256，512，1024，2048，4096，8192，16384，32768，24576，65536。
* 若实例为启用分片集群（即 `ShardedCluster` 取值为 `1`）时，每分片内存容量可选取值为：1024，2048，4096，8192，16384。

* 若该参数留空，表示不修改实例的内存容量。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) 接口查询指定实例的详情信息，包括实例是否开启分片，以及每个分片中的内存容量。
* 若需要缩小分片容量，需保证实例当前的**已用内存**不超过新内存总容量，其中新内存总容量 = 变更后的单分片内存 x 分片数。**已用内存**信息查看方法，请参见[查看实例信息](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/157896)。
* 每种实例规格都有对应支持的分片容量和带宽，因此修改实例分片容量的同时，也会同步修改实例的带宽和规格。关于 Redis 实例规格的更多详情，请参见[产品规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72111)。
ShardCapacity.description_en:
Memory capacity per shard, in MiB. The available values are as follows:

* If the instance does not enable sharded cluster (that is, `ShardedCluster` is set to `0`), the selectable memory capacity per shard is: 256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384, 32768, 24576, 65536.
* If the instance enables sharded cluster (that is, `ShardedCluster` is set to `1`), the selectable memory capacity per shard is: 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384.

* If this parameter is left blank, the instance memory capacity will not be modified.
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) API to query details of the specified instance, including whether sharding is enabled and the memory capacity of each shard.
* If you need to reduce shard capacity, ensure that the instance's current **used memory** does not exceed the new total memory capacity, where new total memory capacity = updated memory per shard x number of shards. For information on **used memory**, see [View Instance Information](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/157896).
* Each instance specification supports corresponding shard capacity and bandwidth. When you modify shard capacity, the bandwidth and specification will also be updated accordingly. For more details about Redis instance specifications, see [Product Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72111).

ShardNumber.description_cn:
实例中的分片数量。取值范围为 2~256。
* 仅当启用分片集群（即  `ShardedCluster` 取值为 `1`）时，需要指定该参数。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) 接口查询指定实例的详情信息，包括实例是否已启用分片以及分片数量。
* 若需要缩减分片数量，需保证实例当前的**已用内存**不超过新内存总容量，其中新内存总容量 = 变更后的单分片内存 x 分片数。**已用内存**信息查看方法，请参见[查看实例信息](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/157896)。
* 若变更前的单节点实例为已启用分片集群实例且申请了直连地址，那么在变更为主备实例时，实例的分片数量不能超过 8 个。如果需要在开启直连地址的场景下增加更多的分片数量，请[提交工单](https://console.volcengine.com/workorder/create/)联系技术支持。
ShardNumber.description_en:
Number of shards in the instance. Value range: 2–256.
* This parameter is required only when sharded cluster is enabled (that is, `ShardedCluster` value is `1`).
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) API to query details of the specified instance, including whether sharding is enabled and the number of shards.
* To reduce the number of shards, ensure the instance's current **used memory** does not exceed the new total memory capacity, where new total memory capacity = memory per shard after change × number of shards. For information on **used memory**, see [View Instance Information](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/157896).
* If the single-node instance before the change is a sharded cluster instance and has applied for a direct connection address, then when changing to a primary/standby instance, the number of shards cannot exceed 8. If you need to increase the number of shards in the scenario where direct connection address is enabled, please [submit a ticket](https://console.volcengine.com/workorder/create/) to contact technical support.

ShardedCluster.description_cn:
是否启用分片集群。取值范围如下：

* `0`：不启用。
* `1`：启用。

若变更前的单节点实例为已启用分片集群实例且申请了直连地址，那么在变更为主备实例时，不允许选择不启用分片集群。
ShardedCluster.description_en:
Whether to enable sharded cluster. The available values are:

* `0`: Disabled
* `1`: Enabled

If the single-node instance before the change is already a sharded cluster instance and has applied for a direct connection address, you cannot select 'Disabled' when changing to a primary-secondary instance.

ApplyImmediately.description_cn:
是否立即执行配置变更操作。取值范围如下：

* `true`：立即变更。
* `false`：在可维护时间段内执行变更。

关于可维护时间段的更多信息，请参见[设置可维护时间段](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70848)。
ApplyImmediately.description_en:
Choose whether to apply configuration changes immediately. Available options:

* `true`: Apply changes immediately
* `false`: Apply changes during the maintenance window

For more information about the maintenance window, see [Set Maintenance Window](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70848).

BackupPointName.description_cn:
为变更前创建的全量备份设置备份名称。若不设置备份名称，默认使用备份 ID 作为名称。
如需设置备份名称，名称需同时满足如下条件:

* 以中文、字母、下划线（_）开头。
* 长度为 1-128 个字符。
* 由中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）组成。

仅当选择了需要在变更前创建备份（即 `CreateBackup` 为 `true` ）时，该参数生效。
BackupPointName.description_en:
Set a backup name for the full backup created before the change. If you do not specify a backup name, the backup ID is used by default.

To set a backup name, make sure it meets all of the following requirements:

* Starts with a Chinese character, letter, or underscore (_)
* Contains 1–128 characters
* Includes only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)

This parameter is effective only if you choose to create a backup before the change (that is, when `CreateBackup` is set to `true`).

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感且不超过 127 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate submissions. The client generates this parameter value, which must be unique across requests, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters

CreateBackup.description_cn:
是否在变更前创建全量备份。取值范围如下：

* `true`：创建备份。
* `false`（默认值）：不创建。

* 该参数仅对主备实例（即 `InstanceClass` 为 `PrimarySecondary` ）生效。单节点实例（即 `InstanceClass` 为 `Standalone`） 不支持备份功能，无需设置该参数。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) 接口查询指定实例的详情信息，包括实例类型。
CreateBackup.description_en:
Whether to create a full backup before making changes. Valid values:

* `true`: Create a backup
* `false` (default): Do not create a backup

* This parameter applies only to primary-secondary instances (`InstanceClass` set to `PrimarySecondary`). Single-node instances (`InstanceClass` set to `Standalone`) do not support backup, so you do not need to set this parameter.
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) API to query details of a specified instance, including its type.

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information about all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID

ShardCapacity.description_cn:
每个分片的内存容量，单位：MiB。取值范围：1024，2048，4096，8192，16384。
* 若该参数不填，默认使用原单分片容量作为启用分片集群后的 `ShardCapacity`，但不启用分片集群实例和启用分片集群实例支持的单分片容量规格不同，若使用了启用分片集群实例不支持的单分片容量，调用该接口时会出现报错。关于 Redis 实例规格的更多详情，请参见[产品规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72111)。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) 接口查询指定实例的详情信息，包括每个分片中的内存容量。
* 若需要缩小分片容量，需保证实例当前的已用内存不超过新内存总容量（总容量 = 单分片容量 x 分片数量）的 85%。
* 每种实例规格都有对应支持的分片容量和带宽，因此修改实例分片容量的同时，也会同步修改实例的带宽和规格。关于 Redis 实例规格的更多详情，请参见[产品规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72111)。
ShardCapacity.description_en:
Memory capacity per shard, in MiB. Valid values: 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384.
* If this parameter is not specified, the original single-shard capacity will be used as the `ShardCapacity` after enabling the sharded cluster. However, the supported single-shard capacity specifications differ between non-sharded and sharded cluster instances. If you use a single-shard capacity not supported by sharded cluster instances, an error will occur when calling this API. For more details about Redis instance specifications, see [Product Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72111).
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) API to query details of a specified instance, including the memory capacity of each shard.
* To reduce shard capacity, ensure that the current used memory of the instance does not exceed 85% of the new total memory capacity (total capacity = single-shard capacity x number of shards).
* Each instance specification has corresponding supported shard capacity and bandwidth. Therefore, when you modify the shard capacity of an instance, its bandwidth and specification will also be updated accordingly. For more details about Redis instance specifications, see [Product Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72111).

ShardNumber.description_cn: 实例中的分片数量。取值范围为 2~256。

* `0`：不启用。
* `1`：启用。

当前仅支持将未启用分片集群变更为启用分片集群实例，故取值必须为 `1`。
ShardedCluster.description_en:
Whether to enable sharded cluster. Available values:

* `0`: Not enabled
* `1`: Enabled

Currently, only instances with sharded cluster not enabled can be changed to enabled. Therefore, the value must be `1`.

设置单分片中需要增加的节点数。
每个分片支持 2~6 个节点，即 2 <= （当前节点数 + 新增节点数） <= 6。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) 接口查询指定实例的详情信息，包括每个分片中当前节点数。

输入 IP 地址或 CIDR 格式的地址段。
* 仅当需要变更白名单中的 IP 地址时，该参数必填。
* 不允许设置重复的地址，多个地址间用英文逗号（,）隔开。
* 设置 `0.0.0.0/0`，表示允许所有地址访问；设置 `127.0.0.1`，表示禁止所有地址访问；同时设置 `0.0.0.0/0`和`127.0.0.1`，表示允许所有地址访问。
* 设置 CIDR `192.168.1.0/24`，表示允许该网段内的 IP 地址访问；设置 `192.168.1.1`，表示仅允许该 IP 地址访问。
AllowList.description_en:
Enter an IP address or a CIDR range
* This field is required only when you need to update the IP addresses in the whitelist
* Duplicate addresses are not allowed; separate multiple addresses with English commas (,)
* Setting `0.0.0.0/0` allows access from all addresses; setting `127.0.0.1` blocks access from all addresses; setting both `0.0.0.0/0` and `127.0.0.1` allows access from all addresses
* Setting CIDR `192.168.1.0/24` allows access from all IP addresses in that subnet; setting `192.168.1.1` allows access only from that IP address

AllowListCategory.description_cn:
白名单的类型。取值范围如下：

* `Ordinary`（默认值）：普通白名单。
* `Default`：默认白名单。

每个火山引擎账号在每个地域最多可设定一个默认白名单。新设置的默认白名单会自动顶替原有默认白名单，即原有默认白名单会自动变为非默认白名单。更多详情，请参见[约束与限制](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71560#%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD%E7%89%B9%E6%80%A7%E9%99%90%E5%88%B6)。
AllowListCategory.description_en:
Whitelist type. The available options are:

* `Ordinary` (default): Ordinary whitelist
* `Default`: Default whitelist

Each Volcano Engine account can set up to one default whitelist per region. When you set a new default whitelist, it automatically replaces the previous default whitelist, which will become a non-default whitelist. For more details, see [Constraints and limitations](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71560#%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD%E7%89%B9%E6%80%A7%E9%99%90%E5%88%B6).

AllowListDesc.description_cn:
白名单的备注信息，长度不可超过 200 个字符。
* 若不设置该参数，表示不修改白名单的备注信息。
* 若传入空字符串（即 `"AllowListDesc":""`），表示清空白名单的备注信息。
AllowListDesc.description_en:
Whitelist remark information must not exceed 200 characters
* If this parameter is not set, the whitelist remark information will not be modified
* If an empty string is passed (i.e., "AllowListDesc":""), the whitelist remark information will be cleared

AllowListId.description_cn:
白名单 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/108835) 接口查询指定地域下所有的白名单列表信息，包括白名单 ID。
AllowListId.description_en:
Whitelist ID
You can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/108835) API to query all whitelists in the specified region, including the whitelist ID.

AllowListName.description_cn:
白名单名称。
* 若不设置该参数，默认使用白名单的原名称。
* 若需修改白名单名称，直接输入新的白名单名称即可。名称需同时满足如下要求：
   * 不能以数字、中划线（-）开头。
   * 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）。
   * 长度需为 1~128 个字符。
AllowListName.description_en:
Whitelist Name
* If you do not set this parameter, the original whitelist name will be used by default
* To change the whitelist name, enter a new name. The name must meet all of the following requirements:
   * Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
   * Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
   * Must be 1–128 characters long

ApplyInstanceNum.description_cn:
当前白名单所绑定的实例个数。
* 当需要修改白名单的 IP（即 `AllowList`）或关联安全组（即 `SecurityGroupBindInfos`）信息时，该参数必填。
* 该参数传入的值必须与当前白名单所绑定的实例个数一致，否则调用该接口时会报错。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/108835) 接口查询当前账号下在指定地域内的所有白名单列表信息，包括白名单下绑定的实例总数（即返回参数中 `AssociatedInstanceNum` 的参数值）。
ApplyInstanceNum.description_en:
Number of instances bound to the current whitelist
* This parameter is required when you need to modify whitelist IPs (that is, `AllowList`) or associated security group information (that is, `SecurityGroupBindInfos`).
* The value you enter must match the number of instances currently bound to the whitelist; otherwise, an error will occur when you call this API.
* You can call the [DescribeAllowLists](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/108835) API to query all whitelist information under your account in the specified region, including the total number of instances bound to each whitelist (shown as the `AssociatedInstanceNum` parameter in the response).

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感且不超过 127 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate submissions. The client generates this parameter value, which must be unique across requests, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

ModifyMode.description_cn:
修改方式，取值范围如下：

* `Cover`（默认值）：使用 `AllowList` 参数中的值覆盖原白名单。
* `Append`：在原白名单中增加 `AllowList` 参数中输入的 IP 地址。
* `Delete`：在原白名单中删除 `AllowList` 参数中输入的 IP 地址。至少需要保留一个 IP 地址。
ModifyMode.description_en:
Modification mode. Available values:

* `Cover` (default): Overwrite the existing whitelist with the values specified in the `AllowList` parameter
* `Append`: Add the IP addresses entered in the `AllowList` parameter to the existing whitelist
* `Delete`: Remove the IP addresses entered in the `AllowList` parameter from the existing whitelist. At least one IP address must be retained

SecurityGroupBindInfos.description_cn:
需要关联的 ECS 安全组信息列表。
* 若不设置该参数，表示不修改安全组。
* 若传入空数组（即 `"SecurityGroupBindInfos":[]`），表示清空安全组。
SecurityGroupBindInfos.description_en:
List of ECS security group information to associate
* If you do not set this parameter, the security group will not be changed
* If you pass an empty array (i.e., "SecurityGroupBindInfos":[]), the security group will be cleared

SyncSecurityGroup.description_cn: 是否更新已有安全组最新ip信息
SyncSecurityGroup.description_en: Update latest IP information for existing security group?

Active.description_cn:
是否启用自动备份。取值范围如下：

* `false`（默认值）：不启用。
* `true`：启用。
Active.description_en:
Whether to enable automatic backup. Value options:

* `false` (default): Not enabled.
* `true`: Enabled.

BackupHour.description_cn:
设置开始执行备份时间段（UTC+8）。取值范围为 0 到 23 间的任意整数。其中，`0` 表示系统会在 `00:00~00:59` 时段内执行备份，`1` 表示会在 `01:00~01:59` 时段内执行备份，以此类推。
当启用自动备份（即 `Active` 取值为 `true`）时，该参数必填。
BackupHour.description_en:
Set the backup start time window (UTC+8). Enter any integer from 0 to 23. `0` means the system will run the backup between `00:00~00:59`. `1` means the backup will run between `01:00~01:59`, and so on.
This parameter is required when automatic backup is enabled (that is, when `Active` is set to `true`).

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感且不超过 127 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate submissions. The client generates this parameter value; it must be unique across different requests, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information about all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID

Period.description_cn:
备份周期。取值范围为 1 到 7 之间的任意整数，多个值间用英文逗号（,）分隔。其中，1 表示每周一进行备份，2 表示每周二进行备份，以此类推。

当启用自动备份（即 `Active` 取值为 `true`）时，该参数必填。
Period.description_en:
Backup cycle. Enter any integer from 1 to 7; separate multiple values with commas (,). 1 means backup on Monday, 2 means backup on Tuesday, and so on.

This parameter is required when automatic backup is enabled (that is, when `Active` is set to `true`).

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于接口幂等判断
ClientToken.description_en: For interface idempotency check

Active.description_cn:
是否开启跨地域备份功能，取值范围如下：

* `true`：开启跨地域备份。
* `false`：不开启跨地域备份。
Active.description_en:
Enable cross-region backup? Valid values:

* `true`: Enable cross-region backup
* `false`: Do not enable cross-region backup

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感且不超过 127 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate submissions. The client generates this parameter value, which must be unique for each request, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

CrossBackupRegion.description_cn:
跨地域备份的目的地域 ID。
* 当开启跨地域备份功能（即 `Active` 为 `true`）时，该参数必填。
* 当关闭跨地域备份功能（即 `Active` 为 `true`）时，该参数不生效。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeAvailableCrossRegion](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1537662) 接口查询目标 Redis 实例中可作为跨地域备份目的地域列表。
CrossBackupRegion.description_en:
Destination region ID for cross-region backup
* This parameter is required when cross-region backup is enabled (`Active` is `true`)
* This parameter is ignored when cross-region backup is disabled (`Active` is `false`)
* You can call the [DescribeAvailableCrossRegion](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1537662) API to view the list of available destination regions for the target Redis instance

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to view basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

AccountName.description_cn:
账号名称。
您可以调用 [ListDBAccount](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71732) 接口查询目标 Redis 实例中所有账号的信息，包括账号名称。
AccountName.description_en:
Account Name
You can call the [ListDBAccount](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71732) API to query all account information for the target Redis instance, including account names.

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感且不超过 127 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate request submissions. The client generates this parameter; it must be unique across different requests, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

Description.description_cn:
修改后的账号描述，长度不超过 256 个字符。
若该参数为空，表示不修改账号描述。
Description.description_en:
Modified account description, up to 256 characters
Leave this parameter empty to keep the current account description

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

Password.description_cn:
修改后的账号密码。修改后的密码需同时满足如下要求：

* 长度为 8~64 个字符。
* 至少包含大写字母、小写字母、数字或特殊字符中的任意 2 种。
* 支持如下特殊字符：
   ```Plain Text
   ()`~!@#$%^&*-+=_|{}[];<>,.?
   ```


若该参数为空，表示不修改账号密码。
Password.description_en:
Modified account password. The new password must meet all of the following requirements:

* Length must be 8–64 characters
* Must include at least two of the following: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, or special characters
* Supports the following special characters:
   ```Plain Text
   ()`~!@#$%^&*-+=_|{}[];<>,.?
   ```

If this parameter is left empty, the account password will not be changed.

RoleName.description_cn:
账号所属角色。支持如下默认角色：

* `Administrator`：允许对所有 Key 使用所有 Redis 实例已支持的命令。
* `ReadWrite`：允许对所有 Key 使用除 `admin` 类之外的所有命令。
* `ReadOnly`：允许对所有 Key 使用 `read` 类中的所有命令。
* `NotDangerous`：允许对所有 Key 使用除 `dangerous` 类之外的所有命令。
* `NotWrite`：允许对所有 KEY 使用除 `write` 类之外的所有命令。

* 若该参数留空，表示不修改账号所属角色。
* default 账号的角色固定为 `Administrator`，不支持修改。
* 关于各角色对应 ACL 规则支持的具体命令详情，请参见 [ACL 语法](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/166234#acl-%E8%AF%AD%E6%B3%95)。
RoleName.description_en:
Account role. The following default roles are supported:

* `Administrator`: Allows all supported commands on all Keys for all Redis instances
* `ReadWrite`: Allows all commands except those in the `admin` category on all Keys
* `ReadOnly`: Allows all commands in the `read` category on all Keys
* `NotDangerous`: Allows all commands except those in the `dangerous` category on all Keys
* `NotWrite`: Allows all commands except those in the `write` category on all Keys

* If this parameter is left empty, the account role will not be changed.
* The role of the default account is fixed as `Administrator` and cannot be changed.
* For details on the specific commands supported by each role's ACL rules, see [ACL Syntax](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/166234#acl-%E8%AF%AD%E6%B3%95).

ApplyImmediately.description_cn:
是否立即执行配置变更操作。取值范围如下：

* `true`：立即变更。
* `false`：在可维护时间段内执行变更。

关于可维护时间段的更多信息，请参见[设置可维护时间段](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70848)。
ApplyImmediately.description_en:
Should configuration changes be applied immediately? Valid values:

* `true`: Apply changes immediately
* `false`: Apply changes during the maintenance window

For more information about the maintenance window, see [Set Maintenance Window](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70848).

BackupPointName.description_cn:
为变更前创建的全量备份设置备份名称。若不设置备份名称，默认使用备份 ID 作为名称。
如需设置备份名称，名称需同时满足如下条件:

* 以中文、字母、下划线（_）开头。
* 长度为 1-128 个字符。
* 由中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）组成。

仅当选择了需要在变更前创建备份（即 `CreateBackup` 为 `true` ）时，该参数生效。
BackupPointName.description_en:
Set a backup name for the full backup created before the change. If you do not set a backup name, the backup ID is used as the name by default.

To set a backup name, make sure it meets all of the following requirements:

* Starts with a Chinese character, letter, or underscore (_)
* The length must be 1–128 characters
* Contains only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)

This parameter is only effective if you choose to create a backup before the change (that is, if `CreateBackup` is set to `true`).

ChangeReplicas.description_en: Do you want to change the number of copies?

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感且不超过 127 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate submissions. The client generates this parameter value; it must be unique for each request, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

ConfigureNodes.description_cn: 设置节点所属的可用区列表。
ConfigureNodes.description_en: Set Availability Zones for the Node

CreateBackup.description_cn:
是否在变更前创建全量备份。取值范围如下：

* `true`：创建备份。
* `false`（默认值）：不创建备份。

* 该参数仅对主备实例（即 `InstanceClass` 取值为 `PrimarySecondary` ）生效。单节点实例（即 `InstanceClass` 取值为 `Standalone` ） 不支持备份功能，因此该参数不会对单节点实例生效。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) 接口查询指定实例的详情信息，包括实例类型。
CreateBackup.description_en:
Whether to create a full backup before making changes. Valid values:

* `true`: Create a backup
* `false` (default): Do not create a backup

* This parameter only applies to primary-secondary instances (when `InstanceClass` is set to `PrimarySecondary`). Single-node instances (when `InstanceClass` is set to `Standalone`) do not support backup, so this parameter does not apply to single-node instances.
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) API to view details of a specified instance, including its type.

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID

MultiAZ.description_cn:
设置实例的可用区部署方案。取值范围如下：

* `enabled`：多可用区部署方案。
* `disabled`：单可用区部署方案。

关于可用区部署方案的更多说明，请参见[多可用区同城容灾解决方案](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70863)。
MultiAZ.description_en:
Configure the instance's availability zone deployment scheme. Available options:

* `enabled`: Multi-availability zone deployment scheme
* `disabled`: Single availability zone deployment scheme

For more information about availability zone deployment schemes, see [Multi-Availability Zone Same-City Disaster Recovery Solution](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70863).

AdditionalBandwidth.description_cn:
设置单分片的额外读、写带宽。设置之后，单分片的额外读、写带宽均为所设数值。单位：MB/s。
* 推荐优先使用 `AdditionalWriteBandwidth` 和 `AdditionalReadBandwidth` 参数来设置单分片的额外读、写带宽。
* 若未设置 `AdditionalWriteBandwidth` 或 `AdditionalReadBandwidth` 参数，则会使用 `AdditionalBandwidth` 所设数值为单分片的额外读、写带宽。
AdditionalBandwidth.description_en:
Set additional read and write bandwidth for a single shard. After setting, the additional read and write bandwidth for the single shard will both be the specified value. Unit: MB/s.
* It is recommended to use the `AdditionalWriteBandwidth` and `AdditionalReadBandwidth` parameters to set additional read and write bandwidth for a single shard.
* If `AdditionalWriteBandwidth` or `AdditionalReadBandwidth` is not set, the value specified by `AdditionalBandwidth` will be used as the additional read and write bandwidth for the single shard.

AdditionalReadBandwidth.description_cn:
设置单分片的额外读带宽，即在默认带宽基础上需要额外增加的读带宽，单位：MB/s。 
额外读带宽取值需同时满足如下条件： 

* 需大于等于 0，取值为 0 时表示不增加额外读带宽，单分片带宽即为默认读带宽。
* 额外读带宽加默认带宽的总和不可超过当前实例允许修改的带宽上限。关于带宽上限的更多详情，请参见[带宽修改范围](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/489147#%E5%B8%A6%E5%AE%BD%E4%BF%AE%E6%94%B9%E8%8C%83%E5%9B%B4)。
* **Redis 实例整体的带宽最大不可超过 2.5GB/s**。因此，实例整体的带宽上限 = min[(分片数 x 单分片带宽上限)，2.5GB/s]。更多详情，请参见[带宽说明](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72111#%E5%B8%A6%E5%AE%BD%E8%AF%B4%E6%98%8E)。
AdditionalReadBandwidth.description_en:
Set the additional read bandwidth for a single shard. This is the extra read bandwidth added on top of the default bandwidth, measured in MB/s.
The value for additional read bandwidth must meet all of the following conditions:

* Must be greater than or equal to 0. If set to 0, no additional read bandwidth is added, and the single shard bandwidth equals the default read bandwidth.
* The sum of the additional read bandwidth and the default bandwidth cannot exceed the maximum bandwidth modification limit allowed for the current instance. For more details about bandwidth limits, see [Bandwidth modification range](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/489147#%E5%B8%A6%E5%AE%BD%E4%BF%AE%E6%94%B9%E8%8C%83%E5%9B%B4).
* **The total bandwidth for a Redis instance cannot exceed 2.5 GB/s.** Therefore, the maximum bandwidth for the instance = min[(number of shards × maximum single shard bandwidth), 2.5 GB/s]. For more details, see [Bandwidth description](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72111#%E5%B8%A6%E5%AE%BD%E8%AF%B4%E6%98%8E).

AdditionalWriteBandwidth.description_cn:
设置单分片的额外写带宽，即在默认带宽基础上需要额外增加的写带宽，单位：MB/s。 
额外写带宽取值需同时满足如下条件： 

* 需大于等于 0，取值为 0 时表示不增加额外写带宽，单分片带宽即为默认写带宽。
* 额外写带宽加默认带宽的总和不可超过当前实例允许修改的带宽上限。关于带宽上限的更多详情，请参见[带宽修改范围](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/489147#%E5%B8%A6%E5%AE%BD%E4%BF%AE%E6%94%B9%E8%8C%83%E5%9B%B4)。
* **Redis 实例整体的带宽最大不可超过 2.5GB/s**。因此，实例整体的带宽上限 = min[(分片数 x 单分片带宽上限)，2.5GB/s]。更多详情，请参见[带宽说明](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72111#%E5%B8%A6%E5%AE%BD%E8%AF%B4%E6%98%8E)。
AdditionalWriteBandwidth.description_en:
Set the additional write bandwidth for a single shard. This is the extra write bandwidth added on top of the default bandwidth, measured in MB/s.
Additional write bandwidth must meet all of the following conditions:

* Must be greater than or equal to 0. If set to 0, no extra write bandwidth is added, and the single shard bandwidth equals the default write bandwidth.
* The sum of additional write bandwidth and default bandwidth cannot exceed the maximum bandwidth allowed for the current instance. For more details about bandwidth limits, see [Bandwidth Modification Range](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/489147#%E5%B8%A6%E5%AE%BD%E4%BF%AE%E6%94%B9%E8%8C%83%E5%9B%B4).
* **The total bandwidth for a Redis instance cannot exceed 2.5 GB/s**. Therefore, the maximum bandwidth for the instance = min[(number of shards × maximum single shard bandwidth), 2.5 GB/s]. For more details, see [Bandwidth Description](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72111#%E5%B8%A6%E5%AE%BD%E8%AF%B4%E6%98%8E).

ChargeType.description_en:

* `PrePaid`: Annual/monthly subscription (also known as prepaid)
* `PostPaid`: Pay-as-you-go (also known as postpaid)

For more information about billing types, see [Billing Types](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/78363).

* You can enter up to 100 instance IDs at a time. Duplicate instance IDs are not allowed
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including instance IDs

* 按年购买：`12`，`24`，`36`。

* 仅当 `ChargeType` 取值为 `PrePaid` 时，该参数生效。
PurchaseMonths.description_en:

* Monthly purchase: `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5`, `6`, `7`, `8`, `9`.
* Annual purchase: `12`, `24`, `36`.

* If this parameter is left blank, the default purchase duration is 1 month.
* This parameter is only effective when `ChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`.

* `true`：立即切换。
* `false`：维护时间段切换。

发起升级小版本操作后，系统会先准备对应版本的节点资源，并在您选择的切换时间内触发主从切换，将新节点提升为主节点。关于可维护时间段的更多信息，请参见[设置可维护时间段](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70848)。
SwitchoverImmediately.description_en:

* `true`: Switch immediately
* `false`: Switch during the maintenance window

After initiating the minor version upgrade, the system will first prepare node resources for the target version, and then trigger a master-slave switchover during your selected time window, promoting the new node to master. For more information about maintenance windows, see [Set Maintenance Window](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70848)

* 以中文、字母、下划线（_）开头。

* 若不设置备份名称，默认使用备份 ID 作为名称。
BackupPointName.description_en:
Set a backup name for the full backup created before the change. The backup name must meet all of the following requirements:

* Starts with a Chinese character, letter, or underscore (_)
* Length is 1–128 characters
* Can include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)

* This parameter is only effective if you choose to create a backup before the change (that is, if `CreateBackup` is set to `true`).
* If you do not set a backup name, the backup ID will be used as the default name.

* `true`：创建备份。
* `false`（默认）：不创建。

* 该参数仅对主备实例（即`InstanceClass`为`PrimarySecondary`）生效。单节点实例（即`InstanceClass`为`Standalone`） 不支持备份功能，无需设置该参数。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) 接口查询指定实例的详情信息，包括实例类型。
CreateBackup.description_en:
Whether to create a backup before making changes. Valid values:

* `true`: Create a backup
* `false` (default): Do not create

* This parameter only applies to primary-secondary instances (`InstanceClass` set to `PrimarySecondary`). Single-node instances (`InstanceClass` set to `Standalone`) do not support backup and do not require this parameter.
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) API to view details of a specified instance, including its type.
