ReserveAdditionalBandwidth.description_cn:
设置是否保留额外带宽。取值范围如下：

* `true`（默认）：保留额外带宽。
* `false`：不保留额外带宽。

* 该参数仅当实例中存在额外带宽时生效。您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceBandwidthPerShard](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72223) 接口查询目标 Redis 的单分片带宽详情，包括默认带宽和额外带宽。
* 保留额外带宽时将遵循如下规则：
   * 实例的单分片总带宽 = 变更后节点规格的默认带宽 + 额外带宽。
   * 额外带宽 = min[ 单分片当前的额外带宽, 变更后节点规格所允许的最大额外带宽 ]。
* 关于修改带宽的更多详情，请参见[修改带宽](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/489147)。
ReserveAdditionalBandwidth.description_en:
Configure whether to retain additional bandwidth. Available values:

* `true` (default): Retain additional bandwidth
* `false`: Do not retain additional bandwidth

* This parameter only takes effect if the instance has additional bandwidth. You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceBandwidthPerShard](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72223) API to view the bandwidth details for each shard of the target Redis instance, including default and additional bandwidth.

* When retaining additional bandwidth, the following rules apply:
   * Total bandwidth per shard = default bandwidth of the new node specification + additional bandwidth
   * Additional bandwidth = min[current additional bandwidth per shard, maximum additional bandwidth allowed by the new node specification]
* For more information about modifying bandwidth, see [Modify Bandwidth](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/489147)

ShardCapacity.description_cn:
每个分片的内存容量，单位：MiB。取值范围如下：

* 若实例为未启用分片集群（即 `ShardedCluster` 取值为 `0` ），每分片内存容量可选取值为：256，512，1024，2048，4096，8192，16384，32768，24576，65536。
* 若实例为启用分片集群（即 `ShardedCluster` 取值为 `1`）时，每分片内存容量可选取值为：1024，2048，4096，8192，16384。

* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) 接口查询指定实例的详情信息，包括实例是否开启分片，以及每个分片中的内存容量。
* 若需要缩小分片容量，需保证实例当前的已用内存不超过新内存总容量（总容量 = 单分片容量 x 分片数量）的 85%。
* 每种实例规格都有对应支持的分片容量和带宽，因此修改实例分片容量的同时，也会同步修改实例的带宽和规格。关于 Redis 实例规格的更多详情，请参见[产品规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72111)。
ShardCapacity.description_en:
Memory capacity per shard, in MiB. The available values are as follows:

* If the instance does not have sharded cluster enabled (that is, `ShardedCluster` is set to `0`), the selectable memory capacity per shard is: 256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384, 32768, 24576, 65536.
* If the instance has sharded cluster enabled (that is, `ShardedCluster` is set to `1`), the selectable memory capacity per shard is: 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384.

* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) API to query details for a specified instance, including whether sharding is enabled and the memory capacity of each shard.
* If you need to reduce shard capacity, make sure the current used memory of the instance does not exceed 85% of the new total memory capacity (total capacity = single shard capacity x number of shards).
* Each instance specification supports corresponding shard capacity and bandwidth. When you modify the shard capacity, the bandwidth and specification of the instance will be updated at the same time. For more details about Redis instance specifications, see [Product Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72111).

ApplyImmediately.description_cn:
是否立即执行配置变更操作。取值范围如下：

* `true`：立即变更。
* `false`：在可维护时间段内执行变更。

关于可维护时间段的更多信息，请参见[设置可维护时间段](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70848)。
ApplyImmediately.description_en:
Apply configuration changes immediately? Valid values:

* `true`: Apply changes now
* `false`: Apply changes during the maintenance window

For more information about the maintenance window, see [Set Maintenance Window](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70848).

BackupPointName.description_cn:
为变更前创建的全量备份设置备份名称。备份名称需同时满足如下条件:

* 以中文、字母、下划线（_）开头。
* 长度为 1-128 个字符。
* 由中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）组成。

* 仅当选择了需要在变更前创建备份（即 `CreateBackup` 为 `true` ）时，该参数生效。
* 若不设置备份名称，默认使用备份 ID 作为名称。
BackupPointName.description_en:
Set a backup name for the full backup created before the change. The backup name must meet all of the following requirements:

* Starts with a Chinese character, letter, or underscore (_)
* Length is 1–128 characters
* Can include Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)

* This parameter is only effective if you select to create a backup before the change (that is, when `CreateBackup` is set to `true`)
* If you do not set a backup name, the backup ID will be used as the default name

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感且不超过 127 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate submissions. The client generates this parameter value; it must be unique for each request, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

CreateBackup.description_cn:
是否在变更前创建备份。取值范围如下：

* `true`：创建备份。
* `false`（默认值）：不创建。

* 该参数仅对主备实例（即 `InstanceClass` 为 `PrimarySecondary` ）生效。单节点实例（即 `InstanceClass` 为 `Standalone` ） 不支持备份功能，无需设置该参数。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) 接口查询指定实例的详情信息，包括实例类型。
CreateBackup.description_en:
Whether to create a backup before making changes. Valid values:

* `true`: Create a backup
* `false` (default): Do not create a backup

* This parameter only applies to primary/secondary instances (`InstanceClass` set to `PrimarySecondary`). Standalone instances (`InstanceClass` set to `Standalone`) do not support backups, so you do not need to set this parameter.
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) API to view details of a specified instance, including its type.

Initiator.description_cn: 请求发起者，为空表示SDK发起，"WEB"表示前端页面调用，Inner表示内部调用（修改实例规格发送的子命令）
Initiator.description_en: Request initiator: leave blank to indicate SDK initiation, 'WEB' for frontend page call, 'Inner' for internal call (sub-command sent when modifying instance specifications)

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information about all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

ModifyType.description_cn: 变配类型, Usually：常规变配；Temporary：弹性升配（临时升配）
ModifyType.description_en: Change Type: Usually: Regular Change; Temporary: Flexible Upgrade (i.e., Temporary Upgrade)

ShardNumber.description_cn:
实例中的分片数量。取值范围为 2~256。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) 接口查询指定实例的详情信息，包括实例是否已启用分片以及分片数量。
* 若需要缩减分片数量，需保证实例当前的已用内存不超过新内存总容量（总容量 = 单分片容量 x 分片数量）的 85%。
ShardNumber.description_en:
Number of shards in the instance. Valid range: 2–256.
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) API to query details of a specified instance, including whether sharding is enabled and the number of shards.
* To reduce the number of shards, ensure that the current used memory does not exceed 85% of the new total memory capacity (total capacity = per-shard capacity × number of shards).

CheckAZ.description_cn: 是否检查subnet的AZ是否和实例的AZ匹配，默认为true
CheckAZ.description_en: Whether to check if the subnet AZ matches the instance AZ; default is true

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感且不超过 127 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate submissions. The client generates this parameter; it must be unique across requests, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to view basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

RetentionDays.description_cn:
设置旧 IP 地址的释放时间。取值范围如下：

* `0`：立即释放。
* `1`（默认值）：1 天后释放。
* `2`：2 天后释放。
* `3`：3 天后释放。
* `7`：7 天后释放。

修改私有网络和子网不会改变私网地址或直连地址域名，但其对应的 IP 地址将会发生变化。建议在旧 IP 地址释放前，及时对客户端缓存进行清理，否则可能会出现读写异常的情况。更多详情，请参见[修改私有网络或子网](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/109850)。
RetentionDays.description_en:
Set the release time for the old IP address. Available options:

* `0`: Release immediately
* `1` (default): Release after 1 day
* `2`: Release after 2 days
* `3`: Release after 3 days
* `7`: Release after 7 days

Modifying a private network or subnet does not change the private network address or direct connection address domain name, but the corresponding IP address will change. It is recommended to clear the client cache before the old IP address is released to avoid read/write errors. For more details, see [Modify Private Network or Subnet](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/109850).

SubnetId.description_cn:
设置实例的子网 ID。
* 子网具有可用区属性，必须选择目标私有网络中与实例属于同一可用区下的子网。
* 子网是私有网络内的 IP 地址块私有网络中的所有云资源都必须部署在子网内，子网为云资源分配私网 IP 地址，您可以调用 [CreateSubnet](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70496) 接口创建子网。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) 接口查询指定可用区内的所有子网列表信息，包括子网 ID。
SubnetId.description_en:
Set the subnet ID for the instance.
* Subnets have an availability zone attribute. You must select a subnet in the target VPC that is in the same availability zone as the instance.
* A subnet is an IP address block within a VPC. All cloud resources in the VPC must be deployed in a subnet. Subnets assign private IP addresses to cloud resources. You can use the [CreateSubnet](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70496) API to create a subnet.
* You can use the [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) API to view all subnets in a specified availability zone, including their subnet IDs.

VpcId.description_cn:
设置实例的私有网络 ID。
* 若输入了实例当前所属的私有网络 ID，表示不修改私有网络，仅修改子网。
* 建议 Redis 实例与需要连接的 ECS 实例在同一私有网络，否则它们无法通过内网互通来实现最佳性能。您可以调用 [CreateVpc](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70492) 接口创建私有网络。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) 接口查询符合指定条件的私有网络信息，包括私有网络 ID。
VpcId.description_en:
Set the private network ID for the instance
* If you enter the current private network ID of the instance, only the subnet will be changed, and the private network will remain unchanged
* For optimal performance, place the Redis instance and the ECS instance you want to connect to in the same private network. Otherwise, they cannot communicate over the internal network. You can use the [CreateVpc](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70492) API to create a private network
* You can use the [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) API to query private network information that meets specified criteria, including the private network ID

AddrType.description_cn:
需要地址前缀的连接地址类型。取值范围如下： 

* `Public`：公网地址。 
* `Private`：私网地址。 
* `DirectLink`：直连地址。

* 如需修改直连地址或公网地址的连接地址，需要先申请对应的连接地址。直连地址和公网地址的申请方法，请参见[申请直连地址](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71643)和[开启公网访问](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71640)。
* 关于 Redis 连接地址的更多信息，请参见[连接地址类型](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/78049#%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E5%9C%B0%E5%9D%80%E7%B1%BB%E5%9E%8B)。
AddrType.description_en:
Connection address types that require an address prefix. Available values:

* `Public`: Public address
* `Private`: Private address
* `DirectLink`: DirectLink address

* To modify a DirectLink or public connection address, you must first apply for the corresponding connection address. For details on how to apply for DirectLink and public connection addresses, see [Apply for DirectLink Address](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71643) and [Enable Public Access](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71640).
* For more information about Redis connection addresses, see [Connection Address Types](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/78049#%E8%BF%9E%E6%8E%A5%E5%9C%B0%E5%9D%80%E7%B1%BB%E5%9E%8B)

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感且不超过 127 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate request submissions. The client generates this parameter; it must be unique across different requests, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

NewAddressPrefix.description_cn:
修改后的连接地址前缀。连接地址前缀需同时满足如下要求：

* 由小写字母、数字或连字符（-）组成。
* 以字母开头，字母或数字结尾。
* 长度为 8~53 个字符。
* 修改后的连接地址需要保证全局唯一，不可以与火山引擎中任何地域下的任何连接地址重名。

* 若该参数不填，表示不修改连接地址前缀。
* 当需要升级域名后缀（即 `UpgradeRegionDomain` 为 `true`）时，必须同时传入连接地址前缀信息（即 `NewAddressPrefix` 参数不允许为空。）
* 当不需要升级域名后缀（即 `UpgradeRegionDomain` 为 `false`）时，您需至少在 `NewAddressPrefix` 或 `NewPort` 参数中选择一项进行修改。
* 修改连接地址后，原有的连接会断开。请及时修改客户端的连接信息，使用新的连接地址来连接实例。连接实例的具体方法，请参见[连接实例](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70857)。
* 当前仅支持修改连接地址前缀，即 `redis.ivolces.com` 或 `redis.volces.com` 之前的部分。更多详情，请参见[修改连接地址](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/993733)。
NewAddressPrefix.description_en:
Modified connection address prefix. The connection address prefix must meet all of the following requirements:

* Consists of lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens (-)
* Starts with a letter and ends with a letter or number
* Length is 8 to 53 characters
* The modified connection address must be globally unique and cannot duplicate any connection address in any region of Volcengine

* If this parameter is left blank, the connection address prefix will not be modified
* If you need to upgrade the domain suffix (that is, `UpgradeRegionDomain` is `true`), you must also provide the connection address prefix (`NewAddressPrefix` cannot be empty)
* If you do not need to upgrade the domain suffix (that is, `UpgradeRegionDomain` is `false`), you must modify at least one of the `NewAddressPrefix` or `NewPort` parameters
* After modifying the connection address, existing connections will be disconnected. Please update your client connection information promptly and use the new connection address to connect to the instance. For details on how to connect to an instance, see [Connect to Instance](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70857)
* Currently, only the connection address prefix can be modified, which is the part before `redis.ivolces.com` or `redis.volces.com`. For more information, see [Modify Connection Address](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/993733)

NewPort.description_cn:
修改后的连接地址端口号。连接地址类型不同，支持的端口号取值范围不同：

* 私网地址和公网地址支持的端口号范围均为 1024~65535。
* 直连地址支持的端口号范围为 1024~4000 和 5100~64512。

* 若该参数不填，表示不修改连接地址的端口号。
* 当不需要升级域名后缀（即 `UpgradeRegionDomain` 为 `false`）时，您需至少在 `NewAddressPrefix` 或 `NewPort` 参数中选择一项进行修改。
* 修改连接地址或端口号后，原有的连接会断开。请及时修改客户端的连接信息，使用新的端口号来连接实例。连接实例的具体方法，请参见[连接实例](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70857)。
* 修改端口会将导致部分服务的访问在短时间内受到影响，请谨慎操作。更多详情，请参见[修改端口号](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/81348)。
NewPort.description_en:
Modified connection address port number. Supported port ranges vary by address type:

* Private and public addresses support ports in the range 1024–65535
* Direct connection addresses support ports in the ranges 1024–4000 and 5100–64512

* If this parameter is left blank, the port number of the connection address will not be changed
* If you do not need to upgrade the domain suffix (that is, `UpgradeRegionDomain` is `false`), you must modify at least one of the `NewAddressPrefix` or `NewPort` parameters
* After modifying the connection address or port number, existing connections will be disconnected. Please update your client connection settings promptly and use the new port number to connect to the instance. For details on how to connect to an instance, see [Connect to Instance](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70857)
* Changing the port may temporarily affect access to some services. Proceed with caution. For more information, see [Modify Port Number](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/81348)

UpgradeRegionDomain.description_cn:
是否升级连接地址的域名后缀。取值范围如下：

* `true`：升级。
* `false`（默认值）：不升级。

* 当需要升级域名后缀（即 `UpgradeRegionDomain` 为 `true`）时，必须同时传入连接地址前缀信息（即 `NewAddressPrefix` 参数不允许为空。）
* 升级域名后缀后，原有的连接会断开，请及时修改客户端的连接信息，使用新的连接地址来连接实例。连接实例的具体方法，请参见[连接实例](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70857)。
* 连接地址域名后缀升级后不支持再降级回原来的后缀，请谨慎操作。
* 升级后的连接地址域名后缀会自动包含实例所属地域信息，即域名后缀会由 `redis.ivolces.com`（或 `redis.volces.com`）变为`redis.{Region ID}.ivolces.com`（ 或 `redis.{Region ID}.volces.com`），旧的连接地址会保留 12 小时，12 小时保留期到期后会被自动释放。更多详情，请参见[升级域名后缀](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1467348)。
UpgradeRegionDomain.description_en:
Whether to upgrade the domain suffix of the connection address. Valid values:

* `true`: Upgrade
* `false` (default): Do not upgrade

* If you want to upgrade the domain suffix (that is, set `UpgradeRegionDomain` to `true`), you must also provide the connection address prefix (`NewAddressPrefix` cannot be empty)
* After upgrading the domain suffix, existing connections will be disconnected. Update your client connection settings promptly and use the new connection address to connect to the instance. For details on how to connect to an instance, see [Connect to Instance](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70857)
* Once the domain suffix is upgraded, you cannot revert to the original suffix. Proceed with caution
* The upgraded domain suffix will automatically include the region information of the instance. The domain suffix will change from `redis.ivolces.com` (or `redis.volces.com`) to `redis.{Region ID}.ivolces.com` (or `redis.{Region ID}.volces.com`). The old connection address will be retained for 12 hours and will be automatically released after the retention period expires. For more details, see [Upgrade Domain Suffix](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1467348)

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感且不超过 127 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency and prevents duplicate submissions. The client generates this parameter value, which must be unique for each request, case-sensitive, and no longer than 127 ASCII characters.

InstanceId.description_cn:
实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

VpcAuthMode.description_cn:
开启或关闭免密访问功能。取值范围如下：

* `open`：开启免密访问。
* `close`：关闭免密访问。

* 参数取值不区分大小写。
* 关于免密访问的更多信息，请参见[免密访问](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/94328)。
VpcAuthMode.description_en:
Enable or disable password-free access. Available values:

* `open`: Enable password-free access
* `close`: Disable password-free access

* Values are not case-sensitive
* For more information about password-free access, see [Password-Free Access](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/94328)

ApplyImmediately.description_cn:
是否立即执行配置变更操作。取值范围如下：

* `true`：立即变更。
* `false`：在可维护时间段内执行变更。

关于可维护时间段的更多信息，请参见[设置可维护时间段](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1262363)。
ApplyImmediately.description_en:
Apply configuration changes immediately? Available options:

* `true`: Apply changes immediately
* `false`: Apply changes during the maintenance window

For more information about the maintenance window, see [Set Maintenance Window](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1262363).

BackupPointName.description_cn:
为变更前创建的全量备份设置备份名称。如需设置备份名称，名称需同时满足如下条件:

* 以中文、字母、下划线（_）开头。
* 长度为 1-128 个字符。
* 由中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）组成。

* 该参数仅当选择了在变更前创建全量备份（即 `CreateBackup` 为 `true` ）时生效。
* 若不设置备份名称，默认使用备份 ID 作为名称。
BackupPointName.description_en:
Set a backup name for the full backup created before the change. If you set a backup name, it must meet all of the following requirements:

* Starts with a Chinese character, letter, or underscore (_)
* Length is 1–128 characters
* May only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)

* This parameter is only effective if you choose to create a full backup before the change (that is, when `CreateBackup` is set to `true`)
* If you do not set a backup name, the backup ID will be used as the default name

实例的数据存储形态不同，该参数的取值范围不同，其中：

* 混存型实例（即实例的  `DataLayout` 取值为 `Hybrid`）：10240~30720（即 10GiB~30GiB），步长为 10240MiB，（即 10GiB）。
* 内存型实例（即实例的  `DataLayout` 取值为 `RAM`）：取值必须为 0，即不支持使用高速存储容量。

* 您可以调用 [DescribeEnterpriseDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1168033) 接口查询目标 Redis 企业版的实例详情，包括实例的数据存储形态。

FlashPerShard.description_en:

* For hybrid instances (DataLayout set to `Hybrid`): 10240–30720 MiB (10–30 GiB), with increments of 10240 MiB (10 GiB)
* For memory instances (DataLayout set to `RAM`): Must be 0; high-speed storage capacity is not supported

* You can call the [DescribeEnterpriseDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1168033) API to view details of your target Redis Enterprise Edition instance, including its data storage type
* For more information about data storage types in Enterprise Edition instances, see [Data Storage Type](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/84772/1258077#%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E5%AD%98%E5%82%A8%E5%BD%A2%E6%80%81)

TimeScope.description_cn:
设置实例的可维护时间段范围，格式为 `HH:mm-HH:mm`（UTC+8）。
* 传入的可维护时间段范围中，起始时间的 `mm` 必须为 `00`，结束时间的 `mm` 必须为 `59`。例如，您可以设置可维护时间段为 `00:00-01:59`。
* 为保证任务能够在可维护时间段内正常进行，可维护时间段的开始和结束时间间隔需大于等于 2 小时且小于等于 24 小时。
TimeScope.description_en:
Set the maintenance window range for the instance in the format `HH:mm-HH:mm` (UTC+8).
* For the maintenance window you enter, the start time's `mm` must be `00` and the end time's `mm` must be `59`. For example, you can set the maintenance window to `00:00-01:59`.
* To ensure tasks run properly during the maintenance window, the interval between the start and end times must be at least 2 hours and no more than 24 hours.

Description.description_cn:
参数模板的备注信息，长度不可超过 200 个字符。
* 若不设置该参数，表示不修改参数模板的备注信息。
* 若传入空字符串（即 `"Description":""`），表示清空参数模板的备注信息。
Description.description_en:
The parameter template description must not exceed 200 characters.
* If you do not set this parameter, the parameter template description will not be modified.
* If you set or pass in an empty string (i.e., "Description": ""), the parameter template description will be cleared.

Name.description_cn:
参数模板名称。
* 若不需要修改原参数模板的名称，直接输入原参数模板的的名称即可。您可以调用 [DescribeParameterGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1415106) 接口查询当前账号和地域下所有的参数模板基本信息，包括参数模板名称。
* 若需修改参数模板名称，直接输入新的参数模板名称即可。名称需同时满足如下要求：
   * 不能以数字、中划线（-）开头。
   * 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和中划线（-）。
   * 长度需为 2~64 个字符。
Name.description_en:
Parameter Template Name
* If you do not need to change the original parameter template name, enter the original parameter template name directly. You can call the [DescribeParameterGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1415106) API to view basic information for all parameter templates under your account and region, including the template name.
* To change the parameter template name, enter a new name directly. The name must meet all of the following requirements:
   * Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
   * Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
   * Must be 2–64 characters long

ParamValues.description_cn:
修改后的参数模板中需要包含的参数信息列表。
* 每个参数模板中需至少存在一个参数。
* 更多关于 Redis 支持的参数详情，请参见[参数支持](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72120)。
ParamValues.description_en:
Parameters to Include in the Modified Parameter Template
* Each parameter template must include at least one parameter.
* For more details about supported Redis parameters, see [Parameter Support](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/72120).

ParameterGroupId.description_cn:
参数模板 ID。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeParameterGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1415106) 接口查询当前账号和地域下所有的参数模板基本信息，包括参数模板 ID。
* 仅自定义参数模板（即 `Source` 取值为 `User`）支持编辑，系统参数模板（即 `Source` 取值为 `System`）不可编辑。更多详情，请参见[编辑参数模板](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1131865)。
ParameterGroupId.description_en:
Parameter Template ID
* You can call the [DescribeParameterGroups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1415106) API to query basic information for all parameter templates under your account and region, including the parameter template ID.
* Only custom parameter templates (where `Source` is set to `User`) can be edited; system parameter templates (where `Source` is set to `System`) cannot be edited. For more details, see [Edit Parameter Template](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1131865).

需要修改执行时间的计划内事件 ID。仅 `CanModifyTime` 值为 `true` 的计划内事件允许修改执行时间。
* 您可以调用 [DescribePlannedEvents](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1467105) 接口查询目标 Redis 实例在指定时间段的计划内事件信息，包括是否允许修改执行时间以及事件 ID。
* 支持一次传入多个事件 ID，多个 ID 间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
EventIds.description_en:
The scheduled event ID whose execution time needs to be modified. Only scheduled events with `CanModifyTime` set to `true` allow execution time changes.
* You can call the [DescribePlannedEvents](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1467105) API to query scheduled event details for the target Redis instance within a specified time range, including whether execution time modification is allowed and the event ID.
* You can enter multiple event IDs at once, separated by English commas (,).

TargetEndTime.description_cn:
修改后的计划结束时间，格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
计划结束时间需晚于计划开始时间，但需早于当前事件所允许的最晚可推迟时间。您可以调用 [DescribePlannedEvents](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1467105) 接口查询目标 Redis 实例在指定时间段的计划内事件信息，包括最晚可推迟时间（即返回结果中 `MaxEndTime`的值）。
TargetEndTime.description_en:
Modified planned end time, format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC)
The planned end time must be later than the planned start time, but earlier than the latest postponement time allowed for the current event. You can call the [DescribePlannedEvents](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1467105) API to query scheduled event information for the target Redis instance within a specified time range, including the latest postponement time (returned as `MaxEndTime`).

* You can call the [DescribeBackups](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65766) API to query all backup information for a specified instance, including the backup ID (the value of the `BackupPointId` parameter in the response).

BackupType.description_cn:
恢复方式。取值范围如下：

* `Full`（默认值）：选择备份方式为 `Full`（即全量备份）的备份文件进行恢复，即按备份集恢复。
* `Inc`：选择备份方式为 `Inc`（即增量备份）的备份文件进行恢复，即按时间点恢复。

* 若需要按时间点恢复（即 `BackupType` 为 `Inc` ），需先开启数据闪回功能。更多详情，请参见[按时间点恢复到原实例](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/79880#%E6%81%A2%E5%A4%8D%E5%88%B0%E5%8E%9F%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B)。
* 您可以调用 [StartContinuousBackup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71803) 接口为指定实例开启数据闪回功能。
BackupType.description_en:
Recovery mode. Available options:

* `Full` (default): Restore using backup files created with the `Full` (full backup) method. This restores by backup set.
* `Inc`: Restore using backup files created with the `Inc` (incremental backup) method. This restores by point in time.

* To restore by point in time (`BackupType` set to `Inc`), you must enable the data flashback feature first. For details, see [Restore to original instance by point in time](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/79880#%E6%81%A2%E5%A4%8D%E5%88%B0%E5%8E%9F%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B).
* You can call the [StartContinuousBackup](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/71803) API to enable the data flashback feature for a specified instance.

InstanceId.description_en:
Instance ID
* Only primary-secondary instances (where `InstanceClass` is set to `PrimarySecondary`) support this API. Single-node instances (where `InstanceClass` is set to `Standalone`) always have one node and do not support master-slave node switching.
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

TargetPrimaryNodeId.description_cn:
需要进行主从切换的从节点 ID。
* `TargetPrimaryNodeIds` 和 `TargetPrimaryNodeId` 参数不允许同时为空；若同时设置了上述两个参数，优先使用 `TargetPrimaryNodeIds` 所设参数值。
* 传入节点的当前角色必须为从节点（即 `CurrentRole` 取值为 `SecondaryNode` ）。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceShards](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1148756) 接口查询目标 Redis 实例下各 Shard 分片的 Server 节点详情，包括节点 ID 和节点角色。
TargetPrimaryNodeId.description_en:
Replica node ID for master-slave switchover
* The `TargetPrimaryNodeIds` and `TargetPrimaryNodeId` parameters cannot both be empty; if both parameters are set, the value of `TargetPrimaryNodeIds` takes precedence
* The current role of the input node must be replica (that is, `CurrentRole` is `SecondaryNode`)
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceShards](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1148756) API to query details of Server nodes for each shard in the target Redis instance, including node ID and node role

TargetPrimaryNodeIds.description_cn:
需要进行批量主从切换的从节点 ID 列表。
* 最多支持同时为 50 个分片进行批量切主。
* 批量切主时，最多允许从每个分片中选择 1 个从节点进行切换。
* `TargetPrimaryNodeIds` 和 `TargetPrimaryNodeId` 参数不允许同时为空；若同时设置了上述两个参数，优先使用 `TargetPrimaryNodeIds` 所设参数值。
* 传入节点的当前角色必须为从节点（即 `CurrentRole` 取值为 `SecondaryNode` ）。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceShards](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1148756) 接口查询目标 Redis 实例下各 Shard 分片的 Server 节点详情，包括节点 ID 和节点角色。
TargetPrimaryNodeIds.description_en:
List of replica node IDs for batch master-slave switchover
* Supports batch switchover for up to 50 shards at the same time
* When performing batch switchover, you can select up to 1 replica node from each shard for switchover
* The `TargetPrimaryNodeIds` and `TargetPrimaryNodeId` parameters cannot both be empty; if both parameters are set, the value of `TargetPrimaryNodeIds` takes precedence
* The current role of the input node must be replica (that is, `CurrentRole` is `SecondaryNode`)
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceShards](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1148756) API to query details of Server nodes for each shard in the target Redis instance, including node ID and node role

ApplyImmediately.description_cn:
是否立即执行蓝绿切换操作。取值范围如下：

* `true`：立即切换。
* `false`：在可维护时间段内执行切换。

若选择了在可维护时间段执行，蓝绿部署会进入**等待切换**状态，且该状态会一直持续到任务完成。关于蓝绿部署状态的更多说明，请参见[蓝绿部署状态](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/2096775#NFCgYsLA)。可维护时间段的设置方法，请参见[设置可维护时间段](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70848)。
ApplyImmediately.description_en:
Whether to perform the blue-green switchover immediately. The value range is as follows:

* `true`: Switch immediately
* `false`: Switch during the maintenance window

If you choose to switch during the maintenance window, the blue-green deployment enters the **Waiting for Switchover** state, which will persist until the task is completed. For more information about blue-green deployment states, see [Blue-Green Deployment States](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/2096775#NFCgYsLA). For instructions on setting the maintenance window, see [Set Maintenance Window](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/70848).

SourceInstanceId.description_cn:
源实例（即蓝色实例）的实例 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) 接口查询目标地域下所有 Redis 实例的基本信息，包括实例 ID。
SourceInstanceId.description_en:
Source instance (the blue instance) ID.
You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65754) API to query basic information for all Redis instances in the target region, including instance IDs.

FailbackToPrimaryDelayInMinutes.description_cn:
自动切换回主可用区前的故障持续时间。单位：分钟。取值范围如下：

* 5。
* 10。
* 15。

* 仅当为实例的主可用区（即调用 [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) 接口的返回结果中， `ZoneIds`  返回的第一个可用区）模拟故障切换时，该参数生效。 
* 若该参数留空，表示不需要自动切换回主可用区。那么故障切换完成后，可能出现主节点位于备可用区，备节点位于主可用区的情况。您可以在故障切换完成后，调用 [ModifyDBInstanceAZConfigure](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65762) 接口手动切换实例的可用区。
FailbackToPrimaryDelayInMinutes.description_en:
Duration of the fault before automatically switching back to the primary availability zone. Unit: minutes. Valid values:

* 5
* 10
* 15

* This parameter only takes effect when simulating a failover for the instance's primary availability zone (that is, the first availability zone returned in the `ZoneIds` field when calling the [DescribeDBInstanceDetail](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65755) API).
* If this parameter is left blank, automatic failback to the primary availability zone will not occur. After failover, the primary node may be located in the secondary availability zone, and the secondary node may be in the primary availability zone. You can manually switch the instance's availability zone after failover by calling the [ModifyDBInstanceAZConfigure](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65762) API.

FailedZoneId.description_cn:
模拟故障发生的可用区 ID。
您可以调用 [DescribeZones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65753) 接口查询 Redis 在指定地域下的所有可用区信息，包括可用区 ID。
FailedZoneId.description_en:
ID of the availability zone where the simulated failure occurs
You can call the [DescribeZones](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/65753) API to query all availability zone information for Redis in the specified region, including the availability zone ID

ProxyNodeIds.description_cn:
模拟故障发生的 Proxy 节点 ID。
支持同时传入多个节点，多个节点间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeNodeIds](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/127841) 接口查询目标实例包含的所有节点信息，包括 Proxy 节点 ID 信息。
* 若该参数留空，表示不为实例中的任何 Proxy 节点模拟故障切换。
ProxyNodeIds.description_en:
Proxy node IDs for simulating failures
You can specify multiple nodes at once, separated by English commas (,)
* You can call the [DescribeNodeIds](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/127841) API to query all node information for the target instance, including Proxy node IDs
* If this parameter is left empty, no failover simulation will be performed for any Proxy node in the instance

ServerShardIds.description_cn:
模拟故障发生的 Server 主节点所属的分片 ID。
支持同时传入多个分片，多个分片间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
* 您可以调用 [DescribeDBInstanceShards](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1148756) 接口查询目标 Redis 实例下各 Shard 分片的详情，包括 Shard ID。
* 若该参数留空，表示不为实例中的任何 Server 主节点模拟故障切换。
ServerShardIds.description_en:
Shard ID of the shard to which the Server primary node (where the failure is simulated) belongs
You can specify multiple shards at the same time, separated by English commas (,)
* You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceShards](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6293/1148756) API to query details of each shard in the target Redis instance, including the Shard ID
* If this parameter is left empty, no failover simulation will be performed for any Server primary node in the instance

该标识为 1~64 位的 ASCII 字符串，大小写敏感，由客户端生成，应确保不同请求之间该标识具有唯一性。
如何使用幂等标识，请参考[请求幂等性](/docs/6410/1160436)。
ClientToken.description_en:
Identifier to ensure idempotency of client requests.
This identifier is a case-sensitive ASCII string of 1 to 64 characters, generated by the client. It must be unique for each request.
For details on how to use the idempotency identifier, see [Request Idempotency](/docs/6410/1160436).

ComputeSpec.description_cn:
实例的计算规格。
您可以在[产品规格](/docs/6410/105397)中查看目前在售的计算规格列表。
ComputeSpec.description_en:
Instance computing specifications
You can view the list of currently available computing specifications in [Product Specifications](/docs/6410/105397)

EipId.description_cn:
EIP 的 ID。
- 指定 EipId 表示开启实例的公网访问。
- EIP 提供独立的公网 IP 资源，包括公网 IP 地址与公网出口带宽服务。指定此参数开启公网访问后，公网地址将绑定您的弹性公网IP（EIP），费用由EIP收取。
EipId.description_en:
EIP ID
- Specifying EipId enables public access for the instance.
- EIP provides independent public IP resources, including public IP addresses and outbound bandwidth services. After enabling public access by specifying this parameter, the public address will be bound to your Elastic IP (EIP), and charges will be billed to your EIP.

EnableSSL.description_cn: 是否使用 SSL 加密。

FileReservedTime.description_cn: 消息在消息队列 RocketMQ版服务端的保留时长，超过保留时长的消息将被过期清理。单位为小时，取值范围为 1~72 小时。
FileReservedTime.description_en: Message retention period on the RocketMQ message queue server. Messages that exceed the retention period will be removed as expired. Unit: hours; valid range: 1~72 hours.

IPVersionType.description_cn: IP 版本， 可选直为 IPv4 或者 DualStack。
IPVersionType.description_en: IP version, selectable as IPv4 or DualStack

InstanceDescription.description_cn: 实例的简单描述。长度范围为 1~128 个字符。
InstanceDescription.description_en:
Brief description of the instance
Length: 1–128 characters

InstanceName.description_cn:
实例的名称。 需满足以下要求：
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）和连字符（-）。
- 不能以数字和连字符（-）开头。
- 长度范围为 1~128 个字符。

如果创建实例时未指定名称，则默认将实例 ID 作为实例名称。
InstanceName.description_en:
Instance name must meet the following requirements:
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
- Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

If no name is specified when creating the instance, the instance ID will be used as the default instance name

NetworkTypes.description_cn: 实例网络类型，固定为 PrivateNetwork。
NetworkTypes.description_en: The instance network type is always PrivateNetwork

ProjectName.description_cn: 当前创建的实例所属的 IAM 项目。若未设置，则会将新实例绑定到名为 default 的 IAM 项目中。
ProjectName.description_en: IAM project for the instance being created. If not set, the new instance will be assigned to the IAM project named default.

SSLMode.description_cn:
实例的公网连接策略，仅在开启公网访问时需要设置。支持设置为：
- enforcing：通过公网访问实例时，必须经由 SSL 认证。SSL 认证可实现数据的加密传输，相较于普通公网访问方式具备更高的安全性，但性能会有所下降。
- permissive：通过公网访问实例时，可以选择是否经由 SSL 认证。
创建实例后，公网访问为开启状态时，不能修改 SSL 连接策略。如需修改，需要为实例关闭并重新开启公网访问，在重新开启时再次设置 SSL 连接策略。详细说明请参考[设置公网访问与 SSL 认证策略](/docs/6410/107703)。
SSLMode.description_en:
The public network connection policy for an instance only needs to be set when public access is enabled. You can choose from:
- enforcing: When accessing the instance via the public network, SSL authentication is required. SSL authentication encrypts data transmission, providing higher security compared to standard public access, but may reduce performance.
- permissive: When accessing the instance via the public network, SSL authentication is optional.
After the instance is created and public access is enabled, you cannot modify the SSL connection policy. To change it, you must disable public access for the instance and then re-enable it, setting the SSL connection policy again during re-enablement. For details, see [Set Public Access and SSL Authentication Policy](/docs/6410/107703).

StorageSpace.description_cn:
实例的存储空间。
单位为 GiB，必须指定为 100 的倍数。取值范围取决于当前指定的计算规格。
StorageSpace.description_en:
Instance storage space
Unit: GiB. Must be specified as a multiple of 100. The valid range depends on the currently specified compute specification.

StorageType.description_cn: 存储类型，内部使用
StorageType.description_en: Storage type, internal use

SubnetId.description_cn:
实例所在的 VPC 子网 ID。
- 实例创建完成后，不可修改对应的私有网络和子网。创建实例时请谨慎操作。
- 您可以调用私有网络（VPC）的 DescribeVpcs 接口查询可用的VPC和子网列表。
SubnetId.description_en:
VPC subnet ID where the instance is located
- After the instance is created, you cannot modify the associated VPC or subnet. Please be careful when creating an instance
- You can call the DescribeVpcs API to query the list of available VPCs and subnets

Tags.description_cn: 云资源标签。可以将实例通过标签进行归类，便于实例的搜索和资源聚合。详细说明请参考[标签概述](https://arcosite.bytedance.net/sites/1677223719896/63f867602dbaa10221c6b523/editor/65ae2823e386540302559854/?docLang=zh&bv=65ae2822e38654030255980c)。
Tags.description_en: Cloud Resource Tags. Use tags to categorize instances for easier search and resource aggregation. For details, see [Tag overview](https://arcosite.bytedance.net/sites/1677223719896/63f867602dbaa10221c6b523/editor/65ae2823e386540302559854/?docLang=zh&bv=65ae2822e38654030255980c).

Version.description_cn:
支持的 RocketMQ 版本。当前支持的版本包括：
- 4.8：兼容 RocketMQ 4.x 版本系列。
- 5.x：兼容 RocketMQ 5.x 版本系列。目前 5.x 版本处于加白阶段，如需使用请联系技术支持申请开白。
Version.description_en:
Supported RocketMQ versions
Currently supported versions include:
- 4.8: Compatible with the RocketMQ 4.x series
- 5.x: Compatible with the RocketMQ 5.x series. The 5.x version is currently available by whitelist only; to use it, please contact technical support to request access

VpcId.description_cn:

- 实例创建完成后，不可修改对应的私有网络和子网。创建实例时请谨慎操作。

VpcId.description_en:
VPC ID where the instance resides
- After the instance is created, you cannot modify the corresponding VPC or subnet. Please be careful when creating the instance.
- You can call the DescribeVpcs API to query the list of available VPCs and subnets.

ZoneId.description_cn:

When viewing which compute specifications are available in a specified availability zone, you can specify multiple availability zones. Separate multiple availability zone IDs with commas (,). You can call [DescribeAvailabilityZones](/docs/6410/1112351) to query the list of availability zones currently providing services.

实例变更后的存储空间。如需扩容存储空间，此参数必选。

InstanceIds.description_cn:

InstanceIds.description_en:
Instance IDs to bind tags to
You can enter multiple instance IDs at once, up to 50 at the same time

Tags.description_cn:

- 支持一次传入多组标签键值对像，多组标签键值对像间用英文逗号（,）分隔。最多同时传入 20 组标签键值对。
- 标签键值需满足设置规则，详细信息请参见[标签设置规则](/docs/6410/177940#标签设置规则)。
Tags.description_en:
Array of tag keys and tag values to be bound
- You can enter multiple tag key-value pairs at once, separated by commas. You can enter up to 20 pairs at once
- Tag keys and values must follow the configuration rules. For details, see [Tag configuration rules](/docs/6410/177940#标签设置规则)

AllowListIds.description_cn: 需要绑定的白名单 ID 列表。
AllowListIds.description_en: List of whitelist IDs to be bound

InstanceIds.description_cn: 需要绑定白名单的实例 ID 列表。
InstanceIds.description_en: List of Instance IDs to Bind to Whitelist

AccessKey.description_cn: 指定 RocketMQ 密钥 ID。 长度限制为 7～128 字符，字符限制为大小写字母或数字。设置 SecretKey 时必选
AccessKey.description_en: Specify the RocketMQ key ID. The length must be 7–128 characters and can only include uppercase or lowercase letters or numbers. Required when setting SecretKey

AllAuthority.description_cn:
此 RocketMQ 密钥是否默认具备所有 Topic 的读写权限。
- `ALL`：拥有发布、订阅权限
- `PUB`：拥有发布权限
- `SUB`：拥有订阅权限
- `DENY`（默认）：不具备发布和订阅权限
AllAuthority.description_en:
Does this RocketMQ key have default read and write access to all Topics? Default: Deny
- ALL: Can publish and subscribe
- PUB: Can publish
- SUB: Can subscribe
- DENY: No publish or subscribe access

Description.description_cn:
RocketMQ 密钥的描述信息，用于有效区分和管理密钥。长度限制为 0～128 个字符。
创建密钥后，推荐调用 DescribeAccessKeys 接口查看已创建的 RocketMQ 密钥列表，您可以通过`Description`参数识别出目标密钥。
Description.description_en:
Description for the RocketMQ key, used to efficiently distinguish and manage keys. Limit: 0–128 characters
After creating a key, we recommend calling the DescribeAccessKeys API to view your list of created RocketMQ keys. You can identify the target key using the Description parameter.

GroupAllAuthority.description_cn: 此 RocketMQ 密钥是否默认具备所有 Group 的读写权限。默认值为 Sub。 - SUB：拥有订阅权限 - DENY：不具备订阅权限
GroupAllAuthority.description_en:
Does this RocketMQ key have default read/write permissions for all Groups? Default value: Sub
- SUB: Has subscription permission
- DENY: No subscription permission

SecretKey.description_cn: RocketMQ 密钥。长度限制为 7～128 字符，字符限制为大小写字母或数字。设置 AccessKey 时必选
SecretKey.description_en: RocketMQ key. Length must be between 7 and 128 characters; only uppercase and lowercase letters or numbers are allowed. Required when setting AccessKey

AllowList.description_cn:
IP 地址列表，表示允许这些 IP 地址访问。

- 多个 IP 地址请以英文逗号（,）隔开，不可重复。
- 支持 IP 地址形式（例如 10.23.12.xx）和 CIDR 形式（例如 10.23.12.x/xx）。
- 当 IP 较多时，建议合并为 IP 段填入，例如 10.23.12.x/24。
- 每个实例最多添加 300 个 IP 或 IP 段，即所有 IP 白名单分组内的 IP 或 IP 段总和不能超过 300。
AllowList.description_en:
IP address allowlist. Only these IP addresses are allowed to access

- Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,) and do not repeat addresses
- Supports both IP address format (for example, 10.23.12.xx) and CIDR format (for example, 10.23.12.x/xx)
- If you have many IP addresses, consider combining them into an IP range, such as 10.23.12.x/24
- Each instance can have up to 300 IP addresses or IP ranges in total, meaning the combined total across all allowlist groups cannot exceed 300

AllowListDesc.description_cn: 白名单描述。长度不超过 200 个字符。
AllowListDesc.description_en: Whitelist description. Up to 200 characters

AllowListName.description_cn:
白名单名称。

- 长度为 1～128 个字符。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线和连字符（-）。
- 不能以数字或连字符（-）开头。
- 白名单名称在当前地域下唯一。
AllowListName.description_en:
Whitelist name

- Must be 1–128 characters long
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens (-)
- Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
- Whitelist name must be unique within the current region

AllowListType.description_cn: IP 地址类型，当前仅支持设置为 IPv4。
AllowListType.description_en: Currently, only IPv4 can be set as the IP address type

Description.description_cn: Group 的简单描述。
Description.description_en: Brief Description of Group

GroupId.description_cn:
Group 的 ID。

- 长度限制为 7~120 个字符，只能包含字母、数字、短划线（-）或下划线（\_）。
- 推荐以 GID- 或 GID\_ 开头。

- 创建 Group 后无法修改 ID，请谨慎设置。
- 对于 2023 年 06 月 05 日及之前创建的 RocketMQ 实例，Group 名称不可超过 93 个字符。禁用词列表请参考[创建 Group](/docs/6410/70973)。
GroupId.description_en:
Group ID

- Must be 7–120 characters long and can only contain letters, numbers, hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
- Recommended to start with GID- or GID_

You cannot change the ID after creating the Group. Set it carefully.
For RocketMQ instances created on or before June 5, 2023, the Group name cannot exceed 93 characters. For the list of prohibited words, see [Create Group](/docs/6410/70973)

GroupType.description_cn: Group 的协议标识，用于备注该 Group 的生产消费协议类型。可指定为 TCP。
GroupType.description_en: Protocol identifier for the Group, used to note the production and consumption protocol type for this Group; the current value is TCP

MessageModel.description_cn: 创建消费组时使用的消息类型，5.x 版本实例使用，默认为 CLUSTERING

Description.description_cn: Group 的简单描述。
Description.description_en: A Brief Description of the Group

GroupType.description_cn: 指定创建的 Group 适用的协议，取值为`TCP`。

MessageModel.description_cn: 消费组消费模式，可选 LITE_SELECTIVE 和 CLUSTERING，对 5.x 实例生效

TopicName.description_en: Topic name bound to the LITE_SELECTIVE consumer group; required when set to LITE_SELECTIVE

SSLMode.description_cn:
实例的公网连接策略，仅在开启公网访问时需要设置。支持设置为：
- `enforcing`：通过公网访问实例时，必须经由 SSL 认证。SSL 认证可实现数据的加密传输，相较于普通公网访问方式具备更高的安全性，但性能会有所下降。
- `permissive`：通过公网访问实例时，可以选择是否经由 SSL 认证。
创建实例后，公网访问为开启状态时，不能修改 SSL 连接策略。如需修改，需要为实例关闭并重新开启公网访问，在重新开启时再次设置 SSL 连接策略。详细说明请参考[设置公网访问与 SSL 认证策略](/docs/6410/107703)。
SSLMode.description_en:
The public network connection policy for an instance only needs to be set when public access is enabled. You can choose from:
- Enforcing: When accessing the instance over the public network, SSL authentication is required. SSL authentication encrypts data transmission, providing higher security than standard public access, but may reduce performance.
- Permissive: When accessing the instance over the public network, SSL authentication is optional.
After the instance is created and public access is enabled, you cannot change the SSL connection policy. SSLMode.description_cn:
实例的公网连接策略。支持设置为：

- `enforcing`：通过公网访问实例时，必须经由 SSL 认证。SSL 认证可实现数据的加密传输，相较于普通公网访问方式具备更高的安全性，但性能会有所下降。
-` permissive`：（默认）通过公网访问实例时，可以选择是否经由 SSL 认证。

创建实例后，公网访问为开启状态时，不能修改 SSL 连接策略。如需修改，需要为实例关闭并重新开启公网访问，在重新开启时再次设置 SSL 连接策略。详细说明请参考[设置公网访问与 SSL 认证策略](/docs/6410/107703)。
SSLMode.description_en:
Public network connection policy for the instance. You can set the following options:

- Enforcing: When accessing the instance over the public network, SSL authentication is required. SSL authentication encrypts data transmission, providing higher security compared to standard public network access, but may reduce performance.
- Permissive (default): When accessing the instance over the public network, you can choose whether to use SSL authentication.

After the instance is created, you cannot change the SSL connection policy while public network access is enabled. To modify the policy, disable public network access for the instance, then re-enable it and set the SSL connection policy again. For details, see [Configure Public Network Access and SSL Authentication Policy](/docs/6410/107703).

MessageType.description_cn:
消息类型。取值说明如下：

- `0`：普通消息
- `1`：事务消息
- `2`：分区顺序消息
- `3`：全局顺序消息
- `4`：延时消息

- 一个 Topic 只能承载一种消息类型。创建 Topic 后不支持修改此 Topic 承载的消息类型。
- 对于**分区顺序消息**和**全局顺序消息**类型的 Topic，服务节点异常时可能会出现短暂的消息乱序现象。
- 延迟消息支持自定义毫秒级延迟，延迟时长最长为 3 天或消息保留时长的 3 倍（两者取较小值）。
MessageType.description_en:
Message type. Value descriptions:

- 0: Standard message
- 1: Transaction message
- 2: Partitioned ordered message
- 3: Globally ordered message
- 4: Delayed message

- Each Topic supports only one message type. You cannot change the message type after the Topic is created.
- For Topics with partitioned ordered or globally ordered messages, brief message disorder may occur if service nodes fail.
- Delayed messages support custom millisecond-level delays. The maximum delay is 3 days or three times the message retention period, whichever is shorter.

QueueNumber.description_cn:
设置当前 Topic 的队列数量，最大不可超过当前实例剩余可用队列数。每个实例规格的队列数量限制请参考[产品规格](/docs/6410/105397)。
在 **4.x** 版本实例中创建 Topic 时，请参考以下说明设置队列数：
- 全局顺序类型的 Topic 队列数默认为 1。其他类型 Topic 的队列数和计算规格有关，n3 及以下规格的队列数默认为 6，n3 以上规格的队列数默认是 broker 组数的两倍。
- 队列数建议设置为计算节点数的倍数，否则可能造成不同 Broker 之间数据不均衡。例如规格 rocketmq.n3.x2.medium 的计算节点数为 3，队列数建议设置为 3 的倍数，即 3、6、9 等。
在 **5.x** 版本实例中创建 Topic 时，请参考以下说明设置队列数：
- 全局顺序类型的 Topic 队列数默认为 1。
- 其他类型 Topic 的队列数默认是 broker 组数的两倍。
- 非顺序场景性能不受队列个数影响，更多队列仅用于提升顺序消费并发性能。
QueueNumber.description_en:
Set the number of queues for the current Topic. The maximum cannot exceed the remaining available queues for this instance. For queue limits of each instance specification, see [Product Specifications](/docs/6410/105397).

When creating a Topic in a **4.x** instance, follow these guidelines for setting the queue count:
- For globally ordered Topics, the queue count defaults to 1. For other Topic types, the queue count depends on the compute specification: n3 and below default to 6 queues; above n3, the default is twice the number of broker groups.
- Set the queue count as a multiple of the number of compute nodes to avoid data imbalance across brokers. For example, the rocketmq.n3.x2.medium specification has 3 compute nodes, so the queue count should be a multiple of 3, such as 3, 6, or 9.

When creating a Topic in a **5.x** instance, follow these guidelines for setting the queue count:
- For globally ordered Topics, the queue count defaults to 1.
- For other Topic types, the default queue count is twice the number of broker groups.
- In non-ordered scenarios, performance is not affected by the number of queues. Adding more queues only improves concurrent performance in ordered consumption scenarios.

TopicName.description_cn:
Topic 的名称。命名规则如下：
- 长度为 3~100 个字符。
- 只能包含英文、数字、连字符（-）以及下划线（\_）。
- Topic 名称中不可包含以下保留字符或特殊前缀。
  - 保留字符：RMQ\_SYS\_TRANS\_OP\_HALF\_TOPIC、BenchmarkTest、TBW102、OFFSET\_MOVED\_EVENT、SELF\_TEST\_TOPIC、RMQ\_SYS\_TRANS\_HALF\_TOPIC、SCHEDULE\_TOPIC\_XXXX、RMQ\_SYS\_TRACE\_TOPIC
  - 特殊前缀：rocketmq-broker-、%RETRY%、rmq\_sys\_、%DLQ%
- 同一实例下 Topic 名称必须唯一，不同实例间的 Topic 名称可以重复。
- 对于 2023 年 06 月 05 日及之前创建的 RocketMQ 实例，Topic 名称不可超过 100 个字符。
TopicName.description_en:
Topic name. Naming rules:
- Must be 3–100 characters long
- Only English letters, numbers, hyphens (-), and underscores (_) are allowed
- Topic names cannot contain the following reserved keywords or special prefixes:
  - Reserved keywords: RMQ_SYS_TRANS_OP_HALF_TOPIC, BenchmarkTest, TBW102, OFFSET_MOVED_EVENT, SELF_TEST_TOPIC, RMQ_SYS_TRANS_HALF_TOPIC, SCHEDULE_TOPIC_XXXX, RMQ_SYS_TRACE_TOPIC
  - Special prefixes: rocketmq-broker-, %RETRY%, rmq_sys_, %DLQ%
- Topic names must be unique within the same instance. Topic names can be duplicated across different instances.
- For RocketMQ instances created on or before June 5, 2023, topic names cannot exceed 100 characters

PageSize.description_en: When displaying query results in pages, this parameter sets the number of items per page. Valid values are 1 to 100.

TagFilters.description_cn:
根据指定标签键值进行过滤，支持根据标签键筛选，或根据标签键+标签值进行筛选。
详细示例及说明请参考[根据标签筛选实例](/docs/6410/177941)。
TagFilters.description_en: Filter by specified tag key or by both tag key and value. For detailed examples and instructions, see [Tag-based filtering examples](/docs/6410/177941).

AccessKey.description_cn:
用于过滤的 RocketMQ 密钥 AccessKey，仅支持精确匹配。
指定 AccessKey 时，只返回指定 AccessKey 对于此 Topic 的权限。
AccessKey.description_en: The AccessKey used for RocketMQ filtering only supports exact matches. When you specify an AccessKey, only the permissions for that AccessKey on this Topic are returned.

PageNumber.description_cn: 查询结果分页展示时，此参数用于表示页码。支持的最小值为 1。
PageNumber.description_en: When displaying query results in pages, this parameter specifies the page number. The minimum supported value is 1.

PageSize.description_cn: 查询结果分页展示时，此参数用于表示每页的数据量。取值范围为1~100。
PageSize.description_en: This parameter sets the number of items per page when displaying paginated query results. Allowed values are 1 to 100

GroupIds.description_cn: Group ID，若未指定，表示查看所有 Group 信息。
GroupIds.description_en: Group ID. If not specified, shows information for all groups

PageNumber.description_en: Minimum page number for the list is 1

PageSize.description_cn: 列表中每一页的条目数量，取值范围为 1~100。
PageSize.description_en: Set items per page in the list (1–100)

TopicName.description_cn: Topic 名称，设置此参数表示根据指定的 Topic 名称进行筛选，支持模糊匹配。
TopicName.description_en: Topic Name: Set this parameter to filter by the specified topic name; fuzzy matching is supported

PageNumber.description_en: Page number for the list, minimum value is 1

PageSize.description_cn: 列表中每一页的条目数量，取值范围为 1~100。
PageSize.description_en: Items per page in the list, range: 1–100

QueueIds.description_cn: 队列 ID，若未指定，表示查看所有队列信息。
QueueIds.description_en: Queue ID. If not specified, all queue information will be displayed

TopicName.description_cn: Topic 名称，设置此参数表示根据指定的 Topic 名称进行筛选，支持模糊匹配。
TopicName.description_en: Topic name. Set this parameter to filter by the specified topic name; fuzzy matching is supported.

MessageType.description_cn:
消息类型。设置此参数表示根据指定的消息类型筛选 Topic 列表。取值说明如下：
- `0`：普通消息
- `1`：事务消息
- `2`：分区顺序消息
- `3`：全局顺序消息
- `4`：延时消息
MessageType.description_en:
Message type. Set this parameter to filter the Topic list by the specified message type. The values are as follows:
- 0: Ordinary message
- 1: Transactional message
- 2: Partitioned ordered message
- 3: Globally ordered message
- 4: Delayed message

PageNumber.description_en: The minimum page number for the list is 1

PageSize.description_cn: 列表中每一页的条目数量，取值范围为 1~100。
PageSize.description_en: Items per page in the list, range: 1–100

SortBy.description_cn:
实例查询结果排序字段。默认使用 CreateTime 进行排序。可设置为：
- `CreateTime`：Topic 创建时间
- `QueueNumber`：Topic 队列数量
SortBy.description_en:
Sort field for instance query results. By default, results are sorted by CreateTime. You can set the sort field to:
- CreateTime: topic creation time
- QueueNumber: number of topic queues

SortOrder.description_cn:
实例查询使用的排序方式。默认为 Desc，即降序。
- `Asc`：升序
- `Desc`：降序
SortOrder.description_en:
Sorting method used for instance queries. Default is Desc (descending order)
- Asc: ascending order
- Desc: descending order

TopicName.description_cn: Topic 名称，设置此参数表示根据指定的 Topic 名称进行筛选，支持模糊匹配。
TopicName.description_en: Topic name: Set this parameter to filter by the specified topic name; fuzzy matching is supported

AllowListIds.description_cn: 待解绑的白名单 ID 列表。
AllowListIds.description_en: List of Whitelist IDs to Unbind

InstanceIds.description_cn: 需要解绑白名单的实例 ID 列表。
InstanceIds.description_en: Instance IDs that need to be unbound from the whitelist

Enable.description_cn:
是否开启自动创建消费组。取值说明如下：
- `true`：是。
- `false`：否。

Enable.description_en: Whether to enable Instance BurstTps capability

Enable.description_cn:
开启或关闭风险巡检功能。

- `true`：开启
- `false`：关闭
Enable.description_en:
Enable or disable the risk inspection feature

- true: Enable
- false: Disable

InstanceId.description_cn: 需要开启或关闭风险巡检功能的实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en: Instance ID for enabling or disabling the risk inspection feature

Filters.description_cn: 过滤项，支持使用 `cluster`、`topic` 和 `group` 进行过滤巡检规则。
Filters.description_en: Filter options support filtering inspection rules by `cluster`, `topic`, and `group`

PageNumber.description_en: Page number, minimum value is 1

PageSize.description_cn: 每页支持展示的巡检规则的数量，取值范围为 1~100。
PageSize.description_en: The number of inspection rules displayed per page can range from 1 to 100

Filters.description_cn:
过滤项，支持根据风险等级和处理状态进行过滤。

- 风险等级Level支持：low（低风险）、medium（中风险）和 high（高风险）。
- 处理状态Status支持：unSolved（未处理）和 Solved（已处理）。
Filters.description_en:
Filter options support filtering by risk level and status

- Risk Level options: Low (low risk), Medium (medium risk), High (high risk)
- Status options: Unsolved (not processed), Solved (processed)

InstanceId.description_cn: 需要查询巡检结果的目标实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en: Target instance ID for querying inspection results

PageNumber.description_en: Page number: minimum value is 1

PageSize.description_cn: 每页展示的巡检异常结果数量，取值范围为 1~100。
PageSize.description_en: Number of inspection exception results displayed per page, range: 1–100

SortBy.description_cn: 排序项。目前仅支持按照巡检异常结果的发生时间进行排序。
SortBy.description_en: Sorting options. Currently, you can only sort by the time when inspection exceptions occurred.

SortOrder.description_cn:
排序方式。

- `ASC`：升序，默认排序方式。
- `DESC`：降序。
SortOrder.description_en:
Sort Order

- ASC: Ascending, default sort order
- DESC: Descending

ResultId.description_cn:
需要修改处理状态的巡检异常结果的唯一 ID。
您可以调用 [GetInstanceInspectResult](/docs/6410/1335399) 接口，获取巡检异常结果的唯一 ID。
ResultId.description_en:
You need the unique ID of the inspection exception result whose processing status you want to modify
Call the [GetInstanceInspectResult](/docs/6410/1335399) API to get the unique ID of the inspection exception result

InstanceId.description_cn: 需要执行巡检规则的目标实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en: Target Instance ID to Execute Inspection Rules On

Type.description_cn:
巡检规则的类型。

- `cluster`：目前支持 queueInsufficient 巡检规则，巡检实例 Queue 资源是否不足。
- `topic`：目前支持 queueBalance 巡检规则，巡检实例 Queue 分布是否不均衡。
- `group`：目前支持 subscribeConsistency 巡检规则，巡检实例 Group 组订阅是否不一致。

5.x 版本实例不支持 subscribeConsistency 巡检规则。
Type.description_en:
Types of inspection rules

- Cluster: Currently supports the queueInsufficient inspection rule, which checks if instance queue resources are insufficient
- Topic: Currently supports the queueBalance inspection rule, which checks if instance queue distribution is unbalanced
- Group: Currently supports the subscribeConsistency inspection rule, which checks if instance group subscriptions are inconsistent

Instances running version 5.x do not support the subscribeConsistency inspection rule

Body.description_cn: 需要发送的消息的具体内容。

Key.description_cn:
需要发送的消息的 Message Key。
消息发送后，您可以通过 Message Key 来查询消息。
Key.description_en: The Message Key of the message to be sent. After sending the message, you can use the Message Key to query the message.

Tag.description_cn:
自定义设置消息 Tag。
可以用来进一步对某个 Topic 下的消息进行分类，RocketMQ 允许消费者按照 Tag 对消息进行过滤。
Tag.description_en:
Customize Message Tag
Use Tag to further categorize messages under a Topic. RocketMQ allows consumers to filter messages by Tag.

Topic.description_cn: 目标 Topic 的名称，即向该 Topic 发送消息。
Topic.description_en: Target Topic Name (messages will be sent to this Topic)

AccessKey.description_cn:
待修改默认权限的 RocketMQ 密钥 AccessKey ID。
创建密钥后，推荐调用 DescribeAccessKeys 接口查看已创建的 RocketMQ 密钥列表，您可以通过 Description 参数识别出目标密钥。
AccessKey.description_en:
AccessKey ID of the RocketMQ key with default permissions to be modified
After creating a key, we recommend calling the DescribeAccessKeys API to view the list of created RocketMQ keys. You can use the Description parameter to identify the target key.

AllAuthority.description_cn:
RocketMQ 密钥的默认权限。
- `ALL`：拥有发布和订阅权限
- `PUB`：拥有发布权限
- `SUB`：拥有订阅权限
- `DENY`：不具备发布或订阅权限
AllAuthority.description_en:
Default permissions for RocketMQ keys
- ALL: Publish and subscribe access
- PUB: Publish access
- SUB: Subscribe access
- DENY: No publish or subscribe access

GroupAllAuthority.description_cn: RocketMQ 密钥的消费组默认权限。 - SUB：拥有订阅权限 - DENY：不具备发布或订阅权限
GroupAllAuthority.description_en:
Default permissions for RocketMQ key consumer groups
- SUB: Has subscription permission
- DENY: No publish or subscribe permission

AccessKey.description_cn:
待设置自定义权限的 RocketMQ 密钥 AccessKey ID。
创建密钥后，推荐调用 DescribeAccessKeys 接口查看已创建的 RocketMQ 密钥列表，您可以通过`Description`参数识别出目标密钥。
AccessKey.description_en:
AccessKey ID of the RocketMQ key to set custom permissions for
It is recommended to call the DescribeAccessKeys API to view the list of RocketMQ keys you have created. You can identify the target key using the Description parameter.

AccessPolicies.description_cn: 自定义权限配置，即设置该 AccessKey 对特定 Topic 所拥有的权限。
AccessPolicies.description_en: Custom permission configuration means setting the permissions that this AccessKey has for a specific Topic

InstanceId.description_en: Instance associated with the target key

AllowList.description_cn:
IP 地址列表，表示允许这些 IP 地址访问。

- 多个 IP 地址请以英文逗号（,）隔开，不可重复。
- 支持 IP 地址形式（例如 10.23.12.xx）和 CIDR 形式（例如 10.23.12.x/xx）。
- 当 IP 较多时，建议合并为 IP 段填入，例如 10.23.12.x/24。
- 每个实例最多添加 300 个 IP 或 IP 段，即所有 IP 白名单分组内的 IP 或 IP 段总和不能超过 300。
AllowList.description_en:
IP address list. Only these IP addresses are allowed access

- Separate multiple IP addresses with commas. Do not enter duplicates
- Supports IP address format (for example, 10.23.12.xx) and CIDR format (for example, 10.23.12.x/xx)
- If you have many IP addresses, consider combining them into an IP range, such as 10.23.12.x/24
- Each instance can add up to 300 IP addresses or ranges. The total number of IP addresses or ranges across all whitelist groups cannot exceed 300

AllowListDesc.description_cn: 修改后的白名单描述。长度不超过 200 个字符。默认值为空，若修改时不设置，则描述会被设置为空字符串。
AllowListDesc.description_en: Modified whitelist description. Maximum length is 200 characters. Default value is empty; if not set during modification, the description will be set to an empty string.

AllowListName.description_cn:
白名单名称。

- 长度为 1～128 个字符。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线或连字符（-）。
- 不能以数字或连字符（-）开头。
- 白名单名称在当前地域下唯一。
AllowListName.description_en:
Whitelist name

- Must be 1–128 characters long
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens (-)
- Cannot start with a number or hyphen (-)
- Whitelist name must be unique within the current region

ApplyDBInstanceNum.description_cn: 已应用实例数量，即当前该白名单所绑定的实例数。主要目的是确认本次修改的影响范围，避免误操作引发故障。
ApplyDBInstanceNum.description_en: Applied instance count indicates the number of instances currently bound to this whitelist. Its main purpose is to confirm the scope of impact for this change and prevent accidental operations that may cause failures.

ModifyMode.description_cn:
白名单修改方式，默认值为 Cover。支持设置为：

- `Cover`：使用`AllowList`参数的值覆盖原白名单。
- `Append`：在原白名单中增加`AllowList`参数中输入的 IP 地址。
- `Delete`：在原白名单中删除`AllowList`参数中输入的 IP 地址。至少需要保留一个 IP 地址。
ModifyMode.description_en:
Whitelist modification method. Default value: Cover. Supported options:

- Cover: Replace the original whitelist with the IP addresses specified in the AllowList parameter
- Append: Add the IP addresses specified in the AllowList parameter to the original whitelist
- Delete: Remove the IP addresses specified in the AllowList parameter from the original whitelist. At least one IP address must remain.

Description.description_cn: Description
Description.description_en: Description

InstanceName.description_cn: 实例名称。
InstanceName.description_en: Instance Name

ProductInfo.description_cn:
产品配置信息。
仅 RocketMQ 5.x 版本实例支持调整实例的 TPS 占比。
ProductInfo.description_en:
Product configuration information
Only RocketMQ 5.x instances support adjusting the TPS proportion

ChargeInfo.description_cn:
变更后的计费类型。
目前仅支持按量付费实例转为包年包月实例。
ChargeInfo.description_en:
Billing Type After Change
Currently, only pay-as-you-go instances can be converted to subscription-based instances (annual/monthly)

AutoScaleQueue.description_cn: 实例规格更改时，是否自动创建队列。
AutoScaleQueue.description_en: Automatically create queue when instance specification changes?

ClientToken.description_cn:
保证客户端请求幂等性的标识。
该标识为 1~64 位的 ASCII 字符串，大小写敏感，由客户端生成，应确保不同请求之间该标识具有唯一性。
如何使用幂等标识，请参考[请求幂等性](/docs/6410/1160436)。
ClientToken.description_en:
Identifier for ensuring idempotency of client requests.
This identifier is a case-sensitive ASCII string of 1 to 64 characters, generated by the client. Make sure it is unique for each request.
For details on using the idempotency identifier, see [Request Idempotency](/docs/6410/1160436).

ComputeSpec.description_cn:
实例变更后的计算规格。如需升级计算规格，此参数必选。
仅支持升级实例规格，不支持降级。
ComputeSpec.description_en: Compute specifications after instance change. This parameter is required to upgrade compute specifications. Only instance specification upgrades are supported; downgrades are not allowed.

InstanceId.description_cn: 需要更新配置的实例 ID。
InstanceId.description_en: Instance IDs that require configuration update

StorageSpace.description_cn:
实例变更后的存储空间。如需扩容存储空间，此参数必选。
单位为GiB，必须指定为 100 的倍数。取值范围取决于当前指定的计算规格，详细说明请参考[产品规格](/docs/6410/105397)。
仅支持升级实例规格，不支持降级。
StorageSpace.description_en:
Storage space after instance modification. Required if you need to expand storage space
Unit: GiB. Must be a multiple of 100. The available range depends on the selected compute specification. For details, see [Product Specifications](/docs/6410/105397)
Only instance upgrades are supported; downgrades are not supported

AccessPolicies.description_cn: 每个 RocketMQ 密钥对于当前 Topic 的权限，支持批量设置权限。若未设置，每个密钥对于当前 Topic 维持密钥的默认权限。

Description.description_cn: Topic 描述。
Description.description_en: Description

GroupId.description_cn:
死信队列对应的的 Group ID。
- 一个死信队列对应一个 Group ID， 而不是对应单个消费者实例。
- 一个死信队列包含了对应 Group ID 产生的所有死信消息，不论该消息属于哪个 Topic。
GroupId.description_en:
Group ID for the dead-letter queue
- Each dead-letter queue is associated with a Group ID, not with individual consumer instances
- The dead-letter queue contains all dead-letter messages generated by the associated Group ID, regardless of which Topic the message belongs to

PageNumber.description_cn: 列表的页码，最小值为 1。其中列表中每一页的条目数量固定为 16。
PageNumber.description_en: Page number of the list, minimum value is 1. Each page contains 16 items.

PageSize.description_cn: 最小为10，最大为100。表示查询结果的分页
PageSize.description_en: Minimum is 10, maximum is 100. Indicates pagination for query results

QueryEndTimestamp.description_cn:
消息存储时间中的结束时间戳，单位为秒。
消息存储时间指消息在投递重试达到最大次数后被发送到死信队列的时间。
QueryEndTimestamp.description_en:
End timestamp of message storage time (in seconds)
Message storage time refers to the time when a message is sent to the dead letter queue after delivery retries reach the maximum limit

QueryStartTimestamp.description_cn:
消息存储时间中的起始时间戳，单位为秒。
消息存储时间指消息在投递重试达到最大次数后被发送到死信队列的时间。
QueryStartTimestamp.description_en:
Start timestamp for message storage time (in seconds)
Message storage time refers to when a message is sent to the dead letter queue after delivery retries reach the maximum number of attempts.

Refresh.description_cn:
是否强制刷新。默认值为`false`。
- `true`：强制刷新消息缓存。若查询范围发生变化，请设置为`true`。
- `false`：不强制刷新消息缓存。
Refresh.description_en:
Whether to force refresh. Default is false.
- true: Force refreshes the message cache. Please set to true if the query range changes.
- false: Does not force refresh the message cache.

GroupId.description_cn:
死信队列对应的的 Group ID。

- 创建 Group 时，消息队列 RocketMQ版会自动为其创建一个对应的死信队列。
- 一个死信队列对应一个 Group ID， 而不是对应单个消费者实例。一个死信队列包含了对应 Group ID 产生的所有死信消息，不论该消息属于哪个 Topic。
GroupId.description_en:
Group ID for the dead-letter queue

- When you create a Group, RocketMQ message queue version automatically creates a corresponding dead-letter queue
- Each dead-letter queue is associated with a Group ID, not a single consumer instance. The dead-letter queue stores all dead-letter messages generated by the Group ID, regardless of which Topic the message belongs to

LiteTopic.description_cn: LiteTopic 名称。非 LiteTopic 查询可不填。
LiteTopic.description_en: LiteTopic Name. If not a LiteTopic query, leave blank

PageNumber.description_cn: 列表的页码，最小值为 1。每一页的条目数量为 16。
PageNumber.description_en: The minimum page number is 1; each page shows 16 items

QueryEndTimestamp.description_cn: 需要查询的结束时间戳。单位为秒。
QueryEndTimestamp.description_en:
End timestamp to query
Unit: seconds

QueryStartTimestamp.description_cn: 需要查询的起始时间戳。单位为秒。
QueryStartTimestamp.description_en: Start timestamp to query. Unit: seconds

MessageBornTimestamp.description_cn: 消息产生的时间戳，单位秒。
MessageBornTimestamp.description_en: Timestamp when the message was generated, in seconds

NeedProduceTraceInfo.description_cn: 是否需要生产者的消息轨迹。
NeedProduceTraceInfo.description_en: Do you need the producer's message trace?

OnlyReturnSuccessProduceTraceInfo.description_cn: 仅返回发送成功的消息轨迹
OnlyReturnSuccessProduceTraceInfo.description_en: Return Traces of Successfully Sent Messages Only

QueryEndTimestamp.description_cn: 消息查询的最后时间戳，单位秒，与`QueryStartTimestamp`参数配合使用，用来控制消息查询的时间范围。
QueryEndTimestamp.description_en: End timestamp for message query, in seconds. Use with the QueryStartTimestamp parameter to set the time range for message queries

QueryStartTimestamp.description_cn: 业务消息的起始时间戳，单位秒，如业务消息是 08 秒生产的，那么查询时需要指定 08 秒以前的时间。
QueryStartTimestamp.description_en: Start timestamp for business messages, in seconds. For example, if a business message is produced at 08 seconds, specify a time earlier than 08 seconds when querying.

Topic.description_cn: 业务消息的 topic 名称。

AccountId.description_cn: 待删除白名单的账号 ID。

All.description_cn:
是否解绑指定实例上的所有标签。取值范围如下：

- `true`：解绑指定实例上的所有标签。
- `false`（默认）：不解绑指定实例上的所有标签。

仅当`TagKeys`取值为空时，`All`参数才生效。
All.description_en:
Whether to unbind all tags from the specified instance. Valid values:

- true: Unbind all tags from the specified instance
- false (default): Do not unbind all tags from the specified instance

The All parameter takes effect only when TagKeys is empty.

InstanceIds.description_cn:
需要解绑标签的实例 ID。
支持一次传入多个实例 ID，最多同时传入 50 个实例 ID。
InstanceIds.description_en:
Instance IDs to unbind tags from
You can submit multiple instance IDs at once, up to 50 at a time

TagKeys.description_cn:
需要删除的标签。
支持一次传入多个标签键，多个标签键间用英文逗号（,）分隔。最多同时传入 20 个标签键。
TagKeys.description_en: Tags to delete. You can enter multiple tag keys at once, separated by English commas (,). You can enter up to 20 tag keys at a time.

ResetTimestamp.description_cn:
仅适用于参数`ResetType`设置为`Timestamp`时。
- 消费时间戳为消息存储到服务端的时间，单位秒级。
- 取值范围：[当前时间-实例消息保留时长, 当前时间]
- 若指定时间不存在消息，则会重置到最近的消息位置。
ResetTimestamp.description_en:
Only applies when ResetType is Timestamp
- The consumption timestamp is the time when the message was stored on the server, measured in seconds
- Value range: [current time - instance message retention period, current time]
- If no message exists at the specified time, the position will reset to the nearest message position

ResetType.description_cn:
消费位点重置的方式，可设置为：
- `EndOffset`：默认值，将消费位点重置到最新的一条消息。该 Group 在消费该 Topic 下的消息时会跳过当前堆积（未被消费）的所有消息，从在此之后的最新消息开始消费。
- `Timestamp`：指定时间进行消费重置。
ResetType.description_en:
Consumption offset reset methods can be set as follows:
EndOffset: Default option. Resets the consumption offset to the latest message. The group will skip all currently accumulated (unconsumed) messages under this topic and start consuming from the latest message after the reset.
Timestamp: Resets consumption to a specified time.
