StorageDays.description_en: StorageDays Storage Duration Range: 30–3650 days; 3650 means permanent storage

DestinationConfig.AutoInstallBlkNone.description_cn:
是否自动为目标实例或目标镜像安装blk-none。取值：
- true：自动安装。
- false：默认，不自动安装。
仅迁移至Linux云服务器实例、Linux云服务镜像时有效。
DestinationConfig.AutoInstallBlkNone.description_en:
Whether to automatically install blk-none on the target instance or target image
Values:
- true: Automatically install
- false: Default value, do not install automatically
Only applies when migrating to Linux cloud server instances or Linux cloud service images

DestinationConfig.AutoInstallVirtio11.description_cn:
是否自动为目标实例或目标镜像安装Virtio1.1驱动。取值：
- true：自动安装。
- false：默认，不自动安装。
仅迁移至Linux云服务器实例、Linux云服务镜像时有效。
DestinationConfig.AutoInstallVirtio11.description_en:
Whether to automatically install the Virtio1.1 driver for the target instance or target image. Values:
- true: Automatically install
- false: Default value, do not install automatically
Only valid when migrating to Linux cloud server instances or Linux cloud service images

DestinationConfig.AutoReplicate.description_cn:
迁移任务通过预检后是否自动开始迁移。取值：
* false：默认，不自动迁移。
* true：自动迁移。
仅迁移至云服务器实例、云服务镜像时有效。
DestinationConfig.AutoReplicate.description_en:
Whether the migration task automatically starts after passing the pre-check. Values:
* false: Default value; does not start migration automatically
* true: Starts migration automatically
Only valid when migrating to cloud server instances or cloud service images

DestinationConfig.DestinationSystem.description_cn:
目标操作系统。取值：
- Unknown：未知。
- VeLinux10Centos：表示迁移为veLinux 1.0 CentOS兼容版操作系统。
- VeLinux20Centos：表示迁移为veLinux 2.0 CentOS兼容版操作系统。
`DestinationConfig.DestinationType`为`ECSSystem`时，本参数必填。
DestinationConfig.DestinationSystem.description_en:
Target operating system. Possible values:
- Unknown: Unknown
- VeLinux10Centos: Indicates migration to veLinux 1.0 CentOS-compatible operating system
- VeLinux20Centos: Indicates migration to veLinux 2.0 CentOS-compatible operating system
This parameter is required when `DestinationConfig.DestinationType` is set to `ECSSystem`

DestinationConfig.DestinationType.description_cn:
目标类型，取值：
- ECSInstance：云服务器实例。
- ECSImage：云服务器镜像。
- ECSSystem：云服务器操作系统。
DestinationConfig.DestinationType.description_en:
Target type, values:
- ECSInstance: Cloud server instance
- ECSImage: Cloud server image
- ECSSystem: Cloud server operating system
- ECSTemplate: Create cloud server instance using migration template
The feature to create cloud server instances using migration templates is currently in invite-only testing. To request access, please contact your account manager.

DestinationConfig.ImageName.description_cn:
镜像名称。
- 必须以字母、汉字开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线“_”、中划线“-”、英文句号“.”。
- 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符。
迁移到云服务器镜像时，本参数必填。
DestinationConfig.ImageName.description_en:
Image Name
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.)
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
This parameter is required when migrating to a cloud server image

DestinationConfig.InstanceId.description_cn:
目标实例ID。您可以调用[DescribeInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70466)接口查询获取。
迁移到云服务器实例时，本参数必填。
DestinationConfig.InstanceId.description_en:
Target Instance ID: You can query and obtain it using the [DescribeInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70466) API
This parameter is required when migrating to a cloud server instance

DestinationConfig.LicenseType.description_cn:
许可证类型。取值：
- PlatformLicense：根据您源服务器操作系统类型，采用火山引擎官方渠道的许可证。
- BYOL：自带许可证（BYOL）。
- 仅当源服务器操作系统类型为RedHat、SUSE Linux Enterprise Server或Windows时，本参数生效；其他操作系统类型本参数无效。
- 各操作系统支持的取值如下：
	- Windows：支持`PlatformLicense`、`BYOL`。
	- RedHat / SUSE Linux Enterprise Server：
		- 源服务器为**火山引擎云服务器实例**：支持`PlatformLicense`、`BYOL`。
		- 源服务器为**非火山引擎云服务器实例**：仅支持`BYOL`。
DestinationConfig.LicenseType.description_en:
License type
Options:
- VolcanoEngine: Default. Uses the official Volcano Engine license based on your source server's operating system
- BYOL: Bring your own license (BYOL)

DiskConfigs.N.DestinationDiskSize.description_cn:
调整后目标云镜像磁盘容量，单位GiB。
- 参数 - N：表示磁盘序号，取值范围：0～14。
- 多个磁盘序号之间用`&`分隔。
- 系统盘容量大小支持范围为40 GiB ~ 2048 GiB，且需不低于迁移分区大小之和。
本参数正在邀测中，如需试用，请联系客户经理。
DiskConfigs.N.DestinationDiskSize.description_en:
Target cloud image disk capacity after adjustment (in GiB)
- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk number; valid range: 0–14
- Separate multiple disk numbers with `&`
- Supported system disk capacity range: 40 GiB ~ 2048 GiB, and must not be less than the total size of all migration partitions
This parameter is currently in invite-only testing. To request access, please contact your account manager

DiskConfigs.N.DiskIndex.description_cn:
源服务器磁盘下标，从`0`开始。
- 参数 - N：表示磁盘序号，取值范围：0～14。
- 多个磁盘序号之间用&分隔。
参数 - N 的值不能超过源服务器实际磁盘数量。
DiskConfigs.N.DiskIndex.description_en:
Source server disk index, starting from `0`
- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk number, valid range: 0–14
- Use `&` to separate multiple disk numbers
The value of parameter - N cannot exceed the actual number of disks on the source server

DiskConfigs.N.DiskSize.description_cn:
源服务器磁盘容量，单位GB。
- 参数 - N：表示磁盘序号，与`DiskConfigs.N.DiskIndex`标识的磁盘序号对应，取值范围：0～14。
- 多个磁盘序号之间用&分隔。
参数 - N 的值不能超过源服务器实际磁盘数量。
DiskConfigs.N.DiskSize.description_en:
Source server disk capacity, unit: GiB.
- Parameter - N: Indicates the disk sequence number, corresponding to the disk sequence number identified by `DiskConfigs.N.DiskIndex`. Value range: 0–14.
- Use `&` to separate multiple disk sequence numbers.
The value of parameter - N cannot exceed the actual number of disks on the source server.

DiskConfigs.N.Partitions.N.AbortPartitio.description_cn:
迁移时是否跳过该分区。取值：
* false：默认，不跳过。
* true：跳过。
* 仅Linux文件复制迁移到“云服务器镜像”时支持。
* 挂载点为`/`与`/boot`的分区必须迁移。
* 暂仅支持系统盘。
* 第一个N：表示磁盘序号，取值范围：0～14。
* 第二个N：表示分区序号。
* 多个分区配置之间用&分隔。
* 本参数正在邀测中，如需试用，请联系客户经理。
DiskConfigs.N.Partitions.N.AbortPartitio.description_en:
Whether to skip this partition during migration. Values:
* false: Default, do not skip
* true: Skip
* Supported only for Linux file copy migration to 'Cloud Server Image'
* Partitions with mount points `/` and `/boot` must be migrated
* Currently supports system disk only
* The first N: Disk number, value range: 0–14
* The second N: Partition number
* Use & to separate multiple partition configurations
* This parameter is currently in invite-only testing. To request access, please contact your account manager

DiskConfigs.N.Partitions.N.DestinationPa.description_cn:
调整后目标云镜像分区容量，单位Bytes。
- 第一个N：表示磁盘序号，取值范围：0～14。
- 第二个N：表示分区序号。
* 多个分区容量之间用`&`分隔。
* 调整后分区大小不能小于已使用空间，且所有分区大小之和不能大于所属磁盘大小。
* 本参数正在邀测中，如需试用，请联系客户经理。
DiskConfigs.N.Partitions.N.DestinationPa.description_en:
Adjusted target cloud image partition capacity (unit: Bytes)
- The first N: indicates the disk index, range: 0–14
- The second N: indicates the partition index
* Use `&` to separate multiple partition capacities
* The adjusted partition size cannot be smaller than the used space, and the total size of all partitions cannot exceed the disk size
* This parameter is currently in invite-only testing. To request access, please contact your account manager

MigrationJobDescription.description_cn:
任务描述。
- 必须以字母或中文开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、点号“.”、空格、下划线“_”、中划线“-”、等号“=”、英文逗号“,”、中文逗号“，”和中文句号“。”
- 长度限制在255个字符以内。
MigrationJobDescription.description_en:
Task description
- Must start with a letter or Chinese character
- Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, periods (.), spaces, underscores (_), hyphens (-), equals signs (=), English commas (,), Chinese commas (，), and Chinese periods (。) are allowed
- Up to 255 characters

MigrationJobName.description_cn:
任务名称。
- 以字母或中文开头。
- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线“_”、中划线“-”和点号“.”。
- 长度限制为1～128个字符。
MigrationJobName.description_en:
Task name
- Start with a letter or Chinese character
- Only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.) are allowed
- Must be 1–128 characters long

MigrationSourceId.description_cn: 迁移源ID。您可以调用[DescribeMigrationSources](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6886/984874)接口查询获取。
MigrationSourceId.description_en: Migration Source ID. You can call the [DescribeMigrationSources](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6886/984874) API to retrieve it.

NetworkConfig.BandwidthLimit.description_cn: 传输限速，单位Mbps。最小值（默认）为0，表示不限速。
NetworkConfig.BandwidthLimit.description_en: Transmission speed limit, unit: Mbps. Minimum (default) value is 0, meaning no limit.

NetworkConfig.NetworkTransitionMode.description_cn:
网络模式，取值：
- PublicNetwork：公网传输。
- VPC：内网传输。
NetworkConfig.NetworkTransitionMode.description_en:
Network mode options:
- PublicNetwork: Public network transmission
- VPC: Internal network transmission

NetworkConfig.SubnetId.description_cn:
子网ID。您可以调用[DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497)接口查询获取。
迁移到云服务器镜像，且通过内网传输时必填。
NetworkConfig.SubnetId.description_en:
Subnet ID
You can call the [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) API to query and obtain it.
This is required when migrating to a cloud server image and transferring via the internal network

NetworkConfig.VpcId.description_cn:
私有网络ID。您可以调用[DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495)接口查询获取。
迁移到云服务器镜像，且通过内网传输时必填。
NetworkConfig.VpcId.description_en: VPC ID. You can query and obtain it using the [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) API. Required when migrating to a cloud server image and transferring via internal network.

ProjectName.description_cn:
迁移任务所属项目，一个任务只能归属于一个项目。
- 只能包含字母、数字、下划线“_”、点“.”和中划线“-”。
- 长度限制在64个字符以内。
ProjectName.description_en:
Project to which the migration task belongs. Each task can belong to only one project.
- Only letters, numbers, underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-) are allowed.
- Maximum length: 64 characters.

SyncConfig.SyncInterval.description_cn:
增量同步时间间隔，单位小时。
取值范围：1~168。
若`SyncConfig.TriggerLastSync`为`false`，本参数必填。
SyncConfig.SyncInterval.description_en:
Incremental sync interval (hours)
Valid range: 1–168
If `SyncConfig.TriggerLastSync` is set to `false`, this parameter is required.

SyncConfig.SyncTimes.description_cn:
增量同步次数。取值：
- 最大值：30
- 默认值：0
- 最小值：0
仅“一键迁移”支持使用本参数。
SyncConfig.SyncTimes.description_en:
Incremental Sync Count
Values:
- Maximum: 30
- Default: 0
- Minimum: 0
This parameter is only supported for One-Click Migration.

SyncConfig.SyncType.description_cn:
复制类型，取值：
- File（默认）：文件复制。
- Block：块复制。
SyncConfig.SyncType.description_en:
Copy type options:
- File (default): File copy
- Block: Block copy

SyncConfig.TriggerLastSync.description_cn:
是否只进行一次全量同步。取值：
- true（默认）：表示仅进行一次全量数据同步，不进行增量数据同步。
- false：表示进行一次全量数据同步后，还将按`SyncConfig.SyncInterval`参数指定的间隔进行增量数据同步。
SyncConfig.TriggerLastSync.description_en:
Should only one full sync be performed? Options:
- true (default): Only one full data sync is performed; incremental sync is not performed
- false: After one full data sync, incremental syncs are performed at intervals specified by the `SyncConfig.SyncInterval` parameter

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
用户标签的标签键。
- 参数 - N：表示标签键的序号，取值范围：1～20。
- 多个标签键之间用`&`分隔。
- 命名规则如下：
   - 不能以`volc:`、`sys:`的任意大小写组合开头。
   - 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
   - 长度限制在1～128个字符之间。
同一资源的标签键不允许重复。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for user labels
- Parameter - N: Indicates the tag key sequence number, valid range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag keys with `&`
- Naming rules:
   - Must not start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`
   - Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following English symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
   - Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
Tag keys for the same resource must be unique

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
用户标签的标签值。
- 参数 - N：表示标签值的序号，取值范围：1～20。
- 多个标签值之间用`&`分隔。
- 命名规则如下：
   - 只能包含语言字符、数字、空格和英文符号“_”、“.”、“:”、“/”、“=”、“+”、“-”、“@”。
   - 允许为空，长度限制在0～256个字符之间。
如果传入该参数，则必须先传入`Tags.N.Key`。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value for user tags
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value, valid range: 1–20
- Separate multiple tag values with `&`
- Naming rules:
   - Only letters, numbers, spaces, and the following symbols are allowed: "_", ".", ":", "/", "=", "+", "-", "@"
   - Can be empty; length must be between 0 and 256 characters
If you provide this parameter, you must first provide `Tags.N.Key`

MigrationJobId.description_cn: 迁移任务ID。您可以调用[DescribeMigrationJobs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6886/984907)接口查询获取。
MigrationJobId.description_en:
Migration Task ID
You can call the [DescribeMigrationJobs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6886/984907) API to query and obtain it.

SourceId.description_cn: 迁移源ID。您可以调用[DescribeMigrationSources](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6886/984874)接口查询获取。
SourceId.description_en: Migration Source ID. You can call the [DescribeMigrationSources](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6886/984874) API to query and obtain it.

DestinationRegion.description_cn:
目标地域，最大长度为255个字符。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1053194)接口查询获取。
根据目的区域查询时，需要传入该参数。
DestinationRegion.description_en:
Target region, maximum length is 255 characters. You can call the [DescribeRegions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1053194) API to query available regions.
This parameter is required when querying by destination region.

DestinationType.N.description_cn:
迁移目标类型，最多支持5个类型。取值：
- ECSInstance：云服务器实例。
- ECSImage：云服务器镜像。
- ECSSystem：云服务器操作系统。
- 参数 - N：表示迁移目标类型的序号。
- 多个`DestinationType`之间用`&`分隔。
- 根据迁移目标类型查询时，需要传入该参数。
DestinationType.N.description_en:
Migration target types. Up to 5 types are supported. Available values:
- ECSInstance: Cloud server instance
- ECSImage: Cloud server image
- ECSSystem: Cloud server operating system
- Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the migration target type
- Use '&' to separate multiple `DestinationType` values
- When querying by migration target type, this parameter is required

MigrationJobId.description_cn:
迁移任务ID。
根据迁移任务ID查询时，需要传入该参数。
MigrationJobId.description_en:
Migration Task ID
Provide this parameter when querying with the migration task ID

MigrationJobName.description_cn:
迁移任务名，最大长度为255个字符。
根据迁移任务名称查询时，需要传入该参数。
MigrationJobName.description_en:
Migration Task Name, maximum length: 255 characters
When searching by migration task name, you must provide this parameter

MigrationJobState.description_cn:
迁移任务状态，取值：
- Preparing：准备中。
- Replicating：迁移中。
- Success：已完成。
- Failed：失败。
- Waiting：等待中。
- Cleaning：清理中。
- Terminated：已终止。
- Terminating：终止中。
- Warning：异常。
- Pausing：暂停中。
- Paused：已暂停。
- Pending：待开始。
MigrationJobState.description_en:
Migration task status values:
- Preparing: In preparation
- Replicating: Migrating
- Success: Completed
- Failed: Failed
- Waiting: Waiting
- Cleaning: Cleaning
- Terminated: Terminated
- Terminating: Terminating
- Warning: Warning
- Pausing: Pausing
- Paused: Paused
- Pending: Pending

MigrationSourceIds.N.description_cn:
迁移源ID，传入后将按照迁移源筛选对应的迁移任务，最多支持50个ID。您可以调用[DescribeMigrationSources](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6886/984874)接口查询获取。
- 参数 -N：表示迁移源的序号。
- 多个迁移源ID之间用`&`分隔。
MigrationSourceIds.N.description_en:
Migration source ID. After you enter the ID, migration tasks will be filtered by the specified source. Up to 50 IDs are supported. You can query migration source IDs using the [DescribeMigrationSources](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6886/984874) API.
- Parameter -N: Indicates the index of the migration source
- Separate multiple migration source IDs with `&`

PageNumber.description_en: Page count

PageSize.description_cn:
页表大小。
- 取值范围：1~50
- 默认为：10
PageSize.description_en:
Page size
- Range: 1–50
- Default: 10

ProjectName.description_cn:
迁移任务所属项目，一个任务只能归属于一个项目。
- 只能包含字母、数字、下划线“_”、点“.”和中划线“-”。
- 长度限制在64个字符以内。
ProjectName.description_en:
Project for migration task. Each task can belong to only one project
- Only letters, numbers, underscores (_), dots (.), and hyphens (-) are allowed
- Maximum length is 64 characters

TagFilters.N.Key.description_cn:
根据标签查询资源时指定的标签键。
- 参数 - N：表示标签键的序号，取值范围：1～10。
- 多个标签键之间用`&`分隔，不允许重复。

释放实例时，该云盘是否随实例一起释放，默认为`false`。
- true：云盘随实例一起释放。
- false：云盘不随实例一起释放。

AutoSnapshotPolicyName.description_cn:
自动快照策略名称，命名规范如下：

- 首字符仅支持中文、字母或下划线（\_）。

- 可包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（\_）、中划线（-）或英文句号（.）。

- 长度限制在1~128个字符。
AutoSnapshotPolicyName.description_en:
Automatic snapshot policy name. Naming rules:

- The first character can only be a Chinese character, letter, or underscore (_)

- Can contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), or periods (.)

- Length: 1–128 characters

CopyEncryptionConfiguration.Encrypted.description_cn: 是否开启快照加密备份，默认值false。
CopyEncryptionConfiguration.Encrypted.description_en: Whether to enable snapshot encrypted backup. Default value: false

CopyEncryptionConfiguration.KMSKeyId.description_cn:
快照跨地域加密复制使用的KMS密钥ID。
如果Encrypted是true，KMSKeyId为空，则使用默认密钥。
CopyEncryptionConfiguration.KMSKeyId.description_en:
KMS key ID used for snapshot cross-region encrypted replication.
If Encrypted is true and KMSKeyId is empty, the default key is used.

DestinationRetentionDays.description_cn: 复制快照的保留时间，单位为天，取值说明如下： -1：永久保存。 1~65536：指定保存天数。 默认值：永久保留。
DestinationRetentionDays.description_en:
Retention period for copied snapshot (in days):
- -1: Keep permanently
- 1–65536: Specify number of days
Default: Keep permanently

EnableCopy.description_cn: 是否开启复制快照功能
EnableCopy.description_en: Do you want to enable the copy snapshot feature?

ProjectName.description_cn:
自动快照策略所属项目。
- 自动快照策略不会继承云盘的项目，即自动快照策略与云盘或快照均可以所属不同的项目。

- 如果您在创建自动快照策略时未设置ProjectName，则自动快照策略默认会加入default项目。
ProjectName.description_en:
Project to which the automatic snapshot policy belongs.
- The automatic snapshot policy does not inherit the project of the cloud disk. The automatic snapshot policy, cloud disk, and snapshot can each belong to different projects.

- If you do not set ProjectName when creating an automatic snapshot policy, the policy will be added to the default project.

RepeatDays.description_cn:
按天重复创建快照，即间隔一定天数创建快照，取值范围为[1, 30] 。
- 按天为周期重复创建快照时，创建自动快照策略的当天视为第一天，并且已过去的时间点不会创建快照，若当天的所有快照创建时间点都已过，当天仍然算第一天。
- 创建自动快照策略时，必须设置RepeatWeekdays.N和RepeatDays参数中的一个，不支持同时设置RepeatWeekdays.N和RepeatDays参数。
RepeatDays.description_en:
Repeat snapshot creation by day, meaning snapshots are created at intervals of a specified number of days. The value range is [1, 30].
- When repeating snapshot creation on a daily cycle, the day you create the automatic snapshot policy is considered the first day. Snapshots will not be created for past time points. If all snapshot creation times for that day have passed, it is still counted as the first day.
- When creating an automatic snapshot policy, you must set either the RepeatWeekdays.N or RepeatDays parameter. Setting both RepeatWeekdays.N and RepeatDays at the same time is not supported.

RepeatWeekdays.description_cn: 自动快照的重复日期，单位为天，周期为星期，取值说明如下： 取值范围：1~7，例如1表示周一。 当一星期内需要创建多次自动快照时，可以传入多个时间点，最多传入7个时间点。
RepeatWeekdays.description_en: The repeat date for automatic snapshots is specified in days, with a weekly cycle. Valid values are 1–7, where 1 represents Monday. You can specify multiple time points within a week, up to 7 in total.

RepeatWeekdays.N.description_cn:
按周重复创建快照，即在周一至周日之间选择一个或多个日期创建快照。说明如下：

- 取值范围为1~7，例如1表示周一。

- 当一星期内需要创建多次自动快照时，可以传入多个时间点，最多传入7个时间点。
创建自动快照策略时，必须设置RepeatWeekdays.N和RepeatDays参数中的一个，不支持同时设置RepeatWeekdays.N和RepeatDays参数。
RepeatWeekdays.N.description_en:
Create snapshots on a weekly schedule. Select one or more days from Monday to Sunday. Details:

- Value range: 1–7, where 1 represents Monday

- If you need to create multiple automatic snapshots in a week, you can specify multiple days, up to 7.
When creating an automatic snapshot policy, you must set either the RepeatWeekdays.N or RepeatDays parameter. Setting both is not supported.

RetentionDays.description_cn:
自动快照的保留时间，单位为天，取值说明如下：

- \-1：永久保存。

- 1~65536：指定保存天数。
RetentionDays.description_en:
Retention period of automatic snapshots, in days. Value description:

- -1: Keep permanently

- 1–65536: Specify the number of days to retain

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
标签的标签键。

- Tags.N.Key：N表示标签键的序号。取值范围：1～20。

- 多个标签键之间用&分隔。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key.

- Tags.N.Key: N indicates the sequence number of the tag key. Value range: 1–20

- Separate multiple tag keys with &

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
标签的标签值。

- Tags.N.Value：N表示标签值的序号。取值范围：1～20。

- 多个标签值之间用&分隔。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value.

- Tags.N.Value: N indicates the sequence number of the tag value. Value range: 1–20

- Separate multiple tag values with &

TimePoints.description_cn:
自动快照的创建时间点，取值说明如下：
使用UTC +8时间，单位为小时。
取值范围：0~23，代表00:00至23:00共24个时间点，例如1表示01:00。
当一天内需要创建多次自动快照时，可以传入多个时间点，最多传入24个时间点。
TimePoints.description_en:
The following explains the valid values for automatic snapshot creation times:
Uses UTC+8 time, with the unit in hours.
Valid range: 0–23, representing a total of 24 time points from 00:00 to 23:00. For example, 1 means 01:00.
If you need to create multiple automatic snapshots in one day, you can specify up to 24 time points.

TimePoints.N.description_cn:
自动快照的创建时间点，取值说明如下：

- 使用UTC +8时间，单位为小时。

- 取值范围：0~23，代表00:00至23:00共24个时间点，例如1表示01:00。

- 当一天内需要创建多次自动快照时，可以传入多个时间点，最多传入24个时间点。
TimePoints.N.description_en:
Time points for automatic snapshot creation. Value description:

- Use UTC+8 time, in hours

- Value range: 0–23, representing 00:00 to 23:00 (24 time points). For example, 1 means 01:00

- To create multiple automatic snapshots in a day, you can specify up to 24 time points

AutoAssign.description_cn:
是否开启为云盘自动分配存储子放置组功能，在创建云盘时绑定存储放置组，并开启自动分配存储子放置组功能后，将为云盘自动分配存储子放置组，取值说明如下：
- true：开启自动分配功能。
	
- false：不开启自动分配功能。
默认为false。
如果开启自动分配功能，同时在创建云盘时设置了`SubgroupNumber`参数，将为云盘自动分配存储子放置组，`SubgroupNumber`参数则无效。
AutoAssign.description_en:
Enable automatic assignment of storage sub-placement groups for cloud disks. When creating a cloud disk, if you bind a storage placement group and enable automatic assignment, the system will automatically assign a storage sub-placement group to the cloud disk. Value options:
- true: Enable automatic assignment
- false: Do not enable automatic assignment
Default is false
If you enable automatic assignment and set the `SubgroupNumber` parameter when creating the cloud disk, the system will automatically assign a storage sub-placement group and the `SubgroupNumber` parameter will be ignored.

Description.description_cn:
存储放置组的描述信息，默认为空，说明如下：
- 首字符仅支持中文、字母或下划线（_）。
- 可包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）或中划线（-）或点（.）。
- 长度限制为1~128字符。
Description.description_en:
Description for the storage placement group. Default is empty. Rules:
- The first character may only be a Chinese character, a letter, or an underscore (_)
- May only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), or periods (.)
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

Name.description_cn:
存储放置组名称，说明如下：
- 首字符仅支持中文、字母或下划线（_）。
- 可包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（_）或中划线（-）或点(.)。
- 长度限制为1~128字符。
Name.description_en:
Storage placement group name instructions:
- The first character must be a Chinese character, letter, or underscore (_)
- May contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), or periods (.)
- Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

SubgroupCount.description_cn:
存储子放置组的个数，最小为2，最大为min{可用区集群数量, 10}。
- 如果某个可用区集群的数量少于`SubgroupCount`值时，则报错`SubGroupCountExceedClusters`，并返回当前实际可用区集群数量。
- 设置存储子放置组后，系统会自动按照数字顺序为存储子放置组进行编号。编号最小值为1，最大值为存储子放置组的个数。

ZoneId.description_cn:
存储放置组所属可用区。
存储放置组的可用区必须位于请求的地域内。
ZoneId.description_en:
Storage placement group availability zone
The availability zone of the storage placement group must be within the requested region.

ClientToken.description_cn: 用以保证请求幂等性。该字符串由您的客户端生成，用以保证不同请求之间的唯一性。ClientToken是一个大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符的字符串。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency. This string is generated by your client to guarantee uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken is a case-sensitive string of up to 64 ASCII characters.

Description.description_cn: 快照的描述信息，默认为空，长度限制在1 ~ 255字符之间。
Description.description_en: Snapshot description. Default is empty; length must be between 1 and 255 characters.

ProjectName.description_cn:
快照所属项目。
- 快照不会继承云盘的项目，即快照与云盘可以所属不同的项目。

- 如果您在创建快照时未设置ProjectName，快照会默认加入default项目。
ProjectName.description_en:
List all project names associated with the snapshot
Note: If you do not set a ProjectName when creating a snapshot, the snapshot is added to the default project by default. In this case, sub-accounts without global permissions may not have permission to manage the snapshot.
If you do not set a ProjectName when creating a snapshot, the cloud disk is not added to any project by default and ProjectName remains empty. In this case, sub-accounts without global permissions may not have permission to manage the snapshot.

RetentionDays.description_cn:
快照保留时间，单位为天，取值说明如下：

- 空：永久保留快照 。

- 1~65536：指定保存天数。

默认为空，即默认永久保留快照。
快照保留时间从快照创建时刻开始计算。

SnapshotName.description_cn:
创建的快照名称。命名规范如下：

- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（\_）、中划线（-）和英文句号（.）。

- 为防止和自动快照的名称冲突，不能以“auto”开头。
SnapshotName.description_en: Snapshot name: Cannot start with auto; only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.) are allowed; length must be 1 to 128 characters

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
快照的标签键。

- 多个标签键之间用&分隔。
Tags.N.Key.description_en: Tag Key

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
快照的标签值。

- Tags.N.Value：N表示标签值的序号。取值范围：1～20。

- 多个标签值之间用&分隔。
Tags.N.Value.description_en: Label Value

ClientToken.description_cn:
保证请求幂等性。该字符串由您的客户端生成，用以保证不同请求之间的唯一性。说明如下：

- 大小写敏感。

- 不超过64个ASCII字符。
ClientToken.description_en: Token

Description.description_cn:
快照一致性组的描述，说明如下：

- 只能以中文、字母或下划线（\_）开头。

- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（\_）、中划线（-）和英文句号号（.）。

- 长度限制为1 ~ 255个字符。
Description.description_en: Description: Start with a Chinese character, letter, or underscore; only Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.) are allowed; length must be between 1 and 255 characters

Name.description_cn:
快照一致性组的名称，说明如下：

- 只能以中文、字母或下划线（\_）开头。

- 只能包含中文、字母、数字、下划线（\_）、中划线（-）和英文句号（.）。

- 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符。

如果没有设置该参数，则在控制台上快照一致性组的名称默认为-。
Name.description_en: Name: Must start with a Chinese character, letter, or underscore (_). Can only contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.). Length: 1–128 characters

ProjectName.description_cn:
快照一致性组所要加入的项目名称。
如果您在创建快照一致性组时未设置ProjectName，则快照一致性组默认加入default项目。
ProjectName.description_en: Name of the Project that the snapshot consistency group will join. Note: If you do not set a ProjectName when creating the snapshot consistency group, it will be added to the default project and ProjectName will be empty. In this case, sub-accounts without global permissions may not have operational permissions for this snapshot consistency group.

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:

- 多个标签值之间用&分隔。
Tags.N.Value.description_en: Label Value

VolumeIds.N.description_cn:
云盘ID，说明如下：

- 该云盘必须处于“已挂载”状态。

- 如果设置多个云盘，则这些云盘需要挂载在同一个ECS实例。
N表示云盘ID的序号，多个云盘ID之间用&分隔，取值范围为1～16。

ResourceIds.description_en: Instance ID

ResourceIds.N.description_cn:
绑定标签的资源ID。说明如下：

- ResourceIds.N：`N`表示资源的序号，取值范围：1～50。
- 多个资源之间用`&`分隔。
ResourceIds.N.description_en: Resource ID

- snapshotpolicy：自动快照策略。

- snapshotgroup：快照一致性组。
ResourceType.description_en: Resource Type

命名规则如下：

Tags.N.Value.description_en: Label Value

AutoRenew.description_en: Auto-Renewal Status

是否开启云盘性能突发。
性能突发功能当前处于邀测状态，如需使用，请联系客户经理。

ClientToken.description_cn: 用以保证请求幂等性。该字符串由您的客户端生成，用以保证不同请求之间的唯一性。ClientToken是一个大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符的字符串。
ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency. This string is generated by your client to guarantee uniqueness across requests. ClientToken is case-sensitive and must not exceed 64 ASCII characters.

DeleteProtection.description_cn: 云盘是否开启删除保护。
DeleteProtection.description_en: Whether to enable delete protection for the cloud disk

DeleteProtectionRetentionDays.description_cn: 删除保护涉及的快照数据默认永久保留，您也可以选择特定的保留时间，范围为 1～65536 天（默认30天），超过设置时间后快照将自动删除。
DeleteProtectionRetentionDays.description_en: Snapshot data involved in delete protection is permanently retained by default. You can also select a specific retention period, ranging from 1 to 65536 days (default is 30 days). After the set period, the snapshot will be automatically deleted.

Description.description_cn: 云盘的描述信息，默认为空，长度限制在1 ~ 255字符之间。
Description.description_en: The cloud disk description is empty by default. If provided, it must be between 1 and 255 characters long.

Encrypted.description_en: Whether the cloud disk is encrypted. Default value is false.

ExtraPerformanceIOPS.description_cn:
额外IOPS性能大小，单位为次/秒，各个类型的额外性能取值范围如下：

- IOPS型额外性能: 0~50000

- Balance型额外性能: 0~50000
仅当ExtraPerformanceTypeId参数值为Balance或IOPS时，才可以配置ExtraPerformanceIOPS参数。
ExtraPerformanceIOPS.description_en:
Extra IOPS performance, measured in operations per second. The value ranges for each type of extra performance are as follows:

- IOPS type extra performance: 0–50000

- Balance type extra performance: 0–50000
You can configure the ExtraPerformanceIOPS parameter only when the ExtraPerformanceTypeId parameter value is Balance or IOPS.

ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB.description_cn:
额外吞吐性能大小，单位为MB/s。
- 不同容量的吞吐型SSD云盘，可购买的额外吞吐量不同。
- 仅ExtraPerformanceTypeId参数值为Throughput时，才可以配置ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB参数。
ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB.description_en:
Extra throughput performance, measured in MB/s.
- The extra throughput available for purchase varies depending on the capacity of the throughput SSD cloud disk.
- You can configure the ExtraPerformanceThroughputMB parameter only when the ExtraPerformanceTypeId parameter value is Throughput.

ExtraPerformanceTypeId.description_cn:
额外性能的类型，不同的云盘，取值不同，说明如下：

- ESSD FlexPL数据盘的额外性能取值如下：

  - Balance：均衡型额外性能。

  - IOPS：IOPS型额外性能。

  - Throughput：吞吐量型额外性能。
关于ESSD FlexPL数据盘额外性能的详细介绍，请参见[云盘额外性能](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1174767)。


- TSSD_TL0数据盘仅支持取值Throughput，表示为TSSD_TL0云盘配置额外吞吐量，详细介绍，请参见[云盘规格-吞吐型SSD云盘](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1262162)

- 仅500 GiB及以上的ESSD FlexPL数据盘，才支持配置额外性能。

- 仅100 GiB及以上的TSSD\_TL0数据盘，才支持配置额外性能。
ExtraPerformanceTypeId.description_en:
Type of additional performance. The available values vary by cloud disk type, as follows:

- For ESSD FlexPL data disks, the available values are:

  - Balance: Balanced additional performance

  - IOPS: IOPS additional performance

  - Throughput: Throughput additional performance
For more details about additional performance for ESSD FlexPL data disks, see [Cloud Disk Additional Performance](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1174767).


- For TSSD_TL0 data disks, only Throughput is supported, which configures additional throughput for TSSD_TL0 cloud disks. For more details, see [Cloud Disk Specifications - Throughput SSD Cloud Disk](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/1262162)

- Only ESSD FlexPL data disks of 500 GiB or larger support additional performance configuration.

- Only TSSD_TL0 data disks of 100 GiB or larger support additional performance configuration.

InstanceId.description_cn:
创建云盘的同时挂载的ECS实例ID。
创建包年包月云盘时，该参数为必选参数，且挂载的ECS实例必须为包年包月实例。
包年包月云盘的地域和可用区需要与所挂载实例相同。当您同时设置了InstanceId和ZoneId参数后，如果实例所在的地域与ZoneId指定的地域不一致，则请求会失败。
InstanceId.description_en:
ECS instance ID to be attached when creating the cloud disk.
When creating a subscription cloud disk, this parameter is required, and the attached ECS instance must also be a subscription instance.
The region and availability zone of the subscription cloud disk must match those of the attached instance. If you set both the InstanceId and ZoneId parameters and the region of the instance does not match the region specified by ZoneId, the request will fail.

- TagFilters.N.Key：`N`表示标签键的序号。取值范围：1～10。

TagFilters.N.Key.description_en:
Specifies the tag key when querying resources by tag. Details:

- TagFilters.N.Key: `N` indicates the sequence number of the tag key. Value range: 1–10.
- Use `&` to separate multiple tag keys. Duplicate keys are not allowed.
- If this parameter is not provided, all tags are queried.
- If an empty string is provided, the error code `InvalidTagFilterKey.Malformed` is returned.

TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_cn:

- TagFilters.N.Values.N：第二个`N`表示标签值的序号。取值范围：1～3。
- 多个标签值之间用`&`分隔。
- 如果传入该参数，则必须先传入`TagFilters.N.Key`。
- 不传入该参数则表示查询同一标签键下的所有标签值。
- 传入空字符串时，表示查询标签值为空的标签。
TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_en:
Specifies the tag value when querying resources by tag. Details:

- TagFilters.N.Values.N: The first `N` indicates the sequence number of the tag key. Value range: 1–10.
- TagFilters.N.Values.N: The second `N` indicates the sequence number of the tag value. Value range: 1–3.
- Use `&` to separate multiple tag values.
- If this parameter is provided, `TagFilters.N.Key` must be provided first.
- If this parameter is not provided, all tag values under the same tag key are queried.
- If an empty string is provided, tags with empty values are queried.

- TagFilters.N.Key: N indicates the tag key index. Value range: 1–10.

- Use & to separate multiple tag keys. Duplicate keys are not allowed.

- If this parameter is not passed, all tags are queried.

- Passing an empty string returns error code InvalidTagFilterKey.Malformed.

TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_cn:
根据标签查询资源时指定的标签值。说明如下：

- TagFilters.N.Values.N：第一个N表示标签键的序号。取值范围：1～10。

- TagFilters.N.Values.N：第二个N表示标签值的序号。取值范围：1～3。

- 多个标签值之间用&分隔。

- 如果传入该参数，则必须先传入TagFilters.N.Key。

- 不传入该参数则表示查询同一标签键下的所有标签值。

- 传入空字符串时，表示查询标签值为空的标签。
TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_en:
Tag value specified when querying resources by tag. Description:

- TagFilters.N.Values.N: The first N indicates the tag key index. Value range: 1–10.

- TagFilters.N.Values.N: The second N indicates the tag value index. Value range: 1–3.

- Use & to separate multiple tag values.

- If this parameter is passed, TagFilters.N.Key must be passed first.

- If this parameter is not passed, all tag values under the same tag key are queried.

- Passing an empty string queries tags with empty values.

Cloud disk display name. Naming rules:

- Can contain Chinese, letters, numbers, underscore (_), or hyphen (-).
Length limit: 1–128 characters.

VolumeStatus.description_cn:
云盘状态，取值说明如下：
- available：可用。
- attaching：挂载中。
- attached：已挂载。
- detaching：卸载中。
- creating：创建中。
- deleting：删除中。
- error：错误。
- extending：扩容中。
- terminatesuspend：待释放。
退订包年包月云盘时，云盘的状态会变成待释放。
VolumeStatus.description_en:
Cloud disk status. Value description:
- available: Available.
- attaching: Attaching.
- attached: Attached.
- detaching: Detaching.
- creating: Creating.
- deleting: Deleting.
- error: Error.
- extending: Expanding.
- terminatesuspend: Pending release.
When unsubscribing from a subscription cloud disk, its status changes to pending release.

- ESSD_PL0：极速型SSD云盘，PL0规格。 
- ESSD_FlexPL: 极速型SSD云盘，FlexPL规格。
- TSSD_TL0：吞吐型SSD云盘。
关于云盘规格的详细说明，请参见[云盘规格](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/101839)。
VolumeType.description_en:

- PTSSD: Performance SSD.
- ESSD_PL0: Ultra-fast SSD cloud disk, PL0 specification.
- ESSD_FlexPL: Ultra-fast SSD cloud disk, FlexPL specification.
- TSSD_TL0: Throughput SSD cloud disk.
For detailed information about cloud disk specifications, see [Cloud Disk Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/101839).

ClientToken.description_en: Ensures request idempotency. Your client generates this string to guarantee uniqueness across requests. ClientToken is case-sensitive and must not exceed 64 ASCII characters.

NewSize.description_cn:
云盘容量大小，单位为GiB。扩容后的大小应该大于原大小。不同类型的云盘容量范围如下：

- 系统盘：
	- PTSSD：10~500 GiB
	- ESSD_PL0：20~2,048 GiB
	- ESSD_FlexPL：20~2,048 GiB
    - TSSD_TL0：40～2048 GiB
- 数据盘：
	- PTSSD：20~8,192 GiB
	- ESSD_PL0：10~65536 GiB
	- ESSD_FlexPL：10~65536 GiB
    - TSSD_TL0：40～65536 GiB
NewSize.description_en:
Cloud disk capacity is measured in GiB. The expanded capacity must be greater than the original size. Capacity ranges for different disk types are as follows:
System disk:
- PTSSD: 10–500 GiB
- ESSD_PL0: 20–2,048 GiB
- ESSD_FlexPL: 20–2,048 GiB
Data disk:
- PTSSD: 20–8,192 GiB
- ESSD_PL0: 10–32,768 GiB
- ESSD_FlexPL: 10–32,768 GiB
Note: If you attempt to expand the disk but specify a size equal to the original, the request will still be idempotent even if you do not provide the ClientToken parameter.

如果Encrypted是true，KMSKeyId为空，则使用默认密钥。

DestinationRetentionDays.description_cn: 复制快照的保留时间，单位为天，取值说明如下： -1：永久保存。 1~65536：指定保存天数。 默认值：永久保留。
DestinationRetentionDays.description_en:
Retention period for copied snapshots (days):
-1: Keep permanently
1–65536: Specify number of days to keep
Default: Keep permanently

RepeatDays.description_cn:
按天重复创建快照，即间隔一定天数创建快照，取值范围为\[1, 30\] 。
修改自动快照策略的`RepeatDays`后，修改自动快照策略的当天视为第一天。
RepeatDays.description_en: Create snapshots on a daily schedule, with a specified interval in days. Value range: [1, 30]. The day you modify the policy is considered the first day.

RepeatWeekdays.description_cn: 自动快照的重复日期，单位为天，周期为星期，取值说明如下： 取值范围：1~7，例如1表示周一。 当一星期内需要创建多次自动快照时，可以传入多个时间点，最多传入7个时间点。
RepeatWeekdays.description_en: Repeat dates for automatic snapshots are set in days, with a weekly cycle. Valid values: 1–7, where 1 represents Monday. If you need to create multiple automatic snapshots in a week, you can specify multiple time points, up to 7 in total.

RepeatWeekdays.N.description_cn:
按周重复创建快照，即在周一至周日之间选择一个或多个日期创建快照。说明如下：

- 取值范围为1~7，例如1表示周一。
- 当一星期内需要创建多次自动快照时，可以传入多个时间点，最多传入7个时间点。
RepeatWeekdays.N.description_en:
Create snapshots on a weekly schedule by selecting one or more days from Monday to Sunday. Details:

- Value range: 1~7, for example, 1 represents Monday.
- To create multiple automatic snapshots in a week, you can specify multiple days, up to 7 days.

RetentionDays.description_cn:
自动快照的保留时间，单位为天，修改保留时间后，不会影响历史快照，只对新增快照生效。
取值说明如下：

- \-1：永久保存。
- 1~65536：指定保存天数。
RetentionDays.description_en:
Retention period for automatic snapshots, in days. Changing the retention period does not affect historical snapshots and only applies to new snapshots.
Value details:

- -1: Save permanently.
- 1–65536: Specify retention days.

TimePoints.description_cn: 自动快照的创建时间点，取值说明如下： 使用UTC +8时间，单位为小时。 取值范围：0~23，代表00:00至23:00共24个时间点，例如1表示01:00。 当一天内需要创建多次自动快照时，可以传入多个时间点，最多传入24个时间点。
TimePoints.description_en: The automatic snapshot creation time points are as follows: Times are specified in UTC+8, using hours. Valid values are 0–23, representing 00:00 to 23:00; for example, 1 means 01:00. If you need to create multiple automatic snapshots in one day, you can specify multiple time points, up to 24.

TimePoints.N.description_cn:
自动快照的创建时间点，取值说明如下：

- 使用UTC +8时间，单位为小时。
- 取值范围：0~23，代表00:00至23:00共24个时间点，例如`1`表示01:00。
- 当一天内需要创建多次自动快照时，可以传入多个时间点，最多传入24个时间点。
TimePoints.N.description_en:
Automatic snapshot creation time points. Details:

- Uses UTC +8 time, in hours.
- Value range: 0~23, representing 00:00 to 23:00, for a total of 24 time points. For example, `1` means 01:00.
- To create multiple automatic snapshots in a day, you can specify multiple time points, up to 24 time points.

If your balance is insufficient, an exception order will be created and can only be voided. false: Only create the order without charging your account. If your balance is insufficient, a normal unpaid order will be created. You can pay for this order in the ECS console.

DurationSeconds.description_en: Temporary key validity period (in seconds). Minimum supported value is 900, maximum is 43200. If this value is not provided or is less than 900, the default is 3600; if it is greater than 43200, the default is 43200.

Policy.description_cn: 角色内联策略，用于进一步限制临时凭证的权限。如果内联权限策略不为空，则临时凭证的实际权限为所扮演角色的权限策略与内联权限策略的交集。策略语法格式同普通的IAM策略，可参考[策略语法介绍](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/65059)。
Policy.description_en: Role inline policy is used to further restrict the permissions of temporary credentials. If the inline permission policy is not empty, the actual permissions of the temporary credentials are the intersection of the role's permission policy and the inline permission policy. The policy syntax follows the standard IAM policy format; see [Policy Syntax Introduction](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6257/65059) for details.

RoleSessionName.description_cn: 角色会话名称，长度2-64字符，支持英文、数字和.-\_@符号。对于同一个角色，在每次扮演时可以指定不同的会话名称，从而达到区分会话的目的。该字段也会在[云审计](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/7015/166040)中体现，方便从审计日志中区分不同会话的访问记录。
RoleSessionName.description_en: Role session name, 2–64 characters long; supports English letters, numbers, and .-_@ symbols. For the same role, you can specify a different session name each time you assume the role to distinguish between sessions. This field also appears in [Cloud Audit](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/7015/166040), making it easy to identify access records for different sessions in audit logs.

RoleTrn.description_cn: 需要扮演的角色Trn，格式为`trn:iam::${AccountId}:role/${RoleName}`。其中`${AccountId}`需要填入角色所属的主账号ID，`${RoleName}`需要填入实际的角色名称。例如账号ID为2000012345的账号内角色名为myRole的角色对应的RoleTrn为`trn:iam::2000012345:role/myRole`
RoleTrn.description_en: Required RoleTrn format: `trn:iam::${AccountId}:role/${RoleName}`. Enter the main account ID for `${AccountId}` and the actual role name for `${RoleName}`. For example, if the account ID is 2000012345 and the role name is myRole, the corresponding RoleTrn is `trn:iam::2000012345:role/myRole`

ClientToken.description_en:
Client token, used to ensure request idempotency.

* This parameter is automatically generated by the client to ensure each request is unique, preventing repeated operations when the API call times out or encounters internal server errors and the client retries multiple times.
* Only ASCII characters are supported, with a maximum length of 64 characters.
* If this parameter is not specified, idempotency validation is not performed.

中转路由器实例的描述信息。

* 必须以字母、数字或中文开头，可包含字母、数字、中文和以下特殊字符：英文逗号（,）、点号（.）、下划线（_）、空格（ ）、等号（=）、短横线（-）、中文逗号（，）、中文句号（。）。
* 长度限制为0 ~ 255个字符。

Description.description_en:
Description of the transit router instance.

* Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. Can include letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: English comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。).
* Length must be between 0 and 255 characters.
* If this parameter is not provided or no value is specified, the default is an empty string.

Description.example_en: This transit router is used for testing.

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
中转路由器实例用户标签的标签键。

* 长度限制为1～128个字符。
* 大小写敏感，不能以`volc:`或`sys:`的任意大小写组合开头。
* 不能以空格开头或结尾。
* 允许包含字母、数字、空格（）、下划线（_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、减号（-）和@。

* 同一资源的标签键不允许重复。
* 不传入该参数或该参数不传入数值时，默认为空。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for user tags of transit router instances

* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters
* Case-sensitive; cannot start with any combination of `volc:` or `sys:` in any case
* Cannot start or end with a space
* Letters, numbers, spaces (), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals signs (=), plus signs (+), minus signs (-), and @ are allowed

* Duplicate tag keys are not allowed for the same resource
* If this parameter is not provided or no value is specified, the default is empty

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
中转路由器实例用户标签的标签值。

* 长度限制为0～255个字符。
* 大小写敏感，不能以空格开头或结尾。
* 允许包含字母、数字、空格（）、下划线（_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、减号（-）和@。

如果传入该参数，则必须先传入`Tags.N.Key`。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value for the transit router instance user tag.

* Length must be between 0 and 255 characters.
* Case-sensitive and cannot start or end with a space.
* Letters, numbers, spaces (), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and @ are allowed.

If this parameter is provided, you must first specify `Tags.N.Key`.

TransitRouterName.description_cn:
中转路由器实例的名称。

* 必须以字母、数字或中文开头，可包含字母、数字、中文和以下特殊字符：点号（.）、下划线（_）和短横线（-）。
* 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符。
* 不传入该参数或该参数不传入数值时，默认为中转路由器实例的ID。
TransitRouterName.description_en:
Name of the transit router instance.

* Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. Can include letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: period (.), underscore (_), and hyphen (-).
* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters.

* If this parameter is not provided or no value is specified, the default is the TR route entry ID.

TransitRouterRouteEntryNextHopId.description_cn:
路由条目的下一跳ID。

* 您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouterVpcAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/170304)接口获取VPC类型网络实例连接的ID。
* 您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouterVpnAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/170308)接口获取VPN类型网络实例连接的ID。
* 您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouterDirectConnectGatewayAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/155992)接口获取专线网关类型网络实例连接的ID。
* 您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouterPeerAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/1130781)接口获取跨地域连接的ID。
TransitRouterRouteEntryNextHopId.description_en:
Next hop ID of the route entry.

* You can call the [DescribeTransitRouterVpcAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/170304) API to obtain the ID of a VPC-type network instance connection.
* You can call the [DescribeTransitRouterVpnAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/170308) API to obtain the ID of a VPN-type network instance connection.
* You can call the [DescribeTransitRouterDirectConnectGatewayAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/155992) API to obtain the ID of a Direct Connect Gateway-type network instance connection.
* You can call the [DescribeTransitRouterPeerAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/1130781) API to obtain the ID of a cross-region connection.

TransitRouterRouteEntryNextHopType.description_cn:
路由条目的下一跳类型。取值如下：

* Attachment：网络实例，表示匹配该路由条目的流量会被转发到指定的网络实例。
* BlackHole：黑洞，表示匹配该路由条目的流量会被丢弃。
TransitRouterRouteEntryNextHopType.description_en:
Next hop type of the route entry. Valid values:

* Attachment: Network instance. Traffic matching this route entry will be forwarded to the specified network instance.
* BlackHole: Black hole. Traffic matching this route entry will be dropped.

TransitRouterRouteTableId.description_cn: 中转路由器实例关联的路由表的ID。您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouterRouteTables](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/170312)接口获取TR路由表的ID。
TransitRouterRouteTableId.description_en: The ID of the route table associated with the transit router instance. You can call the [DescribeTransitRouterRouteTables](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/170312) API to get the TR route table ID.

ActionResult.description_cn:
路由策略条目的策略行为。取值如下：

* Permit：允许。指允许匹配该路由策略条目的路由通过。
* Deny：拒绝。指拒绝匹配该路由策略条目的路由通过。
ActionResult.description_en:
Policy action of a routing policy entry. Possible values:

* Permit: Allow. Allows routes matching this routing policy entry to pass.
* Deny: Prevents routes matching this routing policy entry from passing.

ApplyAsPathValues.N.description_cn:
路由策略条目设置的路由AsPath。取值范围为1～4294967295。

* N：表示路由属性的序号，取值范围1～10。
* 多个路由属性之间使用&分隔。

`ActionResult`取值为“Permit”时，该参数生效。
ApplyAsPathValues.N.description_en:
Route AsPath set for the route policy entry. Value range: 1–4294967295.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the route attribute, ranging from 1 to 10.
* Use & to separate multiple route attributes.

This parameter takes effect when `ActionResult` is set to "Permit".

AsPathOperateMode.description_cn:
路由策略条目的AsPath设置方式。取值如下：

* Additive：追加AsPath。指在允许通过的路由的AsPath最前面追加指定的AsPath。
* Replace：替换AsPath。指使用指定的AsPath替换允许通过的路由的AsPath。

`ActionResult`取值为“Permit”时，该参数生效。
AsPathOperateMode.description_en:
AsPath setting method for routing policy entries. The available values are:

* Additive: Appends an AsPath. Adds the specified AsPath to the beginning of the AsPath of permitted routes.
* Replace: Replaces the AsPath. Uses the specified AsPath to replace the AsPath of permitted routes.

This parameter takes effect only when `ActionResult` is set to "Permit".

ClientToken.description_cn:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

* 该参数值由客户端自动生成，确保不同请求的取值唯一，避免当调用API超时或服务器内部错误时，客户端多次重试导致重复性操作。
* 取值仅支持ASCII字符，最大不超过64个字符。
* 未指定该参数值时，不进行幂等校验。
ClientToken.description_en:
Client token used to ensure request idempotency.

* This parameter is automatically generated by the client to ensure uniqueness across requests, preventing duplicate operations caused by repeated retries when API calls time out or server errors occur.
* Only ASCII characters are supported, with a maximum length of 64 characters.
* If this parameter is not specified, idempotency verification is not performed.

Description.description_cn:
路由策略条目的描述信息。

* 必须以字母、数字或中文开头，可包含字母、数字、中文和以下特殊字符：英文逗号（,）、点号（.）、下划线（_）、空格（ ）、等号（=）、短横线（-）、中文逗号（，）、中文句号（。）。
* 长度限制为0 ~ 255个字符。
* 不传入该参数或该参数不传入数值时，默认为空字符串。
Description.description_en:
Description for the route policy entry.

* Must start with a letter, number, or Chinese character. Can include letters, numbers, Chinese characters, and the following special characters: comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。).
* Length must be between 0 and 255 characters.
* If this parameter is not provided or no value is specified, the default is an empty string.
Description.example_cn: This transit router is used for test.
Description.example_en: This transit router is used for testing

DestinationResourceIds.N.description_cn:
路由策略条目的目的实例ID。

* 您可以调用[DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495)接口获取私有网络实例的ID。
* 您可以调用[DescribeDirectConnectGateways](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104711)接口获取专线网关实例的ID。
* 您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/156017)接口获取跨地域TR实例的ID。

* N：表示目的实例ID的序号，取值范围1～10。多个目的实例ID之间使用&分隔。
* 参数`DestinationResourceIds.N`传入数值后，该参数为必填。
* 指定的路由策略的作用方向为“In”时，不允许传入该字段。
DestinationResourceIds.N.description_en:
Destination instance ID of the routing policy entry.

* You can call the [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) API to obtain the ID of a VPC instance.
* You can call the [DescribeDirectConnectGateways](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104711) API to obtain the ID of a Direct Connect Gateway instance.
* You can call the [DescribeTransitRouters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/156017) API to obtain the ID of a cross-region TR instance.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the destination instance ID, with a value range of 1–10. Use & to separate multiple destination instance IDs.
* After a value is provided for the parameter `DestinationResourceIds.N`, this parameter is required.
* When the routing policy direction is set to "In", this field must not be specified.

DestinationResourceTypes.N.description_cn:
路由策略条目的目的实例类型。取值如下：

* 您可以调用[DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495)接口获取私有网络实例的ID。
* 您可以调用[DescribeDirectConnectGateways](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104711)接口获取专线网关实例的ID。
* 您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/156017)接口获取跨地域TR实例的ID。

* N：表示源实例ID的序号，取值范围1～10。多个源实例ID之间使用&分隔。
* 参数`SourceResourceTypes.N`传入数值后，该参数为必填。
DestinationResourceTypes.N.description_en:
Destination instance type for the route policy entry. The values are as follows:

* You can call the [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) API to obtain the ID of a VPC instance.
* You can call the [DescribeDirectConnectGateways](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104711) API to obtain the ID of a Direct Connect Gateway instance.
* You can call the [DescribeTransitRouters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/156017) API to obtain the ID of a cross-region TR instance.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the source instance ID, ranging from 1 to 10. Use & to separate multiple source instance IDs.
* After specifying the value for the parameter `SourceResourceTypes.N`, this parameter becomes required.

IpPrefixMatchMode.description_cn:
路由前缀的匹配模式。

* Include：模糊匹配。匹配条件中的路由前缀包含被匹配路由的路由前缀即判定为匹配成功。例如：路由前缀为10.10.0.0/16 的策略条目可以模糊匹配到目标网段为10.10.1.0/24的路由。
* Complete（默认值）：精确匹配。匹配条件中的路由前缀必须与被匹配路由的路由前缀一致，才判定为匹配成功。例如：路由前缀为10.10.0.0/16 的策略条目仅可以精确匹配到目标网段为10.10.0.0/16的路由。
IpPrefixMatchMode.description_en:
Route prefix matching modes

* Include: Fuzzy matching. A match is successful if the route prefix in the matching condition includes the route prefix of the route being matched. For example, a policy entry with the route prefix 10.10.0.0/16 can match a route whose target subnet is 10.10.1.0/24 using fuzzy matching.
* Complete (default): Exact matching. A match is successful only if the route prefix in the matching condition is identical to the route prefix of the route being matched. For example, a policy entry with the route prefix 10.10.0.0/16 can only match a route whose target subnet is 10.10.0.0/16 exactly.

IpPrefixes.N.description_cn:
路由策略条目的路由前缀。支持传入IPv4和IPv6网段。

* N：表示路由前缀的序号，取值范围1～200。多个路由前缀之间使用&分隔。
* 不传入该参数或该参数不传入数值时，默认为空字符串。

中转路由器IPv6功能正在邀测中，如需使用，请联系客户经理。
IpPrefixes.N.description_en:
Route prefix for the route policy entry. Supports IPv4 and IPv6 CIDR blocks.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the route prefix, ranging from 1 to 200. Use & to separate multiple route prefixes.
* If this parameter is not provided or no value is specified, the default is an empty string.

The IPv6 feature for transit routers is currently in beta testing. To use this feature, please contact your account manager.

PrefixListId.description_cn:

PrefixListId.description_en:

Priority.description_cn:
路由策略条目的优先级，默认为空。取值范围为1～10000。数字越小则优先级越高。
同一路由策略中不能存在优先级重复的路由策略条目。
Priority.description_en: Priority of the routing policy entry. Default is blank. Valid range: 1 to 10,000. Lower numbers have higher priority. Routing policy entries within the same policy cannot have duplicate priorities.

SourceResourceIds.N.description_cn:

SourceResourceIds.N.description_en:

SourceResourceTypes.N.description_en:
Source instance type of the routing policy entry. Valid values:

* VPC: Virtual Private Cloud
* DirectConnectGateway: Direct Connect Gateway
* TransitRouter: Cross-region TR

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the source instance type. You can specify up to 10 types in a single call. Use & to separate multiple source instance types.

- Outbound direction: The transit router only sends routes that match the routing policy when synchronizing routes to a network instance

* Length must be between 1 and 128 characters

* Cannot start or end with a space

* Tag keys for the same resource must be unique
* If this parameter is not provided or no value is specified, the default is empty

DestinationCidrBlock.description_en:
Destination IP address range: supports IPv4 and IPv6
- When `Protocol` is set to tcp, udp, gre, or all, this parameter accepts either IPv4 or IPv6 address ranges
- When `Protocol` is set to icmp, only IPv4 address ranges are supported
- When `Protocol` is set to icmpv6, only IPv6 address ranges are supported
- The type of IP address range entered for this parameter must match the type used for `SourceCidrBlock`; both must be IPv4 or both must be IPv6

DestinationPortEnd.description_cn:

DestinationPortEnd.description_en:

- When `Protocol` is set to icmp, icmpv6, gre, or all, only -1 is supported

DestinationPortStart.description_cn:

MatchDscp.description_cn:

MatchDscp.description_en:
DSCP value of the traffic packet. Range: -1, 0–63
Default value is -1, which means the DSCP value of the traffic packet can be any value to match this marking rule

Priority.description_cn:
标记规则的优先级，取值范围为 1～10000。
不同标记规则的优先级不能重复。
Priority.description_en: The priority of tagging rules ranges from 1 to 10,000. Each tagging rule must have a unique priority value.

Protocol.description_cn:

- udp：UDP协议。
- gre：GRE协议
- icmp：ICMP协议。
- icmpv6：ICMPV6协议。

Protocol.description_en:

- udp: UDP protocol
- gre: GRE protocol
- icmp: ICMP protocol
- icmpv6: ICMPv6 protocol
- all (default): Supports all protocols

RemarkingDscp.description_cn:

RemarkingDscp.description_en:
DSCP value to set for target traffic packets. Valid range: 0–63
When target traffic matches this marking rule, the DSCP value of the packet is replaced with the value of this parameter.

ApplianceModeEnabled.description_cn:
是否启动路径一致模式。请严格按照以下枚举值的大小写输入，不要传入其他取值。

* true：是。开启后，TR转发流量至该VPC连接时，将选择相同的可用区连接点转发请求流量和返回流量。
* false（默认值）：否。

中转路由器路径一致功能正在邀测中，如需使用，请联系客户经理。
ApplianceModeEnabled.description_en:
Enable path consistency mode. Please enter the following enumeration values exactly as shown, including case. Do not use any other values.

* true: Yes. When enabled, TR forwards traffic to this VPC connection using the same availability zone endpoint for both request and response traffic.
* false (default): No.

The path consistency feature for Transit Router is currently in beta. To use this feature, contact your account manager.

AttachPoints.N.SubnetId.description_cn:

AttachPoints.N.SubnetId.description_en:
Subnet ID of the network instance connection endpoint. You can call the [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) API to obtain the subnet ID.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the subnet ID, ranging from 1 to 100.
* Use & to separate multiple subnet IDs.

AttachPoints.N.ZoneId.description_en:

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the availability zone ID, ranging from 1 to 100.
* Separate multiple availability zone IDs with &.

AutoPublishRouteEnabled.description_cn:

* true：是。表示系统会自动同步该网络实例连接关联转发的TR路由表中的路由条目到网络实例的路由表中。
      仅当该参数配置为true，且网络实例连接关联转发的TR路由表中存在路由条目时，系统才会自动同步TR路由到网络实例的路由表中。
   
* false（默认值）：否。
AutoPublishRouteEnabled.description_en:
Automatically synchronize TR routes to the network instance route table. Please enter the following enumerated values exactly as shown, including case. Do not enter any other values.

* true: Yes. The system will automatically synchronize route entries from the TR route table associated with the network instance connection to the network instance's route table.
      The system will only automatically synchronize TR routes to the network instance's route table if this parameter is set to true and there are route entries in the TR route table associated with the network instance connection.
   
* false (default): No

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
网络实例连接用户标签的标签键。

* 长度限制为1～128个字符。
* 大小写敏感，不能以`volc:`或`sys:`的任意大小写组合开头。
* 不能以空格开头或结尾。
* 允许包含字母、数字、空格（）、下划线（_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、减号（-）和@。

* 同一资源的标签键不允许重复。
* 不传入该参数或该参数不传入数值时，默认为空。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key for the network instance connection user tag.

* Length limit: 1–128 characters.
* Case-sensitive. Cannot start with any case combination of `volc:` or `sys:`.
* Cannot start or end with a space.
* Allowed characters: letters, numbers, spaces (), underscore (_), period (.), colon (:), slash (/), equals sign (=), plus (+), minus (-), and @.

* Duplicate tag keys are not allowed for the same resource.
* If this parameter is not specified or no value is provided, the default is empty.

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
网络实例连接用户标签的标签值。

* 长度限制为0～255个字符。
* 大小写敏感，不能以空格开头或结尾。
* 允许包含字母、数字、空格（）、下划线（_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、减号（-）和@。

如果传入该参数，则必须先传入Tags.N.Key。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
Tag value for the network instance connection user tag.

* Length limit: 0–255 characters.
* Case-sensitive. Cannot start or end with a space.
* Allowed characters: letters, numbers, spaces (), underscore (_), period (.), colon (:), slash (/), equals sign (=), plus (+), minus (-), and @.

If you specify this parameter, you must first specify Tags.N.Key.

* If this parameter is not provided or no value is specified, the default is empty.

TagFilters.N.Key.description_cn:
网络实例连接标签的标签键。

* N：表示标签键的序号，取值范围1~10。多个标签键之间使用&分隔。
* 指定多个标签键时，表示查询同时包含所有指定标签键的网络实例连接。
TagFilters.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key of the network instance connection tag.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, with a value range of 1–10. Use & to separate multiple tag keys.
* Specifying multiple tag keys means querying network instance connections that contain all specified tag keys.

TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_cn:
网络实例连接标签的标签值。

* 第一个N：表示标签键的序号，取值范围1~10。
* 第二个N：表示标签值的序号，取值范围1~3。同一标签键多个标签值之间的关系为逻辑“或(OR)”，即查询同一标签键下添加其中一个标签值的资源。
* 多个标签值之间使用&分隔。
* 如果传入该参数，则必须先传入TagFilters.N.Key。
* 该参数传入空值时，表示查询指定标签键下标签值为空的资源。
TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_en:
Tag value of the network instance connection tag.

* The first N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, with a value range of 1–10.
* The second N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value, with a value range of 1–3. Multiple tag values under the same tag key have an “OR” relationship, meaning resources with any of the tag values under the same tag key will be queried.
* Use & to separate multiple tag values.
* If this parameter is passed, TagFilters.N.Key must be passed first.
* If this parameter is passed as an empty value, it means querying resources with empty tag values under the specified tag key.

TransitRouterAttachmentIds.N.description_cn:

* 您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouterVpnAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/170308)接口获取VPN类型网络实例连接的ID。
* 您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouterDirectConnectGatewayAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/155992)接口获取专线网关类型网络实例连接的ID。
* 您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouterPeerAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/1130781)接口获取跨地域连接的ID。
TransitRouterAttachmentIds.N.description_en:
ID of the network instance connection.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the network instance connection, with a value range of 1–100.
* Use “&” to separate multiple network instance connection IDs.


* You can call the [DescribeTransitRouterVpcAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/170304) API to obtain the IDs of VPC-type network instance connections.

TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_en:

* The first N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, ranging from 1 to 10

* Use & to separate multiple tag values

* If this parameter is provided, TagFilters.N.Key must be specified first
* If this parameter is left empty, resources with an empty tag value under the specified tag key will be queried

TagFilters.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key of the TR route table tag.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, with a value range of 1–10.
* Use & to separate multiple tag keys.
* When specifying multiple tag keys, it queries TR route tables that contain all specified tag keys.

TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_cn:
TR路由表标签的标签值。

* 第一个N：表示标签键的序号，取值范围1~10。
* 第二个N：表示标签值的序号，取值范围1~3。同一标签键多个标签值之间的关系为逻辑“或(OR)”，即查询同一标签键下添加其中一个标签值的资源。
* 多个标签值之间使用&分隔。
* 如果传入该参数，则必须先传入TagFilters.N.Key。
* 该参数传入空值时，表示查询指定标签键下标签值为空的资源。
TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_en:
Tag value of the TR route table tag.

* The first N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, with a value range of 1–10.
* The second N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value, with a value range of 1–3. For the same tag key, multiple tag values have a logical 'OR' relationship, meaning it queries resources that have any of the tag values under the same tag key.
* Use & to separate multiple tag values.
* If this parameter is provided, TagFilters.N.Key must be provided first.
* If this parameter is empty, it queries resources where the tag value under the specified tag key is empty.

- Depending on the resource type to be tagged, you can call [DescribeTransitRouterVpcAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/170304), [DescribeTransitRouterVpnAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/170308), [DescribeTransitRouterDirectConnectGatewayAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/155992), or [DescribeTransitRouterPeerAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/1130781) to obtain the ID of resources of type "transitrouterattachment".

TagFilters.N.Key.description_cn:
根据标签查询资源时指定的标签键。
- N：表示标签键的序号，取值范围为1～10。多个标签键之间使用&分隔。
- 指定多个标签键时，表示查询同时包含所有指定标签键的资源。
TagFilters.N.Key.description_en:
Tag key specified when querying resources by tag
- N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, with a value range of 1–10. Use & to separate multiple tag keys
- When multiple tag keys are specified, it means querying resources that contain all specified tag keys

TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_cn:
资源标签的标签值。
- 第一个N：表示标签键的序号，取值范围1~10。
- 第二个N：表示标签值的序号，取值范围1~3。同一标签键多个标签值之间的关系为逻辑“或(OR)”，即查询同一标签键下添加其中一个标签值的资源。
- 多个标签值之间使用&分隔。

- 如果传入该参数，则必须先传入TagFilters.N.Key。
- 该参数传入空值时，表示查询指定标签键下标签值为空的资源。
TagFilters.N.Values.N.description_en:
Tag value for resource tags.
- The first N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, range is 1–10.
- The second N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag value, range is 1–3. Multiple tag values under the same tag key are logically "OR", meaning resources with any of the tag values under the same tag key will be queried.
- Separate multiple tag values with &.

- If this parameter is provided, TagFilters.N.Key must be set first.
- If this parameter is empty, it queries resources where the specified tag key has an empty tag value.

TagType.description_cn:

- system：系统标签。
- 该参数可以为空，此时查询全部类型的标签。

Direction.description_en:
Direction of routing policy. Possible values:
- In: Receive direction. The transit router only receives routes that match the routing policy when learning routes from a network instance.
- Out: Send direction. The transit router only sends routes that match the routing policy when synchronizing routes to a network instance.

ActionResult.description_cn:
路由策略条目的策略行为。取值如下：

- Deny：拒绝。指拒绝匹配该路由策略条目的路由通过。
ActionResult.description_en:
Routing policy entry actions. Available options:
- Permit: Allow routes that match this policy entry
- Deny: Block routes that match this policy entry

ApplyAsPathValues.N.description_en:
The route AsPath set for the routing policy entry. Value range: 1–4294967295
- N: Indicates the sequence number of the route attribute. Value range: 1–10
- Use & to separate multiple route attributes

This parameter takes effect only when ActionResult is set to "Permit"

AsPathOperateMode.description_cn:
路由策略条目的AsPath设置方式。取值如下：
- Additive：追加AsPath。指在允许通过的路由的AsPath最前面追加指定的AsPath。
- Replace：替换AsPath。指使用指定的AsPath替换允许通过的路由的AsPath。

ActionResult取值为“Permit”时，该参数生效。
AsPathOperateMode.description_en:
AsPath setting method for routing policy entries. Available options:
- Additive: Prepends the specified AsPath to the beginning of the permitted route's AsPath
- Replace: Replaces the permitted route's AsPath with the specified AsPath

This parameter takes effect only when ActionResult is set to Permit

DestinationResourceIds.N.description_cn:
路由策略条目的目的实例ID。

- N：表示目的实例类型的序号，取值范围 1～10。多个目的实例类型之间使用&分隔。
- 指定的路由策略的作用方向为“In”时，不允许传入该字段。
DestinationResourceIds.N.description_en:
Destination instance ID for the routing policy entry.
- You can call the [DescribeVpcs](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70495) API to get the ID of a VPC instance.
- You can call the [DescribeDirectConnectGateways](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6407/104711) API to get the ID of a direct connect gateway instance.
- You can call the [DescribeTransitRouters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/156017) API to get the ID of a cross-region transit router (TR) instance.

- N: Indicates the sequence number of the destination instance type, with a value range of 1–10. Use & to separate multiple destination instance types.
- When the routing policy direction is "In", this field cannot be specified.

DestinationResourceTypes.N.description_cn:
路由策略条目的目的实例类型。取值如下：

- DirectConnectGateway：专线网关。
- TransitRouter：跨地域TR。
DestinationResourceTypes.N.description_en:

- VPC: Virtual Private Cloud
- DirectConnectGateway: Direct Connect Gateway
- TransitRouter: Cross-region Transit Router

IpPrefixMatchMode.description_cn:
路由前缀的匹配模式。
- Include：包含匹配。匹配条件中的路由前缀包含被匹配路由的路由前缀即判定为匹配成功。例如：路由前缀为10.10.0.0/16 的策略条目可以模糊匹配到目标网段为10.10.1.0/24的路由。
- Complete：精确匹配。匹配条件中的路由前缀必须与被匹配路由的路由前缀一致，才判定为匹配成功。例如：路由前缀为10.10.0.0/16 的策略条目仅可以精确匹配到目标网段为10.10.0.0/16的路由。
IpPrefixMatchMode.description_en:
Route Prefix Matching Modes
- Include: Contains match. The route prefix in the matching condition contains the route prefix of the route being matched, resulting in a successful match. For example, a policy entry with the route prefix 10.10.0.0/16 can loosely match a route with the target prefix 10.10.1.0/24.
- Complete: Exact match. The route prefix in the matching condition must be identical to the route prefix of the route being matched for a successful match. For example, a policy entry with the route prefix 10.10.0.0/16 can only exactly match a route with the target prefix 10.10.0.0/16.

IpPrefixes.N.description_cn:
路由策略条目的路由前缀。

Priority.description_cn:

Priority.description_en: Priority of the routing policy entry is empty by default. Valid range: 1 to 10,000. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Routing policy entries within the same policy cannot have duplicate priorities.

ApplianceModeEnabled.description_cn:
是否启动路径一致模式。请严格按照以下枚举值的大小写输入，不要传入其他取值。

* true：是。开启后，TR转发流量至该VPC连接时，将选择相同的可用区连接点转发请求流量和返回流量。
* false：否。

中转路由器路径一致功能正在邀测中，如需使用，请联系客户经理。
ApplianceModeEnabled.description_en:
Whether to enable path consistency mode. Please enter the following enumerated values exactly as shown, including case. Do not use any other values.

* true: Yes. When enabled, TR forwards traffic to this VPC connection by selecting the same availability zone endpoint for both request and response traffic.
* false: No.

The path consistency feature for Transit Router is currently in invite-only testing. To use this feature, please contact your account manager.

AttachPoints.N.SubnetId.description_cn:

* N：表示子网ID的序号，取值范围1～100。
* 多个子网ID之间用&分隔。
AttachPoints.N.SubnetId.description_en:
Subnet ID of the network instance connection endpoint. You can call the [DescribeSubnets](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6401/70497) API to obtain the subnet ID.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the subnet ID, ranging from 1 to 100.
* Separate multiple subnet IDs with &.

AttachPoints.N.ZoneId.description_cn:

* N：表示可用区ID的序号，取值范围1～100。

AttachPoints.N.ZoneId.description_en:
ID of the availability zone to which the subnet belongs.

* N: Indicates the sequence number of the availability zone ID, ranging from 1 to 100.
* Separate multiple availability zone IDs with &.

AutoPublishRouteEnabled.description_cn:
是否自动同步TR路由到网络实例路由表中。请严格按照以下枚举值的大小写输入，不要传入其他取值。

* true：是。表示系统会自动同步该网络实例连接关联转发的TR路由表中的路由条目到网络实例的路由表中。
      仅当该参数配置为true，且网络实例连接关联转发的TR路由表中存在路由条目时，系统才会自动同步TR路由到网络实例的路由表中。
   
* false（默认值）：否。
AutoPublishRouteEnabled.description_en:
Whether to automatically synchronize TR routes to the network instance route table. Please enter the following enumerated values exactly as shown, including case. Do not use any other values.

* true: Yes. The system will automatically synchronize route entries from the TR route table associated with this network instance connection to the network instance's route table.
      The system will only automatically synchronize TR routes to the network instance's route table if this parameter is set to true and there are route entries in the TR route table associated with the network instance connection.
   
* false (default): No.

HealthCheckRevokeRouteEnabled.description_cn:

Period.description_cn:
中转路由器带宽包的购买时长，默认值为1。取值如下：
- 当PeriodUnit取值为“Month”时，取值为1～9，12，24和36。
- 当PeriodUnit取值为“Year”时，取值为1～3。
Period.description_en:
Purchase duration for the transit router bandwidth package. Default value is 1. Valid values are:
- If PeriodUnit is 'Month', valid values are 1–9, 12, 24, and 36
- If PeriodUnit is 'Year', valid values are 1–3

PeriodUnit.description_cn:
中转路由器带宽包的计费周期。取值如下：
- Month（默认值）：按月计费。
- Year：按年计费。
PeriodUnit.description_en:
Billing cycle for transit router bandwidth package. Available options:
- Month (default): Billed monthly
- Year: Billed yearly

RemainRenewTimes.description_cn:
自动续费的次数。
取值包括-1和1～100，默认值为-1，表示自动续费无限次。
当`RenewType`配置为Auto时生效。
RemainRenewTimes.description_en:
Number of auto-renewals
Values: -1 or 1–100. Default is -1, which means unlimited auto-renewals
Effective when `RenewType` is set to Auto

RenewPeriod.description_cn:
单次自动续费的时长，单位为月。
取值包括1～3，6和12，默认值为1。
当`RenewType`配置为Auto时生效。
RenewPeriod.description_en:
Duration of each automatic renewal, in months
Valid values: 1–3, 6, and 12; default is 1
Effective when `RenewType` is set to Auto

RenewType.description_cn:
中转路由器带宽包的续费类型。取值如下：
- Manual：手动续费。
- Auto：自动续费。
- NoRenew：不续费。
RenewType.description_en:
Renewal types for transit router bandwidth packages. Available options:
- Manual: Renew manually
- Auto: Renew automatically
- NoRenew: Do not renew

TransitRouterBandwidthPackageId.description_cn: 中转路由器带宽包的ID。您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouterBandwidthPackages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/1130785)接口，查询中转路由器带宽包ID。
TransitRouterBandwidthPackageId.description_en: Transit router bandwidth package ID. Call the [DescribeTransitRouterBandwidthPackages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/1130785) API to query the transit router bandwidth package ID.

ResourceIds.N.description_cn:
资源的ID。
- N：表示资源 ID的序号，取值范围 1～50。
- 多个资源 ID之间使用&分隔。

- 您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/156017)接口获取“transitrouter”类型资源的ID。
- 您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouterRouteTables](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/170312)接口获取“transitrouterroutetable”类型资源的D。
- 您可以根据待添加标签资源的类型，分别调用[DescribeTransitRouterVpcAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/170304)、[DescribeTransitRouterVpnAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/170308)、[DescribeTransitRouterDirectConnectGatewayAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/155992)或[DescribeTransitRouterPeerAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/1130781)接口获取“transitrouterattachment”类型资源的ID。
- 您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouterMulticastDomains](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/1544105)获取“transitroutermulticastdomain”类型资源的ID。
- 您可以调用[DescribeTransitRouterBandwidthPackages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/1130785)接口获取“transitrouterbandwidthpackage”类型资源的ID。
ResourceIds.N.description_en:
Resource ID.
- N indicates the sequence number of the resource ID, range: 1–50
- Use & to separate multiple resource IDs

- You can call the [DescribeTransitRouters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/156017) API to get the ID of a 'transitrouter' resource
- You can call the [DescribeTransitRouterRouteTables](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/170312) API to get the ID of a 'transitrouterroutetable' resource
- Depending on the resource type to be tagged, you can call [DescribeTransitRouterVpcAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/170304), [DescribeTransitRouterVpnAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/170308), [DescribeTransitRouterDirectConnectGatewayAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/155992), or [DescribeTransitRouterPeerAttachments](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/1130781) to get the ID of a 'transitrouterattachment' resource
- You can call [DescribeTransitRouterMulticastDomains](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/1544105) to get the ID of a 'transitroutermulticastdomain' resource
- You can call [DescribeTransitRouterBandwidthPackages](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6979/1130785) API to get the ID of a 'transitrouterbandwidthpackage' resource

ResourceType.description_cn:
资源的类型，取值如下：
- transitrouter：中转路由器实例。
- transitrouterroutetable：TR路由表。
- transitrouterattachment：实例连接，包括VPC、VPN、专线网关类型网络实例连接和跨地域连接。
- transitroutermulticastdomain：TR组播域。
- transitrouterbandwidthpackage：中转路由器带宽包。
ResourceType.description_en:
Resource type. Possible values are as follows:
- transitrouter: Transit router instance
- transitrouterroutetable: TR route table
- transitrouterattachment: Instance attachment, including VPC, VPN, Direct Connect Gateway network instance attachments, and cross-region attachments
- transitroutermulticastdomain: TR multicast domain
- transitrouterbandwidthpackage: Transit router bandwidth package

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
用户标签的标签键。
- 长度限制为1～128个字符。
- 大小写敏感，不能以`volc:`或`sys:`的任意大小写组合开头。
- 不能以空格开头或结尾。
- 允许包含各国语言文字、数字、空格（）、下划线（\_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、减号（-）和@。

- 同一资源的标签键不允许重复。如果传入的Tags.N.Key与已有标签的标签键重复，则后添加的标签会覆盖原有标签。
- 不传入该参数或该参数不传入数值时，默认为空。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
User tag key.
- Length limit: 1–128 characters
- Case-sensitive; cannot start with any combination of 'volc:' or 'sys:' (case-insensitive)
- Cannot start or end with a space
- Can include characters from any language, numbers, spaces (), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals signs (=), plus signs (+), minus signs (-), and @

- Tag keys for the same resource cannot be duplicated. If the Tags.N.Key you pass is the same as an existing tag key, the newly added tag will overwrite the original tag
- If you do not pass this parameter or do not provide a value, it defaults to empty

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
用户标签的标签值。
- 长度限制为1～256个字符。
- 大小写敏感，不能以空格开头或结尾。
- 允许包含各国语言文字、数字、空格（）、下划线（\_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、减号（-）和@。

如果传入该参数，则必须先传入Tags.N.Key。
Tags.N.Value.description_en:
User tag value.
- Length limit: 1–256 characters
- Case-sensitive; cannot start or end with a space
- Can include characters from any language, numbers, spaces (), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equals signs (=), plus signs (+), minus signs (-), and @

If you pass this parameter, you must first pass Tags.N.Key

传入的Tags.N.Key不存在或已经解绑时默认返回解绑成功，不报错。
TagKeys.N.description_en:
Tag key of the user label to be deleted. Cannot start or end with a space
- N: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key, ranging from 1 to 20
- Use & to separate multiple tag keys

If the specified Tags.N.Key does not exist or is already unbound, the system returns success by default without an error
