DeployMode.description_cn:
部署模式，取值：

* **Unmanaged**：非托管模式部署。
* **Managed**：托管模式部署。
   可以调用 [ListSupportedAddons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115201) 接口，获取待安装组件的托管模式。

若不传入参数值，当组件支持托管时，此处系统默认为 **Managed**；当组件不支持托管时，此处系统默认为 **Unmanaged**。
DeployMode.description_en:
Deployment mode. Values:

* **Unmanaged**: Deploy in unmanaged mode
* **Managed**: Deploy in managed mode
   You can call the [ListSupportedAddons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115201) API to get the managed mode for the component to be installed

If no parameter value is provided, the system defaults to **Managed** when the component supports managed mode; otherwise, it defaults to **Unmanaged**

DeployNodeType.description_cn:
部署节点类型。仅`DeployModes=Unmanaged`时，才需要指定该参数。取值：

* **Node**：以节点（云服务器）方式部署。
* **VirtualNode**：以虚拟节点（弹性容器实例）方式部署。

* 若目标当前集群已安装了 vci-virtual-kubelet 组件，则此处默认值为 **VirtualNode**，否则默认值为 **Node**。
* 请调用 [ListAddons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115206) 接口，获取当前集群已安装的组件。
DeployNodeType.description_en:
Deployment node type. Specify this parameter only when `DeployModes=Unmanaged`. Values:

* **Node**: Deploy as a node (cloud server)
* **VirtualNode**: Deploy as a virtual node (elastic container instance)

* If the target cluster already has the vci-virtual-kubelet component installed, the default value here is **VirtualNode**; otherwise, the default value is **Node**
* Call the [ListAddons](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115206) API to get the components installed in the current cluster

* **false**：（默认值）关闭删除保护。
* **true**：开启删除保护，不允许直接删除集群。

   创建集群后，可以通过调用 [UpdateClusterConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115189) 接口，更改集群的 **DeleteProtectionEnabled** 配置，再次进行删除；也可以在调用 [DeleteCluster](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115188) 时，配置 **Force**参数，选择强制删除集群。
DeleteProtectionEnabled.description_en:
Cluster deletion protection. Available values:

* **false** (default): Disable deletion protection
* **true**: Enable deletion protection. Direct cluster deletion is not allowed

   After creating a cluster, you can call the [UpdateClusterConfig](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115189) API to modify the **DeleteProtectionEnabled** setting and then delete the cluster again. Alternatively, when calling [DeleteCluster](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115188), you can set the **Force** parameter to forcibly delete the cluster.

Tags.description_cn:
自定义的资源标签，用于从不同维度对具有相同特征的集群进行分类、搜索和聚合，能够灵活管理集群。

* **Tags** 中各个 **Key** 不可重复。
* 资源已有相同 **Tags.Key** 的情况下，重复绑定 **Tags.Key** 不会报错，会更新为最新的 **Tags.Value**。
* 单个资源最多支持绑定 50 个 **Tags**。
* **Tags** 中的 **Key**、**Value**不允许在最前或最后输入空格。
Tags.description_en:
Custom resource tags are used to categorize, search, and aggregate clusters with similar characteristics from different perspectives, enabling flexible cluster management.

* Each **Key** in **Tags** must be unique
* If a resource already has the same **Tags.Key**, binding the same **Tags.Key** again will not cause an error; it will update to the latest **Tags.Value**
* A single resource supports up to 50 **Tags**
* Leading or trailing spaces are not allowed in **Tags** **Key** or **Value**

Type.description_cn:
创建的集群类型，vestack专属字段，取值：
    - Standard：标准版集群，
    - OnPremise：基于自建主机的集群，
    - Registered：注册集群
Type.description_en:
Cluster type created. Vestack-specific field. Possible values:
    - Standard: Standard cluster
    - OnPremise: Cluster based on self-hosted servers
    - Registered: Registered cluster

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求幂等性的字符串。该字符串由调用方传入，需保证不同请求之间唯一。ClientToken 对大小写敏感，且最大值不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: String used to ensure request idempotency. The caller must provide this string and ensure it is unique for each request. ClientToken is case-sensitive and must not exceed 64 ASCII characters.

ClusterId.description_cn:
默认节点池所在集群的 ID。
可以调用 [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) 接口，获取集群 ID。
集群必须处于`{Running,[Ok]}`或`{Updating,[Progressing]}`状态。可调用 [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) 接口获取集群当前的状态。
ClusterId.description_en:
The ID of the cluster where the default node pool resides.
You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to obtain the cluster ID.
The cluster must be in the `{Running,[Ok]}` or `{Updating,[Progressing]}` state. You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to check the current status of the cluster.

* 单个资源最多支持绑定50个 **Tags**。
* **Tags** 中的 **Key**、**Value**不允许在最前或最后输入空格。
Tags.description_en:
Default node pool tag information is used to categorize, search, and aggregate node pools with similar characteristics from different perspectives, enabling flexible management of node pools.

* Each **Key** in **Tags** must be unique.
* If a resource already has the same **Tags.Key**, binding the same **Tags.Key** again will not return an error and will update to the latest **Tags.Value**.
* A single resource supports up to 50 **Tags**.
* Spaces are not allowed at the beginning or end of **Key** or **Value** in **Tags**.

ClientToken.description_en: String used to ensure request idempotency. Provided by the caller and must be unique for each request. ClientToken is case-sensitive and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters.

* 支持大小写英文字母、汉字、数字、短划线（-），长度限制为 2～64 个字符。

不能使用默认节点池保留名：`vke-default-nodepool`。
Name.description_en:
Node pool name

* The node pool name must be unique within the same cluster
* Supports uppercase and lowercase English letters, Chinese characters, numbers, and hyphens (-); length must be between 2 and 64 characters

Do not use the reserved default node pool name: `vke-default-nodepool`

NodeConfig.description_cn: 节点池中云服务器（ECS）实例配置。
NodeConfig.description_en: ECS Instance Configuration in the Node Pool

自定义的资源标签，用于从不同维度对具有相同特征的节点池进行分类、搜索和聚合，能够灵活管理节点池。

* **Tags** 中各个 **Key** 不可重复。
* 资源已有相同 **Tags.Key** 的情况下，重复绑定 **Tags.Key** 不会报错，会更新为最新的 **Tags.Value**。
* 单个资源最多支持绑定 50 个 **Tags**。
* **Tags** 中的 **Key**、**Value**不允许在最前或最后输入空格。
Tags.description_en:
Custom resource tags let you classify, search, and aggregate node pools with similar characteristics from different dimensions, enabling flexible node pool management.

* Each Key in Tags must be unique
* If a resource already has the same Tags.Key, binding the same Tags.Key again will not cause an error; the Tags.Value will be updated to the latest value
* A single resource can have up to 50 Tags
* Spaces are not allowed at the beginning or end of Key or Value in Tags

AdditionalContainerStorageEnabled.description_cn:
选择配置节点的数据盘并格式化挂载作为容器镜像和日志的存储目录，取值：

* **false**：（默认值）关闭。
   * 默认节点池：表示不挂载数据盘。
   * 自定义节点池：使用节点池的数据盘配置进行挂载，被添加到节点池的 ECS 实例数据盘必须包含目标节点池指定了挂载的数据盘（含本地盘），且盘类型和大小完全一致。
* **true**: 开启。此时必须同时配置 **ContainerStoragePath** 参数。节点通过 **ContainerStoragePath**参数中的配置进行挂载，而忽略节点池的数据盘配置，对被添加到节点池的 ECS 实例数据盘无特殊要求。
AdditionalContainerStorageEnabled.description_en:
Select and configure a node's data disk, format and mount it as the storage directory for container images and logs. Values:

* **false** (default): Disabled
   * Default node pool: Data disk will not be mounted.
   * Custom node pool: Mounting uses the node pool's data disk configuration. The ECS instance data disk added to the node pool must include the data disk specified for mounting by the target node pool (including local disks), and the disk type and size must match exactly.
* **true**: Enabled. You must also configure the **ContainerStoragePath** parameter. The node will mount according to the configuration in the **ContainerStoragePath** parameter, ignoring the node pool's data disk configuration. There are no special requirements for the ECS instance data disk added to the node pool.

ClientToken.description_cn: 用于保证请求幂等性的字符串。该字符串由调用方传入，需保证不同请求之间唯一。ClientToken 对大小写敏感，且最大值不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符。
ClientToken.description_en: String used to ensure request idempotency. The caller provides this string and must ensure it is unique for each request. ClientToken is case-sensitive and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters.

ClusterId.description_cn:
集群的 ID。
可以调用 [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) 接口，获取集群 ID。
集群必须处于`{Running,[*]}` 或 `{Updating,[Progressing]}`状态。可调用 [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) 接口获取集群当前的状态。
ClusterId.description_en:
Cluster ID.
You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to get the cluster ID.
The cluster must be in the `{Running,[*]}` or `{Updating,[Progressing]}` state. You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to check the current cluster status.

ContainerStoragePath.description_cn:
使用该数据盘设备挂载容器和镜像存储目录`/var/lib/containerd`。
仅当`AdditionalContainerStorageEnabled=true`时有效，且不能为空。
须满足以下条件，否则将初始化失败：

* 仅支持已挂载数据盘的 ECS 实例。
* 指定数据盘设备名时，请确保该数据盘设备存在，否则会初始化失败。
* 指定数据盘分区或逻辑卷名时，请确保该分区或逻辑卷存在，且为 ext4 文件系统。

* 指定数据盘设备时，将自动格式化后直接挂载，请注意提前备份数据。
* 指定数据盘分区或逻辑卷名时，不需要格式化。
ContainerStoragePath.description_en:
Use this data disk device to mount the `/var/lib/containerd` directory for container and image storage.
This parameter is only valid when `AdditionalContainerStorageEnabled=true` and must not be empty.
The following conditions must be met, otherwise initialization will fail:

* Only ECS instances with mounted data disks are supported.
* If you specify a data disk device name, ensure the device exists; otherwise, initialization will fail.
* If you specify a data disk partition or logical volume name, ensure the partition or logical volume exists and uses the ext4 file system.

* If you specify a data disk device, it will be automatically formatted and mounted directly. Please back up your data in advance.
* If you specify a data disk partition or logical volume name, formatting is not required.

GpuDriverConfig.description_cn:
节点 GPU 驱动配置。该配置的优先级高于`GpuDriverVersion`字段。
* 该参数适用于默认节点池和自定义节点池。
* 添加到自定义节点池且未配置该参数时，节点继承使用自定义节点池的`GpuDriverConfig`配置。
GpuDriverConfig.description_en:
Node GPU driver configuration. This configuration takes precedence over the `GpuDriverVersion` field.
* This parameter applies to both the default node pool and custom node pools.
* If added to a custom node pool without configuring this parameter, nodes inherit the `GpuDriverConfig` configuration from the custom node pool.

GpuDriverVersion.description_cn:
**【该参数已废弃，请使用 GpuDriverConfig 代替】​**指定在节点上安装的 GPU 驱动版本。
可以调用 [ListSupportedGpuDriverVersions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/2171489) 接口，获取镜像支持安装的 GPU 驱动版本列表。
GpuDriverVersion.description_en:
**[This parameter is deprecated. Please use GpuDriverConfig instead]** Specifies the GPU driver version installed on the node.
You can call the [ListSupportedGpuDriverVersions](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/2171489) API to obtain the list of GPU driver versions supported by the image.

ImageId.description_cn:
节点对应的 ECS 实例使用的镜像 ID。
不同的镜像类型对应的镜像 ID 也不同，详细说明，请参见 [容器服务支持的公共镜像](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1255819#%E5%AE%B9%E5%99%A8%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E6%94%AF%E6%8C%81%E7%9A%84%E5%85%AC%E5%85%B1%E9%95%9C%E5%83%8F)。
若不传该参数，容器服务将根据您所选的 ECS 实例规格，默认分配与该规格对应的 **veLinux-VKE** 镜像 ID。
ImageId.description_en:
The image ID used by the ECS instance corresponding to the node.
Different image types have different image IDs. For details, see [Public Images Supported by Container Service](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1255819#%E5%AE%B9%E5%99%A8%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1%E6%94%AF%E6%8C%81%E7%9A%84%E5%85%AC%E5%85%B1%E9%95%9C%E5%83%8F).
If this parameter is not provided, Container Service will assign the default **veLinux-VKE** image ID according to the ECS instance type you selected.

InitializeScript.description_cn:
创建 ECS 节点并完成 Kubernetes 组件部署后执行的脚本。支持 Shell 格式，Base64 编码后长度不超过 1 KB。

* 为空时，节点继承使用默认节点池配置的初始化脚本`NodeConfig.InitializeScript`。
* 自定义填写脚本内容后，使用自定义的脚本，忽略默认节点池配置的初始化脚本。

Base64 编码后长度不超过 8 KB。若同时传入 **InitializeScript** 和 **PreScript**，则两个参数的传入值总长度也不能超过 8 KB。
InitializeScript.description_en:
Script executed after creating the ECS node and completing Kubernetes component deployment. Supports Shell format. The length after Base64 encoding must not exceed 1 KB.

* If left empty, the node inherits the default node pool initialization script `NodeConfig.InitializeScript`.
* If you provide a custom script, the custom script will be used and the default node pool initialization script will be ignored.

After Base64 encoding, the length must not exceed 8 KB. If both **InitializeScript** and **PreScript** are provided, the total length of both parameters must not exceed 8 KB.

InstanceIds.description_cn:
要添加到集群的 ECS 实例 ID。单次调用最多支持填写 100 个 ECS 实例 ID。
调用 [DescribeInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70466) 接口，获取 ECS 实例 ID。该 ECS 实例须满足以下条件：

* 与集群在同一个私有网络内。
* 未被其他集群使用。
* 实例状态必须处于 **运行中**（`Running`）。
* 添加的节点数量不能超过集群所支持的最大节点数上限。
* 请勿重复添加同一个 ECS 实例。

若将 ECS 实例添加到自定义节点池，请注意以下事项：

* 当前节点池启用了 **AffinityGroupConfig** 亲和组配置（邀测）时，此处填写的 ECS 实例 ID 数量必须是亲和组规格的整数倍，否则无法成功添加。
* 当前节点池未启用 **AffinityGroupConfig**（邀测）时，若您填写了亲和组 ECS 实例 ID，可能会导致非预期行为。建议在非亲和组购买方式的节点池中，不要选择亲和组 ECS 实例。
InstanceIds.description_en:
ECS instance IDs to add to the cluster. You can specify up to 100 ECS instance IDs in a single request.
Call the [DescribeInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70466) API to obtain ECS instance IDs. The ECS instances must meet the following requirements:

* Located in the same VPC as the cluster
* Not used by another cluster
* Instance status must be **Running** (`Running`)
* The number of nodes added cannot exceed the cluster's maximum supported node count
* Do not add the same ECS instance more than once

If you are adding ECS instances to a custom node pool, note the following:

* If the node pool has **AffinityGroupConfig** enabled (invite-only), the number of ECS instance IDs entered here must be a multiple of the affinity group specification; otherwise, the addition will fail
* If the node pool does not have **AffinityGroupConfig** enabled (invite-only), specifying affinity group ECS instance IDs may cause unexpected behavior. We recommend not selecting affinity group ECS instances in node pools purchased without affinity group configuration

KeepContainerdDirectory.description_cn:
进行数据盘挂载前，是否清理`containerd`目录，取值：

* **true**：清理
* **false**：不清理
KeepContainerdDirectory.description_en:
Before mounting the data disk, should the `containerd` directory be cleaned? Options:

* **true**: Clean
* **false**: Do not clean

KeepInstanceName.description_cn:
是否保留原 ECS 实例名称，取值：

* **false**：（默认值）不保留原 ECS 实例名称，由容器服务自动为其命名。
* **true**：保留原 ECS 实例名称。
KeepInstanceName.description_en:
Whether to retain the original ECS instance name. Values:

* **false**: (default) Do not retain the original ECS instance name; Container Service will automatically assign a name.
* **true**: Retain the original ECS instance name.

KubernetesConfig.description_cn:
节点 Kubernetes 相关配置。

* 为空时，节点继承使用默认节点池的 Kubernetes 配置`KubernetesConfig.Labels/Taints/Cordon`。
* 自定义填写配置后，使用自定义配置内容，忽略默认节点池的 Kubernetes 配置。
KubernetesConfig.description_en:
Node Kubernetes-related configuration.

* If empty, the node inherits the default node pool's Kubernetes configuration `KubernetesConfig.Labels/Taints/Cordon`
* If you enter a custom configuration, the custom configuration will be used and the default node pool's Kubernetes configuration will be ignored

NamePrefix.description_cn:
节点命名前缀，优先级比 **KeepInstanceName** 低，取值为空字符串时表示不启用节点命名前缀。
校验规则如下：

* 支持英文字母、数字和中划线(-)，不能连续使用中划线(-)
* 只能以英文字母开头，英文字母或数字结尾
* 长度 2-51 个字符
NamePrefix.description_en:
Node name prefix. Lower priority than **KeepInstanceName**. If set to an empty string, the node name prefix is not enabled.
Validation rules:

* Supports English letters, numbers, and hyphens (-); hyphens (-) cannot be used consecutively
* Must start with an English letter and end with an English letter or number
* Length must be 2–51 characters

NodePoolId.description_cn:
节点池 ID。

* 不传入参数值：表示将已有 ECS 实例添加到默认节点池。
* 传入参数值：表示将已有 ECS 实例添加到自定义节点池。可调用 [ListNodePools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115197) 接口，获取目标自定义节点池 ID。

若此处填写 **自定义节点池 ID**，则待添加的节点将应用自定义节点池上的 Kubernetes 配置和节点配置（包括 ECS 实例标签、标签、污点、封锁节点配置、项目、节点名称前缀等），因此 **InitializeScript**、**KubernetesConfig**、**ImageId** 参数配置将无效，上述参数仅在默认节点池中添加已有节点时有效。
NodePoolId.description_en:
Node pool ID

* If no parameter value is provided: existing ECS instances will be added to the default node pool.
* If a parameter value is provided: existing ECS instances will be added to a custom node pool. You can call the [ListNodePools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115197) API to obtain the target custom node pool ID.

If you enter a **custom node pool ID** here, the nodes to be added will use the Kubernetes configuration and node settings from the custom node pool (including ECS instance tags, labels, taints, node blocking configuration, project, node name prefix, etc). Therefore, the **InitializeScript**, **KubernetesConfig**, and **ImageId** parameter settings will be ignored. These parameters are only valid when adding existing nodes to the default node pool.

PreScript.description_cn:
【[邀测·申请试用](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/145623)】部署节点前执行的脚本。输入Base64 编码后的 Shell 格式脚本。
* 参数值为空时，待添加的节点继承默认节点池配置的前置脚本 **NodeConfigRequest.PreScript**。
* 自定义填写脚本内容后，将会忽略默认节点池配置的前置脚本，使用此处输入的脚本。
* Base64 编码后长度不超过 8 KB。若同时传入 **InitializeScript** 和 **PreScript**，则两个参数的传入值总长度也不能超过 8 KB。
PreScript.description_en:
[Invite Test · Apply for Trial](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/145623) Script executed before deploying the node. Enter a Shell script in Base64 encoding.
* If the parameter value is empty, the node to be added inherits the default node pool's pre-script configuration **NodeConfigRequest.PreScript**
* If you enter a custom script, the default node pool pre-script will be ignored and the script entered here will be used
* The length after Base64 encoding must not exceed 8 KB. If both **InitializeScript** and **PreScript** are provided, the total length of both parameters must not exceed 8 KB

Roles.description_cn:
节点角色，取值如下：

* Master：master 节点
* Etcd：etcd 节点
* Worker：worker 节点
Roles.description_en:
Node role. Values:

* Master: master node
* Etcd: etcd node
* Worker: worker node

SkipReplaceSystem.description_cn:
添加已有节点时是否跳过重置系统：

* **true**：跳过重置系统，即不重置已有节点对应 ECS 实例的操作系统。
* **false**：（默认值）不跳过重置系统，即重置已有节点对应 ECS 实例的操作系统。

若需要跳过重置系统（取值为`true`），请确保：

* ECS 实例状态必须为 **RUNNING**，可调用 [DescribeInstances](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70466) 查询实例状态。
* ECS 实例必须安装云助手 Agent 且状态为 **Running**，可调用 [DescribeCloudAssistantStatus](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/170931) 查询云助手 Agent 状态。
SkipReplaceSystem.description_en:
Skip system reset when adding existing nodes:

* **true**: Skip system reset; the operating system of the ECS instance for the existing node will not be reset
* **false** (default): Do not skip system reset; the operating system of the ECS instance for the existing node will be reset

If you need to skip system reset (set to `true`), make sure:

CascadingDeleteResources.description_cn:
参数废弃说明：

* 仅 **存量用户** 支持使用该参数。存量用户判断方法，请参见 [FAQ](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467)。
* 因该参数即将下线，所以 **存量用户** 仅在指定时间内可使用该参数，请尽快完成接口改造后使用新的 **RetainResources** 参数。接口改造说明，请参见 [级联删除集群资源相关 OpenAPI 改造说明](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467)。
* 产品 **新用户**（2023 年 12 月 18 日之后开通并使用 VKE）请使用 **RetainResources** 参数。

同步删除指定集群内的相关资源，取值：

* **DefaultNodePoolResource**：同步删除集群内默认节点池中的云服务器（ECS）实例。
   若指定的集群中，默认节点池中存在包年包月的云服务器实例，则该接口仅从集群中移除云服务器实例，不会删除实例。您可以通过 [云服务器控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/ecs) 或 [云服务器 API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70454) 查询到该实例，并按需执行后续操作。
* **NodePoolResource**：同步删除集群内的所有自定义节点池、节点池内的云服务器实例及其关联的弹性块存储。
   不包含存储卷（PV）所对应的存储资源，例如云盘（EBS）、文件存储 NAS、文件存储 vePFS、对象存储（TOS）等资源。
* **Clb**：同步删除集群创建的负载均衡器（CLB）。
* **Nat**：同步删除集群创建的 NAT 网关。
* **All**：同步删除集群内上述所有类型资源，但不包括
   不包含集群内的包年包月节点、PV 对应的存储资源，日志服务关联的 Topic。

在删除过程中，若这些资源开启了删除保护，则无法被删除；未开启删除保护的资源，会被继续删除。建议在调用接口前按需调整删除保护设置。
CascadingDeleteResources.description_en:
Parameter deprecation notice:

* Only **existing users** can use this parameter. For criteria to determine existing users, see [FAQ](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467).
* As this parameter will soon be discontinued, **existing users** can only use it within a specified timeframe. Please promptly update your interface and use the new **RetainResources** parameter. For interface update instructions, see [OpenAPI update instructions for cascading cluster resource deletion](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467).
* **New users** (those who activated and started using VKE after December 18, 2023) should use the **RetainResources** parameter.

Synchronously delete related resources in the specified cluster. Options:

* **DefaultNodePoolResource**: Synchronously delete ECS instances in the default node pool of the cluster.
   If the default node pool contains subscription ECS instances, this interface only removes the ECS instances from the cluster without deleting them. You can find these instances in the [ECS console](https://console.volcengine.com/ecs) or via the [ECS API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70454) and perform follow-up actions as needed.
* **NodePoolResource**: Synchronously delete all custom node pools in the cluster, ECS instances in the node pools, and their associated elastic block storage.
   Does not include storage resources corresponding to persistent volumes (PV), such as EBS, NAS file storage, vePFS file storage, object storage (TOS), etc.
* **Clb**: Synchronously delete load balancers (CLB) created by the cluster.
* **Nat**: Synchronously delete NAT gateways created by the cluster.
* **All**: Synchronously delete all the above resource types in the cluster, except for
   subscription nodes in the cluster, storage resources corresponding to PVs, and Topics associated with log services.

During deletion, resources with deletion protection enabled cannot be deleted. Resources without deletion protection will be deleted. Adjust deletion protection settings as needed before calling the interface.

* **存量用户** 必须完成 [接口改造](	https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467) 后，才能使用该参数。存量用户的判断方法，请参见 [FAQ](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467)。
* **新用户**（2023 年 12 月 18 日之后开通并使用 VKE）可直接使用该参数。

删除集群时，需要保留的集群内相关资源，取值：

* 取值为空：（默认值）删除集群关联创建的全部资源，及添加到节点池的非包年包月类型 ECS 实例。
* **DefaultNodePoolResource**：保留集群内默认节点池中的 ECS 实例及其关联的弹性块存储、公网 IP 等资源。
* **NodePoolResource**：保留集群内的所有自定义节点池内的 ECS 实例及其关联的弹性块存储、公网 IP 等资源。
* **Clb**：保留集群内路由规则（Ingress）和服务（Service）创建的负载均衡（CLB）实例。
* **Alb**：保留集群内 Ingress 和 Service 创建的应用型负载均衡（ALB）实例。
* **Nat**：保留集群关联创建的 NAT 网关。
* **SecurityGroup**：保留集群关联创建的安全组。
* **All**：保留集群关联创建的所有资源。

在删除过程中，若这些资源开启了删除保护，则无法被删除；未开启删除保护的资源，会被继续删除。建议在调用接口前按需调整删除保护设置。
RetainResources.description_en:
* **Existing users** must complete the [API upgrade](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467) before using this parameter. For how to determine existing users, see the [FAQ](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467).
* **New users** (those who activated and used VKE after December 18, 2023) can use this parameter directly.

When deleting a cluster, specify which resources within the cluster to retain:

* Leave blank (default): Deletes all resources created in association with the cluster, as well as non-subscription ECS instances added to the node pool.
* **DefaultNodePoolResource**: Retains ECS instances in the default node pool and their associated Elastic Block Storage, public IPs, and other resources.
* **NodePoolResource**: Retains ECS instances in all custom node pools and their associated Elastic Block Storage, public IPs, and other resources.
* **Clb**: Retains load balancer (CLB) instances created by Ingress and Service within the cluster.
* **Alb**: Retains application load balancer (ALB) instances created by Ingress and Service within the cluster.
* **Nat**: Retains NAT gateways created in association with the cluster.
* **SecurityGroup**: Retains security groups created in association with the cluster.
* **All**: Retains all resources created in association with the cluster.

If deletion protection is enabled for these resources, they cannot be deleted. Resources without deletion protection will be deleted. Adjust deletion protection settings as needed before calling the API.

When deleting a node pool, specify which related resources to retain:

* Leave blank (default): Delete all associated resources.
   If the node pool contains subscription-based ECS instances, this API only removes the ECS instances from the node pool and does not delete them. You can find these instances in the [ECS Console](https://console.volcengine.com/ecs) or via the [ECS API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70454) and perform follow-up actions as needed.
* **Ecs**: Retain ECS instances in the node pool.

If deletion protection is enabled for these resources, they cannot be deleted. Resources without deletion protection will be deleted. Adjust deletion protection settings as needed before calling the API.

CascadingDeleteResources.description_cn:
参数废弃说明：

* 仅 **存量用户** 支持使用该参数。存量用户判断方法，请参见 [FAQ](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467)。
* 因该参数即将下线，所以 **存量用户** 仅在指定时间内可使用该参数，请尽快完成接口改造后使用新的 **RetainResources** 参数。接口改造说明，请参见 [级联删除集群资源相关 OpenAPI 改造说明](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467)。
* 产品 **新用户**（2023 年 12 月 18 日之后开通并使用 VKE）请使用 **RetainResources** 参数。

同步删除指定节点的关联资源，取值：

* 取值为空：（默认值）不删除关联资源。
* **Ecs**：删除非包年包月的云服务器（ECS）实例。
   包年包月的 ECS 实例，仅从集群中移除，不会被删除。您可以通过 [云服务器控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/ecs) 或 [云服务器 API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70454) 查询到该实例，并按需执行后续操作。

在删除过程中，若这些资源开启了删除保护，则无法被删除；未开启删除保护的资源，会被继续删除。建议在调用接口前按需调整删除保护设置。
CascadingDeleteResources.description_en:
Parameter deprecation notice:

* Only **existing users** can use this parameter. For how to determine if you are an existing user, see [FAQ](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467).
* As this parameter will soon be deprecated, **existing users** can only use it within a specified period. Please complete the API update as soon as possible and use the new **RetainResources** parameter. For update instructions, see [OpenAPI update instructions for cascading deletion of cluster resources](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467).
* **New users** (who activated and started using VKE after December 18, 2023) should use the **RetainResources** parameter.

Synchronously delete resources associated with the specified nodes. Value options:

* Leave blank: (default) Do not delete associated resources
* **Ecs**: Delete pay-as-you-go cloud server (ECS) instances
   Subscription ECS instances are only removed from the cluster and will not be deleted. You can find these instances in the [Cloud Server Console](https://console.volcengine.com/ecs) or via the [Cloud Server API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70454), and perform further actions as needed.

During deletion, resources with deletion protection enabled cannot be deleted; resources without deletion protection will be deleted. It is recommended to adjust deletion protection settings as needed before calling the API.

ClusterId.description_cn:
集群的 ID。
可以调用 [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) 接口，获取集群 ID。
集群必须处于以下任一状态：

* `{Running,[*]}`
* `{Updating, [Progressing]}`
* `{Stopped, [Balance]}`

可调用 [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) 接口获取集群当前的状态。
ClusterId.description_en:
Cluster ID
You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to get the cluster ID.
The cluster must be in one of the following states:

* `{Running,[*]}`
* `{Updating, [Progressing]}`
* `{Stopped, [Balance]}`

You can call the [ListClusters](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115190) API to get the current state of the cluster.

Drain.description_cn: 是否在删除节点前排水，默认不执行排水
Drain.description_en: Drain the node before deletion; not performed by default

Ids.description_cn:
节点 ID 列表。
可以调用 [ListNodes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115200) 接口，获取节点 ID。单次调用最多填写 100 个节点 ID。
* 节点必须处于以下任一状态：
   * `{Running,[*]}`
   * `{Stopped, [*]}`
   * `{Failed, [InitilizeFailed, NotReady, ResourceCleanupFailed, Balance, Unknown]}`
   可调用 [ListNodes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115200) 接口，获取节点当前的状态。
* 下线 [弹性裸金属型](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/69763) 节点时，ECS 侧会根据运行状态优先正常关机，如无法正常关机，将执行强制关机。更多信息，请参见 [StopInstance](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70468)。
* 若指定的节点池启用了 **AffinityGroupConfig** 亲和组配置（邀测），则必须确保从节点池中删除节点后，剩余节点数量是亲和组规格的整数倍。您也可以删除该节点池中的全部节点。
Ids.description_en:
Node ID list
You can call the [ListNodes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115200) API to obtain node IDs. You can specify up to 100 node IDs per request.
* Nodes must be in one of the following states:
   * `{Running,[*]}`
   * `{Stopped, [*]}`
   * `{Failed, [InitilizeFailed, NotReady, ResourceCleanupFailed, Balance, Unknown]}`
   You can call the [ListNodes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115200) API to check the current status of nodes.
* When decommissioning [Elastic Bare Metal](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/69763) nodes, ECS will attempt a normal shutdown based on the running status. If a normal shutdown fails, a forced shutdown will be performed. For more information, see [StopInstance](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70468).
* If the specified node pool has **AffinityGroupConfig** affinity group configuration (preview), you must ensure that after removing nodes from the pool, the remaining number of nodes is an integer multiple of the affinity group specification. You can also remove all nodes from the node pool.

NodePoolId.description_cn:
节点池 ID。
可以调用 [ListNodePools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115197) 接口，获取节点池 ID。
节点池必须处于以下任一状态：

* `{Running,[*]}`
* `{Scaling,[Progressing]}`
* `{Failed, [ClusterNotRunning, ResourceCleanupFailed]}`

可调用 [ListNodePools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115197) 接口获取节点池当前的状态。
NodePoolId.description_en:
Node pool ID
You can call the [ListNodePools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115197) API to get the node pool ID.
The node pool must be in one of the following states:

* `{Running,[*]}`
* `{Scaling,[Progressing]}`
* `{Failed, [ClusterNotRunning, ResourceCleanupFailed]}`

You can call the [ListNodePools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115197) API to get the current state of the node pool.

RetainResources.description_cn:
* **存量用户** 必须完成 [接口改造](	https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467) 后，才能使用该参数。存量用户的判断方法，请参见 [FAQ](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467)。
* **新用户**（2023 年 12 月 18 日之后开通并使用 VKE）可直接使用该参数。

删除节点时，需要保留的节点关联资源，取值：

* 取值为空：（默认值）删除全部关联资源。
   若节点为包年包月的云服务器（ECS）实例，则该接口仅移除 ECS 实例，不会删除。您可以通过 [云服务器控制台](https://console.volcengine.com/ecs) 或 [云服务器 API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70454) 查询到该实例，并按需执行后续操作。
* **Ecs**：保留节点对应的 ECS 实例。

在删除过程中，若这些资源开启了删除保护，则无法被删除；未开启删除保护的资源，会被继续删除。建议在调用接口前按需调整删除保护设置。
RetainResources.description_en:
* **Existing users** must complete the [API upgrade](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467) before using this parameter. For how to determine if you are an existing user, see the [FAQ](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/1182467).
* **New users** (those who activated and started using VKE after December 18, 2023) can use this parameter directly.

When deleting a node, specify which associated resources to retain:

* Leave blank (default): Delete all associated resources.
   If the node is a cloud server (ECS) instance with annual/monthly subscription, this API only removes the ECS instance from the node but does not delete it. You can find the instance in the [Cloud Server Console](https://console.volcengine.com/ecs) or via the [Cloud Server API](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70454) and perform further actions as needed.
* **Ecs**: Retain the ECS instance associated with the node.

During deletion, resources with deletion protection enabled cannot be deleted; resources without deletion protection will continue to be deleted. We recommend adjusting deletion protection settings as needed before calling the API.

Count.description_cn:
扩容节点数量，取值为大于 0 的整数。
该参数的取值上限与节点池的期望节点数配置相关：

* 节点池的期望节点数（`DesiredReplicas`）+ 扩容节点数（`Count`）总和不能超过节点池上限值 2000。
* 节点池开启弹性伸缩时，扩容后的节点总数不能超过`MaxReplicas` 参数配置。
* `DesiredReplicas`和`MaxReplicas`的配置方式，请参见 [CreateNodePool](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115194)。
Count.description_en:
Number of nodes to scale up. Must be an integer greater than 0.
The upper limit for this parameter depends on the expected node count configuration of the node pool:

* The sum of the node pool's expected node count (`DesiredReplicas`) and the number of nodes to scale up (`Count`) must not exceed the node pool limit of 2000.
* If auto scaling is enabled for the node pool, the total number of nodes after scaling must not exceed the `MaxReplicas` parameter.
* For configuration methods of `DesiredReplicas` and `MaxReplicas`, see [CreateNodePool](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115194).

Id.description_cn:
节点池 ID。

Id.description_en:
Node pool ID.
You can call the [ListNodePools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115197) API to obtain the node pool ID.
The node pool must be in the `{Running,[*]}` or `{Scaling,[Progressing]}` state. You can call the [ListNodePools](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115197) API to check the current status of the node pool.

DefaultDeleteAllResources.description_cn:
设置删除集群资源相关 OpenAPI（[DeleteCluster](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115188)、[DeleteNodePool](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115196)、[DeleteNodes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115199)、[DeleteAddon](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115205)）的全局策略，将 OpenAPI 的默认行为调整为同步删除相关资源，避免资源残留：

- **false**：初始值，代表调用删除集群资源相关 OpenAPI 时，继续使用旧参数 **CascadingDeleteResources**，该参数默认值为保留全部集群相关资源，不级联删除。
- **true**：代表调用删除集群资源相关 OpenAPI 时，使用新参数 **RetainResources**，该参数默认值为删除全部集群相关资源，避免资源残留产生不必要费用。

为当前参数赋值 **true** 后，在 30 日内未进行二次变更，即认为已经认可新的参数配置策略。后续上述 OpenAPI 调用中将只允许传入 **RetainResources** 参数来指定删除时所需要保留的资源。
DefaultDeleteAllResources.description_en:
Configure the global policy for cluster resource deletion OpenAPIs ([DeleteCluster](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115188), [DeleteNodePool](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115196), [DeleteNodes](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115199), [DeleteAddon](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6460/115205)). Change the default OpenAPI behavior to synchronously delete related resources to prevent resource remnants.

- **false**: Default value. When calling cluster resource deletion OpenAPIs, the legacy parameter **CascadingDeleteResources** is used. By default, this parameter retains all cluster-related resources and does not perform cascading deletion.
- **true**: When calling cluster resource deletion OpenAPIs, the new parameter **RetainResources** is used. By default, this parameter deletes all cluster-related resources to avoid unnecessary costs from leftover resources.

If you set this parameter to **true** and do not change it again within 30 days, the new parameter configuration policy will be considered accepted. Afterward, only the **RetainResources** parameter will be allowed in the above OpenAPI calls to specify which resources to retain during deletion.

* When calling this API, the original password must be Base64 encoded before entering it here. For example, if your original password is `admin@1234`, enter the Base64 encoded value here: `YWRtaW5AMTIzNA==`.
* Configure this parameter only when the `AuthType` is set to `BasicAuth`.

Password.description_cn:
工作区 BasicAuth 密码。

* 支持大写字母、小写字母、数字和特殊字符，并且至少包含三种字符组成。
* 特殊字符包括`!@#$%^*&()_+-=`。

* 调用该接口时，原始密码必须首先进行 Base64 编码处理，然后再填写到此处。例如：如果您的原始密码为 `admin@1234`，则此处应填写经过 Base64 编码后的值，即 `YWRtaW5AMTIzNA==`。
* 仅`AuthType`参数选择为`BasicAuth`时，需配置此参数。
Password.description_en:
Workspace BasicAuth password.

* Supports uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters. Must include at least three types of characters.
* Special characters include `!@#$%^*&()_+-=`.

* When calling this API, the original password must be Base64 encoded before entering here. For example, if your original password is `admin@1234`, enter the Base64 encoded value here: `YWRtaW5AMTIzNA==`.
* Configure this parameter only when the `AuthType` parameter is set to `BasicAuth`.

EndTime.description_cn:
句段的结束时间戳，单位为毫秒。要求如下：

* 必须大于或等于 `StartTime`。
* 必须大于或等于 `0`。
* 不能超过视频的总时长。

为确保后续语音合成的质量，建议设置的句段时长（即 `EndTime` - `StartTime`）不短于 500 毫秒。
EndTime.description_en:
End timestamp of the segment, in milliseconds. Requirements:

* Must be greater than or equal to `StartTime`
* Must be greater than or equal to `0`
* Cannot exceed the total video duration

To ensure the quality of subsequent speech synthesis, it is recommended that the segment duration (`EndTime` - `StartTime`) is at least 500 milliseconds

* `BackgroundClip`：背景片段信息
Additions.description_en:

* `SourceTracks`: Source track information
* `SourceClips`: Source clip information
* `TargetUtterances`: Target language text
* `TargetTracks`: Target track information
* `TargetClips`: Target clip information
* `BackgroundClip`: Background clip information

MultiInputs.description_cn:
输入文件信息数组。
* 您必须设置 `Input` 或 `MultiInputs` 参数之一，但不能同时设置这两个参数。
* 仅**高光智剪**和**长视频故事线分析**任务支持多个输入文件。
* 单次任务最多输入 30 个文件。
* 多个输入文件的类型必须保持一致。
   * 若为 `Vid` 类型，这些文件需来自同一个空间。
   * 若为 `DirectUrl` 类型，文件则需来自同一个空间。
MultiInputs.description_en:
Input file information array.
* You must set either the `Input` or `MultiInputs` parameter, but not both at the same time.
* Only **Highlight Smart Editing** and **Long Video Storyline Analysis** tasks support multiple input files.
* Up to 30 files can be submitted per task.
* The type of multiple input files must be consistent.
   * If the type is `Vid`, these files must come from the same space.
   * If the type is `DirectUrl`, the files must come from the same space.

* 调用 [ListSpace](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/107686) 接口获取当前账号下所有空间的名称。

当 `Input` 和 `MultiInputs` 参数均为空时（如视频生成任务场景），此参数为必填项。

* View all space names under your account on the [Space Management page](https://console.volcengine.com/vod/overview/) in the Video on Demand console
* Call the [ListSpace](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/107686) API to get all space names under your account

When both `Input` and `MultiInputs` parameters are empty (such as in video generation tasks), this parameter is required

UpdateType.description_cn:
更新字幕的方式。支持的取值如下：

* `InputSubtitleFile`：通过文件替换**源语言**字幕。如果后续流程包含语音翻译，AI 可能会调整时间戳以确保语速自然；如果您输入的新字幕文件不包含说话人 speaker 信息，AI 会基于新字幕重新执行语音识别 ASR 以生成说话人信息。
* `OutputSubtitleFile`：通过文件替换**目标语言**字幕。如果后续流程包含语音翻译，AI 可能会调整时间戳和字幕内容以确保语速自然。
* `BilingualSubtitleFile`：通过文件替换**双语**字幕。
* `Utterances`：精确更新一条或多条字幕句段。

对于 `InputSubtitleFile` 、 `OutputSubtitleFile` 和 
`BilingualSubtitleFile` 方式，您需要先将用于替换的字幕文件以素材形式[上传至 AI 翻译项目所在的点播空间](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/65670#素材上传)，然后[获取该字幕文件的 FileName](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/2887#%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96-filename)。需确保字幕文件位于点播空间所关联的对象存储桶中。
UpdateType.description_en:
Subtitle update methods. Supported values:

* `InputSubtitleFile`: Replace **source language** subtitles with a file. If subsequent steps include speech translation, AI may adjust timestamps to ensure natural speech flow. If your new subtitle file does not contain speaker information, AI will perform speech recognition (ASR) on the new subtitles to generate speaker information.
* `OutputSubtitleFile`: Replace **target language** subtitles with a file. If subsequent steps include speech translation, AI may adjust timestamps and subtitle content to ensure natural speech flow.
* `BilingualSubtitleFile`: Replace **bilingual** subtitles with a file.
* `Utterances`: Precisely update one or more subtitle segments.

For `InputSubtitleFile`, `OutputSubtitleFile`, and `BilingualSubtitleFile`, you must first [upload the subtitle file to the VOD space of your AI translation project](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/65670#素材上传) as a media asset, then [obtain the FileName of the subtitle file](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/4/2887#%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96-filename). Make sure the subtitle file is stored in the object storage bucket associated with the VOD space.

CursorTime.description_cn:
时间锚。
**CursorTime使用方式：**
- 首次请求传 0，根据时间排序，返回前100条有关的数据；
- 返回结果包含下次请求的 CursorTime 值，循环上述操作；
- 当返回结果数据量不足100条时，说明已没有更多数据。

- CursorTime的初次请求传0或其他值，也会计算为一次请求，下一次请间隔至少2s再请求。
CursorTime.description_en:
Time anchor.
**How to use CursorTime:**
- For the first request, set CursorTime to 0. Data will be sorted by time, and the first 100 relevant entries will be returned.
- The result includes the CursorTime value for the next request; repeat the process above.
- If fewer than 100 entries are returned, there is no more data.

- The initial request with CursorTime set to 0 or any other value counts as one request. Please wait at least 2 seconds before making the next request.

- Currently, only topics in the Beijing region of the Kafka message queue are supported
- For instances bound to a whitelist, only IPs configured in the whitelist can access the corresponding Kafka instance. Please note:
    - Do not select instances from the whitelist when pushing to the Kafka message queue
    - After configuring delivery to a specific instance, do not add that instance to the whitelist
- The first time you select this topic for delivery to the Kafka message queue in an event rule, a user named __volcevent_xxxvolc will be automatically created under **User Management** for that topic. Do not delete this user, or Cloud Monitoring will not be able to deliver messages to the topic

GroupBy.description_cn:
要查询的指标所使用的分组维度。参见 [云监控指标查询](https://console.volcengine.com/cloud_monitor/metricDoc?tabKey=metric) 下各产品的 **Dimensions**。

* 如果指标的 **Dimension** 列未标注 **可选**，说明不存在可选 Dimension，默认所有 Dimension 都是必选，都会作为指标分组维度。

必选的含义是无论是否传递这些 Dimension 参数，返回的维度都会以这些 Dimension 进行分组。
以缓存数据库 Redis 版的指标`AggregatedTotalQps`为例，Dimension 列为 **ResourceID,Node**。

* 当 Dimension 参数传递 Node，不传递 ReourceID 时：
   * 查询条件：Node=xxx and ResourceID=*
   * 分组维度：Node,ResourceId
* 当 Dimension 参数传递 Node 和 ReourceID 时：
   * 查询条件：Node=xxx and ResouceId=yyy
   * 分组维度：Node,ResourceId


* 如果指标的 **Dimension** 列标注了**可选**，说明存在可选 Dimension，使用时需要额外指定 GroupBy 参数。示例请参见 [GroupBy 说明](#groupby%E8%AF%B4%E6%98%8E)。

SDK 必须升级到以下版本，才支持通过 GroupBy 筛选分组维度。

* Python：1.0.37 版本以上
* Go：1.0.97 版本以上
* Java：0.1.75 版本以上
GroupBy.description_en:
Grouping dimensions used for the metrics you want to query. See [Cloud Monitoring Metric Query](https://console.volcengine.com/cloud_monitor/metricDoc?tabKey=metric) for the **Dimensions** of each product.
- If the **Dimension** column for a metric does not indicate **Optional**, it means there are no optional dimensions; all dimensions are required by default and will be used as grouping dimensions.
  Required means that, whether or not you pass these dimension parameters, the returned data will always be grouped by these dimensions.
  For example, for the Redis Cache metric **AggregatedTotalQps**, the Dimension column lists **ResourceID, Node**.
  - If you pass the Node parameter but not ResourceID:
    - Query condition: Node=xxx and ResourceID=*
    - Grouping dimensions: Node, ResourceID
  - If you pass both Node and ResourceID:
    - Query condition: Node=xxx and ResourceID=yyy
    - Grouping dimensions: Node, ResourceID

- If the **Dimension** column indicates **Optional**, there are optional dimensions. You need to specify the GroupBy parameter when using them. For examples, see **GroupBy documentation**.

You must upgrade the SDK to the following versions to support filtering grouping dimensions with GroupBy:

- Python: version 1.0.37 or above
- Go: version 1.0.97 or above
- Java: version 0.1.75 or above

   如果已报错，请参见错误码部分`max-select-point`原因和解决方案。

  If an error has occurred, refer to the error code section for `max-select-point` causes and solutions

* 当时间选段较长时，不建议使用小单位作为间隔，否则将会导致数据集过大，可能会导致`max-select-bucket`超限，对业务产生影响，请谨慎操作。

Supported data query intervals: second (s), minute (m), hour (h), day (d), and week (w)
- For example, if you query data for 10 minutes and split it by 1-minute intervals, you will receive 10 data points
- For longer time ranges, avoid using small intervals, as this may result in an excessively large dataset and trigger the `max-select-bucket` limit, which can affect your business. Proceed with caution
  If an error has already occurred, refer to the error code section for `max-select-bucket` causes and solutions
- For details on how StartTime and EndTime are offset when Period is specified, see **Period Description**

StatisticsMethods.description_cn:
指定监控数据的统计聚合方式。目前支持的聚合方式：

*  `avg` ：平均值聚合，对同一聚合分组下所有样本指标数值取算术平均值。
*  `sum` ：求和聚合，对同一分组下全部指标数值做累加求和。
*  `max` ：最大值聚合，提取同一分组内所有指标样本中的最大数值。
*  `min` ：最小值聚合，提取同一分组内所有指标样本中的最小数值。

* 若配置多个聚合方式，返回结构中的 `MetricDataResults` 会根据配置的聚合方式分别返回结果，并通过 `StatisticsMethods` 标识当前结果对应的聚合方式。
* 查询时，建议使用 [云监控指标查询](https://console.volcengine.com/cloud_monitor/docs) 中提供的统计方式，否则可能存在数据统计误差。
StatisticsMethods.description_en: Specify the statistical aggregation method for monitoring data. Supports `avg`, `sum`, `max`, and `min`. If not specified, the original query behavior is retained; if specified, the server processes the query results according to the selected aggregation method. When multiple aggregation methods are provided, the `MetricDataResults` in the response will return results for each aggregation method separately, and the current aggregation method is indicated by `StatisticsMethods`. Special note: We recommend referring to the statistical methods provided in [Cloud Monitoring Metric Query](https://console.volcengine.com/cloud_monitor/docs) when querying. Selecting aggregation methods not listed may result in statistical errors.

ClientToken.description_cn:
客户端Token，用于保证请求幂等性。

* 由客户端自动生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一，避免当调用API超时或服务器内部错误时，客户端多次重试导致重复性操作。
* 仅支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
* 若不传入ClientToken，则此次API调用不进行幂等校验。
ClientToken.description_en:
ClientToken, used to ensure request idempotency.

* The client automatically generates a parameter value to ensure uniqueness between different requests, preventing duplicate operations caused by multiple retries when the API call times out or a server internal error occurs.
* Only ASCII characters are supported, and the length cannot exceed 64 characters.
* If ClientToken is not provided, this API call will not perform idempotency verification.

Bandwidth.description_en: Public IP bandwidth limit, default value: 1 Mbps. When BillingType is 1: range is 1–500. When BillingType is 2: range is 1–500. When BillingType is 3: range is 1–200.

Shared bandwidth package ID, used to add the public IP to the shared bandwidth package. To add a public IP to a shared bandwidth package, the following conditions must be met:
- Both must have the same security protection type
- Both must be in the same region
- The public IP must use pay-as-you-go billing

公网IP的描述。

* 长度限制为0~ 255个字符。
* 不填默认为空字符串。
* 需要以字母、中文或数字开头。可包含英文逗号（,）、点号（.）、下划线（_）、空格（ ）、等号（=）、短横线（-）、中文逗号（，）、中文句号（。）。
Description.description_en: Description for public IP. Must start with a letter or Chinese character. Can include numbers, English commas (,), periods (.), underscores (_), spaces, equal signs (=), hyphens (-), Chinese commas (，), middle dots (·), and Chinese periods (。). Length must be between 1 and 255 characters. If left blank, defaults to an empty string.

ISP.description_cn:
线路类型，默认为BGP。

* BGP：BGP（多线）。
* 若您的账号已申请并开通了静态单线权限，则可传入如下取值：
   * ChinaMobile：中国移动静态单线。
   * ChinaTelecom：中国电信静态单线。
   * ChinaUnicom：中国联通静态单线。
* 若您的账号已申请并开通了BGP单线权限，则可传入SingleLine_BGP。
* 若您的账号已申请并开通了精品BGP权限，则可传入Premium_BGP。
* 若您的账号已申请并开通了融合BGP权限，则可传入Fusion_BGP。
* 若您的账号已申请并开通了惠选型静态单线权限，则可传入如下取值：
   * ChinaMobile_Value：中国移动惠选型静态单线。
   * ChinaUnicom_Value：中国联通惠选型静态单线。
   * ChinaTelecom_Value：中国电信惠选型静态单线。
ISP.description_en:
Line Type (default: BGP)
BGP: BGP (multi-line)

If your account has been approved for static single-line access, you can use the following values:
ChinaMobile: China Mobile static single line
ChinaTelecom: China Telecom static single line
ChinaUnicom: China Unicom static single line

If your account has been approved for BGP single-line access, you can use SingleLine_BGP

If your account has been approved for static BGP access, you can use Static_BGP

RenewPeriodTimes.description_en:

SecurityProtectionTypes.N.description_cn:
公网IP的安全防护类型。

* 参数 - N：表示安全防护类型的序号，当前仅支持取1。
* 取值：
   * AntiDDoS_Enhanced：申请增强防护类型的公网IP，可加入到DDoS原生防护（企业版）实例。
            * 若`SecurityProtectionTypes.N`传入AntiDDoS_Enhanced，则`BillingType`必须传入2或3，且`ISP`必须传入BGP。
      * 增强防护类型公网IP正在邀测中，如需试用，请联系客户经理。
      
   * 不填则表示申请默认防护类型的公网IP。
SecurityProtectionTypes.N.description_en:
Security protection type for public IP addresses
| Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the security protection type. Only the value 1 is currently supported. |

Values:
AntiDDoS_Enhanced: Apply for a public IP address with enhanced protection (can be added to a native DDoS protection instance)

If left blank, it means a public IP address with basic protection
Note: To set SecurityProtectionTypes.N to AntiDDoS_Enhanced, you must set BillingType to 2 or 3
This feature is currently in invite-only beta. To request access, please submit a ticket or contact your account manager

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
用户标签的标签键。

* 参数 - N：表示标签键的序号，取值范围：1～50。
* 多个标签键之间用&分隔。
* 不能以 `volc:`或`sys:`开头，包括任意大小写形式。
* 长度取值范围为1~128字符，允许输入各国语言文字、数字、空格（ ）、下划线（_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、中划线（-）和@（@）。
* 若标签键开头或结尾存在空格，系统会自动为其去除。

同一资源的标签键不允许重复。
Tags.N.Key.description_en: Label key for public IP user tags. Parameter -N- indicates the sequence number of the label key, ranging from 1 to 50. N must be in consecutive ascending order. Separate multiple label keys with &. The key cannot start with volc: in any letter case. Length must be 1–128 characters. You can use letters from any language, numbers, spaces, underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equal signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and at signs (@). If there are spaces at the beginning or end of the label key, the system will automatically remove them. Note: Label keys for the same resource must be unique.

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
用户标签的标签值。

* 参数 - N：表示标签值的序号，取值范围：1～50。
* 多个标签值之间用&分隔。
* 长度取值范围为0～256字符，不填默认为空。
* 允许输入各国语言文字、数字、空格（ ）、下划线（_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、中划线（-）和@（@）。
* 大小写敏感。
* 若标签值开头或结尾存在空格，系统会自动为其去除。

若传入该参数，则必须先传入`Tags.N.Key`。
Tags.N.Value.description_en: Tag value (Value) for public IP user tags. Parameter - N - indicates the sequence number of the tag value (Value), ranging from 1 to 50. N must be in continuous ascending order. Separate multiple tag values (Value) with &. Length: 0–256 characters. If left blank, the default is empty. Supports all languages, numbers, spaces, underscores (_), periods (.), half-width colons (:), slashes (/), equal signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and at signs (@). Case sensitive. Leading and trailing spaces in the tag value (Value) are automatically removed. Note: If you set this parameter, you must first set Tags.N.Key.

Bandwidth.description_cn:
IPv6公网带宽的带宽上限，单位为Mbps。

* `BillingType` 传入2：取值范围1 ~ 500。
* `BillingType` 传入3：取值范围1 ~ 200。
* 不填默认为1Mbps。
Bandwidth.description_en:
Maximum bandwidth limit for IPv6 public bandwidth. Unit: Mbps.
- When `BillingType` is set to 2: range is 1 ~ 500.
- When `BillingType` is set to 3: range is 1 ~ 200.

ClientToken.description_en:
Client token, used to ensure idempotency of the request.

Ipv6Address.description_cn: 待开通IPv6公网带宽的IPv6地址。

ProjectName.description_cn: IPv6公网带宽所属项目的名称。不填默认加入default项目。
ProjectName.description_en: Project

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
用户标签的标签键。

* 参数 - N：表示标签键的序号，取值范围：1～50。
* 多个标签键之间用&分隔。
* 不能以 volc:或sys:开头，包括任意大小写形式。
* 长度取值范围为1~128字符，允许输入各国语言文字、数字、空格（ ）、下划线（_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、中划线（-）和@（@）。
* 若标签键开头或结尾存在空格，系统会自动为其去除。

> 同一资源的标签键不允许重复。
Tags.N.Key.description_en:
User tag key (Key).
- Parameter - N - Parameter: Indicates the sequence number of the tag key (Key), value range: 1–50, and N should be in continuous ascending order.
- Separate multiple tag keys (Key) with &.
- Cannot start with `volc:`, in any case.
- Length: 1–128 characters. Supports all languages, numbers, spaces ( ), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equal signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and @.
- If the tag key starts or ends with a space, the system will automatically remove it.
Duplicate tag keys are not allowed for the same resource.

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
用户标签的标签值。

* 参数 - N：表示标签值的序号，取值范围：1～50。
* 多个标签值之间用&分隔。
* 长度取值范围为0～256字符，不填默认为空。
* 允许输入各国语言文字、数字、空格（ ）、下划线（_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、中划线（-）和@（@）。
* 大小写敏感。
* 若标签值开头或结尾存在空格，系统会自动为其去除。

> 若传入该参数，则必须先传入Tags.N.Key。
Tags.N.Value.description_en: Tag value for the user tag. Length limit: 0–256 characters. Case sensitive. Cannot start or end with a space. Supports all languages, numbers, spaces ( ), underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equal signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and @. Note: If this parameter is provided, you must first provide Tags.N.Key.

ClientToken.description_cn:
客户端Token，用于保证请求幂等性。

* 由客户端自动生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一，避免当调用API超时或服务器内部错误时，客户端多次重试导致重复性操作。
* 仅支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
* 若不传入ClientToken，则此次API调用不进行幂等校验。
ClientToken.description_en:
Client token used to ensure request idempotency.

* The client automatically generates a parameter value to ensure uniqueness across different requests, preventing repeated operations when the API call times out or encounters internal server errors and the client retries multiple times.
* Only ASCII characters are supported, and the value cannot exceed 64 characters.
* If ClientToken is not provided, this API call will not perform idempotency checks.

Ipv6Address.N.description_cn:
为网卡指定私网IPv6地址。

* 参数 - N：表示私网IPv6地址的序号，取值范围由网卡状态决定。
   * 当网卡处于未挂载（Available）状态时，取值范围为1~10。
   * 当网卡处于已挂载（InUse）状态时，N的取值范围受到实例规格限制，更多详情请参见[实例规格介绍](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70840)。
* 多个私网IPv6地址之间用&分隔。
* 指定的私网IPv6地址必须为网卡所属子网中的空闲私网IPv6地址。

参数`Ipv6Address.N`和`Ipv6AddressCount`二者必须传入且只能传入一个。
Ipv6Address.N.description_en:
Specify private IPv6 addresses for the network interface.

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the private IPv6 address. The value range depends on the network interface status.
   * When the network interface is in the Available state, the value range is 1~10.
   * When the network interface is in the InUse state, the value range for N is limited by the instance type. For more details, see [Instance Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70840).
* Separate multiple private IPv6 addresses with &.
* The specified private IPv6 addresses must be available private IPv6 addresses within the subnet to which the network interface belongs.

You must provide either the `Ipv6Address.N` or `Ipv6AddressCount` parameter, but not both.

Ipv6AddressCount.description_cn:
为网卡分配私网IPv6地址的数量。传入该参数系统会自动从网卡所属子网中，分配相应数量的空闲IP地址作为网卡的私网IPv6地址。
参数`Ipv6Address.N`和`Ipv6AddressCount`二者必须传入且只能传入一个。
Ipv6AddressCount.description_en:
Number of private IPv6 addresses to assign to the network interface. When you specify this parameter, the system automatically allocates the corresponding number of available IP addresses from the subnet as private IPv6 addresses for the network interface.
You must specify either `Ipv6Address.N` or `Ipv6AddressCount`, but not both.

Ipv6Prefix.N.description_cn:

* Ipv6AddressCount

Ipv6PrefixCount.description_cn:

* Ipv6Prefix.N

* Ipv6Address.N
Ipv6PrefixCount.description_en:

为网卡指定私网IP地址的IP和数量。

* 参数 - N：表示私网IPv4地址的序号，取值范围由网卡状态决定。

* 多个私网IPv4地址之间用&分隔。
* 指定的私网IPv4地址必须为网卡所属子网中的空闲私网IPv4地址。

PrivateIpAddress.N.description_en:
Specify the IP and quantity of private IP addresses for the network interface.

* Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the private IPv4 address. The value range depends on the network interface status.
   * When the network interface is in Available status, the value range is 1~49.
   * When the network interface is in InUse status, the value range for N is limited by the instance specifications. For more details, see [Instance Specifications](https://www.volcengine.com/docs/6396/70840).
* Separate multiple private IPv4 addresses with &.
* The specified private IPv4 addresses must be available private IPv4 addresses within the subnet to which the network interface belongs.

You must specify either PrivateIpAddress.N or SecondaryPrivateIpAddressCount, but not both.

SecondaryPrivateIpAddressCount.description_cn:

SecondaryPrivateIpAddressCount.description_en:
Specify the number of secondary private IPv4 addresses to assign to the network interface. The system will automatically allocate the corresponding number of available IP addresses from the subnet as secondary private IPv4 addresses for the network interface.
You must specify either PrivateIpAddress.N or SecondaryPrivateIpAddressCount, but not both.

- Nat: NAT Gateway
- NetworkInterface: Secondary Network Interface
- ClbInstance: CLB Load Balancer
- EcsInstance: ECS Instance
- HaVip: High-Availability Virtual IP

Note: High-Availability Virtual IP is currently in invitation-only testing. If you want to try it, please submit a ticket or contact your account manager.

PrivateIpAddress.description_cn:
要绑定公网IP的实例的私网IP地址。

* 只支持传入云服务ECS主网卡的私网IP地址和辅助网卡IP地址。

在公网IP绑定高可用虚拟IP、NAT网关、负载均衡CLB时，不支持传入`PrivateIpAddress`参数。
PrivateIpAddress.description_en: Private IP address of the instance to bind the public IP to | Only supports the private IP address of the ECS main network interface or secondary network interface | If left blank: If InstanceType is set to EcsInstance, binds the main private IP address of the ECS main network interface. If InstanceType is set to NetworkInterface, binds the main private IP address of the secondary network interface | Note: When binding a public IP to a high-availability virtual IP, NAT Gateway, or CLB load balancer, the PrivateIpAddress parameter is not supported

ReleaseWithInstance.description_cn:
是否开启随云服务器实例删除。仅按量计费公网IP有效。开启后，当云服务器实例被系统自动回收（退订24小时后、到期回收、欠费回收）或被调用DeleteInstances接口时，公网IP随其一同释放。

- false：否。
ReleaseWithInstance.description_en:
Release public IP when cloud server instance is deleted
Only applies to pay-as-you-go public IPs. If enabled, when the cloud server instance is automatically reclaimed by the system (24 hours after unsubscription, upon expiration, or due to overdue payment) or deleted via the DeleteInstances API, the public IP will also be released.
- true: Yes
- false: No

Ipv6CidrBlock.description_en:

Ipv6Isp.description_cn:
线路类型。取值如下：

* BGP：BGP（多线）。
* ChinaMobile：中国移动静态单线。
* ChinaTelecom：中国电信静态单线。
* ChinaUnicom：中国联通静态单线。
* ChinaMobile_Value：中国移动惠选型静态单线。
* ChinaUnicom_Value：中国联通惠选型静态单线。
* ChinaTelecom_Value：中国电信惠选型静态单线。
Ipv6Isp.description_en:
Line type. Valid values:

* BGP: BGP (multi-line)
* ChinaMobile: China Mobile static single line
* ChinaTelecom: China Telecom static single line
* ChinaUnicom: China Unicom static single line
* ChinaMobile_Value: China Mobile Value static single line
* ChinaUnicom_Value: China Unicom Value static single line
* ChinaTelecom_Value: China Telecom Value static single line

Ipv6MaskLen.description_cn:
掩码长度。

* 当Ipv6Isp传入BGP时，仅支持传入56；除此之外，本参数支持62-64。
* 传入参数`Ipv6CidrBlock` 后，此参数不生效。

* 192.168.0.0/16–28
* 10.0.0.0/8–28
* 172.16.0.0/12–28

The secondary CIDR block must belong to the same major range as the primary CIDR block.

ClientToken.description_en:

* Only ASCII characters are supported, and the value must not exceed 64 characters
* If ClientToken is not provided, idempotency verification will not be performed for this API call

Bandwidth.description_cn:
公网IP转换后的带宽上限，单位：Mbps。
BillingType传入1，不可传入本参数；
BillingType传入2：目标公网IP转换前计费为“包年包月计费”，不可传入本参数；仅支持目标公网IP转换前计费为按量计费-按实际流量计费，Bandwidth的取值范围：1 ~ 1000；
BillingType传入3，Bandwidth的取值范围：1 ~ 200。
Bandwidth.description_en:
Maximum bandwidth limit after public IP conversion (unit: Mbps)

If BillingType is set to 1, you cannot specify this parameter
If BillingType is set to 2:
- If the original public IP uses subscription billing, you cannot specify this parameter
- This parameter is only supported when the original public IP uses pay-as-you-go (by actual traffic), with a bandwidth range of 1–1000
If BillingType is set to 3, the bandwidth range is 1–200

BillingType.description_cn:
公网IP转换后的计费方式。
1：包年包月。仅支持目标公网IP转换前计费为“按量计费-按带宽上限计费”。
2：按量计费-按带宽上限计费。仅支持目标公网IP转换前计费为“按量计费-按实际流量计费”或“包年包月计费”。
3：按实际流量计费。仅支持目标公网IP转换前计费为“按量计费-按带宽上限计费”。
BillingType.description_en:
Billing methods after public IP conversion
1. Annual/Monthly Subscription. Only available if the target public IP was previously billed as 'Pay-As-You-Go – By Bandwidth Cap'
2. Pay-As-You-Go – By Bandwidth Cap. Only available if the target public IP was previously billed as 'Pay-As-You-Go – By Actual Traffic' or 'Annual/Monthly Subscription'
3. Pay-As-You-Go – By Actual Traffic. Only available if the target public IP was previously billed as 'Pay-As-You-Go – By Bandwidth Cap'

Period.description_cn:

Period.description_en:

ISP.description_cn:
线路类型，默认为BGP。

* BGP：BGP（多线）。
* 若您的账号已申请并开通了静态单线权限，则可传入如下取值：
   * ChinaMobile：中国移动静态单线。
   * ChinaTelecom：中国电信静态单线。
   * ChinaUnicom：中国联通静态单线。
* 若您的账号已申请并开通了BGP单线权限，则可传入SingleLine_BGP。
* 若您的账号已申请并开通了精品BGP权限，则可传入Premium_BGP。
* 若您的账号已申请并开通了融合BGP权限，则可传入Fusion_BGP。
* 若您的账号已申请并开通了惠选型静态单线权限，则可传入如下取值：

   * ChinaUnicom_Value：中国联通惠选型静态单线。
   * ChinaTelecom_Value：中国电信惠选型静态单线。
ISP.description_en:
Line type (default: BGP)
BGP: BGP (multi-line)

If your account has been approved for static single-line access, you can use the following values:
ChinaMobile: China Mobile static single line
ChinaTelecom: China Telecom static single line
ChinaUnicom: China Unicom static single line

If your account has been approved for BGP single-line access, you can use SingleLine_BGP

If your account has been approved for static BGP access, you can use Static_BGP

Period.description_cn:

Period.description_en:

PeriodUnit.description_cn:
购买包年包月共享带宽包时长的单位，取值如下：

PeriodUnit.description_en:
Unit for the duration of pay-by-year or pay-by-month shared bandwidth packages:

ProjectName.description_cn: 共享带宽包所属项目的名称。不填默认加入default项目。
ProjectName.description_en: Project Name (Shared Bandwidth Package)

Protocol.description_cn:
共享带宽包的IP协议，取值如下：

* Dual-stack：双栈协议类型。
* IPv4：IPv4协议类型协议。

> 仅`BillingType`传2或4时，本参数支持传入Dual-stack。

IP protocol for shared bandwidth package. Available options:
- IPv4: IPv4 protocol
- Dual-stack: Dual-stack protocol type
> Dual-stack is supported only when `BillingType` is set to 2 or 4.

SecurityProtectionTypes.N.description_cn:
共享带宽包的的安全防护类型。

* 参数 - N：表示安全防护类型的序号，当前仅支持取1。
* 取值：
   * AntiDDoS_Enhanced：创建增强防护类型的共享带宽包，即创建支持添加增强防护类型公网IP的共享带宽包。
   * 不填则表示基础防护类型的共享带宽包，即创建支持添加基础防护类型公网IP的共享带宽包。

共享带宽包仅支持添加和其安全防护类型相同的公网IP，且创建后不支持转换安全防护类型，请谨慎选择。
SecurityProtectionTypes.N.description_en:
Security protection type for shared bandwidth packages. Parameter - N: Indicates the sequence number of the security protection type. Only 1 is supported.

Values:
AntiDDoS_Enhanced: Creates a shared bandwidth package with enhanced protection. This package supports adding public IPs with basic protection.
Leave blank for a shared bandwidth package with basic protection. This package supports adding public IPs with basic protection.

Note: A shared bandwidth package only supports adding public IPs with the same security protection type. You cannot change the security protection type after creation. Please choose carefully.

Tags.N.Key.description_cn:
用户标签的标签键。

* 参数 - N：表示标签键的序号，取值范围：1～50。
* 多个标签键之间用&分隔。
* 不能以 `volc:`或`sys:`开头，包括任意大小写形式。
* 长度取值范围为1~128字符，允许输入各国语言文字、数字、空格（ ）、下划线（_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、中划线（-）和@（@）。
* 若标签键开头或结尾存在空格，系统会自动为其去除。

同一资源的标签键不允许重复。
Tags.N.Key.description_en: Tag key (Key) for shared bandwidth package user tags. Parameter - N - indicates the sequence number of the tag key (Key), with values from 1 to 50. N must be in consecutive ascending order. Separate multiple tag keys (Key) with &. The key cannot start with volc: in any letter case. Length must be 1–128 characters. Supported characters include letters in any language, numbers, spaces, underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equal signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and at signs (@). If there are spaces at the beginning or end of the key, the system will automatically remove them. Note: Tag keys for the same resource must be unique.

Tags.N.Value.description_cn:
用户标签的标签值。

* 参数 - N：表示标签值的序号，取值范围：1～50。
* 多个标签值之间用&分隔。
* 长度取值范围为0～256字符，不填默认为空。
* 允许输入各国语言文字、数字、空格（ ）、下划线（_）、点号（.）、半角冒号（:）、斜杠（/）、等号（=）、加号（+）、中划线（-）和@（@）。
* 大小写敏感。
* 若标签值开头或结尾存在空格，系统会自动为其去除。

若传入该参数，则必须先传入`Tags.N.Key`。
Tags.N.Value.description_en: Tag value for shared bandwidth package users (Value). Parameter -N- indicates the sequence number of the tag value (Value), which must be between 1 and 50. N should be in consecutive ascending order. Separate multiple tag values (Value) with '&'. Length must be between 0 and 256 characters. If left blank, the default is empty. You can enter characters from any language, numbers, spaces, underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), slashes (/), equal signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and at signs (@). Case sensitive. If the tag value (Value) starts or ends with a space, the system will automatically remove it. Note: If you specify this parameter, you must first specify Tags.N.Key.

AggregationInterval.description_cn:
流日志的采样间隔。取值如下

* 1：1分钟。
* 5：5分钟。
* 10（默认值）：10分钟。
AggregationInterval.description_en:
Sampling interval for flow logs. The values are:

* 1: 1 minute
* 5: 5 minutes
* 10 (default): 10 minutes

ClientToken.description_cn:
客户端Token，用于保证请求幂等性。

* 由客户端自动生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一，避免当调用API超时或服务器内部错误时，客户端多次重试导致重复性操作。
* 仅支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
* 若不传入ClientToken，则此次API调用不进行幂等校验。
ClientToken.description_en:
Client token, used to ensure request idempotency.

* The client automatically generates a parameter value to ensure uniqueness between different requests, preventing repeated operations when the API call times out or there is a server internal error and the client retries multiple times.
* Only ASCII characters are supported, and the value cannot exceed 64 characters.
* If ClientToken is not provided, this API call will not perform idempotency verification.

Description.description_cn:
流日志的描述信息。

* 长度限制为0~ 255个字符。
* 不填默认为空字符串。

Description of the flow log.

* Length limit is 0–255 characters.
* If not filled, defaults to an empty string.
* Must start with a letter, Chinese character, or number. Can include English comma (,), period (.), underscore (_), space ( ), equals sign (=), hyphen (-), Chinese comma (，), and Chinese period (。).

EnableIndex.description_cn:

* true：是。
* false（默认值）：否。
EnableIndex.description_en:
Whether to automatically configure the index. The index is used to retrieve and analyze data. Flow logs must have an index configured before retrieval and analysis.

* true: Yes
* false (default): No

FlowLogName.description_cn:
流日志的名称。

* 长度限制为1 ~ 128个字符。
* 需要以字母、中文或数字开头，可包含点号（.）、下划线（_）和短横线（-）。
* 不填默认为流日志实例的ID。

* Must start with a letter, Chinese character, or number. Can include periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
* If not specified, defaults to the flow log instance ID.

IsMustNewTopic.description_cn:
Whether the log topic that you want must be a new one. 
 Default value: false.
IsMustNewTopic.description_en:
Whether the log topic that you want must be a new one
Default value: false.

LogProjectName.description_cn:

* The name can only contain lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens (-).
* Must start and end with a lowercase letter or number.
* The length must be between 3 and 63 characters.

Match the name to see if there is a log project. If not, a new log project will be created.

* 必须以小写英文字母或数字开头或结尾。
* 长度为 3～63 个字符。

根据名称匹配是否为`LogTopicName`传入的项目，若不是，则新建日志主题。
LogTopicName.description_en:
Name of the flow log topic. Must meet the following requirements:

* Only lowercase English letters, numbers, and hyphens (-) are supported.
* Must start and end with a lowercase English letter or number.
* Length must be between 3 and 63 characters.

Match the name to see if it is the project passed in as `LogTopicName`. If not, a new log topic will be created.

ProjectName.description_cn: 流日志所属项目的名称。不填默认加入default项目。
