CustomResponsePageID.description_en: Custom response page ID. An empty string means not configured. This extended field is not detailed in the current public documentation. Before use, ensure the user has enabled and is authorized to use the corresponding custom response page.

EffectTime.description_cn:

当执行动作为限速/拦截/人机验证或 JS 挑战时,建议显式传入.
EffectTime.description_en: Action effective duration, in seconds. Value range: 1~86,400. When the action is rate limiting, blocking, CAPTCHA, or JS challenge, explicit input is recommended.

Enable.description_cn:
规则开关:
- 0: 关闭
- 1: 开启

ExemptionTime.description_cn:
人机验证或 JS 挑战的豁免时间,单位秒,取值范围 1~3600.
用户在豁免时间内通过验证后可正常访问;豁免时间结束后若仍处于限制时长内,将再次触发验证.
ExemptionTime.description_en: CAPTCHA or JS challenge exemption time, in seconds. Value range: 1~3,600. After passing verification within the exemption time, users can access normally. If the exemption time ends but the limit duration is still active, verification will be triggered again.

Field.description_cn:
统计对象,支持单个或多个字段,多个字段使用英文逗号分隔,最多 10 个.
对外文档中的基础格式为 DataType:Value,例如 HEADER:Authorization/COOKIE:PHPSESSID/ARGS:device_id/CLIENTIP.
当前代码还支持 JA3HASH/SESSION-ID/FP 等扩展统计对象.
可选值:
- CLIENTIP: 源 IP
- HEADER:{Header-Name}: 指定请求头,Header-Name 需满足 HTTP 头 Key 规范
- ARGS:{ArgName}: 指定请求参数
- COOKIE:{CookieName}: 指定 Cookie
- JA3HASH: JA3 Hash
- SESSION-ID: 会话 ID (仅 Bot 自定义/Bot 分析在 SessionProtectionAvailable=true 时可用)
- FP: 客户端指纹 (仅 Bot 自定义/Bot 分析在 SessionProtectionAvailable=true 时可用)
Field.description_en:
Statistics object. Supports single or multiple fields, separated by commas, up to 10 fields. The basic format in external documentation is DataType:Value, for example HEADER:Authorization/COOKIE:PHPSESSID/ARGS:device_id/CLIENTIP. Current code also supports extended statistics objects such as JA3HASH/SESSION-ID/FP. Optional values:
- CLIENTIP: Source IP
- HEADER:{Header-Name}: Specified request header. Header-Name must comply with HTTP header key standards.
- ARGS:{ArgName}: Specified request parameter.
- COOKIE:{CookieName}: Specified cookie.
- JA3HASH: JA3 Hash.
- SESSION-ID: Session ID (only available for Bot Custom/Bot Analysis when SessionProtectionAvailable=true).
- FP: Client fingerprint (only available for Bot Custom/Bot Analysis when SessionProtectionAvailable=true).

Host.description_cn:

Host.description_en: Domain name. The website domain name to be protected; please ensure the domain has been added to the current WAF instance before calling.

Name.description_cn:

PathThreshold.description_cn:

PathThreshold.description_en: Overall threshold for the current path. The value range in external documentation is 1~300000, unit: occurrences.

RulePriority.description_cn: 规则优先级:取值范围 0~9;0 为最高优先级,9 为最低优先级.
RulePriority.description_en: Rule priority. Value range: 0~9; 0 is highest priority, 9 is lowest priority.

RuleTag.description_cn:
规则展示 ID;创建/更新时不携带,仅用于列表展示.

SingleThreshold.description_cn:

UpdateTime.description_cn: 规则最近更新时间,仅列表展示使用.

Url.description_cn:

WSCdnByteThreshold.description_cn:

- 1: 开启

WSCdnEnable.description_en:
WebSocket statistics protection switch: 
- 0: Off
- 1: On
When enabled, you must configure at least one of WSCdnFrameThreshold or WSCdnByteThreshold. Cron scheduling configuration cannot be combined.

WSCdnFrameThreshold.description_cn:
WebSocket 帧数阈值.
取值范围 1~10000;为 0 表示未配置.
WSCdnFrameThreshold.description_en: WebSocket frame threshold. Value range: 1~10,000; 0 means not configured.

WSCdnUnit.description_cn:

- MB: MiB
- GB: GiB
WSCdnUnit.description_en:
WebSocket byte threshold unit:
- KB: KiB

- GB: GiB

CustomHeader.description_cn:
自定义 Header。

- 当客户端 IP 获取方式为自定义 Header 字段，即`ClientIPLocation=0`时需要填写。
- 最多支持配置 5 个自定义 Header。
CustomHeader.description_en:
Custom Header

- You must specify a value when the client IP is obtained via a custom header field (that is, when `ClientIPLocation=0`).
- You can configure up to 5 custom headers.

CustomSNI.description_cn:
自定义 SNI，当`EnableSNI=1`时需要配置。
- 如果您的源站 IP 绑定了多个域名，且 WAF 以 HTTPS 协议回源访问您的源站，您需要配置回源 SNI（Server Name Indication）指明请求的具体域名。源站根据配置的 SNI 名称返回对应域名的 SSL 证书，以确保正常回源。
- 如果未配置域名，则根据流量中的实际 host 回源。
CustomSNI.description_en:
Custom SNI must be configured when `EnableSNI=1`.
- If your origin IP is associated with multiple domain names and WAF connects to your origin server over HTTPS, configure the origin SNI (Server Name Indication) to specify the exact domain name for the request. The origin server will return the SSL certificate for the specified domain name based on the configured SNI, ensuring proper origin access.
- If no domain name is configured, the origin server uses the actual host in the traffic to access the origin.
